title: A New Den — Transcript

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Reef different now. Petra mauled by grief, loss of her Queen. Same for House Wolves. Banner is torn, Kell is dead. And so they seek a cave to call home.
Valley Of the Kings, Meridian Bay. Mars

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Fallen Houses must hunt. Prowl, scavenge, defend. House Devils has Earth. House Winter has Venus. And now Wolves claim Mars. Cabal will not be pleased.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: Guardian, stop! I'm reading a large platoon of Cabal soldiers just over that ridge.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Welcome to the front, Petra. You are well?

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: Well enough. Guardian, you're more or less clear to the base entrance. Stay alert. The legion is mobilizing all across the planet's surface.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: You are close. They will have your scent now. Be wary.
Iron Line — Guardian finds the Fallen

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: There! Clear them out. You can't let them take that base.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: Very nice, Guardian. And thank you for giving me something else to think about. She never would have said it out loud, but the Queen respected you a great deal.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: As do I. Wolves here broken, but still more remain. Will continue to track and look for signs of new leader, new Kell.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A New Frontier — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Let's get started. There's a banner on the main floor. Give it a look, will you?
In a side chapel of the church

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is a House of Judgment sigil. We used to work with a Fallen who flew this banner

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Curious. Well, the Fallen seem to have put this up as a bit of a threat. I imagine you'll find lots of objects like this out there with a bit of story to them. We both need some supplies to get going out here. See if you can find a cache in one of the buildings nearby.
The Guardian finds a loot chest

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Very well done. To survive we'll have to look for every opportunity. Keep your eyes peeled for more supplies in the wilds. Speaking of the wilds, there's a symbol on the wall of the church. Take a look.
The Guardian heads back to the church and finds a symbol on the wall at the back of the ambulatory.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Devrim, where did this symbol com from?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I believe your City Hunters must have put them here and there about the region as they scouted around. I think they meant it to mark something special. Or dangerous.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Or both. Let's go check it out.
The Guardian heads into tunnels beneath the church

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: The history of this region is fascinating. I believe tunnels and caves like the one you're now in stretch all across the EDZ. Who knows what's lurking down there. Be careful.
The Guardian explores The Atrium and defeats Skexis, Outcast Captain of The Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I just snagged a keycode from that Captain. I think I can open his supply cache!
The Guardian opens the supply cache

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Good work down there, you two. Keep an eye out for other hidey holes and treasures like this one! But that's for another day. In the meantime what say we get down to business? Come on back up to the church tower. I'm putting the kettle on now.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Garden World — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: This is our only chance. We can use the Infinite Forest against the Vex, or… we prepare for the end.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I'm calculating where to send us. The place is easy. Finding a simulation of the right time is a little tricky.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Alright, find the algorithm that produced the Forest. That will lead you to Panoptes.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex will know they're at their most vulnerable here. This simulation will be well defended.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The point in history where you invent a reality engine? There's nothing more important.
Guardian traverses the Infinite Forest, and enters the tree leading to the Simulant Past.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex have been two steps ahead of us so far. But you and Ikora have given us a chance to actually SURPRISE them. That's impressive.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: So I guess what I'm saying is, when this is all over, I might miss being your Ghost. Just a little.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: All right, we have to get to the top of that tower, and download the algorithm before the Vex create the Infinite Forest.
Guardian begins to force their way into the Spire.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Remember how I said the Vex anticipate everything? They have automated intruder countermeasures here. They'll react and block anything we do. Be unpredictable.
Guardian fights their way through the security measures and enters the Spire

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: We're in! Let's get to the top and find that algorithm.
Guardian reaches the top and confronts Dendron, Root Mind.
After a long, drawn-out engagement, Guardian destroys Dendron.
Guardian ascends to the very peak of the Spire, and plugs Sagira into the network.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Scanning… isolating Panoptes' patterns, overlaying onto the map…

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Annndd….Got him! Panoptes always ends up in the same coordinates. It's over, this is how we beat the Vex!

lines.speaker: Projection
lines.text: I've detected a change. A new future, I will inform Osiris.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Wait, a defensive subroutine? New reality branches forming… No. No!
Panoptes appears, and begins to pull Sagira out of the shell.
Panoptes and Sagira disappear in a flash of blinding light.
Guardian and Ghost find themselves outside the gate to the Infinite Forest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Where are we? Mercury? How did we get back here? Last thing I remember, we were in the EDZ, we found that device and then— WHAM. Oh I feel so strange, like someone's rearranged all the furniture in the house, except the house is my brain.
Guardian tries to force their way back into the Forest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right, look, I'd never thought I'd have to ask this but—who else has been inside my head? Accessing memory core… Huh. You've been busy. Correction: you've been busy without me. I don't know how to feel about that.
Guardian fails to push their way into the Forest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait a second. There's something else in here with me. Encoded holoimages… big ones, definitely Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look, I can't decrypt those files, or open the gate. We need backup, we need Ikora.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Good idea right? You're welcome. Wait… why did I just say that?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Mysterious Disturbance — Transcript

lines.text: Eris Morn traverses a cavern beneath the Moon's surface. She finds what appears to be an artificial surface among the rocks and touches it. The cavern begins to rumble and part of the wall breaks away, letting in light to the cavern. As Eris turns away from the light, a strange Phantom appears before her.
The Guardian travels to the Moon in response to an alert from Commander Zavala.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Attention, all Guardians: last night, we detected a seismic disturbance on the Moon. Within hours, it was swarming with Hive. This plague must not be allowed to spread.
The Guardian arrives on the Moon, alongside several other Guardian jumpships and Vanguard transports.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Hive pour onto the surface of our Moon from the Keep. That is where our disturbance originated. We will investigate, but first we must regain a lunar foothold. For some of you, this is all too familiar. But do not let the atrocities of Crota haunt you. Whatever this is, we will not let the tragedies of our past repeat themselves.
The Guardian defeats the Hive together with other Guardians and several Redjack Frames.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Hive appear to be retreating. Commander, these Hive are erratic. Scattered.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: They lack leadership. Crota's death left a void they have yet to fill. But the disturbance seems to have emboldened them. They must be stopped.
The Guardian heads towards the next area, where they find Eye of the Swarm, a huge Shrieker, as well as a portal and six Annihilator Totems.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hive are coming from that portal ahead. Let's shut it down.
Gothrax, Protector of the Swarm appears. The Guardian defeats Gothrax, Protector of the Swarm. The Guardian drains the six Hive vigils under the Annihilator Totems.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shrieker's vulnerable. Now's our chance.
The Guardian defeats the Eye of the Swarm.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Good work, Guardians. Thanks to you, we'll have an LZ up and running soon. In the meantime, press on towards the Keep.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Guardian. There's no time to lose.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: This "disturbance" — I know what triggered it. Who triggered it. Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris is back on the Moon?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris? She disappeared before the Red War. She's here?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Last I heard from her, she was headed into the Keep. I don't even know if she's still —

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Before we can gain access to the Keep, you'll need to clear the surrounding area. Assistance is on its way.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Commander, was the Vanguard aware of the Hive's activity on the Moon before the disturbance?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We've been closely monitoring their progress, but had not yet discovered the purpose of this Scarlet Keep.
Another Eye of the Swam Shrieker appears. Vanguard transports deploy three Drake Tanks. The Guardian uses a Drake Tank to defeat the Eye of the Swarm and the Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The path is clear. Ready to head into the Scarlet Keep.
The Guardian heads towards the Scarlet Keep.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris came to me. She'd found evidence of something very old on the Moon. A potential threat to humanity. Eris insisted on going alone. Just a scouting mission, she said. And I let her. Eris is resilient. She's proven that again and again. Often to her own detriment.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If anybody can take care of themselves, it's Eris Morn. [static] Ikora? We've lost her signal. That's strange.
The Guardian heads further into the cavern and sees a Phantom. The Phantom disappears.
The Guardian heads further into the cavern, defeating the Hive Thralls which they encounter, as well as two Nightmare Thralls.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Hive… they're not actually Hive. Their energy signature is entirely unfamiliar.
The Guardian heads further into the cavern, defeating the Hive Thralls which they encounter. The Guardian finds a way out of the cavern and sees several Phantoms hovering in the distance.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The source of our… disturbance… should be right around here.
The Guardian heads towards the source of the disturbance and finds a Pyramid.
If the player has not done the Invitations of the Nine

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What… is that? I've never seen anything like it. This must be what Eris was after.
If the player has done the Invitations of the Nine

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's… one of those Pyramids. It can't be. That should not be here. Eris must have gone inside.
The Guardian heads towards the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something's wrong. I feel strange. Like someone — or something — is invading my Light.
The Guardian enters an area closer to the Pyramid and sees a strange red orb in the distance.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That… thing across the way. What is that?
The Guardian approaches the red orb.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's some sort of massive energy spike here. It's too heavy for us to pass through.
Nightmare of Crota, Son of Oryx, appears.

The Guardian fights against the Nightmare of Crota, Son of Oryx. After damaging the Nightmare of Crota, the Nightmare of Crota shields itself and heals the damage it has taken. The Guardian receives an unknown essence from the Nightmare of Crota.
Nightmare of Dominus Ghaul and Nightmare of the Fanatic appear next to the Nightmare of Crota.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can't win. We have to go. Now.
Eris Morn teleports the Guardian away from the Nightmares. The Guardian exits from a portal and finds Eris Morn, along with a Phantom hovering nearby.

lines.speaker: The Guardian
lines.text: Eris Morn. What is that Pyramid?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You've heard the stories. Of the Traveler's sacrifice. Of Darkness descending upon humanity. Before us lies a dark remnant of their existence. Was it struck down by the Traveler? Left here on purpose? The truth is ours to discover.
The Guardian speaks to Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ghaul… The Fanatic… Crota. Like living nightmares, your past confronts you, Guardian. Old scars reopen around me as well. Phantoms of my friends return with a malice they never truly had. Every one of them, the twisted will of that looming Pyramid. We must not let it distract us from our goal: finding a way inside. Together, we have conquered our enemies. We will do it again.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ghaul… The Fanatic… Crota. Like living nightmares, your past confronts you, Guardian. Old scars reopen around me as well. Phantoms of my friends return with a malice they never truly had. Every one of them, the twisted will of that looming Pyramid. We must not let it distract us from our goal: finding a way inside. We're in this together now. Nothing can stop us.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Guardian Rises — Transcript

lines.text: A human spacecraft enters Mars’ orbit and descends onto its surface during the “present day”. Three armed astronauts exit the spacecraft. The astronauts traverse the Martian landscape until they find the Traveler. Rain begins to fall on Mars.

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: We called it the Traveler, and its arrival changed us forever. Great cities were built on Mars and Venus. Mercury became a garden world. Human lifespan tripled. It was a time of miracles. We stared out at the galaxy and knew that it was our destiny to walk in the light of other stars - but the Traveler had an enemy. A Darkness, which had hunted it for eons across the black gulfs of space. Centuries after our Golden Age began, this Darkness found us and that was the end of everything. But it was also a beginning.
Ghost searches for his Guardian amongst the wreckage of cars. Several Fallen are shown in the distance. Ghost scans a skeleton in one of the cars.
Ghost continues searching for his Guardian. A Fallen Captain tracks Ghost from afar. Ghost finds his Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian… Guardian? Eyes up, Guardian! It worked… You’re alive! You don’t know how long I’ve been looking for you. I’m a Ghost. Actually, now I’m your Ghost. And you… Well, you’ve been dead a long time. So, you’re going to see a lot of things you won’t understand.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is Fallen territory. We aren’t safe here. I have to get you to the City. Hold still.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Don’t worry, I’m still with you. We need to move, fast.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We won’t survive long out in the open like this. Let’s get inside the Wall.
If the Guardian doesn’t head to the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I didn’t bring you back just for you to die again, we have to move.
If the Guardian doesn’t head to the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You can hear me right? We are going to die out here. I need you to trust me on this. We’ll be safer inside.
The Guardian heads inside the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay… I need to find you a weapon before the Fallen find us.
The Guardian goes up the stairs and enters a larger area within the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hang tight. Fallen thrive in the dark, we won’t. We need more light. I’ll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Another one of these hardened military systems… And a few centuries of entropy working against me.
Ghost turns on the lights. Fallen are shown nearby, heading towards the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here! I found a rifle! Grab it.
The Guardian acquires a Khvostov 7G-02 auto rifle.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I hope you know how to use that thing.
The Guardian continues through the Wall. A strange sound is heard.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen which they encounter while continuing through the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There’s more ahead! Keep it up!
The Guardian finds a loot cache.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A loot cache! Let’s see what’s inside…
The Guardian acquires a Preacher Mk. 20 shotgun.
The Guardian continues through the Wall and finds several tripmines.
The Guardian continues through the Wall, defeating the Fallen which they encounter.
The Guardian engages another group of Fallen Devils.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Fallen have a tighter hold on this place than I thought. Just a little bit further. Let’s hope there’s something left out there…
The Guardian finds a way out of the Wall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This was an old Cosmodrome. There’s got to be something we can fly out here.
A red flare is shot into the sky.
A Fallen Ketch appears above the Cosmodrome and a Skiff deploys several Fallen units.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fallen ships! This close to the surface?! Move!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I’m picking up signs of an old jumpship. Could be our ticket out of here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There’s a ship! Clear them out!
Rahn, Devil Captain appears. The Guardian defeats Rahn, Devil Captain.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Alright, let me see if I can get us out of here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It’s been here a while. Hasn’t made a jump in centuries. We’re lucky the Fallen haven’t completely picked it clean.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay… It’s not going to break orbit, but it just might get us to the City. Now - about that transmat…
The Guardian turns around. Riksis, Devil Archon appears from a hole in a wall nearby.
Ghost transmats the Guardian into the jumpship.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can come back for them when you’re ready. Let’s get you home.
The Guardian departs in the jumpship. The Exo Stranger watches as the jumpship flies away. The Guardian flies to the Last City and arrives at the Tower.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Welcome to the last safe City on Earth - the only place the Traveler can still protect. It took centuries to build. Now… we’re counting every day it stands. And this Tower is where the Guardians live.

title: A Rising Tide: Eliksni Quarter Community Event — Transcript

lines.text: Tower Courtyard, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian responds to a Vanguard request and reports to the Tower. A message from Mithrax awaits.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian! This is Misraaks, and I require your assistance. I am close to a breakthrough with the relics of Nezarec, but I must concentrate, and there are civic duties that cannot be neglected. I must ask that you work alongside… someone… with experience. Managing a community—

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: All right, Misraakskel, uh… I'll take it from here. Guardian, you claimed piles of valuables from the pirates. Now it's time to put it all to good use. We're asking the whole Vanguard to collect treasure from around the system and bring it back here. Misraaks has trusted me to allocate the funds to improve the Last City, starting with the Eliksni Quarter. [chuckles] He knows I've got a head for business. I think we can make this place sparkle… but only if we all chip in, you get me? Teamwork, Guardian. Don't be selfish now! Bring me everything you can get your hands on. And, uh… may the Light provide.
Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal I
lines.text: Cleanup. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter to check on the results. Several Warmind frames are present, sweeping up.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: How wonderful. Spider is already putting the Guardians' generous donations to good use. There is… justice in using treasure stolen by Eramis's pirates to improve our lives here. Somehow, I think even Eramis herself would approve. Ah… this fills me with hope. May this be but the first of many improvements.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal II
lines.text: The Ether Tank. The Guardian visits The Ether Tank, which is now well-stocked and decorated.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Ah, good. Spider took my advice and made some improvements to The Ether Tank. Eido would have preferred a library, but… sometimes entertainment should come before edification. A social space is important. This is now a comfortable place for citizens to relax and speak openly to their neighbors… and Spider does make an excellent Ether Fizz.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal III
lines.text: Comforts. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter. Behind The Ether Tank are paintings which used to reside in The Spider's safehouse.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Ah, this is where Spider is keeping his treasures. He was speechless when I asked him to ship in some of his trinkets from the Tangled Shore. I told him his collection is part of our culture. Eido showed me that one should not deny the past, but rather grow from it. And there is nothing wrong with cherishing the comforts of one’s home. Even Spider deserves to be comfortable.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal IV
lines.text: Recruits. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter and approaches Spider's Associates near the side door of the Ether Tank.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Look there: the first Eliksni to undergo Vanguard security training. Yes, there was some unrest when Ikora first welcomed us here. But this is about more than security. The Eliksni are being accepted by the Tower. The hatchlings and children of the City now see Human and Eliksni faces protecting them. May they serve with pride.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal V
lines.text: Housing. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter and is directed to a raised ruin. It overlooks new Eliksni additions to the buildings in the area's outskirts.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Look, Guardian. Do you see the additions to the buildings in the distance? New homes for both our people, here… beneath the Great Machine. They say that when a fireteam of Guardians assembles, they can kill a god. But when all the Guardians band together… they can achieve so much more.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal VI
lines.text: Garden. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter and finds Eliksni tending to a garden.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: [chuckles] A garden? Spider told me I would enjoy his latest improvement, and… and he was correct. This is more than food for those in the Last City. We have plenty already. This little garden will bring our community closer than ever before. From this humble soil… we will grow hope.

lines.speaker: The community completes Goal VII
lines.text: Town Square. The Guardian visits the Eliksni Quarter, where decorations, benches, and a podium have been arranged around the wreckage of Insurrection Prime.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: This simple place… a town square, you may call it, but to us, it is so much more. A place for community meetings. An open-air school. There will be lectures, forums, debates! And I will invite all the citizens of the Last City to attend. Spider built it here, standing in defiance of the conflicts of our past. May this signal a new era of understanding for all who live beneath the Great Machine. Thank you, Guardian. You have performed the greatest of kindnesses.
Awaken, Queensguard: Meet with Mara Sov

title: 1AU — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches and lands on the Almighty using Thumos' ship

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala's troops are getting into position around the city. But they can't attack until we shut this thing down. So. Ready when you are, partner.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We made it. We're on the Almighty.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Good. You must find the ship's central core and disable its weapons system. Your best option will be to follow the fuel stream.
The weapon seems to charge up

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The weapon is already active! Are we too late?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Not yet. You need to disconnect the link between the Almighty and the sun before it disrupts the sun's magnetic field
The Guardian extends the bridge over the fuel stream pushing further into The Almighty.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Our forces are moving into position outside the City walls. Your signal will start the assault.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll get the job done, Commander.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That tunnel over there should lead us straight to the central core.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It looks like the Red Legion are using the planet Mercury as fuel.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Strip mining the solar system? That's… kind of impressive.
The Guardian picks up a fusion cell

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's radioactive and unstable. Don't hold onto it for too long.
The Guardian quickly deposits it in the power plant activating the ore tunnel. The Guardian kills Purifier Vurst.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ore tunnels are clear. We can follow the fuel to the weapon's core.
The Guardian walks down the ore tunnel

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These rocks… It's hard to believe that this is one of our planets ground up under our feet.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: There's still plenty of planet left. We'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Zavala, your group is in position at the City's perimeter.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Understood. Preparing to go radio silent. We can't give the Red Legion any warning. Guardian, I will do all I can to reclaim our home. If we do not meet again… know how proud I am of what you have done.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sooo… the only way to get where we're going is— out there.
Stepping out onto the sun exposed deck

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Stay in the shadows. The shadows!
The Guardian traverses the exterior safely

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: It is time for me to go, Guardian. You know your path. You don't need our guidance anymore. If my journey ends today, then I will face it gladly.
The Guardian continues to push towards the core

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey, Hawthorne says we're reaching our insertion point. And I'm not big on goodbye scenes. So you do… what you gotta do. Make it out alive, OK? I need someone who gets my jokes.
The Guardian enters a large room

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: See those tubes? That's how we get to the weapon core.
Bruiser Thurn is defeated and the Guardian approaches one of the tubes to jump in.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Interceptors! It's like they're begging us to blow this place up.
Ghost sees the energy weapon up close

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The thermal exchangers. Take them out and the weapon will over heat!
As the weapon cycles through a lower power mode

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The vents are blocking our shots! Wait for them to open!
The Guardian destroys the first thermal exchange
The second thermal exchange is destroyed.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's two. Last one should be ventilating the core.
The third thermal exchange is destroyed.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Temperature levels are rising, but it's not enough. We need to disrupt the core itself.
The Guardian finds a fusion cell

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A fusion cell! We'll use that to overload the electron reservoir.
The Guardian deposits the fusion cell into the electron reservoir.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm bringing the ship around. Run!
The Guardian starts to run for the ship

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala, the weapon is destroyed! Start the attack!
The Guardian makes it to the ship

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're done here. Let's go home.
A cabal is distracted by a chicken and killed by Cayde-6.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Heh! That's a good job, Colonel.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: What's that now, seven in a row?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Ehh, who needs the Light when you've got a fine-feathered friend by your side? Am I right? Am I right or am I right? I'm right.
The incursion team push further into the city, getting into place to attack a Cabal squad guarding a gate.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: OK. Yeah. That's the rally point where I'll set up the teleporter. Zavala and Ikora should be at their marks by now.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: As are we. Ikora, ready when you are.
A rocket kills a Cabal soldier as Ikora and two other guardian perform a drive by on sparrows to drop a grenade into the group. Hawthorne shoots the grenade
Hawthorne, Cayde-6 and a group of survivors move up their position. Ikora and the other sparrows draw more attention, avoiding enemy fire.
Zavala leads a team straight through the gate meeting a squad of Cabal.

A skirmish ensues. Zavala grapples with a Cabal, using its own weapon to kill it before he is swiped by a centurion. A Cabal steps on Zavala's chest, preparing to shoot him but his head explodes. Hawthorne comes in and helps Zavala up.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: What's with you Guardian falling down all the time?
A spotlight pins Hawthorne and Zavala down in cover

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: If he's sticking to the plan…
The Cabal is thrown from the roof revealing Cayde-6 giving a thumbs up

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: …he's right where he needs to be. Now we just gotta get you and Ikora up there with him.
Suddenly a Cabal shield divides the group.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Well, this changes things. I'll work on this, you need to get moving!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ikora, Cayde is in place and I'm en route. Good luck… Guardian.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: Ghaul. The enemy attacks the city… and the Almighty is lost!

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: Laid waste. By the very same Guardian that somehow managed to reclaim its power and has been humiliating our forces throughout this cursed system. You would know this if you hadn't been wasting your time communing with the machine and the creature who claims to speak with it.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: My tone? Hah! We will fail in our mission to secure this power— And deliver our people. For the first time in the glorious history of the Red Legion— Fail! Because of you and your preoccupations. Look at your Traveler, Dominus. The cage is complete. The time is now. Claim what is rightfully yours and take this power.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Tell me, Speaker. What more does the Traveler want of me?

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: Ghaul. I speak… for… the Traveler. I never said it spoke to me.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: This fixation is over! You have already been chosen, not by some inert machine… but by ME! I chose you the day I found you. Remember who you are. What you are. You are Cabal! Cabal wait for nothing. You WILL take the Light. Do what you swore and give me the vengeance you promised. Look at me, student! Look at me!

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: I will do what I swore, old friend. I am Ghaul. And I will take the Light.
Ghaul regards the Traveler as The Speaker and Consul's bodies lie on the floor.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Traveler. What's happening to it? Zavala, we're back and ready to-
Thumos's ship which the Guardian is flying gets hit by weapons fire. Ghost safely transmats them out.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Shadow Overhead — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The day we've been dreading has finally arrived. The Darkness is here. We need boots on the ground on Io. Recon. There's a Pyramid… It's already disabled Rasputin. I'd lean on Eris's expertise, but we haven't been able to reach her. We both know what that means. Eris is our best chance at understanding what we're up against. I need her at the Tower. She's too valuable an asset to… Find her, Guardian. Bring her home.
The Guardian arrives on Io witnessing a Pyramid close to the surface.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris Morn. A Guardian without a Ghost. I wonder how that must feel. Hollow. Unnatural. When I look at that ship… Eris, can you hears us? Eris? … Nothing. Zavala, come in.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: My signals are being suppressed. I can't even summon a Sparrow.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Pyramid. It's… oppressive. Like a storm building.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Then be quick. Get out ahead of it.
The Guardian observes arc storms beneath the Pyramid and a light coming from the area known as "Last Eden." The Guardian is pulled towards the Pyramid.
The Pyramid speaks through the Guardian's Ghost.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You bring weapons. You will not need them. We offer only truth. We will ha — [static]
Court of Savathûn, Ascendant Plane, Io
An Ascendant Portal appears and the Guardian floats into it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something pulled us out of the beam! What's happening? What is this place?
The Guardian discovers multiple massive shriekers called Savathûn's Witness and is teleported out of the Ascendant Plane.
The Guardian continues to search for Eris.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're back on Io. Close to the Cradle…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm — I'm getting faint readings from Eris now. Let's keep moving. The air down here is choked with strange communications. I don't know if I can —

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're needed back at the Tower. Zavala sent us —

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Of course he did. I'm moving towards the Cradle. It calls to me.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive are frenzied. [thrumming static] … cut through them. We mu— [whirring interference]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala? Did you catch that? [radio static] This interference… I can't triangulate a point of origin. Keep going. Maybe the signal is better up ahead.
Savathûn's Witness appears. The Taken attack the area.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian, your assistance would not be unwelcome! There are forces at play here I do not fully understand. The Hive — [grotesque Hive screaming] Aah!
Ogre Ascendant appears. The Guardian defeats Ogre Ascendant and Savathûn's Witness moves towards the Cradle.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, talk to us. Say something.
The Guardians discovers the Tree at the Cradle. Savathûn's Witness appears. The Guardian goes to the base of the Tree and is teleported into the Ascendant Plane.
Court of Savathûn, Ascendant Plane, Io

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something pulled us back in. It's keeping us from Eris!
The central Savathûn's Witness disappears and multiple Savathûn's Witness shriekers begin attacking the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There are too many of them!
The Guardian is teleported out of the Ascendant Plane.
The Guardian approaches Eris Morn beneath the Tree.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It… is nothing. But this. This is something. A Tree of Silver Wings. It grew from the last place the Traveler touched before it left this world. The Darkness was drawn here. As the Hive is drawn to the Darkness. These eyes of mine. The things they have seen…
Eris attempts to claim the Seed of Silver Wings and is denied.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Something that does not want us here.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. But it is of the Darkness. It has to be you, this time.
The Guardian claims the Seed of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: [static] … anyone's there! I repeat: Come in.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Seed breaks through the interference…

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Report back to me in the Tower, both of you. Our transmissions may be compromised.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Let's not keep him waiting, Guardian.
The Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
Erin Morn approaches Zavala in his office.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It found me. The Darkness reached out to me, but something interferes. Its messages to us are being defaced.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: By the witch-sister of the Taken King Oryx: Savathûn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. She feeds on denial. Ignorance. The Guardian has discovered a means to circumvent her: a seed of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If the Dark reaches out, we must reach back.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are beyond sanctions. It is here. I will return to Io. If we cannot determine what the Darkness seeks, we will find ourselves on the verge of a Second Collapse. Perhaps that is what Savathûn wants.
Eris Morn leaves through a portal. The Guardian enters Zavala's office.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: According to spectral analysis, the Pyramid… Its propulsion… the energy its manipulating on Io… I don't see a ship. I see a being… Paracausal in nature.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All records of the Golden Age agree: On the first day, the sky filled with darkness. On the second, the Traveler fell.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Help Eris where you can, but be ready to deal with the enemy fleet when it arrives. We need you, Guardian.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
The Taken Path | Taken Osseus Fragments
The Taken Path | Taken Osseus Fragments

title: A Hero’s Welcome — Transcript

lines.text: Hanger, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Saint-14 after he returns to the Last City.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Look at this place! I cannot believe what the City has become. To be home again. To hear of the Red War and see the scars. So much has changed. I was not here when the City needed me most. But regret does not serve us. We must look to the future. We must find hope again. There is no more time to waste. On my journey here, I wondered how the City could best use me. Now I think I know. Together, we will shine brighter. We will build a beacon to call all who are lost home. You will fight, and I will build. But for now… my skull needs rest.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Spooky Good Time — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Eva Levante
lines.text: Hello again! Lots has happened since we last met, hm? An old friend came home. The Moon is infested again! And the Vex are invading, tsk-tsk-tsk. These are all important things. But, as always, it is also very important to remember those who have left us. And… to look forward, with hope in our hearts. That is the purpose of this festival. A holiday about death and loss, yes, but also… hidden identities. Beautiful lanterns. And candy! Have fun, my love.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Stranger's Call — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Our new friend must have access to extraordinary methods to reach out to us like that. The radio message she sent came from somewhere in the jungles of Venus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't like us getting dragged out here and not being able to get the lay of the land. There used to be a Guardian outpost nearby. Let's see what they have on this place.

There's a lot here about some war machines called the Vex. Indestructible, relentless, supremely intelligent. And they can teleport. Great. Guardians used to have sensors to track them. Let's get them back online.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vex sensors should be up ahead.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK. I should be able to track these machines. Let's head to those coordinates and find out what she wanted us to see.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The coordinates lead here? What is it? Let me get a close look.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fascinating. A conflux of non-baryonic streams going... where?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh no! No! No! It's the Vex! Better find some cover...

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What are these things? Are there any still intact that I can analyze?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why have you been watching us?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I don't even have time to explain why I don't have time to explain. –I will, I will. I know.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I wasn't talking to you, little light.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Many Guardians fell. Strong ones. But you made it here –Yes, I'm listening. They are here. With me.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: Is that why you brought us here?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: They brought us here. The Vex. Evil so dark it despises other evil.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: No. I was not forged in light. But I believe where our paths cross ground could break. Have you heard of the Black Garden?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The greatest threat to us all lies there, where these machines are born. Find the Black Garden. Rip out its heart. Only then will your Traveler begin to heal.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: Can you help us find it?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: My path's my own. I can't.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If we're going to find the Black Garden we need to see the Awoken.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ah yes. The Awoken. Out there, wavering between the Light and the Dark. A side should always be taken, little light. Even if it's the wrong side.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Too late. Returning. How many? Hold position, kill the engines, and don't let them find you.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: So, how do we find the Awoken?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They live all the way out at the edge of the Darkness. Last place the Light touches. Can't we just stay here with the murderous robots?
Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ

title: Act I - Prologue |  Na-Veskirisk — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Eyes up, Guardian. We’re responding to a distress call from House Salvation civilians. They wouldn’t ask us for help if it wasn’t so dire, so let’s use our leverage wisely. This is a humanitarian mission, so hold fire on all Eliksni targets. Good luck.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: The Hidden report that Eramis is on-site. Your orders are to take her… alive. Now I know she’s caused a lot of damage, but killing her will only harden anti-human sentiment. I’m not turning my first op as Hunter Vanguard into a bloodbath.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This is bizarre, Guardian. It’s not an attack, it’s a roundup. But new Scorn only come from dead Eliksni. So why do they want the prisoners alive?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: House Salvation ships are bailing for Earth, and the H.E.L.M. just arrived to take on stragglers. There’s a lot of reasonable distrust of Eramis’ people, but I’m taking the long view. I want to prove that Hunters can build bridges, not just blow them up.
The Guardian frees the House Salvation prisoners.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: There’s something different about these Scorn. The freed civvies keep referring to them as “na-veskirisk”. Which translates to “not lifeless.” Not sure what they mean by that.
The Guardian pushes forward to find Eramis.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Xenobiological analysis is in: These Scorn are made of living tissue, Guardian. Not necrotic like normal. Na-veskirisk. Fikrul must have found a new source of power. Something paracausal.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Stand before me if you dare! I’ll send you back to the drift again and again!

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Since father Uldren, Scorn were born dead. Great Machine for Humans only. No more. Now I am blessed with Light. Power to make life!
The Guardian defeats the Revenant Scorn.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: House Salvation will never bow. Not to the Scorn, and not to the Vanguard!

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Eramis is getting away, Guardian. Chase her down!

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Damn. Fikrul got his hands on an Echo. He’s using it to mutate the Ether of living Eliksni. That explains this new breed of Scorn, and why he wants the captives alive. For now, let’s keep our eyes on the prize. Eramis is cornered. I’m coming down to personally negotiate her surrender. Standby.
The Guardian provides backup for Crow.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Good work, Guardian. This has been a long time coming. Eramiskel. It’s not for me to judge you, but… I speak for the people of the Last City now. They’re demanding justice for all the people you’ve harmed — Guardians and civilians both. And it’s my job to deliver you.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: [scoffs] The “justice” of thieves and oppressors. What hypocrisy. Your blades are covered in the Ether of my kin.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Think of the kin you have left. They’re aboard the H.E.L.M. right now, and they need you. You can’t abandon them. Besides, if I came back without you, Eido would never forgive me.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: If I come quietly, you will guarantee safe harbor for my people?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: As long as they disarm and live peacefully with House Light… they’ll be safe in the City. You have my word.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I expect the Guardian to enforce that. Now take me to Eido.
Crow, Eramis, and the Guardian transmat to the H.E.L.M. in a cutscene.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: All hands! This is the Hunter Vanguard. We have a high value prisoner on board and a House Salvation Ketch inbound. Prepare for boarding defense.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: We don’t want to fight your rescue team, Eramis; call them off.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I’m not the one in need of a rescue. One HE finds you… it’s too late.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Father! I bring a gift: the power to make all Eliksni our children! Reborn through extinction — risen as Scorn!
A virus consumes the Eliksni aboard the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Bow to Fikrul, Kell of Kells!
The Ketch crashes into the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: [grunts] We’ve lost steering — we’re going down!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I am assuming control of this vessel, due to a comprehensive failure of Arc conduit systems and my extensive experience with crash landings. Please brace for turbulence as we slam directly into—
Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say
Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say

title: Act I - Prologue | Mithrax & Variks — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Misraaks, Variks transmats in.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I greet you in the Light, Guardian. I regret that you must see me like this. Eido insists that this is slowing the curse, but… it is no cure.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Mm. Much Eliksni medicine was forgotten. [chitters] Eido seeks a remedy in secrets of Old Riis.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: There are few still living who know the ways of our old home.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramiskel remembers. Captured by the Guardian this day. She will help.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Her love for the Eliksni is poisoned by her hatred of the Great Machine.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: But now she will see wisdom in your path… yes? Safety with House Light. Protected by Guardians.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Safe… but not whole. I thought being near the Great Machine would help reclaim what we lost on Riis. But I look at our hatchlings now, living in the ruins of humanity, building lives from scrap. And I see that we are debased. Corrupted. Defiled! Doomed to meet our final end… as Scorn.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Trust in Eido. Variks teaches the ways of House Judgement. She will find old solutions to new problems. [chitters] You will see.
Variks transmats away and a cutscene of Old Riis plays.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Even after the Traveler fled our sky, and our world was swept away in horror, after our great Houses fell to betrayal and futile war, some Eliksni held hope for unity, and a future for our people. I do not know how much time remains to me. But if none challenge Fikrul, that dream is lost. Fikrul will condemn Eliksni to decay and ruin. We will be a dead people, ruled over by the dead. My life is for my daughter, and my House. Let them see that I still believe the old stories. Old stories tell that when Riis was threatened by dangers no weapon could defeat it, the Kells would call upon… a Slayer Baron… one possessed of forgotten knowledge, capable of impossible feats… one who can stand against an unrelenting foe. Does that not describe you well, my friend? So much of our history is tale and myth. But the Scribe Variks remembers much. And what he cannot recall, Eido will help you uncover. I name you my Slayer Baron, and I beg of you: defend our House. Defend our people. Deliver them from this second Whirlwind. And when the time comes… deliver them from my curse.

title: Act I - Prologue | Onslaught: Salvation  — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian, the Scorn are imprisoning Salvation Eliksni. You are needed to stabilize their defenses.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I pulled rank to get you an Advanced Defense Unit on short notice. Think I ruffled a few feathers, so let’s make it worthwhile.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: We must prove that Eramis is not the only Kell who offers hope to the Eliksni.
The Guardian rescues the Eliksni from the Revenant Scorn.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Your support is many-armed, as always, Guardian! Thank you for representing my father as his Slayer Baron. I've left you something for your trouble.
The Guardian defeats the Etherbound Familiar.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Guardians, you do us honor with your service. Eliksni have long memories. We will remember this.

lines.speaker: Spider
lines.text: Oh ho! Look at you, all grown up. From deputy of the “Shore’s Only Law” to…what’s your title now? Eh, I’ve never been clear.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I wasn’t your deputy. I was your property.

lines.speaker: Spider
lines.text: Let’s not go saying things we can’t take back. Besides, it all turned out for the best, didn’t it?

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Which you had nothing to do with. But… I’m not a petty person, Spider. And this, whatever it is you’re doing right now? It’s a petty person’s game. And I’m done playing your games.
Act I - Prologue | Speak with Mithrax
Act I - Prologue | Speak with Mithrax

title: A Key Awaits — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian enters the Queen's throne room

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: It is alive...and still has its ball...

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: There is no shame in running away, Guardian. Apart from the cowardice and failure of it, it's an excellent strategy.
The Queen and Uldren Sov exchange looks of confusion

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Was no Gate Lord slain, brother?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, we slayed a Gate Lord!
The Ghost transmats the Vex head into the throne room.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: We need to find the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Hmph...they don't even know where it is.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Let us tell them. Search the Gate Lord for that which gains them entrance.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Why?! If you wish them certain death, just kill them here!

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Often, when we guess at others' motives, we reveal only our own.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: My motive is simply loyalty, to a people, a Queen and a sister.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Then, please. Take what is required.
Uldren Sov draws his knife and plunges it in the Gate Lord, ripping out the eye and smiling as its glow disappears.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Dead, unfortunately. A wasted journey, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Perhaps, but I think these ones resourceful. We gift it, in sympathy for their Traveler.
Uldren Sov turns away from his sister, scowls, and turns to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Mars. Eighty-Four North, Thirty-Two East, Meridian Bay.
Uldren Sov tosses the eye to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I have shown you benevolence, Guardian. Should the Awoken ever need an ally I will call on you. And expect you to answer.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: She's saying you owe us, Guardian.
The Guardian turns and leaves, their Ghost floating for a moment before following.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Good luck! Getting through the Exclusion Zone.

title: Act I - Prologue | Speak to Eido — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to Apothecary Eido

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: So much has happened… I can’t believe the H.E.L.M. is gone. At last we managed to salvage a small section of the ship from Europa. We couldn’t leave poor Failsafe alone out there again. We must operate out of the Last City for now. And so… Welcome to my Tonic Shop.

Petra has been helping me search through old records. Techeun research, even materials from the old House of Wolves. I found many references to tonics. Elixirs my forebears used to treat sickness or grant strength. This wasn’t common medicine. Old Riis was suffused with the Light of the Great Machine. Some of these ingredients must have been, too.

My father is… ailing. Nezarec’s curse works upon him day by day. But I know there’s a solution in here somewhere. I won’t give up until I find it. I hope my studies can be of some use to you as well. Whatever new power it is that Fikrul wields, we’ll need a way to counteract it.

For now, it may be helpful to study the Revenants that Fikrul creates. It’s… unsavory. But we have to start somewhere. I believe my father wants to speak with you. Please don’t let him know that I’m worried for him.

title: Act I - Prologue | Eido’s Gift — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I'm glad the City allowed us to build Variisis Core near the Market District. With this new lab and workshop, I was able to make you all kinds of equipment. I wish I could focus on curing my father, but Fikrul won't stop until all Eliksni are turned. We need to support your battle against the Revenants. Along with your title comes a gift: your Slayer Baron Apothecary Satchel. It may be small, but it's reinforced and filled with ingredients. May it protect you as you protect us.

Your tonic capsule stores all your tonic reagents in the field. And speaking of reagents, I've stocked the capsule with a few reagents to help get your started. When you're ready, head on over to the testing machine and give it a try. Now you're ready to forge a whole new Slayer Baron legend!

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I visited Eramis in her cell. We’ve been talking a little. I think we’re making progress. She’s been more responsive lately. You’ve been out there, protecting our people — even she has to admit that much.

I mentioned that I’ve been working with Variks to track down information about tonics. Eramis said she knew a couple of older Eliksni with knowledge of such things. If we could track down an Apothecary, it would speed up my research considerably.

In the meantime, Eramis also spoke of a Salvation enclave that might need our help. I sent Crow the coordinates. I… might have left out the part where Eramis gave them to us. I know, but… I think we can trust Eramis to look after the interests of her own people. I’m sure Crow will see that soon enough. Trust me on this?

title: Adieu — Transcript

lines.text: A Vision of the Traveler, Leviathan, Subclasses, and the European Dead Zone

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're alive… I thought I'd lost you.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can heal you, but I can't resurrect you. Not since…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They've taken the City, the Traveler, everything…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Red Legion is killing powerless Guardians.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have to get out of here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up an emergency broadcast. Rendezvous coordinates. They're evacuating the planet. We're on our own…
A falcon watches the Guardian before flying off

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Guardians… They had no chance without their powers. That could be us… Guardian — if you die… I can't resurrect you. We need to be very careful.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's that falcon again. Is it following us or are we following it?
A Cabal ship flies towards the City
The Guardian makes his way along the path, following the falcon
Guardian fights off Red Legion attack
Continuing down the path, the Guardian misses a jump and falls

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Oh look, somebody left a perfectly good Guardian lying around.
Hawthorne picks the Guardian up from the floor

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Things must be worse than I thought. And that's our cue. Time to go, people!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ah, but… Wait! Where… where are you all going?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: As far away from here as possible.
The falcon flies to Hawthorne's arm

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That falcon… it belongs to you?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: The name's Hawthorne. And this is Louis. Best pilot we got. What about you? Fit to fly?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Probably gonna need one of these, too.
Hawthorne throws the Guardian a shotgun

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: All right people, spin 'em up! Got a long flight ahead of us!

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Do you see, Traveler… all that I have done. Grace me with your Light. Take your place at the center of my empire! See me, and the Red Legion will be your true Guardians.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: Dominus! The city is secure. Those who fled are being hunted, and those foolish enough to remain have been executed. Victory, as with all things, is yours to claim.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: This victory is as much your as mine, old friend.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: All that remains is the completion of the cage around this great machine. Then we may begin the extraction of its power and put it to its rightful use.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: I would contend that other civilizations may be more precise in their naming. Its functions can be controlled and exploited, as we have so clearly proven.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Yet they believe it to be a god.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: Dominus… Ghaul… We have spent our lives, you and I, working to reshape our society, reforge our people, rebuild an empire nearly destroyed by Calus's greed and corruption. There is nothing in this universe greater than you! The Red Legion will have that machine's power. You will be called Emperor! What more would the Dominus have?

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: I would have words with my guest.
The Speaker descends from the ceiling in restraints

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: So, you're the one who speaks for the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Coming up one the European Dead Zone. Gonna be our new home for a while.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look! Do you recognize it? That's where we're supposed to go.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: That thing? They call it the Shard of the Traveler. I call it: "Not a place you want to go poking around."
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Act I - Prologue | Speak with Mithrax — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Fikrul and his minions continue to hunt down Eliksni across the Sol system. He does not seek to call them under his banner. He will warp their minds. Control them. They will kneel to him, willing or otherwise. Kell of Kells… Slayer Baron… These are old titles, but our faith in them holds strong. Even those in House Salvation will understand the role you play. Death came for Riis, and none could prevent it. But that does not have to be our future. I will not compel your obedience, Guardian. I beseech you, as kin. Join your sword arms to mine. Slayer Baron of House Light: Stand against those who would cast us into ruin. Cut down all those who would destroy our House. Carve a future for the living from the bones of the dead.

title: Adventure: Calling Them Home — Transcript

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Help me spread the work. We are broadcasting a signal from the Farm to people who fled the City saying "You'll be safe here".

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: And we need to make sure everyone, everywhere can hear it.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Place a few signal amplifiers around the area to boost the signal. That should do the trick.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Looks like the signal's already amped. That was fast.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Hang on a minute. I've spotted quite a few Fallen headed you way. Keep your guard up.
The Guardian defeats four Zealous Vandals.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Eliminating that Captain under the church must have drawn the rest of the Fallen out.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: They won't stop coming. We need to make sure that signal is strong. You better hurry up and place that second node.
The Guardian travels to the second area

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: This place used to be so peaceful. This is the first time I've even seen any Fallen since the Cabal hit us. Reminds me of the City. You all tried to make it so we never laid eyes on a Dreg. To keep us safe, right? There's another word for a place you're not allowed to leave — you know — with walls you can't see over and guards everywhere.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Suraya, despite your exploits there, I hardly think the City was a prison.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I'm just saying. No walls at the Farm. Come and go whenever you want. So, let's make sure everyone can get there, eh Guardian?
The Guardian drops the signal booster

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I read the boosted signal, and some kind of strange feedback. The Fallen are nothing if not persistent. I'd wager they have some sort of jamming devices nearby.
The Guardian disables the three jamming devices

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: There. I've got a clear signal. No more feedback.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Five by five here as well. Excellent work.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: It's nice to have a Guardian helping us normals for a change. But there's one more thing. Did I send those coordinates correctly?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've got them. Through the tunnel accross the river.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: That's the place. I left something behind there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We are almost to your coordinates, Hawthorne

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Good. I left supplies there that I had to abandon in a hurry a while back.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: For the City. But you all got attacked, I dropped everything and flew across the ocean to try and help. But the City sure doesn't need it anymore. We could use that stuff at the Farm.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Bad news Hawthorne. That Fallen beat us here.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: All right, forget the supplies. Clear out the Fallen and we'll figure out our next move.
The Guardian kills all the Fallen

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Not for long. The Fallen don't like it when they're denied a good scavenge. They're bound to come at you in force.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: The do me another favour you two. Drop another one of those node things to boost my signal., then get out of there.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: If you've made them mad, you're doing something right. Don't let up.
The Guardian kills Taksor, Scavenger Raider

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You Guardians really are something else. I guess I kinda forgot that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And now we know there are resources to be found in the EDZ. Once we retake the City, that will be a big help.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: What Suraya means to say is "thank you". Head back here when you can, you two. There's still quite a bit to do.

title: Adventure: A Frame Job — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, thanks for checking in you two! We've had our fill of Red Legion patrols and Fallen raids. We could use a spot of help with both.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: see if you can track down a Fallen comms terminal. Dev's got an idea that's crazy enough to work.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, it's difficult for the young to realise the wisdom of experience.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Excellent. What say you use your access to prepare a broadcast in Fallen-speak? I've been meaning to put this Cabal communications cipher to use.

lines.text: The Red Legion fighting the Fallen for a change? Great idea! I can extract archived audio transmissions from any Fallen in the area.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've got enough for a pretty convincing Fallen impression.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Don't mention accents around Dev unless you want a day-long lecture about City dialects. Meantime, best sightline to Red Legion air support is the cliffside where you and I set up that refugee beacon.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: No one appreciates the finer things anymore.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can't believe we have to go back into the mines again.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Chin up, you two! Good news; you'll be able to use a Fallen teleporter to reach the top. Ehh… Bad news, they've wired the place to explode.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If I run a deep scan of the tunnels, we can borrow all these traps and explosives.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: And put them to good use sowing chaos between you enemies. A lovely idea.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't blame you for wanting to blow everything up. Guess my deep scan will need to be a deep, deep scan, though. Got it. Now I can transmat these horribly dangerous explosives wherever we need.
Cliff at the top of The Salt Mines.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great work! Broadcasting the message now. I decided to go with a House of Devils accent. Remember them?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, House of Devils, eh? You know the most interesting thing about their pronunciation?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Actually, Devrim, let's keep the channel clear. You know. To, uh, make sure there's no interference during the transmat.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: lot of big red ships headed your way. Whatever your said, it got their attention.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I used a pretty nasty word to describe Ghaul. I don't want to repeat it here.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, I do so love unconventional warfare. I'd be on the lookout for drop pods, if I were you.
The Guardian ambushes the Red Legion, killing Drusk, the Crushing Fist.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I could hear the explosions all the way back here. I bet it was quite a show!

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Which means the Fallen and Red Legion heard it too. We'll let them shoot at each other for a while, and clean up whatever's left. Great work.

title: Adventure: Arecibo — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey Asher? Are you picking up anything strange on channel J-1869? Sounds kind of like music.

lines.speaker: Asher Mir
lines.text: Channel J what? No! No, I hear nothing of consequence on any of my scanners, including this one.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's weird. I bet I can track it back to the source.
Guardian approaches floating music box and entranced Vex

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Are they scanning that thing, or is it scanning them?

lines.text: There's a message encrypted in this music. Got it. Some kind of quotation, "Real things in the darkness seem no realer than dreams." Asher! Can you run an archive query for us? …Asher? …Channel's down. I'll run the query myself. So, it turns out, both the music and the quotation predate the Traveler's arrival in this solar system. They're old. Maybe we activated some sort of high-tech time capsule.

Guardian follows music to another floating music box

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's another old quotation encoded here: "Misdirected by accident or intent, intelligence can foster its own ecstasies of growth and decay." The weird thing is, this audio file was just updated. So… this cant be a time capsule. Someone's trying to talk to us. No, no. Some thing. This has to be an AI, right? An old Golden Age AI. Like Failsafe…
Subtitles say "An old Golden Age AI, here on Eden."
Quotations reference Parable of the Sower Octavia Butler, 1993
Guardian follows music to another floating music box, surrounded by sleeping Vex

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're asleep. The music must have hypnotized them.
Guardian examines the floating music box
The floating music box activates and the sleeping Vex are destroyed

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This one says, "Once war has been undertaken, no peace is made by pretending there is no war." What does that mean, "by pretending there is no war." I'm not sure I like the new guy.
Quotations reference Mahabharata circa 400 BC-200 AD
Vault doors open upon Guardian's approach

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Someone must be expecting us. Is anyone here? Rasputin?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You know, I'm going to be really disappointed if this is all just an elaborate trap to kill us.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Weaponized music… Creepy quotations… All signs point to Rasputin, but. I don't understand how he could be here.
Door opens to reveal another floating music box

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ah, that music… it hurts… just… give me a second… it says…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Never ask for anything! Never for anything, and especially from those who are stronger than you. They'll make the offer themselves, and give everything themselves.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't understand. Wait. Something's happening… Gah!
Ghost (overridden): Red Sands! Mars! Ice caps! Ahhhhhh!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey! Sorry, I spaced out for a second there. What were we doing?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Dark Alliance — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yello, Cayde speaking. Oh, hang on, someone left a note here. "EDZ forest. Taken energy, question mark. Red Legion… Brian." … Who's Brian?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Red Legion Psions. Guardian, we've heard disturbing reports from your area. They tell of Cabal with new powers.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That sounds ominous. We'll keep an eye out for any… unusual psionic energy nearby.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: We can figure out the connection later. For now, we must uncover the source of this energy.
The Guardian kills another specially shielded Centurion by killing the Psions to remove the impenetrable shield.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No good. Taken energy readings are increasing. I bet it's spreading to Psions all over the area.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If that's true, it could bring a plague of shadow beyond our imagining.
The Guardian kills a third specially shielded Centurion by killing the Psions to remove the impenetrable shield.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Got it! I've pulled location data from that Centurion. But we have to go… into the forest.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You sure about that buddy? Don't wanna get, you know, eaten by a creepy Taken shadow tree.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Cayde, what exactly happened to you on Nessus?
The Guardian heads into the Dark Forest

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: No, they did not "get eaten yet". But use caution. We don't know what's waiting in that forest.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: My glimmer's on something big and Taken.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That may be the safest bet you've made in years.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That portal connects to the forest. The Psions found a way to force it open!

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Well, it was nice knowing you.
The Guardian goes through the portal and finds more Psions and Centurions

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Did you see that? He got stunned when we took out his Psion.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Severing their bond must cause a backlash to the host. Interesting.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Am I the only one who has no idea what any of you are talking about?
The Guardian passes through another Taken portal looking for the Psionic source.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, there are a lot more Cabal than I was expecting.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: They may not like you trespassing in their secret magic fort.
The Guardian discovers Prusk, The Unequaled Maul

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Big Taken. Taken Cabal! Big… Taken Cabal!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: A Colossus. Of course. You must destroy it.
The Guardian focuses fire on the Corrupted Bonded Psions to bring down Prusk's shield to kill him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whew! We did it. They're all gone.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: That'll set the Legion back a ways. Serve's 'em right for messing with things they don't understand.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Which is your area of expertise. As for you Guardian; well done. If that brute had gotten loose with the Psions, there may have been no stopping it.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: And then I couldn't have collected on that bet! Big and Taken. Told you.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: My crews know how to get'er done, Sloane. Regular maintenance is the difference between a Sparrow that races and a Sparrow that rusts.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Sure. But this rig isn't winning any races. That Knight is in my way. Take it out.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: New Hive spells. Just what we need. Get after it you two.
The Guardian finds Takul-Dar, the Unbreakable Hive Knight again, protected by another Necromantis Wizard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is just irritating. Now I know how the Cabal feel about us.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm not in the mood for this. Keep after him. Their spell can't keep that thing safe forever.
The Guardian kills Takul-Dar, the Unbreakable, but he escapes again.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ugh. What do we have to do to kill this thing?
The Guardian chases after the Knight deeper into the Arcology

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I've been fighting Hive for — well — longer than I want to admit. This is some kind of ritual.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: They're losing on purpose? Like — what — throwing a hand of poker?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Maybe. What's their goal, though? Why let this thing die over and over again?
The Guardian finds the knight again, this time protected by two Necromantis Wizards.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Alright, that's three. Sloane, you want us to keep going?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: If this is a ritual, then all of this is leading somewhere. I want the two of you there at the end, whatever that looks like.
The Guardian fights their way through more Hive infested tunnels. Ghost has to unlock some Hive runes.
The Guardian kills two more Necromantis Wizards, stripping Takul-Dar, the Unbreakable of its shield, and then killing him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You were right, Sloane. Apply enough firepower and apparently even Hive magic breaks.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Good work, both of you. You know, Holliday and I were just talking about how different we are from the Hive.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. They worship death, we serve the Light. Good vs. evil, black hats, white hats… really makes you think.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Oh, no. Amanda goes rogue and we'll have Thrall buzzing the control center inside a week. Ahem. But, uh, let's get back to work.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Assistant! Is that you? Vex energy readings are off the charts. Go find out what's happening, and be quick about it.

lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: Ah, yes. Laugh it off. The Vex are simply planning to transform every planet in this system into a cog in a vast, inscrutable machine. They merely wish to convert every particle of matter on ths moon, living or dead, into a radiolarian solid!

lines.text: Ha! I've established a link into the Collective, but I can't deploy the virus. A Vex Mind is blocking deeper access.

The Guradian fight Tekton, the Constructive Mind

lines.text: According to the Collective, the Mind is summoning some sort of… pestilent defence

lines.text: Yes, yes. Now return to solid ground, before the Vex reconfigure their thought protocols. Those platforms are about to disapear.

lines.text: I'm picking up a weird sort of static, and it's messing with my gear. Can you find out what's causing it?

lines.text: Ana, the Hive were carrying pieces of a machine.

title: A Kell Rising — Transcript

lines.text: Your Ghost is detecting traces of a stasis field. Skolas was in a pod for years, it might be him.

lines.text: Variks, get on the comms! What did he say?!

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: Kell of Kells? Did he give himself a promotion?
VARIKS, THE LOYAL: A Fallen legend. He sees himself as a prophet, perhaps. Or he has gone quite mad.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: We're getting close...that cryo-trace is getting stronger.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: That's the Kell! Take him out, Guardian!

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: And...he's gone. (frustrated) That Skiff has already broken orbit! No problem, Guardian. There are still plenty of Wolves in there. Best clear them out.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: Impressive weaponry. Variks, what is that thing?
VARIKS, THE LOYAL: Scorch Cannon. Powerful, and very rare indeed.
Upon Clearing Winter's Lair of Fallen Wolves

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: That's strange...for a moment I detected Vex energy all around the site. As for you, that was great work! Nice to meet a Guardian that exceeds my expectations. Come back to the Reef. Winter now bows to Skolas, and the Wolves have just gotten started.
The Taken Path | Taken Osseus Fragments

title: Adventure: Invitation from the Emperor — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
