lines.text: Hey you two. My scouts picked up a weird Cabal signal coming from a ship that's definitely not Red Legion. Some new guy giving orders. He's got the Red Legion running around like errand boys on Nessus. Last time the Cabal had a management shakeup, they burned down our house. Let's see what they're up too. Bring guns.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, we always have at least three.
The Guardian defeats the Cabal and downloads the data from the first Cabal console.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Legion is pulling schematics of Nessus itself from the Confluxes! Atmospheric, geologic and tectonic… they want it all. I'm not sure why.
The Guardian downloads the data from the second Cabal console.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, this might explain it. Let's see… the Legion is helping their unnamed leader identify mineral-rich deposits on Nessus for… consumption. Well, that can't be right.
The Guardian downloads the data from the third Cabal console.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, I'm going to read this and you pretend like I understand. The Cabal want to grind Nessus into "glorious dust, fit for royalty." It's more environmental data. Just some logistical planning so they can prime their ship to… "eat the planet." This new Cabal leader might have a few screws lose.
The Guardian heads for the landing site.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Transmitting now. Cayde! I'm picking up a planet-wide broadcast. "Red Legion 7th Company has failed to secure Vex data. Their invitation to join the Loyalist regime is hereby rescinded." There's more. "The rest of you still have a chance to prove yourself. I offer you a life of… opulence?"

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Opulence? Oh, I could go for some opulence right now.
The Guardian reaches the landing site and defeats the Cabal, then heads towards the Vex confluxes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great work! Both Confluxes linked! Just keep them away while I… read this recipe for converting Nessus soil into a purified "Royal Wine". What are the Cabal doing?
Ghost pulls all the data out of the confluxes.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: They're gonna be so mad. I love it!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Serves them right! Let's get this to the Vanguard before I have to defrag. The Legion wanted every byte of data the Vex have on Nessus.
The Guardian reaches the beacon. Ghost sends the data.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: "All I ask is you return to my loving embrace." Ew. "Emperor Calus has spoken."

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Woah. Wait. Emperor? As in Cabal Emperor? OK, opulence later. Ikora now. Ikora! Uh, great job today, guys.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Boy, he left in a hurry. I wonder what all that was about?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Deep Conversation — Transcript

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain. I have identified multiple data-rich caches to plunder. I have created an unauthorised login for the friendly Ghost - the Vex will believe he is one of them. Ideally, they will share their secrets.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's… actually very helpful of you. Let's see what we can learn.
Ghost scans one of three floating caches.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The platforms are charged. Is this a deterrent or an experiment? I can never tell.
Ghost scans the second and third caches.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, this login is perfect. I'm pulling all kinds of data on Cabal fleet movements. Zavala will love this.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Happy to oblige, friendly ghost. Marking additional caches.
The Guardian makes their way over to another set of caches suspended slightly higher and scans the first one.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: They believe you are one of them. What did you ask?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nothing! I asked them what they're doing on this planet. Did I offend them?
The Guardian kills Vex to gather Collective Data

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These data cores the Vex are dropping - they contain answers to my questions.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Perhaps they are trying to interface with the friendly Ghost, and you, Captain, are in their way.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm so sorry. I'll fix this!
The Guardian scans the next cache.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can't get them to stop! They want to tell me about the Virgo Prohibition and how its algorithms are wrongly deployed for the Mars environment! How is that even relevant?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: They say you lack a holistic perspective. According to the network, they are sending you help.
The Guardian collects more Collective Data

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Now I know why Asher's Ghost never talks about her encounter with the Vex. They keep telling me to "come home"… Anyway, this data is too valuable to pass up. There's one more access point at the top.
The Guardian climbs to the top of the cache platforms and scans the last cache

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Friendly Ghost! Bad news. The Collective is dispatching a Vex mind to help you terminate the Captain!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Tell them to stop! I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I have no way to do that. But the Vex seem to like you very much!
The Guardian defeats a Network Mind

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That Mind said one last thing as it died. It's afraid. Afraid of your Light - the one thing in this galaxy it can't simulate. Probably old news to Ikora, but I'll ping it to the Vanguard.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Your query has terminated, Ghost. The Vex Collective hopes it has answered all of your questions. A user within the Network named "Osiris" sends his regards.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, Ikora definitely needs to know about that.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: A Disturbance on Mercury, A Matter of Time

title: Adventure: Hephaestus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We have a problem that requires your attention. The Vanguard did a sweep of the existing Bray archives. We found references to the Hephaestus Index. The Index is a weapons development database. If our enemies gain access to it, they could reverse-engineer dangerous ordnance. I've located multiple access terminals that house the data. Destroy them.
The Guardian destroys the first data terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala, we've successfully destroyed the first terminal.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Excellent work. Destroy the next terminal.
The Guardian destroys the second data terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The hard data has been eradicated. Now we-

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Hey, wait! I scrambled the Vanguard channel so we can have a private conversation. Look, Zavala is right about the risk, but you can't just destroy history.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I understand how you feel, Ana. But what do you suggest we do?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Do what Zavala says. Just… make me a copy. I'll be able to study the index, and Zavala won't have to worry about our enemies exploiting it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right. We'll take care of it.
The Guardian finds the data backup. Ghost hacks into the terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let's establish a preliminary connection between the network and Ana's relay.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Connection established! Looks like the deleted data is still on two backup server shards. Access them, and I can recompile it. Slight complication. The Hive found you.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can handle the Hive, even the frozen kind. Just keep the network open!
The Guardian defeats the Hive. Ghost hacks into the first backup server.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That's one piece of the deleted data! It's not pretty, but with both halves I can reassemble it.
The Guardian defeats the Hive. Ghost hacks into the second backup server.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Great, we've got all the data. But I need extra computing power for the reassembly. Get to the main terminal.
Ghost hacks into the main terminal.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: They're helping me Zavala. The Hephaestus Index is an incredible resource. We can't lose it. I need you to trust me.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Do I really have any other option?
The Guardian defends the terminal against the Hive while the data is sent to Ana.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Zavala, thank you. The index is safely offline, and we can use it to recreate Golden Age tech. Think of what we can make!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I am, Anastasia. And if this information ever becomes a problem, I will hold you personally responsible.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I wouldn't have it any other way.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Incursion — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Red Legion have taken enough from us. Now they're here on Mars, scavenging the ruins of our Golden Age. Scouts have reported activity in your area. Intercept them and find out what they're up to.
The Guardian finds a chest with a command map.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a chart here. It's… a plan of attack on the Bray Facility.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Get there A.S.A.P. If you hurry, we can catch them in the act.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Red Legion have stolen energy from the facility!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Don't let them go offworld with those batteries. Destroy them at once.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: That puts an end to that, but nothing's stopping the Red Legion from coming back.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If we can get Cabal communication codes, I can send a signal to the Red Legion.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Then you ambush them and put an end to their operation. I like where your head's at.
The Guardian defeats several Ouragos Phalanxes and obtains comm codes from them.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: There's a gulch near you that will be the perfect ambush spot. I've made arrangements for a special surprise.
The Guardian heads towards the ambush spot.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Devrim Kay had some leftover explosives that we can put to good use. He sends his regards.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why does Devrim have leftover explosives?
The Guardian transmats the explosives into position.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let's get to high ground before our guests arrive.
Ghost sends a signal to the Cabal. The Guardian defeats the Cabal who appear in response to the signal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we've upset whoever's in charge.
Val Palusk appears. The Guardian defeats Val Palusk.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That should disrupt the Red Legion Legion supply chain for a while.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Excellent work. We can't bring back those we lost, but we can make sure the Red Legion never has the opportunity to hurt us again.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: No Safe Distance — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Good, someone I can count on. The Cabal are moving high-yield explosives through that base. You need to neutralize them before they're used against us.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I still think we can put them to use somehow, but I'm letting Sloane have this one. Either way, we need their location.
The Guardian defeats a Firebase Demolitionist and picks up a delivery manifest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whoever this was had a delivery manifest. It says most of the explosives are already gone, but there are still some left in the base.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: No problem. Sloane says you can use your transmat juice to blow 'em up in a safe location.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Oh, like you know how it works.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: That's not relevant. Get into that base, and find those explosives.
The Guardian transmats three explosives out of the base.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: There are heavy tanks near your position. Get out of there before they come online.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait! Head outside, you two!
The Guardian heads outside to where the tanks are located.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Perfect! Now, you can re-transmat those explosives.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Hawthorne, that is some good improvisation.
The Guardian plants explosives on each of the three tanks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, I'm going to arm all the explosives at once. Keep me close so there's no signal interference.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You're gonna get plenty of other interference from the Legion.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Hold that position. Those tanks are too important a target to leave standing.
The Guardian defends Ghost from an onslaught of Red Legion while Ghost arms the explosives.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can use the login from that quartermaster for a remote detonation.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Using their explosives to blow up their tanks. I have pretty good ideas.
The Guardian detonates the explosives, destroying all three tanks.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I bet that was quite the show.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: A well-timed tactical withdrawal is probably wise.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Much as I hate running, Sloane's right. Get out of there, you two.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We'll try to track down the explosives that got away. In the meantime, great work. Those tanks would have been a lot to handle.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: We make a great team, everyone. Let's do this again sometime.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Poor Reception — Transcript

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I'm getting some weird feedback on the comms. Dev, did you put your teacup on the broadcast switch again?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like these Fallen Shanks are rerouting the signal.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Try dismantling one and taking a close look at the insides.
The Guardian defeats a Shank and retrieves an Intact Shank Core.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This core - it's acting as a kind of broadband amplifier. Their signal is blocking transmissions all across the dial.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: After all the work you did setting up Suraya's broadcast? That just won't do.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a signal antenna nearby. I can use the core to find the source of whatever the Fallen are doing.
The Guardian heads towards the antenna.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Why do you think they're trying to jam us, Dev?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: They missed their opportunity to take over this area after our friend touched the Shard.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: And now they're too scared to fight us head-on. Typical Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've lost the connect. The Fallen are jamming us.
The Guardian defends Ghost from the Fallen as he traces the source.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've found the source. It's underground. DEEP underground.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: That figures. Fallen love dark places.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Especially with the Red Legion all over the Dead Zone.
The Guardian approaches a tunnel entrance.
The Guardian enters an antechamber of the cave.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fallen banners. We're definitely on the right track.
The Guardian defeats a Captain, disabling a barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're really built up down here. We need to remember this place after we retake The City - so we can clear it out for good.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Or, we can let the Fallen have their creepy caves and NOT sacrifice more people.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: With that shield down, I can finally get a read on the source. It's close.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is it. Hold them off, and I'll use that Shank core to shut down the signal remotely.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just before you took out that Captain, I fried all their broadcast capabilities. No more jamming.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: That means people will be coming to the Farm from all over the planet. Once we get that last relay set up, we can reach out to the rest of the system!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then we can start rallying Guardians to strike back against the Red Legion.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: There will be plenty of time for both. For now, head back here when you can, you two.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Getting Your Hands Dirty — Transcript

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ahh, assistant. You are just in time to join my Dimensional Anomaly Research Group!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain, hello! Asher Mir says that I will provide the computational support, and you will provide the brute force! He is very rude.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Let us begin with barbaric close combat against the Taken. It is a scientifically sound proposition and is in no way suspicious.
The Guardian collects radiation samples from Taken

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This much Taken radiation can't be healthy.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Nonsense! There is no continuing danger from exposure to Taken radiation.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Incorrect, Asher Mir. I will now list all fourteen permanent debilitating effects from long-term contact with extradimensional matter

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: No need for that. Assistant, continue the experiment. Make you way to the Red Legion's "research" facility.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're almost to the research base. So we just… walk around. But in a Taken-y way.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Taken will think you're one of them, and flood into the European Dead Zone! Asher Mir said it would be like a plague. And a scourge!

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: That outcome is only guaranteed if we do not destroy the blights. Do not overload the test subject with extraneous data!
The Guardian irradiates the Gulch with Taken radiation

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something feels different. I think it's working.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: He means you have performed the correct actions. The Taken will now flood into the surrounding area like a scourge.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: And therefore, the experiment has progressed. Destroy the blights, immediately!
The Guardian witnesses Taken and Cabal fighting

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Now the Taken and the Cabal fight until everyone's dead. Cool.
The Guardian destroys the last blight

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That did it. All the blights are gone.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Except for the ones all across the solar system that will continue to happen for eternity, or at least until the sun burns out.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: That has not been scientifically proven. But otherwise, well done, research group. The Red Legion has shown a measurable vulnerability to concentrated entropy. Definitely worthy of further study.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Red Legion, Black Oil — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, listen to this. That black oily stuff that runs through Cabal armour? Apparently, it's got multiple functions. Assuming we can trust this intel.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Do you not trust facts? Hydrostatic organogel affects gravitational throughput for bipeds and vehicles. This is objectively true!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait. That liquid inside Cabal armour… is also ship fuel?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: More skepticism. Shoot them in their ridiculous helmets, analyse the results, and see for yourself.
The Guardian collects several organogel samples.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Sounded like some solid precision kills from here. But what was that echo we heard on the last two?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Local interference. I'm reading a huge cache of that oil stuff inside the Orobas Vectura.
The Guardian heads inside the Cabal ship, Orobas Vectora.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: If there is a stockpile inside the ship, then the Cabal are planning something big. You have enough firepower to destroy it all?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Destroying it is a wasted opportunity! The chemical makeup of the organogel contrains pathways for data transmissions.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So you're saying I can… hack their body fuel.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Dont listen to Asher. Destroy that stuff, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Don't listen to… whatever her name is! The answer is sabotage!
If the Guardian chooses to sabotage the organogel.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Asher was right. I've integrated a simple endless loop into the fuel supply. When any device - you stopped listening didn't you?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: But I am listening! Continue your stealthy work, Hunter. That organogel is no treasure to be pilfered.
The Guardian and Ghost contaminate the fuel injection systems.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Those Cabal simpletons will display their ignorance on a grand scale. I cannot wait! And you left things remarkably undestroyed. How novel.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: If I know the Legion, they'll be bringing out the big guns once they realise what you all did.
The Guardian escapes the ship and draws out the Cabal gunships.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is a perfect spot. And here they come, just like Sloane said.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Then put away your weapons and revel in your handiwork!

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Do not waste my time with redundant flatteries! Instead, ruminate on the result of this experiment. Wanton destruction does not equate to victory!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: But it sure does feel good. Great work all around. You too, Asher.
If the Guardian chooses to destroy the organogel.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That explosion triggered some kind of seismic alarm. The Cabal are sending reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We both know they won't be enough, Titan. Keep blowing up that fuel.
The Guardian destroys the fuel pods.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Excellent work, you two. Asher disconnected a while ago, but I was with you the whole way. You set the Cabal back weeks with all that destruction. Never had a doubt.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Psionic Potential — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Hey, Guardian, I'm picking up some strange radio chatter. I need you to check it out. Know anything about Psions?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Telepathic, aggressive… and surprisingly adaptable. They once were conquered by the Cabal, but now they fight alongside them.
The Guardian defeats two Psion Couriers and collects the courier orders they were carrying.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've intercepted the orders the couriers were carrying, Ana… but they're encrypted.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Has to be some way to read them. Checking sensors… aha! There's a Commander near your location. He should have what you need.
The Guardian defeats the Commander and acquires a cypher from him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: To transform. To evolve into Flayers. But they need Rasputin to do it.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yeah, they're just gonna make him mad.

The Guardian heads towards Rasputin. A Flayer Aspirant appears. The Flayer Aspirant becomes Tomoc, Psion Flayer, after interacting with one of Rasputin's nodes. The Guardian defeats Tomoc, Psion Flayer and continues towards Rasputin. Several more Flayer Aspirants appear. The Guardian defeats the Flayer Aspirants, including any Flayer Aspirants who become Psion Flayers after interacting with another one of Rasputin's nodes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Psions would never take on Rasputin by themselves. But now that Ghaul's gone, I wonder who could be running what's left of the Red Legion.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Maybe that's what these Psions wanted to do. Fill Ghaul's shoes.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Road Rage — Transcript

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Assistant! I have a task for you, but I fear your fleshy body is… insufficiently resilient for my purposes.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: There's a garage nearby, full of armoured vehicles. Procure one.
The Guardian gains access to a Cabal Interceptor garage.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Now that you have use of this device, do you recall the Warmind Vault? The Vex are keenly interested in its secrets. That ends now.
The Guardian uses the interceptor to destroy Vex trying to access the Warmind Vault.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What kind of information do the Vex want from the Warmind Vault?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: The Warminds had a special connection to humanity's lost arts. Music, literature, film. The Vex may not understand this emotional frivolity, but they will use it as a weapon against us. If we let them.
The Guardian continues destroying the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're making good progress. Um, I have a suggestion, though.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, if the Vex stole irreplaceable data, wouldn't it be good to, you know, recover some of it? Instead of destroying it.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Hmph. Recover it! Yes! Yes. Well! Fine! Fine, do as you see fit!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't see anything interesting in our kill data so far, Asher. Are you sure these are the right Vex?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: What do you mean, "the right Vex?"

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You know, like. Are these the robots we're looking for?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: The Vex would not trust Goblins and Hydras with such valuable data. You need to find the Vex Mind responsible for the incursions.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're… really infuriating sometimes. All right. One Mind coming up.
The Guardian destroys Viadon, Inquisitor Mind.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We got him, Asher. Looks like the Vex did steal files from the Vault. Let's see… Some files about Mars, somebody named Ana Bray… And, of course, lots of data on the Warmind Project. You'll have to take a look. I hope its useful.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Hope is a logical fallacy. Only data leads to concrete solutions.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Supply and Demand — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hey, long time no see, you two! Dev, you didn't tell me she was in town.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ms. Holliday and I have been re-appropriating supplies from the Cabal. She's keeping a low profile at the moment.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: You tag the boxes, I'll fly 'em out. Can't wait.
The Guardian finds a small supply cache.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Figures those four-armed bandits would try to beat us to it. Don't let 'em!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, I guess one crate is better than zero. Transmatted your way, Amanda.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Not so fast. I'm sending you coordinates a short ways from your position.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I've got a fix on it, too. I'll head over that way. Last one to the courtyard's a Dreg-face.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're here. And we've got company

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Red-bellies dug in and set up a whole bunch o' turrets. Clear 'em out, would you?
The Guardian destroys the turrets and defeats the Cabal and Fallen.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Do me a favour and plop down a beacon, would ya?
The Guardian plants a landing beacon.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Those supplies should keep the Farm up and running for a while. Another job well done.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hang on a sec. Dev, you seeing what I see?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Indeed. Another cache of supplies. But these are a bit familiar, aren't they?

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Those toothy-faced Ether-chuggers. They took our stuff!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So the Fallen stole from us, before we stole what they stole from the Red Legion?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: All's fair in love and war, I suppose.
The Guardian finds the Farm supplies.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Secure that cache, and Ms. Holliday will be by in two shakes.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: No can do, Dev. Could be a hundred Fallen hidin' out in those buildings. I'll wait for the all-clear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not all clear. Definitely not all clear.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Too hot for me to help out.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I don't have line of sight, either. You're on you own, you two. Be brave, as they say.
The Guardian defends the supplies from the Fallen and defeats S.A.B.E.R.-06.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Sky looks clear. I'm headed your way to pick up the goods. The Farm'll really appreciate it. Heckuva job, you two.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Quite. Now, do me a favour and see if there's any tea still intact?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Postmodern Prometheus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: I have planned a novel experiment, and you shall be my guinea pig. I need you to gather radiation. Move. Go. Shoo.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're happy to help, but why? What's the experiment?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: I am trying to create synthetic Light! If this experiment succeeds, then perhaps we can make new Guardians here.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: It won't work, Asher. The energy here is not Light, and science cannot manufacture blessings.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: So you say, but you have not stopped me, have you? You want this to work! And it will! My theory is sound!
The Guardian passes through radiation hotspots.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Field team to home team. We are 100% irradiated.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Excellent. Now we'll need calibrations. Act naturally, assistant. Go punch something.
The Guardian calibrates Asher's test equipment with Vex melee kills.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm sending that data back now, Asher. Um. Should we keep punching, or-?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: No! My field equipment is ready. Go to the test site.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If this works, it will change everything.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Think we're coming up on your test site, Asher.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: You simply need to activate the field equipment to begin. And be gentle with it! It's yours to replace if it breaks!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, Asher, something's definitely happening, but we'e got a lot of Taken coming in.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Yes, yes. I expected they would be drawn by the antiumbral pulses.
The Guardian protects the experiment equipment.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's creating some kind of energy. Huh.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: I'm seeing extreme variance in my data. The Taken must not be allowed to interfere with this experiment!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Extravagant light shows can't create Guardians.
Using the energy generated by the experiment, the Guardian defeats the Taken and the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All clear at the test site. Um, you guys have any results? Heh, this thing isn't gonna put the Traveler out of a job, right?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Unfortunately, my predictions appear to be flawed. Your Light cannot pass to another. Nor can the "power" created by this experiment.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: What he means is, "No." We cannot creat or take Light. Only the Traveler can choose to gift us with it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let us know if we can help with anything else. I didn't think it would work either, but… You can't help hoping for a miracle.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Target: The Mad Bomber — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Ooh, what luck! What fortune! A playmate appear! Hello! Hello, hello! To begin – a gift! A gift just at you, from ME, good friend Kaniks! BEST friend Kaniks! Go, go, go! Open gift!
The Guardian approaches some crates. The crates explode.
The Guardian fights against an ambush of Screebs and other Scorn. Kaniks, the Mad Bomber appears. The Guardian fights the Mad Bomber. The Mad Bomber teleports away. A splinter mine appears.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Ah-ah-ah! Game go on! Close your eye and COUNT DOWN.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have to disable that splinter mine or this whole place will blow.
The Guardian defuses the splinter mine.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Where am I hide? Ugly, stupid Cabal can knowing – but not you! YEE-HEE-HEE-HEE-HEE-HEE-HEE!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Red Legion ships above us. Must be the Cabal the Bomber mentioned. Let's follow them.
The Guardian finds and defeats three Scorn War Chieftains.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Lightbearer, Lightbearer, I see you, yesss, I dooo…

A splinter mine appears. The Guardian defuses it. Two more splinter mines appear. The Guardian defuses them and follows a group of Stalkers down a hole to the Mad Bomber. He disappears through a teleporter.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Ooh, WHEE! Now a game truly begin!
The Guardian fights against the Mad Bomber. The Mad Bomber transmats in a splinter mine. The Guardian defuses it.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Friend Cayde? No fun to play with, no fun at all. Such a boring boy to kill-kill-KILL.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Cayde beg and beg and beg. HEE-HEE-HEE-HEE!! "Mercy, ah! Mercy, please, Prince Uldren! Oh pretty, pretty please, oh please!" …SAD.
The Guardian defuses the splinter mine. Another mine appears. The Guardian defuses it.

lines.speaker: The Mad Bomber
lines.text: Cayde MURDER Eliksni. Think you DIFFERENT, think you HERO? Joke at you.
The Guardian defeats Kaniks, the Mad Bomber.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This place is rigged to blow. We have to leave. Hurry.
The Guardian runs to the splinter mine and defuses it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No matter what the Bomber said, you're not a murderer. Guardians are defenders of the Light. We just have to remember… we're doing this for Cayde.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Act I - Prologue | Speak with Mithrax

title: Adventure: Target: The Mindbender — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is a synaptic amplifier - a mind-control device specifically calibrated to interface with the Hive. We're on the trail of the Baron called the Mindbender.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've traced the original signal to a nearby cave. Let's check it out.
The Guardian finds an amplifier protecting some Hive. The Guardian destroys the device and defeats the Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I need a minute to triangulate the signal's origin.
The Guardian defends Ghost against the Hive while he locates the signal's origin.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Got the coordinates. The signal's coming from that crashed tombship.
The Guardian heads towards the tombship. They find and defeat a Mindbent Ogre. The Guardian finds an amplifier. Ghost scans the amplifier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This one has a safeguard. I'll need a minute to disable it.
The Guardian defends Ghost against the Scorn while he disables the amplifier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's the last amplifier. The signal we're tracking now is from the source. The Mindbender.
The Guardian heads towards the signal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This guy's file says he's obsessed with creating his own throne world, like Crota and Oryx had. The Mindbender thinks he can create it by killing powerful beings. But that should only work for the Hive.
Hall of the Exalted, Tangled Shore
The Guardian defeats the Hive and Scorn which they encounter. The Guardian finds Hiraks, the Mindbender. The Guardian fights Hiraks and the Hive. A portal opens.
Hiraks, the Mindbender enters the portal. The Guardian follows Hiraks through the portal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How did the Mindbender get a throne-world this big? Oh. Cayde.
The Guardian defeats Hiraks, the Mindbender.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got to go; this place is destabilizing.
Hall of the Exalted, Tangled Shore

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I want to think Cayde can rest easy now that the throne-world built from his death has been destroyed. Six names off our list. Only two left - then Uldren. Maybe Petra or Spider has a lead on the Machinist and the Fanatic for us.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Act I - Prologue | Speak to Eido

title: Adventure: Reversing the Polarity — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, it's you! Ikora will be pleased.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Guardian, I need you to test a theory. Find a power core in a disabled Red Legion tank, install it in a supply console, and stand back.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, that was as good as advertised.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Red Legion has brought a new weapon online, one powerful enough to threaten the Farm and everything around it.
The Guardian heads towards the firebase.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: While you're in transit, I'll try and fill in the gaps. Back in the City militia, we used to see the Fallen try to repurpose technology from other races and fail rather explosively.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Conversations with Devrim surfaced a memory from my studies: the Cabal are made up of many different races. They have always struggled to adapt to a single technology.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: That new weapon is an artillery cannon too big for you to blow up. But you could exploit that weakness.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The thing with the power cores. Sold.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, munitions system unlocked. Now to expose the power cores, I need to override the maintenance schedule.
The Guardian overloads the three firing mechanisms by exposing the power cores and then transferring them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That artillery cannon will be offline for minutes. I mean, weeks. I think.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: The Cabal never were very good at details. Good thing for us.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: This is another step to ending them for good. Well done, Guardian.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Siren Song — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, we're reading some odd fluctuations in our scans.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Gravity waves. Small for now, but amp 'em up and they'll rip us apart.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I've got three locations where the waves are strongest. Sending you coordinates.
Ghost scans the gravity waves at the first location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't see anything, Sloane. But I - did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's gone. Maybe I'm imagining things. We'll check your other coordinates.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Do it quick. I don't like what I'm seeing.
Ghost scans the gravity waves at the second location.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Not to rush ya, but these waves are growin' fast.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Get over there, and we should be able to track those gravity waves back to their source.
Ghost scans the gravity waves at the third location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sloane, you have to hear this.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Oh, I hear it. Amanda's grabbed your data and is mapping the source now.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Sources. Three of 'em. Go shut 'em down!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sloane, it's a ritual, a big one. They really ARE going to shake this Arcology to pieces.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Then let's do the same to them.
The Guardian destroys the Hive shrine and the Hierarch Wizard.

The Guardian heads further into the Arcology. They find another Hive shrine and destroy it, then defeat another Hierarch Wizard. The Guardian continues deeper into the Arcology and finds a third Hive shrine.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We tear this altar down, we stop that horrible noise.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The sooner the better. We're hearing that sound on all sensors now. Feeling it, too.
The Guardian destroys the shrine and the Ritual Hierarch, a wizard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, team! We've torn down the altars.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Then we got a problem. Those must have been transmitters, not the source. Ritual's still going. We're jittering up, down, and sideways over here.
The Guardians heads further into the Arcology. They enter a room with a huge crystal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sloane, there's a giant crystal in here. It's… SINGING.
The Guardian defeats the Hive. A knight, Nalcthor, the Crystalline, appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That Knight, he's singing like the crystal. Are they… drawing power from each other?
The Guardian defeats Nalcthor, the Crystalline.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We're stable again. Whatever you did, it worked. My… stomach thanks you.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Got a wild idea. How 'bout you send me that rock for analysis? Whaddaya say?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: One big glowy rock, coming right up.
The Guardian plants a transmat beacon and Holliday transmats it elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: You're a beaut, aren't you? Oh, the tests I'm going to run on you. I wonder how many pistons you can power. Sparrow thrusters, obviously, but what about warp drives, or…?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm sure I'm going to hear all about what Amanda will use that for. What were the Hive doing with it?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Target: The Hangman — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches a cage containing a Servitor.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This Servitor's been drained. No… mauled. I see a name carved into it. "Reksis Vahn". The Hangman. I've got a lead on him.
The Guardian finds two of the Spider's Servitors in cages guarded by Scorn.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's one of Spider's Servitors. It might help us if we free it.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn and frees both of the Spider's Servitors. The Hangman's Second appears. The Guardian defeats the Hangman's Second.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Servitors are holy to the Fallen. They create the Ether that the Fallen need to survive and grow. It's shocking that the Scorn - who were once Fallen - would even attack Servitors.

The Guardian finds and frees two more of the Spider's Servitors. The Guardian heads towards the final caged Servitor. Before the Guardian can free the Servitor, Reksis Vahn, the Hangman appears and the Servitor is destroyed. The Guardian fights the Hangman briefly before he escapes.

The Guardian and the Spider's Servitors fight together against the Scorn. The Guardian reaches the Hangman's hideout which is filled with caged and dead Servitors. Reksis Vahn, the Hangman appears. The Guardian defeats Reksis Vahn, the Hangman. The Guardian finds a room with two more of the Spider's Servitors in cages and frees them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Hangman enjoyed this - causing pain. Let's get out of here, Guardian. I don't want to think about what he did to Cayde.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: The Runner — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, I've detected a single Cabal within a simulation, carrying encrypted data between two points. The scientist in me would say the Vex are running a test - a continual loop to establish a benchmark dataset. To what end, I am not sure.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sounds like we'd better find out what they're after.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Remember that big Cabal trapped in the labyrinth? You're not going to believe this - it's back.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Vex are continuing their studies of Cabal behavior. They have reestablished the encrypted data transmission.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: More to the point, the Cabal are marching again. Better get moving.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex are focusing a lot of processing power on this particular simulation. This is a big deal for them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If you can tell that, can't you terminate it from your end?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Ever try to remotely control a machine on a perpetual feedback loop? YOU'RE the off switch. Go close it down.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: It's funny. The Vex keep running the same test, but they haven't changed the defenses yet.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: They are eliminating all stray variables that could affect their results.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: So, Guardian… Go be you - the stray variable.
The Guardian traverses the Infinite Forest, heading towards the entrance to the Simulant Present.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: With everything they could be doing in the Forest, why would the Vex choose to focus so much effort on a solitary Cabal in a single simulation?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: It will depend on how important that one Cabal is. What it carries may be critical to their ultimate plans.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: If they're trying to transmit data, why use the Cabal?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That is what we must determine through careful study and observation.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I say you smash first and ask questions later.
The Guardian finds Valus Traud, Proxy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: He's making a break for it. Let's drop him.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Aaand he's on the run. Bet you can stop him.
The Guardian pursues Valus Traud, Proxy through several checkpoints.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, no. We're not done with you.
If the Guardian defeats Valus Traud, Proxy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK, let's see what inside. Oh. This is code for what looks like a phage. Part technology, part biology. Just like the Vex.
If the Guardian defeats Valus Traud, Proxy.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes, good. This will force the Vex to recalibrate.
The Guardian defeats a Gladiator and a Centurion.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Another abstraction destroyed. Their data might have reached its destination, but the framework will soon be lost. And that is still a measurable victory against an enemy like the Vex. Well done.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Thief of Thieves — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian! Fallen thieves headed in your direction!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: They hit us and ran. We lost tools, gear… My crews can't work without that stuff.
The Guardian recovers the repair tools from the Fallen Supply Thieves.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: My crews will be reinforcing this Rig again in no time.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Those Fallen you tracked? We've located the rest of their gang. They're consolidating stolen Golden Age tech… in a nice big pile… out in the open.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Give those thieves a taste of their own medicine.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think that's the stash. Let's clear the area for transmat.
Guardian clears the area of Fallen and scans the stash.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Good job. I'll set up a transmat. Wait… Wait a minute. Where's my beacon?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Did the Fallen steal your transmat beacon too?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Sloane has stepped aside for the moment. The things she's shouting would blister your ears. May I recommend finding that beacon?
The Guardian searches for the transmat beacon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Does that Fallen look like a transmat beacon thief to you? He looks like a transmat beacon thief to me.
The Guardian kills the Supply Thief. It drops a broken diode. The Guardian continues searching for the beacon and finds another Supply Thief.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That one! That's gotta be a transmat beacon thief. He looks even thief-ier than the first one.
The Guardian recovers Sloane's transmat beacon from the Supply Thief.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Area's clear. Let's get back to that stash, so I can send it over.
The Guardian returns to the stash and places the transmat beacon. They defend the transmat zone from the Fallen and defeat Telks, Bandit Captain.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You've cleaned them out. These components are critical to the Rig's structural integrity. And thanks to you, we've got the tools to put them back.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whatever the Fallen steal, we steal back.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: While I cannot condone theft, I do appreciate payback. Well done.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Target: The Trickster — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This Glimmer is encrypted with a signature: Araskes, the Trickster. She's a coward who hides behind traps and flunkies. Bet we can find an informant somewhere around here.
The Guardian finds the Trickster's Courier and defeats them. The Courier drops an exotic engram. The Guardian picks up the engram.
The Guardian throws the explosive away. It detonates on impact.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If a shipment of these rigged engrams ever made it to the Last City… we CAN'T let that happen.
The Guardian finds and destroys the first engram fabricator.

lines.speaker: The Trickster
lines.text: [laughs] Oh no… it found our factory of delights. If only we planned for this… [laughs]
The Guardian destroys the second engram fabricator.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Good news: the engram fabricators are destroyed, and I traced the source of the Trickster's broadcast. Bad news: the trace was too easy for someone called "The Trickster."
The Trickster runs away, leaving behind a trap disguised as heavy ammo.
The Guardian pursues the Trickster, defeating any Scorn which they encounter along the way. The Trickster escapes through a door, closing it behind her.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Dead end. If we want to go deeper, we'll have to blast our way in.

The Guardian picks up an engram explosive and takes it to the door. The Guardian throws the engram explosive at the door, blasting a hole in it. The Guardian goes through the hole in the door and continues to the next area. Araskes, The Trickster appears.

lines.speaker: The Trickster
lines.text: [laughs] It wants revenge? Yes, we deserve it. Here is some ammo for you. [laughs]
The Guardian defeats Araskes, The Trickster.
If the Guardian has defeated six of the Barons, including The Trickster.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Six names off our list. Only two left - then Uldren. Maybe Petra or Spider has a lead on the Machinist and the Fanatic for us.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Target: The Rider — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This garage belongs to one of Uldren's Barons: Yaviks, the Rider.
The Guardian takes one of the Pikes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Take the Rider's Pike for a spin. We won't have to find her; she'll find US. Hmm, it's biometrically calibrated. Let me run some diagnostics. I can tune it.
Ghost calibrates the drive while the Guardian boosts the Pike. The calibration reaches 50%.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Pikes have some unusual mods.
Ghost completes the calibration of the Pike's drive.
The Guardian fires the Pike's weapons so that they can be calibrated. The calibration reaches 100%.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All set. Let's ride. Petra's files say Cayde caught the Rider first time by beating her in a race. There's Prison of Elders security footage of her swearing revenge on him. And… well. You know the rest.
The Guardian heads towards Soriks's Cut.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Pikes have a very distinct exhaust signature, and right now it's all over my scanner. The Rider's gang is nearby.
The Guardian defeats one of the Rider's Minions.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're talking to the Rider on a secured frequency. We can triangulate her location with a little more data.
The Guardian defeats two more of the Rider's Minions.
The Guardian heads towards the Rider's location.
The Guardian chases the Rider, eventually defeating her.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Rider's racing days are over. Guess Cayde's record is safe.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ahamkara Tales - Osiris & Crow (Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to the radio message.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I understand your concern. But if we cannot rely upon the Veil, the Ahamkara is our only option.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Even if it was Savathûn who pointed us at Riven in the first place?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Witness is our priority. We've dealt with Savathûn and Riven in the past.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: And now Savathûn is free, and Riven is toying with us. I won't end up as a puppet again.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I fear it too. The experience of watching your body perform a series of actions you would never condone. Of that terrible regret... But that fear won't stop me. Just as I know it won't stop you.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Was any of it real? All that advice Savathûn gave me, while she pretended to be you?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: At the time Uldren began his campaign against the Reef, he was already suffering from the Black Garden's corruption. Riven must have found him an easy victim. One could argue he wasn't fully in command of his decisions. All the same, the impact of those decisions was very real. So, let me ask you this: Did I give you good advice?

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

title: Ahamkara Tales -  Petra & Osiris (Week 3) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Osiris, are you on this channel?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I am. Quite frequently, these days. How may I assist the Queen's Wrath?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: A personal matter. I was hoping you could tell me about your experience with Strand — how it's affected you?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Strictly research, but it is fascinating.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: We know you've learned to wield it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Who told you this? [chuckles] Mara. The rumors are true, though I am still only a figment of my former self.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That's understandable, but your worth was never seated in the Light. It's in your mind.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I imagine I'm not unlike one of your Techeuns, then. If I'm not mistaken, the queen mentioned you trained as one yourself.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: A long time ago, without much success. Though my sister, Pinar, excelled in her training. She was the pride of Amethyst. I was not. But even with that power, she couldn't stop the House of Wolves from razing our home. I joined the Corsair shortly after, to hunt the Wolves down.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Loss has a way of shaping us all.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: And clouding us. I thought the decisions I was making were the ones required of me. A kind of honor-bound reaction to pressure. I burned bridges across the Reef on my hunt. Without Mara, I'd be an outcast. Now, seeing the new coven, having their respect, their trust… I can do more than just react. Maybe I can tap into that training for something progressive, as something other than a Techeun. For the benefit of our people.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I've learned that failure is not a lacking within us. It is a sign that we were not ready to face the challenge we chose at the time. We must fall to start again, Petra. But as long as we persist, hope remains… potential remains. Perhaps, you're ready now.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I can see why Mara values your perspective. Thank you, Osiris.

title: Adventure: The Up and Up — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex run all kinds of things in the Forest now, including combat tests on Fallen. They're planning some kind of invasion, possibly on Nessus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You want us to ruin their test case? We've got guns. We can do that.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian. Ghost. I've obtained the coordinates to a Vex combat test within the Forest, designed to study the fighting capabilities of the Fallen. They must be preparing an invasion.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got this. The Vex can't study the Fallen if we delete them.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Vex are simulating the Fallen's capability for retreat. I need you to attack it and destabilize their experiment.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: All this predicting, and they never predict that we're going to air-drop the Guardian on them. Again.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Ghost! Guardian! The Vex are running a combat loop against Fallen hostiles.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But it won't be much of a test if we get rid of all those simulated Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If these readings are correct, the destination gateway is heavily protected. This simulation must be valuable.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: There's nothing the Vex value more than unique data.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Osiris and I are running cover for you by causing a little chaos in a nearby simulation. But the Vex know we're interested in this Fallen experiment too. Expect a… strong response.
The Guardian traverses the Infinite Forest, heading towards the entrance to the Simulant Present/Future.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So… the Vex have moved on to experimentation with the Fallen. Is it too much to hope they'll destroy each other?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Don't hope. We'll deal with them ourselves.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Vex controlling this simulation have been alerted to your presence. They've begun to shift the terrain.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex are aware of your presence. They're manipulating platforms to slow you down. Remember: get in, eliminate the Fallen, and get out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why simulate the Fallen? They've never been weaker.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Vex intend to erase all other life-forms. Powerful or weak. Affluent or destitute. Anywhere we can stop them, we must.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Remember, you will not have much time to act. Move with purpose, and strike with intent.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: C'mon, he gets it! This is one of MY Guardians we're talking about.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: By the way, the Vex have you on a time limit. Don't let those Fallen escape!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're not wasting any time. And neither should we.
The Guardian defeats two Fallen guards. Several platforms appear.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: You're doing great. Just don't think about what happens if you fall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great. Now I'm thinking about it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I have seen evidence that leads me to believe the phasing platforms shift between different realities.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Vex - always have to do everything the hard way. If it helps, try not to look down.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: If it helps, try not to look down.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: More platforms. And this is why the Vex have no sense of humor. Or friends.
The Guardian reaches the top of the platforms.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You are near the target. Do what you must to stop the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We know how to do that.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The combination of constants and variables in this simulation is fascinating. Rigid structure in movement, dynamism in engagement, all within a strict framework. Beautiful. Unfortunately, I must destroy it when you're finished.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The simulation window is closing, but you are near the payload that the Fallen are trying to extract.
If the Guardian kills the Cache Defender, a Fallen Captain, within the time limit.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Excellent. Another reality path closed to the Vex.
If the Guardian kills the Cache Defender within the time limit.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Nice. One more Vex master plan thwarted.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: And we'll stop them too. Just enjoy the moment.
If the Guardian does not kill the Cache Defender within the time limit.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Enemies are closing on your position. We've lost our chance to deny the Vex information, but we can still destroy the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Take heart. Even thought the Vex retrieved their data, your efforts may have already altered its usefulness.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Hmm. I wonder if they predicted that?
If the Guardian does not kill the Cache Defender within the time limit.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All hostiles down. The Vex got the data, but this bunch isn't getting up again.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: A few less bad guys running around the Infinite Forest? I'm OK with that.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Target: The Rifleman — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is a sniper's nest. Great sightlines… We're on the Baron that murdered Cayde's Ghost. That was a one-shot kill. Keep your guard up.
The Guardian heads towards the Rifleman's location and finds Cabal fighting against the Rifleman. The Guardian fights against the Rifleman.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: He's retreating, but I'm tracking his position.
Jetsam of Saturn, The Tangled Shore
The Guardian finds and destroys one of the Rifleman's decoys.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Decoys. Smarter than he looks. Lightweight simulation tech. I've never seen anything like it. If we find more, let's grab it.
The Guardian destroys several more decoys. The Guardian continues towards the Rifleman's location.

lines.speaker: The Rifleman
lines.text: King Uldren wants you dead. [laughs] I bring him your body… keep your Ghost. [laughs] Sell its shell to Spider. [laughs]
The Guardian defeats the Hive and the Scorn.

lines.speaker: The Rifleman
lines.text: …Or I mount your Ghost on my wall… next to Cayde's… [laughs]
The Guardian continues towards the Rifleman's location, eventually entering a large room. Two of the Rifleman's decoys appear. The Guardian destroys the decoys. Pirrha, the Rifleman appears.
The Guardian defeats Pirrha, the Rifleman.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You know, there's a reason I keep a low profile when you fight. It's just smarter. But Cayde's Ghost was just like him. Flashy, cocky… and incredibly competent. She didn't deserve to go down like that.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Adventure: Unbreakable — Transcript

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain. Vex in your patrol area have upgraded their barrier technology to be impenetrable using a new, unidentified energy source. Nearby constructs should have the data we need to locate a sample of this technology.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Unbreakable shields sounds bad. Let's take 'em apart!
The Guardian collects several Vex data cores.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I skimmed the cores. There's a weird energy spike nearby that might be what we're looking for.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I would be happy to analyze any samples you obtain. I need a life. Someone get me off this rock.
The Guardian finds the energy spike.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got the spike, but there's a Minotaur here using those fancy shields.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The captain always finds a way!
The Guardian kills the Empowered Minotaur.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I detect additional spikes nearby. We should collect them for analysis. Perhaps we can discover how they are producing it. And then blow 'em up.
The Guardian collects energy fonts for Failsafe.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: This is superb data. I have located one final set of fonts for you to collect.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, this is turning into kind of a long walk.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Hey! At least you can walk. I live in a dilapidated boat.
The Guardian collects a large energy font and kills an Empowered Minotaur.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I've traced the samples to one source and have pushed its coordinates to your tracker. I do not believe the Vex will want to give up their "fancy shields". You're gonna have to make them.
The Guardian overloads the shield generators and destroys the Vex energy device by standing in Vex energy fonts and killing Empowered Minotaurs who drop arc charges.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, we can report those shields won't be a problem anymore. Nice catch.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Vex Collective is reporting the same thing. Hopefully they do not possess the resources to do this twice.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ahoy and Aweigh: Speak with Spider — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian speaks with Spider after rescuing him from House Salvation.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Guardian. It's been a while. Seems like only yesterday I was in the Tangled Shore, trading in Seraphite and Phaseglass. Now… I'm nestled in the bosom of the Traveler. [chuckles] Funny where owing a debt to Drifter can get you, eh? And let's keep the details of my ignominious rescue between us, hm? Now then… it sounds as though you're off to cross swords with Eramis and the old crews. Misraaks seemed none too pleased about that. I wonder why… I'll tell you what, my friend: I'll let you keep using my ship while you go digging for secrets. I think you've got the steel for it. Now go show those pirates what happens when they cross Spider. While you're gone, I'll gather some accoutrements no budding captain should be without. No need to thank me, Guardian. I only ask that you keep my wanton generosity to yourself. I have a reputation to maintain. [chuckles]
Act I - Prologue | Speak with Mithrax

title: Adventure: Unsafe at Any Speed — Transcript

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Hey, Zavala. Guess who pinged our beacon near that Fallen Pike gang?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fallen? All we see around here are Cabal.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Red Legion must have strengthened their defences against mobile assault.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Tell you what. Those Pikers can wait. Take out the Legion first. I bet they won't expect you to do it with their vehicles.
The Guardian uses a Cabal Interceptor to kill enemies.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These vehicles aren't as maneuverable as a Sparrow, but they pack a punch.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Keep punching. You have a golden opportunity to put the Red Legion down for the count.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Remind me never to get into a boxing match with a Titan. You all are scary. But as much as I hate to agree with him, Zavala's right. Vehicular mayhem now, Pike gang later.
The Guardian uses the Interceptor to ram enemies.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Hmm. That Fallen Pike gang is still a threat.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Took the words right out of my mouth. Let's not make this a habit, huh?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We'll see. Be careful out there. Those Pikes were rebuilt with scavenged technology. They may be unpredictable opponents.
The Guardian defeats two Pike gangs.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That'll teach the Fallen to not mess with us.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Don't let your guard down. The gang's leader will be close.
The Guradian defeats the Pike Gang Leader, Spekkis, Pike Captain.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Picking up a big spike in Fallen chatter. They sound pretty pissed.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we can handle whatever they throw at us.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: They've deployed a Walker to your position.
The Guardian destroys the Fallen Walker.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whew, one Fallen Walker sent back to the scrap heap.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: And a victory like this will ensure a respite for us as well. Excellent work.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: An Important Message — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds Ikora looking at the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I had to see it with my own eyes… How long has it sat in silence? Watching us?
The Guardian and Ikora turn around and see Eris Morn with several phantoms hovering near her.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I can't help but feel responsible for this, Eris. If I hadn't sent you here —

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your concern is noted, but my fate is my own responsibility. And we both know you didn't come here to apologize.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I came to tell you… You were right. It seems those responsible for our Collapse… are coming back.
The phantoms move closer to Eris Morn, then move away when she begins to yell at them.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: QUIET! You're all insufferable! Save your torment for someone who gives a damn!

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Eris. The Vanguard is at your disposal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then if you'll excuse us, Ikora… We have work to do.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ahoy and Aweigh: Visit The Ether Tank — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian enters The Ether Tank and witnesses a conversation between Eido and The Spider.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: We have not formally met. I am Eido, Scribe of House Light, daughter of Misraakskel, whom you already know.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: [sighs] Yes. Misraaks and I are well acquainted.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Do you hold a title, sir? I've heard what they call you…

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Oh, ha… I hold a great many things. "Spider" is better than "Fallen," and no worse than your old man letting the Guardians call him "Mith-racks." [laughs]

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Yes, some of them struggle to pronounce his name.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Yes, it's surprising what they struggle with.
The Spider gestures with one hand.
Eido turns and also gestures toward the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Oh, yes, this Guardian is quite competent. I still hope I will be able to assist somehow.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Very plucky of you, Eido. How does your father feel about your involvement? Seems these old pirate crews have put a touch of fear into him.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Yes, he seemed… apprehensive. But I am a Scribe. Chronicling our history is part of my position. And, deep down… he must be as excited about the adventure as any of us.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Oh, I'm positively thrilled. Now, little Scribe, if you'd be kind enough to excuse us… the Guardian and I have business to discuss.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Of course. Welcome to the Last City. May the Light provide.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Heh. "May the Light provide." Misraaks, you old charlatan. You've built quite the house of cards here. [chuckles]

title: Antiquarian III: Return the Third Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I've been trying to determine what exactly is inside these reliquaries, but I dare not open them. The resulting surge of Darkness energies would have unforeseeable effects on my physiology. However, I did manage to secure a centuries-old Vanguard mission report from the Cryptarchy. The reporting Guardian said that Eliksni crews were in-fighting over what he called, quote, "chunks of rotting meat." The report is of dubious quality, but it did make me wonder if the relic could be biological in nature!

title: Anti-Anti Air — Transcript

lines.text: Firebase Hades, European Dead Zone, Earth

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Welcome back to Firebase Hades. The fun never stops does it? Luckily, they're off their game. Red Legion's still reeling from you taking out Thumos, so we've stepped up our air raids.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: And in turn, they've stepped up their defenses at the base. Some kind of anti-aircraft fire. Think you could find out more?
Guardian kills a Psion called a Turret Machinist, granting them an Ordinance Installation Order.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're right, Devrim. They've installed anti-aircraft turrets all over the base.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: And with how paranoid you've made the Red Legion, I'm betting they're pretty well guarded.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This seems familiar, but look out the window.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Does that mean you can see the turrets?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Barely, we need to find a way out there.
Guardian kills another Turret Machinist, which grants them a Firebase Security Code.
Guardian proceeds deeper into the Firebase, and approaches a shield, stopping their progress.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're almost there, but everything's locked down. We really did make them paranoid.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: It will be great, when they reach those turrets and give them a good thrashing.
Guardian kills Warden Derg. Granting them another Firebase Security Code. They return to the shield.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The power sources for those turrets are shielded too! That's just excessive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Get me to a console, I'll take care of them.
Guardian takes Ghost around to various consoles, dropping the shields on the turrets in the area, and destroying them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's all of them. But as much as I want us to get out of here, there are two generators recharging their heavy tanks.
Guardian destroys the two generators, and kills Taskmaster Vazar, granting them yet another Firebase Security Code.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's our ticket out of here. But there's one more we can do while we're here. There's a huge artillery cannon in another part of the base that's about to go online.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: You two are pushing your luck out there.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Sometimes that's the only way to win, Dev.
Guardian works their way back through the base, destroying a section of fuel pipe, before continuing.
Firebase Hades, European Dead Zone, Earth

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Perfect. The next time that big cannon tries to fire, it's not going to go well for the Red Legion.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's a good point! Let's get to a maintenance console, and we'll start a firing sequence!
Guardian proceeds to a maintenance console, setting off a chain of explosions, disabling the cannon.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You two have definitely earned your keep today. Red Legion's gonna be furious.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: May I suggest calling it a day? Before the entire base comes down on your heads?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ahh, you worry too much, Devrim!

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I don't know what's gotten into him, but I like it!
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Another Step Closer — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Eris Morn after defeating Hashladûn, Daughter of Crota.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Pryramid trembles under the weight of our progress. With every victory, we draw closer to conquering it. The spoils of Hashladûn's death are twofold. We now know what the Hidden Swarm have been using to shield themselves from the Nightmares - and where it lies. The Cryptoglyph. If ever there was a more powerful set of runes the Hive use to conjure the magics, I have yet to learn of it… Of course, to acquire it, we must delve into horrific depths. Our Cryptoglyph lies… at the bottom of the Hellmouth.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Antiquarian IV: Return the Fourth Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Guardian. We intercepted another of Eramiskel's transmissions… this time to the Pirate Lord, Alaaks.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: It is finally time for the Eliksni to take their rightful place in the Sol system. We've struggled for too long under the boot heels of others. Hive and Cabal rain artillery down upon us. The Vex steal every last scrap for themselves. And the Lightbearers hunt us for sport. But no longer! This system will soon enter a new age, one of Eliksni prosperity. Be sure you're on the right side of it, Alaaks.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I wonder what the Witness promised Eramiskel in exchange for the relics. Clearly, it was a persuasive offer.

title: Antiquarian I: Return the First Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Guardian. The artifact you recovered from the pirate lord's hideout has incredible research potential! I'll leave records of my findings here. Come by after you recover a new reliquary to learn what I've discovered! Spectral analysis indicates trace amounts of Darkness energies radiating from within the vessel. However, the reliquary is made of a super-dense substance, like a lead barrier around uranium. This leads me to deduce that the relic itself is likely quite powerful, and potentially harmful if handled directly.

title: Antiquarian VI: Return the Sixth Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Your latest mission unearthed another intercepted transmission. It seems pertinent to our research.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Do not open the relic under any circumstance. I don't care if the whole Lucent Brood is outside. The Darkness inside would dissolve you before you could ever wield it against the Hive. Only beings of extraordinary fortitude can withstand its energies. And we both know you're less than that. Retreat and fortify your defenses. Protect the relic at all cost. Reinforcements are on the way.

title: Antiquarian V: Return the Fifth Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
