lines.text: Our parley with Eramiskel has changed everything… though not in the way I had hoped. I understand the relics now… the potency of their Darkness, and Eramiskel's use of the old pirate crews to hunt them. Even my father's reticence. But this is not about the House of Light. This is about the mysterious disciple. The many tombs of Nezarec are well known, though the being itself is less thoroughly documented. I will delve into the Cryptarchy's records and see what I can uncover.

title: Antiquarian VII: Return the Seventh Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I've searched for information on Nezarec in the Cryptarchy's records, but most of the primary sources from that era were destroyed. What we know from… second-hand accounts is that Nezarec led the Witness's first assault on Earth, or, as Humans call it, "the Collapse." After the Great Machine repelled the attack, Nezarec's Pyramid crash-landed on your moon. Beyond that, the sources are vague. They hint at a process for harnessing the relics' power, but give no instructions. If we could replicate this ancient methodology, there's no telling what we might accomplish!

title: Antiquarian VII: Return the Eighth Relic — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. with a relic recovered from a Pirate Hideout.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Now that we've collected all the relics, Misraakskel and I believe that we could harness their power. To what end… we're still uncertain. While I believe in our abilities, I am concerned about the potential side effects such a process could have. An ancient dirge I discovered describes something called, "the Curse of Nezarec," which is rumored to drain the life of the user. Of course, I don’t give credence to such superstition. Dark Age Humans were comically ignorant. Still, I would rather not take the risk. My father… disagrees. I suspect he wishes to redeem himself for his past wrongs, and in that, I cannot dissuade him. We will continue searching for a method to unlock the relics. Until then, the Light provides.
Act I - Prologue | Speak to Eido

title: Arm Yourself with Knowledge: Asterion Abyss — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian helps the Exo Stranger archive information on Europa by scanning objects in the environment.
The Guardian scans a Vex structure.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Unlike their brethren on Venus, the Vex were not "discovered" here. They were brought. By Mr. Bray himself.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Just because humanity discovered Vex on Venus first doesn't mean that was their only entry point. Clovis Bray built a door for them here too.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You know of the Ishtar Collective. Clovis Bray also tried to crack open the secrets of the Vex. Proof of his failure stands before you.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This structure dates back to the late Golden Age. The Vex-Exo War. If history were just, it would be known as Bray's Folly.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The history of the Vex is nigh on impossible to track given their manipulations of time. But I was here when they first came to Europa.
The Guardian scans a red glacier.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Red ice is common here and perfectly harmless. Though from the long view, Europa looks like it’s been scratched by giant claws.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: That red glow is a natural occurrence. Comes from some combination of native bacteria and the radiated atmosphere.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Europan bacteria is preserved in the ice. A small colony compared to what’s floating in the ocean beneath your feet.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Beautiful, isn’t it? The color is a reflection of radioactive ions in the air interacting with bacteria frozen within.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: One of Europa’s natural phenomena. The only kind Clovis didn’t care about. He couldn’t make use of red ice.
The Guardian scans the interior of an incomplete Vex structure.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: BrayTech’s top engineers studied structures like this one for years, but they never grasped how the Vex defied the laws of nature so neatly.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: As you can see here, on Nessus, wherever they go, the Vex are quick to remake their surroundings in their own image.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This structure is incomplete. The Vex only stop when they themselves are stopped. We learned that the hard way, during the war.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Vex constructions uniformly resist natural law. Even entropy itself. No one, not even Clovis Bray, has figured out how.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This unfinished column was proof that we’d stopped the Vex years ago. Now, thanks to Eramis, they may yet finish their work.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Deadly Trial — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The coordinates Brother Vance gave us are just beyond the village.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Hawthorne's scouts surveyed that area in the Red War. There's no temple there. Just an old radio tower.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen, then heads towards the rendezvous with the Followers of Osiris.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, are the Followers all as… "passionate" as Brother Vance?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: You mean fanatical. Yes. They follow the idea of Osiris. They do not know the man as I did. But they're our best chance to revive Sagira.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen Walker. The barrier blocking the road ahead disappears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I feel bad for anyone who has to live out here.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Osiris would say it's a trial. If his Followers can't survive here, they aren't worthy to begin with.
The Guardian continues towards the rendezvous with the Followers of Osiris. After passing through a tunnel, they arrive at an open area with a radio tower.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It really is just a radio tower. And the Fallen got here first.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That's what faith in Osiris gets you.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen and proceeds into the tower.
The Guardian begins to revive Sagira.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let me take a closer look. This is heavily modified Vex tech. I've never seen anything like it before. Let me try something… Wait… Something's happening. What is…

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: …going on?! Whoa! New shell. Who…? Did you actually just put me in a strange machine you've never seen before? Who does that?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Ikora! Great! Glad you're still around. Look, we've gotta move. Right now. Osiris is in over his head, as usual, and I need to… Wait… Where are we? Who are you? Ugh, never mind. We've gotta get to Mercury. And don't worry about your Ghost. We're… sharing right now. He'll be back.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: A Disturbance on Mercury, A Matter of Time

title: Arm Yourself with Knowledge: Cadmus Ridge — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian helps the Exo Stranger archive information on Europa by scanning objects in the environment.
The Guardian scans the abyss at the edge of Cadmus Ridge.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The entrance to Europa's ocean lies at the bottom of the abyss. Twenty-five kilometers straight down.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This abyss reaches Europa's subsurface ocean. A BrayTech camera still floats down there, amongst arctic plankton and bacterial colonies.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Expedition rovers, BrayTech employees: many were sacrificed to the study of this ravine. Not that Clovis Bray cared.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Chasms like these crisscross all over this moon, allowing radioactive ions to flow into the depths of its dark ocean.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: BrayTech researchers dropped a camera down there once. You wouldn't believe what they saw swimming around in the dark.
The Guardian scans one of BrayTech’s exterior panels.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The Europan construction was BrayTech’s most expensive project by far. But it paid off. Centuries later and still intact.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: To say Europa presented an architectural challenge is putting it mildly. What these roofs can withstand is an engineering miracle.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The exterior paneling was designed to hold up against subarctic temperatures, radiation, and 50 kilotons of blast force.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: That paint job had a use beyond aesthetics. All the buildings were painted so they could be seen even in a whiteout.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Gale force winds, kilotons of snow and ice, radiation bombardments. And still, centuries later, this roof stands intact.
The Guardian scans Eventide’s emergency fuel tank reserves.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: These fuel tanks were our emergency reserves. Which Clovis drained for his research trips. So when an emergency came… well…

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Fuel was a precious resource on Europa. Clovis and I argued over it constantly. He won, in the end. And the people of Eventide suffered for it.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: These tanks once held fuel — for Eventide. But Clovis prioritized research over human lives. When people needed them most, they were empty.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Fuel reserves. I insisted, in case we needed to evacuate. Which we might’ve done, if Clovis hadn’t wasted it all.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Eventide required an enormous amount of fuel to stay up and running, but it paled in comparison to the Exo Factory.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: A Hum of Starlight — Transcript

lines.speaker: Spider
lines.text: Huh. Well? Ready for fortune and glory in the Watchtower? Well, go on. I won't stop you. See, I had a quid pro quo with Queen Mara Sov. Nobody in or out on my watch. But now? Taken pour out, Scorn flow in — place is a revolving door, and I'm washing my hands of it. So, you see our Awoken friends, you tell them I met the parameters of my commitment 100%. Bon voyage, friend. Oh, and the next time you get the itch to play on the right side of wrong, you know where to find me.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Petra crossed through that gate alone and asked us to watch her back. That's what we're going to do. Now let's get up there and help our friend.
The Guardian heads towards the gateway. They find the gateway in a large room. The Guardian destroys the Taken Blights and defeats the Taken with the help of Spider's Associates.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Now's our chance. Open the gateway.
The Guardian defeats the Ravenous Taken Knight and deploys Ghost to activate the gateway.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's open. Let's go! We'll be there soon, Petra.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Arm Yourself with Knowledge: Eventide Ruins — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian helps the Exo Stranger archive information on Europa by scanning objects in the environment.
The Guardian scans an old Exoscience computer terminal.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: An old Exoscience computer. This one is fried, but there were a lot of these stations. We can still find one with data left on it.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This is where they conducted Exo stress tests. Exposing us to extreme temperatures, radiation, direct bomb blasts…

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This is where Exos came to be "put through their paces," as Clovis said. If there's any data left, it's likely biometrics. Interesting, but not very useful.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I tried to erase all evidence of the Exo project once. I never thought I'd be happy I failed, but… well, I've changed my mind about a lot since then.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: All Exoscience computers were routinely wiped clean of incriminating data. But traces may linger deep in the hardware.
The Guardian scans one of House Salvation’s Ether caches.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Looks like House Salvation has tucked away some Ether for a rainy day. We should keep careful track of these.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: A House Salvation Ether cache. Even the Darkness isn’t enough to keep them alive, as much as they wish otherwise.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This Fallen may have knocked their Servitors down a peg, but they still need a steady stream of Ether. Hence the hidden caches.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: House Salvation may disdain their Servitors, but they still need Ether. I’ll make a note. We can use this to our advantage.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ether stores for House Salvation. Hold off on destroying them for now. We can be strategic about this.
The Guardians scans one of House Salvation’s transmission towers.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The Fallen are thrifty, I’ll give them that. These towers have BrayTech parts in them. Good to know.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Looks like the Fallen have repurposed some BrayTech leftovers. Perhaps I can find a backdoor into their comms…

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: House Salvation has made a real effort to blast their propaganda far and wide. It’s good to know where the transmissions are coming from.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: A lot of outgoing transmissions, calling for Fallen to join House Salvation. Reminds me of how BrayTech used to recruit.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This must be why I’ve been picking up so many House Salvation transmissions. They’re getting desperate for recruits.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Repeat emergency transmission. This is Amanda Holliday. My ship was disabled during combat, and I was forced down in the EDZ. While I was waiting for evac, I saw a Shadow Legion patrol leading a group of captives to a Pyramid. I'm sneaking into the facility with the prisoners. I'll bring my comms along as a beacon. Whoever hears this, tell the Guardian to gear up and follow my signal. I'll be waitin'. Repeat emergency transmission.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: This is Amanda Holliday—does anyone read me?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: There she is! I'm so glad to hear your voice.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hey, Devrim! Good to hear you too. I was starting to worry I'd snuck in here for nothing.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Quite clever of you! A bit risky, though. Can't say I condone it.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Risky?! Ain't you the fella who once ran a Cabal blockade just for fresh eggs?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Guilty as charged. Just hold tight, my dear. Reinforcements are on their way.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Where in the facility are you, Amanda?

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: I'm in the cell block with the prisoners. The Guardian can follow my comms signal right to us.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: They've hit a bit of a roadblock at the moment, but fear not. They're en route.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: We will breach the Pyramid not through its walls, but through the very fabric of reality. Harness my power, and enter the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I must admit, I had several good ideas for this jailbreak… but traversing an alternate reality was not among them.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Guardian's doing what now? I swear, the longer I know y'all, the stranger things get.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Stranger still now that the Witness has arrived.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Eliminate the Taken blight, and summon a Balefire in its place. It will consecrate this place and drive the Darkness out before it.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Whatever you did out there must have worked, Guardian. You got base security chasing their tails! Looks like they're deploying some heavy firepower to stop you, though.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: There's something up ahead. It's… bringing back a memory, or… Uldren's memory, I guess. A familiar voice. Be careful, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Banish these Taken defilers. They are but empty shells, filled with the desires of a greater will. Trust in your Light, and they cannot stop you.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I tested the perimeter of that Pyramid for hours but couldn't find any entry points. And now the Guardian just walks in?

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: It depends on one's point of view. The walls of the prison may be impenetrable, but the walls between worlds are not.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: You never did have much respect for boundaries, did you?

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: I see you on my radar, Guardian! The prison cells should be just ahead. The head guard's a real piece of work, though, so watch yourself.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Target powerful Taken, seize their Essences, and consecrate them in your Balefires. Once sanctified, the Essences will become weapons to lower your enemies' defenses.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Extraction confirmed. The hostages are on their way back to the Farm. Good work, everyone.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Guardian? My ship's nearby, but she took a beating. I could use your help getting her outta here.
Awaken, Queensguard: Meet with Mara Sov

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

title: As a Friend — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
After helping Eris to vanquish her phantoms, the Guardian speaks to Ikora.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: For most of us, there are moments where our losses creep into our minds and overwhelm our senses. For Eris, that has been every second since those phantoms began haunting her. Sure, she's strong. More so than most. But even the strongest require allies in their darkest moments. That's been you. Through it all, you stood by her side. As a friend. That's something Eris hasn't had in a very long time. I'm sure she won't soon forget it. And neither will I.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Awaken, Queensguard: Meet with Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Hello, Guardian. Good to see you again. Wish it were under better circumstances. I don't believe we've met. Devrim Kay. Velask.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Velask. I am Misraaks, Kell of the House of Light.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I’d heard the Vanguard had Eliksni allies in the City. Good to have you here.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Yes, many have come to the Vanguard's aid. Marakel is using her Light to protect us.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: “Kell”? There is no need for honorifics... and my power is not of the Light.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Afraid we must cut the pleasantries short. In the aftermath of the attack on the Traveler, the Shadow Legion has begun taking captives to the Pyramids.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Amanda Holliday is… we cannot reach her on any frequency.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Holliday is out there. Of that, I'm certain. I'll continue scanning the comms. Knowing her, she's up to something. The only question is what, precisely. Give me a moment to prepare the LZ, and I'll brief you. Until then!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Together, we will save the captives, AND Amanda. The Light provides.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: You will need more than the Light to stand against the Witness... but I can provide. Now go, and I will focus on the battles to come
Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ
Awaken, Queensguard: Message from Mara Sov

title: Awaken, Queensguard: Briefing from Devrim Kay — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: All right, Guardian. I'll keep it brief. The Witness took a swing at the Traveler, and when we tried to intervene, our pilots went down… Amanda Holliday among them. The survivors—what there were of them—went to ground near Trostland and Old Russia. Now the damned Shadow Legion is picking through the wreckage and capturing prisoners. We're running rescue ops in the EDZ now. Crow has gone ahead to scout the defenses. He's reporting the Pyramid outpost is utterly impenetrable. Fortunately, the queen is on our side. Mara is imbuing you with otherworldly power… Awoken magics and all that. I'm not sure how it works myself, but if she believes you can make it through, I'm not about to disagree. I'm glad you're here, Guardian. I'll see you in the field.

title: Awakening — Transcript

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Before she went to war, Queen Mara left me with three orders… Protect our people. Hide our secrets. Believe in the plan. I have protected. I have hidden. I have believed. Now, I want answers. I want to know what drove Uldren to madness. I want to kill whatever evil has crept into the Dreaming City. And most of all, I want to see my Queen again. I want to know that she lives.
Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something pulled Uldren to the Watchtower. Petra came here to find answers, and she asked you to watch her back. I'll be here to watch yours. Let's get to high ground and find her.
The Guardian heads uphill. Petra's ship appears as it flies past the Guardian.
The Guardian follows Petra's ship and approaches an area with three women hovering in the air.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those women used to be Awoken…
The Guardian is teleported to the Ascendant Plane by the women.
The Guardian defeats the Taken which appear, including Savriks, Riven's Patience, and Val Grask, Warmth of Riven. A glowing white ball appears. The Guardian approaches the white ball.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: YOU! Why would you come here? There is no place less suited for the likes of you, walking in the dreamland of your enemies.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: And what, am I to be your Virgil? A guide, a shepherd? [chuckle] No, no, no…
The Guardian continues to follow Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: There are no guides here. It is a place of scheming queens and traps unsprung.
The Guardian continues to follow Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: "The dreary plain, forlorn and wild, the seat of desolation, void of light!" Ha!
The Guardian continues to follow Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: You walk blind above an abyss, full of trust for a friendly voice. You're playing right into her hands.
The Guardian continues to follow Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: Leave the Dreaming City while you still can, dear squanderer.
The Guardian is teleported back to the Dreaming City.
Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian heads towards the rendezvous point with Petra. They defeat the Taken and the Hive they encounter. The Guardian finds Petra's ship.
The Guardian defeats the Taken which appear, including Urlos, Greeting of Riven, and Mat Azar, Riven's Welcome. The Guardian finds Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Guardian! You made it. I know what happened to Uldren. I've seen the evil that we face. I have to tell the Queen, or we are lost. There. Watch this. Mara Sov! My queen. Are you there? Can you hear me? Damn it! Calibration looks good. Signal is strong. And the Offering… Wait. The Offering is missing.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: This is an Oracle. It can do nothing without an Offering. Maybe I can override it, somehow…

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: There is an immense creature at the heart of this place. But I cannot say more. The Queen must be the first to know. I'm sorry, my friends.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: We evac'd just before the Taken War. Queen Mara ordered everything to be locked down. Then she and the Techeuns sealed off the Watchtower, and Mara made a deal with the Spider. Protect it, and she would turn a blind eye to his businesses. No one was supposed to come back here until everything was safe. You're lucky to see this place, you know. It's sacred. Outsiders are forbidden.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Awoken built hidden cities like this throughout the Reef. In some, we live and raise our children. In others, we build our weapons. We train our armies — or we used to, when we had armies. Here, in the Dreaming City, we learn from greater powers. We meditate. We transcend. This is our most sacred place.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Techeuns call it an Oracle Engine. They say Queen Mara used it to walk between realities. No one knew where she went, but they used the Oracle to learn from her while she was gone. Mara has told me it's much more than that… Perhaps you and I will see, someday.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You talk about her like she's alive. Uldren did, too.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Uldren — was not himself. He believed he heard her voice. I believe she lives.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: She had a plan. She always had a plan. Queen Mara does not fail. But whatever it was that spoke to Uldren was not my queen. It was that thing.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Did you see the Queen's Techeuns?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm not sure. We were attacked by three women while we were trying to find you.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That's them. Mara's most trusted advisors — corrupted by the Taken. Those women raised me. If there's a way to save them, we must take it.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: We need to get this working. I must speak to the Queen. The fate of the Dreaming City is at stake.
The Guardian searches for an Offering. The Guardian defeats the Scorn, including Elikaa, Sworn to Vengeance, and retrieves the Offering. The Guardian heads back to Petra.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We found an Offering, Petra. The Scorn had it.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I should've known — vengeful thieves. Bring it up here.
The Guardian presents the Offering to the Oracle Engine

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Mara! You're — alive! I'm so — I mean — My Queen.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: And I see you brought the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Yes, forgive me, Your Grace. But I have news. Your brother, Prince Uldren is —

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Of course. He — his soul was corrupted by the Taken. He suffered from delusions, which I now believe were caused by —

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Yes, m'lady. She, too, has been Taken, as have Kalli, Shuro, and Sedia.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: So many loved ones turned against us…

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Tell me what to do, my lady… Please.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Assemble a team, Petra. Send them into the heart of the City. Kill that creature and extract its heart. I offer the riches of our realm as bounty. Open the gates, and let the Guardians in. I must go. The battle rages on. If you have news, send it. I will answer as I am able. Stay strong, my Wrath. I believe in you.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Yes. Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken, LIVES. I'm going to get my ship. Meet me when you can.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Awaken, Queensguard: Briefing from Devrim Kay
Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ

title: As Prophesied: Broadcast from Lakshmi-2 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the radio in the H.E.L.M. Lakshmi-2's portrait is displayed as she speaks.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: People of the Last City: we have endured many great tragedies thanks to our strength and a steadfast commitment to humanity. The Traveler chose us. It abandoned the Fallen because they are unfit, unworthy of the Light. They would take it from us if they could. The Vanguard have lost their way. They embrace the Darkness. Welcome Eramis's followers into our midst with open arms. Force us to celebrate our lost heroes alongside those who murdered them. Yes, the Endless Night is over. But now, Mithrax and his House will use this opportunity to do what the Fallen have always done. Covet. Cheat. Steal. Kill. I have seen the future with my own eyes, and it has not changed. Doom still builds on our horizon like a terrible storm. But there is hope. Right now, loyalists to the Future War Cult and New Monarchy have rounded up the Fallen in our city. With the aid of Osiris, I have learned how to safely command the power of the Vex. I will use it to do what the Vanguard will not. I will tear open a rift; banish the Fallen to the depths of space from where they came. We alone will save humanity. I have seen the darkest of futures, and with this act, I will–
Lakshmi-2 pauses and there is radio static. Vex can be heard roaring in the background.
Her voice distorts mechanically as she screams, carrying on for a few moments before fading out. The transmission ends in silence.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Awaken, Queensguard: Meet with Mara Sov

title: Bad Blood — Transcript

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Something's got the Hive more riled than usual down in the Plaguelands, and we can't afford another front in this fight. The Fallen Splicers are trouble enough.
So get down there, Guardian. If the Splicers are stirring up the Hive, we need to know how and why. And you need to put a stop to it.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: The Hive are hitting the Splicers near the beached Tanker, head that way and find out why they're at each other's throats.
Guardian makes way to Giant's Husk

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's possible we're walking into a territorial dispute, but something's telling me there's more to it than that.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Agreed. The Hive can be defensive, but what I'm tracking seems like a full-on assault. The chatter's aggressive, angry. This isn't just a show of force. The Hive are after something.
Guardian arrives in Giant's Husk, Fallen and Hive battling

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I was expecting hostilities, but this is... They're at war.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Take out as many as you want, but my advice? Find the Splicer leading this fight, and put him down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There! A Splicer Captain. Up high. Near the overpass.
Guardian climbs adjacent rocks, upwards to overpass

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's a coded relay from the Splicer's High Priest. There's references to the Hive here.
The Splicer's High Priest is either keeping something from the Hive or has taken something from them.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Search the overpass. See what else you find.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whatever the Splicers have locked up here, the Hive are hungry for it. Let's crack open some crates, see what their High Priest is hiding.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No luck, but we should keep looking.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No luck, but we should keep looking

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nothing. Let's keep looking. We're not done. Keep checking crates.
Hive pour out from crate, Guardian attacks

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Splicer's High Priest is... He's corralling Thrall. Collecting them.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: No wonder the Hive are on the warpath. Any chance this isn't related to the Splicers' experiments with SIVA?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Slim to none. There were heavy SIVA readings all over the Hive they had crated, along with an odd heat signature.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think the Splicers are simply displacing the Thrall.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: The Splicers' role within a Fallen House is equivalent to a mad scientist.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Sure. Just didn't want to be the one who said it. Point is, they're the Fallen's big brains. We've seen what they can do with limited knowledge of SIVA. They've basically force-fed their own evolution. So...

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What if they're attempting the same with the Hive?

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: They can control them... or worse.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There are SIVA readings pinging all over this region. I'll try to match them against the specific heat signature we found.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need a closer look at what's in that cave.
Guardian is ambushed by spawning Hive

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is worst-case scenario. The Splicers aren't in a territorial war with the Hive; they're experimenting on them.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: And if the Splicer's High Priest is going to these lengths, he's either gone crazy with power or he's taking orders from someone who has.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Or a Prime. Either's bad news. But for now, we've got a clear-cut problem. We need to find this High Priest and put an end to his atrocities.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Awaken, Queensguard: Message from Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: May this transmission reach you… wherever you find yourself. The Scepter will rest true in the hands of its wielder, but a message comes with no such guarantee. In the aftermath of the Witness's attack, the Vanguard called for aid. On behalf of the Awoken people, I answered. We now face a war on two fronts: one on the far reaches of the system, and the other at your home, Earth. Continue your fight against the Voice in the Darkness. I will assist as best I can in your absence. But even my powers have their limits. Return when you are able. Your people need their heroes.
Awaken, Queensguard: Meet with Mara Sov

title: Behold: Pleasure Gardens, Derelict Leviathan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: A once-glorious monument, now little more than a sunken head. All things decay and change. It is the nature of the universe. Entropy knows no master, walking hand in hand with the phantom of time. All things that exist are doomed to crumble. Only that which does not exist — which has never existed — is truly free. Contemplate this, my friend.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Looks like Calus has seen better days.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: There is an unplanned truth in the monument's depiction of my form. Just as I have let this statue crumble, so have I allowed myself to. This withered flesh is an inefficient vessel by which to explore the limits of sensation the universe allows. I wish for something new.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I imagine this is how Caiatl must see me. A crumbling monument to indulgence, long forgotten. It matters not. I gave my daughter everything she needed to succeed, and she returned the favor with a knife in my back. And yet, I continue to give her chance after chance. Hoping that, perhaps, she will see reason. That I only want what is best for her.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Huh. Cabal really do love their war beasts. I wonder if this was a specific one.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Milos, Caiatl's first war beast. I gifted it to her when she was just a girl. She was so very attached to it. Too attached. I had it butchered. It felt insulting for her to love an animal more than her father.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: War beasts are celebrated part of Cabal culture. They were native to our homeworld, Torobatl... when such a world still existed. In my era, each war beast was bred to serve a specific handler from birth. The bond between war beast and soldier was profound. I assume Ghaul saw fit to change that, turning them into something that is a military asset and not a partner. A shame.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: War beast statue. Gold-plated and... can't tell what the material beneath is. Definitely radioactive, though. I wonder if Saladin has a war beast of his own, now that he's working with Caiatl? It's probably best that he's not here, though. With his history? [chuckles ruefully] I'd hate to see what Nightmare the Leviathan would create for him.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: They are majestic, are they not? These fungi are not unlike your world's mushrooms in how they live, how they breathe, how they grow. Their mycelial networks do not proliferate in soil, but rather spread like ethereal conduits between dimensions of space.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This... sounds a lot like the Ley Lines in the Dreaming City. Is that possible?

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Do you know these fungi are drawn to the unique psychological phenomena of death? The moment of true terror before life ends… the death of sentient beings fosters the growth of these fungi. Normally it takes centuries for them to spread like this, but…

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: But Calus sacrificed countless lives to feed his pet project. This is horrifying.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I have become quite attached to this fungus since I discovered it on a world far from yours. It grew in great forests across the planet. Even here, infinitely far from where the first spore was harvested, they remain connected. Darkness is many things, Guardian. Many things.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'm sure Eris might find this information... insightful. But I'm a bit nervous about intelligent fungus that can think across the void of space.

title: Behold: Derelict Leviathan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Guardian! Welcome, welcome! The Leviathan beckons, and you answered. I knew you would survive its greeting. Such tenacity. Such grace and wisdom. This is why I want to... share my bounty with you. We do not have to be enemies. I have heard the Voice in the Darkness, Guardian, and it sings a song of peace everlasting. Come and see.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Good. Great. Perfectly normal. All right, Guardian, let's go, see what Calus wants to show us.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: There's material embedded in the hull here. I can't be certain, but I think it might be Ghost Shell fragments.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Your scout is as keen as he is troubled. I did have some Guardians as guests. They appreciated my generosity, my compliments. I appreciated their capacity for enduring pain, and the generous offerings of their final deaths. Nothing is gained without some sacrifice.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It looks like someone fought a war in here before us, but I've never read any reports of a full-scale conflict on the Leviathan.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: There were those among my Loyalists who lacked conviction in the face of the unknown. No transition is ever painless. But now? We're of one mind.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Beyond those doors lie some of my greatest creations, but also my greatest failures. I feel a sense of kinship to my Loyalists. I feel a sense of kinship to my Loyalists. They are like family to me. Even more so now, as each is but an appendage of the greater apparatus I am becoming. I cannot wait for you to behold my majesty.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: That doesn't make any sense. It sounded like he was talking about a lab. But if I'm reading this map correctly, this door leads to the baths.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The Leviathan has changed since last I had guests. Its innards have twisted into new shapes, its steely flesh blooming with new growth. I encourage you to witness these changes for yourself, and ask a question: What more could you become, if only didn't fear loss?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: There's spores in the air here: same kind we'd seen aboard Calus' research vessel, Glykon. They don't seem to be harmful.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Aspirating the Egregore spores allows them to take root in your body. While they are symbiotic, they are also short-lived. But for a time, they join your consciousness to that of the mycelial network, and other minds that would witness you.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: This ship was once so full of a specific kind of life, vascular and wet: flesh, meat, bone. Now, new life flourishes in the dark. My Menagerie became a feeding trough for such splendor, the likes of which are both beautiful and obscene.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: The plants we're seeing here appear to be concentrated through those doors. Maybe it's where they started?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: The map of the Leviathan says there was some sort of arena near here, but I think it’s derelict. No signs of life. There’s bodies, though.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Once upon a time, I would enjoy watching blood sport with my Shadows. Loyal to the end to their friend, to his riches. My Shadows paved the way for my transcendence, and for that, I am eternally grateful.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: In my exile, I thought of the Leviathan as a prison. But what I have found while journeying has given me greater perspective. Do you hear that, Guardian? The Leviathan is breathing. Its veins pulse, its heart beats. This ship is alive, in so many ways.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It's not actually alive, is it?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Weird readings here. The power conduits below this spot have a reversed flow. The energy is behaving… strangely. I don’t know how to describe it.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The Leviathan is growing, changing, transforming. You are witnessing the death of one state of being… and the beginning of another. Terrible and beautiful new life will bloom from its carcass.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: One of these days, Guardian, we will meet face to face. There is an inevitability to our lives, the course of them. I merely hope that when we do, it is with one mind and one vision for the future. Not as enemies.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: People have made me similar offers before, and they never turn out well. For anyone.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: According to the Vanguard database, Calus' throne room is beyond these doors. And below it's some sort of... fabrication lab.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The heart of the Leviathan, yes. A forge where I replaced tired and imperfect flesh with gleaming steel and glittering jewels. But even those aspirations were misguided. I did not truly see until I slipped beyond the edge of our universe and... was witnessed.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Our last meeting beyond these doors was exhilarating, was it not? I wish you had been able to stay, to shed this... dead meat you inhabit. Perhaps in time, I can help you understand. All of this, it is temporary. Fleeting. It is not worth fighting for.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: That sounds a lot like cowardice. You're too afraid to lose, so you'd rather just give up.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: [chuckles] You think this statue is big enough?

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: That monument was forged from exotic matter mined from the heart of a neutron star. It was sculpted by one of my empire's finest artists. May he rest in peace.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I once reveled here for hours on end, contemplating mysteries of the universe while soaking in these now-stagnant pools... Gorged on wines and fruits from across the empire, asking questions of the stars. Yet the truest question was one I could not think to ask.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Going to take a while to get that image out of my head.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Why is Calus showing us all this instead of Caiatl? Is he avoiding her?

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: You would do well to keep my daughter's name out of your mouth, whelp. She is not and never will be your concern. Caiatl will come to see things my way... in her own time.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: There's definitely something below us, a larger facility. I can't tell if it's still functional. On a scan, it looks like the hull folded in on itself.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My Leviathan has been changing, contorting itself into new shapes and forms both regal and majestic. I encourage you to stay around long enough to bask in the majesty of our transformations.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My cloning facilities below the baths are a labor of love. It took centuries to perfect their design. It has long been a point of personal pride that my Loyalists are handcrafted. Each meticulously engineered to exacting specification.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I suppose that makes sense. I can't imagine anyone willingly serving you.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'm picking up something weird under the — wait. This isn't water. It's a protein slurry. There's Cabal DNA mixed in this and —

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Ah, yes. I suppose calling these "baths" is a bit of a misnomer. They are built atop a cloning facility where my Loyalists are engineered. What you are standing in is the liquefied remains of failed experiments, which was fed to their unborn kin.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I suppose that makes sense. I can't imagine anyone willingly serving you.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I remember a day when these lifts would rise, expelling new, perfectly engineered Cabal champions into my embrace.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Perfectly? The way I hear it, most of them were failures, like the one you engineered to bear the Crown of Sorrow.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: It is not failure, it is progress.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Based on structural scans, this chain is part of a containment system that connects to a lab below us. It's too badly damaged to use. This must have been a deployment system. When whatever was engineered down there was finished, it was brought here.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: These mechanisms no longer serve a purpose. My cloning facilities no longer serve a purpose. I have been shown... new horizons.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'm reading pieces of exterior hull fused with the machinery below this lift. I can't explain how the outside of the ship got in here.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: When this ship passed beyond the threshold of our universe, the change had already begin. You are witnessing its growing pains. I can feel every bulkhead, every door, every pillar pulsing with new life. You understand, now, what I wanted to show you.

title: Beneath the Waves: Reconvene at the H.E.L.M. — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Good to be back in contact with the Vanguard. It's an honor to serve with you. The Taken moved in quick after we lost Titan. I had to switch gears: escape, evade, and rotate between extraction points. Survive for another day. That was the mission. I absorbed some of the Taken corruption to tap into their comms… if you can call them that. My bond with Ahsa proved mission critical, too. I owe her my life. Now that Titan's back, the mission's changed. We need more intel on our enemy… the Witness. Drifter claims he knows a way to help Ahsa share that intel—boost the signal so her message can get through. If he's right, then you're going to need some diving equipment. Thankfully, I was able to secure a pair of intact subnauticals from the Arcology's storage units. Feel free to toss out that junk Drifter gave you earlier. This is the real deal.

title: Beneath the Waves: Reunite with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: An ally. Her name is Ahsa.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: It's complicated, sir. I get impressions, emotions… ideas. She knows our true enemy. The Witness came for her species too. Discrete concepts are harder. Even more now… since this.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Every bit. My Light is holding this corruption back, but I can… hear voices whispering. Demanding. It's like being tuned in to the enemy's radio. If we could strengthen my connection with Ahsa, I believe it would improve my ability to communicate through the noise.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I got some ideas. I'll draw up some specs and drop by soon.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm fine, sir. And I think I'm long overdue for a debriefing.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: As you wish. We'll reconvene at the H.E.L.M.

title: Beyond Infinity — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Osiris saw something in the Infinite Forest— and it terrified him. NOTHING terrifies him. We need to find him

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Osiris could be anywhere. Put in the wrong coordinates and you'll never find your way out.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I know I can do it. Osiris is in there protecting the rest of us from the Vex. He needs us. He needs ME. And we're going to find him.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Osiris has adopted some of the technology of the Forest to his own purposes. We're going to run into his Reflections. They're copies — of himself. Made so he can explore multiple pathways at once. And yes, I am aware that it makes Osiris seem like an egomaniac. But don't worry. He is.
The Guardian begins to activate the Well

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Osiris has to be here somewhere.

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Sagira! You shouldn't be here. And you've brought someone new with you.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Who? Oh, her? Get this — she's a friend of Ikora's.
The Guardian makes their way through the Well while Reflections of Osiris pop into and out of reality.

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Osiris sent you away for your own safety. Your presence ere puts everything at risk.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Well guess what? He needs me.

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: New timelines are expanding. We must create Reflections to explore them.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: What do they mean, "too late"? Something must have gone wrong.
Infinite Forest, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: You cannot go to him, Sagira.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: What? What did he find? What's so bad that it could scare Osiris?

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Behold — the Infinite Forest! A planet sized prediction engine, simulating trillions of realities in parallel, all geared towards a single Vex purpose. Keep going, and you'll see.
The Guardian makes their way through the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Vex are simulating reality in here. Brute forcing the future. And before you ask: everything in here IS real enough to kill you.
A locked gate blocks the Guardian's path

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Sometimes the Forest blocks a path Eliminate the Daemon controlling the local simulation, and the door should open.
Simulant Past, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: First, I will show you were it all began. Mercury, untold centuries ago, before the Vex arrived. Here, the Vex planted the seed that became the Infinite Forest, and its Mind, Panoptes. Panoptes has a single purpose — reshape reality for the Vex. All this started with a single Vex. Will it end with the arrival of a single Guardian? And only the Vex.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Now I see why he's made so many new Reflections.

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Yes, we've tried, and failed, to prevent this outcome. Now even our best efforts only slow it. But you must see for yourself.
Infinite Forest, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Tell me Guardian. Were you there when the Traveler woke? A living Traveler changes everything. For good and bad. Now many things have been set in motion. Osiris wrote the lost prophecies to warn the other Guardian, and they sent him away. But you cannot exile the future.
The Guardian makes their way across the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: We must find and stop Panoptes, but none of us have discovered a timeline where we succeed. This is what it looks like when we fail. This is the future the Vex want.
Simulant Future, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The Lighthouse! This is what Osiris saw.

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Neither Light nor Darkness exists anymore. The sun's warmth is gone. All life… lost. But that was before you. You are the key. You can stop this. Every timeline we've tracked leads here. We must destroy Panoptes to prevent this dark future.
Vex on Mercury awaken and Panoptes appears

lines.speaker: Reflection of Osiris
lines.text: Panoptes! He's found us! Go! You're more important than any of us now!
The Guardian jumps through the portal

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: This is bad. Really, really bad. We need to work together. All of us — you, me, Osiris, Ikora. If we don't stop Panoptes, you've seen what happens.
The Lighthouse, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Sagira? You just left… Where's Osiris?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: In trouble. We all are. I'll explain everything on our way back to the City.
The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: So, its the end of everything. I thought after the Red War, we'd get a bit of a break. I'm not giving up yet. If nothing else, the Vex are methodical. They'd have a schematic of the Forest. A map. And that map will show where Panoptes is. There's only one place they could store that much data: the Pyramidion on Io.

title: Beyond Light Campaign Introduction — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Exo Stranger
lines.text: I've seen terrible things born out in the darkness. Every moment brings them closer. My future does not begin here. But yours does. It's time to step beyond the Light. And it all begins… with a Splinter.
Variks traverses the Europan surface in pursuit of an old communication center. Variks places his cache on the table behind him and activates the comm relay.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: My friends. We are in great danger. Earth, the Great Machine, Eliksni… and Human.
The Exo Stranger quietly transmats behind Variks.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Darkness walks among us. We are all in great danger. My kind must survive.
The Exo Stranger opens Variks' cache revealing a Splinter of Darkness within.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Please… send help… There is not much time.
The Exo Stranger receives a transmission, altering Variks. She grabs the Splinter and transmats away as Variks turns around in confusion.
Fallen Skiffs descend upon the Variks's location and multiple soldiers surround the area.

lines.speaker: The Spider

Taken pour out, Scorn flow in - place is a revolving door, and I'm washing my hands of it. So, you see our Awoken friends, you tell them I met the parameters of my commitment 100%. Bon voyage, friend. Oh, and the next time you get the itch to play on the right side of wrong, you know where to find me.

title: Beyond — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian heads towards the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Our fate lies ahead of us. That Pyramid destroyed so many lives so long ago. Getting inside is paramount. We must find something - anything - to help us prepare for their violent return. Remember to keep your wits about you. We do not know what tricks they may play within.
The Guardian continues towards the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's happening again. Like it's reaching inside me.
The Guardian continues towards the Pyramid. The Guardian defeats the Hive which they encounter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It beckons us to come closer.
The Guardian is pulled into the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Violence. Beauty. Truth. These things await inside. There's no turning back now.
The Guardian heads further into the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're so close now. Just a little further.
The Guardian can encounter the Nightmares in the order they choose.

The Guardian encounters the Nightmare of Ghaul. The Guardian is transported to an area that looks similar to the top of the Immortal, the ship where the Guardian originally defeated Ghaul. The Guardian defeats the Nightmare of Ghaul.
The Guardian is transported back to the inside of the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Red War saw so many lives lost. Saw the Light taken away so easily. In Light, there is only weakness.

The Guardian heads further into the Pyramid. The Guardian encounters the Nightmare of The Fanatic. The Guardian is transported to an area that looks similar to the entrance to the Watchtower, where the Guardian originally defeated the Fanatic. The Guardian defeats the Nightmare of The Fanatic
The Guardian is transported back to the inside of the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Light abandoned Cayde. Left him for dead. And kept him from being saved.

The Guardian heads further into the Pyramid. The Guardian encounters the Nightmare of Crota, Son of Oryx. The Guardian is transported to an area that looks similar to the area in Crota's throne world where the Guardian originally defeated Crota. The Guardian defeats the Nightmare of Crota, Son of Oryx. The Guardian is transported back to the inside of the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: One by one, Crota slaughtered many Guardians.The Light stood by and did nothing. And a great disaster ensued. In Light, there is only death.
The Guardian heads further into the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Come to us. Do not be afraid. Respite lies ahead.

The Guardian finds a statue of a veiled figure. An orb descends from the ceiling to rest in front of the Guardian. The Guardian inspects the Unknown Artifact. The Guardian is teleported to The Black Garden.
A figure matching the appearance of the Guardian approaches the Guardian. Several Pyramids can be seen in the distance.

lines.speaker: Unknown Figure
lines.text: You made it. We have heard your cries for help. And soon we will answer.

lines.speaker: Unknown Figure
lines.text: Don't you recognize us? We are not your friend. We are not your enemy… We are your… Salvation.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They are not our salvation… They're our destruction. This has been a manipulation from the very start. They know we're here. They know what we've found. The artifact you recovered may be tainted. After all, they wanted us to have it. But a treasure such as this is far too valuable to destroy. I must stay and study it with the utmost care. Whatever I discover, you will be the first to know.
The Guardian gives Eris Morn the Unknown Artifact.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: In the meantime, the Nightmares continue to plague parts of our galaxy, leaving only suffering in their wake. If we ignore them, they fester and spread. How long before they reach the Last City? How long before our friends become infected with this same torment? We will not let this come to pass. These Nightmares must be kept at bay. Whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6

title: Beyond Light Prologue — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: People of the Last City. Humanity has endured a devastating blow. Vanguard scouts have confirmed that Io, Mars, Titan, and Mercury… have disappeared. We don't know why. We have lost contact with Deputy Commander Sloane and Gensym Scribe Asher Mir. We are deploying Guardians to all corners of the system to find answers. And with those answers, we will form a plan. In the meantime… we ask that all Lightless civilians remain within the safety of the City walls, under the protection of the Traveler. Do not lose hope. Humanity has survived many horrors. We have done so through the strength of our community. Through steadfast commitment to one another. Stay strong. Be brave. The Traveler protects us… and we will protect you. The Guardians will come through. They always do.

title: Born In Darkness Part 2: Speak to the Exo Stranger — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Turns out, Clovis's journal is fairly encrypted, and I'm unable to bypass most of it. Probably to keep it away from, well, me. I stood by his side for a time. It's why I look like this. He needed a guinea pig, and after Dad passed… I needed a father figure. Eventually, I realized my mistake and joined my sisters in trying to take our grandfather down. So Clovis took precautions to keep us from interfering. Didn't want us exposing every dark truth about every unethical experiment. And so here we are. Encrypted journal and all. I think it's about time we extract some good from the bad.
Exo Stranger — Born in Darkness Part 2
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Born In Darkness Part 3: Speak to the Exo Stranger — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Exo Stranger at the campsite.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Thanks for your help last time. I was able to decrypt a portion of the journal with what we found, and — it's even more unsavory than I ever knew. Amongst the madness, however, it appears our efforts were not in vain. Clovis hadn't just found Stasis — he'd enhanced it. Fortunately for the world, he didn't know how to use it. Just sat in a lab somewhere until the Collapse, like so many of his experiments. Decrypting the remainder of his journal should point us in the direction of that knowledge. And I know where we can do just that.
Exo Stranger — Born in Darkness Part 3
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Black Armory - Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.text: Annex, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian enters a room with weapons on display. They approach one of the displays.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Stunning, isn't it? That weapon… is beyond special. A witness to the slaughter of our founder. And my ally in vengeance against those responsible. Lightbearers. Just. Like. You. You are not welcome here, Guardian.
The Guardian holds up the Black Armory badge given to them by the Spider.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: I see. Well, then… What we offer, Guardian, is privilege - normally afforded to those who do not already have their own. Today, however, it would seem our doors are open to you. Welcome… to the Black Armory.
