title: Born In Darkness Part 3: Key to the Truth — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian enters the Concealed Void lost sector and clears the area of House Salvation Fallen. The Guardian rendezvous with the Exo Stranger and Ana Bray.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I knew Clovis was bad, but all this… I'm feeling a little ashamed of being a Bray right now.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Elsie… Clovis, you… This is all I wanted. All I searched for. But you've been around this whole time, and I never heard from you —
Ana turns to face the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Guardian? What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: This is actually why I brought you here, Ana.
The Guardian uses the Skeleton Key.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Perfect. This is exactly what we need to decrypt the journal and find that Stasis research.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ana… what we're doing here is extremely important. Stasis is just a tool. We've used it for good —

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I was skeptical at first too, Ana —

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Both of you? After everything it's done to us?

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ana. Our past — I thought that keeping it from you was the best way to protect you.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Protect me? I've been protecting myself just fine without your help, thanks. And this? Using the Darkness? That can't end well.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: And it didn't before. But this time —

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: In another timeline, Ana, you were… too obsessed with your past for your own good. And I was… too selfish for my own good. The truth is… I'm not from this timeline. Where I come from, the Darkness won. And I tried to shield you from it, but all I did was… Drive you to it. I'm sorry for keeping so much from you. I think the best way to help you now… is just to be there for you.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Look… I don't mean to be ungrateful, and it's incredible that you're alive. Really. But I… don't know how to handle this. I'm sorry.
Ana transmats away from the area.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Being honest with her was the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Time will tell. For now, I'll keep working to find the location of Clovis's Stasis research. We'll talk again soon.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Born In Darkness: Speak to the Exo Stranger — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Exo Stranger at the campsite.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Humanity's refuge does not lie in us alone. We must awaken Darkness far and wide. Teach the masses to use it for good. But first, we must awaken its power fully. There was one whose knowledge of the Darkness exceeded even our own. My grandfather: Clovis Bray I. "Elisabeth," he said to me as I woke, born again as an Exo. "You are going to save the world." What a load of crap. The old man didn't care about saving the world. He only cared about his precious legacy. Still… here's to hoping he was right. Clovis kept most of his secrets in his personal journal. And I know just where we can find it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Catharsis: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. to debrief with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Even with all our strength, we barely stopped Calus. This was not a victory, Guardian. It has merely bought us time. Calus has become an emissary of the Witness. He is the harbinger of the second Collapse. For all we know, this was Calus's plan from the beginning. Luring Guardians to his side with promises of riches and lavishing them with praise… ...only to slaughter all of humanity at the behest of a voice whispering to him in the dark. Calus may be gone, but the Leviathan remains, and it will take months to clear out the remaining Nightmares and assure there's no longer a threat. But even those efforts may be for naught. We have reached the point of no return. The Witness is near. It is the beginning of the end.

title: Born In Darkness Part 4: Key to the Truth — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian rendezvous with the Exo Stranger and Ana Bray and confronts the Clovis Bray AI.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Yeah, well… it's not every day you reunite your robot sister after the apocalypse. …And because I figured if you went to that much trouble to protect me, you must really care.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I do. I've just been scared, Ana. About losing you, again. I thought I was doing the right thing keeping the truth from you.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: All you need to do is be my sister, Elsie. Whatever truths we face, no matter how tough, we'll do it together.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: No better time than the present, then.
The Exo Stranger turns to face the Guardian.
The Guardian uses the Skeleton Key on the Clovis Bray AI.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Confidential intelligence activated. It has been centuries since our collective passing, and yet, my granddaughters, Elisabeth and Anastasia, stand before me, alive.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: I assume since you've made it this far, you've come for my research. Potent Darkness energy. This is what you were looking for, Elisabeth? I could never use it, but… something tells me you can.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I can. And will. But not alone. We can all use it for good. To save humanity.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: No, no, no. What? That's not what it's for at all. It's for research. For legacy. For the Bray name only.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Don't get holier-than-thou on me, Elisabeth. Need I remind it was you who volunteered for Project Exo? You knew the Bray name was at stake, and you fought for it. Unlike your sisters. Oh, your mother, even your father. All ungrateful and weak.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You were always a bastard, Clovis.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: And yet, you stood beside me willingly, even into eternal life. Life I gave you.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Well good thing you did. Because I'm going to use it to help save the universe from evil like you.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Your naivete was always to be your downfall, Granddaughter. Enjoy the gift. And don't forget, you'll always be a Bray… like me.
The Clovis Bray AI goes offline.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You know, Clovis was always problematic. But he used to have some humanity. Before he let the Darkness take it from him.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Screw him. He can't control us anymore. Let's take this power and use it exactly like he doesn't want us to. For humanity.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ana's right. We have what we came for. Time to take it to the Ziggurat. Come find me after.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Born In Darkness Part 4: Regroup with the Exo Stranger — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian regroups with the Exo Stranger at the campsite.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I just wanted to say… thank you. For so much. Most of all, helping me reunite with my sister. In the dark future, Ana was tempted. And I wasn't there for her. From now on, she can count on me. And when she's ready to wield Darkness for good — I'll be right there to guide her. In fact, I'll be here to guide anyone who wants it. The Vanguard only recognizes the Light. Someone has to do the same for the Dark. Or else we risk losing everyone and everything. We have a universe yet to save. I'm looking forward to doing it together.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Born In Darkness Part 4: Speak to the Exo Stranger — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Exo Stranger at the campsite.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Turns out, Clovis really did find Stasis power within the Darkness. He just didn't know how to use it. So naturally, he hid it. Lucky for us, he did so in the most Clovis Bray of locations. With himself. The giant Exo at the bottom of the Exo Factory? That's him. Well, his AI. And I think it's time we all had a talk. Ana included. This is her journey too. In the dark future, she was going to take it with or without me. And when I wasn't there… the Darkness was. I won't let that happen again.
Exo Stranger — Born in Darkness Part 4
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Forgiveness: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: After Zavala's successful ritual of severance, the Guardian returns to the Wing of the Haunted to debrief with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is done. Another of Calus's connections to the lunar Pyramid is severed. We are poised to strike the final blow. And yet… I find myself unable to enjoy this success. It has come too easily. Only one connection remains to the lunar Pyramid, and Calus has barely reacted. There is a piece of his agenda that we cannot yet see… I know it! To be this close and still feel as though it is but a mirage is… infuriating. I will find the answer to our final severance. For now, continue your exploration of the Leviathan. Any piece of information, no matter how small, could change everything.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Forgiveness: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Crown of Sorrow and speaks to Eris, who has devised a plan of attack for the next ritual.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We begin again, with fresh eyes and open hearts. I believe the commander has found the strength he needs. So too must we marshal ourselves for the task ahead, for there is more at stake here. As time progresses, Calus's hold on the lunar Pyramid grows in strength. For each connection we have severed, the remaining grow stronger. The Nightmares only increase in number, and soon I fear they will overflow from the Leviathan and spread across the system. Zavala is ready to face his past again. Collect the necessary reagents for the next ritual and join him on the Leviathan. We cannot afford to fail again.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: Check in with Zavala

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Grief: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian joins Eris at the Crown of Sorrow. for a debriefing after Zavala's failed ritual.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Zavala's wounds run deeper than he allows us to see. The lengths he has gone to cut himself off from his heart is... familiar. It is through accepting what we cannot change where we find the strength to move forward. We grieve, we move, and we grow. Zavala only knows grief. But perhaps there is hope in others, in the counsel of friends and family. There is no running from his truth any longer. The past is laid bare, and so too the commander's heart. [takes a deep breath] Resume your patrols aboard the Leviathan, Guardian, and I will see what can be done elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: Check in with Zavala

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: Check in with Zavala

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Grief: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: Eris has returned with a bounty of information pertaining to the new state of being created in the ritual. The Guardian meets with Eris at the Crown of Sorrow in the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: With change comes opportunity. In studying this "memory" of Uldren Sov, a truer nature of the Nightmares is revealed. They are born of Darkness, and drawn to it like moths to a flame. Calus is such a fire. Through the Leviathan, Calus's mind reaches down to the lunar Pyramid, forging the connection that draws the Nightmares to him. And should that connection be severed…

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We can stop Calus dead in his tracks before he causes any more damage. Your success with Crow isn't going to go unnoticed. Calus will push back… he may be doing so already. Recently, I've been… visited in the H.E.L.M. and elsewhere. By one of the Nightmares Eris bound to the Crown. We need to push harder. I will be accompanying in your next severance mission to weaken Calus's connection to the Pyramid. You and I will get this done.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Go to the Leviathan and harvest the necessary essence of the Nightmares. We must enact the next ritual of severance before it is too late. And Guardian… keep watch over Zavala. As with Crow, the commander may find confronting his past to be the most difficult mission he has ever faced.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Catharsis: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian meets with Eris at the Crown of Sorrow in the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is as I feared. We were too late. In spite of our efforts, the lunar Pyramid has surged to life, and the depths of the Moon roar with this monumental change. Calus has assumed control.

But all may not be lost. Calus's psychic imprint is massive. Like a snail coiled within its shell, not all of him has slithered out of the Leviathan and into the Pyramid. If we strike now, as one, at the heart of Calus's presence within the Leviathan, we may yet be able to prevent him from turning the power of the Pyramid against us.

A ritual of this size will require a massive amount of power, and all of our combined efforts. Crow, Caiatl, and Zavala will need to coordinate with you. Return to the Leviathan, gather the reagents we need to perform one last ritual, and perhaps, just perhaps... we will be able to prevent disaster.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Forgiveness: Transmission from Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: After his successful ritual of severance, Zavala leaves a pre-recorded message for the Guardian in the H.E.L.M. The Guardian approaches a Holoprojector overlooking the Crown of Sorrow.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: When I first saw Safiyah return as a Nightmare, I was afraid. I didn't want her to reveal what I'd done. I did everything I could to save Hakim. I can accept that now. But back then… Guilt, like gravity, warps our perception of what is real. His death carved out a place in me, and everyone I lose under my command only compounds that feeling. Safiyah knew that. She understood that losing him only pushed me further toward being a Guardian. She knew that I couldn't stand by and watch the world burn. Because in her own way… neither could she. After everything we faced aboard the Leviathan, I'm left to wonder… Have I made the right choices? I don't regret all the good the City has done, or that I was a part of it. But what it took to get here… what it's taken to keep it… [sighs] Our minds weren't meant for this many years. Like so many other things, we have a word for eternity… without the capacity to comprehend what it actually means. When is enough… enough? Maybe it's time to let go.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: Check in with Zavala

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Grief: Check in with Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: The Tower, The Last City, Earth

Zavala was unprepared for the emotional challenge of confronting his Nightmare. He withdrew to the Tower on Earth following the failed ritual and has refused to speak to anyone about what happened. The Guardian travels to the Tower to speak with him.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: A hollow man… leading others to die… for a silent god. Is that what I've become? Have the years whittled away my nerve? I… was convinced that seeing her might make things easier. That her absence cuts deeper than her presence. But they are… equally sharp. Safiyah. She wants me to speak her name… to confide my feelings in you. [sighs] What good does it do? Go and see Eris. I'll tell her you're coming. She'll know what to say.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Rage: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: After completing the investigation on the Moon, the Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. to debrief with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Calus knew exactly what he was doing. Goading his daughter into striking out on her own, manipulating her. But there is a silver lining to this cloud. The information you retrieved on the Moon has proven to be the final piece of Calus's puzzle. It is no mere curiosity that drew him to the lunar Pyramid. He is a consciousness that spreads out like a vascular system… And he is attempting to become one with the Pyramid, so that he may control it… so that he may wield its power. Worse… it appears as though Calus is not doing so of his own volition. He is doing it at the behest of another, our true enemy. The Voice in the Darkness. The Witness. You must return to the Leviathan, Guardian. Continue your work there while I prepare a ritual to add the empress to our bond.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Rage: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Crown of Sorrow and speaks to Eris about the final ritual of severance.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Leviathan's corruption spreads like a plague. Even as we succeed, Calus's influence strengthens. I had thought his presence at the Moon was fascination. He has always been an explorer of the unknown, a researcher of malign intent but boundless curiosity. But this… this feels different. If Calus's experiments in communing with the Darkness aboard the Glykon was a theory… what we see here and aboard the Leviathan is that theory put into practice. Caiatl has observed Crow and Zavala's successes from afar. She wishes to help us sever Calus's connection to the Pyramid by confronting the Nightmare of Dominus Ghaul. He haunts her relentlessly, as Uldren haunted Crow, as Safiyah haunted Zavala… but Caiatl was not bound with us. There is no certainty a ritual would succeed. I have advised her to remain aboard her flagship for now. In the meantime, we continue our preparations while I look for another solution. I will contact you soon.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Reconciliation: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: With the Nightmare of Uldren Sov transformed into a new kind of force, a victory, of sorts, is at hand. The Guardian returns to the Crown of Sorrow to debrief with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have long said that the Darkness can be used as a power for good, even when others doubted. By helping Crow to accept his past as Uldren Sov, we have changed the inherent nature of a Nightmare into something new. A manifestation of healed trauma... a memory of the man Crow once was. The best of him. Uldren is as much a part of Crow as the Darkness is a part of you or me. And there is more to it than pain. In this success, we have discovered the key to our victory. Through our bond to the Crown of Sorrow, we could convert the Nightmares into a force against Calus. But the process to convert these psychic constructs will not be an easy one. It is a battle Guardians are not accustomed to fighting. I know that shortcoming all too well. Resume your work aboard the Leviathan, Guardian, and I will prepare for the next severance ritual.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah — Transcript

lines.text: After Zavala refuses to discuss the details surrounding the Nightmare haunting him, the Guardian speaks to Eris about the Nightmare of Safiyah.
Eris stands in the central area of the H.E.L.M. The Guardian approaches her and she turns to face them.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Zavala will not speak to you of his regrets... but I will not let him bear them alone. Here. Listen closely: whispers and confessions, as I have heard them. He would tell it differently, but memory clings so loosely to the truth. I will share what I know.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Before the Vanguard, before the City, there was a woman. Her name was Safiyah, and she was a surgeon. She came to Lord Saladin's gates offering her skills in exchange for shelter. Zavala was his protégé then. He had been taught his purpose, and he followed it without question. She maddened him. He infuriated her. But respect grew to admiration. And admiration, to love. Does it surprise you that Zavala loved? She was meticulous and gentle. Strong-willed. Stubborn. Fearless. It began with an infant, orphaned in a Fallen raid. Saladin had taught Zavala duty, war, and the Light. But Safiyah showed him that he was more than an instrument of violence. She had one life, and she would share it with him. They called the boy Hakim. And he called Zavala "Father." In his joy, Zavala thought to abandon the Light, as he had abandoned Saladin's ways. That joy ended as it began. With their son. When Hakim followed his father into battle, Zavala could not protect him... and Safiyah could not save him. Hakim died in his mother's arms. Zavala wanted her forgiveness. But she knew there was nothing to forgive. And that giving up the Light... would be no absolution for him. They returned to the lives they once led. She found love again. She had a daughter. And when Safiyah passed, he asked her to forgive him. Through each generation, he mourned. He asked for their forgiveness. And still, he has not found it.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Reconciliation: Speak to Crow — Transcript

lines.text: Thanks to the Guardian's efforts, Crow was able to confront and turn the Nightmare of Uldren Sov into something new and remarkable. The Guardian returns to Crow in the H.E.L.M. to discuss the matter.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Second chances… hm. Turns out I've been using mine wrong. I thought being a Guardian was my destiny. That wielding the Light for good was the most I had to offer. But it's clear now. This is what the Traveler chose me for. I was reforged in the Light for a purpose. To remake something dead and gone… into something beautiful. To learn how to forge something new from what we were. Everything Uldren did to the Reef, the Scorn… Fikrul. I have a responsibility — no — a calling to make them whole. And… I can't replace Cayde. But I can cover his old patrols — maybe organize the Hunters a bit, if they'll let me. Clean up some of my mess. I don't know if I can fix everything Uldren left broken… but I can try.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Rage: Lunar Investigation — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian investigates the connection between the Derelict Leviathan and the Moon's Nightmares.

Following Caiatl's failed ritual of severance, Eris asks the Guardian to investigate the connection between the Derelict Leviathan and the Moon's Nightmares. The Guardian travels to K1 Revelation and defeats the Nightmare of Arguth, the Tormented.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This Nightmare is quelled. Buried in the screams of its death throes lies a call to the Pyramid. Calus must have used the relic in this place as a focusing point in lieu of the connections we've severed. To the Pyramid, Guardian.
The Guardian travels to the Lunar Pyramid and investigates a dead Legionary nearby.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Calus's Loyalists. Egregore spores line their esophagus. They are freshly dead. Empty. I see now. Their lives were forfeit, spent as a cost to ferry Calus's mind across a vast distance, and hasten ingress to the Pyramid. Our foe is desperate. But that means our plan is working. I must speak with Caiatl. Return to me.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Rage: Transmission from Caiatl — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian receives an incoming Priority 1 transmission at the H.E.L.M. holoprojector, originating from the Eligos Lex V, flagship of the Cabal Ascendancy.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Attention, Vanguard. I have been patient. I have listened to your warnings and kept my landing parties from raiding the Leviathan. But still Calus eludes your Guardians, and the Nightmare of Ghaul continues to hang over my head. My patience has its limits. Ghaul is the last, our only remaining opposition. Then Calus cannot hide. Your ritual only requires I defeat the Dominus's Nightmare. So be it. Do not interfere, Guardian. I am Cabal, and this conquest is mine to claim. There must be a proving. An acceptance from the old ways. So, as a gladiator entering an arena, I issue my challenge. Dominus! Are you listening? I aim to finish what we began all those years ago. You won't stop me. GHAUL! I challenge you! In the depths of my father's tomb… we do battle!

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Resolve: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: Following Caiatl's successful ritual of severance, the Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. to debrief with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Victory sits before us, and yet it feels strangely hollow. We have severed what should be the final connection to the Pyramid, and yet... There is no reaction from the Leviathan, no reaction from Calus, and the lunar Pyramid's psychic emanations are… quiet. I cannot help but feel as though we have not weathered the storm, but merely stepped into its eye. The Nightmares contained within the Crown of Sorrow are seething. Something is coming, Guardian, and we are not prepared. I would ask that you return to the Leviathan, continue to imprison the Nightmares aboard it while I attempt to ascertain what has changed.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Resolve: Transmission from Caiatl — Transcript

lines.text: Following Caiatl's successful ritual of severance, the Guardian receives a transmission at the H.E.L.M. holoprojector, originating from the Eligos Lex V, flagship of the Cabal Ascendancy.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: It is strange… what we are to those around us, and what we are not. The Dominus was a hero to my people: self-made and defiant. He inspired many. But the Leviathan's trickeries allowed me to see Ghaul as the Vanguard did: dangerous, relentless… cruel. Those were qualities I embodied to survive Calus's interpretation of fatherhood. They kindled in me a stifling reliance on self, on action… and nothing else. Most of all, Cabal wish to be seen, our conquests recognized and ratified by the shockwaves they send through the empire… the impact we leave. But an endless war in pursuit of glory leaves only ashes. When I am gone… it won't be the impact of my conquests that shape the empire. Instead… it will be the quiet of peace, in the company of allies. Well fought, Guardian.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Reconciliation: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: Eris has returned from seclusion with new information gained through further research of the Nightmares. The Guardian returns to the Crown of Sorrow to formulate a plan with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: There is a misconception among the Vanguard that Nightmares are like... spirits. That they are who they appear to be. This is untrue. They are forged from the Darkness and born of your own subconscious fears, desires, and regrets. They have only as much power as you give them. We project our shame on these Nightmares and make them real, but they are not inherently evil… no more than the Darkness itself is. The Nightmares are a weapon, and a weapon can be turned on its creator. I believe I have found a way to do just that. We approached the last ritual of severance the wrong way, attempting to banish the Nightmare of Uldren Sov. But I should have known… denial is not the way. Return to the Leviathan, Guardian. Harvest the Nightmare essence we need to perform the ritual again… and perhaps this time, acceptance will succeed where rejection has failed.

title: Breakneck — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: So, going directly after Calus kinda blew up in our faces.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: We need to be looking at the bigger picture. We wanna protect the Veil, we first and foremost need to protect the CloudArk.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Rohan, I think we're still a little fuzzy here. What exactly is the CloudArk?

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: It's our city's network. Our infrastructure, our people, our defenses... everything depends on it.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: And what we're doing now is stopping the Vex from siphoning energy from the CloudArk's reactor. We do that—the Veil's safe, the Neomuni are safe. Bing, bang, boom. Star-garitas on Rohan!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Make your way to the CloudArk reactor, and we'll head to the central power junction. Once you've cycled the system, we'll be able to return power to the reactor.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just so we're clear—if the CloudArk is lost, what does that mean for the Neomuni?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: All our citizens have uploaded their consciousness into the CloudArk. No CloudArk means lights out for everyone in Neomuna.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ah, so it's bad. Got it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's another one of those pockets of Darkness energy. Should we get a closer look?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, it worked that time! Why did it work that time? Huh. It's like you're pulling on some kind of invisible ropes… I'm detecting those sources as a concentration of energy coming from a common source. It's got to be the Veil. Like some sort of magnetic field all around Neomuna. Let's keep an eye out for more of those!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Guardian, I'm almost at the central power junction. Ready to blast this power back to the CloudArk once you've cycled the system.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hold on… these Vex are short-circuiting voluntarily. Ah, OK. You'll have to clean up those Vex confluxes before heading to the reactor.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: We haven't observed this kind of behavior before. Hope you're taking notes, Nimbus.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Of the headless robot dance? Yeah, I've seen it before. It's gotta be a way for them to create a gateway to the CloudArk. Or… express themselves… emotionally? I dunno; who can say, honestly?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This station's power output is unbelievable. Earth was decades away from technology like this, even during the Golden Age.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: The CloudArk needs a lot of juice. Like we said earlier, it supports all the Neomuni, the city's defenses, and also the Veil's defenses. Once we get that power, we'll have all the backup we need to take back the Veil from Calus!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's good. We're going to need all the help we can get.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's escaping! Wait... why did it leave?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Weird. Something's off. Keep going, but… keep an eye out.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I'm in place, and I can see you're coming up to the reactor. Stop the Vex from siphoning the station, and we're golden!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And that does it. How's it looking, Rohan?

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Hmm. Something's still siphoning power. Look around for any remaining Vex influence.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Power's cycling. Once it's back on, it'll be running the CloudArk.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something feels off here. That was a little too easy.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Uh… what do you say we expedite that exit, folks? I got Shadow Legion on my tail.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: What? What are they doing here?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Well, considering I'm getting SHOT at, I'd say it's for us! Get out of there, Guardian! It's a trap!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Nimbus, get yourself out of there!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I think I'm in the clear, but man, it's rough out there. Guardian?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: More of those paracausal strands! They're probably the best chance we've got to get out of here.
host: Guardian, I'm detecting bombs... a lot of bombs.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shadow Legion are trying to lock us in! Remapping the escape route.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: They're swarming! Get out of there now!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK, we need to get out of here fast. I found a way out. We're going up!

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Resolve: Return to Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian meets with Eris at the Crown of Sorrow in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We stand at the precipice of victory. There is but one final link that remains between Calus and the Pyramid, and we are ready to strike at it. Caiatl has been brought into our ritual bond. She is now prepared to confront the Nightmare of Ghaul and undo her father's work. However, by my estimates, Calus has already infiltrated the paracausal matrix of the lunar Pyramid. The dark below groans and churns with excitement at this revelation. Emanations from the lunar Pyramid whisper a singular psychic demand to all who can perceive it… "Rejoice." Calus is overconfident, and we must take advantage. Go, return to the Leviathan and prepare.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Shame: Debrief with Eris — Transcript

lines.text: Following Crow's defeat during the ritual of severance, it is clear that severing Calus' connection to the lunar Pyramid will be harder than expected. The Guardian returns to the Crown of Sorrow to formulate a plan with Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It appears the situation is far more complex than I first believed. The Leviathan has become an extension of the lunar Pyramid, channeling feelings of shame and regret into reality. The Pyramid did so as a security system, driving away those who would tamper with it. But what is happening on the Leviathan… this is purposeful. Malicious. As the Nightmares on the Leviathan spread, it could threaten Earth and beyond. Calus's bond with the Pyramid endangers all of us. Crow was unprepared to face his own demons when we attempted to sever it. And though I may be able to counsel him through the next confrontation, that will take time. You should return to the Leviathan. Continue harvesting the Nightmares and disrupting Calus's plans. We will speak again soon.

title: Breakneck: Conversation between Osiris and Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Hey, uh, I have a message here from your Vanguard's "Commander Zavala" asking about you.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: He's probably attempting to "check in" on my "physical and psychological status."

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: He do that kind of thing often?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: He and Saint and Ikora are… concerned for my safety. As if no longer carrying the Light as I did has transformed me instantly into a fragile elder.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Sounds like they care about ya, old bird. It's sure rough to be stuck with supportive friends, huh?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I imagine, from your perspective, I must seem terribly ungrateful.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: You know, when I first got the full set of mods, I was making friends with the ground every five minutes. Takes a second to find your balance sometimes.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: So it does. I… appreciate the reminder.

title: Breakneck: Interlude with Caiatl — Transcript

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: These are precarious times. I came to see an end to Calus once and for all. But—and I say this with considerable restraint—we are not ready. I've witnessed a great many patriarch of the Cabal Empire poisoned by obsession: Ghaul with the Light, Calus with the Darkness. I worry for Osiris. Recklessness can manifest into obsession. He must rein in his tempestuousness to hope to defeat Calus. "So in war, the way is to avoid what is strong, and strike at what is weak."

title: Breakneck: Meet with Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: That Caiatl… phew. She's something else, huh? Well, look, I was rooting for us, really, I was. There's no greater joy for me than doing something Rohan would call… "incredibly reckless." He'll shake his head and say his little catchphrase: [mimics Rohan's voice] "Nimbus! Headlong and empty-handed." I'm sure you heard it. It's shorthand for "Hey, kid, stop trying to do it all yourself. We're partners for a reason!" And if I screw up and things go south, well, we'll fix 'em together. The CloudArk is still vulnerable. If we can cycle the power, a hard reset like that should kick things back into gear. It's just… this "hard reset" is deep in Vex territory, and that's where you come in. Osiris and Rohan can go process their differences over some fermented tea or whatever. We're off to go protect the people of Neomuna.

title: Bound in Sorrow: Sever — Shame: Check in with Crow — Transcript

lines.text: Unable to overcome the shame of his past life, Crow has suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the Nightmare of Uldren Sov. The Guardian finds Crow in the H.E.L.M. to check in on him.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Come to tell me it's not my fault? Hey, Guardian. I know this is on me. You don't have to feed me any comforting platitudes. I've been running from the truth for long enough. You know… when I first came to the City, I told these little lies about who I was or where I came from. Nothing hurtful, just a few stories to keep a comfortable distance from the truth—to fill in the blanks. When I got my memories back… I remembered Uldren did the same thing. He started little rumors, recounted adventures to an audience, planted gossip in Mara's ear, just to watch those stories spread. We're exactly the same! Down to the instincts! It's in my blood. [exhales shakily] I thought I could do this. I thought I could prove to Zavala and Caiatl and you and everyone else that I was better than him. But lies… they only get us so far.
Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It was out of control; we did the best we could.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I'm fine, Ghost. I'll be fine. Go on.

lines.speaker: Zavala

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We got him. I'll let Commander Zavala know there's one less problem on Mars.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Valus Ta'aurc has finally been defeated and the Cabal command dealt a great blow. But in the Darkness rising, more fleets will come and new leaders will rise. We must be ready to face them all.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Cayde's Stash — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Turns out Crota does have a father. His name is Oryx and he's come all this way to kill you. We're not gonna let him. Oryx controls the Taken from a Dreadnaught near Saturn, but we can't get close without a stealth drive. Lucky for us, I hid one at the top of an old colony ship before I got roped into the Vanguard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How do you know it's still there?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You better hope it's there. You won't survive the Dreadnaught without it.
Fallen and Taken are engaged in battle

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cayde, we've got a real problem down here.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Let me guess, four arms, wear cloaks, smell real bad?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I thought we'd have more time...

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Earth's going to look a lot like Phobos if you don't find that stealth drive.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Okay, you're going to find a vault door. There's a trick to getting through it so let me know when you're there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The door's already open Cayde. We're inside.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: And the flux grenades didn't detonate!? I gotta get out of this Tower.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What are the chances the elevator still works?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're heading up. Cayde? When's the last time you rode this elevator?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Relax! It works fine... but stand by for resurrection, Ghost.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: From this height I can pick up Taken energy reads throughout the Cosmodrome.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You know I was here, looking for you, when the first Fallen crews came through. Started with one skiff. A few months later the Cosmodrome was theirs. The Taken have done it in hours.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How do we find your stealth drive?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: There's a bridge from the tower to the ship. Took me days to get it working, it's a little unstable, so watch your step.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cayde, someone moved the bridge, destroyed the controls.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yeah, that's the Fallen, probably trying to keep the Taken off their backs. See if you can reroute the power.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's still an active feed moving through those pipes overhead. Guardian, if you find the source I can patch the circuit.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Once you get the bridge working, my stash is in the ball on top of the colony ship.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: We're still waiting for details on this plan of yours, Cayde.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yeah, uh, gimme a second, Guardian.
Ghost begins hacking bridge power source

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: All right, back in business. Hey, the bridge is already moving! Get to the top of the colony ship where I left my stash — and watch yourself on that bridge!
Bridge moves to connect the ship and the tower
The middle section of the bridge drops to the floor

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Any advice on which way to go?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey, you found one of my secret rooms. Good times. Help yourself to the Glimmer but leave the exotics for me. When I get out this Tower... Hm hmm!!!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's nothing in here but Fallen caches...

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: They took my loot? It's like there's no rules.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yeah, I had a whole system to keep track of things. The royal cards stood for weapons. Spades meant Häkke, clubs for Crux/Lomar, diamonds for Omolon, and hearts... huh, well hearts were for this girl I knew.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh, don't you have a stealth drive to find?
Elevator leads to a group of Fallen, they are interrupted by an Echo of Oryx

lines.speaker: Echo of Oryx
lines.text: What Crota began I complete. My will conquers all!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That thing seemed pretty mad. Oryx must still be holding a grudge for us, you know, killing Crota.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Things won't get any easier on the Dreadnaught. You find my stealth drive?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Are you sure it's still here?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: It's like all things. You gotta know where to look. Enter frequency 5982, Ghost.
Fallen container de-cloaks to reveal the stealth drive

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: The best hiding places are always in plain sight. Transmat it out of there, I'll get it set up.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Just do me a favour. If you find anything else I've hidden leave it for me. There'll be treasure enough for everyone on the Dreadnaught.

title: Challenger’s Proving II: Impasse — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. Osiris stands next to it. The holoprojector turns on with Caiatl's image.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Did I keep you waiting? I've been busy managing the antics of your commanders.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: "Antics?" Hmph. Time-honored traditions. They don't concern you.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You're auditioning members for your war council. I'd say that concerns us very much.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Your commander could be a valued member of it, if he would accept my offer. You seem like a wise man. We both know that the best victory is won before the war even begins. I'm giving humanity a way out. Zavala can end this now. You can end this now.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: A Cabal empress with a penchant for mercy — it's a novel idea. You've learned from the mistakes of your predecessors. But I see how you lean on tradition when you fear a loss of control. I see your uncertainty. Dithering. As for what I know… I know that an empress without an empire is in no position to offer anything.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: The Cabal have lost their home, not their honor. If we're to die, we will take many with us. Tell your commander my patience is running out.
Caiatl ends the call. Osiris turns to face the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Your orders are the same. Honor or no, without a war council, she'll have no war.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Calus Afraid — Transcript

lines.text: Calus stands before his throne and begins to step towards the Witness. He holds his chalice in one hand and gestures around with it.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My Witness, there have been... complications. Our hold over the Veil has been...temporarily loosened.
The Witness steeples it's fingers and turns away from the approaching Emperor. Calus halts. The Witness begins to float away.

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: You fear loss, Emperor. Your fear...brings you pain. We know pain. Our purpose...is its end. You have no purpose...because you fear to seek one.
The Witness looks over it's shoulder at the Cabal.
Calus begins to pace around the room, his arms waving wildly. He walks past a number of relics on plinths.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My failure? My failure?! I have fed this force with vicious subjugation, battered down the gates of our enemies, and seized our glittering prize!
He turns and points with a thumb towards his chest. The Witness watches.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Why? Because I wanted it! You hold the universe in your grasp, and all you can think of to do with it is—
The Witness narrows its eyes and the air around it shatters like glass.

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: ENOUGH! Secure the Veil. We will create the link.
Calus looks up and trembles. A stream of blood goes down his face from beneath his helmet.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Infinite apologies. The Veil is yours. It will be done.
Calus awakens with a jolt atop his throne. He looks at the chalice in his hand, gripping it so forcefully it begins to crack. He roars and throws it across the room.

title: Challenger's Proving III: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. A hologram of Lord Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: You're needed back on Nessus, Guardian. As if their tank wasn't enough, now we have Psions tunneling into Vex territory. According to Crow, their leader is Ixel, the Far-Reaching. She's looking for something that will secure her a seat on the war council. Something that will impress, like Vex prediction engines. Whatever Ixel digs up could give Caiatl the winning edge. Or worse, simply unleash destruction on us all. Either outcome is to be avoided at all costs. Ensure they never try this again.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

title: Challenger’s Proving IV: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table and a hologram of Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Nessus, Europa, the Cosmodrome. Every time the Cabal return to the battlegrounds, so shall we. Osiris has sent Crow undercover to investigate their plans for the Vex prediction engines. We need you back on the front lines. The more you can draw their fire, the easier it'll be for Crow to slip under the radar. And while you're out there, be sure to claim whatever you find in the aftermath. Weapons. Gold. Without their home system, they can't resupply. And without supplies, they can't resist for long.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving IV: To Fell the Mighty

title: Challenger’s Proving II: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. A hologram of Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Get ready to move. The Cabal have invaded the Cosmodrome. As we speak, Val Ma'rag leads a charge into a Hive nest. Seeking revenge for what Xivu Arath did to the Cabal's home system. If he succeeds, Caiatl is certain to promote him to her war council, and more Cabal will flood into the Cosmodrome. We can't let that stand. Not in the territory that produces some of our best Guardians. Fortunately, our enemies are distracted. Cut through the chaos and take out Ma'rag. If we don't crush this now, we could lose an entire generation of New Lights.
The hologram disappears as the call ends.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Challenger's Proving IV: Predicted Missing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to Crow, who beckons them closer, speaking in hushed tones.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Listen, I've been combing through the prediction you pulled from Nessus. I've got bad news. I think the Cabal are going to try to take Zavala out. He's missing from every single one of the futures they've predicted. Not missing, "where'd he go," missing. DEAD missing. Osiris says they're only possibilities, but I think it's the real deal. Zavala has refused to work with Caiatl. It's in her best interest to remove him. Sends a strong message. Glint can't pinpoint a time and place yet. We need more information.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Word is the Vex have always had trouble predicting you. Maybe that's our edge. What do you say? Wanna help prevent a prophecy?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving VII: Chosen of the Vanguard
Challenger's Proving IV: To Fell the Mighty
Challenger's Proving VII: Chosen of the Vanguard

title: Challenger's Proving VI: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. A hologram of Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: The Cabal have no shame. They failed to take out our leadership, and now they escalate their barbarism on the battleground. Believe me, I wish it were not this way. But I've seen this pattern play out many times before. Like the warlords of our darker days, Caiatl and her commanders see honor as a currency. Valuable only for the fear it strikes in their enemies' hearts. There's no merit in it. No trust. And there's no negotiating with brutes like that. Meet them on the battlefield and prove, again and again, where the real honor lies.
The hologram disappears as the call ends.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving VII: Parting Ways, For Now

title: Challenger's Proving IV: To Fell the Mighty — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Crow and speaks to him.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Thanks to your fieldwork, I have an idea of what the Psions are planning. It's not good. This gadget you found, it's a tiny Light-disruptor. Small, but strong enough to knock down a Ghost. Saladin says when the Cabal sieged the City, they severed our connection to the Light. Looks like the Psions have refined that tech. It's… elegant, actually. And deadly. They wouldn't need to fly a fleet into the City to use this. A single gunman would be enough, if they could catch a Guardian flat-footed. I'll tell Osiris. And I'll keep an eye on the Commander. You know… just to be safe.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Challenger's Proving V: Debriefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Crow and speaks to him.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: My mask was in my hand. Stupid, I know, but I felt… safe. I thought I could just relax for a minute. It was a mistake. Osiris tells me the commander always talks about making the hard choice. Reveal myself or let him die. Whatever I chose, someone would still say I was wrong. I'm sure you've lost people. Wracked your mind for how it could have been different. Too far away to act, but close enough to wonder. If you could've stopped it, wouldn't you? No matter the cost. I've been at the mercy of something I couldn't stop, without knowing why. Blind in a nightmare. I didn't want to be the reason for more pain. The next time they come for the commander, they'll have to get through me. Mask or no mask. Just… don't tell Osiris I said that.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving IV: To Fell the Mighty

title: Challenger's Proving VII: Chosen of the Vanguard — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I issued a challenge to Caiatl, knowing she could not show weakness in front of her people. She accepted… and now the time has come. It's simple: a final Rite of Proving. We each send forth a warrior to represent us. Whichever side claims victory sets the terms of a binding agreement. If we win, Caiatl ceases hostilities immediately. Her forces never set foot on Earth again. But if we lose, we surrender Nessus and support her claim to the imperial throne. And as a gesture of good faith, I become "Bracus Zavala" and serve on her war council. A glorified hostage. That… cannot happen. Caiatl's chosen warrior waits deep within her fortified tank. Storming it and defeating him in ritual combat will be nearly impossible. But I've come to expect the impossible… from you. Guardian… represent the Vanguard in the Rite of Proving. Be our champion.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Challenger's Proving V: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. A hologram of Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: There was an assassin within the walls of the Last City - and no one knew until it was almost too late. Luck was on our side. Next time, it won't be. What we must do now is channel our Light onto a clean-burning fury and raze the Cabal Empire to ashes. Zavala may still have hope for a peaceful resolution, but he hasn't seen what I have. I'm still an Iron Lord. I'll be in the fray exacting retribution. When you're ready, you should be too.
The hologram disappears as the call ends.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving VII: Parting Ways, For Now

title: Challenger's Proving VII: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the War Table. A hologram of Saladin appears.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: At last, we have a plan to strike at the heart of the Cabal. It's not what I'd do, but at least we're taking decisive action. Zavala has challenged Caiatl to settle things with a final Rite of Proving. No response yet, but Osiris is confident she'll accept. Personally, I don't think there's any course of action more "final" than a full-scale offensive. Your task is to "encourage"" Caiatl to accept the easy out. Her aspiring commanders are the pressure points, so hit them with everything you've got. And keep hitting them until Commander Zavala tells you otherwise.
The hologram disappears as the call ends.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Challenger's Proving VII: Parting Ways, For Now
Challenger's Proving VII: Parting Ways, For Now

title: Challenger's Proving VII: Parting Ways, For Now — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Crow and speaks to him.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I've officially been commissioned as a recon agent by Commander Zavala. He wants me to track down the conspirators who tried to sabotage the ceasefire. I believe Caiatl when she says she wasn't behind it, but let's not take chances. Two assassination attempts is more than enough, I think. Zavala looks at me, and I feel like he really sees me. Who I am, not who I was. He didn't say much else, just that it might be a good idea if I laid low while he figured things out here. I know it's taboo to talk about the people we were before, but…
Crow clenches his fist as he pauses.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: The weight that's been hanging around my neck since I woke up in this body…

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: It finally feels a little lighter. I doubt this is the last time we'll be seeing each other, Guardian.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Chosen — Transcript

lines.text: Peregrine District, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Traveler! What's happening to it? Zavala, we're back and ready to – [grunt]
The Guardian's ship is hit by a Cabal missile. Ghost transmats the Guardian onto a rooftop just before the ship crashes.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian! Are you still with us?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: That's why we're here – to stop this madness. Ikora and I are converging on the rally point. Cayde's already there.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: We'll use the Vex teleporter to jump to the Traveler… if we make it there alive.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Welcome back, Guardian. Glad you could join the party. Red Legion's using these energy barriers to funnel us into kill boxes. I can hack into the grid and knock it down for short stretches. Stand by.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Power's down! Go, before the Legion turns it back on!
The Guardian heads through the doorway before the barrier is turned back on.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Roger that! We're almost at the rally point.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: I knew it. Never send a Cayde to do a Hawthorne job.
The Guardian comes to another doorway that's blocked by an energy barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorne, we're blocked again. There's another energy barrier.
Hawthorne deactivates the barrier. The Guardian heads through the doorway.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Cayde! We're seeing a squad of Red legion flanking your position. What's your status?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Damn it! Next time you get to fix the Vex tech while being shot at!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Keep your head down, Cayde. We're almost there!
The Guardian continues towards the rally point.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ikora and I have reached the rally point, but Cayde is still wrestling with the teleporter.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I can either shoot or work on this thing, but not both, because they just shot off my arm!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Cayde, we need that teleporter! We can't hold this position much longer!
The Guardian continues towards the rally point.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: They're coming at us from all sides. We need your help, Guardian!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Traveler… Ghaul found a way to drain its Light. It's the only explanation. Guardian, we have to stop him. If he takes the Light - It's over.
The Guardian continues towards the rally point.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ikora. Cayde. If we don't make it out of this alive… know that I've never been prouder to be part of your fireteam.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If we have to die, at least we'll die in the shadow of the Traveler, old friend.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: We're about to die, and you're still making speeches?!
The Guardian continues towards the rally point.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Just one more… Hey! Don't shoot that!
The Guardian arrives at the rally point.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian. We can't make the jump. It's all up on you now. Save the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: A working, probably-stable Vex gate! One step, and you'll be right next to the big guy.
The Guardian jumps through the teleporter.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You're on Ghaul's command ship. It's a close to the Traveler as we can get you. Be brave. For all of us.
The Guardian makes their way through Ghaul's ship, defeating any Cabal they encounter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's the Traveler. We're getting close.
The Guardian arrives at the top of the ship.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Fitting your Traveler would send you to face me once more. Look upon me. Dominus of the Red Legion. Annihilator of suns. Razer of a thousand worlds. Slayer of gods and conqueror of the Light. I. AM. GHAUL… And I have become legend.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Your Traveler should have chosen me, and now it is too late. Look at your dead god. It won't save humanity a second time. I am Ghaul. I claim what is mine.
Ghaul retreats to absorb more Light.
The Guardian continues to fight against Ghaul.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: You failed your Traveler. You let your city die. Give up. You have nothing to fight for. Nothing to die for.
Ghaul retreats once more to absorb the Light.
The Guardian continues to fight against Ghaul.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: I pity you. You know nothing of sacrifice. Nothing of worth.
An apparition of Light appears from Ghaul's body. It looks like the shape of Ghaul with wings.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Traveler! Do you see me now? I am immortal! A god! You have failed! Witness the dawning of a new age!
The Traveler awakens and breaks the cage surrounding it.
The Traveler defeats Ghaul with an explosion of Light.
The Tower, The Last City, Earth

Zavala stands on a platform in the Tower. Ikora approaches him, followed by Cayde and Hawthorne. The Guardian walks towards the Vanguard and Hawthorne. The Vanguard and Hawthorne congratulate the Guardian.

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: The Light lives in all places, in all things. You can block it, even try to trap it, but the Light will find its way.

An explosion of Light from the Traveler spreads through the galaxy and beyond. It first touches Mercury, then Mars, the Reef and Saturn. The Light continues to spread outside the galaxy where it reaches a fleet of pyramid ships.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: An Old Friend, The Dawning: Eva’s Return

title: Combustion — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Welcome back. This time I did make tea for you — but I seem to have drunk it all. Perhaps if you were a mite quicker. Heh. Right. The beacon. While you were tussling with the Fallen, we've encountered a bit of a setback. Hawthorne has placed the last relay on the mountain above the salt mines. But even from that height, the signal still doesn't have the range we expected. It's a bit curious… Regardless, this signal booster should solve our problem, it we can get it to her. Heh. Dead Zone indeed.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Hey, Dev. I'm still sitting up here above the mines with this busted comm relay. Where's that signal booster?

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Our new Guardian friend is en route. I'm getting too old to clean up after you, Suraya.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Finally! He admits he's old. Hahaha! Bail me out on one assault charge and you never let me live it down.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Aww, don't you mean one a week? You're the reason my hair is gray.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Keep talking, old man.
The Guardian heads into the mines and defeats the hostile Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That elevator should take us to the top of the mines.
The Guardian activates the elevator. The elevator comes down but crashes to the ground.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll have to find another way up to Hawthorne.
Ghost opens the gate leading further into the mines.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Careful. The Fallen are scavengers of the highest order. They're going to put up a fight for whatever they can get their grubby claws on.
The Guardian continues further into the mines and defeats the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah! You'll be pleased to know that I can see the Fallen fleeing the mine. Seems you've really kicked the hornet's nest, haven't you.
The Guardian enters a large area within the mines.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You're good. Almost as good as Louis!
The Guardian tries to call the elevator.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Elevator's not working. Power must be out. And… we've upset the Fallen.
The Guardian defeats Kiriks-16 and the other Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That did it. Killing the Servitor brought the power back on.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Good job! Maybe I'll finally get my booster one of these days.
The Guardian calls the elevator and heads up in it to an area outside the mines.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorne, we're out of the mine and heading your way.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Then hurry up with that booster. Let's finish hooking up the comm network. And, uh, thanks for the help. You're not so bad… for a fancy-pants Guardian.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Now that's the nicest thing I've ever heard Suraya say. You're in rarified air, my friend.
The Guardian meets up with Hawthorne.
The Guardian gives Hawthorne the booster.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Looks like Louis owes me money! All right, let's see if this works. Now if I read the manual right… There's an incoming beacon…

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardians… the City is lost… if there is any Light left in the system… we rally on Titan. Be brave.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala's alive?! If we leave now, we can -

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You are not going to Titan! We've got refugees coming in, the Red Legion on one side, the Fallen on the other -

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But we have our powers back! And if we're going to retake the City -

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorne. We will be back. And we won't be alone.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You'll know where to find me.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: It would save us both a lot of time if you would just kill me.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: For one who calls himself "Speaker"… you have remarkably little to say. We've learned that one of your Guardians has reconnected to the Light. You say you have no power over the Traveler, yet… this. Help me understand, Speaker.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: The Light lives in all places… in all things. You can block it… even try to trap it. But the Light will find its way. And the Traveler will protect itself.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: The Traveler… For years, I have studied it… the worlds it has touched… its power over life and death. We are not so different… your Traveler and I.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: You are nothing like the Traveler. NOTHING. You think you have power. Control. I know your kind. You started small… you will end small.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: If the Traveler truly has chosen humanity of its own free will… then there is no reason I should not reach inside… tear out the Light for myself, and leave this system in ashes!

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Only those the Traveler chooses will be reborn in the Light.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Yes. This I know. This is why I have claimed your planet, and why you still live. The Traveler WILL choose me, Speaker. And you are going to tell me how.

title: Challenger's Proving VII: Debriefing — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard of the Tower, The Last City
The Guardian approaches Commander Zavala and begins to speak with him.
Zavala turns partially away from the Guardian, no longer facing them.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ikora spoke those words when I offered her the news of Crow's unmasking. She already knew, of course. As did Osiris. And you.
Zavala turns back to the Guardian, gesturing frustration with his hands.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Without trust, we become like the Cabal: fractured and consumed from within. I've sent your friend on a reconnaissance mission while I determine the best way forward. Empress Caiatl will honor our agreement. This is an armistice, not an allegiance. Those who do not answer her call to leave Earth are criminals in the eyes of her empire, left to us to deal with as we see fit. Saladin will have words, I'm sure… But preserving what's left of the Cabal insulates us from further incursions by Xivu Arath.
Zavala looks away from the Guardian, into the distance, before looking back to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The enemy of my enemy, Guardian… until such time they are not.
