title: Chamber of Night — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Urgent transmission incoming on all channels. From the Speaker!

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Nothing is more important now. We believe the Hive are engaged in a ritual that is draining the Traveler of its Light. Whatever power they wield must be understood and destroyed.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This ritual could be happening in any one of their thousands of chambers. If we can find cracks deep enough I can map the entire Hive fortress.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, good scan, but not enough to locate the ritual yet. Let's keep looking.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hold on, I got it. But we have to go deeper into the Temple of Crota.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Someone's trying to establish contact. Could be the Speaker.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let's get out in the open, I'll have a better chance of locking this signal.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You're interesting. Not entirely interesting, but you have promise.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't know, I'm losing the signal.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Guardian, I know what you're about to do. It's brave. But there are enemies out here you would not believe.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Go down and face the Hive, and if you live, come find me.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Signal's dropped. I got some broken coordinates: Venus, Northern hemisphere, Ishtar region.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great. What do we do now?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hive seeder, just like the ones invading Earth. If we don't finish this there'll be more of these hitting home.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here it is, the darkest of all the Hive's chambers.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's a shard of the Traveler! They were using it against the Traveler, devouring its Light. But we freed it. And our new friend said there are enemies on Venus worse than this? Great...

title: Constellation: Lock — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
THE GUARDIAN REVEALS A MESSAGE HIDDEN IN THE SPINE OF KERES USING THE WISH-KEEPER EXOTIC BOW, CAUSING AN IMAGE OF AN AWOKEN-MADE BOX TO APPEAR IN THE SKY.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: At the height of the Great Hunt, the queen separated us. I was treated to a beautiful cage. For my protection. Our kind has much agency, but there are rules. And the queen is a deft navigator of rules. I never saw Taranis again. I have not found Ahamkara to lament such things. But I did. The path that brought you here was built by us both. No others that I have ever known walked your path. You are unique in that way.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I lost Sjur like Riven lost Taranis, years before that. And there was no cage. Just senseless oblivion. I didn’t know I had done so at the time… But I do not regret the choice to separate Riven and Taranis. I imagine it was difficult. Much more so for them, than me. But necessary. The Vanguard had no right to annihilate a sentient species — no matter the cause. I bear responsibility as well. Pretended to aid the Vanguard during the Hunt while keeping Riven as a weapon of the state. Don’t get me wrong. I was responsible. Not regretful. But thanks to you, the cycle of Wish-Keepers and Wish-Enders will continue. For good or ill.

title: Constellation: Tower — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian reveals a message hidden in the Black Garden using the Wish-Keeper Exotic Bow, causing an image of the Keep of Voices to appear in the sky.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: We have reached the end of all things. Our echoes fade from this place… and all others. So I carve this for you into the stars, like myths of old. Taranis and I met at the highest peaks of the queen’s dreaming halls. Together, we set on a path that led to where you stand. It was a time when bargain-eaters and bargainers worked in tandem. A cycle of feeding. It ended in a Great Hunt. The near-death of our kind.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Guardian! Your connection to Taranis activated an ontological reflection. It seems Riven left a message in a bottle. Curious. The era she spoke of was a time of fortification for the Awoken. The Dreaming City should have been a pillar from which we defended this system against the likes of the Witness. Thanks to Riven, it has fallen far from that. Scour her old haunts. Let's make sure she hasn't left anything less pleasant.

title: Contact - Titan — Transcript

lines.text: Siren's Watch/The Rig, New Pacific Arcology, Titan
The Guardian deploys a containment bank underneath a Pyramid Scale and joins other Guardians to charge the Seed of Silver Wings with Darkness.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank firing in. Signal tracking. Kid, you're on deck.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Harvest all the Darkness you can muster. Now is not the time for mercy.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Ooh, Moondust, you've got a mean streak.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Is their message a warning? A trick? We can't know until we hear their words for ourselves.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I cannot shake the troubling notion that we are feeding a ritual. It serves our purpose, yes — but what other schemes advance by our hand? Perhaps if we had listened sooner, on the Moon, we would have been more prepared.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We never wanted this fight, Guardian. But it is one we cannot run from… no matter what the Drifter says.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your position will come under fire soon, Guardian. Do your duty.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Our foes are infested with Darkness. Take it from them!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Operational overwatch established. Light guide you, Guardian. The Drifter is useful, but the cost of dealing with him does not end with Glimmer. Whatever scam he's running… be wary.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Energy output has increased from the Pyramids, Guardian. Time is not on our side.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Darkness building up right on your head. Bank down. Expect friends real soon.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Harvest their Dark remnants for the Seed. Bring clarity to our cause.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Mini-bank en route. Put your mean faces on.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Darkness presents us an opportunity to further understand its intentions. Seize it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have heard that Titan used to be the jewel of Saturn. People would stare at the planet's rings all night and be filled with awe.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eh, until they got bored. Then they'd move on to the next jewel.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: People used to tell stories about this place during the Dark Age. Treasures buried in the methane. Stuff like that.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Did the Drifter ever chase any of these stories?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: No. Heard a big crew lost twenty wave crawlers out there… and it wasn't from no storm.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's an important strategic position in the system.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eh, how do they know every damn time? You got incoming left, right, and center.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Like Prometheus offering the flame. They cannot turn it away.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Guardians come up with the craziest names.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: How many Pyramids drift out beyond our sight?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What's here is enough to make a statement… there have to be more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Rasputin would agree, so I've heard.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Darkness would not speak without a reason. We must listen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It lies. That's what it does.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I share your apprehension, Little Light. We will proceed with caution.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank down. So. Wild card with a chip on her shoulder… can be tough to manage.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris survived the Hellmouth. Lightless. She doesn't need management.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah. And who got her there?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I know we need his tech, but please tell me you don't trust the Drifter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Talking behind my back? Here, I thought Ghosts were honest and noble.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ghosts talk. We know who you are.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Rumours. Like an ace up their sleeve. Trust, right, Hero?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You don't get a vote, partner.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I know what you do to your partners.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You don't get a vote, partner.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Watch your back, Hero. Ain't nobody else doing it for you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Words, words, words. Let's see who's there when things get really bad.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Command weighs heavy on Zavala. He presents a stoic image, but his mind…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No one has ever stood against the Darkness and won, Eris.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. The City requires his attention. We must be his strength in the field.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Golden Age harbored powers beyond imagination, and yet they fell to the Collapse.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: When the Collapse struck, they didn't have Guardians.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I agree. Though I fear it is not our might that will avert this crisis, Commander.
The Guardian deposits Motes into the containment bank. Taken appear and attack the bank.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Taken blocking my gear! Clear 'em out!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, those aren't my Taken. Get them off my gear!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank offline! Taken signatures all over it.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank's cut off, partner. Sweep it clean!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey… HEY! Taken stooges are messing up my bank!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Pawns of the Witch Queen! Protect the contraption!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Taken scouts. Wipe them away before Savathûn takes notice!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn's pets swarm our containment unit!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sterile neutrinos? Taken! On the bank!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Picking up Taken signals. They're on the bank!
The Guardian deposits more Motes into the bank. Taken Will of Quria appears.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

The Guardian deposits Blooms from the Pyramid Scale and prevents the Taken from extracting Blooms from the bank. Taken Pyromaster, Taken Monstrosity, or Taken Howler appears instead of Taken Will of Quria.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They come for the Seed. Savathûn commands great strength to wield Quria so. The Seed must survive. Fight well.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, hotshot. Big nasty Taken headed your way. Keep that bank in one piece.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eh, something's jamming the signal. Ooh, you've got company. Slug it out a bit. Gonna get a frickin' wrench.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Picking something up… Those are Taken signatures. You've got incoming.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She has found us! Drawn to the coalescing Dark. Stand fast!
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian, the Taken draw power from nearby infestations of Darkness. They must not stop us now.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The witch sends a sword. Brash. Is this desperation or a show of strength?
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn… our actions have sent reverberations through her web. Prepare yourself, Guardian. This battle is not over.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Pull back your contraption. The Taken have found us!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You can either start chanting or buy me a few minutes. Let Drifter work!
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Witch Queen's wretched marionette, and upon its tongue, her violent regards.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: New growths, Guardian. They sustain this Taken monstrosity. Break them.
If the Guardians do not activate the Heroic Public Event
The Guardians defeat Taken Will of Quria.
If the Guardians activate the Heroic Public Event
The Guardians defeat Taken Pyromaster, Taken Monstrosity, or Taken Howler.
Savathûn's Taken retreats and the Pyramid Scale departs. The bank collects 100% of resonate energy and refines its quality.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You think they're scared of you?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. It is the only reason I am willing to listen.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hmm. You ain't as blind as you look.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The liberal application of Light… simplifies problems for those unwilling to pursue other means.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Titan… never bounced back after the Collapse. Fine by me. Still a quiet place to camp out when things get rough.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Time to pack it in. I'll scrub the bank for the next round. You cleaned up real good.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This is not how I expected to meet the Darkness. I find their willingness to speak… disappointing. I would rather the war than this invasive indifference.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: From Titan to Mercury, their shadow reaches. The Reef… is surrounded. We are surrounded. And yet we must move forward. Petra. How fare you in this chaos?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well done, Guardian. Savathûn's goals slip farther from her grasp.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: A small victory, perhaps, but one that inches us closer to an answer.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You ever seen Taken here? Before this?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bingo. Methane makes them wig out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Curious… The Witch Queen must feel threatened to direct Quria's forces to Titan.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Yeah, made setting up Deep Six a tough nut to crack. But, I did it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Gambit yields valuable intelligence. Is this why the Vanguard haven't thrown you from the Tower?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hah! They're probably just busy arguing over who should come and do it.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You ever seen the long-boy in the soup?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Big ol' snake swimming around Titan. Oh, ho ho ho! Drifter knows something Moondust doesn't.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's not a snake. With your symbols, I would have expected you to know that.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Playing in the Dark's not so bad, huh? You got any Praxic friends, Moondust?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Order defends the Vanguard's operational authority. You're safe.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Moondust. I hear you're the resident Hive expert.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I hear you try to cook them.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You know what the best part is?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eyes. Cooked just right… makes you see colors for hours.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You got it. I can never tell where they're going.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: How naive do you think I am?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Mars falls under shadow. Hold close your knowledge, Ana. We will need you to see this night through.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: The kill bot coming back online anytime soon?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's difficult to be certain. The damage is… peculiar.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: He dropped hard, but that nutjob gunned down a star killer. Respect.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: True enough. The Almighty's demise brought closure for many. Perhaps Rasputin still has a part to play.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So where's this "Witch Queen" at? Just walk in there, bang - little justice, walk out.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: All right, you can't find her. What she look like?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn has never shown her face. She feeds on our ignorance.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Ya don't say… Savathûn… You sure that's her name?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Offloading mini-bank. We make a slick team.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I'm surprised you agreed to help us.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eh, we're all in the same boat.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You must be truly afraid… or woefully desperate.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You look outside? Anyone who ain't scared, ain't smart.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: King's dead, right? Thought a crew put 'em in the ground years ago. Double tap.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This is the work of a mind unlike any other. A mind wrapped in fog.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Saturn still bears the scars inflicted by Oryx's vengeance. We will not permit Savathûn the same permanence.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Reef's never been the same since. Still waiting to see if that Awoken Queen's dead or not.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Drifter doesn't keep any crows? Interesting.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Maybe you could help me with that.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Did that require more Motes than usual?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I'm not used to so many… discrepancies.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: This mini-bank runs a 47 percent conversion. Direct injection. Doesn't get better.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Drifter. You've witnessed many of us rise.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You've had more time than most to see what we could be. What kept you away?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Experience. Do you actually call him "Lord" Shaxx, or do you just say Shaxx?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I, too, share a skepticism for authority.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If we do not succeed, Titan will be lost. Sloane won't leave willingly.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: She is Firebreaker, a fist of radiance. I would not insult her by demanding she retreat. Nor would she listen.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You're just tripping over each other to sacrifice yourselves.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Spoken like a man who's never bled for a cause.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Spoken like someone whose cause bled them out.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Perhaps our efforts will reveal why the Darkness holds Mercury. Heh. I'm sure Saint would contest that he has lost it. He is truly stubborn to continue manning the Lighthouse.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: He's unafraid. A trait we'll surely need in the times to come.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Feeling's got nothing to do with it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I remember that. It wanes… but, you know.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: You're killin' it out there, Hero. Doing real good. Great even. I mean, wow! Eh… And… yeah, we're clear. How's the Shore, Sir Don… Yeah, drop's coming… handpicked Dark, banked today. Aww, can't come myself. I'm a respectable agent of the Vanguard now. [chuckles] All those shell bits they bring you… Oh, cores if you got 'em… Ah, good man.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Does he know we can still hear him?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All this Darkness. It feels… suffocating.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your bravery is commendable, Little Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Thank you, Eris. We'll get through this together.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Is no one digging a grave for the Drifter?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: He would need friends for that.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Brother, I got so many friends, I can't remember their names.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Your report was absent from today's brief. How goes our intelligence acquisition?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: We had an agreement. I like my space.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Had. This is a Vanguard operation. If you don't want me here, deliver your reports on time.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Excuse me, friends. A bureaucrat needs my time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Commander. We've locked another signal down from the Pyramids.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Yes. The more of their signals we uncover, the less I understand of their intentions.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Darkness might be trying to show us something, Commander. But I don't think anything has changed. They are still our enemy.
The Guardians fail to secure enough resonate energy and extract the Seed of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Bank's getting dinged up. This is a lost cause, Brother. Scoot, and we'll try again when things aren't so hot.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I'm not gonna risk my gear for nothing. Break off and we'll try again later.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's enough for now. We'll come back when things calm down.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Things aren't going our way, pal. I'm calling my gear back before it gets too banged up. Get outta there.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are overwhelmed. Retreat, and we will prepare ourselves better for the next assault.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are not able to win every engagement. There will be another chance, of that I am sure.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Bah! There's no point continuing this attempt. Regroup. There's more battles to come.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We cannot hold this position any longer without risking our work. Take what we have and leave.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's… so… Dark. Get out, before the bank ruptures!

title: Constellation: Pair — Transcript

lines.text: THE GUARDIAN REVEALS A MESSAGE HIDDEN IN THE BLACK GARDEN USING THE WISH-KEEPER EXOTIC BOW, CAUSING AN IMAGE OF A PAIR OF AHAMKARA LOVERS TO APPEAR IN THE SKY.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: One vital note to impart to you who walk this path… What Taranis has done has never been done in all the solar cycles of this system. Ahamkara are solitary, self-defending creatures. By instinct. By necessity. But his last wish sent our clutch into the Ley Lines of the Dreaming City. It cost him everything. Ahamkara do not love. It is not in our nature. But Taranis loves. And instinct will not import this cold hard fact. So I weave it here… into the stars.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I thought Riven had left these for you, Guardian. I haven't missed the connections the two of you forged. Whoever these messages are for… I think she finally let go. Of many things… Perhaps, I can do the same.

title: Country Radio III: Eramis and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Eramis? I have nothing to say to you. I spared your life, and you used it to return to your hate and violence!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I will not thank you for your mercy, or ask for your forgiveness. But I am not your enemy.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You spoke this way before. Eido believed your lies then. I will not do so now.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I saved your daughter's life. I know she is the future of the Eliksni. But the Machine-spawn will never allow us that future. Again and again, they cut us down; when we seek to unify our Houses, when we seek power for ourselves. They will never see you as their equal.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: And you believe that we are equals? You bow to the Witness, and a god of the Hive!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: We are the leaders of our people, and we must find power where we can. You did the same when you chose to live amongst those who have slaughtered us for centuries.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: It has not ended. You just live behind our enemy's walls. Your House relies on hope as much as mine does. I want us to be free. To be gentle, and care for each other. I want us to be weavers and dancers again. That is why you did not kill me. Because you want this as well. But until we control our own future, the Eliksni will never be these things again.

title: Country Radio II: Devrim and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Devrim. I had heard of you before our first meeting.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: There is much good. But you were feared as well.

lines.speaker: Devrim

title: Country Radio VI: Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: Holliday… I know the Traveler won't bring you back. But if it did… you wouldn't remember any of us, or who you were. You wouldn't remember what you did. title: Court of Blades - Enter — Transcript

lines.text: HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian enters the Court of Blades.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: You killed me. Sword logic dictates that I love you for it.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: My communion with the Deep left me branded. A mark of knowledge, earned through strife. Seek yours now.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Your paracausal will has buried entire armies. What if they kneeled instead?

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Behold the worlds that lay ripe to be Taken.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: These domains are yours to navigate. The beings within them are yours to Take.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Those here are willing sacrifices. Use your budding power to grant them new shapes.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: In Taking, I see truth, for it drives me. In Taking, you will see power. Ascend, King.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: To Take is to free what has been offered to you. In service, the weak may share our strength.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Here you will learn to cleave flesh from will. They are lured by a whisper, sunken into their mind.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: A challenger awaits. Only one may take my throne and quell the unrest in the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Take up the knife. Do you hear it? They yearn for your blade.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: When I Take a being, they kneel broken, to discover themselves. They stand, flayed of the weakness that clung to their flesh. Bloodied with potential. Soon, the knife will be in your hand, and the bone — scraped by your blade.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: A shift has occurred within the Deep. What once offered recognition is now tinged with apathy. Arrest its attention.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Taken slain here are not all called back to me. There is another well of want, drawing them in. I shall seek it out.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: We are not alone in the Deep. Something I cannot see stands between the Winnower and the Taken. Carve these offerings free from their weakness, King. Before something else does.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I know the wills of every knife in this realm. I hear them scream as the strong metastasize the weak. And I feel a strength I do not know, carving paths that should belong to the Winnower. But don’t.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: A CHAMPION TO PLAY VESSEL FOR MY BELOVED BROTHER. BECOME THE FLESH OF MY FLESH.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: THIS COURT IS A CIRCUIT. A DESCRIPTION OF MY SIBLINGS. OF YOU, AND ALL CHILDREN OF LIGHT.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: ORYX FORGED THIS COURT WITH THE HAMMER HE STOLE FROM ME. HE INTENDS ITS VICIOUS CYCLE AS A DISTRACTION, MASQUERADING AS FRATERNAL LOVE. IT IS A VERY GOOD DISTRACTION.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: WARRIOR OF THE SKY, YOUR WILL WAVERS. I FEEL THE TAKEN RECOIL FROM YOUR CLAIM.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I AWAIT THE DAY WE CROSS BLADES, WARRIOR OF THE SKY. I WILL SLAY YOU UPON MY BROTHER’S THRONE. AIAT!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: A SHADOW IS CAST OVER THE TAKEN. THEY QUESTION WHEN ONCE THERE WAS SILENT OBEDIENCE.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: THERE IS A WOUND IN THE DEEP, A FISSURE OF LUST AND HATE AND GREED. ITS SHAPE DEFIES DESCRIPTION LIKE COLOR IN THE DARK, SO I CANNOT FIND IT. CANNOT CRUSH IT. CONSIDER MY BROTHER’S THRONE, SKY WARRIOR. FOREVER A BLADE IN THE HANDS OF ANYONE ELSE COULD DESCRIBE A NEW HIGH WAR.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: A FALSE PROPHET LURED THE DARK INTO BRIGHT CORNERS. AND YOU REAPED IT. NOW ANOTHER LURKS WITH THE DEEP. LIKE TRUE LOVE, SWORD LOGIC PERVADES, INVOKED OR NOT. NOW A THOUSAND, THOUSAND MOUTHS YEARN TO BE FED. THEY WILL NOT WAIT FOREVER.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Power belongs to those who take it.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: CRUSH THEM. CRUSH THEM UNTIL THEY CEASE TO MOVE.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: LET THEIR PATH END HERE, AT THE TIP OF YOUR BLADE.

title: Crow’s Best Night — Transcript

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: There was one night early in my stay with Spider — I don't remember why he was angry, either I did something stupid or said something smart — but he kicked me out.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I'm sitting in this alley on the Tangled Shore next to piles of scrap and garbage… feeling like I belong there, and these three Eliksni approach me.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Now I'm not in the best place emotionally so… I pull myself together and stand up, ready to spend the rest of the night dead. But… they just say "Velask". That means "Hello".

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: And… they bring me inside a little market, push a warm cup of something into my hands and start talking to me.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I say talking, but they only spoke Eliksni. They'd point to something and they'd say what it was and I'd repeat it, and [scoffs] they'd laugh. That sort of thing.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: And then [mechanical sounds] we hear music from somewhere a few doors down.
Hope For The Future begins to play.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: So, they got up and started — well I wouldn’t call it dancing exactly — but they were definitely moving.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: I was just sitting there… watching them while this ethereal music is bleeding out of some club.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: And you know… it was honestly one of the best nights I've ever had.
Hope For The Future continues to play in the background.

lines.text: I can reprogram that warp gate. It should get us close to the conflux.
The Guardian defeats the Vex enemies

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Calculations are ready. All you gotta do is jump through the hoop.
The Guardian goes through the Vex gate

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Well, that didn't work as well as I expected…

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Sagira I knew would never admit to anything less than Osiris-level perfection.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Ikora, here's a secret. NO ONE has ever lived up to Osiris's reputation. Not even Osiris.
The Guardian continues through the Pyramidion

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I can tell that the conflux is somewhere nearby, but the Vex must be cloaking it.
The Guardian stands on the Vex sync plates
The Guardian defeats the Vex enemies
The Guardian scans the conflux to display Infinite Forest data

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: The map's not here. I don't understand.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Wait, I've got something. Coordinates for a node in the Infinite Forest. That's where our map is.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Decision Point - Stand with the Vanguard

title: Dark Monastery (Loop 6) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Awoken Corsair
lines.text: I lucked out, you know. I get to come up here every three weeks and just… hang out. I know that nothing's going to happen to me. And when you leave for the monastery, I watch you through my scope. I tell myself that if something happened, I'd be able to do something. Take a shot. But I can't do anything; I can't protect you. I can't help you or anyone else. I have to stay here, doing nothing. Makes me sick.
The Guardian heads towards the monastery. They defeat the Scorn which they encounter, including Drekaa, Warmonger Chieftain, as well as the Taken, including Agra, the Stalwart.

The Guardian defeats the Scorn which they encounter, including Kruvil, Subversive Chieftain and heads further into the monastery. The Guardian defeats the Taken which they encounter including Teksis, Ascendant Sentinel, Om Air, Ascendant Sentinel, and Yamaat, Ascendant Sentinel. The Guardian heads further into the monastery. Val Belyx, Gauntlet of Incaru appears. The Guardian defeats Val Belyx, Gauntlet of Incaru.
A portal appears. The Guardian goes through it.
The Guardian finds the ritual site and defeats two Priests of Incaru. The Guardian destroys the crystal which was near the Priests of Incaru. A number of Taken suddenly appear.
The Guardian runs back to the portal and goes through it, escaping the Ascendant Plane.

title: Darkness’s Doorstep — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian and Ghost survey a Crux of Darkness on Europa's surface.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: That's another one. They all scan the same. Empty. Why did the Darkness invite us here? You're quiet today.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yeah… It's just… we keep coming face-to-face with Darkness, and every time, we fail to stop it. We're just so… powerless. I'm picking up a distress signal. Someone's in trouble.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: My friends. We are all in great danger.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's… Variks?! He has a lot to answer for.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'll send a message to let Zavala know.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: No, wait! Where is the signal coming from?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've tracked Variks's distress signal beyond the ridge. We'd better hurry.
If the player completed the Forsaken campaign.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It was Variks, you know. He instigated the riot at the Prison of Elders. He's equally responsible for Cayde's death. The Vanguard's been after him since. No wonder he's hiding on a desolate moon.
If the player is a New Light during Beyond Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, Variks traded the Prison of Elders for this? I guess if I had played a part in the murder of Cayde-6, I'd hide on a desolate moon myself.
The Guardian heads towards the source of Variks' signal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're close to the origin point of Variks's distress signal.
A Fallen Ketch and multiple Fallen Skiffs appear overhead.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those Fallen patrols are right where we're going — the campsite! They must be after Variks too. Let's hurry!
The Guardian defeats the Fallen and enters the campsite.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These Fallen have an unfamiliar House symbol. Who are we dealing with? Someone's been staying here. There's traces of… Darkness energy.
Ghost scans a device inside a building at the campsite.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's BrayTech. From Eventide — Clovis Bray's Golden Age colony here on Europa. Whoever was here was using it to track Variks too. They must have intercepted the distress signal before we did. Okay, I've got the signal's true origin point. It's not far. Let's hurry!

The Guardian approaches a Fallen barrier and is ambushed by Fallen Skiffs blocking Variks' signal. The Guardian defeats the Fallen, disables the Fallen barrier, and continues tracking Variks' distress signal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks must have really done it this time. If we don't get to him first, someone else will. If it's not already too late. Wait — Darkness. It's close. I feel it too, but… it's different somehow.
The Guardians heads towards the true origin point of Variks' signal. Variks is shown surrounded by Eramis' forces. Eramis approaches Variks and knocks him down.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Not only a traitor, but a thief. Now, where is it?!
Eramis summons her dark power and traps Variks with Stasis.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Wait! Eramis… Old friend… These powers… they create chaos. They are changing you. This…

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Ha! Cling to your Machine God. With this power… we make our own fate.
As Eramis turns away, Variks grasps her arm. Eramis turns back and forcibly detaches Variks's mechanical, upper-right arm, crushing and tossing it aside.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Always playing pretend. Living in the past. I should have seen it. Make an example of him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks should be just up ahead. There! That's where Variks' signal is coming from.
The Guardian finds Variks surrounded by Fallen.
The Guardian fight against the Fallen near Variks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait a second — I'm picking up more chatter on the Fallen's comms.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Have them surround the perimeter. The snake does not leave here alive.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Savior, hurry! You must free me!
The Guardian frees Variks and he stumbles to the ground.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [wheezes in pain] Variks thanks you. [insect-like chattering] And now must hide.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not so fast. We heard your message: "Darkness walks among us." What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: There is no time. They are coming! Variks asks for your protection once more. I will take shelter inside. Succeed, and Variks will reveal all.
Fallen Skiffs descend upon the Guardian and summon a Brig. The Guardian defeats the Brig and the Fallen reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Success, savior! Variks is truly grateful. [insect-like chattering]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then prove it. We expect answers.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Come to Variks, and you will have them. [insect-like chattering] But know that our work here has only just begun.
The Guardian returns to Variks, an Eliksni Rebel.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: You do not trust Variks, yes? But leave your distrust, your blame, for later. The Eliksni who attacked me — she is Eramis, the Shipstealer. A new Kell of Kells, unifier of the houses — and she seeks to build an army of Eliksni, powered by Darkness. [insect-like chattering] If she is not stopped, she will destroy us all. You must go! Variks will help you find your way.
