title: Depth Reception I: Zavala and Drifter — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: And that's it? It just… works?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: It's not a scam, if that's what you're asking. Ain't gonna make you put in some Glimmer and pull a lever.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: See… the way I look at it, this has always been the plan. Playing the game, Gambit… the machine. The Nine taking the long view.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You think the Nine were telling you to run Gambit… for this. That they saw everything coming, and THAT'S how they chose to prepare us?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Dunno, boss. Maybe they see the future. Maybe they're just a few floors above and can see further down the road than we can. Maybe we're all just squintin' at specks, looking for meaning. What I'm saying is… it works. It'll get us what we need, and maybe, if we're lucky, get Sloane what she needs too.

title: Depth Reception IV: Zavala and Saladin — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The ever-forward march of time has a humorous way of looping in on itself. Doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: In some ways. A long-lived perspective makes it difficult not to see trends die and resurface.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Do you think that's how the Witness sees us? Variations of potential, or lack thereof?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Sloane. She is singularly focused on her mission. That type of focus… you forget to come up for air. It's like a death when it's over.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Your command can be an anchor—keep her from drifting. That's what I tried to do for you.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I seem to recall pushing back against your methods quite often.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: The Dark Age drove us to extremes. Your style of leadership is… more refined than mine.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: It wasn't long ago that I was your pupil. Since then, I'd like to think we've developed a trust beyond authority or duty. How did you foster that friendship while being my superior?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: You're not listening, Zavala. I didn't. Remember, you left my tutelage. All I did was give you the lessons I thought you needed to survive. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You're saying I can't be all things.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I'm saying I can't tell you what you want, because our friendship was not of my making. When the Iron Lords fell, when the Red Legion caged the Traveler, when the Pyramids filled our skies… my heart was not open. You were. Despite your doubts, others see you as a pillar of strength. They're drawn to the shade you provide. Just… stay standing.

title: Depth Reception II: Saladin and Saint-14 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Saint? What is it? I'm busy.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Does Caiatl know you use her ship to jam my messages to the deputy commander?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Ah. This. [sighs] Sloane doesn't want your help. We're allowed to carry our own burdens.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You and I do not speak for years. When a battlefield brings us together, you choose to lecture. I am not one of your Iron beasts, Saladin. Do not treat me as a pupil.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Then don't act like one. You've been alive too long to be this naive.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: There is no shame in asking for help, nor harm in offering it.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Is that why you don't? I see a friend drowning, their armor pulling them down, so I lift them up from the water, yes?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Sloane held Titan, Lightless, during the Red War. She thrives under pressure.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Tell me, Saladin… are you not doing the same as me?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You shield Sloane against my "overbearance," do you not? Did she ask you to do that?

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I… you're not turning this back onto me.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You are softer than the Cabal think—more like fluffy dog than iron wolf.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Point taken. I'll remove the jamming signal. Just… trust enough to let her learn to swim before you dive in after her.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I will temper my outreach to Sloane—a little. Perhaps I will shift those efforts to opening your heart, Lord Valus.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Haha! I win, ha! Goodbye, Saladin.

title: Depth Reception V: Zavala and Drifter — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You never did tell me why you trust the Nine so much.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Oh, I don't. Not even a little. I trust Orin.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Long story. [sighs] The short of it is… I may have had a feeling or two for somebody a long time ago. Somebody that lost themselves along the way. But there's a little piece of her still out there. A sliver… who still has a feeling or two for the somebody I could be. So I trust her. Because she ain't never steered me wrong, no matter how rotten I was. Because at the end of the day, maybe we gotta put our faith in something other than ourselves… even if we're too stubborn to admit it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I… didn't expect you to put a lot of stock in faith.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: And I didn’t expect you to lose yours and keep moving. Guess we’re all full of surprises, ain’t we?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I’m giving you the benefit of the doubt that you’re being genuine.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Oh, I'm always genuine. People just ain't always payin' attention. For real, though? Moondust might've given me a push. Thought it'd help.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Sounds like familiar advice. Is it, though? Helping.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Then we have that in common too.

title: Desperate Measures — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian. All of our training, all of our losses—it's brought us to this moment. We must stop Calus from reaching the Veil and establishing a link to the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: The final stand, baby! If I can get this old Ishtar-era orbital beam thing up and running, might come in handy.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I would suggest exercising an abundance of caution around "untested Ishtar technology."

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I miss the old "go in without a plan and hope for the best" Osiris.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Today shall be the end of Calus's reign. The Shadow Legion will submit, or be crushed beneath my heel.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Caiatl's forces are entering Neomuni airspace now. Something's not right, though.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: They've set up anti-air guns! In our city!

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Eradicate their weapons. I will not subject any more of my soldiers to such fruitless deaths.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: My forces are rallying, but it will take some time.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You're almost at the Veil, Guardian. Every moment wasted brings us that much closer to calamity.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: So… this defense relay thing. Taking a bit more work than I thought! It hasn't been turned on since the Ishtar days. Hope it still works!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: With the empress's legion routed, it may be our last line of defense.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Sounds like someone's coming around to the "untested Ishtar weapon."

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: She's almost ready. I think I got it…

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Whoa! Did you see that? Totally planned that.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Keep the turrets under our control. They're vital to our defense.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Enemy tanks are headed to your position.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: That sounds like a job for "untested Ishtar weapon"! Paint the targets, Guardian! You tag 'em; I'll frag 'em.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's no end to them! Osiris, what do we do?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Remember your training! You only have one goal: keep them from the Veil!

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Shadow Legion cowards! This is Empress Caiatl, the true sovereign of the Cabal. You've chosen to ally yourself with a gutless traitor worshipping a false god. We are Cabal. We eat the mountains, we drink the seas. If you've any shred of honor left, then at least give us the pleasure of a worthy battle.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Guardian! If it's our day to die, we shall be immortalized in legend together!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: You're doing great, but, uh… I've got some bad news. We're outta juice. No more turrets. No more defense relay.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Retreat to higher ground! You need a more defensible position.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: This way, Guardian! We'll safeguard the Vault together.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: The Veil's exposed. Keep them away from it, at all costs! Leave the emperor to me.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You must reach the Veil before the Shadow Legion. Do whatever you must to prevent the link!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I have a feeling she can take care of herself.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Empress Caiatl is buying you time to find the Veil before the Shadow Legion. Don't squander this opportunity.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: According to Neomuni lore, the Veil is deep beneath the ground. Like, waaaay deep. Whatever you find in there, just keep going downward.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: We're keeping an eye on the surface. Caiatl's holding off Calus for now, but she's outnumbered.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Osiris, I'm sending you a visual feed. We could use your help navigating this place.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Incredible! Just like the Archive on Venus. You should be able to access that Ishtar terminal like any other.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That must be the Veil. It's massive! I feel a little strange. Don't know how to describe it… It almost gives me the same feeling as… the Traveler? That doesn't make any sense, does it? Let's press on.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: For both our sakes, please don't fall. It looks like the Veil goes even deeper!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Looks like a CloudArk prototype! That's…wow.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: I held them off as long as I could. Calus is coming for you. It's in your hands now, Guardian. Give him the end he deserves.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I'm reading major shockwaves in the Vault! The emperor's smashing through that place!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Hurry, Guardian! He'll get there before you!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I've been waiting for this day a long time, Guardian. Come! Let us revel in this exquisite moment!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Don't die on me yet, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Witness! Venerate your Disciple! Heh heh. [exhales] Let the war beasts feast tonight!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I am the Disciple! I am the emperor!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Argh! The Witness will see me…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Caiatl, we've done it. Calus is no more.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: You gave him a Cabal's end? [exhales] I'll believe it when I see it for myself.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, uh… do you guys feel that?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: No clue what you're talking about. We're almost at the Veil. Hang tight.

title: Desperate Measures: Debriefing with Ikora — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Guardian. The Traveler is gone, but… we're still here. It may seem small, but it's no less important under the circumstances. Despite your triumphs against the former emperor, the Witness has transformed the Traveler, and gone somewhere we cannot follow. Losses are no stranger to any of us, and I have long since known that the world does not obey laws of poetic justice. Much as we might hope otherwise. It would be easy to look at the sky and falter. We cannot. We must take the time we have, and make these losses mean something. Neptune is the best and only direction we have. Work with the Cloud Striders. Learn what you can about the Veil. A step at a time, an inch at a time—we keep going. With… or without the Traveler.

title: Depth Reception VI: Sloane and Zavala — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Commander. On Titan, I… had a moment of weakness. Xivu Arath—

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: At ease, Sloane. You resisted the will of a Hive God. An apology isn't necessary.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [sighs] Everything I'd done since they took Titan… that was the moment. And I almost faltered.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: "A mettle tested leaves an impression." Something Saladin used to recite… when we were young.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: It's more than an impression. I accepted a lot, thinking I wasn't coming back. When we secured Titan before, it was survival. But we had hope, a goal. We won, and it was over. This time… [sighs] something's dragging me back. Like… like that struggle's all there is.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You're kidding? What was her name, this woman who wooed "Old Man" Zavala?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Safiyah. Together… we raised a son. Hakim.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: It was the Dark Age. I was Saladin's charge. Young, reckless, enchanted by… [sighs] A warm memory, now.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I've never heard you talk about those days. Is Rehnpeir's Drunken Noodle still there, or'd we lose it in some catastrophe?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: It's still standing. Expanded, actually. Let's talk in person. I'll clear the night's schedule.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Uh oh. Must be for someone important.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Well, I don't know what I would've done if Rehnpeir's blew up while I was gone. Sometimes those noodles held me together.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We would have rebuilt it. Brick by brick, if that's what it took.

title: Desperate Measures: Debriefing with Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Calus is gone, and the Veil is safe for now. I don't really know what victory looks like going forward, but I'm not gonna take this win from us. From Neomuna. It's weird not being the rookie anymore. I'm just "Cloud Strider Nimbus." Feels wrong. Like I jumped out a window without my board. There was confidence in knowing the buck stopped with someone else. For Rohan, when I met him at least, it seemed like he just took everything in stride. It was easy for him. Hm. I guess I'll get there someday. We're having Rohan's induction into the Hall of Heroes in a bit. Will you join us? It'll be great. Quinn will say something stuffy, there'll be lots of cheering… Maybe a whistle if you want to get spicy. But… I think… he'd be honored if you were there.

title: A Rising Tide — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vex are taking control of the surface to protect the Black Garden. Mars could soon be worse than Venus. We've got to find out where they're coming from.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need to track down a Conflux, like we saw on Venus. There's reports of one not too far from here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Once we find out where the Vex are coming from, cut them off, or it's only a matter of time before Mars becomes one of their machines.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is part of an even bigger surge, coming from below the Buried City. We better check it out.
Guardian travels down to the Buried City, clearing the surrounding Vex.
Guardian proceeds through the entrance of Off World Transit M Line, and deep into Freehold Station

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like it's going to be dark in here for a while. Just aim for any red eye you see.
Guardian, in near darkness, is immediately surrounded by teleporting Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They have Transfer Gates down here. Shut them down!
The Vex bleed from transfer gates, the guardian makes an assault on the gates.
Guardian makes an assault on the Vex stronghold, destroying all remaining Transfer Gates**.
A Conflux is still active. Let me check it out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This isn't an invasion, the Vex are returning home. Something is calling them back to the Black Garden.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Desperate Measures: Interlude with Caiatl — Transcript

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: I wanted to thank you for bringing an end to what was once my father. I wish we had a moment of respite to celebrate our victory. Greater strife lies ahead. I will prepare the Cabal for the Witness's machinations, and when it reveals itself, I will once more be standing by your side on the battlefield.

title: Desperate Measures: Neomuna Civil News — Nimbus Interview — Transcript

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: [Neomuna News with Jisu Calerondo musical jingle] With Neomuna Civil News, this is Jisu Calerondo, coming to you today with Cloud Strider Nimbus for updates on the recent conflict. Nimbus, thank you for joining us in light of the heavy burden that has recently fallen on your shoulders.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I mean, whole city's hurting right now, Jisu. Rohan was my hero, same as everyone else. But the best thing we can all do is make sure his sacrifice means something. Keep this city safe.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: And what of the Guardians? Have they helped maintain our peace and safety, or are they adding new complications?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: We all knew the return of the Pyramid fleet was going to be complicated, and I'm glad we've had the Guardians here every step of the way. There's one thing Rohan taught me, it's that no one survives alone. We need each other.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: Impassioned words from one of our city's great champions. Let us hope time proves them wise as well. This is Jisu Calerondo, signing off.

title: Desperate Measures: Neomuna Civil News — Caiatl Interview — Transcript

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: [Neomuna News with Jisu Calerondo musical jingle] This is Jisu Calerondo, coming to you once again with a special guest as part of our continuing war coverage: the Cabal empress, Caiatl. Your Majesty, thank you for joining us today.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: Most of our listeners know little of your people's history beyond your colonization efforts on Mars, and the recent Red War with Earth. Tell me, what is your goal here in the Sol system?

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: We came to your system as conquerors, Mr. Calerondo. While that was not under my rule, it is a banner I would have gladly waved.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: And yet, you extended the offer of truce with Earth.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: The Cabal say, "There is no road through war." Your direction must change with circumstance.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: Ah, you're referring to the recent destruction of your homeworld?

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Torobatl was consumed by the Hive… and the Witness. And so now, my people fight for survival, in addition to glory.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: My sympathies. All of Neomuna knows what it is to lose a homeworld.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: I do not place much value in your "sympathies," Mr. Calerondo. They were of little value to Earth.

title: Desperate Measures: Debriefing with Zavala — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Traveler… Gone. Should I feel… humbled by this sacrifice? Relieved that it can't grant any more of our enemies the Light? Lost… without a god in whom I can place my trust? [sighs] But what consumes me in this moment… is the human loss. We've watched so many die for this war. And yet… Those losses have given us insight… and common bonds. We stand alongside more allies than ever before. Humans. Awoken. Eliksni. Even the Cabal. When I came to the Last City, I looked up to the heavens for the hope the Traveler gave us. Now… I look up and see the hope we've built for ourselves.

title: Desperate Measures: Interlude with Osiris — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It doesn't make sense. How are we still alive? Was the Witness only interested in the Veil? It appears to have created a link using Ghost and the Veil. The convergence of primordial Light and Darkness to open a portal… But to where? We should focus our efforts on the Veil and the trail the Witness might have left behind. If you need a moment, take it. But bear in mind: one loss does not equate to defeat. Keep fighting.

title: Downfall — Transcript

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Lightbearer, you have a dangerous mission ahead of you. Storming Calus's stronghold won't be easy. Normally, I'd have more intel before a direct attack.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Guardian has faced the unknown and prevailed every time. They are equal to the task. The Radial Mast is somewhere in Calus's ship. If you strike swiftly, we can remove it as a threat before it ever reaches the Veil. Enter Calus's fortress, find the Radial Mast, and destroy it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, they're rolling out the red carpet for us!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Huh, some kind of energy lock. Disrupting the circuit should open the door.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Be cautious. If Calus is smart, he'll have his most powerful forces guarding the Radial Mast.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's… something strange here too. A powerful concentration of… Light energy?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Wait. A source of paracausal energy? It could be the Radial Mast.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shadow Legion have the corridor locked down tight. Even if we could fight through, they'd have enough time to secure the Radial Mast.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: There must be more than one path to the Radial Mast. Stand by. I'll send you all the sensor scans we have.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You want them to take an indirect route? We can ill afford to waste time!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm working with less data than I'd like, but I've mapped out an alternate route through the ship. One with fewer cannons pointed at it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If this is what you think is best, then.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian, do you see that? It's more of that strange Darkness energy. What is it doing here?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like a dead end. Hang on, I'll reroute us.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You're losing valuable time. This is exactly what I was concerned about.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That statue could've come right out of the Leviathan. Maybe he's still the same old Calus, deep down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shadow Legion must use this grav lift to move equipment and troops across the ship. It should take us deeper in. I still can't believe my sensors. Could the Radial Mast really be a Light artifact?

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: There's still a great deal we don't know. What is the Radial Mast capable of? How will it affect the Veil? And what is the Witness planning?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: All very good questions, but ones that can wait until we've destroyed the Radial Mast… and saved your city.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: I know what's at stake here, Osiris.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shadow Legion are ready for a siege, all right. Just look at all these ships!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Calus is ready to annihilate this city. If those ships reach the cryo-pods, the casualties would be devastating.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, I bet we could help with that! Overloading those energy conduits should do the trick.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Are you handling extremely volatile energy? AGAIN?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ha! Take that! Rohan, you've got fewer ships to worry about now.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: An improvised distraction… [sighs] but an effective one.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: And the people of Neomuna will be safer, at least for now.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Are you at the Radial Mast yet?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No, but we're getting closer. I can sense it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Good, good—they haven't moved it yet. There's still some time. Focus on the path ahead of you, Guardian. You're almost there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's strange. I thought as we got further in, we'd see more of the old Calus. But this… How much has the Witness changed him?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Osiris has been struggling. But I don't know what we can do to help… …If we can do anything.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If my angles are right, this grav lift is a straight shot to the Radial Mast. We're almost there!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You have overcome every obstacle so far, Guardian. Do not falter now.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just look at this place. All these Shadow Legion soldiers… there's a whole army in here!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: An army ready to march on Neomuna. Calus won't leave a single wall or citizen standing.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That won't come to pass… as long as we stop him in time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something's wrong. The door just… opened for us.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: I have a bad feeling. Be vigilant.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That monument must be the Radial Mast. There's no mistaking it. That's Light energy radiating from it!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: At last, you have arrived, Guardian. Welcome to this final test of strength. Alas! This day, I have no riches in store for you.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Ignore Calus's bloviating. This is your chance! Destroy the Radial Mast!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: So you've come for this meager trinket? It is the very least of the Witness's gifts. A mere glimpse of the power it can bestow!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Even the best contender's performance grows insipid without a worthy opponent. [laughs] Wouldn't you agree?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Radial Mast is too well shielded. We can't even scratch it. But maybe we can overload those energy conduits!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I have made you what you are! Now let us see if you were worth the effort.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Another Darkness anomaly! Where did it come from?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian? Guardian! Oh no, not now!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Now you will see true power—what could have been yours, if only you had accepted my generous offers. You cannot escape fated oblivion. Embrace your end.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hang on, I'm getting a transmission. It's… uh, a set of coordinates? Inside this arena?

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Is this the extent of your strength? Is this all the Traveler's chosen Guardians can muster? [laughs]

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Guardian. Your recklessness will be the end of you one day. But not today.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Caiatl. Daughter. Traitor. Have you come to disappoint me one last time?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll, uh, just show ourselves out.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Is it done? Have you destroyed the Radial Mast?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can't! The whole ship is coming down on top of us. We have to go!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: We were too late once already, and Calus was able to secure the Veil. Now the Radial Mast?

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Headlong and empty-handed, Osiris. If you fight the river, it'll sweep you away.

title: Downfall: Meet with Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: So… the Veil's safe, for now. I don't have an Earth Warlord translation for this, so, um, stick with me. If Calus uses whatever that Radial thingy is and somehow destroys the Veil, well… It's tied directly to our CloudArk and literally all Neomuni. I don't think you need a Warlord translation for why that's bad. From the sound of it, your buddy there, Osiris, wants to go in guns a-blazin', which, hey, I fully support. But the old man—the, uh, other old man—my old man. Not literally, but, you know. Between you and me, he isn't sure it's the right call. But don't worry, though. I reminded him you Guardians are the experts here. You've been dealing with this whole Witness thing a lot longer than we have. It's okay if we lean back and try a little trust fall. If you drop us, it might be my funeral, but whatever, it'll be fun!

title: Downfall: Interlude with Osiris — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: So far, this city is more advanced than I could have ever anticipated. This CloudArk they've constructed fascinates me. It appears to function with the assistance of the Veil somehow. To willingly give up control of your physical body… It's an intriguing concept to exist primarily in a virtual space.

title: Download Complete — Transcript

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: In searching for more information on SIVA, I discovered some recent unexplained phenomena originating near Clovis Bray.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: That's deep in Cabal territory. I find it unlikely the Fallen would have had time to experiment in those labs undisturbed.

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: True, but there are records of SIVA prototypes that were never recovered. They could be the missing link.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Lord Timur spoke of SIVA prototypes, too. Very well, old friend. Let's follow this path.

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: You should be in the vicinity any time now.

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: I can guide you to the biolabs, though it may take some investigation to locate the SIVA prototypes once you're there.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: I have faith in our young wolf there. He will find our way forward, I'm certain of it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Did he just call one of us a young wolf? Because it's probably less endearing if he meant me.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm not seeing any flashing lights advertising SIVA research. Maybe there's a console that can help us narrow things down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, what do we have here? Ha! Who knew finding dangerous Golden Age archives would be so easy? There's an intact data store just below us.

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: Unfortunately, my intel says you're going to need to make your way underground.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Falling great distances is actually our specialty. Elevator shaft, anyone?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The doors to the elevator shaft should be here somewhere.
Guardian unlocks door, drops down elevator shaft

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nothing says "We're in the right place!" like dead Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There, that's the Bray Research archive! Now to rummage through its files.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Interesting. There were multiple prototypes, each programmed to serve a different function. One that built Constructs, viral armour enhancements - that's neat - and we have a winner! Cybernetic diagnostics! Exactly what the Fallen would need to -
Heavy Cabal enforcements surround and attack Guardian

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, maybe later. We've got company!

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: The Young Wolf strikes again! Tyra, the prototype archives — will they be enough to identify a weakness in the Fallen's hold on SIVA?

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: I have to remind you, of all the people that I'm a scholar, not a scientist? Don't worry, old friend. Between myself and Shiro, we won't leave a single stone unturned. You'll have your defence.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Downfall: Interlude with Rohan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Nimbus gave me their report about your attempt to reach our Veil. Don't let it get you down. This is a marathon, not a sprint. I've been a Cloud Strider for almost 10 years. When our decade's up, we die. Our bodies can't handle so much augmentation. I took on this mantle to protect the people of Neomuna, knowing it would kill me. I've only got one life to give, and it's almost up. I need to take care of the Shadow Legion for Nimbus. Lighten the load. I still have so much to teach them. They aren't ready. Not yet. But sometimes, they're the one teaching me… a lesson I think Osiris could stand to learn. Look after him; he needs it.

title: Dread Patrol — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian helps Cayde set up a patrol network on the Dreadnaught.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: It isn't fun, but we need to set out some beacons so the Vanguard can patrol the Dreadnaught. Isn't fun for you, anyway. See you on the comms!
The Guardian heads to the Dreadnaught.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: So, Zavala was here a while ago. Gave this big speech about how proud he is, how well the "Dreadnaught campaign" went and... you know how he gets. Anyway, he gave me a list here — set up locations for patrol beacons. We need them planted and tested if we're going to get that tub under control. You plant them, you test them. I'll keep you company.
The Guardian touches down on the Dreadnaught.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Right. First on the list is an intel beacon. Helps us get the lay of the land, gives us updates on troop movements, skirmishes and the like. You've got the marker, go do your thing.
The Guardian plants the intel beacon.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Okay, the beacon signal is coming in loud and clear. Ah, in fact, I've already got a ping. Marking a hot zone for you. Go get a look at the fighting, see what you can see.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Data's good. Second marker should have been downloaded to your Ghost. Intel beacons are Ikora's favorite, by the way. Never met a woman who appreciated ambient temperature and energy readings as much as she does.
The Guardian places a race beacon.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: The marker's up and running. The eggheads love these scoot-and-scan missions. I just like 'em as an excuse to stretch the old legs. I'm feeding you data for a few nearby energy spikes. Get moving!
The guardian scans some energy spikes.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I was gonna send you off with a pithy joke, but Eris started droning on about the pathways into Darkness or some damn thing. Got distracted. Anyway! One more beacon to go, if you would be so kind.
The Guardian places a hunt beacon.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Beacon is hot. Yeah, that's a good signal. I'm getting some data on Taken patrols around the ship. We've already got a hot spot on the board. Go clear out that blight, Guardian.
The Guardian defeats Balvog, Shield of Oryx.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: And that's a Taken pack all cleaned out. Good work. Heh. You know, Zavala gets all cranky if you "have more important things to do" than plant beacons. Not a problem today. Come on back.
The Guardian returns to the Tower.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Patrols are just one of those things we have to do as loyal Vanguard members... yeah. You did me a favor today, Guardian. I won't forget it.
Echoed Warnings | Eris Morn's Final Message

title: Dredging Up Secrets | The Mausoleum — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian’s Tithe is found worthy. They enter a nearby portal.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian. I mentioned that there's a new influence on the Taken. Like feedback over a comms channel. It's been getting stronger, and gaining clarity. Like a radio signal gradually tuning in. I didn't want to mention this until I was sure but... it has a familiar rhythm to it. A cadence. I'm not sure how, but I'm afraid a Dread commander gained access to the Taken. Keep this between us for now. I don't want to raise alarm unnecessarily. Just... keep your eyes open.

title: Duality — Transcript

lines.text: Enter the Echo of Calus's Consciousness

"Once I stood out overlooking a vast plain. Wildflowers and nettles blossomed at my feet. The future was full of promise and potential. Yet I upturned an overflowing chalice of shame at my feet, and let it puddle into rot."

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You arrive. Good, yes. We have only a brief window of opportunity. The Darkness is thick here, coalesced inside this effigy of Emperor Calus. It is tethered to his very mind. I have snared that thread. Caught it between my fingers and woven it into a tapestry. One that I can weave you into. Enter Calus's consciousness. Use this opportunity to steal his darkest secrets from him.
"...and here, you see, etched on the bell? That is when I attained the title of emperor and began a thousand years of peace."

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: What you feel may seem like reality, but it is not the one you know. Your mind now stretches across a vast gulf. Though while this world is born of Calus's thoughts, it is no less dangerous than physical reality.
The Guardian walks down the stairway.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This... is not what I anticipated. The imprint of Calus's consciousness is... fractured, straining. As if Calus's mind is at war with itself.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: All my history is etched here, from humble beginnings to my rise as emperor. It is an ancient tradition of our people.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Calus? No, not Calus, but an echo of him. This is a recollection of a time since past.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My Bell of Conquest is so grand because I have lived a grand life. One day, my daughter, yours will be just as majestic.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You are experiencing echoes of Calus's personal torment. Glimpses into his past which may provide insight to the future. I must focus to maintain your connection to this mindscape. From here, you must navigate these memories on your own.
The Guardian interacts with the first Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The Praetorate's time has come to an end. Too long have the people of Torobatl languished under their heel. A world that knows only war has no future. We were not always conquerors. We were not always tyrants. If violence carved us into the shape of what we are now, then so shall violence be that shape's undoing!
The Guardian interacts with the second Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Ever since she was born, Caiatl has shown a curiosity for the world beyond. She shares my fascinations. I worry for her, for the galaxy she will grow up in, for the future of our people. But perhaps the time for worries is at an end. My daughter will grow up knowing only celebration, triumph, and peace. This is the world I made.
The Guardian interacts with the third Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: [drunkenly] Peace has its detractors, hahaha! I was too kind in my coup against the... [stutters] Praetorate. Drank too deep of the cup of mercy. Now there are long shadows in the night, hands clutching knives, eyes at my back. I hear them, whispering. I hear them. But soon, those whispers will become screams. The Ghost Primus is the answer to this sedition. My Red Legion, anointed in blood... [grunts]
The Guardian passes through a hallway.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: [grunts angrily] Exile? Is the mighty Ghaul too great a coward to kneel down and take my head from my shoulders?

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: I am as you made me, and I would kill you were it my choice. But it is not. Caiatl stayed my blade. Remember that.
The Guardian interacts with the fourth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My servants come, but I refuse their succor. I will not feast, I will not drink! I will wither away until there is nothing left. My love has been turned to poison in my veins. They do not appreciate all that I had done for them. My sacrifices! [sighs] All betrayal is inevitable. We are a ring of beasts, feasting upon one another.
"Her memory curdles in my chest. Her first laugh, her first steps, her first kill. Poison. Poison. Poison."

"You were born only to suffer, because I could not set aside that which I knew was a trap. My curiosity is a poison flowing through my veins, curdling my heart, rotting my mind. And yet, I do nothing to stop it."

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: You were bred to be a sorrow-bearer. I seek a Hive commander, but those are not so readily available. So I made you.
The Guardian interacts with the fifth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: At the edge of the universe, I stared into the infinite deep. It stared back, and was pleased. I would become the herald of its victory and bear witness for all creation. The key is to realize the future isn't an enemy to be fought. It is a friend to embrace. A closing of the circle. And when the end comes, I reserve the right... to be last.

"I defiled them. The remains of countless dead. Honored servants of the empire, extended members of my lineage. I ripped their tombs open to harvest their genetic information... to build an army of unquestioning soldiers. What have I become?"

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: There was a time I would have gladly laid in death beside you, here in these crypts. But we were both different then.
The Guardian interacts with the sixth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The Light is a fascinating thing, and in my ignorant youth, I may have seen it as aspirational. Like Ghaul. I see this force for what it truly is. Eternal life after death is a trick of the Light. An illusion! Nothing is forever. But these Guardians entertain me. I will use their ignorance. Shower them with lavish gifts, with praise. I will watch them dance into the grave of creation for my amusement.
The Guardian slides down into the next room.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: No one of honor will be interred here. The dead are raw materials, and nothing more.
The Guardian interacts with the seventh Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Savathûn, Savathûn. She nearly had me. Had I not birthed Gahlran, had he not donned the Crown, I would be lost. The Voice warned me of her, but I did not heed it, and the Voice is so... silent now. The promised end is at hand as worlds are swallowed into nothing, and I... I hear nothing. Excruciating silence. Perhaps I have displeased it. Or perhaps... I am not listening hard enough.
"I should have killed every member of the old guard when I had the chance. Mercy was my greatest failing, and they used mercy's edge to cut me down to my knees."
The Guardian enters the statue room.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Shadows were cast here. History made.
The Guardian interacts with the eighth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: In my haste to find a suitable bearer for the Crown of Sorrow, I failed to see a more elegant solution. The Hive were not those who could most elegantly bear the Crow. My Shadow, Katabasis, found the alternative. Mindless corpses of Fallen, risen through an Ahamkara's wish magic, fuelled by Darkness-infused Ether... the Scorn. The only component that was missing was a connective tissue, and this, the Egregore spores would provide.
"It hurts. It hurts. It hurts. It hurts."
"Cut it away. A knife through memory's flesh. Peel back what I was and replace it with scalding gold. I do not want this. I do not want this. I do not want this."
The Guardian fights the Nightmare of Ka'hok, Sworn of Umun'arath.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Do not open doors you cannot close!
The Guardian fights the Nightmare of Emonut, Sworn of Moli Imoli.
The Guardian fights the Nightmare of Uroa, Sworn of Shayotet.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Please! No, please! Don't do this!
The Guardian defeats the last enemy.
The Guardian interacts with the ninth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Through the Crown of Sorrow, the Voice in the Darkness called out to me, beckoning me to the absence of Mercury. At first, I feared the Leviathan would not survive the journey, as the Glykon had been rent asunder by a similar journey. But my Leviathan, it is strong. Its heart beats anew, and as it pierced the veil of creation... the Voice greeted me. There were such sights to behold.

"For once in my life, I do not feel shame. I feel the caress of a thousand hands, hear the comforting hush of a thousand voices. 'Do not be afraid,' it whispers. 'We are your salvation.' Yes. Please. Save me from myself."
The Guardian interacts with the tenth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: There, in that gravity shadow, I was truly seen. There, I understood my role in the closing of the circle. The Witness opened its mind to me, and I saw my darkest desire made reality. I would be the last. It is my right. I am the herald. I am the end.
The Guardian interacts with the eleventh Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: The Witness's voice is so strong now. I hear it clearer than my own. I understand now what true paracausality is. The Light and the Dark are threads on a loom, woven into the tapestry of the universe by those who wield it. The Witness would see things differently. The gaps between those threads. Freedom from the greater design. Freedom... for all.
The Guardian heads to the Dark Shrine.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: She is more beautiful than any star I have ever beheld. I name her Caiatl, for the brightest star in our sky. May she outshine it always.
The Guardian interacts with the twelfth Memory

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: I have reached the limits of what this crumbling body can offer, and yet there is so much more that I must do. I must shed my remaining attachments to this flesh, and ascend. The others have, and a path is laid before me. There is fear in this. Fear of losing myself. But there is no other way. I must prove my loyalty, or wither. To understand the final shape, I must become more than myself.
The Dark Shrine, Mindscape of Calus
Defeat the Nightmare of Princess Caiatl
"Is this what I have done? Once, she looked at me with adoring eyes. I was her world, and she my stars. How have I made her into this? Have I been so blind? So selfish? What have I done?"

title: Dredging Up Secrets | Trenchway — Transcript

lines.text: TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian’s Tithe is found worthy. They enter a nearby portal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oryx’s return instigated a grand schism in the Hive. They are shaken. They entertain the first doubt, the oldest doubt. They call it the “Entaoxuanna.” The doubt that will destroy them. The doubt that will undermine their core philosophy. Whatever happens must be so, but what must be so, is poison. Their king was slain, but his mantle went unassumed. Now he returns as a sword: wormless, resurrected, and without the strength of his brood. There is no greater heresy than this. His sisters know it. He knows it. And so, in this, Oryx wishes to begin again.

title: Echo Chamber — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The Vex still mourn the loss of the Nexus Mind. But for the Vex, time is relative. In one moment, a construct is lost. In the next, it is reborn. When a powerful part of the network is lost, the Restorative Mind is summoned. It has begun creating a bridge through time. A bridge that, if it is not destroyed, will see the Nexus Mind reborn.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I’m detecting a series of concentric barriers around the bridge site.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: They protect the time bridge. And seek to undo what we have done.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Unless I’m mistaken, barrier technology of this nature is unstable.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: She’s right. Find an Arc source. You can use it to short out the barriers.
Guardians use Arc source to disable gates

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Did you know the Vex are organic? Within their metal frame, a heart beats. And they shudder at your approach — an approximation of fear.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The Nexus Mind must have been a vital resource. The very appearance of the Restorative Mind means we have the Vex off balance. Press the advantage, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That’s the time bridge. And the Restorative Mind!
The Restorative Mind is shielded inside the time bridge. An Arc Source capacitor materializes in front of the Guardians.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That capacitor just lit up. You know what to do.
Guardian retrieves the Arc Source and places it into the capacitor across the chamber. The time bridge begins to open and the Restorative Mind prepares itself for battle.

The Restorative Mind exits the time bridge and posts itself above the Arc Source. The Guardians continue to retrieve the relic. The Restorative Mind has no choice but to follow the relic and lower its shield, allowing the Guardians to inflict massive amounts of damage. It returns to the time bridge as a last resort. The walls begin to close in and shift left to right, as a great deal of Vex enemies begin to spawn. The Guardians continue to fight. They retrieve the relic and place it in the capacitor one last time. The Restorative Mind fires its Medusa’s Gaze to no avail. Its shield is down. The Guardians deal their final strike. The Restorative Mind is destroyed.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The weft and weave of space and time is intact. You have made whole the past again. The destruction of the Restorative Mind will ripple across the stars. And its deeds will be undone over and again. Very well done, Guardian.

title: Echoed Warnings | Discuss the Echo with Sloane — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Shaping Slab.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Now we know what we're dealing with. An Echo of the Navigator. A—a memory of Oryx,

and not the one we remember. He woke up the Dreadnaught and launched the anchors. The Taken are here because of him. And the Dread are working with him. His "knife". Eris' killer. But you've caught Oryx's attention. The Echo didn't know you killed him. Now he does. And he's... impressed. That means he's distracted. He wants to test you. Use that. Right now, Xivu Arath and Savathûn are mobilising. Their brother’s flagship is a battlefield. And Drifter’s gone. We have twice the trouble and half the support. Losing Eris was hard on him. We show who we are in hard times. We can’t afford to lose focus or lose ground. We need intel. We need you back on the Dreadnaught. Find out what you can. We must destroy the Echo. It can’t be allowed to exist. Sounds impossible, doesn’t it? But you’ve killed Oryx once. You’ll do it again.

title: Adventure: Hack the Planet — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, team. I know how we can hook Failsafe up to the Nessus core and mine all the data we could ever want. Just help me place these beacons and I'll explain!
The Guardian deploys the first beacon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These beacons should allow us to hook Failsafe into the Nessus core. Think of all the data she could pull!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: It is a proactive and clever plan, friendly Ghost! I still think its a bad idea.
The Guardian deploys the second beacon.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This will work, trust me! You know how I usually hack and scan stuff for us?
The Guardian deploys the final beacon and goes to unlock the Nessus Core.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The core is open! Get ready, Failsafe!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I am practising my best Vex impressions. Please do not let them capture me, Captain!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just treat it like tight-rope walking. Don't think about it.
The Guardian approaches the jump rings.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You can do this, Failsafe. I believe in you!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: If they kill me, I will haunt your shell.
The Guardian connects Failsafe to the core of Nessus.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I have interfaced with the Nessus core!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: See? Easy! Grab everything that's not nailed down!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Vex are attempting to impede my progress. There should be a conflux nearby. Please stabilise it for me.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Thank you, Captain! Now eliminate those data cubes. They contain security protocols that are blocking my progress.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You're a pro! I knew this could work.
The Guardian destroys five data cubes.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Vex are fighting back. I have marked other Confluxes for stabilisation. Destroy the cubes they generate!
The Guardian stabilises the other confluxes and destroys the data cubes just before a Network Minotaur appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe! The Vex have sent a Mind after us! Failsafe? Any updates?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK. So. She's been captured by the Vex. Ugh. I'm so sorry, I can fix this! Get me the data core from that Mind!
The Guardian retrieves the Vex Mind Core from the Network Minotaur and heads through a Vex Teleporter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe's gotta be in here somewhere. Help me get rid of the interference from these Confluxes, and I should be able to lock onto her position.
The Guardian destroys the data cubes and stabilises the confluxes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Got her! They've locked her in a cube construct. Take out the Vex, and we'll free her. I hope it's not too late.
The Guardian uses data cubes to destroy a Network Cyclops guarding Failsafe.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Thank you, Captain. I have spent the last decade speaking with a fellow prisoner.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A decade? It didn't take us that long!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Time must work differently within the Network. He was a very good listener. It's a shame I couldn't take him with me. He showed my a myriad of potentialities for this galaxy. How the Vex intend to shape them. I will share them with your Vanguard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm so sorry I put you through that.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: But you did! And I never forget those who wrong me.

But I figured it out, thanks to a few friends in low places — some graves. And Osiris gave me a few tips. Sounds like he's got experience. Weird dude. All we need is a few bloody stumps. Forwarding your first target, killer.

title: Echoed Warnings | Peer into the Shaping Slab — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian interacts with the Shaping Slab: Resolve

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian… Ikora sent me. I’ll be assuming operational command here to strike back against the Dread that took Eris from us… I… You’re hurting. I am too. We lost a soldier and a friend. But I’ve got you. Take a moment — more if you need ‘em — and then suit up, because we’re going back. We have the Vanguard’s full blessing to unleash hell — Ikora’s words. There’s a wall of Taken between us and an answer on the Dreadnaught, changing, and we don’t have any intel. I bet you’re raring to break right through it. So here’s the plan: Attack. Kick in the front door, honor Eris with vengeance, and crush whatever is going on before it gets any worse. Remember Eris. Remember what she meant. Remember what the Taken stole from us. What they thought was weakness, we turn to strength. Keep that pain close. We’re gonna use it to start a fire in the Dreadnaught and burn every last Taken out.

title: Echoed Warnings | Skyburner's Deep-Scan Data — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Eversion Anchors are forming all over the system. We need to root them out at the source. Find a way to stop them. Get to it, Guardian. We need intelligence. Then we can deal with the Taken.

title: Echoed Warnings | Kludge — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian. We’ve been on the back foot trying to keep the anchors from forming. It’s time to seize the initiative. We can’t disable them, but we can stop their eversion pulse. That’ll buy some time. See you on the Dreadnaught.
THE MAUSOLEUM, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian arrives on the Dreadnaught

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian. Make your way to the Halls of Souls and decouple the Eversion Anchors. I’ll meet you there. We’ll put a stop to this. Don’t rile up the Taken. It’s important we keep the element of surprise.
THE HALLS OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the Dire Taken around the weapon conduit and approaches Sloane.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian. You have what you need. Hive systems are disgusting, but effective. The Dreadnaught’s power is immense, but we can break its hold over its own weapons and turn it against itself. Disconnecting the Eversion Anchors will stop them from dragging us all into the Ascendant Plane. Show the Taken who’s in control.
The Guardian hacks the second Hive biosystem.
The Guardian hacks the third Hive biosystem.
It can’t be… A familial, regal voice bellows from the Hall of Souls. Chills run down the Guardian's spine. The voice... It can't be.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I am the Taken King. The First Navigator. I rise from the Deep.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: An Echo! Linked to the memory of Oryx?
The Guardian approaches the Echo. The Voice of Xivu appears.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: BROTHER! KING! MY NAVIGATOR! YOU RETURN TO US!

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Xivu Arath. What has become of our war?

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOU WERE SLAIN BY A WARRIOR OF THE SKY. THEY STAND BEFORE YOU!
Savathûn: Sadly yes, elder brother. You’re just the memory of a dead god. The sword you always wanted to become.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I only just mantled myself by the death of Akka. Carved my throne from the worm’s corpse.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOUR FORM SHALL REVIVE UPON THE DEATH OF YOUR KILLER. YOUR THRONE WILL BE RESTORED.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: If I am destroyed, then I deserve my extinction. My heir, my killer. Step forward.
Savathûn: Stop acting like children, the both of you. We are finally free to create new paths for ourselves.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: NO! I WILL NOT LET YOU ABANDON US AGAIN!
The two Hive sisters leave. The Resonant Knife, First of the Reshaped, arrives to claim the Echo.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: This… this isn’t possible! We need to regroup. Get out of there!
Corrupted eyes appear and the Guardian is afflicted with Suffocating Terror. They flee.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: Escape! The sibling gods of the Hive quibble over the Guardian's life. They escape to their ship before their jaws close in.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Sharpen their knives, that their lie may become my logic’s truth!
THE TRENCHWAY, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian succeeds in escaping to their ship.

title: Echoed Warnings | Sloane’s message to Drifter — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message from Sloane

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Damn it, Drifter, get back here. You're better than this. It's not going to help. We both know running doesn't stop the dead haunting you. Can't say I'd do the same thing, but... I guess I've thought about it a time or two. But you're the one who told me, "some things, you carry with you forever." Eris Morn's one of those things. You think she'd be proud of you taking off? Call me when you get this. I mean it. Situation's getting worse here. Hive god worse. We need you. If nothing else, for vengeance. In her honor. Let's make that weight a little easier to lift.

title: Echoed Warnings | The Eversion Anchors — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: So, the anchors are weapons. Like the one Oryx used at the Battle of Saturn. Classic, typical. Every damn thing near the Hive gets sharpened into a shiv at some point. [sighs] Well, we're making progress. We've got more of the Dreadnaught mapped now than ever, stopped every blight from taking form, and your resolve is iron. We've disabled the Dreadnaught's weaponry before. We can do it again. Savathûn can make all the threats she wants. I want you back on that ship. Track down the Echo while Drifter and I do some digging. I think some of the intel you've turned up details how to interface with the Dreadnaught's systems... I'll look into it.
The Guardian interacts with the Shaping Slab.
Echoed Warnings | Sloane’s message to Drifter

title: Echoed Warnings | Tome of Want — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You’ve taken your first steps into a very deep well. The Dreadnaught isn’t going to hold back. And as long as it can use those anchors like weapons, neither can we. Lots of things push a person to seek out being Taken. Loss, weakness, power, revenge. It’s important to remember that the promises the Deep makes you are just bad deals. Don’t let yourself get wrapped up in them. Control and reserve. Stick to the plan, and we’ll all see this through. I’ve got Drifter doing anchor recon. If he turns anything up, I’ll give you a call. Until then, keep squeezing.
Eris’s Flat, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian interacts with the Shaping Slab.

Your form reflects in Taken sheen...You have begun to walk the Path of Resolve with the Deputy Commander's guidance, and through your contact with the Anchor incursion, you learned valuable information about the linkage to the Dreadnaught's systems. Wielding Taken power is a risk, but one you can withstand if it means holding back the surge of blight spilling from the Dreadnaught. Though... you cannot deny that you feel stronger.
The Mausoleum, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn
The Guardian defeats the final boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Eris always did whatever she set her mind to, regardless of the risk. And regardless of who told her no. I can respect that, but that risk gets an edge when you encounter something you’re not ready for. We can’t let ourselves be caught off guard again. We’re going to peel this place apart until there’s nowhere to hide another ambush.
The Guardian interacts with the Shaping Slab.
Echoed Warnings | Trial of Will: Resolve

title: Echoed Warnings | Trial of Will: Resolve — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We kicked in the front door to the Dreadnaught all right, but something in there is keeping us from pushing deeper. I—I was afraid of this. If we’re going to stop the Taken, I’ll need you to follow me down a dangerous path. We can start by getting eyes on that anchor point you found in the EDZ. They’re obviously connected.
The Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, ready for some fieldwork? This one might not be… by the book. That anchor that took you to the Dreadnaught is close. You’re going to turn it into our weapon. This is how we avenge Eris. This is how we force these Taken anchors right back down the Dreadnaught’s throat. Head there, and what control I’ve learned over my own blight, I’ll teach to you.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You’ll have to make a path to the anchor. Get to it.
Blighted Eyes appear and the Guardian is afflicted with Suffocating Terror

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: That thing makes me uneasy… I… can’t stand looking at it, even through the feed. Síocháin says it’s radiating corrosive energy like what I tapped into on Titan. Damn… You’ll need to soak in it, but not too much or you’ll die. Remember: focus, control, resolve.

Park it here. Let’s get a look at what we’re dealing with. Okay. We know it’s connected to the Dreadnaught somehow, and it funnels Taken shock troops to corrupt the surface. You’re going to bend that corruption into a feedback loop. Steel your mind. Make your way to the target, and listen to every word I tell you.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I’ve learned that being Taken is all about control. You have to keep the idea of who you are intact, and shrug off anything telling you otherwise. Taken offer themselves, by choice. You will, too, but not fully. You'll extend your hand, and grip their power in your fist util it submits. Remember what you want, will it into truth — just like you do with the Light. Let it temper your resolve. If you can do that, you'll survive. If you can't... then I guess we'll finally know who'd win an arm-wrestling match between us.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Now there’s just the anchor. Stay sharp, and focus your will. Offer the handshake… then shatter their grip with your Light!
The Guardian interacts with the Blight and absorbs it.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: There’s… something else! Fight it! Focus, now hold… and pull back! That’s it. You ripped it out by the roots… and absorbed some of its energy. You’re not blighted like me, but it’s enough to impose your will and use their power. We’ll keep refining, keep tapping into it. For now, you’re ready to hit the Dreadnaught again.

lines.text: These Eliksni seek refuge with House Light. [insect-like chattering] Guard their departure. Variks will be grateful.

The Guardians witness an allied Skiff being held in a containment field. The Guardian tampers with the field generators. Archon Aspirant appears. The Guardian defeats the Archon Aspirant, acquiring field emitter codes and disengaging the emitters. The allied Skiff is released and escapes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Skiff evacuated. Send word to Mithrax — your friends are on their way.
