title: Eliksni Rescue | Broadcast from Fikrul — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to the broadcast from a Shank.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Troubled times, Guardian. You fight well. Every day new survivors come to Misraakskel for protection. But the Scorn come like a tide. They swarm the Reef. They build in secret, using the bones of old ruins. Ketches full of prisoners vanish into the belt. Useful prisoners, yes? Many who might help us, if we retrieve them swiftly. But Variks does not yet know where— Guardian?

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Dead thing. Slayer Baron. Why fight for the Fallen? You and I know the truth. These old names, these stories… so easy to burn away. But you and I survive, again and again, to fight one another. You took Father from me. Just as you took my friends. As you took everything! But you give… new purpose. [laughs] When I am Kell of Kells… I will find a way to hurt you.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Fieldwork: EDZ  — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian collects ivy strands and dead tree bark.
The Guardian drinks experimental tonic and defeats the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Hmm. This tonic is triggering a fight-or-flight response in your endocrine system. We’ll have to try something else. These Earth-based reagents are anemic compared to Old Riis analogs.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Earth is a wasting sphere of rock. Of course its bounty is pitiable in comparison to what we lost.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Earth is a beautiful world. That it still has such bounty in the wake of the Collapse is remarkable! It—

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis may have chosen cold words, but there is truth in them. You know Riis as a story. We remember the taste of Ether in the air.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: And… so does the Apothecary. She shares your perspective — your loss. Even if we find her, she may balk at the idea of working with someone like me. Someone who knows nothing of Old Riis but stories.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: We who saw Riis fall may seem cold. But within, there is more than ice. There is a want for warmth.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Even those of us who knelt to our oppressors remember what we lost. It is important to never lose ourselves again. That is why we hold on so firmly to the past… for the promise of those who will live in a better future. No, the Apothecary will not see the Sol system with your eyes. But she will see you with ours.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Fieldwork: Europa — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Your progress with tonics has been astounding, Slayer Baron. But Fikrul is still at large, and a shadow continues to loom over my father. Crow remains adamant about keeping Eramis confined. I'm worried he's hindering a key source of help for us... At least we have you on the field helping my people. You always manage to find a way out of the dark. House Light and the Vanguard scouts are on Fikrul's trail. I'll let you know when we've found something. Thank you for everything you've taken on for us, Guardian. I have more to ask. We can bolster my tonic research to create more potent mixtures to aid you if you'll help me with the fieldwork to gather resources and lab equipment I'll need. Eramis has also informed me that House Salvation is missing an Apothecary named Ixis in the wake of Fikrul's attacks. If you'll do me the favor of helping to search for her while you're out in the field, I'm sure she could expedite my research. I'll benefit you in this struggle against Fikrul and it may even help my father and his condition.
The Guardian collects a Stasis chunk and a Europan icicle.
The Guardian drinks experimental tonic and completes the Major Fieldwork.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Thank you for providing me with ample data for my research. In return… I wish to share something with you. A recording. Do not ask how I obtained it.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: When do you think my people’s Ether reserves run out? At the rate your Guardians destroy our Servitors, it can’t be long.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Have you seen the effects of Ether starvation? The way our carapace flakes? The way it peels away to expose raw muscle? It is living death. Agony in unsleeping rot.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I’ve seen it. In the Eliksni who refused to kneel to House Salvation and fled across Sol for their lives. You willingly marched your own kind to their deaths in service of a lie. That’s why you’re here. It’s what you have the power to prevent. We’ve both made mistakes we can’t take back. I killed Cayde. I created Fikrul. But I can make it better. I can own those choices and do better by the people I hurt. You can too. Help us find the defectors of House Salvation. They can integrate into the House of Light. They have a chance for a fresh start. Right here, right now.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: There is no future for me. But that does not mean there must be no future for my people. I will rob them of that. [sighs] I will tell you.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Eramis has blood on her hands, and so many ask for blood in return. But her death would not undo any of it. I shared this in the hopes you may see that too. That one life spared could spare a thousand more. Father may call that naive. But I remember the old words: “A docked arm cannot share the weight.”

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Your support is many-armed as always, Guardian! Every success out in the field opens up opportunities to create more tonics or find new lab equipment. House Light and Hunter Vanguard scouts are tracking Fikrul across the Sol System. We've been searching the region in every Eliksni enclave he attacks. I'll let you know when we find something. In the meantime, my people need you on the frontline against the Revenants.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Fieldwork: Nessus — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian collects a Vex alloy and a Nessusian Cactus.
The Guardian drinks experimental tonic and defeats the Vex.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: This isn’t enough. Father would sooner throw himself at Fikrul than listen to me. Give me a chance to heal him. The things he says to me. The thing he’s becoming. Some days I don’t even recognize him. And… and then one day, he’ll just be gone. There is so much at stake. So much to hold in so few hands. Fikrul must be stopped, but if I must pay the price of losing my father to do it I… Thank you, Slayer Baron, for listening to me. Thank you for all that you do to fight in my father’s name. In our people’s name. You are truly of our ketch.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Fieldwork: Neptune — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian drinks experimental tonic and defeats the Cabal.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This is good. I’ll make sure to pass along the data to Eido.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: No, she’s in her lab. I offered to monitor comms. She left, uh, extensive notes.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [chitters thoughtfully] What is your opinion of Eido? Humor Variks, yes?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: She has a lot to learn about the world, but honestly, her naivete allows her to see things people like us miss. She saw the good still in Eramis. She saw the darkness growing in Mithrax.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Yes. Eido sees through unclouded eyes. A good judge of… character.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: There is only so much Variks can build. Any foundation for the future sinks into resentment of the past. House Judgment’s legacy suffers. Variks does not get the Once-Prince’s second chance. Varik’s legacy is forever stained.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: House Judgment deserves a fresh start as well. To see a new world with new eyes. Much as you have become, yes?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Eido is that future. Isn’t she? Have you talked to her about this? Is it even something she wants?

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Variks is old enough to know that what one wants to do and what one needs to do are often… very different things.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Fieldwork: The Moon  — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian drinks experimental tonic and defeats the Hive

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work, Guardian. But if I can’t get these protein chains to synthesize, these experiments may all be for nothing. I’m not good enough. I’m not an apothecary.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: You just need to step away for a little bit. Clear your head.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Thanks. But… I can’t. There’s so much to do.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I get it. Family is important. The thought of losing them can feel… inescapable. The fear sinks bone deep, makes you desperate.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: What would you do? If you were me?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Don’t do what I did. I let a beautiful lie lead me astray. I stopped believing in myself.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: It’s hard to believe in yourself when all you can see are your failures and shortcomings.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Yeah. But we all fail. What matters is how we deal with that failure. Who we choose to be in that moment.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Thank you. I… I think I need to hear that.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Sometimes I need that reminder, too.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Message from Eido — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to Eido’s message.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Guardian, your battles against the Revenants to save Eliksni captives from a fate worse than death… It’s like one of our old fables! I’ve learned so much about our lost homeworld lately. About how Ether flowed through all the plants and animals there. Not just the Eliksni. But for every drop I learn there’s a whole tank-full that was forgotten. That’s why it’s so important we learn from the few survivors, like Variks… and Eramis. I know you and Eramiskel share animosity, as my father would say. But she’s more than a leader, or a fighter, or a criminal. She’s a rare link to the secrets of Old Riis. I encourage you to put aside the past, and let Eramiskel help us. Or we risk making her the last of the Eliksni.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Message from Eramis — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Tell me, Guardian: Is this a gratifying sight, or a frustrating one? You strike me as someone who appreciates finality. Not so your Hunter Vanguard, it seems. I am grateful for one thing: no Salvation Captains share my cell. This remains a private humiliation. Eido claims you will defend both our Houses against Fikrul’s beasts. So, here it is, Slayer Baron: I know of another Salvation outpost. The Eliksni there cut communications shortly before my incarceration. If any yet live, it seems likely they too are under threat. I once believed anything would be preferable to accepting your assistance. I have Fikrul to thank for illuminating me. I hope to demonstrate my gratitude in person before the end.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This is definitely the place, but… it’s weirdly quiet out there. Revenant Scorn have been turning up everywhere. We’ve really got to get a handle on this. If I could just — wait. Is that—

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: We are here. We wait for you.
The Guardian watches Crow speak to Fikrul.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Father… we ever serve and await return.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Look! I inspire. I avenge. For you. Now, we rule, together! I, as Kell; you, King Uldren.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This isn’t — you don’t have to do any of this. Please.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: This is our purpose! Your teachings! To break their Servitors, their lies… their trust in Light.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I’m the one who lied — to you. This is just pointless slaughter — please! You can just stop. You can be more than this. I’ll help you.

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: You… are not him. You are a dead thing, like the others. You wear his face. You steal his voice. Forget his purpose.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It wasn’t a purpose! It was delusion!

lines.speaker: Fikrul
lines.text: Hear me, Father! I will rip this imposter from your bones.
The Guardian frees the unconverted Eliksni from their cages.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: OK, got it. I’m setting up a transmat site. Get that device over there and we can ditch it in orbit.
The Guardian transports the unstable Scorn explosive away.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Explosives taken care of. You did it, Guardian. At least, no one else died today.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: [sighs] Death is all Fikrul believes in. It’s what I taught him to believe in. My faithful acolyte. I thought… I could reach him. One more time. [sighs] Let’s go, Guardian. This is only going to get harder from here on out.
The name of this mission is a reference to the "Nothing Left to Say" mission in Forsaken.

title: Eliksni Rescue | Return to Eido  — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Thank you for following up on Eramis' intel. And thank you for saving as many Eliksni as you did, with Fikrul getting to that enclave first. A Salvation cell had been holed up there, hoping Fikrul would pass them by.
I know you and Crow did your best — I just wish peace had been a possibility. All the more reason to leverage Eramis' help for the good of those still living.
I'll coordinate with Crow to have scout groups searching for Fikrul's base of operations. He must be gathering Revenants somewhere. We'll be in touch.
Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say

title: Eliksni Rescue | Speak with Mithrax — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I greet you in the Light, Slayer Baron. I grow restless in these quarters... Yet here I must remain. You have our faith, Guardian. Mine, and that of my daughter. I do not know Riis as Eramis does, or as my own mother did. I must concern myself with our new home. [growls] Liars. Liars and deceivers, all... The purest light. The darkest hour. The time is at hand, Guardian.
Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say

title: Eliksni Rescue | Tonic Brewing Guide — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian creates their first tonic.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Great work! Now that you're familiar with tonics, let's try something more complicated: batch brewing! This should be enough to brew a few more. Our repurposed Walker should be able to process everything in that bag all at once. Once you're finished here, you may want to stop by the holoprojector. Variks mentioned he'd reach out soon. I hope it's good news.
Eliksni Rescue | Variks at the holoprojector
Eliksni Rescue | Variks at the holoprojector

title: Eliksni Rescue | Variks at the holoprojector — Transcript

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Variks sees… suspicion in the Slayer Baron. Can they trust Variks? Perhaps he still desires to be Kell of Kells, yes? After all, many died to make it so. It is true that Variks wanted power. Not for himself, but for all Eliksni. To build a new home, filled with peace. But Variks lied. To himself, and his people. He was misled by Darkness. And he lost the way of his House. And many terrors were born of his failure. Now Variks is humbled. He remembers, he is not a Kell. He is a Scribe. House Judgement is not the way of fighting or ruling. It is the way of keeping history. Promoting justice. Teaching hatchlings. So Variks will train Eido. And together, Scribes will undo… The many wrongs of Variks, the Loyal.

title: Empire Hunt: The Technocrat — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian begins hunting down Praksis, the Technocrat within Bray Exoscience.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis met Praksis in prison, yes? [wheezes] Each day, they spoke through the walls of their cells, dreaming of a new world. His research gave Eliksni the ability to draw power from the Splinters. [insect-like chattering] Be careful, friend. Kill Praksis, and Eramis will no longer be able to empower her followers with Darkness. [insect-like chattering]
Zedraks-6, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats Zedraks-6.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: Interlopers. Meddlers. Extraneous variables. But perhaps I can make use of you… Your kind make compelling test subjects.
The Guardian enters Bray Exoscience and encounters a Brig.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: Let us run a test. Initiating defense protocol NIIRSAI.
The Guardian destroys the Brig and clear the room of House Salvation forces.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: No, no, no… Troubling. Embarrassing. I must keep this from Eramis… The data must be clean.
The Guardian destroys and evades Praksis's traps.
The Guardian destroys a challenging Servitor.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: This is where your Golden Age Kell built his machines, hmm? Trivial tinkering. I will elevate it…
If the player is an Exo

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: This is where your Golden Age Kell built you, hmm? Trivial tinkering. I will elevate it…

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Is it stranger to see this place, Guardian? [wheezes] Eliksni are haunted by what we have lost — but we are not forced to walk the ruins of our former life, as you are. [insect-like chattering]
The Guardian continues to destroy and evade Praksis's traps. The Guardian confronts Praksis.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: The others did not come this far. You are an outlier. Aberrant. But I can account for you.

Praksis’s shield generator comes online. The Guardian destroys Praksis’s shield generator. Praksis retreats. The Guardian pursues Praksis and discovers Cruxes of Darkness in the area. Praksis arrives on a shank and activates a barrier.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: Eramis does not permit errors, so I will not fail.
The Guardian weakens Praksis. Praksis's shield generators come online.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: This is all the Machine gave you? Ha ha!
The Guardian destroys Praksis's shield generators. The Guardian weakens Praksis. Praksis's shield generators come online.
The Guardian destroys Praksis's shield generators. The Guardian weakens Praksis. Praksis's shield generators come online.

lines.speaker: Praksis
lines.text: Let me see your tiny Servitor. I will take it apart, like the others…
The Guardian destroys Praksis's shield generators. Praksis is shielded by Stasis. The Darkness beckons… and the Guardian becomes empowered with Stasis. The Guardian defeats Praksis, the Technocrat.
The Guardian acquires Praksis's Splinter of Darkness.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks, Praksis is down. We're finishing up here.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Good. Without Phylaks and Praksis, Eramis will grow reckless. [insect-like chattering] Careless. Without her council, she is weak. She will struggle to control this new Dark power. [insect-like chattering]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Perfect time for us to strike. Guardian, we should get back to camp with this Splinter. The Stranger will be waiting.
Eramis meets with Kridis and Atraks.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Praksis and Phylaks are dead. We must retaliate! Atraks. Kridis and I can handle this. Return to the Crypt and prepare the body.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: Eramis. We must take pause. These powers are not what we expected. I, too, am impatient. But there is wisdom in caution.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: [grunts] Caution? Look what caution has earned us. Our enemy exploits our weakness. I will give these Guardians the destruction they crave.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Eliksni Rescue | Variks at the holoprojector

title: Empire Hunt: Dark Priestess — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian hunts down Kridis, Dark Priestess.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis wished to destroy gods… but Kridis simply chose another. She craves not power, but meaning. And she seeks it in Darkness.
The Guardian searches for Kridis, defeating the Fallen which they encounter. A barrier blocking a corridor disappears. The Guardian heads into the corridor.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: My people… your Kell sleeps, but she is not dead. The Darkness brings another gift: the means to rouse her from her slumber.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: Eramiskel has not left you. Eramiskel has just begun. Eramiskel will return in a storm of blood and ice.
The Guardian continues to search for Kridis, defeating the Fallen and the Vex which they encounter.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: In her slumber, Eramiskel seeks greater knowledge from the Darkness. She pledges herself to its mysteries. She journeys through its glorious depths. And she will return not as Kell, but as a god.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: The Darkness sends visions of Eramiskel. It names me her escort out of the deep… back to you. Her people. Her faithful.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: If Kridis speaks true… if she has found a way to bring Eramiskel — ah… To bring Eramis back to life…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're not gonna let that happen.

The Guardian continues to search for Kridis, defeating the Fallen which they encounter. The Guardian enters Eramis' command room. Yamiks Prime, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats Yamiks Prime, House Salvation.
The Guardian heads to the platform outside the command room. Kridis, Dark Priestess appears. The Guardian approaches Kridis and the frozen statue of Eramis.

lines.speaker: Kridis
lines.text: Welcome, spawn of the Traitor Machine. Have you come to witness the rise of a god?
The Guardian defeats Kridis, Dark Priestess and claims Kridis' Splinter of Darkness.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: She's down, Variks. It's over. That's… all of them. All of Eramis' lieutenants. Her entire council.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: The reign of the Kell of Darkness is ended. [insect-like chattering] Thanks to the Guardian. But in death, Eramis becomes myth. Immortal. [insect-like chattering] Her legacy will go on. New champions will rise in her name. We must stay always vigilant. [insect-like chattering]
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Eliksni Rescue | Variks at the holoprojector

title: Empire Hunt: The Warrior — Transcript

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Phylaks found fame at Twilight Gap, yes? [insect-like chattering] Fame for ruthlessness. For final deaths. For Phylaks, there is no greater joy than battle. You must challenge her, but use caution, Guardian.
The Guardian finds the Vex and House Salvation Fallen fighting each other. Riliks, House Salvation appears. Abstract Hydra appears. The Guardian defeats all Fallen and Vex in the area.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: They say you are a great warrior.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: And you have challenged Eramiskel once before.
If you completed the Rise of Iron Campaign in D1
If you completed the Taken King Campaign in D1

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: But I think you are built with machine-weakness. God-dependence. You flee from battles you think you will lose. Prove you are worth my time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What did Phylaks mean by "god dependence"? The Traveler? I don't feel dependent on or limited by the Traveler. I feel close to the Traveler. Protected. Or… I did. Since you got that Splinter… I feel further away than ever.
Principle Wyvern appears. The Guardian defeats all Vex and Fallen. The Guardian disables the Vex barrier and proceeds forward.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: What drives you, Machine-spawn? Do you fight for glory? For power? My Eliksni fight for the fight itself. There is nothing beyond it. Let me teach you this lesson.
Deniks, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats Deniks and the surrounding Fallen. Heavy Shank, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats the Heavy Shank and disabled the Fallen barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've never seen the Fallen's military forces so… organized.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: For many years, Eliksni lived scattered, yes? [insect-like chattering] Eramis took our broken Houses and forged an army.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And she wants to give that army Stasis. If they ever came for the Last City…
Two Harbinger Wyverns appear. The Guardian defeats the Harbinger Wyverns including surrounding Vex and Fallen, and disabled the Vex barriers.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: I see now you are a worthy challenge. A chance to hone my blade. Come find me, Machine-spawn. I am waiting.
The Guardian descends into the next area. Brig, House Salvation appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Another one of those giant mechs.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Technology taken from the Kell's Scourge. Another splintered house, united under Eramis.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: I will bring your corpse to Eramiskel. I will forge myself a ring from your armor.
The Guardian weakens Phylaks and Phylaks retreats to the next platform.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: Surprising strength for such a little creature!
The Guardian weakens Phylaks and Phylaks retreats to the final platform.

lines.speaker: Phylaks
lines.text: Your skill will earn you a quick death!
A Crux of Darkness appears. The Darkness beckons… the Guardian becomes empowered with Stasis. The Guardian defeats Phylaks, the Warrior.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Her soldiers will scatter. But there are other powerful Eliksni that will stand in your path. [insect-like chattering]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Destroying the general doesn't destroy the army. But this is a start, at least. Let's get that Splinter back to camp.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Parts Long Lost, A Moment In Time

title: Enemy of My Enemy — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Oryx could be anywhere on the Dreadnaught. With time, we could find him, but we don't have time. The Cabal have been there long enough to have real field intelligence. The path to Oryx lies on their ship.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Cabal are still holding out. Multiple survivors.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Survival's a temporary condition. Cut through them, and get inside their ship.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Who fights this hard to protect a crashed ship?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: That's not a crash site, it's a beachhead. Only way those doors will open is to send reinforcements. Draw them out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think you got their attention.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: When those doors open, fight through it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Cabal protocol is to detonate any ship that crashes. If they haven't after all this time it must be a base of operations. They're looking for something on the Dreadnaught. See what they know about Oryx.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh nice! There's a terminal nearby. It should have the info we're looking for.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Cabal have located Oryx. He's protected in the center of the Dreadnaught, reachable only through something they call 'a rupture'...

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Must be some kind of portal. Have the Cabal found one?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They've got a team heading for it right now.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Then I suggest you get there first.
The Cabal, lead by Valus Ta'aun, battle with Taken

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We found the Cabal team headed for the rupture. They're outnumbered by Taken.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Forget what they say about "the enemy of my enemy". Something stands between you and the rupture, put it down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those Cabal won't last much longer.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Let him take all he wants. He won't be around long enough for it to matter.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Toland spoke of statues the Hive use to navigate ruptures.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'll see if it's still active.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's linked to the rupture but I can't understand how the Hive control it. Let's try another statue.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes, the statues control where the rupture leads. They could deliver us to Oryx!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's dead, but something's happening at the rupture.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Thrall will smother your Light! Do not underestimate them as Tarlowe did!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Forget about the Thrall, get through that rupture.
The rupture pushes the Guardian back, preventing access

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think we're going that way.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then it's true, only the Ascendant can will a rupture to open.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's something Ascendant passing through right now...
An Echo of Oryx emerges from the rupture
The Guardian defeats the Echo of Oryx

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It will only open for Ascendant Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then how do we reach Oryx?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We'll sort this out, Guardian. Head back to the Tower when you can.

title: Entropy's Pinnacle — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The search to root out the Taken on Venus has led us to some dark places. None are darker than the heart of the Vex. If my information is correct, the blight now curls around the heart of their Citadel. This must not stand.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The assault on the House of Wolves gave us detailed information about the Citadel spire. By all indications, the heart of the blight is there at the top of the tower. Good luck, Guardian. May your path through the Darkness lead you to the Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The roots of the Citadel go deep into the heart of the planet. The spire is the metal trunk of a very, very big tree. Sort of.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Remember Skolas? Crazy Kell, angry Fallen? Can we go back to that? I prefer them to the Taken any day.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They were trying to knock us off that platform! Oh, the Taken really are insufferable.
Guardian approaches blight atop the Citadel
Guardian retaliates, Echo of Oryx is killed

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: You sent Oryx screaming back to the Ascendant realm, and still his Echoes stain our system. That is why you are here, Guardian. Only you are strong enough to stand against the terrors in the night.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These coordinates put the Gate to the Black Garden near the lost City of Freehold. It's been buried in the sands since the Collapse. Now, the Cabal occupy the area, and most of Mars. No one gets through their Exclusion Zone.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great. The Gate to the Black Garden is miles from here and the Cabal got a lock on Orbital communication. If you want your Sparrow, we're going to have to break into one of their bunkers and disable the system.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here's what I have on the Cabal: 800 pounds and highly militarized. They blow up planets and moons just for getting in their way. Just so you know what we're dealing with.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're inside. My Advice, we avoid engagement until we understand them better.
Scanning for something linked to their orbital grids.

lines.text: Access key? I don't need an access key. DOS is more complicated.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, there's a cloaked Fallen in your vicinity. Neutralise it, we need to confirm a theory.
Guardian finds and neutralises cloaked Fallen. It drops a 'Scout Report'

lines.text: We found something on the body. These are coordinates to the Exodus Black!

title: Eye of a Gate Lord — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The more we learn about the Vex, the more I understand why our Exo friend is so worried about them. During the Collapse, the Vex transformed the planet Mercury into a machine in days. They would have spread to every planet if The Traveler hadn't stopped them. We need to get into the Black Garden. We need a Gate Lord's head.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: First thing we're going to have to do is get me into the Vex network so I can lure out a Gate Lord. I'll lead the way.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here's what we have on Gate Lords: "Three stories tall. Protect the realms the Vex keep locked out of time." Time? That can't be right.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up a heavy conflux nearby. I can use it to get into their network.
The Guardian approaches the conflux and deploys the Ghost to scan it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And I thought you had the hard job.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, we've got to head for a place called the Endless Steps. That's where we'll find the Gate Lord.
The Guardian proceeds through Waking Ruins and approaches Campus 9.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: To find the Gate Lord, I sort of had to mess with all their transfer gates here. You're probably going to have your hands full.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Gates are waking. They'll keep coming unless you can shut them down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You've got to destroy the Gates!
Following Ghost's command, The Guardian destroys a Gate.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And that is where we'll find the Gate Lord. Let's go.
The Guardian clears out all of the Vex at the top of the steps.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I guess you're going to have to step inside the ring.
The Guardian stands on the sync plate for a few seconds.
Zydron, Gate Lord appears. The Guardian battles the Vex and destroys Zydron, Gate Lord.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nice work! This better get us into the Black Garden. Let's go get our key from the Queen.

title: Expunge: Delphi — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: This is it, Guardian. Payback for the Dreaming City. For our city. For everyone.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Quria has shielded itself in multiple layers of the domain. It hides, a festering rot deep within the core of this network. Savathûn's eye is upon us now. I can feel her. It is as if this moment was unavoidable... fated. But you have shown me there is only the destiny we make for ourselves, nothing more. Go, Guardian. Walk in the Light.
The Guardian delves deeper into the Vex Domain, avoiding countermeasures in the environment as they proceed. The Guardian goes through a Vex portal which they encounter.
The Guardian is transported to the location of the Labyrinth Expunge mission in its corrupted state.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Quria has retreated within layers of security mirroring domains you have previously collapsed.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The challenges you face here are the very ones you faced as you honed your Splicer powers. You are ready for this. Our hopes rest on you.
The Guardian traverses the Vex domain, defeating the Vex and Taken they encounter, then enters a portal.
The Guardian is transported to the location of the Styx Expunge mission in its corrupted state.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Quria rages against your presence. I can feel the sickening rot of the Taken's power shuddering through this domain. The Vex, too, struggle against the yoke of oppression laid on them by Quria.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Our enemy hides behind others and uses them as pawns! Does their cowardice know no end?!
The Guardian continues into the Vex domain, defeating Vex and Taken. The Guardian obtains an Authentication Key, and deposits it to activate a Vex portal. The Guardian goes through the portal.
The Guardian is transported to the location of the Tartarus Expunge mission in its corrupted state.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Not much longer now, Guardian! We are all here; we believe in you!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Quria is close. The Taken corruption in this Vex domain is deep. I can feel its infection through their systems: fingers of darkness grasping. Searching. Be careful, Guardian.

The Guardian continues into the Vex domain, and encounters a pair of Vex barriers powered by protected Vex Lenses. The Guardian defeats Taken and uses Stabilized Security Access to destroy the Vex Lenses, disabling the barriers. The Guardian enters a Vex portal.
The Guardian is transported to the lair of Quria, Blade Transform. Quria, Blade Transform lies in the center of a large circular arena, and awakens.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Quria, Blade Transform. The Dreaming Mind.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Guardian! This is it! Fight with everything you have!

Quria, Blade Transform summons Taken and Vex which attack the Guardian. The Guardian defeats the Vex and Taken, and damages Quria, Blade Transform. Quria, Blade Transform shields itself and summons a Nexus Minotaur and an Evaluator of Savathûn. The Guardian deposits Authentication Keys to lower their shields and defeats the Nexus Minotaur and Evaluator of Savathûn Quria. Quria, Blade Transform becomes vulnerable. The Guardian defeats Quria, Blade Transform, which explodes and crashes to the ground.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: A great evil, vanquished. A deed of legends.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Haha! I knew it! I knew we could do this! Congratulations, Guardian! This victory, it is monumental!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Let's not uncork every bottle of champagne in the City just yet.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Osiris is right. This is a monumental victory for humanity... and Eliksni. But it's a battle, not the war.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Even so... victories should be cherished.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Yes! Mithrax is correct. We will have a party. A celebration! A small one. Respectful. Very classy. I will wear suit.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Extraction Protocol: Introduction — Transcript

lines.text: Ana, Osiris, an Eliksni, and an Exo Frame are in the Wing of the Seraph. Ana observes the engram containing Rasputin and Osiris paces behind her.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Savathûn couldn't conceal every thought. Some I stole. One of Neptune. The Collapse. A turning point. It's a... it's a blur I cannot focus.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: (to the Eliksni) Pass me the wrench?
The Eliskni passes Ana the wrench.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Hidden found nothing there, but I saw it, through the Witch Queen's eyes. A city set against the waves.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: [huffs] Ikora thinks I need to rest... hmph! The gall! You've really made no progress while I was indisposed?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Is that why you're here, Osiris?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Wonder where she got that from. [sighs] Red's scrambled in there. Degrading. He's dying.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Warmind is our greatest bastion of Golden Age data. I need what it knows.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I've tried everything! I— I can't even access his protocols!

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Osiris? That man... no. Clovis Bray is... is a maniac. A selfish, murderous monster.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: So was Rasputin. But it might be the only option I have left. Just as Clovis... might be yours. When did hope cease to require risk?

title: Extraction Protocol: Speak to Clovis — Transcript

lines.text: After retrieving the AI of Clovis Bray I from Europa, the Guardian returns to the Exo Frame in the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray
lines.text: Hmm. A crude, incomplete shell. Still, I must admit that its storage capacity vastly exceeds that of a standard Exo frame. It will have to do for now. These "Wrathborn" present a far more pressing concern. If they can seize control of Warmind technology… …Then it stands to reason that the Warsats are their ultimate goal. We must secure the Warsat network ourselves before it's too late. Rebuilding the Warmind is now humanity's top priority. Rasputin was designed to partition itself into "subminds" as a resiliency measure. In the event of a catastrophic failure, reintegrating them into the AI core would repair the broken Warmind. Most of the facilities housing those subminds are now defunct. A scant few remain, but the Wrathborn have likely fortified their locations. Infiltrate said facilities. Retrieve the submind data from the vaults within. With the subminds in hand, we can upload Rasputin to the Warsat network onboard its orbital hub. I am aware that Anastasia does not hold a high opinion of me. But let it not be said that I left humanity to… fend for itself.

title: Fear's Embrace — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The assault on Phobos was the opening salvo in this war. We believe now it was a trial, the first full-scale use of Taken power in this system. The Warlocks see it as a place of power. The Echo must as well.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I see this Echo as a strategist. It moved to capture the Black Garden, now a push on Phobos. End it, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're back. This war against the Taken began here. Let's end it here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian, this room is crawling with blight. And I'm detecting poison gas in the vents. Oh, and the Cabal flame jets are primed to fire. So... yes. You've got this...you...

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Your first mission to Phobos ended with a flight for freedom. Now, you leave that moon with a decisive victory over the Taken.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Festival of the Lost… Sector — Transcript

lines.text: Hangar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hey, friend. Hell of a year, huh? Lot of us still haven't gotten over the Red War. But the Infinite Forest was saved, Rasputin came back… things were just startin' to look up. And then… Cayde. Still can't believe that SOB's gone. So much I didn't get a chance to… Well, I'll be damned if we're gonna sit around and mope all day. He woulda hated that. So let's have some fun, huh? I'll try to keep everyone's spirits up back here. You put this on. Go show the bad guys they can't keep us down.
The Guardian heads towards the Sanctum of Bones lost sector.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Lockin' down your coordinates. Ooh, the Sanctum of Bones, huh? [laugh] Way to get into the holiday spirit. I remember Asher sayin' there's a nest o' Taken in there. Hoo, even more creepy. I love it! Anyway, get in there and show 'em what's what.

The Guardian defeats the Taken and the Vex, and destroys a Cyclops. The Guardian collects a Simulation Seed from the destroyed Cyclops. A wave of Vex and The Impregnable Nightmare appear. The Guardian defeats The Impregnable Nightmare. The Nightmare, Dreaming appears, then escapes.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That sounded like a lot o' shootin' and then somethin' weird. Same kind of signal we used to get off you when you were runnin' around Mercury. Do me a favor. Go hit the other Lost Sector nearby. And check in with me before you go inside, 'kay?
The Guardian heads towards the Aphix Conduit lost sector.

The Guardian defeats the Taken and the Vex. The Impregnable Nightmare appears. The Guardian defeats The Impregnable Nightmare. The Guardian destroys a Cyclops and collects a Simulation Seed from the destroyed Cyclops. The Nightmare, Dreaming appears. The Guardian defeats The Nightmare, Dreaming.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Yep, I saw what you saw. That cinches it. This is worse than regular weird: it's Vex weird and Taken weird. Get back here when you can. We gotta figure this out.
Hangar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Welcome back. Ikora stopped by while you were in flight. She sure don't miss a thing. She says there's somethin' up with the Infinite Forest. But our old buddy Osiris isn't pickin' up when we call. I told her you were wearin' masks and gettin' into trouble on Io and she laughed! Ikora! I couldn't believe it. Guess the only thing to do now is what you been doin'. Put your mask back on, head to the Forest, and see what happens. Oh, and our comms don't work in there, so you're on your own. Watch yourself, all right?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Field Assignment: Active Duty - Anchor of Light, Near Ketch — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds Toland by the Fallen Ketch.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: The pirates came in the wake of our Collapse to pick at our bones. I have no answers as to whether it was bravery or desperation that drove them to scavenge at the edge of the Hive’s most hallowed ground. But the Hellmouth has been rich in its bounty. And many Fallen crews made a name among the old Houses for the treasures stolen from this dead rock.

title: Final Wish - Conjure Riven — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Guardian, my Techeuns are preparing a spell to conjure Riven's spirit, so that she can grant Savathûn's wish. However, the Vex of the Sol Divisive have laid siege to the Keep of Voices in an attempt to halt our efforts. I must call upon you to defend the Dreaming City once again. Petra and Crow will guide your path.
Keep of Voices, The Dreaming City

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Apologies for not rolling out the red carpet. I've been... preoccupied.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Haven't we all? What's our situation?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Techeuns evacuated the Keep with Riven's Heart. The Vex have since fortified their position.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Then let's cut them down, and take back what's ours.
The Guardian opens the Vex gate.
Hall of Two Souls, The Dreaming City

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: A good start, but there are more Vex gathered around Riven's remains. The Techeuns need a fragment of those remains to cast their spell.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: A spell to conjure Riven's spirit. Are you sure about this, Petra?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm sure that I trust my queen's judgment.
The Guardian breaks through more Vex fortifications.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Time to visit Riven's corpse. A shame I wasn't around to see the killing blow.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: We never should have done it. She set a trap, and we — I — walked right into it. My desire for vengeance blinded me to her schemes.
The Guardian approaches Riven's corpse. Several Sol Divisive Vex are knelt down in worship to her.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Whatever they're doing, you'd better put a stop to it.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That got their attention. Don't let them near Riven!
The Guardian clears the Vex reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That's the last of them. Retrieve the fragment and bring it to the chamber. I'll hail Queen Mara.
The Guardian collects Riven's tooth and returns it to the Techeuns.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Well done, Guardian. Deliver what my Techeuns require and they will open a portal to the Wall of Wishes, as they begin to conjure Riven.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Your Deepsight will Savathûn wish. Once Riven grants it, we can at last pursue the Witness.
The Guardian jumps through the Awoken portal.
Tower of Opened Eyes, The Dreaming City
The Guardian fires at the wish wall, changing the symbols to a new one, an Ahamkara skull.
The Guardian wishes for a new pathway.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Hear me, Riven! Savathûn's final wish, inscribed in secrecy, has been invoked by the Guardian! Grant it now, and feast upon the difference between desire and reality!

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Such a long slumber. Such a rude awakening. Grant the Witch Queen's final wish, you say? I... refuse.
Eliksni Rescue | Something Left to Say

title: Final Wish - Speak with Mara — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I knew there would be a cost in bargaining with Riven. I did not intend it to be a cost we kept paying, all these years later. But now, the Witch Queen's scrolls have confirmed my greatest fear — the curse on the Dreaming City cannot be undone. I've pored over a thousand possibilities, but the Corsair souls trapped there remain. I won't give up on them. Even with the curse in place, there must be a way to bring my people home... a task for tomorrow, perhaps. All this pain Riven has inflicted, and still, we're beholden to her. There must be alternatives to restoring her clutch. The resurgence of the Ahamkara now, Taken or not, could be disastrous. The Reef and the Last City went to war to stop them before. For now, above all else, we must pursue the Witness. I need an operative to finish this bargain with Riven, force her to enact the final wish. So while I ponder countermeasures, you do what you do best... carve a path.
Grave Robber | Eido at the Holoprojector

title: First Contact — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm checking our location. We've hitched a ride to the outer giants—Neptune orbit. Osiris was right. The Witness sent Calus after something hidden here.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian. I did not anticipate a fellow stowaway. Calus is after an artifact on Neptune, the Veil. I'm working on a plan to stop him. For now, find your way through that ship.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That Pyramid resonance is shielding the Cabal. Another weapon from the Witness!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: My faithful Shadow Legion, this is your glorious emperor speaking. Our alliance with the Witness bears such "delectable" fruits. [chuckles] Together, we will devour Sol!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Stay vigilant. With the Witness's backing, they could throw anything at us.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Forward fleet, prepare for descent! Bring glory to the Herald of the Witness!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Shadow Legion is one step ahead of us. Any damage we can inflict on the Cabal fleet will buy us time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We should regroup as soon as possible… but maybe we can disable the ship's computer core.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I've located a terminal here and sent you their ship layouts.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just received it. Locating now… Got it! We're not far from the core.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need a way in there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That Cabal had a keycard. It should get us through that door.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can't help but feel like we should have stayed behind to protect the Traveler and our people. Was it the right choice to follow Osiris?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If the Witness establishes a link with the Veil, it'll be over for the entire system. All of our losses would have been for naught. We have never faced a threat of this magnitude. Even if you stayed, you wouldn't have stood a chance against the Witness. None of us would. This is our only hope to survive the Witness.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The fruits of an unholy alliance between the Witness and Calus. I fear they'll have more surprises in store.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This keycard lets us access the computer core. Let's head there now.
Not sure which directive to pick

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is the core for the entire ship: communications, navigation, deployment…

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I'm relaying my position to you. Make your way to this ship.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need some way to get to the surface.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I believe I have a method to accomplish that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Did I detect a bit of hesitation in your voice?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No! My impromptu stratagems have a high rate of success! …Just get here quickly.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look, down there! Calus's flagship! He's heading right for the surface!

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Oh, is that you, my tenacious little Guardian? What do you think of my Shadow Legion? [cackles] Revel in these hollow victories. I want you in the best of spirits when we meet in the arena.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have to get to Osiris quick. He's used to getting things done his own way. Seems like he hasn't changed, even after… Now he only has us to watch his back. Hopefully he hasn't gone off the deep end.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Okay. Here's the plan. Destroy the engine.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Of this ship? The one we're on?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Crazy or not, we need to stop this invasion. I'll do whatever it takes to stop the Witness, so if you aren't going to help me, then leave me alone.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, we've blown up the engines! Ship's losing altitude!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Rendezvous at the escape pods, posthaste!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just between us, I'm not a big fan of Osiris's escape pod plan. Even for him, this is pretty touch and go.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I'm almost at the escape pods. Where are you?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're being sealed off! Have to find another way.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is… Neptune? There's a whole city here. An entire civilization! I've got a ping on Osiris's coordinates. Let's find him.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: You on the road. Identify yourself. Are you with the invaders?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're Guardians, from the Last City.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're fighting the same enemy. We're here to find something called "the Veil."

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Nimbus and I are a little pinned down right now, but we'll be there soon.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: [sounds of combat] Where are these ugly things coming from?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We always thought we were the last ones left. Wait until the Vanguard hears about this! No time for that now. If we don't stop the Shadow Legion, there won't be any city left!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, I'm up here! I think the Cabal know I'm here.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Hello? What's going on out there?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Osiris, I'm detecting an anomaly on my sensors. We'll check it out while the coast is clear.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Understood. I will patiently note that it is quite confined in here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This energy source—this is incredible! You can wield it!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I could use a hand over here!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Your body can't handle this much power! Your vital signs are in the red!

title: First Contact Intro — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian jumps from their ship onto the surface of the Cabal cruiser, Vaul Guadium

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Guardian, help Osiris reach the Veil before Calus does. And please, stay close to him. He doesn't have any life to spare.
The ship begins to launch and the Guardian rips open a hatch and climbs into the interior.

title: Fist of Crota — Transcript

lines.text: Opening to The Fist of Crota

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We went to the Moon seeking vengeance, but it found us first. Crota, the Son of Oryx. We’d never faced anything like him. In the end, only I was left. Crota and his armies destroyed our Moon. If we don’t stop them, I fear Earth will suffer the same fate.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sardon commands the Hive spawn on Earth. Search the Grotto, find this monster and see to his end.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sardon is the first of Crota’s disciples. His army helped shatter the Moon and claim it for his master. His presence here is a sign. The Hive are preparing to wake Crota’s soul.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I survived for years in the tunnels under the Moon, using the shadows as the Hive do. Keep your eyes open.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Now that Sardon has fallen, come see me. There is more to do. The rest of Crota’s disciples will not cease until Earth is ready for their master’s return.

title: Fury — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: As we all know, Zavala plans to attack the Almighty.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Typical Titan idiocy. I'm sure he thought, "Ah, Ghaul has a sun-destroyer? I don't need a plan! I'll simply headbutt it!"

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: It's desperation, Asher. Zavala has forgotten he might die his final death. Head toward the heart of the energy mining operation, Guardian. We'll use a Warmind, part of an interplanetary defense network, to scan the Almighty.
The Guardian comes across Vex and Taken fighting

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Pay them no heed, assistant. You and I can deal with them later.
The Guardian heads into the Cabal mining facility.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora, we found another drill. This one's big. Really big.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Good. That drill pierced an entrance to the Warmind Vault. The scanner's inside.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Gotcha. Let's find the drill controls and get it out of the way.
The Guardian interacts with a terminal

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got the power going, but the drill is still in our way.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ha! What a gloriously irritating commitment to safety standards.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: There has to be a manual override somewhere in that base.
The Guardian heads for the Cabal base.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: I find it incredible that those myopic Red Legion ignorami did not realise they were drilling directly into a Warmind Vault.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: I'm detecting a spike in paracausal energy. Sterile neutrino particles have quintupled.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: He means watch out for the Taken. You should hire a translator, Asher.
The Guardian battles their way through Taken

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nice work. Let's find that override.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we've got the drill going.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Good! Return to the drill site and get into the Warmind Vault. I am eager to discredit Vuvuzela's plan to attack the Almighty.
The Guardian navigated their way back out of the base.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, uh… Are we going to see Rasputin? Or is this some other Warmind?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: There is only one Warmind, but Rasputin is not here on Io. I believe he's been marooned on Earth ever since his network fragmented.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: What? Lift it up, before it collapses the Warmind Vault!
The Guardian lifts up the drill

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ha — finally! Let's get down to the vault
The Guardian drops down to a vault tunnel exposed by the Cabal drill

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: This will be rich. I will ask Zavala, "Can you tell me, in zettajoules, the Almighty's expected destructive capacity?". And he will say, "No, Asher. I cannot, because I am a reckless fool!".

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Ignore Asher. Find the Warmind, reconnect it to the network, and we'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Reconnecting to the Warmind network to begin a remote scan…

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Yes, we can see the connection coming online.
The Guardian destroys Modular Upsilon and its support Modular Sigma's shield generating Taken.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Poorly. The Almighty is inextricably bound to the harmonic resonance of the sun's magnetic flux tubes.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If Zavala blows up the Almighty, it'll take the sun with it. It's time I rejoined my fireteam.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Tell me again, Speaker. What makes your Guardians worthy of the Light? What is the price for such power and immortality?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Devotion inspires bravery. Bravery inspires sacrifice. Sacrifice… leads to death. So… feel free to kill yourself.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Hmm. Devotion. Sacrifice. I was born an outcast. A runt. As is custom with the Cabal, I was cast aside and left for dead. I was taken in by an old scholar, himself disgraced, who saw in me something… redeemable. He raised me. Taught me. Trained me. And in return, I would become a vehicle for his revenge, against an empire that failed him, that failed itself. Rejection, ridicule, torment… It made me stronger. I gave everything to win not just acceptance, but glory. Beneath my mask, Speaker, is the face of devotion and sacrifice. I will not take the Light by force. To do so would be to admit failure, and I never fail! Now, do you see why I would be chosen?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I see now. I see all that you have done.

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: Our operation on the Jovian moon was a success. Once the cage is complete… we will have everything we need to begin the process of extracting the Light. Dominus. Everything we've worked for is here for the taking! All that remains is your word.

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: No. This is not the way, old friend…

lines.speaker: Consul
lines.text: But it is the way! The only way.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They take us for fools. The artifact you brought back from the Pyramid began emitting a signal. One that reaches deep into… the Black Garden. Once again, we are beckoned into their trap. They expect us to follow the signal. To discover where it leads. Fine. We will play their games. But this time, with caution… not curiosity.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

My only regret is that I will not live to see his triumph.

title: Ahamkara Tales - Shaxx & Mara (Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian turns on the radio.

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Queen Mara. I hail you now out of necessity of the heart. Else, I feel as though I will burst into Solar flame. Long have I admired you from afar, ever since you graced me with your power and benevolence in The Reef Wars. Not a day goes by without me thinking back to the time you bade me repay that debt to you. How we spent hours together, long into the night. Would that you spirit me to your side again, to serve as your consort, your knight, your humble vassal. Anything to be near you. I beg you to grant me an audience once more. Please, give me the gift and the privilege of basking in your favor. For without you, I shall wither and crumble into dust, to be scattered across the cosmic winds.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: This again? You and I both know he sounds nothing like that, Riven.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: [laughs cruelly] Perhaps I should use a voice with which you are even more intimately familiar. How about—

title: Ghost in the Machine I: Amanda and Crow — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: This isn't — this is not a good time.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: It's NEVER a good time. I've been trying to talk to you for weeks, and you keep dodging me!

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: How long did you know? How long have you known who you were?

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: We're done. We're — done here. I do not have time for this. For you. For anything.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Wait! I was scared. I am scared. People used to kill me. Kill me for— for something I didn't— You don't understand!

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: I cared about you, and you lied to me. You wore that mask, you kept secrets from me, pretended to be my friend.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: No. You're not. I had a friend, and you murdered him.

title: Antiquarian II: Return the Second Relic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Your last raid yielded a surprising fragment of intel. This was found in the pirate hideout, along with the relic.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: You forget your place, Iriks. I am no longer the Shipstealer. I am a Kell, and your obedience is my right. Deliver the relic as agreed, and I will overlook your attempts to extort me. Do it, or face the wrath of a power you cannot imagine.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I believe Eramiskel references the Witness. Perhaps she really has abandoned her calls for Eliksni unity.

title: Ghost in the Machine II: Caiatl — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Per our arrangement, I am delivering a status report on the Imperial survey of the Leviathan. Our scouts confirm your reports of psychic anomalies emanating from the red phantoms seen throughout the ship. Psion opti theorize that these phantoms are manifestations forged from a psychic "background radiation" permeating the Leviathan. Darkness. Navigational equipment shows that the Leviathan entered a gravitational anomaly and… It was at once within and outside of the known universe for an indeterminate period of time. When it emerged from this state, most of its crew were missing, and an infestation of unknown fungal matter had infiltrated all decks of the ship. Command structure appears to have broken down. Loyalists who emerged from the anomaly disembarked from the Leviathan. We are attempting to determine their location. Those currently aboard are newly grown, combat-ready clones that have no higher brain function. They operate as an extension of my father's will. At Valus Forge's suggestion, I have submitted a recommendation for Crow to participate in a joint investigation to supplement our own. It is my hope that together, we can tear into the beating heart of the Leviathan, and drag my father screaming into the light of your sun. Until such a time, we are Cabal. We eat the mountains; we drink the seas.

title: Beneath the Waves: Distress signal on Titan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: This is a Priority 1 rescue operation. We have received a distress call on a secure Vanguard channel. The target of extraction is Deputy Commander Sloane. She was last seen on Titan before it vanished, during the arrival of the Pyramids. Our job is to triangulate where the distress signal is coming from, find the deputy commander, and get her out. I know what you may be thinking. But Sloane is one of the most tenacious, resilient soldiers I've ever known. If anyone could have survived this… it's her.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Guardian has landed. I'm at our old LZ; no sign of Sloane or enemy activity. Extraction team, what's your status?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Commander, I am at the Tidal Anchor not far from your position. It is abandoned—quiet. Distress signal is weak.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I've established a beachhead inside the New Pacific Arcology; no sign of the Hive. Signal strength is weak here as well.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, you need to cross the rig to align a communications dish so we can triangulate Sloane's position. Keep comms open—we don't know what happened here.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Taken! I've got multiple Taken engagements on my position!

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: [grunts] They are on me as well!

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Confirmed ten Taken contacts in the New Pacific Arcology. Iron War Beasts are engaging.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Tidal Anchor is secure; the Taken are gone.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, gang! Heard there was a party, and I thought I'd pop on by and see what the fuss is all about.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: This is a rescue mission for Deputy Commander Sloane—get off the line.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Oh, great! She owes me a drink.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: We have more Taken incoming! Falling back to the Arcology Solarium.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I AM THE MOUNTAIN UPON WHICH ALL SWORDS SHATTER! HONE YOUR EDGE AGAINST ME!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I AM THE HAND AROUND YOUR THROAT. I AM THE LAST BREATH IN YOUR MOUTH. YOU CANNOT ESCAPE ME.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: More Taken! They're coming up from the methane flush! I'm holding position!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I REMEMBER SAGIRA SHATTERING. SHE WAS WORTHY OF DEATH. OSIRIS WAS NOT. ARE YOU SO FRAGILE?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: [screams in rage] Show yourself! Fight me! I will tear you apart with my bare hands!

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: That voice we heard… it was Xivu Arath! I'd only heard her voice in audio logs from the fall of the Cabal homeworld. There's no mistaking her. She must be near; we need to be careful. Her influence has never been this strong.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We need to find Sloane and get her out of here, now. You're almost at the array, Guardian—get moving. Go!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The consoles here at Siren's Watch say the array is unpowered. Guardian, you need to find a way to reroute power, then properly align the array's receivers.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Excellent work. Systems are lighting up here; I have Sloane's position as… one kilometer down?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: She is in the ocean? That is a sea of crushing methane—nothing can survive there.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I wouldn't be so sure of that.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian. Rig schematics show a ballast maintenance shaft near your position. Follow the signal down and find the deputy commander. I'll join up with you shortly.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've arrived at the diving point; I'm coming down to you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That ain't gonna happen, boss. Do you know how much pressure they're taking? They gotta get out of there.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I am not leaving anyone behind again.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: And I ain't saying we do!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: All right, that's enough! I'm pullin' you up before you and your Ghost get flattened!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Welcome to the Derelict. I'm down in engineering, making sure we… don't blow up. Zavala's got his heart in the right place, but ol' Blue's about as stubborn as they come. You can't brute force this moon. The Collapse messed the whole place up good. Gravity's weird down in the deep. There's pockets of air… some places you can move safely. Others that'll crush you into a little speck. But I think I got something in my gets that'll help us out. Titan ain't my first aquatic rodeo. Go ahead and try out that prototype. Should protect you from the pressure. Well, some of it, at least.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Now get on outta here. I'll fill the boss man in for ya.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, you're almost at the source of the distress signal. I've acquired one of Drifter's... devices. I'll be joining you momentarily.

lines.speaker: Bound in Sorrow
lines.text: Sever — Grief: The Nightmare of Safiyah

title: Ghost in the Machine IV: Caiatl and Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Conquering one's demons is a noble task. There are many stories of Cabal heroes who did the same. Now, they live forever, as legends.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I don't want to be a legend, Caiatl.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Too late. Even we have stories about the great "Commander Zavala," only we do not call him that.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: This is not a formal communication. This is… a private reckoning. One warrior to another.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I see. I've fought countless battles where my life was on the line. Won and lost them. Nothing like this. Never as hard.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Hm. As I told your Crow once: battles fought in the theater of the mind and heart are just as brutal as ones fought with flesh and bone. We all… bear our scars. Victories, defeats. Some openly with pride, some others hidden away beneath layers of shameful armor. This battle was the most honest of your Risen life. You won.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I don't feel like I've won any battles. I just feel… tired. And old.

title: Ghost in the Machine III: Amanda and Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Hey, Commander. How're you holding up?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've been better. Sounds like you have too.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Yeah. Pretty tore up inside. Any little thing sets me off. Might've said some… hurtful stuff to somebody who didn't deserve it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We've all been at our worst. When we're hurt, when we're afraid. We all fall apart.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Feels like I'm held together by duct tape and spit lately.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The last few weeks have opened up some old, old wounds. Reminded me of important people I've lost. My wife. My son.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Yeah… yeah… I know that kind of hurt. Other way around, though. I still think about my folks, but I… I can't really remember their voices anymore.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I can't remember Hakim's voice either. I try. I try so hard.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: You wanna tell me about him? Your wife?

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Want some company down in your office anyway? We don't have to talk. Maybe we just… sit?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I'd like that. Thank you, Amanda.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Ain't nothing. It's what family does.

title: Ghost in the Machine V: Caiatl and Eris — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Morn. Would your ritual have prevented my failure?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Now you seek the counsel of a "Hive-tainted witch"?

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Do you revel in your foresight? Do you delight in witnessing my shame?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I offered you my support. That offer remains. Know that this failure does not define you, Caiatl.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You are not a crown. You do this for yourself, not for the Cabal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. You are a woman with a burden, as I was.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: There can be no such distinction. Torobatl lies in ashes. From my ranks rise traitors and spies. My incompetence threatens the future of my people. There is no quarter for failure.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You speak Ghaul's words. They erode the truth. What is your Nightmare? An expectation you must shed like dead skin. What will remain when you do so?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then you must look past your shame and say, "I am more."

title: Ghost in the Machine VI: Caiatl and Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Eris told me what happened. How are you?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: But do you feel like a legend, Caiatl?

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: I will break you in half, small-man.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: [sighs and laughs softly] I can't imagine it was easy. That confrontation, after all this time. Mine wasn't.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: You are not mistaken. I know what Ghaul is to your people: a symbol of death and ruthless ambition. But he was so much more than that to me. He was an idol, an inspiration to all Cabal. Even though he was born to a low station, he rose. How he rose. I was blinded by the light of his accomplishments. Unable to see the man inside. Unable to see his self-aggrandizing corruption. I refused to believe he was as much like my father as he was… It repulses me how much I still feel for them both, in spite of everything they became.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: It's hard to challenge your idols. Even harder to make the decision that you'll be different. But then you look back on your life, your own mistakes… and you wonder how you'll be judged when all is said and done. I'll never know Ghaul as you did. But I know you, Caiatl. I see you.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: That is all anyone can ask for. To be seen as they are.

title: Ghost in the Machine VII: Eris Morn — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a message on the radio in the Wing of the Haunted

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I received your last message. Whatever reckless plan brings you to the Reef need not be shared with the Vanguard… or the Guardian. But keep me informed, at the very least. Those haunted here have found a measure of peace. But it takes more than resolve to overcome one's regrets. We have both felt it. How a moment of pain can weave into the whole of our lives. How it binds us to patterns of thought and action. I have stared into the eyes of my pain made manifest. Pleaded with it. Raged at it. What face would your Nightmare wear? For so long, I believed peace was beyond my reach. No more. I have found it in guiding others down the same path that saved me. But… I might allow myself to want more than peace. What, I am not certain. Is joy the word? Might I find that again? You told me to live my life. There is more truth in you than either of us would care to admit. I have something that will be of interest to you. The lunar Pyramid remains rife with secrets. Meet with me, and we will discuss what I have found. Take care, Rat.

title: Ghost Scan: Alton Dynamo, Mars — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Machines and morality. Within five decades, we hope to relinquish full autonomy of our defense network to Rasputin. But can we trust an artificial intelligence to make the moral decision? Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Autonomous vehicles were first built at the dawn of the millennium, prior to which there were over a million automobile-related deaths per year. AI programmers at the time found themselves confronted with moral quandries that were once mere experiments in thought. A self-driving car on a collision course that kills five people has but one viable alternative: a new path where one innocent bystander is killed. For a machine to make a decision on whether to divert its course, its creator must undertake the impossible task of assigning an objective value to individual Human life. It turns out that the ethical implications of artificial intelligence are a great deal more complicated than Asimov's Laws of Robotics lead us to believe.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The engineers of Clovis Bray conceived a solution during the development of our Warmind project. By relegating ethical decision-making to a Black Box Morality system, the Warmind instruments its own proprietary virtue quantifiers incomprehensible to even its own creators. Rasputin determines morality on its own terms, and by design we are blind to that process in order to preserve its objectivity.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Bazaar, Tower, #2 — Transcript
