title: Ghost Scan: Alton Dynamo, Mars, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Clovis Bray is pushing the limits of computer science and engineering to secure Humanity's future. Our Warmind project is a ground-breaking defense AI. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The Warmind is a crowning achievement in Human engineering. Utilizing the latest techniques in quantum and engramic computing to create a neural network of unprecedented processing power. Artificial neural networks are probabilistic systems that rely on a method of error calculation known as backpropagation. They are good at pattern recognition, but must be fed "correct" outputs to be properly calibrated.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: In the past, one could create a neural network able to identify a feline or canine when given images of these animals but it would never be able to find a useful application for that knowledge on its own. The approach with Rasputin was to create a nested neural network that could not only detect patterns on a small scale, but recursively find patterns among all of its data. The end goal for this machine is for it to see things in a way that Humans cannot, and thus predict and eliminate threats before we know of them.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Aurora Reach, Mars — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Valkyrie. Sleeper Simulant. Hades Flame. Aurora Knives. The weapons of the future are being developed by the Warmind Rasputin today. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The goal of the Warmind project is to prepare our defenses for unseen threats. We are still learning to interface with Rasputin, but it's already in the process of helping to forge new weapons suited to protecting Humanity. Communication with the Warmind has been a logistical concern from the project's inception. But the Hephaestus Index is a promising first step towards cooperation with our new commander and protector. This catalog of next-generation weapons ranges from planetary cannons to small- and mid-sized arms for use by ground infantry.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: There are currently over 150 projects in varying stages of research and development. By parsing data and performing calculations at a phenomenal rate, Rasputin is able to to provide instruction in the form of math… the language of the universe. With Clovis Bray engineers and Rasputin working side by side, we can rest assured that our children will live in a prosperous, safe galaxy.

lines.speaker: Ghost

title: Ghost Scan: Bazaar, Tower, #5 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look at all these inventory notes. Looks like everyone is trying to get the Tower's market back on track. Tess, Banshee, Rahool, Eva Levante … they're all working together on this stuff.

title: Ghost Scan: Cabal losses — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cabal mining sites across Mars and Phobos have been hit. Losses to Blind Legion: 35%, Losses to Sand Eaters: 58%, Dust Giants: 39%. What is this?

title: Ghost Scan: Chamber of Sky, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This isn't like other Vex technology I've seen. I think it's a relic from past iterations. Or maybe… future iterations. You can never tell with the Vex.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Cabal detonated this ship — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Cabal detonated this ship after it crashed. Standard procedure when they are under attack. I think the last directive received was an evacuation order. But the Cabal have no word for "evacuation". All ships and personnel were directed to focus attack on enemies beyond Martian orbit.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Chamber of Stone, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, so this Gate is too small for a Hydra to fit through. But, according to this, dozens of Hydras passed through before it broke down. So either the Gate got smaller at some point, or there are hundreds of tiny Hydras out there somewhere.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Core Terminus, Mars, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Every day we're finding new applications for engrams that will make your life easier. At Clovis Bray, we're pushing the boundaries of computer science by utilizing the power of the engram. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Engineers of the 21st century hit the physical limit in the advancement of silicon transistors, unable to resolve the issue of quantum tunneling at the nanoscopic level. The dream of quantum computing danced at the edge of our predecessors' imaginations, somewhere between science and science fiction.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Ironically, it would take a further technological leap for us to later return and resolve the messy problem of quantum incoherence. That leap was the first successful encoding of solid matter by Doctor Willa Bray opening a window to the wonderful and mysterious world of the engram.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The latest and most exciting application of this new state of matter is within the field of engramic computation. Physically encoding conventional silicon transistors allows them to safely store exponentially more information in a smaller space. With that breakthrough our computing power has grown immeasurably, and we can now actualize what was once bound to the dreams and fiction of our ancestors.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Cosmodrome, Old Russia, Earth — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's where your Ghost found you, huh? Wonder if you were part of the exodus, or someone who came along after. Someone who picked the wrong place to hide from the Fallen.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Chamber of Water, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm getting some weird readings from this conflux. Hey, remember the old Vault of Glass? There are some fractured headers here marked "Aetheon." "Sekrion." "Theosyion."

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't know why the Vex would put a Conflux all the way up here, unless it was for the view. But Vex aren't really big on aesthetics. Hmm.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Braytech Futurescape, Mars — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The Clovis Bray Corporation is the leading innovator in the most prosperous time of Human history. We are proud to serve you, and proud of those of you within our ranks. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: You are Clovis Bray. Whether you're one of our distinguished top scientists, a valued consumer, or investor, we welcome you to the family.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: At our present rate of progress, current estimates predict Humanity becomes an interstellar civilization within the century. Imagine the astonishing feats your children will witness, and the wondrous era of peace and productivity in which they will live.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: We have challenged ourselves and Humankind to be better, to reach higher. You are part of an important moment in history. You are Clovis Bray.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Cosmodrome, Old Russia, Earth, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Cayde brought me out here once. We looked at all the cars, all the people who died tryin' to get to safety during the Collapse. And he said, "Listen, don't worry about dying. Death isn't the end, not since the Traveler showed up. You ever feel sad about your folks, you just wait for them to show up as Guardians. You just wait." …I'm still waitin'.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Core Terminus, Mars — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The Human mind in a mechanical body. We are at the cusp of major breakthroughs in making this a reality. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Early experiments in Exo science managed to encode the Human consciousness into a form that could be processed digitally. At the time, we believed that was the big hurdle to overcome in the creation of the Exo. Little did we know that the real challenge would be the phenomenon known as Dissociative Exomind Rejection. Nascent Proto-Exos developed serious symptoms of cognitive disorder that eventually led to death. It turned out the human mind would not reconcile its presence in a new "body".

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: It took multiple iterations in design, but the Clovis Bray Corporation eventually developed several solutions. The first is to "reboot" the mind once it has been transferred, allowing it to awaken inside its new shell as though it were being reborn. This has side effects of memory loss and fragmentation, but it's highly effective in the prevention of DER. The reboot process can be repeated multiple times to further the odds of survival. It is not currently known how many times a Human consciousness can be rebooted, but scientists estimate it to be around twenty.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The second preventative measure to DER is to program certain "humanisms" within Exos. As machines, they have not the physical needs to eat or reproduce like real humans. But artificially injecting that drive has been clinically proven to reduce the odds of DER. Further experimentation is required to perfect the Exo project, but you can be assured that Clovis Bray is at the forefront in the field of Exo science.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Cosmodrome, Old Russia, Earth, #4 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Somethin' opened up that hatch recently. Your telemetry's spikin' a lot of residual Ether around that pipe. Keep your eyes out for Fallen, you hear me? I don't wanna lose you, too.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've heard from other Ghosts that there are a lot of spots like this popping up. secret places where people go to just sit and talk. About the attack, about the Traveler, about the future. Who knows what tomorrow holds?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Court of Oryx — Transcript

lines.text: Guardian jumps forward, the rupture opens

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a stream of interdimensional energy concentrated within that field. Growing stronger.
Two Hallowed Wizards and Thalnok, Fanatic of Crota step through the rupture

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And something just stepped out of it.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Stay on target, we need more Guardians on that Dreadnaught.
The Wizards are killed, Thalnok disappears
Guardian approaches the rupture, and scans the pedestal

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The output is consistent with my readings at the Shrine of Oryx on the moon. Osiris believed all of the shrines were connected and went searching for their nexus. I think we found it. Did I tell you Osiris never returned?

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Interference, Means to an End (Final Week)

title: Ghost Scan: Cosmodrome, Old Russia, Earth, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Used to be the Fallen pretty much owned the Cosmodrome. Then they just… split. Right before the Legion hit us. Left a lot of stuff, some of it real useful. Why put a tarp on something you're not coming back for? Unless they did come back after all…
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Blueprints for a bunch of modular housing, bridges, some simple shopfronts … I think these are reconstruction plans for City blocks. As bad as the Tower had it, some parts of the City are just… gone.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Cosmodrome, Old Russia, Earth, #5 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's a highway to nowhere right there. I've flown all across this region, and it's just… rusted-out cars, dead cities, rubble, and rebar. I can't imagine what it was like before the Collapse. Sometimes? I can't even picture a future where it's just us on Earth again.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #4 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All this stuff belongs to Amanda Holliday. I think I heard her mention this place once: her "secret hideaway to get away from all that nonsense in the hangar". Let's not tell anyone about it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #5 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Maintenance logs from a system engineer. She talks about how she's having to do tasks for two people now that her mechanic buddy is gone. Everybody lost someone when the Cabal attacked us.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorne told me she comes up here to read sometimes. She's studying up. Vanguard history, the Consensus, the Faction Wars, even books about the founding of the City! Huh. I wonder where Louis goes while she's here.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #7 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They rebuilt the Speaker's private quarters even after the reconstruction. I still can't believe that he's gone. He wasn't the first Speaker, and… he can't be the last, right? We still need a Speaker. Don't we?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #6 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The last login on this terminal was from Banshee-44, but… he tried and failed so many logins as Banshee-41 that it locked him out. All those reboots might have finally gotten to him.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Devils' bones — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not all of these bones belong to Guardians who fell to Sepiks. Some were pulled from the stasis pods and offered in sacrifice. That makes them older than the Collapse. Typically, the Fallen only use this ceremonial presentation for members of rival houses.

title: Ghost Scan: Dantalion Engine — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's still enough power moving through this ship for it to take off.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: They won't leave until they get what they came for. A lesson I learned the hard way from Valus Ta'aurc. He didn't know every dog had its day until he saw his last. These will too.

title: Ghost Scan: Dimensional Lock — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's a dimensional lock. As long as this turbine is stationary, this place and everything in it exist in only one realm. This must be how Oryx moves between dimensions.

title: Ghost Scan: Echion Hold, European Dead Zone — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This component was shipped here from the Dantalion Exodus. Remember? That big Cabal ship that crashed into the Dreadnaught. I guess we found out where its distress signal went.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Courtyard, Tower, #8 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think somebody stole these supplies from New Monarchy! References in the logs to "following Hawthorne's lead". I wonder what that means.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Excavation Site II, Io — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ascendant Realm readings in spades down here. Down the line this could be another one of those weird portals. The Taken are so strange.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Excavation Site II, Io, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Listen. It sounds like… It sounds like someone's whispering in there. Over and over. Eugh.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Crota — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There are no markings that suggest a carving tool. They were assembled and crafted through some kind of Hive spell. I think this one represents Crota.

title: Ghost Scan: EX-077 Command, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This thing is still online. And it's connected to Fallen comms on Titan. And in the EDZ. But… those are the only places I'm seeing. Nothing on the Moon, or Venus, or Mars. Did the Red Legion wipe them out?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Exodus Black, Nessus, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why set up a terminal this far from the Exodus Black? Must have been some kind of last-ditch effort by Failsafe's crew. Poor folks.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Exodus Black, Nessus, #4 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Fallen set up this terminal for remote access into the Exodus Black's security system. I could have told them that wouldn't work. Bet Failsafe had fun with them, though.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Excavation Site II, Io, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm detecting… I think this is sending a message back to the Ascendant Realm. But who's listening?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Exodus Black, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This Servitor shorted out when it tried to interface with the Exodus Black's network. And then limped out here to shut down. It looks like Failsafe wasn't gentle.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Exodus Black, Nessus, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This thing is full of Ether, but it's been… diluted somehow. Maybe a byproduct of the weird atmosphere on Nessus. Or maybe things are more dire for the Fallen than we thought.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Exodus Black, Nessus, #5 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wonder what the Fallen are planning to do with these? Some kind of remote probes to study the Vex? Raw materials for something?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: These Hive spawn pods are different from the ones we saw before. Maybe a different brood. Or a different generation. Gross and confusing.

lines.text: A fragment of our past, touched by the Traveler in the present… I see beautiful futures spiraling out of this.

lines.speaker: Jalaal
lines.text: This enigma troubles me. If it is valuable, it will draw enemies and sow dissent. We will study it closely.

lines.speaker: Hideo
lines.text: What an intriguing mystery. We shall treat your find with reverence, Guardian.

lines.text: The Arcology's operating system isn't very smart. Nothing even close to an AI. Lots of entries here, different names. It may not have had a personality, but it made living here better for a lot of people.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Festering Halls, Titan, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We saw this rune before, on the Dreadnaught. It means either "doorway" or "treasure" or "chamber". Perhaps the Hive use this rune to tap into their Throne-world dimensions.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hive runes draw their power from a different dimension, where there’s no difference between a word and its meaning. When the Hive erode the barrier between our dimension and theirs, the rune for “death” brings literal death.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Firebase Hades, European Dead Zone, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why would you store refueling information in a remote access point all the way up here? I swear, I will never understand Cabal architecture.

title: Ghost Scan: Firebase Hades, European Dead Zone, #3 — Transcript

title: Ghost Scan: Giant’s Scar, Io — Transcript

lines.text: I swear I just saw something looking back at us through that thing. The Taken do not live in a nice neighborhood.

title: Ghost Scan: Firebase Hades, European Dead Zone — Transcript

title: Ghost Scan: Giant’s Scar, Io, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm taking some background readings here. Past connections include Mercury, Venus, Mars… seems about right. The Vex sure do like to make themselves at home.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Giant’s Scar, Io, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Even passive, their Gates give off the strangest readings. I'm reading exotic particles from… wow. That is a long, long way from here.

lines.text: The Vex transformation process sure leaves some weird artifacts behind. If we let them, they'd have this whole place looking like Nessus, or Mercury!

title: Ghost Scan: Giant’s Scar, Io, #4 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like Asher might have come through here to do field work. You know, you'd think the City's foremost expert on the Vex would be… neater.

title: Ghost Scan: Glade of Echoes, Nessus, #2 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This Arc Spear was never used. Just leaning against a Golden Age agriculture container forever. I'm not sure the Fallen were really ready for what they found out here. I can relate.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Glade of Echoes, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vex don't usually display trophies, but I can't see any other reason for why this device is here. Something related to the crash of the Exodus Black? What a bunch of jerks.

title: Ghost Scan: Glade of Echoes, Nessus, #4 — Transcript

Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Glade of Echoes, Nessus, #5 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The surface of this Goblin was oxidized by some kind of Fallen energy weapon. Always interesting to see how such different races interact at a technological level. In this case, mostly they were trying to melt each other. But you get me.

title: Ghost Scan: Hallows, Nessus, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vex never leave decommissioned units out in the open like this. Claw marks around the fluid chamber… I think the Fallen drained this construct. Huh.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Glade of Echoes, Nessus, #3 — Transcript

lines.text: Someone tried to reforge this conductive metal into… I'm not sure what. It must have been the Fallen, which means that they thought it was valuable.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Ghost Scan: Hallows, Nessus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We came all the way up here, and this access point won't even let me into the Vex network. I guess we should take that as a sign.

title: Ghost Scan: Hangar, Tower, #3 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Someone's been trying to modify one of Shaxx's Redjacks! But all the interface history shows is access by other Frames. "Arcite and Dahlia", it says. Over and over. "Arcite and Dahlia".
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: Parts Long Lost, A Moment In Time

title: Ghost Scan: Hangar, Tower — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like a journal: Ana Bray. But I can't tell who— Pretty much the entire thing is redacted. And there are whole pages missing. Something about all this seems… wrong. Am I worrying too much?

title: Ghost Scan: Hangar, Tower, #6 — Transcript

lines.text: "Fly Girl: The Story of Amanda Holliday." Is this… someone is writing a biography? I'd keep it out of sight, too, if I were them. Hmm, this chapter talks about how she was born on the road outside the City, how she lost her family to the Fallen… I didn't even know some of this stuff.

title: Ghost Scan: Hangar, Tower, #7 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Huh. Communications between Amanda Holliday and Commander Zavala. Back and forth and back and forth for weeks, keeping tabs on shady characters in the hangar. Nothing gets by Zavala.

title: Ghost Scan: Mindlab: Rasputin, Mars — Transcript

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: From Mercury to the outer planets, Clovis Bray provides the most robust communication network in the system. Our Warsat network watches over us all. Would you like to know more?

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: As Humanity expanded to the far edges of the solar system, communication and logistics grew increasingly difficult among the outer planets. Pioneers of the outer frontier built makeshift transmission relays, but these were unreliable and prone to failure.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: The development of the Warmind program compelled a need for a unified circumstellar communication network so Clovis Bray seized an opportunity to kill two birds with one exceedingly large stone. We built thousands of War Satellites and deployed them throughout the system. These Warsats link with the Warmind designated Rasputin and with each other, forming an integrated defense and comms system.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Each satellite is equipped with a state-of-the-art kinetic superconductor that shields it from Kessler debris and has an orbital life spanning hundreds of years. No matter what threats lie in store for us, rest assured that that Rasputin and the Clovis Bray Warsats will never cease their vigilant watch over Humanity.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Cocoon — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian travels from Earth's orbit to the Dreaming City. Saint speaks over their comms.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Guardian... thank you for accompanying me. Ikora issued an order for Osiris's arrest. She has questions about his involvement in Lakshmi's attack on the Eliksni. I volunteered to collect him from the Dreaming City, where he now hides. No one will touch Osiris until I know the truth. He has acted rashly in the past, but... I have never seen him willingly endanger the City. Something is wrong. I have felt it for some time now. He is... distant. Help me bring him home.
The Guardian's ship enters the Dreaming City, and they enter.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I am... [grunts] I am making way through the opposite flank from you. The Hive are swarming! We will be as the mighty crabs of old and pincer them! Break their lines, and meet me at Osiris's signal.
The Guardian fights Hive as they proceed forward.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Geppetto says there's another Ghost nearby. Lightbearer, reveal yourself.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: What are you doing here, bird brother? Did Zavala not send you away?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Osiris called me for help. With all these Hive around, I can see why. This reeks of Xivu Arath.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: He... called you? No. Go home. This is not your fight to take; it is mine.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: You can't keep him in a cage, Saint. You're not the only one who cares about him.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Lectures? You know nothing! Osiris is not himself, and I will be the one to bring him back.
The Guardian finds the door locked. Xivu Arath's reinforcements descend on them. They defeat Rhungatt, Might of Xivu Arath before breaking through.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Still fumbling around in the overworld, old Light? There's an Awoken device near you. It should let you slip into the Ascendant Plane and get you closer to Osiris.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Crow and I used them to hide from Wrathborn.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Stalk, we were stalking, not hiding.
The Guardian defeats some invading Hive and interacts with an Awoken Beacon. It sends a beam into the air as it aligns. A portal opens behind it.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Taken portals, Awoken dimensions. Fine. Go, Guardian, take the Crow's path.
The Guardian enters the Ascendant Plane. A mirror image of the Harbinger's Seclude appears, distorted and shattered.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: The Ascendant Plane should skirt you past the Hive's barricades. Just be sure to mind the Taken.
Fighting through Taken enemies, the Guardian finds a path through the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Word to the wise: bringing down Quria left the Taken rattled. I don't think Savathûn has control of them anymore.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: No matter! My bullets do not know the difference.

The Guardian defeats H'Kullna, Stained By Darkness, before aligning the next Awoken Beacon. A portal appears, but before they can enter it, Taken spawn in front of them, accompanied by a Hive Knight, Kelgorath, Risen From Bones.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Guardian, many Taken signals falling on you.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: A big Wrathborn headed your way too.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Be brave. Osiris is not far ahead.
The Guardian defeats the enemies blocking them.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I am not far ahead of you, Guardian... We converge on Osiris's signal.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Then we'll see each other soon. Crow out.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Whatever happens, friend, we cannot lose him. Even if I do not understand, I must believe his actions have purpose.
The Guardian enters the portal, returning to the Dreaming City.
Ahead of them, Crow has found Osiris speaking with Mara Sov. He looks around. Mara notices him and turns to speak to him.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: I had hoped you'd find your way back.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'm a bit lost, actually... but this feels familiar.
Crow pauses, looking at Mara closely.
Mara's face is stoic, but her eyes narrow. Saint-14 interrupts as he and the Guardian enter.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Osiris... You must come home. Answer for what you have done. The Vanguard will show mercy —

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes, Ikora and Commander Zavala are nothing if not generous. Queen Mara, look how they've welcomed the Crow into their flock.
"Osiris" waves his fingers at Mara, beginning to drop the facade. Crow approaches.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It isn't too late. You can still be forgiven.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Be careful... I'll hold you to it.

Osiris takes steps backwards. As he speaks, his voice distorts; Savathûn's voice begins to overlap and then overtake it. As he steps out of view, Hive roaring and the sound of transformation can be heard. Everyone looks upward as something before them gets bigger and bigger.
Saint shakes his head, shouting with disbelief.

Crow, Saint-14, and the Guardian begin to step back but Mara Sov remains in place. Mara closes her eyes as shadows begin to envelop the room, then she holds out her hands, eyes glowing. There is a flash of light as she contains whatever is transforming. There is a sound of cracking crystals.
A huge crystal stands in place of where Osiris once was, vaguely humanoid. Crow, Mara Sov, and Saint-14 stand near it, and Saint points his shotgun at it and shouts.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: Lower your weapons. Osiris still lives.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: This thing and I have come to an agreement. You need only cooperate.

Savathûn: I am Savathûn, the Witch Queen, Sister of Shapes, Deepest in the High Coven, etcetera, etcetera. My sister Xivu Arath hunts me on behalf of another. I wish to only be free, and Mara Sov has graciously agreed to help.
Savathûn: Sweet that you should care, little bird. I have been Osiris for as long as you have known him. But rest assured: I will return him safely to you... in exchange for your assistance.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Queen of Lies, pray this is the one time you are telling truths. The Vanguard must know what has happened here. Stay, Guardians. I will go.
Saint-14 transmats out of the room.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: Someone once told me the line between light and dark is very thin. Walk it alongside me. For Osiris. This will guide you; a powerful relic of Awoken design. Take it, and return to your H.E.L.M.
Mara turns away from the Guardian, and she and Crow stare up at the crystal; they occasionally exchange glances but say nothing to each other.
The Guardian enters the Reliquary and retrieves the Wayfinder's Compass.
