title: Heist Battleground: Europa (Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches and enters the Bray Exoscience Lab.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It is a new day, Young Wolf.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Time to snag another submind fragment, Guardian. Get in and out before they even know what's hit 'em.
The Guardian heads deeper into the facility.
The Guardian fights alongside BrayTech Security Frames in the facility. The BrayTech Security System gives an alert.

lines.speaker: BrayTech Security System
lines.text: Creation Demolition Sequence: EXCISION - CHARGE PRIMED.
When a BrayTech Security Frame is defeated
The Guardian proceeds down a chute toward the vault.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Submind vault's locked down tight, but the maintenance shafts are just big enough to fit you and all that armor. Happy crawling!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I never knew there was a submind housed in Europa. Neither did the Vanguard's archives. Which submind is this?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I had the same question. Turns out, it's not really a submind—not in the traditional sense. It's more like a foundational AI framework they all use.
The Guardian destroys Hive wards on the Mindlab doors.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That is one big, shrieky eye. Guardian, get gouging.
The Guardian battles and defeats Warwatcher, Eye of Xivu Arath.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: So much on Europa could have helped during the Dark Age. Why hide all this away instead of using our legacy to better humanity?

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Humanity's betterment is a vehicle, an indirect consequence of parallel actions. It advances in the shadow of individuals. My shadow.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: It really is all about you.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: We are all propelled by selfishness. Even you, even now. It is why you came to me.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Once the Warmind's network control has been re-established, we will see the extent of the damage to my empire.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I'm not going to sugarcoat it. It's bad. Your name's rubbed off most of the signs!

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Yes, very humorous. I've gathered the solar system is a war-torn ruin, despite all of you "Guardians." You aren't the first critic to foretell my doom. Yet here I am… and here you are.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Anastasia, what drew you back to the Bray name after all these years? It's clear that your memory is… fragmented at best.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I woke up attached to my badge. Got caught up chasing the promises of the Golden Age… before I learned about who you really were.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: And now, you're taking on my life's work as your own. It seems you truly will always be a Bray.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: For a long time, I thought being a Bray meant I was a pioneer… some kind of torchbearer for the future. I hoped digging into my past would show me how to do that. It's been more like exhuming a grave than excavating a relic.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Squeamish minds seldom produce anything of merit. They prattle on, wringing hands, while others change the course of humanity. Existence is entropic. In limited time, better to spend one's resources, lest they go to waste.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: You left me down here for quite some time, Anastasia. Our disagreements never kept you distant before.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The old me? Her world used to begin and end with you—in a terrarium, like some pet. But I've met you again with fresh eyes, and I won't live in one of your boxes.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: That's all I ever wanted you to realize. Someone had to prepare you for what was coming, and keep you safe until you were ready.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Is that supposed to sound convincing? You did it for the same reason you kept the Darkness for yourself. The only thing you love is control.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Well done. The sooner we finish here, the better. Saint has expressed that Europa, even in orbit, is dangerous. He awaits my return.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That'll get better. He thought he'd lost you for a long time. I haven't seen him like that since you vanished into the Infinite Forest.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Is that the Exo? I could show you how to remove that memory—the pain. You could give him a better, blissful life.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You are not permitted to speak of him. Remove yourself from this conversation.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Data link established and transferring. We'll get what we can and bug out.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Not everything's as fast as transmat. We're moving a digital tonne of data that was never meant to be moved like this.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: There was a faster way, but someone crashed my orbital station into a moon. This moon, in fact.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: From what I'm told, your station was being uncooperative.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Some of these files have been accessed recently, by force. House Salvation is looking for something more than just tech.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: There are foreign traces of a virus as well. This code pattern is reminiscent of biological encoding structures.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Xivu Arath's words have found their way into the submind's closed network. She attempts to drive it to madness with her cryptoliths.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Then you will see those things destroyed! These are my creations, and theft will be met with extreme prejudice.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, Xivu Arath's oversight of House Salvation is troubling. Her Wrathborn will not be uprooted by strength alone.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: No? Perhaps you just aren't strong enough.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: She commands a great deal of power, Clovis. Any attempt to strike directly at her would only add to that power.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Preposterous. Rituals, magic, and superstition. Even your Light can be quantified and controlled. These fairy tales don't scare me.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: You know, I've run sims on this before. I never got it to work right.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Your grandfather seems confident he can rebuild Rasputin's core systems.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Yeah, only… Red's not just code, Osiris. He developed… personhood. Autonomy. I don't want to take that from him.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Rasputin drifts in limbo. But with this, the Warmind can find what he once was. Sometimes… that opportunity is all we can ask for.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Heist Battleground: Moon (Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian attempts to gain entry to the Seraph bunker.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: All right, Guardian. This is a smash and grab: smash some Hive, grab a chunk of submind.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And live to tell the tale.
A Deathtongue moves to channel Xivu Arath's Battlesong.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Xivu Arath's battle song emboldens her soldiers. End it.
The Guardian reboots the Seraph security protocols.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That did it! Hatch opening… and setting that perimeter tower to "friendly." You're welcome!
The Guardian ventures inside to reach the submind Malahayati.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Xivu Arath moves in the open, but I worry we are missing a piece of our enemies' plan.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Maybe for now, but we'll have a Warmind up and running soon. If anyone can outmaneuver Xivu Arath, it's Rasputin.
The Guardian begins hacking the door.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Patch me in, and I'll get that door open again.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Cracked it! You and Ghost are clear to move.
The Guardian enters the Malahayati submind vault.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Vault security re-upped. You know what to do, Guardian.
The Guardian attempts to breach the Submind Vault Security Door.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: You were right, Mara. That Scorn's definitely trying to corrupt the submind, and… using some weird interface to copy out files? Luckily, it looks like Malahayati's rewriting itself with repair protocols every time we clear the bunker, so damage is minimal.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I suspect the Witness is treating this Scorn as a living archive, copying important information to its mind for safekeeping. Troubling…

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Vault open. All right, Malahayati, here we come.
The Guardian battles and defeats Once-Phyris, The Exhumed Tether.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: My Corsairs report movement in the Ley Lines surrounding the Moon. Your mission's success draws attention.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: The great Clovis Bray, finally risen from your frozen tomb. To what do we owe the presence of this revenant?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: He means to help us restore the Warmind, so that we may wield its knowledge against the Witness.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: We need him to save Rasputin's life.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Both such noble endeavors for a man as vile as he. I am not convinced, and I hope neither are you.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: The submind is in our control. Well done, Guardians… and preserved minds clinging to a frail existence.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: I assume that was directed at me.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Did you solve that riddle all on your own?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I've cut Clovis's comm link. I don't think his response was important anyway. Exfiltration ready.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Osiris, my heart lightens to see you returned to us, and that our plan found purchase with so much at stake.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Did, uh… did all unfold as you foresaw? Did I?

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Not all. I carry sorrow for Sagira's sacrifice. The details are never exact, but I am assured this path will lead us through the storm, despite the costs.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: We've both suffered losses for the potential of a better future. Let us hope that probability is in our favor.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: This is where we first encountered Clarity. This was the beginning of everything—the second age, after the Traveler. It was meant to be the Age of Man.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: There was never a second age. Only a precursor to the Collapse. The Witness drew you in and exploited you, like an invasive vine pushing through a crack in stone. You invited it in, and it ran rampant.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: From your tone, I take it you've had a similar experience? Well, that doesn't surprise me. You seem the type to be attracted to power.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: No, it is power that is attracted to me.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: I'm not familiar with this station! My authentication protocols aren't functioning. Did Elisabeth do this?

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Insubordination, then. Did you teach it to do that?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Since your death, the Warmind has evolved, Clovis. Many of the shackles you bound them with have rusted away.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: And he's so much more without you than he even could have been with you. Hey… I'm seeing a pattern emerge.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: How long has our Moon been overrun by vermin? Is the City this weak?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The Hive aren't so easy to root out. It's been tried.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Then destroy the Moon! I could have replaced it with a singularity, or a station to maintain tidal gravity. There are options here.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I've seen firsthand the brashness of Golden Age humanity. Odd that the Collapse didn't humble you at all. It is better to keep the Hive concentrated in one place. Show them they are threatened, and they will cease to make obvious their plans.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Our victory here is short-lived. Xivu's Wrathborn are converging upon you through the Ascendant Plane. You're advised to extract quickly.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: A realm that shadows our own; I do not have the time or the patience to explain it to you.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Then I haven't the same to listen.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Absent for hundreds of years, and still gripping onto smug superiority. As if the world could never advance beyond you. I doubt your ego would allow the capability to listen.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: You've been sneaking in extra files to these data packages, Anastasia. Literature? Philosophy? Unnecessary drivel.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Rasputin's not just protocol and process. Treating him like that won't be rebuilding him. It'll be remaking him into something else. His memories, lessons, connections… I'm doing the best I can, but some things can't be expressed in a line of code.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Heist Battleground: Europa (Week 4) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches and enters the Bray Exoscience Lab.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Guardian, Xivu Arath's cryptoliths are back. We're in for another fight to dig out more submind data.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Hive and altered Eliksni biosignatures are present within Bray Exoscience. Submind extraction in danger.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Guardian… I take it you've seen the error of your ways and come to join me. Good. Be a lamb and kill every last intruder in my lab. You're too kind.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: More Hive in Exoscience trying to dig out secrets. [sighs] Part of me just wants to say, "Let Clovis rust." But we're better than that.
The Guardian heads deeper into the facility and confronts a Deathtongue Chorister.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: A Deathsinger's dirge. It's Xivu's battle song.
The Guardian proceeds down a chute toward the vault.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I know House Salvation is our enemy, but I feel for these Eliksni. From what I've heard… becoming a Wrathborn is not a walk in the park.
The Guardian destroys Hive wards on the Mindlab doors.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Without her Shrieker, Xivu Arath will be blind on Europa. You know what to do.
The Guardian battles and defeats Warwatcher, Eye of Xivu Arath.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Welcome, backstabbers. I see you've returned to pillage more of my work in order to fix your own mistakes. Do you really believe you'll succeed without my acumen dragging you along? Who will replace me? Anastasia? Pah! Elisabeth? She wouldn't know where to start. The Warmind—MY Warmind? An inferior version. You're finished without me. Enjoy the annihilation your small minds have wrought. I know I will.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: This is a pre-recorded message. Clovis Bray's AI appears to be ignoring us.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: And he still felt the need to host one last lecture. Typical.

lines.speaker: Clovis Bray AI
lines.text: Anastasia! Elisabeth! One of you answer me, now!

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Clovis Bray. Your progeny have surpassed you. Your services are no longer required. We appreciate your understanding.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Connection terminated. Submind extraction initiated. Guardian, I have cleared a flight path for your ship. Stand by.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: So many secrets lost to time. Do you think your grandfather could ever see himself as an ally of the City?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No one asked you. His mind would be an asset, no? Assuming he was kept content.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He doesn't know the meaning of the word.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: House Salvation is suffering. Xivu Arath has only tightened her claws around Europa since we began our mission.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Eliksni movement to House Light in the City has increased sharply. They appear to recognize following Eramis is no longer beneficial.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Maybe one day, Eramis will swallow her need for vengeance and realize that herself.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Why do you persist? Schemes will not save you. The sword is already at your throat.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You could be more than this. You can defy it. I've seen you make that decision.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I know you walk as the Vex do. You see slivers of time, where another Eramis lives a different life. But I do not have the luxury you once did. Here I stand. This is who Eramis is now.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Maybe it is, right here, right now, but… I've learned that nothing is ever too late to change. All it takes is a step in the right direction.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Working theory proposal: the Witness did not begin widescale assaults until Savathûn's death. It is possible her presence acted as a deterrent, and her death facilitated necessary developments for an invasion.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: That coincides with my experience in other timelines. The second Collapse always seemed like it was waiting for some kind of trigger. But it's not something that we could have avoided. Maybe some things are set in stone.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Even stone can be eroded, Elsie. You and I must once again take the long view to find victory.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Okay, Saint isn't here to tackle me. Osiris, how lucid were you during your… uh, abduction?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Savathûn attempted to keep my consciousness suppressed. But I could still feel her digging through my mind. That feeling… lingers.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Reminds me of dealing with Clovis. I hear his voice telling me who I should be.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Who we are is not so easily overwritten. Despite all his poisoned words, you are still you. Only now, you wear his failed barbs like thorned armor.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: And you hold Savathûn's secrets like… a poorly labeled key.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I… yeah. I suppose that is a suitable, if clumsy, comparison.

title: Heist Battleground: Moon (Final Weeks) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian attempts to gain entry to the Seraph bunker.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Xivu Arath's Scorn puppet is still picking over this Seraph bunker. There's still plenty worth stealing; let's clear them out.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: She did not deserve this. Give her a good death.
The Guardian ventures inside to reach the submind Malahayati.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The depths of this place still stir unease in me. Loss imprinted in the dust, without wind to sweep it away.
The Guardian attempts to breach the Submind Vault Security Door.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Abandon this. It will only lead to more bloodshed. It will only lead to more pain. How can I make you understand?
The Guardian battles and defeats Once-Phyris, The Exhumed Tether.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: It is over. Silence hangs between us, and still blood is shed. Still this mockery of a life serves the bidding of the Witness.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: She was your friend? It must be difficult to see her like this.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: We were sisters of battle. Our lives held in each other's arms. Our fear quelled by feeling the other at our back.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That is a loss that I too carry. Let us honor them as they were in life, and forget the circumstances of their death.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I don't know where we go from here. I don't know how to make the best of this.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: You've been one of my guiding stars for some time now, Elsie. Let me offer some advice. Uncertainty is the potential for a life unfettered by the weight of knowing. Your choices will be your own.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You're saying I'm going to have to get used to being surprised.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I've kept myself on a road to reach an end I thought was my duty. I'm saying you're free from that fate now. Act on that freedom.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Rasputin's gone, but his legacy's spread between all these little fragments now. The subminds, Felwinter… even that cute little robo-mutt of his.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: He lives on through the doors he opened for us… and yes, through that robotic canine, strangely enough.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Now we just have to walk through those doors. Have you made any headway about Nefele Stronghold?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Somewhat. I know it is on Neptune, or was. Its purpose was unclear, but with Rasputin's coordinates, I can see for myself soon enough.

title: Heist Battleground: Moon (Week 4) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian attempts to gain entry to the Seraph bunker.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: I require additional data from Malahayati. Its contribution may develop additional strategic assessments.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: First, we have to deal with the Hive… and the Scorn. Guardian, I believe you have a solution prepared?
The Guardian ventures inside to reach the submind Malahayati.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: The Sea of Screams churns with gnashing teeth around Luna. Our enemies are drawn to our presence.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: The Hive, the Scorn… their numbers seem endless, but we're used to finding victory against the odds. Let's get that submind, Guardian.
The Guardian attempts to breach the Submind Vault Security Door.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: There was a time I would have thought to destroy all of this. A younger version of myself would have seen this installation as a threat.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Youth shows us the power of action—drives us to make quick, fleeting decisions. Many are mistakes. Age teaches the benefits of temperance.
The Guardian battles and defeats Once-Phyris, The Exhumed Tether.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Now that Rasputin's back online, I think I can specify which file clusters we're pulling from the submind.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Clever. If we can align the structures with Rasputin's current ones, integration will be even faster. Actually, if we'd like to add another string to our bow, so to speak… you could plant a scrambling encryption.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That's a great idea! It'd slow down anyone—other than Red—from trying to take over the bunker.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: The Bray sisters reunited. Pride is an inadequate expression, but it is the first to come to mind.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: How has it been working with Osiris again? He seems like he can be rather… dry.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Yeah, maybe more like "crusty." He's fine, but he's very much a talker and not a listener. Not much for group projects.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Osiris often disregards important safety procedures. Likelihood of injury near him increases by 40%.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I'm not sure if you've got enough of your code back to be joking or not.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: You've never been one to trust Rasputin before, Osiris. Why now?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I remember how Rasputin killed the Iron Lords… as Saladin does. Luckily, this isn't about trust. It's about extracting information.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Osiris understands that whatever risk the Warmind poses pales in comparison to the Witness.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I also know the arc of history is long. There were many mistakes made during darker days, before we found our purpose as Guardians. It is possible for all, even Rasputin, to change.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I'm glad to hear you say that.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Ana Bray. Are you confident the Warmind will be effective against the Witness? Its last engagement…

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I don't know about Pyramid ships, but Red can shoot down Hive carriers just fine. If there's a war coming, we'll want Rasputin on our side.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Of that I have no doubts. The Reef has long been wary of such a power in the system, at its ability to strike across great distances without warning. But we no longer fear the Warmind's wrath. I have seen how you have shaped it into something new… something better. I have to believe that is possible… and so I must not fear.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Warmind, are you able to tell what this Scorn creature has been attempting to do here?

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Retrieving encrypted change logs. Stand by, Queen of the Reef. Curious. They attempted to surface information regarding Exodus Program colony sites and pre-Collapse contingencies for extinction events.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: The Witness isn't just preparing for war. It is looking for something specific housed within your archives. Mark those files for Osiris.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Request complete. I suggest we vacate the premises within 3 minutes to avoid an incoming Hive counterattack.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Mara, I'm worried about Ana now that Rasputin's back. I've seen this play out before, albeit not like this. : I see Ana about to trip, and I want to pull her back. How do you protect someone you love without interfering in their life?

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Strange of you to come to me for this advice. I had intended to ask you a similar question. Your sister is speaking to you, at least. There is a thin line between control and protection. Between neglect and trust. I do not have a balanced solution. I can only offer you what advice I was offered: be patient.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Transfer uplink… green. That's mission accomplished.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Ana, I've heard you were seeing someone… a scientist? I didn't know how to ask.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Yeah. She's a researcher with Owl Sector in the City. Civvie stuff, but still pretty secret.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: [laughs] I'm not trying to pry about her research. I want to know about my sister. What's her name?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Camrin. She's wonderful, Elsie. Why don't you come back to the Tower with me? You can meet her.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Yes! Please! I would love that.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Rasputin. Do you still keep Felwinter's remains interred here?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No! You slaughtered Felwinter and the other Iron Lords without so much as a second thought. Why memorialize him?

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Felwinter was my son. I was ill equipped to process his revival by the Traveler. My reaction was emotionally driven. I have since gained his perspective. I've learned nuanced problems are seldom solved by simple solutions. One day, I hope to earn forgiveness.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: One day… you might receive it. First, I will tell you what kind of man he was. Not from his memories, but… how his friends remember him.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: All of this technology stems from one man. His touch ripples through history, humanity, and into the future. And yet… he is monstrous. If one day, after my passing, the Awoken look upon my works, will I embody the same prolific notoriety as Clovis? To be remembered through a veil of lies and hidden atrocities… some already think of me in that way.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Your consideration of this alone differentiated you from Clovis Bray. He has never weighed the moral implications of an action. We have both committed terrible wrongs. Our attempts to right those wrongs are what keep us from becoming our worst selves.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Xivu Arath's influence is spreading. The positions her forces hold are strategically valuable for an assault on Earth. We must act soon.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: She prowls the Ley Line crossroads throughout the Ascendant Plane. She's cutting us off, and my Corsairs cannot dissuade their movements.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Then we must maintain our efforts to restore my capabilities. I will continue to assess the situation to devise an appropriate response.

title: High Plains Blues — Transcript

lines.text: Uldren Sov is shown sitting on the throne previously occupied by Mara Sov. He holds the Ace of Spades.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Yes… I am humbled by your gracious acceptance. Mara Sov, my sister, your Queen… may be gone. But she is with us now and always. As for you, my friends, my Barons… you embraced me when I was cast out. And for that I gift to you the bounty of the Tangled Shore. Go! Unleash upon the Fallen… chaos.
The Barons exit the throne room.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: You would be proud. The Reefborn's love for their Queen remains… undiminished.
Mara Sov appears next to Uldren.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Love is fleeting. But devotion… now that is forever. Not one of them has ever shown more strength of devotion than you, my dear brother. The Awoken cannot be trusted. You and I know that better than anyone. Together we can bestow upon our people the fortune they so richly deserve… Extinction.
Uldren tosses the torch to the floor, engulfing the throne in flames.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Come, Brother. Let us see what dreams may come.
The camera pans over shots of the Tangled Shore.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Tangled Shore. A lawless frontier of outlaws, scavengers, and pirates. Murderers like Uldren and his Fallen would fit right in. We need to search the Shore - from the Fallen camps in Quitter's Well to that ancient Awoken Watchtower on the horizon. Leave no stone unturned. Uldren can't hide from us.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora told us Cayde's killers are skulking about the Tangled Shore. It's not much of a lead, but it's all we've got. Let's get to searching. Uldren and his gang of Fallen can't hide from us.
The Guardian searches the Tangled Shore for Uldren and the Barons.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've marked a suspicious energy signature on your display. Might be worth checking out.
The Guardian finds a terminal. Ghost hacks the terminal. A wall nearby disappears, revealing the entrance to a tunnel.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Huh. Well, that's gotta be something.
The Guardian heads into the tunnel.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is some kind of smuggler's tunnel.

The Guardian finds a terminal. Ghost hacks the terminal. A wall nearby disappears, revealing a path further into the tunnel. The Guardian defeats the Scorn they encounter and continue through the tunnel, eventually finding their way outside.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those were the creatures we fought in the Prison of Elders. They're spreading.
The Fanatic and the other Barons appear on a nearby ridge.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Perhaps you will give my children a better fight than your friend CAYDE.
The Barons disappear. The Guardian defeats the Scorn which appear. The Guardian scans the corrupted Servitor.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're sucking the Ether out of this Servitor. Corrupting it.
More Scorn appear. The Guardian defeats the Scorn.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: You're late. Here I was thinking I'd be hunting Uldren alone.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: We need to talk. Face-to-face. I'm on my way to see an old acquaintance. Word is he wants Uldren and his Barons dead as much as we do. Problem is, the feeling is mutual, so my acquaintance is laying low in a hidden bunker. If we want him to open the door, we can't leave any witnesses - clear the area.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn. The energy shield drops, opening the path ahead.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm sending you some backup. Please - don't shoot the backup.
The Guardian meets up with two Fallen, Arrha and Avrok, Spider's Associates.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Oh, did I forget to mention that?
The Guardian descends in the elevator. They defeat the Scorn in the first area.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not that I'm complaining, but why are Fallen fighting against other Fallen?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Scorn aren't Fallen. Not anymore.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn in the second area.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Barons' leader, the Fanatic, has the power to resurrect dead Fallen as frenzied, bloodthirsty puppets. And he believes Uldren gave him that power.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn in the third area.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So Uldren and the Barons murder Cayde… and then come here. What's so special about the Tangled Shore?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That's not my secret to tell, Guardian. It's the Reef's. I'll say this: Uldren sent the Barons here for a reason. I just need to confirm my suspicions.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn in the fourth area.
The Guardian heads towards the Spider's lair. A wall disappears revealing the entrance to the Spider's Lair. The Guardian finds Petra Venj and approaches her.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Shine your shoes, Guardian. You're about to meet… the Spider.
The Guardian and Petra Venj enter the Spider's Lair. They approach the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Ah! [laughter] Well, if it isn't Petra Venj, the worst jailer in the solar system! What brings you to my home away from home away from home? On the run, are we?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I heard you lost the Shore…

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Thought you might want some help getting it back.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: A Guardian! And where oh where, pray tell, is its Ghost?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Never mind the Ghost. There were two Guardians at the Prison of Elders when it fell: Cayde-6… and this one. The three of us want the same thing, Spider. Uldren and his Barons. Dead.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: What it is you're… Oh ho ho, I see! Haha. Despite our clear, mutually aligned interests, I'm sorry, but I can't help but feel like it is I who will come up short.
Petra Venj begins to reach for her knife.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: It's true. I know where Uldren and his "Barons" scheme. You go, scratch your itch. Then we can just say… you owe me. Do we have a deal?
Petra Venj removes her hand from her knife's hilt.
The Guardian speaks to the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: One more thing before I give you the location of the Barons' soiree. The Prison of Elders continues to leak like a sieve. SOMEONE should clean up that mess before traipsing off for murder and mayhem. What do you say, "friend"? Quid pro quo before you go?
The Guardian speaks to Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm sorry about Cayde. He didn't deserve to... [sigh] And my people are in ruins. Those who knelt to Uldren, he slaughtered. The rest have scattered. But it's not too late for revenge. Here. This bow is for you, straight from the Vestian armory. Let's go set things right.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Invitation of the Nine - Mystery and Potential (Visit 3)

title: HyperNet Current: Briefing from Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Thanks for the… drive. When we take on this job, get the augs and everything, the clock starts ticking. Ten years may not seem like a lot, especially to you, but it's well spent. It's worth it. I can't think of a single Strider that went before their expiration date— We've got way bigger problems right now. We need to get Neomuna's defenses working again. I've got reports of Shadow Legion attempting to get up close and personal with the VexNet. I have absolutely no idea why, apart from the breathtaking views this time of axial tilt. But we're not waiting around to find out. That sounds like a good plan. Right? It's what he would've— No. That doesn't matter. You and I are gonna see this through. Ready when you are.

title: Homecoming — Transcript

lines.text: Hall of Guardians, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Ikora, if you tell me this is a practical joke. Well, it kills me to say it, but I - I would be really impressed.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Impressing you, Cayde, is the easiest thing I'll do all day.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Zavala! This is my serious face. Can't you tell?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Someone or something has sabotaged the Skyline Defense Systems.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: And comms have been spotty for the last few hours. Every sensor beyond the wall has gone dark.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Hmmm… Maybe it's just the storm. Maybe it's… What are the sat feeds telling us?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: No! I mean, they're not there. There are no satellites.
Zavala sees approaching armada of warships coming out of the storm
Warships fire missiles at The Tower
Zavala forms Ward of Dawn, and Ikora blinks herself and Cayde-6 inside
Zavala struggles to maintain the Ward under heavy fire. The armada passes overhead flying toward The Traveler

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Repeat, Tower Approach, this is City Hawk seven-two-three. Anyone home…?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No response on any channels, even the emergency frequencies. [sigh] What is going on back there? Remember when I told you that you fly too fast? Forget I said that. Fly fast.
Tower Watch, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Let's get moving. We need to find Zavala, Ikora, and Cayde.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This doesn't make sense. The Cabal conquer systems by blowing up planets.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Whatever they want, it must be here – in the Last City.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: This is Commander Zavala. Civilians: report to evac points. Guardians: rendezvous in the Plaza. Our City will not fall.
Cayde-6 appears in doorway fighting Cabal

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey you two! Gimme a sec.
Cayde-6 defeats the Cabal with his Golden Gun

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Zavala's doing the hero act in the Plaza. Me? I've got a date with whoever's behind this. It'll be a short date.
Guardian meets up with Shaxx defending civilians

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Ah, Saladin's Young Wolf. My armory is open to you. Follow the path from there. It will lead you through the hangar to the plaza. I'll take care of these people. If the Cabal want war, give them war.
Guardian picks up The Last Dance and Origin Story

lines.speaker: Tower Announcement
lines.text: Evacuation order Seven Seven is in effect. This is not a drill. All civilians report to designated evacuation areas immediately.
Tower Hangar, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look at the size of that thing. It must be their command ship.
Guardian defeats a flying Cabal squad

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: OK. My Ghost keeps tagging these Cabal as "Red Legion." Ikora what do you got?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: They're elite. Ruthless. And rumor is, they have never known defeat.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Until today. Today, they face Guardians.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But Zavala! They're attacking the Traveler!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Traveler waits! We protect our people. At any cost.
Tower Plaza, The Last City, Earth
Guardian arrives at the Tower plaza where Zavala is defending against Red Legion

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: These Red Legion are well trained. But we are better. We will hold this line until the last civilian is safely away.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Incoming! Fall back to my shield!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Don't let them past the gate! The evac shuttles are back there!
Guardian and Zavala defeat the first wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We hold here. That command ship - it's next on my list.
Guardian and Zavala defeat the second wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: More Red Legion! Show them what Guardians are made of!
Guardian and Zavala defeat the third wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Zavala, the last of the shuttle is away. But the Speaker - he never made it. I'm going to look for him.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've got the plaza. Go with Ikora. Find the Speaker!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Another barrage! Go Guardian!!! Just go! I'll take care of these.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need to find The Speaker.
Running towards the North Tower, the Guardian passes sweeper bot who has found her whistle protocol
Tower North, The Last City, Earth
Ikora Nova Bombs a squad of Red Legion

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Speaker is gone. Red Legion, you will take no more from us. And you will find no mercy in me!
Ikora jumps on a Cabal ship

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: She'll find the Speaker. We need to move that command ship. Now head to the North Tower. I'm sending Amanda Holliday to pick you up.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Holliday is inbound. We need that ship of the field!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Someone told me you need a ride.
Amanda transmats the Guardian onto her ship

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Zavala, picked up that Guardian you never shut up about.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Get them on that command ship - Now!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Come on, big guy. Do something.
The ship is hit by minor fire
Amanda pulls up to an unshielded area of the command ship

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: All right, Guardian! Time to kick'em where it hurts.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Let us know when the shields are down and we'll hit that ship with everything we got.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That hologram could help. Let me take a look.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK, the shield generator should be at the bottom of the ship.
Guardian defeats Pashk, the Searing Will

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh… little low on ammo. The whole flaming pistol [static] burning out. Anyone… [static]… heard from Ikora?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Not since she went [static] for the Speaker. Form up! [static] on me!
Guardian defeats Brann, The Unbent Blade

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The shield generator should be straight ahead.
Guardian defeats Kreth, the Living Skyfire

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right. Destroy the turbines. The shields should fizzle.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala! We did it! The shields are down!
The Guardian runs onto the back deck to see the Traveler being caged

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How do we come back from this?

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: You don't. Welcome to a world without Light.
Ghaul activates the device around the Traveler and the Guardian loses their light

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Do not look at me, creature!

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: You are weak. Undisciplined. Cowering behind walls. You're not brave. You've merely forgotten the fear of death. Allow me to reacquaint you.
Ghaul punches Guardian towards the end of his ship, Ghost falls off the edge

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Your kind never deserved the power you were given. I am Ghaul. And your light… is mine.
Ghaul kicks Guardian off the command ship

lines.text: Our home... Everything's gone. The Tower.. The City...

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: Big armour, bigger guns. Like giant space rhinos; smash first, ask questions never.

lines.speaker: Zavala
