lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey you two! Gimme a sec.
Cayde-6 defeats the Cabal with his Golden Gun

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Zavala's doing the hero act in the Plaza. Me? I've got a date with whoever's behind this. It'll be a short date.
Guardian meets up with Shaxx defending civilians

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Over here, Hunter/Titan/Warlock. My armoury is open to you. Follow the path from there. It will lead you through the hangar to the plaza. I'll take care of these people. If the Cabal want war, give them war.

lines.speaker: Tower Announcement
lines.text: Evacuation order Seven Seven is in effect. This is not a drill. All civilians report to designated evacuation areas immediately.
TOWER HANGAR, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: Look at the size of that thing. It must be their command ship.
Guardian defeats a flying a cabal squad

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: They're not just assaulting the City. Look at the Traveler!

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: OK. My Ghost keeps tagging these Cabal as "Red Legion." Ikora what d'ya got?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Rumors, mostly. An elite faction of the Cabal, deathly loyal to their commander. But that is irrelevant. They are attacking the Traveler! We MUST get to it now!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Negative. The Traveler can wait. We will protect our people at any cost.

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: The Traveler... what is that... thing they're attaching to it?
Guardian arrives at the Tower plaza where Zavala is defending against Red Legion

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: These Red Legion are well trained. But we are better. We will hold this line until the last civilian is safely away.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Incoming! Fall back to my shield!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Don't let them past the gate! The evac shuttles are back there!
Guardian and Zavala defeat the first wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We hold here. That command ship- it's next on my list.
Guardian and Zavala defeat the second wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: More Red Legion! Show them what Guardians are made of!
Guardian and Zavala defeat the third wave of enemies

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Zavala, the last of the shuttle is away. But the Speaker - he never made it. I'm going to look for him.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've got the plaza. Go with Ikora. Find the Speaker!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Another barrage! Go Guardian!!! Just go! I'll take care of these.

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: We need to find The Speaker.
Running towards the North Tower, the Guardian passes sweeper bot who has found her whistle protocol
Tower North, The Last City, Earth
Ikora Nova Bombs a squad of Red Legion

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Speaker is gone. Red Legion, you will take no more from us. And you will find no mercy in me!
Ikora jumps on a Cabal ship

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: She'll find the Speaker. We need to move that command ship. Now head to the North Tower. I'm sending Amanda Holliday to pick you up.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Amanda's inbound! She'll drop you on the command ship.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Someone told me you need a ride.
Amanda transmats the Guardian onto her ship

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Zavala, picked up that Guardian you never shut up about.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Get them on that command ship - Now!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: : Come on, big guy. Do something.
The ship is hit by minor fire
Amanda pulls up to an unshielded area of the command ship

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: All right, Guardian! Time to kick'em where it hurts.
THE IMMORTAL Command Ship, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Let us know when the shields are down and we'll hit that ship with everything we got.

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: : That hologram could help. Let me take a look.

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: Let me at that console. We can find a schematic in there. OK, the shield generator should be at the bottom of the ship.
Guardian defeats Pashk, the Searing Will

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh... little low on ammo. The whole flaming pistol [static] burning out. Any... [static]... heard from Ikora?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Not since she went [static] for the Speaker. Form up! [static] on me!
Guardian defeats Brann, The Unbent Blade

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: The shield generator should be straight ahead.
Guardian defeats Kreth, the Living Skyfire

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: All right. Destroy the turbines. The shields should fizzle.

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: Zavala! We did it! The shields are down!
The Guardian runs out onto the back deck to see the Traveller being encircled

lines.speaker: GHOST
lines.text: How do we come back from this?

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Welcome to a world without Light.
Ghaul activates the device around the Traveller and the Guardian loses their light

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Do not look at me, creature!

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: You are weak. Undisciplined. Cowering behind walls. You're not brave. You've merely forgotten the fear of death. Allow me to reacquaint you.
Ghaul punches Guardian towards the end of his ship, Ghost falls off the edge

lines.speaker: Ghaul
lines.text: Your kind never deserved the power you were given. I am Ghaul. And your light... is mine.
Ghaul kicks Guardian off the command ship
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Parts Long Lost, A Moment In Time

title: HyperNet Current: Interlude with Caiatl — Transcript

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: The Neomuni are a tenacious people. Rohan met his end with honor. He'd be given funeral rites of the highest distinction had he been Cabal. The war is not over. Calus has failed in the eyes of his master, and knowing him, he's about to unleash his barbarity, like a cornered war beast.

title: Hope — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorn already believes Zavala abandoned her and the survivors. Now that we're leaving, if we stay, yes we could help them survive. But if Zavala really is building a counteroffensive on Titan, we can save them all, and take back the City.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Vanguard Fleet; Guardian Ship seven-two-three is on approach. We received your beacon, and we're here ready to join the fight.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian Ship, this is Zavala. It's too late. The Hive have overrun Titan. I was wrong to bring us here…

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: No! We've already lost too many Lightless Guardians to the Hive. We can't secure this moon.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Commander, if I may. Guardian, this is Deputy Commander Sloane. We have a counter-offensive to plan. To do that, we need to get this station up and running. There's a fleet to prep, Guardians to arm, and a trove of intercepted Red Legion transmissions to decrypt. It's critical we gain access to the station's Control Center. That's where you come in. If the Light really is with you, send the Hive back to hell.
Guardian makes their way across the understructure of the base

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Golden Age cities of Titan were once the pride of humanity. We thought they were abandoned. But I was a fool to think the Hive would not spread this far.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I have a bad feeling about this…
Guardian fights off a pack of feeding Hive, and comes across some floating rocks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The gravity on Titan is approximately 1.352 meters per second squared, except here. These floating rocks must be a residual effect from some Hive magic.
A swarm of thrall attack near a cocoon sack

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's a… cocoon of some kind. the life inside it isn't Hive, exactly. This could be how the Hive's symbiont worms grow.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, Sloane. We can see the Control Center.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Copy that. Keep pushing forward. Commander. At this rate, we can start planning our counteroffensive. We'll be outside the City gates in no time.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Hmm. If it were only that simple.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I shudder to think what spell the Hive were casting back there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We should talk to Eris Morn. She would know which Hive god they were communing with.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: No one has seen Eris - or Ikora or Cayde - since The City fell.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We should talk to Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Clear the area so we can move in.
Guardian clears the area of a small army of Hive.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Perfect. Recon the perimeter before you move on the Control Center
Guardian fights off a pack of thrall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So it looks like we're standing in some kind of Hive breeding ground.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We cleared the nest. Heading to the Control Center now.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Well done. Sweep the perimeter, and we'll move in on your signal.
Guardian discovers a broken servitor in the hive breeding ground

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A broken servitor. These parts are extremely valuable. The Hive corrosion must be really bad for the Fallen to abandon it like this.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Copy that. Zavala and I are inbound. We're approaching the landing platform. Get up here, and take a bow.
Sloane and Zavala are dropped off by their ship on the landing platform. Sloane jogs by, giving the Guardian a respectful nod.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I didn't dare believe it. If the Light can find its way back to you, then perhaps there is hope for us all. Our numbers will continue to dwindle. We can no longer protect ourselves, much less the survivors. And without the Light… are we even Guardians anymore?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We won't last long with dead generators. Wave Energy Converters power this station. But thanks to the Hive, they're in need of… attention

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can take care of it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: HyperNet Current: Neomuna Civil News — Transcript

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: [Neomuna News with Jisu Calerondo musical jingle] With Neomuna Civil News, this is Jisu Calerondo reporting. It is with a heavy heart I must report the passing of our senior Cloud Strider, Rohan, who perished while defending our city from Shadow Legion forces. Rohan is succeeded by the protégé, Nimbus. The council has scheduled a vigil soon to pay homage to this great hero. Good night, Neomuna, and good luck.

title: Idle Dialogue: Nimbus, Neomuna — Transcript

lines.text: Idle Dialogue from Nimbus in Neomuna.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I know you’re busy out there, but if you get a chance, take a look around. Neomuna is a beautiful place.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: It’s too bad you haven’t seen Neomuna at its finest. Lights, music, and people on every corner! Real people, not just their mobile platforms! It’s incredible…

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Ugh, I wish the Thrilladrome was still running. I bet you'd love it!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Shadow Legion, Shmadow Legion! We’ll kick ‘em out of Neomuna in no time.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Rohan always says "battles are won with strength, but wars are won with brains." Lucky for all of us you have both, yeah?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Got some weird chatter in the CloudArk lately. I could use a hand.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Now that you're here, the Vex won't know what hit 'em!

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I'm seeing hostile movement in the city. Could use your help.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I hear the coders are real curious about you, Exo. Something about seeing if your processors are compatible with the CloudArk.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: So hang on, let me get this straight. The Awoken have a magic city with an ancient queen out there? [laughs] That. Is. Awesome.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Hey, can you do that cool glowy magic hand thing again?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: You Warlocks are good at synthesizing information, right? I could use your eyes on this.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Have you gotten to see the Farm yet? It’s nice out there. Well, it was nicer before all the fighting started, but still...

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: New data's coming in. Want to take a look?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Got some new intel. Come take a look.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: That's some neat hardware you've got there.

title: Ice and Shadow — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Life is a delicate thing, Guardian. Hope… faith… love… In an instant they're gone. Everything you've sworn to protect is lost. And all you're left with is silence and shadow… and the knowledge that you should've done more.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Could we have defeated Ghaul if the Traveler hadn't awakened? And what of the next threat? Or the next? What then? The Traveler is awake… and the Age of Legends is upon us.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: In the shadow of the light, our universe is a beautiful, terrible place. Where I once saw miracles… now I see monsters. Someone has to. We have to. That's what a Guardian does.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Guardians aren't supposed to investigate their past. That's the rule. But I'm not good with rules. Not when there's this much at stake.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The Clovis Bray tech in that building allowed us to colonize the system during the Golden Age. We – they sought to create peace for all Humanity. Which is ironic, because they also built Rasputin… the single most powerful weapon in the solar system.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Either way, it's all been entombed on Mars since the collapse… along with something far more terrifying.

Ana Bray jumps off the cliff. Frozen Hive emerge through the ice. The ice begins to break apart. Ana uses one of her knives to stop herself sliding down a large piece of broken ice and climbs to the top of the ice. The shadow of a massive creature passes over Ana.
The Guardian's ship heads towards Mars.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Mars – the first place where humanity encountered the Traveler. Home to the Clovis Bray Research Facility, and lost wonders of the Golden Age. The icecaps have kept those wonders hidden for hundreds of years. But the return of the Traveler's Light has sounded an alarm heard throughout the system…and perhaps beyond.
A Warsat falls from orbit towards Mars.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Red War is over, but Ghaul's forces, what remains of them, have been scavenging during their retreat. And now that Warsats are falling out of orbit near Mars, the Cabal are headed there too. I'll plot a landing course.
An alarm sound suddenly goes off.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Mayday! Mayday! Do you copy! Vanguard access code 0306… GET AWAY FROM MY GHOST, YOU FROZEN – Guardian, requesting backup! I repeat! I need backup down here!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This frequency is reserved for official Vanguard business. So, look, whoever this is…

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That's cute! You've got one of the uptight ghosts.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I'm uploading coordinates to a safe landing zone. Please hurry.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right, but you're going to owe us for this one.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I wouldn't have called you down here unless it was absolutely critical. The most dangerous weapon in the system is on this planet, and an entire army of Hive is trying to destroy it. I need your help.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've touched down on the surface of Mars, Guardian. What's your status? Are you safe?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: For now, but there's a whole lot of "not safe" between us and the Clovis Bray facility, which is where we need to be.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Warsats, like the one that almost hit you on approach, have been dropping out of the sky since I got here. Which usually means one thing…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Rasputin? The "greatest weapon of the Golden Age" you were talking about? But…that's impossible.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Nothing is impossible where Rasputin is concerned. Meet me at the facility.
The Guardian heads into the ice cavern. While traversing the cavern, Hive suddenly emerge from the ground and attack the Guardian. The Guardian defeats the Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've never seen Hive like this before.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: As far as I know, they don't exist anywhere but here.
The Guardian continues through the cavern.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think it might be time to call in help from the Vanguard.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Not a great idea. Zavala won't be happy about us digging around Bray. He wants the past to stay buried. But we need to get in there to find out what's going on with Rasputin.
Hive appear and attack the Guardian. The Guardian defeats the hostile Hive.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: We've found a Golden Age research facility buried inside a glacier. Where do you think? Meet me at the entrance to Clovis Bray.
The Guardian approaches a door. A Hive Knight charges toward the Guardian. Ana Bray shoots the Knight from behind, killing it.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Well, there were a lot of them. But you did great.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Come on, let's see what's hiding in here! Besides hordes and hordes of frozen Hive, I mean.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: H.E.L.M. SECURITY LOCKDOWN: Investigate the Distress Call — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian arrives to investigate the cause of a communications black out at the H.E.L.M. A large projection of Calus appears above the War Table.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: You never cease to entertain me, little Guardians. Time and again, you have moved me to applause. And have I ever withheld your gilded reward? No, for I am magnanimous. Generous. Forgiving. And so, I grant you yet another gift: one last chance at salvation. The Witness, in all its glory, has set its covetous gaze upon your Traveler. You cannot stop it. Light burns for only so long. A feeble flame, easily… extinguished. But you need not share that fate. I invite you to instead join me in revelry, and embrace the inevitable. Alas, you have always been… stubborn. So if you insist on being devoured… Then I will savor your final moments. Until our next reunion… Guardian.

title: In Search of Answers — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Pyramid's warding is only a temporary inconvenience. We must first understand how it works if we're to pass through it. For that, the Hive may provide answers. For eons, they've lived next to the Pyramid. And now they've constructed that Scarlet Keep above it. Its existence was clearly no secret to them. Now that it's activated, strange congregations of Hive have begun to appear on the Moon. There is undoubtedly a connection.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, we found it. It appears to be a ritual of some kind.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We must learn its purpose. Do not be afraid to engage the Hive.
The Guardian defeats the Hive and collects six Ruined Tablets.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, it's the Nightmares. The Hive are trying to draw them in for the ritual.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's unclear. But they don't seem affected by the Nightmares at all. Not like we are.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Fascinating. We must learn how they've achieved that. That's our key to finding a way beyond the Pyramid's war—
A terrible scream is heard over the comm channel and Eris's signal cuts out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris?! Those screams. That's a Hive Wizard. We have to hurry.
The Guardian returns to Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sai Mota screams as she did the day Omnigul tore her apart and silenced her forever. Our fates nearly intertwined today when a Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp. My survival was a gift, granted by the Essence you retrieved from the Crota Nightmare. Were we to truly harness the power of this Essence, it may provide aid in the fight against the Nightmares — and beyond, to the Pyramid itself. It knows we're coming. I can sense it. And we will have the upper hand.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: In The Deep — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Catacombs. Somewhere within that Hive-infested labyrinth lies our Cryptoglyph. If we hope to go beyond the Pyramid's warding, we must retrieve it. But be warned: Those who enter the rotting depths of the Catacombs often fail to return… In that tomb, light does not find a way.
The Guardian heads towards the Catacombs, defeating any Hive which they encounter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's our entrance, over on the other side of the pit.
The Guardian continues towards the Catacombs.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Never are the Catacombs unmanned, as they play host to the most potent of Hive magics — including our Cryptoglyph. We know not what the Hive plan to do with power as dangerous as this. But they must not find success. The dark rituals of the Hive pose a threat we can't currently afford to face. If their goals align with ours, it is of utmost importance they be halted immediately.
The Guardian heads into the Catacombs, defeating any Hive which they encounter. The Guardian opens a Hive gate and continues further into the Catacombs.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It was within these depths that Crota and his brood stripped me of all that I cared for — my fireteam… my friends. Only I remained, beaten and broken. The guilt of survival lingers… But you must not. Onward.
The Guardian reaches an area near the Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Pyramid… My Light… It's happening again.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Focus. The Pyramid distracts, nothing more. When you have the Cryptoglyph in hand, I will teleport you out.
The Guardian conjures a bridge across the chasm and crosses it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: More Phantoms… just like those haunting Eris. Faceless Guardians watching us. They're nothing more than a distraction.

The Guardian tries to get the Cryptoglyph but a hive barrier appears around it. The Guardian defeats the Hive which appear, including both of the Scholars of the Cryptoglyph. Besurith, Daughter of Crota appears. The Guardian defeats Besurith, Daughter of Crota and takes the Cryptoglyph.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, we have the Cryptoglyph. Teleport us out. …Eris? Are you there?
The Guardian escapes from the Catacombs.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I thought you'd… I'm sorry. The immense darkness of the Pyramid kept me from you. But we must not waste time. With the Cryptoglyph in hand, we stand a chance against the Pyramid. Bring it here, and let us make use of it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Into the Depths I: Bring the coral to Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: An oasis in the desert. Seeds of hope… buried beneath the sands… Nomads… wanderers… travelers. Their journey comes to an end… The first to be claimed by the Deep… [breathes uneasily] the first to fall victim to the Witness… [gasps for air]

title: HyperNet Current: Interlude with Osiris — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Seeing Nimbus right now reminds me how difficult it was to move on after my losses. My pain was always secondary. I felt that pain deeply when I lost Saint. But I channeled it into bringing him back to me. I couldn't bring Sagira back. But… [sighs] Our pain is a reminder: we are still breathing. Still fighting.

title: Hijacked — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: One of my Hidden has located an Entangled Mind for you. That class of Vex Mind should provide the processing power you need.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Great. We'll find it and take its brain.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I think we're on the right track.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Those Vex were patrolling here for a reason. Let's keep looking around.
The Guardian finds the Entangled Mind

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: That's the Vex we need. Go get it.
The Guardian defeats the Entangled Mind and scavenges the Mind Core.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Excellent, this is our processor. I just need to connect it to the Vex network.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: You're near the Well of Echoes.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Right. The confluxes there should work.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Get me to the conflux, and I'll plug in the processor.
The Guardian uses materialising platforms to reach the conflux

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: I hope this does the trick.
Sagira plugs in the processor to the conflux.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Bad news- the processor shorted out. I'm getting an image, but no coordinates. I'm out of ideas here.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: We've been so focused on the threat of the future… What if the answer lies in the past? If you found the code that created Panoptes, you could use the Infinite Forest against the Vex.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: YES! We go back to the moment that led to Panoptes, run time forward and use THAT data to find its location in the present! Oh, thats good, Ikora. Osiris level good. You know, you're not the same Ikora I remember. You're better.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Into the Depths II: Mayday, Mayday — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Fireteam, prep your dive loadouts. We've received a mayday call from an off-site coral extraction team.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Síocháin, add their search-and-rescue IDs to our objectives.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You're first on site. Find our missing Guardians, get their sites back online, and break down any resistance. Saint-14 will provide tactical oversight.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Let's bring our missing crew home.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm on the move, Guardian. Good luck out there.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: No—today, I sit in chair. But is good chair.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Do we have the missing fireteam's last known?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Yes—now so do you. You will find them; I know it.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I’m just hoping they got turned around. It can be disorienting down there.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Help them find the surface, and things make sense again. Like having sea legs, and then on land… it takes time, yes?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I’m not sure what you mean.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Oh, we're talking about me now. Can we stow this until I'm back?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I mean to say… I understand becoming lost.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [sighs] Big guy, I know you want to help, but I'm about to be shot at here.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Wait, a fight? Very good—what can I do?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Start marking targets! I'll knock 'em down.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I've got bodies on the approach to Delta Site.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [sighs] Damn it. The gear's offline. We need to get these running.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I SOW THE DEATH YOU SEW. YOUR NEEDLE IS A BRUTAL, EFFICIENT VIOLENCE.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Fireteam! Payload secure, and all transmats locked. Turn your attention to the Wizard.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm already in contact. Tagged 'em, but they're headed to ambush you.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Send this Wizard back to the Sea of Screams.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I used to know every fireteam that passed through Titan's rig. These Guardians—I don't recognize them.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You have spent a great deal of time pushing forward. Stop, sit, rest! You will come to know again. Then you will find others to push with you. Like now.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Heh, you don't have an off switch do you, Saint?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [chuckles] I need to go see Ahsa. Send me their names?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: They will be in your debriefing.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Thanks, Tactical. [takes deep breath] Sloane out.

title: Into the Depths II: Bring the coral to Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: A city of Light… a… a flourishing garden… A silent god… withholds a deeper truth. Questions unanswered, uh… longing… unfulfilled. The sky… darkens… as a new journey begins. [gasps for air]

title: Into the Depths II: Return to the H.E.L.M. — Transcript

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Commander, Guardian—were you waiting here for me?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Just considering the pieces on the board, Saint.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You worry for the deputy commander. She is strong, and her friend is very large. They will be OK.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Sloane will do what's necessary. But after that, things are less… simple.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: When I was trapped in the Infinite Forest, before Osiris broke time to reunite us… There were many days I felt lost. [chuckles] But I am here, and you are all with me again.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: That you are. A hero of the City… then and now.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: A hero? Yes. Though… my memory differs from what the stories say.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: There's only so much I can do behind a desk, weighing costs and outcomes. Sending someone else never sits right with me. [takes a deep breath] I'd rather the clarity of the battlefield, beside the two of you.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: The burden of good leaders—to never feel we have done enough. But trusting those we send is what makes us strong.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You were Vanguard Commander once. What made you step down?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Because I am not as strong as you. You carry the command for the same reason the Guardian and I stand in the trenches. To set the example. To be the hope. When the time comes, you will see it too, ah? I know you will.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Into the trenches then, Guardian. Yours on Titan, and mine in the Tower. I look forward to your report.

title: Idle Dialogue: Tyra Karn, Felwinter's Peak — Transcript

lines.text: Idle Dialogue from Tyra Karn at Felwinter's Peak during Rise of Iron (D1)

lines.speaker: Tyra
lines.text: Did you know that Servitors are a relatively new invention of the Fallen? They begin to appear in the records shortly after the event they call the Whirlwind. Quite an interesting correlation, don’t you think?

title: Into the Depths II: Speak with Zavala — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian. Operations on Titan are in full swing. Drifter believes he can further improve his modified bank to work at greater depths. He will require more salvage from the sunken Arcology. Acquire it for him so we can continue enhancing Sloane's link with Ahsa. This mission… Sloane's been through enough as it is. I informed her of everything that transpired while she was MIA. Guardians using the Darkness, Savathûn's deception, the Witness attacking the Traveler… [sighs] and Amanda. The two of them were close. Word of Amanda's death hit Sloane hard. I saw it in her eyes. The moment when the news landed… …And the moment she buried it. I don't like putting this mission on Sloane. But I recognize her need for it. Her need for an objective… and a commander to assign it. What I need is for you stand beside her in the trenches. Show her that she doesn't have to fight this battle alone. We'll all see this through together.

title: Into the Depths I: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: So you heard all of that, huh? Hard to believe, but it's not just noise. I can understand bits and pieces of it through Ahsa. Xivu Arath's thirst for battle, the… Witness's cold rage. The Taken's enmity. It's all in there. I started hearing it when my arm got this new paint job. But it hasn't sounded that real since… Doesn't matter. I've been through it before, and I can get through it again. Ahsa has vital information about the Witness. I'll do whatever it takes so she can deliver it. That's the mission, and I always complete the mission. Ahsa and I both need to recover before we boost our connection again. Until then, continue helping Drifter upgrade his technology. I hate to admit it, but his plan seems like it might actually work.

title: Into the Depths III: Speak with Saladin — Transcript

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Your efforts are paying off, Young Wolf. It's time for another dive, and another haul of coral for the deputy commander. Assuming, of course, that you can prevent the Deep from drowning you like a rat. Not that I'm worried about your capacity to do so. Especially when Sloane's fighting by your side. She's always been one to shoulder a burden so that others need not. That's something I understand all too well. After the Iron Lords fell, I alone remained to keep the torches lit. To hold the banner high… and honor those who died in the line of duty. It was… a lonely path. One I walked for centuries without complaint. Now, a legion of my former enemies walks beside me. I had forgotten what such camaraderie could be like. And I suspect the same holds true for Sloane. Keep that in mind when the two of you are in the depths. There's no weapon more powerful than the soldier standing next to you.

title: Into the Depths IV: Return to the H.E.L.M. — Transcript

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [laughs] Sure is. You ever been outside of Sol?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Mm. Can't say I recommend it. Saw some stuff while I was out there. Bad stuff. A world colder than you can imagine. Creatures that suppressed the Light. My crew… Let's just say we wore out our welcome. Creatures started closing in. Trigger fingers got itchy. Some of us froze to death. A Lightless, final death. The others… they didn't go so quiet. Not until I shut them up. Not sure how long I stayed after that. Had to mod my Ghost to survive. Used the parts from… [takes a deep breath] I did what it took to get off-world. And now, I'm here.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm no stranger to combat, but… How did you leave it all behind?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [inhales sharply] …I didn't. Some things, you carry with you forever. But eventually, they stop feeling too heavy to lift.

title: Into the Depths II: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: It's hard to make sense of Ahsa's thoughts… but they're coming into focus, Taken interference be damned. Hearing those sounds… puts me right back in the thick of it. Staying on the move, gun in hand, Xivu Arath's voice in my head. Escape and evade. No matter how bad things got, that routine kept me going. And Ahsa kept me safe. She shored up my resolve. Helped me find food. Watched over me when I caught a few hours of shut eye. Now she's doing everything she can to tell us what she knows. We're both on a new mission. Unfortunately, Drifter needs to tinker with his machine before we bank more coral. Hurry up and wait, right? I've been around a long time, Guardian. Seen a lot of action, gone on a lot of sorties. Always ready for the next set of orders. It's staying still that gets to me.

title: Into the Depths III: Bring the coral to Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Shrouded in… Darkness. A promise of something more… Two halves of a whole… long divided. A… schism between them. Reunited. [exhales in joy] A glimpse beyond… to the beginning… [gasps for air]

title: Into the Depths III: Operation Fulgurite — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Fireteam, this is Operation Fulgurite. Scans have uncovered a rich shelf of Egregore coral at a depth we've yet to explore. So rich, in fact, that it has attracted the attention of a Taken Knight and their minions.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: And they’re radiating Taken energy, turning our haul rancid.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Uh, you don't mind if I take it from here—do ya, Big Blue? Good. We're diving into the dark and robbin' the Taken blind! Woo! Let's be heroes.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Just so we're clear: disrespect the commander again, I'll hurl you off the Arcology like a shot put.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That all it'll take to get you to surface? I'm betting the ocean floor feels like home sweet home now… eh, chief?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Get swallowed up by anything big while you were out there?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [sighs] Not much cover at seafloor. Before Ahsa, they tried.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Doesn't sound so bad. Open space, cozy long-girl. How'd you sleep?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Like a lamb in power armor—stay on mission! And don't call her that.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Thing is… since you strapped on that rig and walked out into the deep, I've been itching to know… you regret it?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Worried you couldn't hack it? From what I hear, you're a survivalist.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [chuckles] I've run from every damn thing, if that's surviving. But, uh… you commit.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [sighs] I'm fixing to commit to something stupid myself—get swept up in a cause. So be real. You regret it?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Vanguard had a file on you. Doesn't paint you as the hero type. YOU might regret it.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Deploying tsunameter. This whole shelf is contaminated.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOUR VIOLENCE BEARS OFFERINGS: I ACCEPT THEM. SLAY, BE SLAIN, RISE. DRINK, AND LET SPILL. IN THIS STRIFE, YOU ARE HOME.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Keep it coming. I've seen you run Motes faster than this—pick it up!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, I just tangoed with a massive Taken Knight—clocked 'em, but they're right behind me. I'll keep their attention—wait. They're gone!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That Knight's headed your way, hero. Get ready for a showdown.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm cut off. Give 'em hell, Guardian!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: KELGORATH, TAKEN FROM BONES, FIGHT FOREVER!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Aw, they shoulda kept running! Look at 'em now: they're dead! Ha ha!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [pants heavily] Well, if you didn't need the backup, I could have saved myself the leg cramps. [exhales in exhaustion] Let's exfil. Get this back to the long-girl—yes, I like it—and hear what she's got for us.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: See? It grows on you. Talking with her must be a trip and a half.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [chuckles] It's a bit like… wandering out into the dark. You're lost for a minute., but… then your eyes adjust, and you acclimate. Things normalize.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: One foot in front of the other. Funny how many things work like that.

title: Into the Depths IV: Bring the coral to Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Anathema… calamity! That which cannot, MUST not come to pass… A wordless denial. A fleeing god. Betrayal… and escape. The pursuit… for the final shape… [gasps for air]

title: Into the Depths V: Origin of the Witness — Transcript

lines.text: Sloane (Ahsa): Our minds are one, linked by the Darkness. But only for a moment. I must borrow Sloane's voice to speak my words. Please... heed them well. Before you can confront the Witness... you must understand it. The Witness's first victims were once like you. Struggling for survival. Bolstered by hope... Until their hopes became reality. They called it "the Gardener," their deity of life. It ushered them into a golden age. For eons, they prospered. But their newfound god never spoke to them. It lavished them with gifts, but not with guidance. And though they lived in paradise, they came to crave a greater purpose. They desired meaning. Structure. A "Winnower"... to shape the garden. Their scholars discovered that the Gardener shared a connection with another entity among the stars. They called it "the Veil." And when they found it, they arrived to claim it. They already knew much about the Light. How it could bend the laws of the universe and create life. But they came to realize that it could bring ruin... just as easily. The cosmic events it set in motion could wipe out entire civilizations in a heartbeat... without reason. And so they saw the Light not as a source of prosperity... but of unfettered chaos. By studying the Veil, they came to know the Darkness. A power that was shaped by thought and consciousness. And in the Darkness, they found the means to carve away the chaos of existence. To calcify it into a final shape. Eternal... and perfected. They brought the Veil back to the Gardener in an attempt to strengthen their connection. There, they could reshape reality itself. The Gardener would not allow it. And so, it fled their world. But they would not be deterred. Having witnessed the truth in the Darkness, they used its binding power to merge themselves... into the salvation they craved. Thus began the Witness's pursuit... its campaign to impose meaning on a meaningless universe. One that is nearly at its end. [gasps for air]

title: Into the Depths IV: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We're almost there. My link with Ahsa feels crystal clear. It's… a little frightening, but strangely comforting, too. A lot changed while I was gone. It feels like… like the entire universe moved on without me, and now I'm struggling to catch up. Old enemies became new allies. New enemies wield the Light against us. And old allies… friends… like Amanda… Sometimes I wonder… if I returned to the Tower, would it even be my home anymore? Or would I just be a phantom, a forgotten memory wandering its streets at night? Xivu Arath's voice keeps telling me I don't belong there. That the battlefield is my home. That it always has been. Maybe she's right. Maybe reliving what I went through over and over again is a way for me to… stay in familiar territory. To remain in the hell that I know… and avoid the one I dread. Either way, the mission comes first. I have to see it through to the end, regardless of where I end up when it's done.

title: Into the Depths III: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The plan's working. It's getting easier for me to parse Ahsa's thoughts, like a picture coming into focus. Other things are a little harder for me to wrap my head around. When I first heard of Saladin's "Iron War Beasts," I… didn't know what to think. We lost a lot of people in the Red War. The empire took so much away from us, and now Saladin commands an imperial legion? They're the reason we had to fall back and regroup on Titan. Why I had to send fireteams down into the Arcology, never to return. Those Guardians died under my orders. They paid for our foothold in blood. When the Pyramids arrived… There was no way in hell I'd give it all up without a fight. This? This is nothing compared to what others sacrificed. Completing the mission is how I honor them. Just like Saladin honors the Iron Lords, no matter who he leads into battle against our enemies. Stay the course, Guardian. Once Ahsa and I are ready again, it's back into the depths for us.

title: Into the Depths V: Speak with Saint-14 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Ah, I see you—you see me too? Ha, good, good. Then it is all working: you, me, this projector. Even if we sometimes falter… There is a war building in Sloane's eyes, one that Xivu Arath will exploit, as she did with Osiris. Savathûn wore his face, but it was Xivu Arath who took his Light. Her whips drove him into a frenzy, lured him into danger, forced Sagira's sacrifice… and left him to die. Now she twists my thoughts into thorns… draws out the faces of the suffering Eliksni into my dreams. She whispers that… I took pleasure in their pain. I see their eyes as they died by my hands. And they see me. She does not lie. She challenges what you hold as a strength. Osiris's ambition, my protection… Sloane's duty. I have felt how the right word, the right face, can incite one to violence. But I have changed. What she has taken… it will not break me. Sloane is no warrior of glass, but the war within her… even stone crumbles under enough strife. Stay with her, Guardian, as I should have with Osiris. We must offer her what support we are able, even if she does not want it.

title: Into the Depths V: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Well… now we've heard what Ahsa had to tell us. We know our enemy better than ever. To think that it all started with the need for purpose… how that need became an obsession… [inhales deeply] What bothers me most is how much I… understand it. This mission… it's MY purpose, MY reason for being. My guiding light. Without it, I… I'm lost. I don't know who I am or what I'm supposed to do. And that lack of direction, it's… harder to face than a thousand battles. I felt the same about my previous mission, when I held the line on Titan. And if I'm being honest… …It feels like I failed. I survived, but for what reason? What was it all meant to achieve? The only answer I've found… is to learn what Ahsa knows. If I can do that, it will all have been worth it. Our link ended before Ahsa could explain how to get through the portal. The bond took its toll… but we'll both be ready again soon. When that time has come and gone… then I can feel like I accomplished the mission.

title: Into the Depths VI: Speak with Saladin — Transcript

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Change of plans—Xivu Arath struck while you were returning from the dive. Hive deception slipped through our guard, and Ahsa was targeted by a Hive ritual. Xivu Arath's voice tore through the air like a wall of swords. We think it wounded Ahsa, but she swam off to try and interrupt the ritual before we could do anything. Zavala and Sloane are tracking her to the ritual site, and I am mobilizing the Iron War Beasts to support them. We need you in the fight, Guardian. I'm sending coordinates to your Ghost, but we have no idea what to expect there. Deploy to the ritual site and disrupt the Hive. The hunt is on.

title: Invitation of the Nine - Mystery and Potential (Visit 3) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian jumps through the portal in the Derelict.
The Guardian finds the Emissary and an enormous vision of Mara Sov.

lines.speaker: The Nine
lines.text: THE CLEVER ONE IS IN PERIL.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: Then she will die as one of us. Gladly.

lines.speaker: The Nine
lines.text: SHE WILL REGRET BEFORE THE END.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: You don't know the meaning of that word.

lines.speaker: The Nine
lines.text: SHE WILL BEG FOR DEATH'S RELEASE.

lines.speaker: The Emissary
lines.text: You cannot kill what has already died.

title: Into the Depths VI: Barotrauma — Transcript

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Commander, we've picked up Ahsa's trail deep below Kraken Mare, behind Xivu Arath's battle lines.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Understood. The deputy commander, Saint, and I will set up a perimeter to draw the Hive's attention. Then the Guardian can break through unscathed.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: The Iron War Beasts prepare to support our assault. Say the word.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Keep them in reserve until the Guardian has eyes on Ahsa.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Daylight's burning, and she's in pain. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I'll find you on the field, Sloane. Hit your marks, and we'll get this done. Move out!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Fireteam, check in. I've reached my position on the left flank. I've encountered a ritual.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'm setting up on the right. Looks like a smaller ritual site here too.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Pushing toward the commander's position now.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: My drop pod is deploying to your location, Sloane. Drifter, you're on Tac.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Well, all right. Taken energy's spiking up ahead of you, hero.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: That must be Ahsa—ahh! My arm! Whatever they're doing, it's getting worse. If we're gonna do something about it, now's the time!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, start pushing forward—as soon as Saladin's pod hits ground, we launch our diversion.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Fireteam, report! Saint and I hold the left flank.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: It is working! We draw them off the Guardian!

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Enemy reinforcements flooding the right flank! We're holding.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: OK, hotshot. It's all you now.
THE COWARD FLESH MUST BURN. YOUR WORM WRITHES IN PAIN, AS MINE IN PLEASURE. COME AND TAKE IT, WARRIORS OF THE SKY.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Found the long-girl. Guardian's almost there. Dropping a ping to the fireteam.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: They are overrunning our position! Zavala!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Drop wards and focus fire on their ritualists! No one gets past us!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Is that…? Wait… these rituals… they're trying to Take Ahsa!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Keep your Taken pants on. I ain't never seen a ritual our walking tank couldn't smash.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Don't hesitate, Guardian—she's relying on you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's a whole lotta magic, and I bet those Wizards are holding the reins. Get in there, and start breaking things!

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Every Wizard you put in the dirt makes a dent. Plug away, hero!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: [pants] Ahsa just got a second wind, Guardian—whatever you're doing, keep it up.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: War Beasts, DEPLOY! You will take that position!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: THE COWARD FLESH MUST BE TAKEN.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Last one. Long-girl should be home free.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Excellent work, Guardian. Fireteam, check in.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Down to a sword, but… Hive and Taken forces routed.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: They will not run far. So many Titans; we encircle them like impenetrable walls, ha!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Clear your zones, and fall back to defensive positions around Ahsa as she swims back to the Arcology.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Consider it done. War Beasts, you fought well. Extra rations for all.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I've got an eye on her, and I'm shipping a transmat beacon your way. Hold onto your boots.

title: Into the Depths VI: Return to the H.E.L.M. — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: [sighs] Relying on Savathûn. This is what it's come to.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I am. Ahsa has given us a way to follow the Witness.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: This cannot be the only way.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Everyone in this room understands the risks. But we finally have a path forward; we can't wait for another.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: The Empress won't take kindly to this news.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: You stand on her council. Convince her.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I cannot watch the Witch Queen rise again, Zavala—to scheme against us, to steal another face? No!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: She won't be given the opportunity. Eris and Ikora will keep the situation under our control.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: Immaru isn't one to be baited into a trap.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Not a trap. A bargain. We're all against the Witness. Savathûn's Ghost has no choice but to cooperate.

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: I'll convey your decision and assurances to the Empress. Commander. Guardians.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: We tried to control the Witch Queen before. I saw how that ended, Zavala. It is a treacherous path. When she strays, as I know she will… even one claw…

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: My fist will be right behind yours.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I hope I am wrong. But right now… I cannot see how. Osiris will hear of this. I imagine he will have words too.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: There's a long night ahead of us. Let's be the beacons others need to follow… at least until we make it through this.

title: Into the Depths VI: Speak with Sloane — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We did it, Guardian. Cut a swath through the Taken and got the intel we needed. The mission is complete. I've… waited a long time to say those words. And I used to dread the moment that comes after. But not anymore. I thought I needed the mission to draw my focus, to… drown out all the noise. All of… this. But not focusing on it doesn't mean it isn't there. It's a part of me now. I'll carry it with me wherever I go. And that's OK. I'm strong enough to shoulder that weight, especially… if I don't have to do it alone. Ahsa's in hibernation now. All that strain on our psychic link has worn her out. Poor girl's earned some time to rest. She won't be alone, either. I'll camp out on Titan and watch over her. Just like she watched over me. That's not to say I'll never return to the Tower. When I do… I know there'll be a place for me. And people to welcome me home. Take care, Guardian. And watch your back when you dig up Savathûn. If you ever need to punch her lights out… you know where to find me.

title: Ishtar Collective — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I wish you'd check with me before making insane promises. If we're going to take down a Gate Lord we've got
to find out how these machines operate. Let's find the biggest one we can, pull out its brain and see what we can learn about them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, there's a big Vex signature just up the coast. Let's kill it, whatever it is, and bring its mind core to one of the old Academy research labs.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Up ahead. A ridiculously large Vex emission. Sounds like what we're looking for.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fascinating! Let's head for that research station.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Their mind cores are actually biological, not relative to any known life forms recorded. Maybe the Collective's research can tell us more.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These ruins predate humanity by a few billion years. Vex are coursing through them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nice work. There's got to be a central terminal around here... Found one! Let's see if I can get it to work.

lines.speaker: Ghost

title: Lost to Light — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It began with Crota. But Crota was only a servant of his father, sent to extinguish the last of the Light. The great battle fought for the soul of our world ended in slaughter. The son was dead. And we invited the wrath of Oryx, destroyer of Light. Taker of will. Only Ascendant Hive move between Ruptures. To reach Oryx, you must walk in the dying footsteps of his son. You must become Ascendant.
Circle of Bones, Ocean of Storms, Earth's Moon

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Hold fast to Toland's journal. It saw me through my time in the Dark.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hold fast to your gun, Guardian. You're headed back to the chamber where they held Crota's soul.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Alright. Here's what needs to happen. We have to steal a chunk of Hive crystal that still has a trace of Crota's soul so you can pass through a dimensional portal on the Dreadnaught and kill Oryx.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It must be done before Oryx turns his scrying eye to this realm.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Toland's journal contains an impressive amount of data. I should probably read it... Done. Some of this stuff is fascinating!

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: A Dreadnaught shields the Hive from the Traveler's Light. Were we to pass through its deepest layers, our Light would be as a dying sun.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think Toland was much fun at parties.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If the Thrall still feed, Crota's essence must endure.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's gone. I think Oryx just took an ogre...

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Not even Oryx can control an ogre. Unless it's Taken. Now quickly, I need a shard of that crystal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I knew it could be done. And does it still hold the whisper of Crota's soul?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: According to my analysis it's empty.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No matter. Return to me, Guardian, and we will destroy [static]

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: [static] Guardian? We're losing you. Guardian can you hear...? [static]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris? Cayde? I think we've lost them. Something's blocking our signal and our transmat.
Echo of Oryx and many Taken champions arrive

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's too many of them! Run!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How long do you want to keep doing this?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris? Cayde? Can you hear us...? Still no connection. This must be how the Hive trapped Eris.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Taken have locked us in. Let me check it out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Doors used to be so simple. I'll search the journal.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: It has long been my belief that the binds which hold the greatest Hive terrors could be lifted by releasing the energy stored within their tomb husks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Remind me to make copies of this journal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ugh. They've warded it with two locks this time.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [static] We're going to lose her, just like Eriana!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's Eris. The connection is getting stronger.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Three locks. Well, you can't say they aren't trying.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: [static] Guardian? Get out of that pit! We must have that crystal or we'll never reach Oryx.
Sarkoor, a Taken Wizard, guards the exit

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then the Taken King will fall. Bring me his dead son's crystal.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: That's how Eris says she appreciates your sacrifice. Glad you're still alive.

title: Memory of Eriana-3 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian goes through the portal near where Eris Morn is usually located.
The Guardian finds Eris Morn along with one phantom.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I know this isn't really Eriana. She herself said she didn't want to be remembered this way. I want to remember her the way she was. Before the Disaster. Before the darkness.
The Guardian approaches Eris Morn and gives her Eriana-3's letters.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, when your strike team headed to the moon – did Eriana-3 carry the letters Wei Ning sent her?

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: Yes… to remind her of why we fought. Why we sought to bring about Crota's end. It was not simply vengeance. Eriana wanted no one to suffer like she and Wei had suffered. That is how she should be remembered. [sigh]
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ever since our descent into the Pit, when I thought upon my friends, I remembered only pain. These keepsakes have reminded me… there was joy, too. So long as these treasures are here to remind me of my friends, these phantoms cannot hurt me.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Memory of Omar Agah — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian goes through the portal near where Eris Morn is usually located.
The Guardian finds Eris Morn along with two phantoms.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I tried to save him… I tried to save him… That is not Omar… Forgive me…
The Guardian approaches Eris Morn and gives her Omar Agah's Brace of Knives.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, do you recognize this talisman?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Omar surely made this, though I have never seen it before. Perhaps he made it in captivity… hoping for rescue… No, that's not it. He knew his Light was lost. This talisman was not for him… He meant for me to find it. Thank you, friend, for one last gift of luck.
The phantom of Omar Agah disappears.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: There was a moment, in the Pit, where I perhaps could have saved Omar. Or perhaps we both would have perished. I will never know.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Omar offered to make me a talisman before we descended. I was young and foolish then and thought I knew better than to believe in superstition. I am glad he did not listen to me.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Memory of Sai Mota — Transcript

lines.text: The guardian goes through the portal near where Eris Morn is usually located.
The Guardian finds Eris Morn speaking to the phantoms near her.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Please! Leave me alone… No, wait! Don't leave. I don't… I need you.
Eris Morn falls to her knees. The Guardian approaches Eris and gives her Sai Mota's repaired necklace.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eris, we found something that we believe should be yours.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It's Sai's necklace. I'd recognize her craftsmanship anywhere. She's the one that taught me how to use a knife to carve beads. Perhaps I will take up carving again… Thank you…
The phantom of Sai Mota disappears.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: When she joined the fireteam, Sai asked for only one thing: to be avenged. I wasn't able to do that for her… But… I helped another Guardian to slay Omnigul. I think Sai – the real Sai, not this phantom – was at peace.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sai spoke little – except when giving toasts. Then none could silence her.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: More Than a Weapon I: Speak to Ana Bray — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian receives a transmission from Ana Bray at the Holoprojector.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Two submind cores in the bag, and launch pod scouted. So… we're making progress! Ikora officially wants us wrangling this situation. She’d like Osiris in a hands-off role, but he’s watching Clovis like a judgmental hawk. It's kind of adorable, actually, and I'm here for it. We got lucky, touching down on Europa when we did. Rasputin could have predicted this. Maybe even prevented it. If Xivu Arath acts on the Witness's orders and uses the Warsat network against us… It doesn't even need full power to cause an extinction-level event. [sighs] "We're making progress." Just keep saying it, Ana. Repeat it until it is real. You too, Guardian. We're gonna manifest this together.

title: Lightfall Intro Cinematic — Transcript

lines.text: Three Guardian jumpships fly over Earth to where the Black Fleet approaches the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Unknown
lines.text: There are too many of them!

lines.speaker: Unknown
lines.text: Mayday! Mayday! On your left! On your left!
Zavala, Ikora, The Exo Stranger, Osiris and Mara Sov watch from the bridge of the H.E.L.M.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Vanguard to all units, keep the enemy away from the Traveler at all cost.

Caiatl's cruisers and Guardian jumpships engage Calus's Shadow Legion ships in battle. Amanada Holliday, accompanied by two more Guardians eliminate two of Calus' cruisers with missiles and swerves to join the rest.

The Witness floats along the bridge of its ship, which is exposed to the vacuum of space. It flicks a finger and several Pyramids charge and release Resonant energy blasts which destroy many allied ships.

Zavala watches and lowers his head. He looks toward the Traveler which begins to gather energy from its surface and fires and energy beam towards the Witness's Pyramid. Flowers and roots are seen growing from the warping surface of the vessel. The wall before the Witness is ripped open by the roots generated by the beam and spread across the interior. The Witness rises up and walks through the Traveler's beam towards it. The gathering on the H.E.L.M watch.
Amanda in her cockpit speaks to Reed-7 in his jumpship.

lines.speaker: Amanda Holliday
lines.text: Whatever that thing is, we got to take it down.

They, along with two others bank towards the Witness, still floating through the beam. It turns towards the approaching fireteam and flicks its hand. Reed, his Ghost, and his ship along with the other two are separated into numerous horizontal slices. Amanda's ship is hit by a piece of debris and all goes black.

The Traveler is surrounded by eight Pyramids. They release a pulse of resonant energy which coats the Traveler, shuts off its beam and spreads towards the H.E.L.M. Its blast doors shut before the pulse can breach, leaving the gathering in dim red lighting.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Multiple casualties out here, we need to pullback.

Osiris turns and leaves the H.E.L.M bridge. The Witness reaches the Traveler and touches its surface with its hand. A light flashes and several images are seen. The Veil, past the various planets upon Neptune. The Witness pulls its hand back and looks at it. It turns its head and Calus's box aboard the Typhon Imperator appears.

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: Disciple, you know what must be done.
The box opens and Calus appears in his Disciple Garb. Calus' fleet above Earth begin to turn towards the outer system.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We’re in no position to engage the enemy.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: We don't have a choice. We're out of time.
Osiris in his ship flies into the Vaul Guadium as it jumps to Neptune. A piece of debris covers the screen.
Invitation of the Nine - Mystery and Potential (Visit 3)

title: Memory of Toland, The Shattered — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian goes through the portal near where Eris Morn is usually located.
The Guardian finds Eris Morn along with three phantoms.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They have no worms… how do they commune with the Darkness? Do not mock me. Toland is not the only one capable of understanding the enemy!
The Guardian approaches Eris Morn and gives her Toland's journal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That… is one of Toland's lost journals… I have never laid eyes upon it… He knew. He knew about this Pyramid. He must have. And said nothing.
The phantom of Toland disappears. Eris turns to look at the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Thank you for being here. For going where I couldn't.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I should not miss Toland. His ruthless pursuit of knowledge led to his downfall. He is not even gone. His spirit lingers, buoyed by the Ascendant Plane. And yet… a fireteam's bonds are not so easily undone.
If the Guardian wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Toland. His spirit came to visit me here, on the Moon. He told me you saw him in the Dreaming City. His curiosity makes him predictable. I knew he could not resist a marvel like the Queen's Eleusinia.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
No One Dreamed it a Trespass

title: Memories: Derelict Leviathan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: In the Dark Age, there were many small settlements scattered across the land. Caravans braved the wilds to deliver supplies to those in need. I often rode with them. It never hurt to have a surgeon along, just in case. Civilization has collapsed. All humanity had ever built was buried in rubble. And yet, as we traveled, I saw how nature continued to thrive around us. When all seems lost, look not to the ruins. See that saplings that sprout anew and remember that life endures.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: There was a time when Guardians walked shoulder to shoulder with the people under their protection. That was before the walls and towers. When hope was our only shield, and community our refuge. I can see why Zavala thinks that keeping people safe means keeping them at arm's length. I understand that all too why. But perhaps one day, he can remember how things used to be. And how they could be again.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: Humans have short memories. How could we not? In the face of infinity, our lives are so incredibly fleeting. It may sometimes seem that no single life matters, that the actions of one person are almost immediately lost to time. But... the handful of years I spent with Zavala forever changed his life. And in turn, he changed the lives of all he met afterward. Including yours. Perhaps we are merely pebbles skipping across the surface of an ocean. But the ripples we create continue onward, long after we sink into the sea.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: When he was just a boy, Hakim asked Zavala how to become strong. Zavala smiled and said, "What makes you think I'm strong?" "Because can kill the Fallen," Hakim answered. Zavala shared a look with me before he spoke again. "Killing doesn't make you strong," he told Hakim. "The strongest people are the ones who lift others up." Always remember that you are one of the strongest people Zavala has ever met. And it is not because you know how to kill.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: The Fallen were only one of many threats humanity faced in the Dark Age. Famine, disease, exposure... Warlords. I once asked Zavala's Ghost, Targe, why one of his kind would ever raise a Warlord. He answered with a question of his own: If a Warlord's soldier stumbled into our camp, bleeding out, would I tend to their wounds? Or let them die? Targe, of course, already knew what I would decide. That is why I cannot fault a Ghost for whom they raise. Not when I would do the same.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: Zavala used to talk about the Last City late into the night. Back then, it was a dream. An impossible, beautiful dream. A place for people to live and not just survive. Everyone speaks about the Golden Age in terms of progress and potential. But do you know what I pined for the most? The simple pleasure of a boring day spent with those I love. That was what Zavala yearned to build. If he was at all successful, then I know he would sacrifice everything to protect it. Not for himself, but for all who call it home.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: The Light can perform miracles. I have seen it set broken bones, replace lost skin... even reconstruct someone from a pile of ash. With that kind of gift, it can be easy to think of yourself as invincible. Immune to harm. But trust me, Guardian... there are some wounds that even the Light cannot heal.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: How do you measure an eternity? How much value is there in nearly two decades of an immortal man's life? Even after we parted ways, I never uprooted the part of myself that Zavala planted in my chest. It still grew. Thrived. The daughter I raised was raised by him too, in a way. In the lessons he taught me, in the parts of me he changed forever. Just like I changed him.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: Amanda Holliday. Do you know her, Guardian? I never met her myself, of course. I have seen her only through Zavala's eyes. He looks at her the same way he looked at Hakim. An orphan in need of a family, someone for him to protect. But like Hakim, Amanda is of her own mind. She does what she feels is right, no matter the risk. I hope this time, Zavala can learn to accept that.

lines.speaker: Memory of Safiyah
lines.text: Before there were Guardians, there were the Iron Lords. They thought themselves a noble order of knights, like in the ancient legends. None more so than Saladin. He never said so aloud, but you could tell by looking at him that he cherished his sisters and brothers-in-arms. Do you ever think of him alone on that peak all those years? His solitary, eternal vigil? I hope that one day, Saladin finds solace in a new order of knights.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: Do you know the legend of Acrius, Guardian? First Emperor of the Cabal... he who defeated a mighty beast to claim the sun. When Caiatl tells the story, she speaks of the warriors who gave their lives to wound the beast first, paving the way for Acrius's victory. She means to say that the source of the Cabal's strength is the empire itself, not the one who leads it. But I hear a different message. To be remembered, one must write their own legend. Strike the final blow, or be forgotten. This is the way of the Cabal.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: To be a gladiator is to earn the right to live with every battle. Victory bought one more day. Defeat meant death. Once, in the coliseum, that fate loomed over me: a cleaver poised to fall upon my neck. In what would be my final moment, I looked to the crowd. Calus sat upon the royal balcony, dispassionate. But then I saw Caiatl. The look in her eyes issuing a silent command: "Win and live."

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: I came from nothing, and rose to rule the Cabal. Every victory earned through battle... and blood. Calus never faced such adversity... and he knew it. He saw in me resilience he could never match. Perhaps that is why he treated Caiatl as he did. To forge her into everything he wished his legacy to be. Now it is Caiatl who rules the empire. And her legacy will outlive us all.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: This abomination of a ship was meant to be a prison. Instead, Calus plated it in gold and called it a "pleasure barge". His exile was no less depraved than his reign. He gorged himself upon his throne, be it on Torobatl or the Leviathan. You see where that has led him. He and his Loyalists now rot from the inside out, just as his empire once did. Exile was a mercy. When you next face him, Guardian, I trust you will be merciless.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: Gladiator. Primus. Traitor. Dominus. All titles I have worn. Never did I count "hero" among them. But that was how Caiatl saw me. Someone to admire and emulate. A guiding light in a starless sky. I sought a different Light... one that incinerated me. If I had stayed behind, perhaps Caiatl and I could have saved Torobatl together. Perhaps... I could have even called myself a hero.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: When I first met you in battle, Guardian, I thought you soft and weak. Not because you feared death... but because you did not. To throw one's life away, safe in the knowledge that it will return... that is the antithesis of sacrifice. A mockery of the warrior's creed. I see now that it is not your death you fear, but the death of those you defend. And that fear gives you power. A power I failed to recognize until it bested me. May Calus make the same mistake!

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: We Cabal have destroyed worlds before... but only rarely. There is no honor in such atrocity. Even when I aimed the Almighty at your sun, I intended it as only a last resort. A decision I did not make lightly. Now Torobatl has been laid to waste, and the Cabal seek refuge on the world I sought to claim. The irony wounds me. But... Caiatl has shown me that no matter where we make our home, the Cabal will never lose sight of who we are. We eat the mountains. We drink the seas. Our empire lives on.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: I would have liked to face an Ahamkara in battle. To bathe my blade in a dragon's blood. Some would call that foolhardy. That the danger posed by those beasts lurks within such desires. You Guardians fell prey to as much before, did you not? You vanquished Riven only for your own wishes to be turned against you. The Cabal need not fear that outcome, for we do not make wishes. We forge our own fates.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: Some among the Cabal have made extensive study of Hive warfare. Caiatl's first advisor, Umun'arath, was chief among them. At first, she sought merely to understand our enemy. That desire festered into obsession. She came to worship their war god. Know this, Guardian. The Cabal revere warriors, not war itself. We do not slaughter, we conquer. War without purpose is wasteful. War without honour... is butchery. That is what sets up apart from the Hive. A lesson Umun'arath never learned.

lines.speaker: Memory of Ghaul
lines.text: For years, I conspired with Calus's enemies to end his rule. I cared nothing for political rivalries. But I knew Calus would lead the empire to ruin. So when the Praetorate first entreated me to join their cause, I agreed, and swallowed my distaste for deceit. They did not expect me to befriend the emperor. Nor did I. On the night of the coup, I could not meet his eyes. But neither could I forsake my duty. Friendship would not blind me to Calus's weakness. And I would not allow it to become my own.

lines.speaker: Memory of Uldren
lines.text: You know, my friend Jolyon and I used to run circles around the Cabal. It was so easy to slip past them unnoticed. We watched them build up their forces on Phobos and Mars. They never marched on the Reef, so we stayed out of their way. In hindsight, I wonder whether that was the right choice. If we had intervened, would Calus have ever come to the Sol system? Would Ghaul? Guess we'll never know. The shot not taken, right?

lines.speaker: Memory of Uldren
lines.text: Do the people of the Last City ever cheer you when you come home? Do they celebrate your triumphs? I remember what that was like. Returning to a prince's welcome, adored and beloved across the Reef. Mara once asked me if I set out on such adventures for the benefit of our people, or simply so I could bask in their praise. Let me tell you a secret: there's nothing that says it can't be both.

lines.speaker: Memory of Uldren
lines.text: I always thought my sister had all the answers. That she just... knew everything. But that doesn't give her enough credit. When Mara asks a question, she wills the answer she wants into being. That's her real gift. Because knowing the truth... and being powerless to change it? That, my friend, is a curse.

lines.speaker: Memory of Uldren
lines.text: Light and Dark. Good and evil. Never that simple, is it? That's something the Reef's always known. Caught between two cosmic forces, walking in the shadows between them.
