lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: [grunts] I'm pinned down here! Can't make it to you! Too many of these damn things!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: The Lightbearer and I can handle this. Stay alive, Nimbus!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: No path forward… Then we'll have to make our own!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If the Radial Mast links with the Veil, it's all over. You and Rohan are our only hope.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: The Radial Mast! It's activating! I'll buy you some time, Lightbearer!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Be careful, Rohan! Even you can only deter it for so long… must be a way to destroy it.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Guardian, as long as I can hold the line, the Radial Mast can't create the link. Find a way to destroy it. Hurry!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: [grunts in exertion] Is this all they got?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Radial Mast cannot be destroyed with conventional weapons…. but like before, perhaps they didn't account for Strand.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: [pants] Give me some time… to expose its weak point! When I give you the signal… use your Strand!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Now's the time! Lightbearer! Destroy it now!

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: [grunts in pain] Then I have no choice… Nimbus… …See you on the other side.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: He chose a Cloud Strider's end. Hey. Guardian… can you please pick up his core? I… I'll need it.

title: Of Queens and Worms: Meet with Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian travels to the Enclave to meet with Mara.
The Guardian approaches Savathûn’s dying worm.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: The very parasite that once plagued the Witch Queen herself.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Queen Mara. Good to see you.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: Do not delay us with pleasantries. This parasite knocks at death's door.

lines.speaker: The Guardian
lines.text: What use do we have for Savathûn's dying worm?

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: This parasite is an opportunity — to learn from humanity's greatest failure.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: But not ours alone. That day was as much a failure for the Wit—
Mara Sov's focus is suddenly drawn away

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: I'm fine! As I said, our Collapse was as much a failure for the Witness and its followers… Savathûn included.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: On behalf of the Witness. But something prevented humanity's end. Something known by Savathûn and—

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: It requires strength and a new host to survive, to divulge its secrets.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: For most, yes. But for the Queen of the Awoken… It's worth the risk.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Nothing Left to Say — Transcript

lines.text: Uldren Sov is shown standing in front of a barrier. The Fanatic enters the room and places a large chest on the ground.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: This is as far as you go.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Please. For you, I go… instead. All know… darkness lives here. Death. You are not of Ether. Can't bring… you back.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Yes, Father. We ever serve and await return.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Go. Inspire… and avenge your murdered friends.
The Fanatic leaves. Uldren Sov turns towards the chest. Mara Sov appears near the chest.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: There's no more room for fear, dear brother.
Uldren Sov regards the Ace of Spades he is holding, places it in its holster and opens the chest. He picks up the small shard which he previously obtained from the shard of the Traveler.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Oh, Uldren. You have sacrificed like no other. You looked into an abyss, bowed to false kings, and suffered uncountable betrayals. You were humiliated, imprisoned, manipulated… Taken. And still you gave up everything… because you love.
Uldren Sov walks towards Mara Sov, who is floating in front of the barrier.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Please, Brother. Will you walk through hell for me one last time?

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Good. Then let us finish this. Even paradise is a prison… when you can't leave. Free us!
Uldren Sov walks through the barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You know what's down there. The Watchtower. The Fanatic. Uldren. The end. Justice… or revenge. Uldren deserves what's coming to him, but… Guardian: The "why" of what we're doing is as important as the "what". I don't know what you're thinking… but remember that.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn on the path to the Watchtower with the help of Spider's Associates. The Guardian arrives at the Watchtower. Fikrul, the Fanatic appears.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: You enjoyed killing them? You enjoyed putting them in dirt — where you belong? Did it make you feel good?
The Guardian fights against Fikrul, the Fanatic and the Scorn.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Kaniks. Reksis Vahn. Yaviks. Pirrha. Araskes. Hiraks. Elykris. Tell me that killing my friends made you feel good. TELL ME.
Fikrul, the Fanatic retreats towards the Watchtower and teleports the Guardian into the air, tethering them to his staff.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: I will pay any price… to be there when you die…
The Guardian defeats Fikrul, the Fanatic.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We did it. Only one name left… Uldren Sov.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: It's time to end this. For Cayde.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Guardian. No one has stood where you are since the Queen closed these doors. Yours are the first outsider eyes to ever see this place.
The Guardian heads further into the Watchtower.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Keep moving. I'll get to you as fast as I can.
The Guardian continues further into the Watchtower. The Guardian finds a portal and walks through it.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: Open the door, Brother. OPEN THE DOOR.
The Guardian walks through a portal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The line between dimensional planes is thin here.
The Guardian heads further into the Watchtower. Zuuan, Taken By The Voices, appears. The Guardian defeats Zuuan, Taken By The Voices and walks through another portal.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: No. No, no, no, no… Something's wrong.
Sorvox, Taken By The Voices appears. The Guardian defeats Sorvox, Taken By The Voices and walks through another portal.
The Guardian heads further into the Watchtower. The scene changes to show Uldren Sov with Mara Sov standing behind him.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: You've no idea how fortunate you are to be my chosen. You hold the flesh of a god in your hands. You are mere steps away from our salvation. Only Light and Dark, together, can unlock my way back into your world.
Uldren Sov walks towards the gateway.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: That's it… keep going. FREE ME!
Uldren Sov presents the small shard, opening the gateway. Mara Sov appears and floats down towards Uldren.
Uldren Sov reaches out for Mara as she floats toward him.

lines.speaker: The Queen
lines.text: You brave, devoted, pathetic fool. Thank you.

Uldren Sov takes hold of Mara's arms and closes his eyes. What appeared to be Mara Sov is revealed to be the Voice of Riven. The Voice of Riven's tentacles pull Uldren towards its mouth. Uldren opens his eyes and cries out when he sees what is holding him. He attempts to get away from the Voice of Riven, dropping the Ace of Spades in the struggle, before being swallowed whole by the Voice of Riven.
The Guardian fights against the Voice of Riven and the Taken. The Guardian is teleported to the Ascendant Plane.
The Guardian fights the Taken and defeats an Ascendant Plane Guard. The Guardian is teleported back to the Watchtower.
The Guardian continues to fight against the Voice of Riven and the Taken.
The Guardian is teleported to the Ascendant Plane again.
The Guardian fights the Taken and defeats another Ascendant Plane Guard. The Guardian is teleported back to the Watchtower.
The Guardian continues to fight against the Voice of Riven and the Taken.
The Guardian defeats the Voice of Riven, releasing Uldren Sov. The Guardian picks up the Ace of Spades and walks towards Uldren Sov who is struggling to crawl away.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: [struggling] [chuckles] Congratulations. You have my undivided attention. Now where's my sister?
Petra Venj appears and walks towards Uldren Sov, pointing her gun at him.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: She's not here, Uldren… And if she was… this would be a whole lot easier.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: So, this is to be a reckoning.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait. Not like this. Look at him — he's finished. Even with everything he's done, we can't just —

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: You have no idea what he's done! If Cayde was here, I know what he would do, Guardian. Do you?

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Yes. What would the notorious Cayde-6 do? You have his gun. Seems you get the last word. Everything I did, I did for her. Funny. The line between Light and Dark is so very thin. Do you know which side you're on?
The Guardian lowers their gun. Petra Venj looks towards the Guardian, who raises their gun again. The scene fades to black and a gunshot is heard.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: On the Verge — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, Nimbus, want to fill us in on where we're headed?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: There's this place where Cloud Striders go. A place to be alone, meditate, pray. If the old bird's theory holds up, should be a mega-source of Strand there.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Let's hope it's larger than the ones you've seen thus far.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: You can see them? Wha—hang on, so you've got resurrection, sweet jumps, and the ability to witness thinning in the fabric of existence. Who do I gotta kill to get one of those Ghosts?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If Strand is another side of the Darkness, how come we'd never encountered these sources before?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: The old bird thinks it's like a… stink cloud the Veil leaves behind.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I said it's a SIMILAR type of by-product… To use… a different analogy, if we are all part of this "river of souls," how do we direct the river's current?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I said we ARE the river. You don't direct anything. You just flow.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Well? What are you waiting for? Let's begin.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Let's see how quickly you can dismantle them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vex have blocked the path. Guess they want this Strand source for themselves.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Of course. The Vex could learn much from a power originating in linked consciousness.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Now is the time to lean into using Strand, not back away from it. You can't effectively train if you don't push past your limits.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Just don't burn yourself out. This is only one battle. We've got a whole war to fight.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: A war we cannot win without this power well in hand.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Right, this part. Forgot you don't have a skyboard. Oh, but don't worry! You can still get to the place. Just have to find the way around.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: All that swinging around, that is… wow, that is really something!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Ah, yes. How could Calus possibly overcome your… rope swing?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Good. Now the true training can begin.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're hitting a wall with Strand. The aftereffects are stacking up.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I don't understand. You've got more power, more practice… hasn't this done anything to condition you?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Hit them again! Hold nothing back.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Get up, Guardian. Now is not the time to slow down!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think you know what you're asking, Osiris.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Guardian, listen: don't strain for the energy. Drop the effort and just… let it flow through you.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Now that's how you send the Vex packing! Nicely done.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes. That was a challenging fight, but you pulled through. Still, we cannot afford any faltering when facing Calus. You should be able to wield Strand without strain. [grunts] We're still missing something, but what? I must think. We can discuss this more later.

title: Off-World Recovery — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We need something to draw out Xol. Something worth… feeding on.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I'm not sure I want to know what a monster god feeds on.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Power. And we've intercepted Red Legion transmissions about a new fragment of the Traveler that splintered off during Ghaul's assault. Xol won't be able to resist its Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's the Taken! They're jamming me!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The Taken? Are they after the fragment?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: It doesn't matter! Clear them out!
The Guardian destroys the Taken Blights.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've got a lock! The fragment is nearby, but the readings are inconsistent with the other pieces of the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Zavala, assuming this fragment bait plan works, how do you expect to take down Xol without Rasputin?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I won't have this discussion again.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I can tell you without a doubt, Rasputin is the only way to stop Xol. We need the Valyrie.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We've won against impossible odds before. Without Rasputin.
The Guardian defeats the Taken. The Guardian finds the fragment from the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Taken have projected some kind of shield around the fragment.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think we can get through.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: There might still be a Warsat left in Earth's orbit. Let me see if I can adjust its trajectory.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Stay where you are! I'm using your position to lock on with the Warsat.
The Guardian defeats the Taken. Mahesh the Bitter appears. The Guardian defeats Mahesh the Bitter.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Warsat armed and in position! Requesting orbital support!
The warsat fires on the fragment, destroying the Taken shield surrounding the fragment.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ana, how did you get it to fire?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I asked him. Rasputin was created to help Humanity. He listens to me.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: This time, the warmind listened. But are you ready to shoulder the burden the day it doesn't? Guardian, secure the piece of the Traveler and get back to Mars. It is time to go to war with a god.
Ghost transmats the fragment of the Traveler.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: On the Verge: Interlude with Osiris — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Upon first glance, this new power appears unstable and chaotic. But I wonder if that's based on our approach: too much, too fast. These… "pouka" creatures are curious ones. They appear semi-organic, but Nimbus claims they're a form of artificial intelligence. A fascinating—albeit odd—being, nonetheless. Their attraction to this paracausal power seems… instinctual. They flow in and around it effortlessly. And very clingy.

title: On the Verge: Broadcast from Calus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: To all the Cabal who still follow the Empress Caiatl… Stand aside before your emperor. Whether you lay down your arms or join with my legion, you will have all the freedom of the stars, until the last. Those who persist should ask yourselves: why do you follow a cautious empress, who has turned her back on bravery and grandeur? Even when Cabal must fight, there should be magnificence. There should be glory. Not timidity, not this cowardice. Look how your empress has fled from battle, relying on these Humans for strength. I may once have been deposed, but I remember how to be Cabal!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We should probably see if Nimbus can disable that radio frequency.

title: On the Verge: Interlude with Rohan — Transcript

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: When I first realized you were from Earth, I remembered the stories. Immortal, Lightbearing warriors chosen by the Traveler. Like figures out of myth. But what do myths care about ordinary people? I imagined Warlords conquering Neomuna. Or gods crushing us underfoot. I was wrong. Now, when I see you… I see a comrade-in-arms. Someone who will stand with me to defend Neomuna and its people. I see a Guardian.

title: Omega — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is it. Whether it's us or Panoptes, someone's future is ending today.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: It took Osiris years of study to find a way to open the gateways. We don't have years, so…
Ikora forces open the gateway to the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: It's open but unstable. Go! I'll hold it open for as long as I can!
The Guardian runs to the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've gotta get to Panoptes before Osiris does. Without Sagira, if he dies, he dies for good.
The Infinite Forest, Fields of Glass

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Infinite Forest — it's huge. I never thought… When the fate of the world's not at stake… can we come back?
The Guardian clears a path through the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're only going to get one chance at this. If we lose Panoptes here, we won't be able to find it again.
The Guardian meets Panoptes who tries to evade the Guardian
The Guardian jumps after Panoptes as it retreats

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Osiris and Sagira came to the forest to stop Panoptes, but they're not here. We are.
The Guardian battles through hoards of simulated enemies and Taldriks, Infinite Proxy

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No no no no no— it's deleting us from the Forest— I can't stop it—

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Panoptes! Face me! I'll block it for as long as I can. You must take down it's defences!
The Guardian flies up to an arc charge
The Guardian dunks the arc charge and lowers the defenses

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I can give you a clear shot of its eye, Guardian
The Guardian manages to get one shot off before Panoptes recovers his shield and summons Ergoth, Infinite Proxy.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Your time in the Infinite Forest ends now! The shields!
The Guardian repeats the process of disabling Panoptes shield, again only getting one shot off before Panoptes recovers his shield. Panoptes tries to retreat again.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can't let Panoptes get away! Follow it!
The Guardian continues to fight their way towards Panoptes, killing Alecto, Infinite Proxy

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No, Panoptes! Your future only has one ending now.
Osiris materialises another arc charge for the Guardian to use to drop Panoptes shield enabling the Guardian to kill Panoptes

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And give me back my ghost!
Ikora watches as the Guardian and Osiris emerge from the portal to the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Vex Mind is destroyed, and the path to their dark future is gone with it.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: And in case you were wondering, our Guardians were amazing!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OUR Guardians? Humph. MY Guardian. Guardian thief.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Osiris. It's been… a very long time.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Too long, my… I… I was going to say "student" — but, well, that word is too small for you now.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I've had other teachers. Time. Pain. A Guardian who makes the habit of the impossible… who I'm proud to call a friend.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: So has the City. You could come back with me.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No, my place is here now. We stopped the Vex this time. But many equations lead to the same solution. If they were to ever find another… Besides, I predicted many things, but I never saw you. Now we have a future.
Osiris ascends the stairs back to the Infinite Forest

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The pathway to the Forest will be open to you if you ever need to find me… or if you want to talk.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Great! Galaxy saved. Friends again. Our big hero over here. And by the way, you're welcome.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Come, little light. We have infinite realities to explore — and all the time in the world.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: On the Verge: Neomuna Civil News — Transcript

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: [Neomuna News with Jisu Calerondo musical jingle] I'm Jisu Calerondo, reporting for Neomuna Civil News. Cloud Strider Nimbus reports that recent CloudArk fluctuations are the result of new security measures to guard against intrusions. The Cloud Strider credits the Earth's Guardians for contributing personnel toward the dangerous operation. Despite this, more citizens have experienced nightmares. One name common to all? "Nezarec."

title: On the Verge: Meet with Nimbus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I talked with Osiris. Y'know, he gives off uptight-museum-volunteer vibes, but he's a nice guy when you catch him one-on-one. He got me thinking, which is a compliment I can give VERY few people. There's a place nearby you two might find useful for your Strand stuff. I'll get you the coordinates. Speaking of compliments—ha! You. You never fail to amaze me, you know that? Everything that's come at us, you're just like BAM, PEW PEW, KACHOW! And suddenly, whatever's comin' at us, ain't comin' at us anymore! And you just keep doing it. Like it's nothin'. Wow. The first time Rohan told me I did a good job, I'd given up hoping for it, and by the time I got it, I didn't need it. In hindsight, I think he did that on purpose, but whatever, I promised myself I'd do it different when I took over. The old man might think compliments go straight to your head. But if that helps you Strand-ify, and us take down Calus, by all means, let it go to your head, shoulders, knees, and toes.

title: Oracle Engine (Loop 1) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sedia
lines.text: The Taken have seized control of our observatory. I fear they've set their sights on the Oracle Engine.

lines.speaker: Sedia
lines.text: It is far more than that, but – yes. The Oracle is immeasurably valuable. We cannot repair it. We cannot replace it. And so, we cannot allow the observatory to fall.

The Guardian defeats An Ragaar, Son of Xivu Arath, Tir Balok, Daughter of Xivu Arath, and Xavan, Daughter of Xivu Arath, and uses the arc charges which drop after they are each defeated to destroy the barriers blocking the path to the observatory. The Guardian heads towards the observatory.
Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City

The Guardian continues towards the observatory, defeating the Hive and Taken which they encounter. Val Pros, Tower Sentry appears. The Guardian defeats Val Pros, Tower Sentry. The Guardian continues towards the observatory. Orm Vashyx appears. The Guardian defeats Orm Vashyx and picks up the arc charge which drops after it is defeated.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm trying to send you some backup. Bear with us.

The Guardian uses the arc charge to destroy the barrier blocking the entrance to the observatory. The Guardian enters the observatory. Mukor, Soulkeeper and Urgoth, Soulkeeper appear. The Guardian defeats Mukor, Soulkeeper and Ugroth, Soulkeeper.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Petra, come in. Observatory's clear. No damage to the Oracle.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Good! That's good – but I can't shake the feeling that we're being outmaneuvered. First the relics; now the observatory. I just don't see how it adds up.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It may not. The Hive aren't renowned for their strategy. Neither are the Taken.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I suppose that's true. Good work, anyway.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 5, Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Mara Sov, if you're listening - The Guardians have been fighting this curse alongside the Awoken for a long time now. We'll keep fighting, but we're going nowhere. We need your help. You saw this was coming, just as you foresaw Oryx. That's true, isn't it? Please. We'll help you in your war. Whatever you need. Just… Do something.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 4, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Queen Mara - this is a message from the resistance force occupying the Dreaming City. We continue to - ugh, what's the point? She never answers.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Heh. The point is that she hears it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 1, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: My Queen. The battle is long, but the fight is good. In due time, we will open a gateway that we hope will lead to the heart of the curse.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: When it opens, the Guardians will lead the way.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: And we will end this. Wherever you are, we hope you are well.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 2, Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Broadcasting to Queen Mara Sov of the Awoken… The curse has taken its true shape. This whole week has happened before, beat by beat. I was shocked. There's nothing like it in our records - the closest are Vex simulations, but this curse isn't that. It's too cruel to be that.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 2, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: My Queen. I need your counsel now more than ever. If you're there, if you can spare a moment from whatever battle it is that you fight, please - speak to me. To us. Please.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: No… This is a lesson, I'm sure. My lady's lessons always cut deep.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 6, Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Mara Sov! We need answers, and your people need help. They are suffering while you're busy with… what, exactly? I don't know, because you don't tell us. You never say anything. Nothing plain! Nothing useful. Guess you're too wrapped up in your own affairs to be a good queen.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 7, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Transmitting to Mara Sov: my Queen, my lady. Reinforcements continue to arrive from across the system. Guardians, lots of them. And Corsairs that I haven't seen since the Taken War. Many old friends that I'd written off as dead. Everyone's here, ready to fight for the Dreaming City. If this curse goes on for centuries, at least we'll be here together. I wish… I wish you could join us.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 7, Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The curse has begun again. This will be the seventh try for the Guardians. I don't see how this time around will be any different. We throw ourselves at this thing again and again, and it never changes. How can anyone here go on when there's no guarantee they'll see the future they're fighting for?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 6, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Broadcasting to Queen Mara. We continue to fight back the curse in absence of your leadership.

lines.speaker: Petra
lines.text: "In absence"? No. She is with us. There are moments when I can feel her presence at the edges of my mind. You may not be able to feel it, but I'm sure she checks on you, as well.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 5, Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right, Petra, go ahead. The Oracle is running.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: My Queen. The Techeuns had a troubling vision. And I have had dreams, as well. Sedia, Shuro, and Kalli all dare not reach out to you, for fear that the curse will find you. I am sure you've seen this, too - but if you are listening and able to reply…

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm sorry, my friends. I can't say.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Oracle Offering (Loop 8, Week 1) — Transcript

lines.text: Spine of Keres, The Dreaming City
The Guardian presents an Oracle Offering.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Queen Mara. This will be our last message to you. We made a commitment to Petra to help protect the Dreaming City. We've stood again and again to strike back at the forces that command the curse. We're proud to fight alongside the Awoken. They're courageous and honorable, and we affirm our commitment to them and to you. We will not let the city fall. But, there's no point in calling out to you if you can't hear us. So. We're going dark, but we're not giving up. We are Guardians, and we were made to fight forever. May the Light guard you in whatever battles you face.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Paradox Daily — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Vault of Glass. It is one of the Vanguard's greatest triumphs. The destruction of Time's Conflux. A victory over the Vex collective mind. From deep in that vault, we've received a signal laced with an old Vanguard signature. Vex technology disrupts the weft and weave of time itself. If a Guardian has become lost, unstuck in time, we must return them home.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The message we received was this:

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: [static] a message. The creatures will soon reach the heart of the vault. When [static] once they take the Vex, they'll come for the Light.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: [static] where I am. My name is Praedyth, and I was a member of Kabr's Fireteam. I just hope[static].

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Praedyth. I've heard that name before. Scattered pieces of gear, references in the margin of a text. He is real.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: So the Vex have predicted their own annihilation. When did they believe this would happen? Can the calculations of minds the size of planets be wrong?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If the Taken are here in the vault, they are at the heart of the Vex collective mind. Imagine the machine-planets of the Vex surging with Taken power. This must not be, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: [static] [I don't know why they're letting] me speak. Now, after so long. But if anyone is listening [static] [I came] into the vault with two others. Kabr was intense sometimes. And Pahanin was always talking to himself [static] [but] they don't deserve this. No one does.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm tracking the signal. Just a little further.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: I had a friend back at the Tower. She used to say, "Praedyth, there's always room in the mind for hope. It's the crack that lets the Light in." The Vex have no hope. No imagination, no drive, no fear. All they have is the pattern. Everything must fit. If it can be made to fit, good. If it can't, it gets cut away.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've lost the signal. Something down here is blocking it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's it! That Hydra is causing the block. Take it out or we may never find Praedyth.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think...yes. We've cleared the vault of Taken. For the moment, anyway.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: I think that's it. They're closing the door. I lived! Just remember, tell them I lived [static]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Signal's gone. But I can pinpoint the source.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: They think this is the end of them, a path with no escape. And yet, here they are, there they were, and there they will be, and there they will have been. For them, there is no paradox. There is only the pattern. And the pattern needs the Vex to see it to completion. And so the Vex must be. For the mind of the Vex, is that faith?

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: Welcome to the end of the Vex. Their "immutable" future.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: Enslaved to a will they don't understand. A will long dead here. Dead eons ago. But then, they won't end, will they? Because you're here.

lines.speaker: Praedyth
lines.text: The Vex won't spare the City. They won't even thank you. But that's the thing about Light. You never know where it will shine.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Another dead Ghost. This is...wait, I think this is Praedyth's Ghost. She's still got files in her core memory. They're marked with Future War Cult headers. I'd bet Lakshmi will want to see this.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Blood in the Garden, Not Forged In Light

title: Osiris Pondering — Transcript

lines.text: Osiris squats by the pond, gazing at his reflection in the water. He tosses a stone in and stands to watch the ripple.
Osiris holds out his hand as a Pouka comes around and floats above it. He lowers his head, clenching a fist.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Sagira, could you run some scans— Oh... right.
Osiris and the Pouka turn to look at the approaching Rohan.
Rohan holds his own hand out for the pouka as it orbits his body.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I've been pondering the Veil’s paracausal effects on Ghosts.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I know I haven't been the easiest guest in your city.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: Pain is not a hindrance. It simply reminds us we're still breathing. Still fighting.
He suddenly turns to look at Cabal ships ferrying the Radial Mast to the inner city.

lines.speaker: Rohan
lines.text: They're going to attempt a link! We have to stop them!
Rohan begins to run. Osiris glances at the pouka and starts to follow.

title: Outbound Signal — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: On my order, the Dead Orbit fleet is well clear of Saturn. We'll need them to defend the City, if it comes to that. They've picked up a high-gain signal from the Cabal beachhead on the Dreadnaught.
The message is outward bound. Its target is far outside the solar system. We have to know what they're saying and who they're saying it to.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Their commanders are dead. The Cabal are trying to survive against an implacable foe. Expect heavy resistance.
Guardian proceeds through Dantalion Exodus VI
Guardian clears area of Cabal and Hive threat

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The signal's coming from the bridge, but the whole place is on lockdown.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Heavy weapons fire has their defence grid on high alert. Clear out the ship. When things quiet down, the doors should open.
Guardian clears area of Cabal and Hive, shuts down Defense Net

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Defence Net is down! Heh, kill everybody and the system thinks it's safe. Stupid computer.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Be wary. If the defence systems are active, some of the bridge crew may still be alive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Captain's station should control the signal. Let me at it.
Guardian clears area of hive and heavy Cabal enforcements
Vro'ourn, Fist of Oryx spawns with Taken army

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Signal's down. It was encrypted, but some of the headers are legible. This was a detailed distress signal intended for...the head of the Cabal Empire.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I'll pass the scan from your Ghost to the Cryptarchy. I have a feeling we'll want to know as much about this signal as we can. In the meantime, that's a job well done.
When you see Arach Jalal, tell him, "thanks for the tip."
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Osiris confronts the Warmind — Transcript

lines.text: The entrance to Rasputin's Core opens and Osiris appears with his scout rifle, Garden Progeny 1, in hand. Osiris walks toward the Warmind.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It's been a while, old man. The Tower looks at you and sees a god. But I see a thug. A murderer. Betrayer. You know why I left the Infinite Forest. What I saw. A line has been drawn in this system. Light on one side. Dark on the other.
Osiris points his weapon at Rasputin's console.
As the entrance to Rasputin's Core closes, the Warmind responds to Osiris.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 10 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the tenth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: The Veil. She did it! Maya connected people to the Veil. Our own scientists. And they survived. I should be happy, but... happy that all this horror wasn't for nothing? But I'm not. I'm disgusted. In myself. In Maya. In all of us. This thing, the Veil. It's... it's some kind of web of consciousness. Just like the Vex network, but organic instead of artificial. It make sense why the Vex want it. Paracausal simulations? There'd be no stopping them. I should be happy. To— to be a part of history, to solve a cosmic riddle. Happy for Maya; happy for all of us. But I'm not. I don't feel anything. Maya is gone. The woman I knew... may as well have died when we landed on Neptune. But her ghost still haunts me... this place. I don't know what to do. There's a generation of children born here now. This is their home. [sighs] I don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Damn. Osiris, this is... I don't know if I want to listen to this anymore.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Obsession is a beast with long, sharp talons. A beast that does not so easily release its prey. Maya Sundaresh is... but one victim.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: That sounds like you're talking from experience.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Painfully so. But unlike Dr. Sundaresh, I found a way out of the beast's grasp, before it was too late.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 1 — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Hey, Guardian! Thanks for coming down. We've had some weird vex activity going on across the city in the last couple weeks. When I sent the data to Osiris, he got all excited about it. You know how he gets. Osiris thinks whatever the Vex are after has to do with the Veil, and he wants you to look into it; collect some data, see what they've been digging into. Problem is, we don't have a lead on the Vex... but the Shadow Legion does. So we're gonna pay 'em a visit, bust a few heads, and figure out which Vex we need to target. I'll be on overwatch, and the old man will be in your ear the whole way. So, ready to roll.
The Guardian slays Cabal on Neomuna.
The Guardian collects the first set of Vex data from the Conflux.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: This Vex data is intriguing. It seems as though they're trying to access servers not currently connected to the CloudArk.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Do we even have systems that aren't connected? Huh, that's weird. Does it say where they're digging?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Not yet, not. We need a few more data points. Guardian, let's get moving.
The Guardian collects the second set of Vex data from the Conflux.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Interesting. The Vex have been attempting to breach an air-gap firewall in the old Ishtar Collective systems at Veil Containment. My initial investigation indicated those systems had been wiped in some sort of electromagnetic event. But perhaps, in our haste, we overlooked something. Let us go discover what the Vex have been after.
The Guardian starts the mission “Parting the Veil”
The Guardian enters the Irkalla Complex.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: You know, ever since we defeated Calus, I've been wondering a lot more about the Veil. I think... I think we take it for granted. It's always been here. We always assumed that the Ishtar Collective brought it with them on the Exodus ship, but...

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: But now you question that assumption.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Nezarec seemed to know something, didn't he? When we were inside the Vex network, he said something about... Savathûn.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: My memories cast shadows of Savathûn's. Echoes of the time she and I were bound by her dark magic. The more time we spend here, the clearer the outline of those shadows become. The Ishtar Collective didn't bring the Veil here, Nimbus. Savathûn stole it from the Witness and left it here... quite possibly for the Ishtar Collective to find.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Why? Why would she do that? Isn't she our enemy?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: She is. And yet, at times, she is our ally... when it is convenient to her, and in that convenience, we find common ground. or as a friend once said, the line between Light and Dark... is very thin.
The Guardian passes through an Ishtar Collective laboratory.
The Guardian finds a working terminal in the Veil observation room.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Excellent. That terminal is functional. I've sent a data-mining application to your Ghost. Upload it, and let's see what we can find.

lines.speaker: Chiomi Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, personal log: incidental. Maya arrived yesterday with the Exodus Indigo. I should be relieved, but... in light of the current situation, I... I don't feel much of anything. We're presently en route from Hyperion to the terraformed surface of Neptune. I'm scared. I'm so scared! We don't even know what we've lost. Comms are dead. It's just silence everywhere. We might be all that's left. Maya was right about everything. The cult, the end... how we'll survive. [sighs] I hate this.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Chioma Esi was one of the founders of Neomuna. There's a part of the city named after her! This is... like hearing a legend.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I knew of Chioma Esi and her wife, Maya Sundaresh. They were Ishtar Collective researchers on Venus during the Golden Age.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Is this all there is? The one log?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No — there's an entire archive here. It could be the key to unraveling the mystery of the Veil.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Not to cut this short, but we've got incoming! There's Taken popping up all over the courtyard and — Tormentor! There's a Tormentor heading into the facility!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, neutralize the Tormentor! We can't lose this data!
As the Guardian engages the Tormentor, tendrils from the Veil surround the arena.
The Guardian defeats the Imprint of Nezarec.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Exterior's all clear. How you doing down there?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Tormentor is defeated, and the area is secure. However, the remainder of Dr. Esi's logs are encrypted. She's using an adaptive Vex algorithm to protect them. It will take me several days to break through. Whatever this is, it must be valuable. Guardian, I recommend you check back here later to see what we've uncovered.
The Guardian meditates by the Pouka Pond.
The Pouka Pond — Parting the Veil

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Thank you for assisting me in this fact-finding mission, Guardian. There is much to uncover about the Veil, and your work here is indispensable.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I got you on overwatch. Heh, let's get to work!

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: A March of Fire, The Sunbreakers’ Challenge

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 16 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the sixteenth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I've reached the extent of what I can glean from the research data.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Less than I'd hoped for. But the last of Chioma Esi's research has led me to an intriguing topic: Ghosts.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Ghosts? As far as I know, Neomuna never had any contact with a Ghost before you all showed up. We knew about them, but...

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Precisely. Chioma Esi was researching the entanglement of Light and Dark without fully understanding either. Our Ghosts are a link to the Light of the Traveler. Then how was the Witness able to — on numerous occasions — communicate through them?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Is this about the, uh, the magnets thing? The parallel energy fields, right?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Very good. In areas of Darkness, the Witness is able to create a link, not unlike what it created with the Veil and the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Ah, like the Vex are able to hack into the CloudArk with their tech! It's a parallel connection.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And I believe that connection may not be one-sided. I believe that our Ghosts may be able to leverage this connection against it.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Turn the enemy's weapon against 'em — well, that sounds great. But how?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That... I do not know. But what I do know is that while the Witness is out of our reach, it is also out of the reach of our Ghosts. Which means whatever lies beyond that portal — whatever is inside the Traveler — has left the Witness blind to OUR actions.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: And given us an opportunity to make a plan without it knowing.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Precisely! The Witness has played all the pieces it can. This is its final act, win or lose. Whatever we do from here determines the fate of everything.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 14 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the fourteenth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Years ago, back on Venus, the Vex simulated copies of us — Maya and I. Trapped in a virtual hell. After so long, even hell can look like heaven, can't it? [chuckles] I'm tired. I'm done. Maya has to be out there. The Maya I remember. And all I want is one more moment with her. To hold her in my arms. Tell her that I love her. So she can tell me to "hush" one more time. If... if we learned anything from the Veil, it's that eventually... we all have to learn to let go. So... I made contact with the Vex. I'm ready. And it's time to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: In the end, Maya Sundaresh was consumed by her desire to understand and her inability to let go. She and Chioma lost everything in pursuit of knowledge. Chioma abandoned it all — sought to wipe the slate clean for future generations.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: What did we learn from all of this?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That the Veil is Darkness — the power of consciousness made manifest — as much as the Traveler is the Light, the power of the physical world. The implications are great. But so too are the risks. As a younger man, I may have fallen into the same trap Maya did. But now, I know better. We must proceed with caution... lest the river sweeps us away.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 15 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the fifteenth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I found no more logs from Dr Esi, but I have used her algorithm to crack the data core of the Vex Conceptual Mind.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: That's the doodad we got from the Black Garden, right?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Indeed. The data within contained the Vex's blueprints for their artificial Veil: the Black Heart. It all but proved Dr. Esi's theory. Dr Esi theorized that the paracausal energy of the Traveler operated on a quantum wavelength parallel to electrons.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: In simpler terms: the Traveler's power runs parallel to the forces of nature. Gravity, magnetism, sound, light. The Veil does this too. It is synchronized with the Traveler. Wherever the Traveler came from, the Veil may have as well. But what the Vex made, while connected to the Traveler, was inherently flawed. It did not create the link the Witness desired. Instead, it weakened the Traveler, created... "static" in the flow of their cosmic forces. But it did reveal one intriguing possibility... that at one time, they may have been... united. Part of a whole.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Whoa! So, wait... does this mean the Light and Darkness... were the same once? One force?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Dr. Esi believed so. I am... not as convinced. But it is a theory. One many scholars will explore once this data is shared. But this data allowed me to calculate the telemetry of the beam the Veil fired at the Traveler. When the Witness linked to the Veil through a Ghost, it created a faster-than-light connection of Darkness to the Traveler's Light... ...a bridge to the Traveler's consciousness. If it has one. But the beam did not stop at the Traveler... rather, a point inside of it.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Inside? Wait, what's inside the Traveler?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: No one knows. But if the data I have been able to extrapolate here is correct, that is where the Witness is now: inside the Traveler. It may be the reason why the Traveler has gone dormant—its attention directed inward, where the true threat is. But I am speculating. There is more I need to study, but I fear it will take a substantially longer amount of time.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Months. If we have that long left, that is. Until then, I suppose.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 12 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the twelfth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, log... whatever. The Warmind has reactivated. Our base on Hyperion detected network activity. He found us. Classified our location "Nefele Stronghold". We already estimated that Rasputin has attempted remote interference with our network. Our research. It can't. I won't let what we've learned here ruin more lives. I'm going to send Stargazer off-world to... to deal with the problem. They can take Lakshmi with them and... do whatever. As long as it's out of the city. Out of my sight. It's a risk, taking an action off-world. Exposing ourselves. But we have to. What we've done here has to be quarantined. The Veil is too much power. Too much for anyone.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Stargazer! That puts the time of this recording around the foundation of the Cloud Striders. Chioma must have been... REALLY old.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And Stargazer is the one responsible for redacting Nefele Stronghold from Rasputin's records... or Maya by proxy with Lakshmi. Fascinating. There's two more logs left; once we've decrypted them, I will need to take time to contemplate the larger picture they present.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 11 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the eleventh research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, personal log: incidental. Maya's dead. I found her in the conductor's chair, alone. Nobody knows what she was doing. Her "copy" — that thing, Lakshmi — is still developmentally incomplete. It doesn't understand what happened to Maya. I had it quarantined until we can... Until we... Do something.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: There's no dates on any of these files. There's no telling how much time is set between them.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Time enough for loss. How many are left?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Then let us hope there are yet more answers to uncover.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 3 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the third research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: the Veil. We shouldn't settle here. It's a mistake. But Maya is insistent that we have to build our long-term shelters near the Veil. We're almost done constructing an enclosure around it. Once the field emitters are up, we should at least be safe from its radiation. The SIVA tech Maya had on the Exodus was a lifesaver. Not only for building the enclosures, but shelters, tools—we'd be dead without it. But it still wasn't fast enough. The last Exo in our group, succumbed to brain death yesterday. Maya's... quarantined the bodies for study. She says our next step should be finding a way to draw power from the Veil so we're self-sufficient. I'm insisting on turbines instead. But she doesn't think that's good enough. Not for as long-term as this might be. Which—I guess. But I can't shake this feeling... like we're making a terrible mistake.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I'm not getting a good vibe from this. Quinn says these records contradict some of her own. But there's a ton of references to Maya Sundaresh in our archives that are redacted. I'm... I'm worried, Osiris. What if everything we've been told our whole lives—what if it was all a lie?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Don't despair yet, young friend. The truth may be somewhere between these logs and what you've been told in the past. In my experience, history can be contradictory. Regardless, we won't know until we decrypt more of these logs.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 4 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the fourth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: the Vex.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Six weeks ago, our settlement came under attack by an intrusion of Vex forces. It was a test of our defenses for a larger incursion. Yesterday, scouts discovered temporarily realigned architecture just outside the stronghold limits. The Vex had retroactively inserted themselves into Neptune's history... just like they did on Venus. But unlike Venus, something stopped them short of our habitat. They had to fight their way in. I think it's the Veil. Something about the paracausal nature of the Veil is preventing their temporal excursions. But the Vex aren't giving up. They did something to Neptune's magnetic field — wove a sim into it. A screen to isolate us. It's a double-edged sword. The Vex screen hides us from the outside world, from whatever's happened. So we're safe... ish. But we're stuck with the Vex. Thankfully, they're slow to react, and it's giving us time to research countermeasures. Huh... it's almost our anniversary. I should do something for Maya. She'll forget. She's always so busy. Computer, prepare food synthesis. File: Chioma data night 6. Oh, and add a bottle of port.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Y—yes, I'm fine; I just, um... saw shadows. My choices. Saint. Dr. Sundaresh and I walked very similar paths of obsession, it seems.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: [stutters] Nevertheless... it appears that Neomuna's history is deeply tied to the Vex. Hopefully the next decryption will shed more light on this.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 13 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the thirteenth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: The Veil is too great a power for humanity to wield responsibly. All that's left is to close down the facility. Neomuna will go on. Humanity will persist on the back of our unspeakable work. But I won't pass that guilt on to humanity's future. My hands can be bloodied. Let the children have innocence. And in my dissolution, I will find peace.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I don't know if I agree with Chioma's choice to hide the sins of the past. But... I also do not know what I would do in her place.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Quinn says there's a data signature on this file, like something else was crawling the network. A... Vex signature? What's... MSund12?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: There's one log left to decrypt. Perhaps we'll find out.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 6 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the sixth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: SIVA. SIVA is a nanotech fabrication system, intended to be used by Exodus ships to rapidly build necessary resources from base matter. Maya calls it "Willa Bray's obsession" without a hint of self-awareness. But we — we both see the potential it poses for the future. Each nanomachine in SIVA's design is an independent, thinking machine, utilizing a distributed quantum network to coordinate movement. Like a... mechanical version of radiolaria. Probably where the design was inspired from, if I'm being honest. But the design can be pushed. We're, uh — we're looking at ways of incorporating components from disabled Vex and erased Exominds. If we can insulate the nanomachines from the radiation that killed the Exos, maybe... maybe their deaths won't be for nothing.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Wait... does this really mean I'm part Vex?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It's too early to jump to these conclusions, Nimbus! But there does seem to be some connection between the Vex and the Cloud Striders. It may explain why you and the others are able to enter the Vex network without the aid of Splicers.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 2 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the second research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: the Veil. [sighs] I don't even know where to start. When we landed on Neptune, there was... something waiting for us. An alien structure. It's an electromagnetic anomaly. No mass, but a tangible surface area. It's like a thesis statement to the Von Neumann-Wigner hypothesis. It's definitely paracausal, like the Traveler. Maya calls it the Veil. She says she heard the name in a whisper when... when she looked at it. When I asked her who whispered, she said it was... her own voice. I still haven't had time to process that. Everyone on the initial survey team died. The minute they touched the object, they entered a state of... of brain death. All of them. To make it worse, the EM radiation emitting from the Veil is causing psychological distress in the Exos that came with us. They've all described moments of intense, hallucinogenic reverie. Some of them went silent and rigid and just... stopped. Maya called it "billboarding." Something from the early days of Clovis Bray's Exomind project. She doesn't seem afraid. Or surprised. She's convinced this thing—in her own words, she says—it'll be our "salvation."

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Fascinating. This corroborates what Nezarec said... that the Veil survived Savathûn's escapade. This must have been the root of Savathûn's betrayal: stalling the Witness's plan to buy time to counter it.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: So... she stole the Veil from Nezarec?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And killed him in doing so. It explains what happened to the lunar Pyramid. Why it's dormant.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: And what about the rest of this? What happened to the Exos? Is... is that what happened to all of them?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I have some theories, but... it's too early. Regardless, it sounds like the Veil had an ill effect on Dr. Sundaresh. We must be cautious. Hopefully the next log we decrypt will shed more light on this enigma.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 7 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the seventh research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: Veil interface. Maya and I have finalized a prototype interface for the Veil. Hopefully, it'll allow our research team to investigate it in detail. The system's designed like an orchestra, with a central "conductor" directing a symphony of minds to act like a distributed network. The... idea came to us by watching how collective networks like SIVA and the Vex operate. The hope is we can aggregate and parse the vast amounts of psychic data emitting from the Veil. Turn it into something intelligible. If we're successful, the interface will provide us with a starting point for any future technological research tied to the Veil. The risks of — of such integration are high. The estimates mortality rates are... but I... I... I don't know what I'm doing. This is wrong. This is so wrong! We shouldn't — all she ever talks about is survival! "Think big picture!" What about your survival? What about your heart? My heart? [sighs tearfully] I can't keep doing this. I can't. I can't!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I... again, I see a shadow of myself in Maya Sundaresh. The man I could have become had I let obsession continue to rule me. I'm worried what the next recording will reveal.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 8 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the eighth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: Veil interface, supplemental. They're all dead. Chorus, conductor... everyone. It was too much. Swept their minds away like... like grains of sand on a beach. They're all dead! Maya... Maya called it "valuable data points." Wellsprings and rivers, or... something. What have I done?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Dead? They — this killed their entire research team, but it sounds like — it's like—

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Like their lives held no value to Dr. Sundaresh. There's a troubling symmetry with data we've recovered from Titan. Data on the origin of the Witness. It too, was once multiple people that became conjoined by the way of some sort of... ritual with the Veil. Perhaps a "conductor" and a "chorus." It is troubling that Dr. Sundaresh seemed to be moving down the same path.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I don't like this, Osiris. I don't like this at all.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 5 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the fifth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Chioma Esi, research log: Exos. Maya and I have built a working theory around the deaths of our Exo crewmates after their exposure to the Veil. According to Maya, Exominds contain a combination of Vex radiolaria and something known as "Clarity". Radiolaria are alien microorganisms living within a hive mind state. Or, I suppose more accurately, a community. Clarity is.... Maya described it as a paracausal power derived from an alien artifact. Something BrayTech had kept secret. Something Maya... Maya thinks the Veil and this artifact are related. That the paracausal force from the Veil overloaded their Exominds. Unraveled them. It's like taking a powerful magnet to an archaic magnetic storage device. Full erasure. But Maya... she thinks we can reverse-engineer this phenomenon. Use it to write data to a Clarity-infused object. Fabricate consciousness. Scientifically, the process seems sound, but morally... [sighs] Maya keeps saying that we're past the point of morality. She said that! She's convinced that our survival hinges on mastery of the Veil. It's like SHE'S the one unraveling. I feel like I'm losing her. But every time I try and push, I feel her move a little further away. I'm — I don't know if I can lose anything else. How much more can any of us lose before there's nothing left?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Nimbus... how much do you how about the Cloud Striders' creation? The technology used?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I make no assertions yet. But I worry that your neon-lit city may have darker roots than either of us knew.

title: Parting the Veil: Research Log 9 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian decrypts the ninth research log from Veil Containment's archive.

lines.speaker: Chioma Esi
lines.text: Maya's... I don't even know what to say. I'd recused myself from further experiments. Told her to take some time off. She refused. And she... the minute I wasn't there, she started hauling the braindead Exos out of cold storage. Hooking them up to the Veil interface. She burned through dozens of them. Reversed the entire machine's design. Used a chorus of braindead Exos to funnel data down to the conductor seat, projecting a mental imprint. Hers. I... I didn't know Lakshmi-2, but Maya did. And now she's.... she's made this thing. It speaks with her voice. Has some of her memories. The way it looks at me... It's like it knows something I don't.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Osiris, do you recognize that name. "Lakshmi"?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes... and no, Lakshmi-2 was an Exo and once-leader of a faction on Earth known as the Future War Cult. She died over a year ago. But she never once made mention of any of this. Of Neomuna, of... Maya. Did she know. Did she remember? This is all as much a revelation to me as it is to you. It throws everything she did while in the Last City into question.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I mean, with... if she was a copy of Dr. Sundaresh, then... is she really dead?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I don't know. For now, I must deliver a rather uncomfortable report to Ikora.

title: Path of the Splicer I: Broadcast from Lakshmi-2 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a broadcast from Lakshmi-2.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: The Last City has always been a place of refuge. For centuries, the vulnerable have found shelter and security under the watchful eye of the Traveler. Now, it seems that includes Fallen. Once they sieged our walls, and now, Ikora Rey throws open the gates. A charitable act from a compassionate leader. But is it the right thing to do? Can we really spare the energy and resources to shelter our enemies while we are under Vex attack. Can we afford to extend a peaceful hand to those who might bite it? As leader of the Future War Cult, I have foreseen violence and strife within our walls. This is not the first time. I warned you all of Ghaul before the Red Legion took our City during the Red War. I am warning you again now. Are these the newcomers the cause of our visions? That, we do not yet know. What we do know is that the Vanguard owes the people an honest and transparent explanation.

title: Path of the Splicer I: Communication from the Crow — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a Vanguard communication from the Crow to Commander Zavala.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Can't say I'm enjoying lying low, Commander. Reminds me of the old days. But hey, I'm nothing if not good at following orders. If it was my choice, I'd be there helping you get the Eliksni settled in the City. Might be hard to believe, but they're more like us than you think. Just… give them a chance. Like you did for me. "Velask." That's how they say hello. Just so you know.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: A Cry From Beyond, Let Loose Thy Talons

title: Path of the Splicer I: Speak with Ikora Rey — Transcript

lines.text: The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian rendezvouses with Ikora Rey in the Tower's Bazaar.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: It has been some time since you and I have worked together. That's going to change. As internal affairs falls under my purview, you'll be reporting to me for this operation. Mithrax has kept his promise. His Splicers work tirelessly to decode the data you pulled from the Vex network. Zavala and I have every confidence that this was the right decision. Years of Hidden operations coming to fruition in our time of need. The Eliksni would say, "The Great Machine provides." But if Osiris hadn't suggested we contact Mithrax directly, all our outreach could have been wasted. Guardian, we are all made to believe that loss is how we grow. It took me decades to see that it is not the pain we learn from, but the risk. The chances we take, and the strength to see them through. Here in the City, every new life can begin in peace. Without fear. Without loss. We need only set aside the past. While you're in the field, I've asked Saint-14 to oversee the Eliksni settlement. If we can turn the Kell-breaker into an advocate for House Light, then others will follow. I hope he's feeling generous. Where the Darkness seeks to divide us, we need only offer out a hand.
Ikora Rey — Path of the Splicer I
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer I: Speak with Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Splicer Servitor in the Eliksni Wing, after listening to Lakshmi's message.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I have felt your conflicts with the Vex from here, and your victories. This area is a crossroads — many threads connect this City to the Vex. They seek to use their simulation to drain the Light from this place — bend it to their will. Just as you seek to disrupt their network. But while you fight for survival, their motive are… unclear. The network connection cannot be broken without destroying your city. Both are bound now, and one must fall for the other to survive. But there is hope. Every Vex you destroy sends ripples across this false-dark sky. I do not know how many must fall to end this simulation they have created, but the data they guard hides the answer. We will study it together — this is my word in the Light.
Splicer Servitor — Path of the Splicer I
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer I: Transmission from  Lakshmi-2 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the holoprojector in the Eliksni Wing, and receives a secure communication from Lakshmi-2.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: Hmm… when I requisitioned this transmitter, I was told the H.E.L.M. would be a secure location. I suppose this will have to do. Greetings, Guardian. I am Lakshmi-2, of the Future War Cult. And I am here to offer my assistance… because you need it quite badly. The Future War Cult has long used Vex-derived technology to see into the future. I won't bore you with an explanation of mind-forking. Suffice to say, we understand its dangers and use the device responsibly. I have glimpsed our future, Guardian. And what I saw was chilling. Skies dark with smoke. Shouting. Gunfire. And in the center of it all, standing in our City… A group of Fallen. The same Fallen I saw earlier. Ikora listened to my report, but she chose not to hear it — the Vanguard would rather protect its image than its people! And so, I will handle things myself. We can change this future; stop it from happening. While I monitor your progress against the Vex and assist where I am able, I will observe these Fallen. If they begin to act against us, well… When I foresaw the Red War, they laughed… until Ghaul bound the Traveler. This time, I will not whisper my warnings. I will not be polite. I look forward to working with you, Guardian. Together, we can protect our City from all who would wish it harm.
Holoprojector — Path of the Splicer I
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer I: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Splicer Servitor in the Eliksni Wing.
Splicer Servitor — Beneath the Great Machine

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian, I greet you in the Light. It is I, Misraaks… or "Mithrax," as your people say. I speak to you through a Servitor we liberated from the House of Salvation. It fuels our camp now, turning raw matter into the Ether we need to survive. I will use it to study the Paradrome Cube you recovered from the Vex. In this way, it will provide for us both. We are settling into your City. You may have seen the work of the House of Light Scribe, Eido, my daughter. She has been creating a chronicle of our journey… but there will be time for that later. This city holds great scholars and warriors. Ikora, Osiris, Lakshmi-2, even… the Saint. They have agreed to aid in your fight against the machines. And I will be your guide. I am a Sacred Splicer, one who can touch the Light rippling through the Vex networks… For the Light is all: the wind through the grass and the motion of galaxies. In this way, I can see into the Vex domain. But you… [sighs] Your abilities might grow beyond mine. I have prepared something for you: a Splicer Gauntlet, the first made for a non-Eliksni. The Ether it pulls from defeated foes will let you override the Vex signals. Push back and enter the machine domain, as you did on Europa. Bring me data from within, and together, we will discover its secrets. Fight bravely. Free your people from this Endless Night.
Splicer Servitor — Path of the Splicer I
The Guardian receives a Splicer Gauntlet from Mithrax.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer III: Broadcast from Lakshmi-2 — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a broadcast from Lakshmi-2

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: People of the Last City: we are governed by a consensus. A democracy where the people have a say over what happens in their city. Or so we thought. But did you agree to shelter a mob of dangerous Fallen? The same Fallen that spent a century stealing from us, besieging our city, and destroying our families? Did you agree to suddenly forgive and forget? No. Ikora Rey decided, without the people's consent, to allow House Light inside our walls. These are not the actions of a democratic leader. She claims that this "Mithrax" can end the Vex curse. Then why has he not done so? Perhaps because he has no such power. Or perhaps because he's simply biding his time… I have gazed into the future using Vex technology and have seen only strife and conflict with the Fallen. Unless we change course immediately, bloodshed is inevitable.

title: Path of the Splicer II: Speak with Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Splicer Servitor after witnessing the conversation between Mithrax, Saint-14, and Osiris.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian. Earlier, I could not speak openly to Osiris. To… the Saint. I wanted to shout, "Have you been beneath the Great Machine so long that you cannot survive without its bounty?" But fear stopped my words. Yes, my Eliksni are here, warm, safe inside high walls. But this Endless Night, it is like a weapon. It attacks the heart. An invisible foe sieges your people, so they look desperately for an enemy. And after so long with nothing, my people finally have something to lose. Please, Guardian. Seize more data from the Vex, and let us shatter this foul night. For the sake of all.
Splicer Servitor — Path of the Splicer II
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer II: Mission Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Splicer Servitor in the Eliksni Wing.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian. I greet you in the Light. When we last spoke, I saw your potential. Now that you have returned, I see your resilience. We should learn from your example. We struggle to make a home under this Endless Night. Supplies spoil more quickly — the air leeches life from all we have. I have never seen corruption like this. It is… unknown to me. When you are ready, I will guide you to where the Vex are most vulnerable. They are difficult to predict — they do not behave as they should. I think they guard powerful secrets. Tighten your Gauntlet, and let us take them.
Splicer Servitor — Path of the Splicer II
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer II: Broadcast from Ikora Rey — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian listens to a broadcast from Ikora Rey.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: People of the Last City: Commander Zavala and I have been touched by the generosity and kindness you've shown toward our new Eliksni neighbors. We also understand the reluctance some have shown toward their resettlement. To those who mistrust our arrangement, let me remind you that this very city was founded by refugees. We sought shelter not only from alien aggressors, but from other Humans. The bandits and warlords that profited from our suffering. So it is with the Eliksni. For the first time in our shared history, we need the Eliksni, and they need us. Together with Mithrax and his Sacred Splicers, we can end the Endless Night. But only if we stand united for the betterment of all.

title: Path of the Splicer II: Meet with Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian enters the Eliksni Wing and witnesses Saint-14 and Osiris speaking with Mithrax.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: We have already surrendered too much! Now they want more. Meat, cloth, medicine… people in the City need these things!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: We ask for no more than you can give.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: This Endless Night, it drains us. Our resources are spread too thin. What you give to them, you take from the mouths of our citizens!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: All right. That's enough. Ikora was firm: I am to provide for the Eliksni as if they were our own people.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Pff, our own people. Lakshmi was right. You are too political an animal, Osiris.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The House of Light… we wish to destroy the Vex. To aid the Guardian. Same as you, yes?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Do not start with this. Tell me, Mithrax: were I in one of your cities, would you bow to all of my demands?

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: We would give you anything you asked for.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I see. Hmph. You are fighting for your people as I would fight for mine, yes? It is true. Split the supplies as Ikora says. Anything to make this false night pass more quickly.
Saint-14 transmats out of the area. Mithrax looks at Osiris and then transmats out of the area.
Osiris transmats out of the area.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Path of the Splicer IV: Sabotage at the Eliksni Camp — Transcript

lines.text: Botza Ruins, Botza District, The Last City
The Guardian arrives at the Eliksni encampment and approaches Mithrax, Saint-14, and Lakshmi-2.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
