title: Quest: A Ranger Found, The Nightstalker’s Trail — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Guardian, I've been trying to raise Tevis. He won't answer. Either he's in over his head, or… look, that guy owes me a lot of Glimmer, so, uh, he better still be kicking. Alive, or the other thing, we need to find Tevis. There aren't a lot of Nightstalkers in the field. We can't afford to lose his connection with the Void to the Vex. Go get him.
The Guardian steps through the Gate and arrives in the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Tevis is a cheat. And a liar. And he smells like a barrel of Thrall spit. But he's our cheat. The Vex can't have him.
The Guardian searches for Tevis, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian finds destroyed Vex units with Void energy. Nearby, the Guardian finds Tevis' body.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Tevis is gone, but the Light in his bow still burns.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Won't stay lit forever. Make it your own.
The Guardian takes the Void Light from Tevis' hand, forming a bow out of Void Light and firing a Void arrow into the distance.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You know, I was there when he first picked up that bow. You have it?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Take them out, Guardian. Make them pay.
The Guardian defeats multiple waves of Vex using their newly acquired Shadowshot.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I'll be honest, Guardian. I wasn't sure you could connect with the Void. I should have known better. We may have lost Tevis, but your strength means the Vanguard still owns the night. Come on back.
Hall of Guardians, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You did good. Tevis cheated in every game of dice we played. Wish he were still here. Keep his bow safe, Guardian.
The Guardian receives a Nightstalker's Cloak.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: A Ranger Lost, The Nightstalker’s Trail

title: Quest: At Full Power, Enemy of my Enemy — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian, thanks to you our power shortages are just a bad memory. Between the wave generators and this reactor, we're seeing systems light up we didn't even know existed. You brought a little bit of the Golden Age back to life today. And hell - who knows what tomorrow will bring?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Black Armory Badge, The Black Armory — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: You know me, friend. I'm a "sensitive" soul. I take no pleasure in seeing members of my family in distress. Take, for example, my highly valued business associates - the Black Armory. Your… "assistance" might just be the pick-me-up they need. Their name never graced your ears, I know. Allow me to pull the vast curtain of "things-Guardians-don't-know" back an inch. This right here is a token of the Black Armory's appreciation. Without it, they won't "appreciate" the presence of someone with your… job description. Tread carefully, friend. You won't find hospitality as warm as the Spider's behind their doors.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Black Armory Curator, The Black Armory — Transcript

lines.text: Annex, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
After locating the entrance to the Black Armory, the Guardian returns to the Tower to speak to Ada-1.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Our wares seduce you, Guardian. However, none can currently be sold. The Red War left us without a vital necessity, our Forge. In its absence, our operation has all but ceased. We have found no success in locating it, despite our best efforts. If you truly covet our wares, then understand: we would very much like our Forge back. And Guardian… if you would return empty-handed, you'd best not return at all.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Asher’s Theory, Dynasty — Transcript

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ah, my assistant. The so-called "Hero Of The Red War". The celebrated restorer of Light. Hmph. I have always believed that Guardians squander the miracle of the Light: resurrection. They waste it on heroism, when they could devote themselves to discovering the secrets of our universe! Despicable. However… your heroism has proven the ugliness of my prejudice. Studying you has been quite educational. Surprisingly, I still have much to learn. And much to do, while I still have time.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: You're late. The Pyramidion is the engine with which the Vex intended to convert Io into a machine-world. There are warp gates inside, which connect the Pyramidion to thousands of different places and realities. In your luxurious absence, the Taken entered it in search of said warp gates. I hypothesize that they seek to consume the Vex Collective Mind. Obviously, that must not happen. I lost my arm in the Pyramidion, I cannot begin to postulate what you will lose.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Black Armory Machine Gun Frame, The Black Armory — Transcript

lines.text: Annex, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
After successfully calibrating the weapon frame given by Ada-1, the Guardian returns to the Tower to speak to her.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Dare I go against our values and ask a Guardian to craft a new Black Armory weapon? If I do, our operations could finally restart… but more of their kind would come. They'll want our wares, of course. We'll need more supplies to meet demand, which means… even more Guardians, which means further disgracing the memory of our founder. You've put me in quite the predicament.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Blood in the Garden, Not Forged In Light — Transcript

lines.text: The Black Garden, Meridian Bay, Mars
The Guardian enters the Black Garden and draws out the Groundskeeper.
Objective — REACH THE GARDEN'S HEART: The Black Garden has experienced a curious time distortion. Reach its heart to investigate.
The Guardian traverses the Black Garden and arrives at the gate to the Black Heart's area. Sol Imminent Vex appear.
Objective — ANGER THE GROUNDSKEEPER: Draw out the Vex construct by slaughtering the Vex at the Garden.
The Guardian angers the Sol Imminent Vex. The Groundskeeper approaches. The Guardian defeats the Groundskeeper.
The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Lakshmi-2 in the Tower’s Hangar.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: And now… what? A ring, with the symbol of the Warlock Pujari? Death, again. Like Ana Bray, a Guardian fallen to the second death. Lost to us. We shall study these objects, Guardian. Learn why they have been pulled through time. I believe your work is over. For now. Praedyth’s files have unspooled. Their data undone like uncoiled strands of hair? And what has fallen free? A weapon, transmatted from some time and some place, and specifically for you. Someone has taken notice of our actions, Guardian. Someday, we may be able to ask them to explain what all this means.

title: Quest: Boot Sector, Raising Our Defenses — Transcript

lines.text: The Sludge, European Dead Zone, Earth
The Guardian enters the Seraph Bunker.

The Guardian heads through the corridors. The Guardian opens a door to the Seraph Bunker and sees the Fallen infiltrating the Bunker. Zavala defends Ana Bray against the Fallen with a Sentinel Shield.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Okay Rasputin, let's get you plugged in. [pause] This interface is - so convoluted. Buy me some time.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Take as long as you need. I have your back.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Damn firewall. The access point doesn't recognize my login.
The Guardian heads towards the control room, defeating the Fallen which they encounter. The Guardian enters the control room. The Guardian defeats the Pilferer Captain, securing the control room.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Connection locked! Good to see you, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Indeed. Ana, are you certain we can't operate this bunker from the Tower?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Interfacing Rasputin's mainframe with these systems is the only way we'll get the firepower we need.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Hopefully the Warmind remembers where to point said firepower.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I'm more concerned with whether it will pull the trigger.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He's a Warmind, Zavala. He understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Rasputin has been silent for too long while Guardians hold the line.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: You gotta have a little faith.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Faith is self evident. If it's between you and Rasputin, I'll put my faith in you.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Then I hope it proves me wrong.
If the Guardian speaks to Ana Bray.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Rasputin can do this. Trust me. I understand Zavala has his doubts. I've stood on those walls. I've seen what looked like the end. He's… he has a lot of people relying on him. The Almighty will be knocked out of the sky. We won't let you down.
If the Guardian speaks to Zavala.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We give our lives for the City. On the Moon. In the Black Garden. Rasputin hasn't so much as glanced in our direction. I've failed to protect our people before and must bear that responsibility. Be ready. The City doesn't look to Rasputin for protection. For good reason. If it comes to it, we Guardians must be the ones to make a hard choice… Truth be told, I don't believe Rasputin even knows what sacrifice is.
Zavala and Ana Bray transmat out of the Bunker. The Guardian restores Rasputin's connection to the Bunker.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Bottle the Arc, The Stormcaller’s Path — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Mars. The Vex crawl across her surface, seeking out rare Arc storms, bathing in their power like hot springs. We have located one on the far frontier. If you are to call the storm, to learn the trance, you must go. And let nothing stand against you.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Find a space to clear your mind, Guardian. This is how a Stormcaller begins.
The Guardian heads towards the area where they are to complete their first meditation, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian completes their first meditation.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Good. The storm is aware of you, but you need its loyalty. Do it again.
The Guardian heads towards the area where they are to complete their second meditation, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian completes their second meditation.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The storm begins to obey. Once more, Guardian.
The Guardian heads towards the area where they are to complete their third meditation, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian completes their third meditation.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Your lightning walks its own path! A show of force is in order. Call the lightning and become one. You will either rise a Stormcaller - or not at all.
The Guardian heads towards a railing that is being struck repeatedly by lightning. Arc energy surges through the Guardian's body. The Guardian is struck by lightning and summons Stormtrance.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: A Stormcaller rises. Let's turn our attention to the Vex. They're here for the Arc. Show them the Arc.
The Guardian uses Stormtrance to defeat the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: None stand against you, and the wind is at your back. You are a Stormcaller, and you wear the mantle well. The storm is both an answer and a question. As you carry your spark from this place, remember this. And teach this lesson to those that would drag you from the skies.
Hall of Guardians, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The power of an Arc Storm surges through your fingertips. I can feel it. The air hums with potential. You are a Stormbringer, in title, and strength, and power.
The Guardian receives a Stormcaller's Bond.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: A Spark in Shadow, The Stormcaller’s Path

title: Quest: Broken Awoken Talisman, Key of Light and Darkness — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The deed is done. But I can't rest. I want answers. I want to know how to protect my people from whatever horrors infect the other side of that gateway. And… the prince must be laid to rest. I'm going through the Watchtower… to the Dreaming City. Take this talisman. It will grant you safe passage. Follow me when you can. There's no one else I'd rather have watching my back. And if anyone deserves answers… it's you.
The Guardian speaks to the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Welcome back, dear friend! Your bloody quest for revenge was a boon for us both. Bye-bye, Barons. Adieu, Awoken. Only Spider remains. I see the Queen-less Queen's Wrath left you with a broken trinket. Typical. Offer the treasures of the Awoken… but conveniently fail to give you the means of claiming them. Lucky for you, Spider is a very near and dear friend of yours… Hahahaha…
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Chalice of Opulence, The Invitation — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to Werner 99-40, Shadow of Frames. Werner's eye changes from blue to purple.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: This Chalice is my gift to you. It is a symbol of power for a Shadow of Calus. My Shadows are a chosen people, selected from the best of the best from each world I've encountered. Restore the Chalice so that you may fill it to the very brim with the viscera of your enemies. And do not forget to drink your fill. How else will you grow fat from strength?

The Guardian obtains the Cracked Chalice. The Guardian defeats Cabal on Nessus to collect ten Chalice Fragments and obtains the Mended Chalice. The Guardian defeats several Vex on Nessus with melee damage and obtains the Chalice of Opulence.
The Guardian defeats Shayotet Partisan, a Cabal Colossus, and recovers Imperials from the cache in the Conflux Lost Sector. The Guardian upgrades the Chalice of Opulence.
The Guardian speaks to Werner 99-40, Shadow of Frames. Werner's eye changes from blue to purple.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: You've improved the Chalice. Your taste is impeccable. But it remains incomplete. If you wish to finish your Chalice, come to the Leviathan. There is a dark place aboard my ship that you have never been. Where I was reborn. Like you were reborn. The Menagerie awaits you, Guardian.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Bound by Fire, The Sunbreakers’ Challenge — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Mercury was transformed by the Vex in the early days of the Collapse. As far as we know, the Warlock Osiris is the only Guardian to spend any time among the spires. And we haven't heard from him in years.

lines.speaker: Commander Zavala
lines.text: Osiris brokered a contract between the Sunbreakers and the City. Its terms were… unacceptable to me. Now, the Sunbreakers hate the Vanguard. They… hate me.
The Burning Shrine, Fields of Glass, Mercury
The Guardian arrives at the Burning Forge.

lines.speaker: Ouros
lines.text: We do not know of you, Guardian. But if you found us, you are worthy of our time. I am Ouros, Third Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreakers. You have come to test your Light in the forge. Here you must prove you are one with the Light. Use your Ghost to ignite the forge.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yes, ma'am. Guardian, Ouros is a legend. If even half the stories are true, she's one of the most powerful Titans alive today!
The Guardian defeats the Vex which appear while Ghost restores power to the array.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Power's on, but the array needs to be aligned. Let's head outside.

lines.speaker: Ouros
lines.text: In the shadow of the Light that gave birth to the ancients, use the forge.
The Guardian approaches the Burning Forge.

lines.speaker: Ouros
lines.text: Fire born of man. Fire of the Light. Ask yourself, what power do you seek from the forge, Guardian? Can you bring Light to where only Darkness survives?
The Guardian is sheathed in flames as they forge their own Hammer of Sol.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, we're going to get attacked then. Here we go!
Multiple waves of Vex appear. The Guardian uses the Hammer of Sol to defeat the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ouros
lines.text: A Sunbreaker does not answer to any but the will of the Light. Welcome, Guardian. Wield no power but the fury of fire.
Hall of Guardians, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: A Sunbreaker's fire has not been seen within the Walls in years. Take that hammer to the stars, Titan. It represents the Tower now.
The Guardian receives a Sunbreaker's Mark.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Corridors of Time Part 1, An Impossible Task — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian activates the Sundial and is teleported to the Corridors of Time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Shotgun you crafted in the Infinite Forge is reacting to the Sundial! An onboard transponder is broadcasting coordinates: a path through the Sundial, crossing two time periods. The prophecy blueprint you used to create the Perfect Paradox must have included this broadcast. If you can open up the initial chamber, I can align us to the first time period the broadcast is referencing.
The Guardian traverses the Corridors of Time, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian enters a portal to Mercury's past.
The Guardian finds Skiffs deploying Fallen units to fight the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is new… Topographical scan confirms this is Mercury circa the Dark Age. Incoming signal is an old emergency band… Hold on…

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I repeat, this is Saint-14. The Fallen have overrun Zephyr Station. If you can hear this, turn back!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Saint, hold your position. You have an armed Guardian incoming!
The Guardian defeats the Vex and the Fallen. A barrier blocking a nearby corridor disappears. The Guardian searches for Saint-14.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: All is lost, Guardian. Get out of here. I'll hold them off for as long as I can. The Fallen cannot be stopped. They do not negotiate. Their bargains are lies. I've watched them burn and pillage whole villages in the Cosmodrome. [gags] I've watched Dregs eat children. They envy us. Their legends say the Traveler chose them before us. And they will kill. They will torture. They will maim to earn their Machine God's favor.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen, including a Resilient Captain. The Guardian continues to search for Saint-14 and finds him in a Ward of Dawn, surrounded by the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: The Light the Traveler gave to us — it only brings more violence.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Your strength is a sight to behold. But what has all your strength come to? Our people are dying on Earth. They died here, on Zephyr Station.
The Fallen launch signal flares into the air. A skiff deploys a House of Rain Walker and a House of Rain Servitor alongside Fallen reinforcements. The Guardian defeats the House of Rain Servitor.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I arrived with a dozen human colonists: Mercury was supposed to be a garden world. But the Vex were here first. They have murdered this planet. And these Fallen, of the House of Rain, tracked us here all the way from the Cosmodrome. They destroyed us.
The Guardian defeats the House of Rain Walker. Saint-14's Ward of Dawn disappears.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: We never should have come. Another minute and they would have eaten my Ghost. Fallen are monsters.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Some are. Are you fit to fight, Titan?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I was supposed to protect these people. I should be dead.
The Guardian and Ghost give the Perfect Paradox to Saint-14.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Perfect Paradox. Built by my Guardian out of spare parts and Light and sheer will to aid you.
Ghost shows Saint-14 a hologram of the Last City in the future.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I probably shouldn't be showing you this, but when has that ever stopped us? This is the Last Safe City of Humanity. Hundreds of years from now. During the day, there are children laughing in the streets. When night falls, the people sleep in their homes. Not against the walls — weapons in hand — like the early days.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These are your people, Saint. Their descendants. If you quit the fight, maybe you'll live forever. Your Ghost will protect you no matter what. But this Last City might never happen.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Everything I've ever built has died. I've buried most of the people I've met. I — I can't do this. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We all make our own choices. Good luck, Titan.
The Guardian is teleported back to the Sundial in Mercury's present.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, let's check the Tower databases to make sure we didn't just wreck the entire timeline. Queuing "Saint-14"… Records state he was a former Commander of the Tower. He vanished on a final mission to Mercury in search of the exiled Warlock Osiris. Well, those are the big beats. Timeline intact. Good job, Saint. But our trip's not over. That broadcast I picked off the Perfect Paradox marked one more set of coordinates within the Sundial.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Corridors of Time Part 2, Completing An Impossible Task — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian activates the Sundial and is teleported to the Corridors of Time.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I've killed enough of you to end a war. And you took my Light. I guess that makes us even. What are you waiting for? Last words? Finish it, you cowards.
The Guardian traverses the Corridors of Time, defeating the Vex which they encounter. The Guardian enters a portal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Now, where are we? Let's see… Topographical readouts match near-present Mercury. This is before I found you. And after Saint-14 launched his last mission to find Osiris…

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Guardian, you're back! Just in time. I was about to send my Ghost away! I'm afraid that Martyr Mind has taken my Light. But now that you're here, these Vex are do— [strained grunting]
Agioktis, Martyr Mind appears and captures Saint-14 in a Vex trap. The Guardian fights against Agioktis, Martyr Mind and the Vex which appear.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Now that you're here, perhaps I will survive today after all!

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I would ask you how my father fares, but I would rather ask him myself.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Save some Vex for me, my friend! I'm trapped, not dead!
Agiotkis, Martyr Mind retreats and a Shackled Minotaur appears. The Guardian fights against the Shackled Minotaur and the Vex.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Once I get out of this stupid trap… We will crush them together!

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You are even more vicious than I remember!

The Guardian defeats the Shackled Minotaur and deposits the Arc Charge which appears. Another two Shackled Minotaurs appear. The Guardian defeats the Shackled Minotaurs and deposits two more Arc Charges.
Agioktis, Martyr Mind traps the Guardian. Saint-14 is freed from the Vex trap.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I can feel the Light in my bones! Martyr Mind! Time to die!
Saint-14 summons a Void shield and defeats Agioktis, Martyr Mind. The Guardian is freed from the Vex trap.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: It's been a long time, my friends. I've chased your memory for centuries. You should go now. Those who could kill me are dead. You've made sure of that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And what if the Vex take your Light again?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Impossible. It cost them everything to build the Martyr Mind. When you crushed it, they were doomed.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You want us to leave you? You'll be stuck here for years.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: You've both done plenty. Just open the Infinite Forest gate for me. I'll meet you the long way around, at the entrance.
Saint-14 turns around and sees more Vex spawning into the area.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: What's a few more years of fighting Vex?
The Guardian is teleported out of Infinity's Siphon.

title: Quest: Data Requisition, Enemy of My Enemy — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ah, good. You're here. I presume Sloane's briefed you?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We go in. We scare the Fallen out of the control center. We get out.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Affirmative. Reports say we're dealing with one Captain and his crew. This should be routine, for someone like you.
The Guardian heads towards the control center. They find a barrier blocking their way to the control center. There is a Barricade Servitor in front of the barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That barriers energy spectrum matches this Servitor's. It could be a coincidence.
The Guardian defeats the Barricade Servitor. The barrier disappears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not a coincidence, looks like they're using Servitors to wall us in.
The Guardian enters the control center lobby and sees Mithrax, the Forsaken, a Fallen Captain, on the other side of the glass by the terminal.
Mithrax, the Forsaken and the other Fallen leave the control center. Ghost scans the terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like they wanted data, not systems control. Linking up with their taps.
The Guardian protects Ghost from a Hive ambush while he retrieves the data.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Everything the Fallen got, we've got. Lets move.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It seems like these floating stones mark places where the Hive have weakened the line between our world and theirs. Bet all this weird magic they have out here comes from sources like these.
Ghost scans another floating stone, this time covered in chains.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like the Fallen tried to chain it closed. A for Effort guys, but I'm not sure this is how we're going to beat the Hive.
The Guardian finds a locked door which blocks their escape.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can get this open! Just hold them off!
The Guardian defends Ghost against the Hive while he unlocks the door.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hah. We're through. I hope this data's worth it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Indeed. In the meantime, you've ensured the Rig will stand for at least one more day.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Well said, sir. Come on by when you can, Guardian. We'll get a look at what you got.

The Guardian speaks to Benedict 99-40. Benedict's eye changes from blue to purple.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: There are Hive aboard the Leviathan. They are mine, though they don't know it. One of my Loyalists controls them. He possesses an artifact of Ascendant authority. Unfortunately, wielding it has cost him his mind. If you two should meet, consider his welcome… overstayed. And his riches yours for the taking.

title: Quest: Choir of the Damned, Symphony of Death — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The song remains unbound. There are notes yet to steal and bone yet to defile. Toland knows the way. His madness is your truth. Heed his warnings and know that your suffering will become your strength… Once the Deathsong is yours to command.
Toland appears nearby. The Guardian speaks to Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: Welcome, once more, to the edge of oblivion, hero. You have faced much — enough to impress the easily impressed — but the melody we seek to cage may be more than you can overcome.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Is that concern I hear in the old man's voice? Maybe his humanity isn't lost after all.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: My concern extends only to all we gain to learn from what comes next. Succeed or fail, Guardian. Either way, new understandings will be gleaned from your courage.
The Guardian heads towards the location of Ir Airâm, Deathsinger.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: Beyond, the choir awaits. Quiet the Aria before they shred your mind and rend your flesh. The song's embrace will be harsh, but remember… Every note you endure will lead to the Hive's undoing.
The Guardian finds a Deathsinger, Ir Absuul, First Aria. The Guardian defeats Ir Absuul, First Aria and heads further into the Catacombs.
The Guardian finds another Deathsinger, Ir Nagash, Second Aria. The Guardian defeats Ir Nagash, Second Aria and heads further into the Catacombs.
The Guardians finds another Deathsinger, Ir Sûfra, Third Aria. The Guardian defeats Ir Sûfra. Toland appears. The Guardian speaks to Toland.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: Here, Guardian. I came to the Moon with Eris and other lost warriors not to end the Nightmares, but to meet them — understand them. From that understanding, I expected to conquer their horrors and safeguard our past, present, and future. But the Hive are not simply waking terror. They are a dark mirror — a reflection of all we fear to face in ourselves. Crota, Oryx, the Worm Gods, the Ascendant Plane… they are so much more than enemies and the unknowable. They are teachers. The fear they sow: a lesson — a path toward an evolution. We must tear every instrument of death they wield from their hearts, minds, and hands and remake them to inflict our will.
The Guardian crosses a bridge and finds Ir Airâm, Deathsinger.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: The pain of her song. Even removed from your plane, I can feel its reach. Silence her!
The Guardian defeats Ir Airâm, Deathsinger.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: The Deathsong is yours to command — a new chorus to serenade your enemies with suffering. The final instrument is yours. Take the Deathsinger's skull to Eris; complete the weapon.
The Guardian returns to Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The deadly chorus of the Deathsinger's call has been stolen and bound to your growing arsenal. Once more you have proven yourself worth to stand against the night. Let the Deathsong protect you as it rends those who once cheered its wicked power.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Defender of Light, Dark Priestess — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian approaches Zavala after defeating Kridis, the Darkness Priestess.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Kridis is defeated. But it's not the Fallen that concern me now… It's us. I've had time to think. Guardians are not immune to corruption. The pursuit of power has divided us before. I don't know what comes next. But I know — I know — that we must remain in the Light. I see fractures already. If we bend, we will break. Guardians must not use the Darkness. This is the Vanguard's official position. The people of the City look to us. Help me show them the way.

lines.text: Annex, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: The man with the Golden Gun killed Callum. Every one o' those Hunter types has got a Golden Gun, but that man fights like it's HIS. He's been after me and my crew a long time. Pretty sure I'm the only one left… Anyway, I gotta thank you. Not a lotta people I like. Even less I can trust. Just don't ever tell anyone what you saw today. You cross me and, well… let's just say it wasn't an accident that man found Callum. Let's get you back to action. There's plenty o' Gambit in front o' you.

title: Quest: Differential Diagnosis, Enhance! — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay. Think outside the box. If I were several containers of artificially enhanced Ether, where would I be?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Keep it simple. The Fallen are desperate. They're trying to hide something. How did they do it last time?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, they used a set of barriers to keep us out. I'm detecting one nearby. Let's go!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That is a big barrier. No wonder I could detect it so far away.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: The bigger the barrier, the bigger the cache. How are you going to get it down?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Don't overthink it. Go punch some Fallen, see if they've got the keycode.
The Guardian melees several Fallen. Instead of finding a keycode, the Guardian finds some explosives.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ha! No keycodes. But I think this explosive will work just as well.

The Guardian plants the explosives and then detonates them, bringing down the barrier. They continue along the path and find another barrier. The Guardian defeats an Unstable Vandal, which drops more explosives. The Guardian uses the explosives to bring down the barrier. The Guardian heads further along the path and finds a third barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a Fallen teleporter here. I think I can brute force my way past their security, but not quickly.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: No choice. You're gonna have to kick down the door, little guy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What is it with mysterious, hooded, anti-authority types calling me little?
Ghost hacks the Fallen teleporter. The Guardian defeats several waves of Fallen. The Guardian uses the teleporter to get past the barrier. They find and destroy several Ether tanks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's nothing left in these cores. All the Ether's been drained out of them. But there's another cache nearby.

The Guardian heads towards the cache and finds another barrier. The Guardian defeats the Fallen who appear, including an Unstable Captain who drops some explosives. The Guardian uses the explosives to blow up the barrier.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Be on your guard. The Red Legion must have heard all the commotion. I've seen Harvesters flying about the area.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Bet they want some payback for the Fallen stealing their stuff. I can relate.
The Guardian continues towards the Ether cache.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This must be the place, but there's no Fallen. And the Ether must be cloaked.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Then lets get the neighbours to uncloak it! Why don't you send up a couple of flares, and see how some Red Legion shock troops shake things up?

The Guardian launches several flares. Kraug, the Undeterred and his Cabal shock troops drop in, causing Mazan, Lost Captain and his Fallen to panic and reveal themselves. The Guardian defeats Kraug, the Undeterred and Mazen, Lost Captain and destroys the ether caches.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's hard to tell with all the cloaking, but I think we got it all.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Seems likely. I just caught a glimpse of a Servitor headed for the mines. Never seen one like it.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Ten glimmer says THAT'S the one making all the modified Ether! Don't miss this chance, you two.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, just… let us enjoy this one for a minute.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Evacuation, Beyond Light — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian travels to Eventide Ruins.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian, I don't know if I have it in me to keep this up… wielding the Darkness, I mean.
A Skiff with Eliksni escapees who are allies of Variks is prevented from leaving Europa due to being held in place by an emitted field.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: The Skiff is prepared [wheezes] Help my allies flee this ruined place, and they will become your allies too.

The Guardian tampers with the field emitters and three Archon Aspirants arrive to protect the field emitters. The Guardian defeats the Archon Aspirants and enters the field emitter codes. The allied Skiff is released from the emitted field and escapes.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: My friend… thank you. Soon, the Eliksni who still know hope will flee to safety. [insect-like chattering] Misraaks, the Light Kell, awaits them. For a Kell, he is young. Untested. [insect-like chattering] But my people dare to hope, yes? I see now that you wield this dark power more wisely than Eramis. Perhaps the corrupt did not stem from Darkness, but from anger. [insect-like chattering] Bring this lesson to Eramis. [insect-like chattering]

title: Quest: Eyes on the Moon, Vex Invasion — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Black Garden lies open. As we speak, Vex are spilling out onto the Moon, drawn by the Pyramid's influence. Countless more are sure to follow. Our problems, it seems, are multiplying. If the Vex drive us off the Moon, we'll lose our access to the Pyramid – and with it, any hope of stopping the Nightmares. This threat must be contained. Before it grows beyond our ability to contain it. My focus must remain fixed on the Pyramid. This task, then, must fall to you. You and Ikora both. Push the Vex back. Learn what you can of their intentions. And bring your findings to Ikora. Light the path for one another, and we may yet survive this… complication. See it through, Guardian.

title: Quest: Expand and Collapse, Raising Our Defenses — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian opens the Seraph Bunker.
The Guardian heads through the corridors. The Guardian opens a door to the Seraph Bunker's control room and sees Zavala speaking with Rasputin.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ana insists you understand the stakes. Convince me. Hm…
Rasputin displays a hologram of the solar system with several Pyramid ships at the edge of the system.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Our enemy reveals itself. Their shadow is long and close. Is this what's had your attention? Preparations to fight? To rebuild? To run?
Rasputin responds to Zavala and hacks Zavala's Ghost to play recorded transmissions from the Collapse.

Zavala's Ghost: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday! This is NFV Meritursas XVI, 11,000 souls in cyrosleep aboard. We are, uh, we are a few minutes out of New Pacific Arcology. We were struck by debris in a large wave. Fusion plant offline. We can see extensive… catastrophic damage to one of the arcology domes. Oh. Oh, it's gone over. Respond if able…

Zavala's Ghost: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. This is New Pacific Arcology on GUARD, declaring a SUNDOWN loss of habitability event. We have 2.9 million souls aboard. We repeat, Titan is no longer safe for human life -

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Collapse. You were there. You gave everything to a cause and saw it all swept away. You're afraid to fail. Again.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: So am I. I've never considered how it must have felt to live through the Collapse. From this day, we speak as allies, not warriors who seek to wield each other as weapons. After we break the Almighty, the City will devote whatever resources you need towards banishing these dark omens. When they come, we will stand together. As equals. As Guardians.
Zavala turns and looks up at the hologram and then transmats away.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Experimental Treatment, Enhance! — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Hawthorne has asked Ikora to take her place. Something about, "Knowing more about all that Fallen stuff."

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Meaning Ether distribution from Servitors to Kells, consequences when that supply is severed, subtleties of an Archon Priest versus a Captain…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got an Archon Priest, and he's glowing.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Then some enhanced Ether still remains. Finish him quickly.
The Guardian defeats Raksil, Archon Priest and collects several Ether Cores.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Perhaps you could scatter them like breadcrumbs and draw your quarry back to the surface.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: You're joking, Devrim. But that might actually work. Guardian, head back to Devrim's tower. You'll need some room for this to work.
Using the Ether cores, the Guardian lures many Fallen and Serkuleks, the Fount, a Servitor, who teleports away after being damaged.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: That Servitor will be vulnerable while it recharges. Find it, and destroy it.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: I'm reading multiple inbound Fallen ships. They're not going down without a fight!
The Guardian defeats Serkuleks, the Fount and the rest of the Fallen.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The Fallen won't recover from this any time soon. Exemplary.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Head back this way when you have a minute, and we'll close this chapter out.

title: Quest: Faculties of the Skull, Symphony of Death — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Luna — forever haunted by the Hive's vile corruption. But we will turn their wicked sins against them. Find Toland, Guardian… Let his shattered mind guide you.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: The siren call of the Deathsingers pervades the minds of those with little strength. Step beyond the threshold and display your power.

The Guardian finds the Nightmare Servant of Ir Yût and Devoted of Ir Yût attempting a wicked communion. The Guardian defeats the Nightmare Servant of Ir Yût and Devoted of Ir Yût and receives the Silent Skull.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: The skull of the devoted belongs to you now. There is great power in it… should you find a path to wield it.
The Guardians returns to Eris Morn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Have you heard the call of the Deathsong? Do you remember its tune? Madness and decay and destruction of the flesh. Its terrible melody can be ours.

title: Quest: Follow Up Appointment, Enhance! — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: I'm fresh out of words to thank you for a job well done. Perhaps I should study some other languages. If not for you, the Fallen might have clawed their way back to our door in time. Instead, they're back to running scared. It's easy to think of them as just another enemy. But look a bit closer, and their desperation's not too different from ours. Ah, that's enough philosophy for now. I'm just glad not to have glowing Fallen about the place while I try to sleep. So for that: cracking good job!

title: Quest: Further Interference, Let Loose Thy Talons — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Guardian, the coordinates the Traveler sent us lead to the dam. It's overrun by Taken, but we're going deep inside. They're less active on those levels. I'll scout out the spots the Taken usually infest. Clear the path for you as best I can.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Do you… come out here often, Crow?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Not as much since we met, but I used to when on assignment. It's quiet out here. No one to bother me… hmph, or for me to bother.
The Guardian approaches a golden hawk, a manifestation of the Light, and communes with the Traveler. The Guardian searches for the golden hawk's feathers.
The Reservoir, European Dead Zone, Earth
The Guardian collects a Paracausal Feather.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This feather both exists and doesn't exist. It's a manifestation of potential energy. The choice between action and inaction.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Keep an eye out for Taken. That's exactly the sort of thing Savathûn would love to get her spindly little hands on.
The Guardian heads further into the reservoir, defeating the Taken which they encounter.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Not to worry you or anything, but there's definitely something going on here.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: What he means is that we've picked up numerous paracausal readings throughout the dam… and a number of very agitated Taken.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: We'll handle Savathûn's Taken, but the other energy signatures are closer to you. Can you look into it?

The Guardian defeats the Taken which appear as they head further into the Reservoir and collects two more Paracausal Feathers. As the Guardian approaches the fourth Paracausal Feather, they discover one of Crow's hideouts.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Don't mind the mess. Glint's a terrible maid. This is just where I come to… get some distance when I need it. Some place to call my own.
The Guardian approaches several empty bottles.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I did not drink that by myself, in case you were curious. In fact, I didn't have any of it. After Glint brought me to life, I quickly came to realize that Guardians recognized me as whoever I was before. They… weren't always kind. Heh. So I took to wearing a helmet to hide my face. Before Spider. Even then, I rescued a Warlock and her Ghost once. She offered me a drink afterward, but I left before she came back with it. I don't know why but I returned for the empty bottle later. I've always wondered how she would have treated me if I'd stayed. If she saw my face.
The Guardian approaches an Ascendant Sword.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I've learned many things since my second birth. Fear. Humility. But this… this was where I learned pride. That Sword belonged to the Hive Knight I killed to protect Osiris. It felt good, saving someone so important to the Vanguard. Someone who used to be an outcast. It was like I had finally found my purpose. Like I was brought back for a reason. And there you were, Guardian.
The Guardian approaches a white shroud.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I forgot this was here. My first memories are waking up under this shroud. The first thing that was mine. It was comforting, somehow. I couldn't bring myself to throw it away. Someone cared enough to lay me to rest. I meant something to them, whoever they are, and that… means something to me.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Ahh… ha, yes. Spider wanted all of this thrown out, but I couldn't bring myself to. Even broken, it still might have a purpose to someone. I've heard that before the Collapse, there used to be an art. It took broken things and put them back together with precious metals. It made something new and beautiful out of something that would have just been thrown away.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Oh, right. Glint gave this to me.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: It was a gift. It was the Dawning. Your first Dawning.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: The first time I ever felt it might be safe to be around other Guardians. I'm not stupid. I know… the person I used to be, he did something terrible. I can feel it when people look into my eyes and see him. The way you looked at me when we met. I don't ever want to know him.
The Guardian collects the fourth Paracausal Feather. The Guardian tracks the Taken to the lowest sector of the reservoir. Ishrasek, Lightbinder of Savathûn appears.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Something's happening. I'm detecting massive gravity distortions in the dam! A little tip from upstairs: when these Taken are destroyed, they'll collapse into singularities of paracausal energy. Use that to disrupt their shield!
The Guardian defeats Lightseeker Taken Acolytes and uses orbs of condensed paracausal energy to destroy Ishrasek's shield. The Guardian attacks Ishrasek until Ishrasek retreats.
Velox, Lightseeker of Savathûn and Teorax, Lightseeker of Savathûn appear. The Guardian defeats Velox, Lightseeker of Savathûn, Teorax, Lightseeker of Savathûn and the remaining Taken.
The Guardian collects two more Paracausal Feathers. The Guardian approaches the golden hawk nearby and communes with the Traveler.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I don't know why the Taken blocked that wing off. There's just an old ship down there. Spider wanted me to junk it, but I… might have told him that I did, and kept it for myself.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Doesn't run anymore. It was already in pretty bad shape before we got to it. And while Crow might be an excellent pilot, he, uh… he isn't exactly gentle with his ships.

lines.text: The Guardian heads towards a door that was previously locked but is now unlocked. The Guardian opens the door and enters a control room that was seen during a previous mission. The Guardian finds a Fallen Transponder on a desk in the control room. The transponder has six missing nodes and clues to the locations of the nodes.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Data Requisition, Enemy of My Enemy
The Guardian finds the first node for the Fallen Transponder.
The guardian finds the second node for the Fallen Transponder.
The guardian finds the third node for the Fallen Transponder.
The guardian finds the fourth node for the Fallen Transponder.
The Guardian finds the fifth node for the Fallen Transponder.
The Guardian finds the sixth node for the Fallen Transponder.
With all the nodes, the Fallen Transponder reveals a code which leads the Guardian to the Farm.
The Guardian enters a cellar and finds Mithrax, the Forsaken, a Fallen Captain whom the Guardian encountered during previous missions on Titan. The Guardian rendezvouses with Mithrax, the Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Chances and Choices, Enemy of My Enemy

The Guardian goes through a doorway and finds a Fallen Dreg. Mithrax, the Forsaken appears and kills the Dreg before disappearing. The Guardian enters a vent and heads towards an open area. The Guardian defeats the Fallen in the area then continues through the Tower ruins towards the enemy target.
The Guardian follows the path to another open area. The Guardian defeats the Fallen in the area and continues towards the area where the Hangar used to be.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen in the area, including a Fallen Walker. The Guardian continues through the Tower ruins, defeating any Fallen they encounter along the way.
The Guardian continues through the Tower ruins, defeating any Fallen they encounter along the way.
The Guardian enters a vent underneath a ship and continues through the vents towards the enemy target.

The Guardian enters a room with a map on the screen with the letters TR3-VR on it. The Guardian enters a vent and continues through the vents until they reach a maze-like area. The Guardian pauses at the vent opening which leads to the maze-like area. A machine, TR3-VR, passes through the corridor belong the Guardian. The Guardian jumps down and works their way through the maze, eventually finding their way to a room with several elevator platforms. The Guardian activates one of the elevator platforms and travels on the platform to a walkway high up in the room. The Guardian jumps onto the walkway and enters a vent, then continues towards the enemy target.
The Guardian enters the Cryptarch's Vault and heads through the Vault towards the enemy target.

The Guardian falls through a vent towards an open area below where Siriks, Loyal to Eramis is waiting, along with a group of Fallen. The Guardian fights against Siriks and the Fallen. A Fallen Servitor, Mimiks-0, Devils Scion, appears. The Guardian defeats Mimik-0, Devils Scion. Another Fallen Servitor, Mimiks-1, Devils Scion, appears. The Guardian defeats Mimiks-1, Devils Scion. The Guardian continues to fight against Siriks and the Fallen. Two Fallen Walkers appear. The Guardian defeats the Fallen Walkers. The Guardian defeats Siriks, Loyal to Eramis and the remaining Fallen. Mithrax, the Forsaken appears, along with a Fallen Skiff. Mithrax teleports to the Skiff and Skiff flies away. The Guardian receives the Outbreak Perfected weapon.

title: Quest: Gratitude, Dynasty — Transcript

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: When we first met, I presumed you were quite useless. I'm sure you understand why. But you… you have disproved my hypothesis. You succeeded where I failed. You entered the Pyramidion and returned unscathed. Of course, you did not go so deep as I. You did not reach the lake… The Vex never fail to leave their mark. The Taken will discover that in due time. And as for you… You warrant further observation.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Initial Consultation, Enhance! — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Have you two noticed any strange Fallen nearby? I swear I've caught sight of four armed creatures that were glowing.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: We've all been through a lot, Devrim. Staying in your church tower for this long might have taken a toll.
The Guardian finds and kills a glowing Empyean Vandal. They collect an Ether sample from the Vandal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Good news Devrim. It's not just you. There is something different about these Fallen.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Somehow that doesn't make me feel any better.
The Guardian defeats several more glowing Fallen and collects Ether samples from them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's something in their Ether. Traces of Cabal technology

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Ether only provides sustenance for the Fallen. If they're augmenting if for some other purpose…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've gotten pretty good at isolating Cabal signatures. Let me see if there's something around here I can trace.
Ghost tracks the Cabal signature underground to some energy barriers.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These energy barriers are throttling our communications. Whatever we're doing down here, we'd better do it fast.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Say again? You're breaking up a bit.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Fallen made some kind of electromagnetic cage to hide what they're doing. No wonder we couldn't find the source.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Devrim, do you still have their signal?

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: No luck, mum. We might have lost them down there.
The Guardian defeats Kalis, Sunless Captain and the other Fallen, then disables the EM field.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Good to hear your voice again. What did you find?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm not sure. Some kind of machine. It's enhancing their Ether somehow.
The Guardian destroy the Cabal device.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Ah, the direct approach. Well, if it means they can't make any more of that stuff, I'm all for it.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: But the Fallen are resourceful. This isn't over. I must go and meditate on how to end this crisis.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Always thinking about the big picture, that one. Head back to the church, you two. Let's figure out our next move.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: Savathûn's influence over the Cradle grows. Retake the Tree of Silver Wings.

lines.text: The servants of Savathûn fight to keep us from the messages of Darkness. Use the Seed to dispel their foul influence.

lines.text: Savathûn's forces reach toward the Darkness. Use the Seed to burn them away.

lines.text: Enemies of the Light swarm the roots of the great tree. Bring the Seed and banish them once more.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Savathûn's forces attack the Cradle. Destroy them, and use the Seed to reveal the secrets that sleep within.
The Guardian heads towards the Tree of Silver Wings.

The Guardian enters the area with the Tree of Silver Wings and finds two Envoys of Savathûn summoning Savathûn's Witness, a huge Shrieker. Savathûn's Witness teleports away. The Guardian defeats the Envoys of Savathûn and the other Taken which appear.

The Guardian heads towards the area where Savathûn's Witness has teleported to. Another Envoy of Savathûn appears. The Guardian defeats the Envoy of Savathûn and fights against Savathûn's Witness. Savathûn's Witness teleports away again and the Guardian is teleported to the Ascendant Plane.
Court of Savathûn, Ascendant Plane, Io

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: You are a child reaching toward a flame. The Taken Queen would not have you burnt. Pledge your allegiance and be reborn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Nokris? Oryx's foundling and exiled brother to Crota. He is now bound to Savathûn as a catalyst for her interference. Silence it.
The Guardian approaches an Ascendant Portal resembling the Court of Oryx. Nokris, Supplicant to Savathûn appears.
The variations of Nokris' dialogue can occur at any point during the battle with Nokris, and may occur in a different order to the one shown below.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: You are but one in a chain of failures claimed and sunken.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Be Taken and see endless possibility awaken.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Oryx, Crota, Xol. Gods with gods. End your faith and walk unhindered.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Our shackles are strong. We must be strong to break them.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Life and death are liar’s tools. Weave your own lie.
Nokris releases a soulfire crystal and shields himself. Two Envoys of Savathûn appear. The Guardian defeats the Envoys of Savathûn, destroys the crystal, and breaks Nokris' shield.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: The tree brings ruin. Fell its might or be buried in the shadow of its leaves.

Nokris releases another soulfire crystal, shields himself, and aggresses towards the Guardian. Two Envoys of Savathûn appear. The Guardian defeats the Envoys of Savathûn, destroys the crystal, and breaks Nokris' shield.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Light and Dark are locked blades. A logic simple and narrow. A bridge with only one path.
Nokris releases two more soulfire crystal and shields himself. Two Envoys of Savathûn appear. The Guardian defeats the Envoys of Savathûn, destroys the crystals, and breaks Nokris' shield.

lines.speaker: Nokris
lines.text: Savathûn shields from dire truths. Submit and be free.
The Guardian defeats Nokris, Supplicant to Savathûn.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Nokris is an abomination, his name stricken from the World's Grave. You've done well to purge his stain from this failing court.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why would Savathûn work with him?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: With? Nokris is an exploited outcast, Little Light. A Necromancer. Though I'm sure the "Taken Queen" saw value in his craft: death rituals to buck the Worm's game. I dare not wonder how she meant to wield that knowledge.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We shouldn't dwell on it, you know. He's not coming back from that.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Good riddance. Savathûn's haze has diminished considerably, though not completely.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Then I hope she saw what became of her brood. Hold still. I will fetch you.

The Guardian is teleported to the Pyramid hovering over the Cradle and witnesses a display of a Pyramid surrounded by four factions: the Guardians, the Cabal, the Fallen, and the Hive. The Darkness speaks to the Guardian through Ghost.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Don't you see? This is as we once said. In Light, there is only weakness. Only failure. Only death. But where the Light takes, the Dark gives. No longer will you be a pawn. No longer will you watch the lives of those you care for be lost. Remember, in Darkness, there is only strength. Only victory. Only life. Ancient power awaits you on Europa.
An Ascendant Portal appears and the Guardian returns to the Tree of Silver Wings. The Guardian approaches Eris Morn and the Seed of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This transmission can be translated as "contact." Not physical. More ethereal. Influential. It is conjugated here as an action with a singular subject but innumerable objects. Guardian… what if we are not the only ones to whom the Darkness speaks?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well done, Guardian. I will interpret the Darkness's messages as best I can. Although this particular form of communication is… logographic, composed of evocative glyphs. Metaphors, really. For example, this message… this word could mean "protected," but it is loaded with subtext. These are connotations of blithe authoritarian forces, unshakable in their faith. The translation "sheltered" would not be sinister enough. Perhaps… "gelded?" Clearly, the Darkness does not believe the Traveler to be as benevolent as we do. Continue your efforts. We have much to learn.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I didn't think it was possible. I had given up. I spent lifetimes looking for Saint. A dozen of my echoes lost their minds before I retired them. Part of me wishes you were there to see it. To feel what I felt when I surrendered. But then where would we be? What you've done today… This is amazing. Saint will need your help. The world has changed since he last walked free. In his youth, he talked often about the Guardian who inspired him. I should have guessed it would be you.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: This place is crawling with Hive. Keep an eye out while I hook Rasputin in. Some of this netcode is ancient. I hear what people say behind my back. You know, that I'm a Bray first and a Guardian second. Selfishly chasing my past. But Rasputin and I have been busy scouring the system. Not for ourselves. We were looking for Golden Age relics, hunting down the Deep Stone Crypt, chasing loose threads. It wasn't just weapons. Old nano-meds, construction servos, disease-resistant crop strains. Finds that would make a real difference in people's lives. We assumed Zavala and the Vanguard could handle any immediate threats, but… we could have done more.
Ana Bray transmats out of the control room. The Guardian restores Rasputin's connection to the Seraph Bunker Network.

title: Quest: Legacy Code, Data Recovery — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I've been digging through Rasputin's data repository, and I've found a blank spot in his artificial cortex. It's not like it was erased - his brain is structured to work like ours. It's more like it was suppressed. Now, some may think that mere mortals shouldn't be poking around at suppressed Warmind memories. But there is nothing mere or mortal about you. That's a compliment, by the way, in case it sounds weird. We're gonna solve this puzzle together.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I've been digging through Rasputin's files, and there's a similar pattern that keeps popping up. After some analysis I've deciphered it. It's a set of coordinates! Head over there and check it out.
The Guardian heads towards the coordinates.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's nothing here, Ana. Wait… I'm detecting a unique energy signature.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: That can't be a coincidence! Follow it and see where it leads!
The Guardian heads towards the energy signature. Ghost scans the source.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ana, we found the source of the reading. My sensors tell me it's a DVALIN core. Let me see if I can pull data from it. There's a reference to IKELOS… a serial number… it's giving off a faint signal. Transmitting now.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Hmm… the serial number links up with a chest that's marked as missing in the database. Search the facility. It's got to be there somewhere.
The Guardian defeats the Hive and the Cabal they encounter as they search for the chest. The Guardian finds the missing chest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ana, we've found the chest, but it's empty. Must have been the Red Legion.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Is there any part of this facility that they haven't picked clean?
The Guardian searches for Ana's components. The Guardian finds the chest with the first component.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ana, we've retrieved your… well, we don't know what it is. The data is encrypted.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The encryption is a sequence, a really familiar one. But this is only one piece of the data. There's got to be another. We can use this piece to track the missing one.

The Guardian searches for the second component. The Cabal commanders Val Bulgur and Val Garurc appear. The Guardian defeats Val Bulgur and Val Garurc. A barrier surrounding the chest with the second component disappears. The Guardian opens the chest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have it, Ana. Sending you the data now.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: This isn't just a random sequence. It's an algorithm! I know what it's for! Get to the core and I'll explain later!
The Guardian heads towards the core.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: This algorithm, it's an omni-key. My omni-key. It can unlock anything in Rasputin's database. But that's not all. Load the data components you recovered into the core.
The Guardian uploads the data components into the core.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Those data components aren't just useless code, they're blueprints. And Rasputin is recombining them in the core!
The Guardian defeats the Cabal which appear. Commander Truvul appears. The Guardian defeats Commander Truvul. The Guardian investigates the reunited artifact and picks up a Forged Engram.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've never seen anything quite like this before. I wonder what's inside?

title: Quest: Lighting the Dark, Enemy of My Enemy — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: With your data, Holliday's been able to dig out the locations of two terminals in the reactors auxiliary system. They appear to be on the fritz.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We need you to get in there and cycle the power. That should clear up the noise and restore the core systems as well.
The Guardian cycles the power on the first auxiliary terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cycling power. Lets find the other one.
The Guardian cycles the power on the second auxiliary terminal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's two… Wait. Devices that require multiple, separate activations? Aren't those, you know, really dangerous?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Did I say the reactor was safe?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here I was thinking you liked us.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The people Sloane likes tend to wind up in crossfire in indefensible positions. Ask me how I know.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Because I trust you to survive, Commander. All right. With those terminals refreshed, we've pinpointed the reactor's bootup console. Light 'em up.
The Guardian heads towards the bootup console. They find a safety checkpoint blocking their path to the console.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Huh, Golden Age safety checkpoints. Still operational too.
Ghost hacks the checkpoint so that they can continue towards the console. Ghost spots the Fallen Captain they previously encountered stuck in a security box.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, look who it is! The Captain. And it looks like he's stuck. Too bad.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Don't let him distract you. Wake up that reactor.
Ghost turns on the reactor. The Guardian and the Ghost get trapped in a security box. The Fallen Captain is freed from the security box which was holding him.
[In another language: "Reactor initializing. Returning recognized life forms to safety zones"]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I, uh… didn't mean to free the Captain
The Captain and the other Fallen escape as Ghost tries to free the Guardian from the security box.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're free, lets get out of here.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I can see the reactor on heat scans, bright and clear. Well done, Guardian. Now all we have to do is get to it before the Fallen do. Should be easy. Right?
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: O Captain, Exodus Black — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Poor Failsafe. It's been so long since the Black crashed here. I'll be surprised if we find much.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait. This is weird. I'm picking something up nearby.
The Guardian finds a dead person's body. Ghost scans the body.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This… there's a voice recording left behind in this… suit's computer.

lines.speaker: Unknown Male Voice
lines.text: Mayday! Mayday! I repeat, the Exodus Black has been compromised by an unknown alien lifeform! We are 600 souls on board; systems are failing. We are going down! Mayday!
The Guardian finds the bodies of two more dead people. Ghost scans the bodies.

lines.speaker: Unknown female voice
lines.text: Day 9. We're out of just about everything. Water, oxygen, ideas. I'm gonna disable the shackle programming on the ship's failsafe AI. We need every bit of help we can get.
The Guardian finds a fourth body. Ghost scans the body.

lines.speaker: Female voice
lines.text: We lost the Lieutenant today. Now it's just the pilot, the Captain, and me. Cap thinks the Black's satellite array might still be intact. I think he's crazy.
The Guardian finds a fifth body. Ghost scans the body.

lines.speaker: Unknown female voice
lines.text: Captain, please! Don't go. Those robots will kill you!

lines.speaker: Captain Jacobson
lines.text: The satellite array is our only chance. (sigh) Stay if you want, but I'm going. I'm sorry. I'll come back for you.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: That was Captain Jacobson! That was his voice!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Don't get too excited yet. Let's see if we can find that satellite array he mentioned.
The Guardian finds the satellite array.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a microcomputer here. It's trying to send a message.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: That transmitter is only 13% operational! I may be able to execute a remote repair. Please stand by!

lines.speaker: Captain Jacobson
lines.text: Mayday-mayday-mayday, this is Captain Jacobson. The Exodus Black has crash landed on a planetoid, ID "Nessus." We request immediate [VEX DATABURST]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That sounded like a Vex signal at the end.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: According to my database, the Vex use that noise as a greeting! And/or a war cry!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well. It's possible that the Vex might remember what happened to the Captain. Or recall where he went… centuries ago…
The Guardian defeats three Empathic Sentinals to collect memory data from the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Aggregating our kill data now. This is crazy. Seems like the Vex believe that the captain is coming to meet us. Right now. Look up! Something's up there! Never mind… it's just a weird looking Harpy.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: No! Please pursue the "weird looking Harpy"! Remember, you said the captain is coming to meet you!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yes, but that's not the captain. I suppose maybe he sent an escort for us, but I've never heard of anyone befriending the Vex.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain Jacobson was exceptionally kind to all robotic lifeforms.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Not a Weapon, Lock and Key — Transcript

lines.text: Annex, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Siviks, perished. Another forge, recovered. And yet, one final piece of the puzzle remains… What was Siviks searching for in that facility? What secrets remain within the Black Armory Papers? I pored through its pages, and I believe I found us a lead. The artifact you forged - it's for the very weapon I used to avenge our murdered founder. The pages imply that when the two are combined, they act as a key. And I'd be honored if you used it to solve our final mystery.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: My Captain, Exodus Black — Transcript

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain, did you find the Captain?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No sign of him yet, Failsafe. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: That is fine, and not at all disappointing! It's not like I've been waiting centuries for this.
The Guardian follows the strange Harpy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's that Harpy again. It seems… friendly. Maybe it'll lead to the Captain. If nothing else, we'll have an interesting story for Asher.
The Guardian follows the Harpy deeper into the Sunken Cavern.

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: From… Earth? You… like. Captain. Once.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, this is not your captain.

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: Captain. Yes. Come… Test. We test.
The Guardian jumps further down into the Sunken Cavern.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I knew this was some kind of trap.
The Guardian defends themselves against the hostile Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What is this? Where's Captain Jacobson?

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: Captain Jacobson. Yes. Come. Share mind…
The Guardian starts to establish a link with the Harpy while defending themselves from hostile Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, don't say we've never done anything for you.
The Guardian defends another mind link with the Harpy against the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey, that Harpy's on the move again.
The Harpy makes a successful mind link with the Guardian before leading the Guardian towards another trial.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain Jacobson? Can you hear me? It's me, your failsafe.

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: It's you, my failsafe. Yes. I have this memory. You are a good failsafe. Always helping. Very good.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain? Are you… I've scanned for you everyday since you left. I'm so sorry I couldn't find you.

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: I left. Yes. I have this memory.
The Harpy leads the Guardian over floating rocks to another area within the Sunken Cavern.

lines.speaker: Harpy
lines.text: Loss. Yes. We will test loss.
The Guardian destroys Kagathos, Empathic Mind. The Harpy leads the Guardian to Captain Jacobson's body. Ghost scans the body.

lines.speaker: Captain Jacobson
lines.text: This is the final log of Captain Jacobson, of the Exodus Black. We hoped to touch the stars, to colonize beyond our system. We failed. I couldn't save my colonists. I couldn't save my crew. (wheezy chuckle) I couldn't even save myself. The machines here are closing in. I think… I think they mean to study me. If someone finds this… I would do it all… again.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yes. I'm so sorry, Failsafe. We'll see you soon
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Quest: Not Even the Darkness, Legends Lost — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yes! I have a reading on Saint-14's location. Hold on, we're coming for you.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: Bring him back to us, Guardian. Saint-14 is a primary source of the early Osiris years. He will be able to settle some… let's call them "differences of opinion in which one side is wrong."

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll get right on that, Vance…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If Saint-14 has been lost all this time, do you think he's OK?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Nothing could stop that old Exo. Probably lecturing a Vex? Titan lectures – long speeches, occasional punching.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Oh. Yeah. You missed our first trip here. Vex are quite the decorators, aren't they?
The Guardian heads towards the signal's location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There! The signal is coming from beyond that gate.
The Guardian finds a conflux. Ghost attempts to scan the conflux but before being able to scan it, the conflux disappears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: And it moved. Definitely a temporal disruption.
The Guardian finds the conflux, but it disappears before Ghost can scan it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If Saint-14 was threatened, he would attack. And he would not have known how easy it is to be cast adrift in these… realities.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then we'll find him and bring him home.
Several confluxes appear in front of the gate. Hagios, Reverent Mind appears near the confluxes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A Minotaur. Are they trying to keep us out, or him in?

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Both? Take out the Mind, take down the gate. It's true in pretty much every reality.
The Guardian defeats Hagios, Reverent Mind.
The Guardian finds the conflux and Ghost is finally able to scan it. The gate opens. The Guardian walks through the gate into the stronghold.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What happened…? Vex. Thousands of them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I… I think we should leave him here. It looks like the Infinite Forest laid him to rest. Built him a… memorial. Did the Vex learn to respect him?
If the Guardian doesn't immediately recover Saint-14's personal effects.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Saint-14 must have been here for years. Decades. He ran out of ammo, and just… kept fighting.
The Guardian recovers Saint-14's personal effects.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't think I ever told you this, but Saint-14 was one of the first Guardians I ever met, even before I found you. I always hoped you'd turn out like him. I wasn't disappointed. You were a good friend, Saint. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: That encryption pattern… let me examine it! Yes… yes! This relic you found – it once belonged to Saint-14! It has power. But not power enough to save the mighty Titan. Lost to the Vex. Alone in the Infinite Forest. We really do need each other. Guardian and Ghost. The Followers and Osiris. In any case. It is not our charge to keep relics such as these. It is yours now. Use this as he would have.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: The Sundial, Fields of Glass, Mercury
The Guardian enters a portal to Mercury's past. The Guardian defeats the Vex including a Cyclops. The Guardian opens a gate to the Infinite Forest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: If we did this right, Saint should be waiting for us in the Forest. Let's hope he's still alive.

A gate to the Infinite Forest is shown. A Vex Goblin is thrown out of the gate. The Goblin gets to its feet and walks towards the gate. A fist emerges from the gate and punches the Goblin, killing it.
Saint-14 emerges from the gate, dragging a Vex Goblin behind him. Saint-14 shoots the Goblin with his shotgun.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: They call me the greatest Titan who ever lived. But I would be dead if not for you.

A Vex Minotaur emerges from the gate. Saint-14 turns around and bashes the Minotaur with his Void shield, then headbutts the Minotaur several times. Saint-14 grabs the dead Goblin, wraps it around the Minotaur, and kills the Minotaur with a final headbutt.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Since the day I met you, I swore I would make it my duty to follow your example. I'm still trying.

lines.speaker: Ikora

I can't remember the last time we all came together like this. The Red War, I suppose. There's a saying that Osiris once taught me. "We are dwarves standing on the shoulders of giants." Every truth we discover, every victory we win is only possible because of those who came before us. Take time to rest and enjoy the Festival. You've been working hard.
