lines.text: Bazaar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Undying Mind. If we could kill it now, we would secure Luna from the Vex. But the Mind is moving between timelines, making copies of itself in hundreds upon thousands of different realities. A difficult problem with no elegant solution… I don't think we need elegance. We need brute force. Imagine a portal tuned into the Undying Mind. One that would allow us to summon it from any timeline. If we had such a portal, we could kill it in hundreds upon thousands of different ways until there's nowhere and no when left to hide. I think we can make such a portal. It won't be quick. It won't be easy. But if we hold the line and work together, we can do it.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The only way to decode that engram is to bring it to Rasputin himself. I'll have to install my omni-key into his network to crack it. I've located a terminal with a direct line to his mainframe. I need you two to upload the omni-key.
The Guardian finds the terminal and uploads the omni-key. The Guardian defends the terminal against the Cabal.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Head to Rasputin! Time to open that engram!
The Guardian heads towards Rasputin. They find a firewall blocking their path.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Where did this firewall come from?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Safety mechanism. Cabal are encroaching on Rasputin. The Cabal have severed the lines to the security terminals. I'm sending you physical copies of the omni-key.

The Guardian picks up the first copy of the omni-key and uses it to disable the firewall. The Guardian defeats the Cabal which they encounter. The Guardian finds and picks up the second copy of the omni-key and uses it to disable the second firewall. They continue towards Rasputin. The Guardian finds and picks up the third copy of the omni-key and uses it to disable the third firewall.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Upload complete! Now we can talk to Rasputin and see what's in here.
The Guardian continues towards Rasputin. The Guardian defends the entrance to Rasputin's chamber against the Cabal by using the Valkyrie.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: There's the main terminal. Upload the omni-key and we'll be able to open up that engram.
The Guardian enters Rasputin's chamber and gives Rasputin the engram.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Wait, wait! Don't tell me. I want to see it firsthand.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I programmed Rasputin's linguistic AI. I taught him his first words, and then he made his own. That is an answer. And that is a gift. Thank you. These blueprints you recovered are something special. My sister Elsie and I worked on these together. I don't want to work on things alone anymore, if it can be helped. So I was wondering if you'd maybe help me finish it.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Guardian, if you're not busy, I could use your help. As you know, I have a wide network of informants. The Hidden. One of my Agents saw the Taken interacting strangely with the Vex, and then she went dark.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sorry to hear that. We'll take a look around. Maybe it's nothing.
The Guardian investigates a site to gather intelligence for Ikora.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hey guys? Seems like the Taken are trapping the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Why trap them? Are they trying to take them?

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ikora, please. Without their King, the Taken could not hope to possess even the most dim-witted of Goblins.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Challenge your assumptions, Asher Mir! Its always the impossible that actually happens.
The Guardian gathers intelligence from a group of Taken enemies and defeats an Ensnaring Wizard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm with Ikora. Something strange is going on here, and the Taken do not want us around.
The Guardian gathers intelligence from two more groups of Taken. Another Ensnaring Wizard appears. The Guardian defeats the Wizard.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up on a Vex broadcast. Seems like a distress call. We can track it.

The Guardian gathers intelligence on the confined Vex. A Taken Knight, Ir Arok, Tongue of Quria, appears. The Guardian fights Ir Arok but it disappears before it can be destroyed. In its place appears Elatiox, Beloved of Quria. The Guardian defeats Elatiox.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora, I think we found the Taken Knight behind all of this. He got away, but we're tracking him now.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That creature had the sense to retreat? Strange. Mind your step. We believed only Oryx, the Taken King, had the power to take his enemies and transform them. I fear we may have been wrong.

We can waste no more time trying to stop him. Asher Mir will stand and fight — he still has the heart of a Guardian. And Deputy Commander Sloane… she plans to meet the Pyramid above Titan head-on. One woman against the Darkness. What more could I have done? I tried to unite the Vanguard, and now we lie splintered in the face of the dark fleet. All we have left is faith in the Traveler… faith in the Light. Faith… in you.

lines.text: The Sundial, Fields of Glass, Mercury

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I told you before - I tried to save Saint-14. I bent the rules of time using a prototype of the Sundial. It allowed me to walk the corridors of time here on Mercury. But I failed. I never found Saint's final moment against the Vex. I encountered younger versions from his first mission to Mercury, among others. But none were the right Saint. The prototype Sundial still exists, accessible off the main deck. And it can still travel through Saint's personal timeline on this planet. But venture there at your own peril. He cannot be saved. I have walked every permutation of those corridors with a hundred thousand of my Echoes and found nothing. Saint-14 is lost.

title: Quest: Risk/Reward, Pain and Gain — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's a Fallen raiding party out there! I'd say something about risk versus reward, but that seems too obvious. We're hunting Dusk Captains! Kill the Mechanics to draw them out.
The Guardian defeats several Dusk Walker Mechanics. Three Captains, House of Dusk appear. The Guardian defeats the Captains, House of Dusk and the Dusk Walker.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've got what we need. Let's move!
The Guardian searches for the locked gate, defeating the Fallen which they encounter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Banshee's notes mentioned a locked door "near the gap."
The Guardian finds the gate and unlocks it, then heads into a passageway.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The only other note is: "Chasm. Have fun." If we're hunting for one of Cayde's stashes… those three words are a threat followed by sarcasm. Watch your angles. The fall will probably kill you.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cayde was always precious with his treasures. Hid them throughout the system. I wonder how much of his secrecy was for safety, and how much was for fun.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cayde would've liked you. You have his explorer's spirit, and you're not afraid to take risks. Careful now.
The Guardian continues traversing the chasm.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The math says, even those closest to Cayde will never find all of his stashes. The rumors of his misadventures don't even scratch the surface of the trouble he got up to.
Maybe… if Sundance were still with us… But… The memories of those we care for only hurt because we care… Anyway… we've gotta be close.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But who knows? Your legend is just getting started, Guardian. Maybe someday it'll be your adventures that inspire a new generation of heroes and explorers.
The Guardian reaches the far side of the chasm.
The Guardian finds Cayde's stash marked with a spade, a picture of the Colonel in a frame bordered by two ace of spades, and multiple boxes of spicy ramen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Banshee was right. His "funny, chicken-loving" friend left us a present.
The Guardian recovers the Arc Conductors and receives Riskrunner.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Your arsenal keeps growing, Guardian. Some of the technology in your hands is as advanced as the Golden Age. Which is to say: watch where you point that thing.
The Guardian enters the Fallen's nest below Cayde's stash.
The Guardian uses their new Riskrunner to defeat the Fallen. Haviks, Dusk Baron appears. The Guardian defeats Haviks, Dusk Baron.

title: Quest: Signal Light, Legends Lost — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up a signal. It's faint, but it's definitely coming from the Forest. Sounds like an old Vanguard code.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: Perhaps you hear the final dreams of the lost.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Uh… thanks? Very helpful. Since I can't track "dreams of the lost", how about we go find that signal?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The signal's getting stronger. I should be able to find the source, but there's some kind of interference.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: Signals tend to overlap, get mixed up with simulations… It can be hard to find what's real and what's not in here.
The Guardian heads towards the signal's location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Detecting traces of familiar Light up here. Wait… Saint-14? He's been missing for decades. Saint was one of the greatest Titans who ever lived. Hero of Six Fronts. All that power and he just… vanished. The City's still looking for him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The signal's coming from a Vex conflux. But there's something odd. The time stream around it is unstable. I don't know anything that could do that. Get me to it. Maybe we can figure this out.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If Saint-14 is lost in the Infinite Forest, it's because he came here to find us.

lines.speaker: Sagira
lines.text: You can't blame yourself for every missing Guardian, Osiris.
Ghost scans another conflux. An unstable conflux appears and Ghost scans it. After the scan, a force pushes the Guardian away from it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What was that? Light! The conflux was holding back a rift full of Light!
The Guardian defeats the Vex from the past, present, and future. Two Wayward Minds appear. The Guardian defeats the Wayward Minds.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Vex from all times, fighting together. Like they were pulled here by the rift in the time stream – a rift Saint-14 made with his Light.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If he still lives, then we must find him.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Already ahead of you on that one. You start searching in here. We'll head back to the Lighthouse and see if Vance knows anything.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: It's him, isn't it? The first Vanguard commander! The one who made the great Osiris leader of the Warlocks. Saint-14! He could join us here in the Lighthouse. Fight alongside you and Osiris. Turn the tide against the Vex for good. Can you imagine?! You found Osiris; you can find Saint-14. He's got to be in the Infinite Forest. With him by our side, we could succeed where Osiris failed! Well, you get the idea.

He searched and searched, but in the end, he created it instead. From his "Fountain of Youth," I… and every other Exo was born. This is a truth we cannot hide — the Darkness within us — and so we must embrace it. The Guardians that entered the Deep Stone Crypt brought new life to the long dormant machines of Europa. lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Good health, friend. What is this? My old weapon? No. Your new weapon. Oh, you seem to improve everything you touch, Guardian. Old things made new. Given purpose. This is a good lesson. In your absence, I walked the streets of the City. Spoke to the people. I sat beneath the Traveler and listened. Scars are still healing. I witnessed many new faces. They look to me and see a myth. I admit it does make me feel old - and humbled. As i walked, do you know what I saw? Smiles. I heard music! It is good to be reminded why we fight. I will walk the streets again tomorrow. Maybe, I will sing.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Listen, this Lightbearer you're looking for? His name's Callum Sol. Like I said, he ran headfirst into the Ascendant Plane. Thanks to those Raider friends of yours, there's bound to be a portal nearby. Keep your eyes open.

The Guardian defeats the Scorn, including Avakrii, Temple Claimant, and the Taken, including Ashorc, Temple Claimant. The Guardian searches for a way into the Ascendant Plane. The Guardian finds a ball of energy. Ghost scans the energy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can extrapolate some data from this energy to find a viable portal.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So do it. And watch your back.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Oho, you're feisty. You kiss your Guardian with that mouth?
The Guardian enters the Ascendant Plane. The Guardian defeats the Taken which the encounter. The Guardian finds a portal and goes through it.
Temple of Illyn, The Dreaming City

The Guardian comes through the portal onto an elevator. The Guardian defeats the Taken which appear. Val Talcanth, Bound to Sedia (a Taken Centurion), appears. The Guardian defeats Val Talcanth, Bound to Sedia.

Orm Duluz, Bound to Sedia (a Taken Knight), Val Gruuk, Bound to Sedia (a Taken Phalanx), and Val Prosk, Bound to Sedia (a Taken Phalanx) appear, along with more Taken. The Guardian defeats Orm Duluz, Val Gruuk, and Val Prosk as well as the other Taken.
The Guardian continues further into the temple, defeating any Hive which they encounter, including Shrieker, Bound to Sedia. The Guardian finds another ball of energy. Ghost scans the energy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up multiple reverberations of Light. Looks like… two Guardians. Multiple Solar Light discharges. And Void. They've torn their way across the Ascendant Plane… I've got new coordinates.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's what I wanted to hear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Who is this other Guardian? What aren't you telling us?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Don't worry about it. You find Callum. Then maybe we'll talk.

The Guardian continues further into the temple, defeating any Hive which they encounter. Yächaar, Bound to Sedia, a Hive Ogre, appears. While fighting against Yächaar, Bound to Sedia, the Guardian is teleported to the Ascendant Plane.

Irûn, Bound to Sedia, a Taken Ogre, appears. The Guardian fights against Irûn, Bound to Sedia. The Guardian is repeatedly teleported back and forth between the temple and the Ascendant Plane until they defeat Yächaar, Bound to Sedia, and Irûn, Bound to Sedia.

The Guardian continues through the Ascendant Plane towards the coordinates Ghost found, defeating any Taken which they encounter. Eventually the Guardian finds a rock with scorch marks in the shape of a humanoid figure. Before the Guardian can investigate, Yächaar, Bound to Sedia, a Taken Phalanx, appears. The Guardian defeats Yächaar, Bound to Sedia. Ghost scans the scorch marks.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Drifter… if I'm reading this right, your friend Callum was killed… by another Guardian.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm pulling final audio from his Ghost. Hang on.

lines.speaker: Shin Malphur
lines.text: I gave you a chance. Gave all of you a chance. I told you not to follow him!

lines.speaker: Callum
lines.text: You and I are the same. Sometimes we do the wrong thing for the right reasons.

lines.speaker: Shin Malphur
lines.text: Spoken like a true disciple. If you have any last words, now is the time.

lines.speaker: Shin Malphur
lines.text: I don't have to. You're killing yourselves.
The sound of a Golden Gun charging and four shots firing from it can be heard in the recording.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think you have some explaining to do.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Gimme a minute, would ya?! I'm thinking.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You owe us a little more than Glimmer for this.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Shut up and bring me everything you found at that grave. You'll get paid.
The Guardian finds a depleted weapon core at Callum's grave.

lines.text: The Reef's sky has holes in it… the whole system's in chaos. Of course, Xivu Arath decided now was the right time to corrupt herself an army. We call them Wrathborn. lines.text: I did not understand the Festival of the Lost when I first returned to the Tower. I had lost so much. My fireteam. My eyes. My Ghost. It took a long time for me to see that sometimes the best way to honor the dead is to live your best life. And above all… to brush your teeth. Dental hygiene is key to a long life. Trust me. lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I've been studying incoming recon data from Luna. It all points to the same thing. The Vex have resurrected an ancient Hydra that we call "The Undying Mind." The name says it all, really. We've fought it many times before. Its primary directive is to take control of the Black Garden. Its secondary directives could result in the destruction of the Traveler. It's moving between timelines, hiding itself. It's learned from its past mistakes. But so have we. I'll come up with a plan. But I need time, and I need more data. I'm counting on you.

title: Quest: The End, Exploring the Corridors of Time — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian explores the Corridors of Time, eventually finding an entrance to the Timelost Vault. The Guardian enters the Timeless Vault.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Thank you for coming. We’ve gathered here today to celebrate the life of my mentor. My inspiration.
If the player is a Destiny 1 veteran.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: They called her Crota’s End. The Hivebane. Kingslayer. The Young Wolf.
If the player has completed the Forsaken campaign.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: He had a hundred titles I cannot recall. And he died doing what he does best. Defending the Last City of humanity. Ages ago, he saved my life. And then inspired me to save myself. I am glad that he did. Because, Traveler help us, he is gone. And there is no one to save us now. On the day we met, I decided I would follow his example. I’m still trying. I’ve marked this grave with one of his favorite weapons, shattered in that final confrontation. It used to be mine. All who find what we’ve left here – please leave it be. Unless… Unless you’re still out there somewhere. You’ve performed miracles before. In which case, take it. And come back to us. And we’ll kill what killed you. Or die trying.
If the Guardian has saved Saint-14.
The Guardian receives the Chronometric Weapon Core.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Devrim here, subbing for Cayde. Righto. The Legion nicked the secure channel you Guardians use for your patrols. Naturally, Cayde didn't leave any kind of instructions, so… I suggest you rough up a few Cabal for the intel.
The Guardian collects munitions from several Cabal Legionaires.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we've narrowed in on that frequency.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Brilliant. Thin out the ground troops a bit. You won't want anyone following you when you go and reclaim our channel.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Right. Have a quick peak around. We want things quiet before you pop into that Legion base.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Dev? Are you all… doing Cayde's chores?

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: We are. Care to pitch in?

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: No, no thanks. Haha. In fact, uh, something just came up; I'm gonna hop off. Good luck!
The Guardian heads to the survey point and surveys the area.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Lovely. Let's keep moving. You're looking for a high ranking Legion commander.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: This is Commander Zavala. Who's on this channel?

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Devrim Kay, sir, and our favourite Guardian.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ah, is this the patrol set-up? Do you mind if I listen in?
The Guardian finds and defeats Zarik, the Booming Voice.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Excellent. There should be a terminal nearby. Input the key, and we'll - oh, I'm sorry, Devrim, I should have let you handle this.
The Guardian accesses the terminal using the access codes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Access codes are in. I'm transferring broadcast permissions back to our patrol system.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Yes, we see it coming online now.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ahem. The field beacons still need to be reactivated.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Indeed. Make your way outside, if you please. You're looking for a patrol beacon. They're fiddly little batons jammed into the ground.
The Guardian reactivates a patrol beacon.

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay
lines.text: Well done. If you're keen to run more support missions, keep your eyes peeled for patrol beacons. I'm watching the rest of the network come online now, right across the system. You should be able to pick up patrols on any planet.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Ah. Who among us does not love infrastructure?

lines.speaker: Devrim Kay

title: Quest: The Lost Cryptarch — Transcript

lines.text: Hanger, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Everybody's got their head in the clouds. Dreamin' City, Hive worm god, Warmind... It's easy to forget about the lives of regular people, even for... well, for heroes like you. Remember the Cryptarch in the Reef? I do. His name was Ives. Yeah, that's right: "was". He's dead. And not like all the other Awoken who died in the Reef. Petra says he was murdered. She sent me all his stuff. Got her own problems out on the Shore, so this is up to us. Cayde taught me a lotta nonsense. But he also taught me that you gotta follow a trail before it goes cold. Keep an eye out for the pages that go in that thing. They're the only clues we're gonna get.

The Guardian collects the pages from Ives' journal by decrypting legendary and exotic engrams and defeating powerful Fallen in the European Dead Zone. After the pages have been collected and Amanda is able to decrypt the journal, the Guardian heads to several Lost Sectors in the European Dead Zone in search of more clues.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Still can't believe what they did to his robe. Treated it like a trophy. Even a puffed-up Cryptarch doesn't deserve to end up like that. Nobody does. I was out of ideas, so I showed Rahool what you found. His face when he found out... like it had happened to him. Couple hours later, I get some coordinates on my terminal - for a Fallen transmat pad in the EDZ. I can't read where it's pointin', but it's somewhere they don't want you to be. This is our chance. Head back across the pond, use that transmat, and get ready for trouble.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: OK, got your signal. Where'd you end up…? Oh my cotton socks - the Cosmodrome?! Uh… sit tight! There. I scrambled your location. Zavala won't know you're breakin' the quarantine on Old Russia. Do me a solid and stick to the Wall, OK? All hell's gonna break loose if the big guy finds out you're there. Meantime, I'll keep you covered. See if you can find any clues nearby. Then track down the Fallen bastards that did this. After all, you've got some practice.

The Guardian heads towards the Wall and finds a barrier blocking the entrance into the Wall. An Irradiated Shank appears. The Guardian defeats the Irradiated Shank, disabling the barrier. The Guardian heads into the Wall.

The Guardian makes their way through the Wall, eventually entering a large room. Kikliss, Murderer appears. The Guardian fights against Kikliss. A servitor, Rudriks-9, appears. The Guardian defeats Kikliss, Murderer and Rudriks-9. The Guardian heads back towards the area outside the Wall where they first landed.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's it, huh? You got 'em. Somethin's still buggin' me about this, though. Get back to that teleporter when you can. But listen: I don't think my little trick is gonna fool Zavala twice. This might be the last time you ever set foot in the Cosmodrome. See you back in the Tower.
Hanger, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Good to pay Old Russia a visit, huh? Lotta memories back there. I still think we're missin' somethin'. What were the Fallen really after? Why go after some Cryptarch from the Reef? Ah, well, that's above my pay grade. Meantime, you should probably have this. I found it in his stuff. One last trinket he don't need. And... thanks, Guardian. Not everybody's lucky enough to get avenged.

lines.text: The Guardian joins Osiris on the Moon in his hunt for vengeance.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, we have a developing situation that I need you to take point on. For the past few weeks, Osiris has been trying to assess the damage caused by the return of the Darkness. He believes that Xivu Arath, the Hive god of war, seeks to take advantage of the power vacuum left in its wake. Osiris was investigating physical manifestations of her magic near the Scarlet Keep when… his Ghost, Sagira, was slain. Osiris delivered a message through a secure channel requesting that you personally aid him in this hunt. He's desperate, Guardian. I need you to save him from himself.
Archer's Line, Ocean of Storms, The Moon

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm… I'm worried about Osiris. If Sagira's gone, then —

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Don't worry about me, but keep your voice down. I'm using an external comm. I thought I was hunting Sagira's killer… the High Celebrant of Xivu Arath. But now I think it's hunting me. Meet me in the Hall of Wisdom.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: He cut the transmission. We have to hurry.
The Guardian proceeds into the lunar caverns.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Your friend is in a lot of danger.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: A concerned Ghost. Osiris shouldn't be here, especially in his condition.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We appreciate the warning, but we know what we're doing. If you and your Guardian are here to help…
Hall of Wisdom, Ocean of Storms, The Moon
The Guardian explores the Hall of Wisdom.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes, I can hear you! I'm luring the High Celebrant to the Shrine of Oryx! They're — damn! It erected a barrier. I think it knows you're here. It's trying to keep us separated!
The Guardian defeats the nearby Hive removing the Hive barrier. The High Celebrant appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That Knight is radiating strange energy… It has to be the High Celebrant — the one that killed Sagira! Osiris, we're here! We'll get that barrier down!
The High Celebrant retreats. The Guardian witnesses a Hive cryptolith. The Guardian removes the Hive barrier and gains access to the Shrine of Oryx.
The Guardian pursues the High Celebrant.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I've retreated deeper into the shrine. I think this may have been a trap… That tower you saw on the way in, that's a Hive cryptolith. It's a conduit of Darkness. One of many. The High Celebrant is using them to deploy soldiers across dimensions and… and tempt others to Xivu Arath's side. If I don't make it out of this, I want you to tell Saint —
Shrine of Oryx, Ocean of Storms, The Moon
The Guardian find the High Celebrant within the Shrine of Oryx and it retreats summoning more Hive. The Guardian defeats the Hive.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Guardian! Picking up multiple Hive signatures headed Osiris's way! We're closing in but facing heavy resistance!
The High Celebrant disappears and an ascendant portal appears. The Guardian enters the ascendant portal and is ambushed by the High Celebrant's Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have to get out of here!
The Guardian exits through another ascendant portal and returns to the Shrine of Oryx regrouping with Osiris.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You're here! Finally. Is it done? I'll come down to y — Oh!
A Hive Knight appears behind Osiris and knocks him down.
The Hive Knight raises its sword to strike Osiris, but is stabbed and killed from behind. The Awoken glares at Osiris and a Ghost appears.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: We warned you it was going to be dangerous down here. Especially for the Ghostless. I'm… I'm glad to see we're all okay, though. I'm Glint, by the way. It's a pleasure to meet you all.

lines.speaker: The Crow

The Guardian blankly stares at Crow.

lines.speaker: Seraph Bunker
lines.text: The Moon, Ocean of Storms, The Moon
The Guardian investigates Rasputin's hologram of Felwinter and Felspring.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He's telling a story. In a time of great prosperity, a tyrant king sent his son to live among the people and learn their ways.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He did so for many years, until a great calamity befell the kingdom.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: In the aftermath, the tyrant's son was changed.
The Guardian heads deeper into the bunker. Rasputin displays another hologram of Felwinter being attacked by a Frame.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The tyrant's son turned away from his father, and became a warrior.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The tyrant chased his son across fields and mountains and oceans.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He said, "If I can't have my son, then no one shall."
Rasputin displays another hologram of Felwinter being attacked by SIVA nanites.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: In the end, the tyrant used his son's love of the people against him.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: He promised him a miraculous technology that could rebuild the kingdom.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: When his son came to claim it, he unleashed a plague upon him. His son was destroyed.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: And the tyrant looked upon his tyranny and wept.
A hidden entrance opens. The Guardian heads deeper into the bunker.
Seraph Berth, Ocean of Storms, The Moon

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Is Rasputin… is he talking about himself? I think the tyrant's son…

Ana Bray's comm channel cuts out. The Guardians reaches a secret room and finds a sarcophagus containing a hologram of Felwinter and his shotgun. The Guardian examines the shotgun and receives Felwinter's Lie.
Ghost uses a comm station to reestablish contact with Ana Bray.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Guardian? Can you read me? There you are. Comms cut out completely. You're in a really old part of the bunker. The signal's terrible. This place is like a time capsule. Where are we?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: This looks like the casing of an old safety AI. But marked with Rasputin's symbol. These transcripts suggest his original code was for… a sort of emergency response system from pre-Golden Age space stations. Checking oxygen levels, fuel, that kind of thing. Clovis Bray took a safety AI and turned it into an interplanetary defense system. With sentience. And Rasputin kept all this. Almost like a scrapbook of his past. A way to remember his roots. And he showed it to us. When did he learn to be so sentimental? Wish Zavala could see this.

The Crow transmats into the Spider's Safehouse. The Guardian approaches the Crow and the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: What's this? Thought I told you to bring me the Warlock Osiris.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Lost his Ghost. He's gone back to the Tower to recover.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: You Lightmongers never cease to amaze me. You deal with violence so easily, and suffer loss so poorly. Such fragile killers.

lines.text: Avenge Sagira. Eliminate the High Celebrant.

lines.text: I had it in my sights. If your friend hadn't needed saving —

lines.text: Now then. Perhaps we can help each other out, eh? I know how accomplished you are at exacting revenge. [chuckles] Xivu Arath is using her High Celebrant and those damned cryptoliths to corrupt Eliksni. Cabal too. But I'm losing soldiers and Glimmer by the Skiff-loads. That's right. I know what Osiris was doing on the Moon. I also know you'll fare far better, given the, ah, proper motivation. Leave us, Crow. The Guardian and I have terms to discuss.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: My little bird sure is something, isn't he? I have to imagine you share in my appreciation of fate's cruel sense of humor. I found him wandering the Reef like a piece of wind-blown trash. Aimless, hopeless. No memory of the prince he was. Now, I could have sent him off to the Tower, but… we all know what's waiting for him there. I couldn't let that happen, so I took him in. As a kindness. As far as his loyalty is concerned, I took a few extra precautions and made some… modifications to his Ghost's shell. Now, if he ever flies too far from the nest? Boom. That ugly business out of the way, let's focus on what really matters: this Hive infestation. I propose a partnership. You go out there and do what it is you do best, and I'll ah… lend you the resources you need to get it done. Maybe even a little extra something on the side, hm. Just don't mention the name Uldren Sov. For his sake.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: This is the season of the Dawning. A holiday created from a thousand traditions, brought together to rejoice in the Light. And this Dawning, with the Traveler shining above us? We have so much more to celebrate. But, as Cayde would remind me, this is also a time for gifts and games. To forget all of our troubles. I have just the thing picked out for you.

title: Raid: Deep Stone Crypt — Transcript

lines.text: Below the frozen tundra of Europa lies the Deep Stone Crypt. For decades it has remained dormant… until now.
The Guardian and their fireteam arrive on Europa.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Eramis found it. The Deep Stone Crypt. The birthplace of the Exo… and a prison for something sinister. Her followers intend to make use of it. To unleash a chaos they do not understand. Their success means untamed power beyond their wildest dreams. They must be stopped.
The Guardians defeat the Dark Council Guards and unlock the way forward.

The Guardians traverse the frozen tundra, surviving the cold using House Salvation heat bubbles to avoid frostbite. The Guardians defeat House Salvation Fallen, Dark Council Guards, and Brigs to proceed forward.
The Guardians approach the entrance of the Deep Stone Crypt marked with House Salvation banners. The Guardians discover a log recorded by the Exo Stranger labelled "DSC-777-ALB."

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: And so, here I am again — in this damn crypt I told myself I would never return to. But I have to do it. I have to.

The Guardians proceed and enter Crypt Security. The Guardians begin destroying the Crypt’s power system to disable security, as the Fallen attack. The Guardians use the Crypt's Scanner Augment to identify weaknesses in the Crypt's power system. The Guardians use the Crypt's Operator Augment to access the power system's lower chamber.

A Sentinel Servitor appears and disrupts the augmentation terminals. The Guardians destroy the Sentinel. Security shielding lowers, presenting a weakness. The Guardians successfully disable the Crypt's power system. The Guardians push deeper into the Crypt to locate Eramis's followers.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Crypt power systems compromised. Initiating emergency backup system. Crypt status: Active. Orbital status: Standby. Humanoid lifeforms detected approaching Clarity Control. Threat determined: Crypt compromised. Nuclear descent protocol recommended.
If the player is an Exo

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Crypt power systems compromised. Initiating emergency backup system. Crypt status: Active. Orbital status: Standby. Humanoid lifeforms detected approaching Clarity Control. Exo lifeforms present. Welcome home. Threat determined: Crypt compromised. Nuclear descent protocol recommended.
Clarity Control, Deep Stone Crypt, Europa

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Clarity Control breached. A single unregistered Exo and a single lifeform of unknown biology detected in the Crypt Laboratory. Status: Disastrous. Notice: Vacate the premises immediately. This will be your only warning.
The Guardians approach a Veiled Statue and hear whispers coming from it. The Guardians also discover a second log recorded by the Exo Stranger labelled "DSC-777-WIB."

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Turns out, he had plans of his own. To keep running it himself. Because of course he did.

The Guardians proceed into the Crypt Laboratory and discover Atraks-1 reviving Taniks from a cryopod hooked up to Clarity Control. Taniks emerges, witnesses the Guardians, and attempts to breach the barrier between them. After failing to breach the barrier, Taniks retreats and Atraks-1 summons replications of herself and attacks the Guardians. The Guardians access the launch pods to ascend to the Morning Star Orbital Station.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Sector reassessment: Orbital platform active. Orbital platform breached. Status: Calamitous.

Multiple Sentinel Servitors appear, disrupting the augmentation terminals. The Guardians defeat the Sentinels. The Guardians use the Scanner Augment to identify which Replication to attack, weakening Atraks-1. The Guardians defeat Replications of Atraks-1, collect their remaining energy, and use the Operator Augment to open airlocks and release the Replications’ energy into space. The Guardians defeat Atraks-1, Fallen Exo.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Multiple hostile intruders detected within the orbital platform. Orbital confinement protocol initiating. Status: Pathway to nuclear cores obscured. You have no warnings left. Nuclear descent protocol: Initiated.
The Guardians proceed to the exterior of the Morning Star Orbital Station to locate the nuclear contingency chamber.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Artificial intelligence activated. Enjoying yourselves, intruders? It's worth knowing the cataclysmic damage you will be responsible for today. Do not fool yourselves. This facility is not simply the fruitless work of some pathetic scientist. This house was built by the genius Clovis Bray I himself. Within lies humanity's salvation. La fontaine de jouvence. Made possible by Clarity Control. Magnificent, wasn't it? An entity from beyond our own dimension. And the answer to humanity's eternal struggle: mortality. Were it to fall into the wrong hands, humanity, and the universe, would be utterly doomed. I have no reason to believe you are anything other than "the wrong hands." You now face godlike judgment. May it extend externally.

The Guardians fight through House Salvation forces and witness a House Salvation Ketch and House Salvation Skiffs. The Guardians discover a third log recorded by the Exo Stranger labelled "DSC-777-ANB."

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Not to worry. I'm taking care of it now. In your memory.
The Guardians discover a fourth log recorded by the Exo Stranger labelled "DSC-777-SCB."

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I activate this… and it all goes away. [sniffles] Cheers to that.
Rapture, Morning Star Orbital Station, Europa's Orbit
The Guardians discover a fifth log recorded by the Exo Stranger labelled "DSC-777-CLB."

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I'll set whispers on the wind for any future generations. Tales of the evil Clovis Bray brought forth.
The Guardians proceed to the nuclear contingency chamber. Taniks, Reborn appears.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Nuclear descent protocol: Active. Utter destruction of Europa: Imminent.

The Guardians begin disarming the Nuclear descent protocol to prevent Europa's destruction. As several nuclear cores begin charging, the Guardians use the Operator Augment to guide the nuclear cores to other Guardians. The Guardians acquire the Suppressor Augment and use it to stun Taniks and unlock the nuclear stations. The Guardians use the Scanner Augment to locate the active nuclear stations. Dark Council Guards appear. The Guardians defeat the Dark Council Guards. The Guardians deposit and neutralize all nuclear cores and successfully disarm the Nuclear descent protocol.

lines.speaker: Crypt AI
lines.text: Nuclear descent protocol deactivated. Orbital collision remains imminent. Clever little rats. I will not forget what you have done here today. Upon collision, the Crypt will be torn open, and all defenses will be destroyed. It is now open to all. Allies and enemies alike. If you do not defend it, the results could be world ending. Humanity's fate is now on you. Best of luck.

The Guardians survive and emerge from the wreckage of the Morning Star near the entrance of the Deep Stone Crypt. The Guardians approach Taniks's body covered in debris. Taniks, the Abomination appears.

Taniks begins charging several nuclear cores attached to his modified Heavy Shank. Dark Council Guards appear. The Guardians detach the nuclear cores from Taniks's body and use the Scanner Augment to locate the active nuclear stations. The Guardians use the Suppressor Augment to stun Taniks and unlock the neutralizer stations. Taniks creates a field which immobilizes some Guardians. Other Guardians use the Operator Augment to free their teammates. The Guardians deposit and neutralize all nuclear cores.
Taniks summons a shock field. The Guardians enter the shock field and weaken Taniks. Taniks teleports throughout the area evading the Guardians. The Guardians defeat Taniks, the Abomination.
After defeating Taniks, the Guardians collect the spoils of the Morning Star.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

A beacon is ignited and a beam of light from the device shoots up towards the sky.

title: Quest: Voice of Light, Let Loose Thy Talons — Transcript

lines.text: The Crow — As the Crow Flies
Spider's Safehouse, Tangled Shore, The Reef
The Guardian returns to the Crow after tracking down five feathers; manifestations of the Light.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Do you have a minute? Something's been going on, and I'm… I've been having these dreams lately. Vivid. Real. Glint… Glint thinks there might be something to them. I'm flying. There's a green forest. Mountains. European Dead Zone, I think. Sometimes the clouds part, and where there should be a bright blue sky, there's just… darkness. I'm free… soaring towards a distant pillar of light. But the dream always ends the same way. That light… flickers like a candle flame and goes out. And then there's… nothing. I can't shake it. It's all I think about… Would you come with me? See if anything's there?
The Crow — Let Loose Thy Talons

title: Quest: Wish-Ender — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian traverses the floating platforms to the next area. The Guardian defeats the Taken they encounter as well as several Labyrinth Architects. The Guardian jumps into an opening in the ground which appears and falls down to the next area.
The Guardian heads towards the Spire. The Guardian defeats the Taken they encounter. Asterion, Set Apart appears. The Guardian defeats Asterion, Set Apart. The Guardian continues towards the Spire.

The Guardian enters a new area. Several Keepers of Petitions appear. The Guardian defeats the Taken as well as the Keepers of Petitions. Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger appears. The Guardian defeats Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger. The Guardian heads towards the next area and approaches a statue.

lines.speaker: Sjur Eido
lines.text: My name is Sjur Eido. I was the first to stand beside Mara Sov. You will be the last. But only if you prove yourself worthy…
The Guardian presents an Awoken Talisman to the statue.

lines.speaker: Sjur Eido
lines.text: I failed my Queen, but I will redeem myself.
The Guardian approaches a white glowing orb.

The Guardian heads into the tunnel and defeats the Taken which they encounter. An Archersbane Wizard appears. The Guardian defeats the Archersbane Wizard. The Guardian heads further into the tunnels. The glowing white orb appears again and the Guardian approaches it.
The Guardian heads further into the tunnels. The glowing white orb appears again and the Guardian approaches it.

lines.speaker: Toland
lines.text: Show her your nerve exceeds your grasp.

The Guardian heads further into the tunnels. Another Archersbane Wizard appears. The Guardian defeats the Archersbane Wizard and continues into the tunnels. The glowing white orb appears again and the Guardian follows it to a large room. An Archersbane Wizard appears. The Guardian defeats the Archersbane Wizard.

The Guardian heads to the next room where several Archersbane Wizards appears. The Guardian defeats the Archersbane Wizards. Xavoth, The Dreaming, Eriviks, The Dreaming, and Querim, The Dreaming appear. The Guardian defeats Xavoth, The Dreaming, Eriviks, The Dreaming, and Querim, The Dreaming, obtaining a Dreaming Token from each of them.
The Guardian summons Querim, The Waking by picking up a relic and depositing it at a statue. The Guardian defeats Querim, The Waking and receives the Waking Token of Querim.
The Guardian summons Eriviks, The Waking by picking up two relics and depositing them at two statues. The Guardian defeats Eriviks, The Waking and receives the Waking Token of Eriviks.

The Guardian summons Xavoth, the Waking by defeating a Fleeting Shade, a Taken Minotaur, picking up the relic which spawns, and depositing it at a statue. The Guardian defeats Xavoth, the Waking and receives the Waking Token of Xavoks. The Guardian defeats Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger. The Guardian heads towards the next area and approaches the statue they encountered previously.

lines.speaker: Sjur Eido
lines.text: This is where bravery is defined.
The Guardian presents the Waking Tokens to the statue and receives the Wish-Ender bow.

lines.speaker: Sjur Eido
lines.text: Respite, at last. I will seek a way home.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Release — Transcript

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain, the Vex appear to be capturing Fallen. I have traced a high number of prisoners to a cave near your location. Imprisonment by the Vex is not a fate I would wish on anyone! Perhaps we can help.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, just so you know, the Fallen probably won't thank us for helping them.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Trust me. Either way, you'll be doing them a favour.
The Mists, north of The Tangle

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're in. I've never done a prison break before!
The Guardian clears the first chamber of the cave freeing the Fallen who then turn on the Guardian. Ghost picks up something interesting.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This device is ordinarily used to shield a Vex Gate, but not any more. It looks like a buckler from stories they used to tell in the City. The really old stories. Before we even knew what a Vex was.
The Guardian navigates their way through the cave system

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There sure are a lot of Fallen down here. I'm picking up barriers ahead and below us. Deep below us.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain, that could mean more prisoners. You should free them!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Failsafe, they tried to kill us.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Better that than dying in a cage.
The Guardian kills the Vex prison wardens and free the Fallen, who then turn on the Guardian. The Guardian defends themselves from the freed Fallen before moving deeper into the prison.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain; the Vex collective is sending a response to your prison break!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ha! Too late to stop us. If its a fight they want!
Vex enemies teleport into the prison and the Guardian fights them all off.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All clear! Not a single Vex or Fallen in sight. I'm sorry it had to end this way Failsafe.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The attempt was appreciated friendly Ghost.
Ghost finds something interesting in a hidden cave below the prison

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think they are running a test to see if they can get this thing to self-replicate. And failing, thank goodness. If the Vex were able to manipulate matter that easily, we'd be in a lot more trouble.
Pushing further into the prison, Ghost wants to scan a Vex relic.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They've taken- wow- a lot of Fallen. This is just the tip of the facility. This group was told they could "terminate each other" and the survivor would be set free. None of them fired a shot, except us, I mean. Gotta admire that loyalty.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yeah, the Vex are the worst.
On a recess above the Vex relic, Ghost scans a crystal

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This crystal is made of the same material as the Lighthouse on Mercury. Remember the first time we went there? I wonder if its still out there.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Reforged in the Light — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth
The Guardian speaks to Eva Levante after visiting the European Aerial Zone.

lines.speaker: Eva Levante
lines.text: So, how did did it feel to celebrate your triumphs? I hope you took time to bask in every one of those moments. Each victory represents a time when your heroism kept us safe. Without you, there wouldn't be a Last City to come back to. For that, we are eternally grateful. So please, friend, continue to embrace glory as much as you'd like. It's our gift to you.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Regicide — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: All this was set in motion long ago. He calls out, and the Darkness answers.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Okay, creepy sidekick. Check. Roguish commander. Check. And then we have the Guardian, my greatest success story. I'd say we're ready to get this done.
Hull Breach, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Push back the dark. End it.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: She's right, Guardian. There's no doubt in my mind this could possibly work. Now, get to that rupture.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Okay, that's where the rupture should be.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Get it open! Once you're through send your co-ordinates. We'll lock down your signal and deploy reinforcements.
The Guardian approaches the rupture and it opens.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The rupture can sense the soul you hold. You are Ascendant!

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Time to go kill a king, eh Guardian? Good luck.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, I'm ready if you are.
The Founts, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're going to have to finish this on our own. My scans are returning nothing. We're definitely... somewhere, but no sign of Oryx.
The Asylum, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn
The Guardian sees a floating light, it flees further into the Dreadnaught

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, now we know we have his attention. Hi, Oryx.
The doors open, leading to a room with a rupture in the center.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: You... are the last hope of the Light? I have taken entire worlds! You are not worthy to face me.
The rupture opens. Ta'aun, Hand of Oryx and Baxx, Hand of Oryx appear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Huh. Well, I guess we're worthy now.
Hive Knights and Acolytes gather around a large doorway.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: Come for me, warrior of Light. I will finish what Crota began.
Altar of Oryx, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn
Oryx is waiting for the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: At last, I will have vengeance!
Oryx summons his sword and Taken troops.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: Your Traveler's Light cannot reach you here.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: What you call Darkness is the end of your evolution.
Oryx transports himself and the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Oryx
lines.text: The Darkness is a gift. Let my will set you free.
Oryx fires dark projectiles, summons Taken, and swings his sword at the Guardian.
Oryx is defeated, he drops to the floor and reaches for his sword. It is wreathed in a glow resembling that of the Taken.
Oryx laughs before disappearing, leaving his sword behind.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: My Queen. You were right. The Guardian was the key. For the first time the whispers are silent. It is done.
Eris touches the hilt of Oryx's sword. It begins to crumble. As the pieces of the sword fall away, a single crystal is left behind, suspended in mid-air. Eris takes the crystal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have accepted my fate. I will not fail.

title: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT: Preservation — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian reports to the Hidden's Evidence Board.
The Guardian investigates the Sunken Pyramid at the request of Queen Mara Sov.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: Guardian. You're needed within the Throne World Pyramid. The Scorn have become frenzied at the death of the Witness's disciple, Rhulk. They seek to take the Pyramid out of our hands and use its power to capture the Throne World for themselves. One final, desperate attempt to win a battle they've already lost. Ensure it stays that way.
The Guardian defeats a Projection of Savathûn and proceeds into the bog.
The Guardian gathers resonant runes and overflows the Pyramid's vessel with knowledge to traverse the bog.
The Guardian witnesses the aftermath of the raid on the Sunken Pyramid: Xita, mother of the Worm Gods, emits black smoke. The Upended no longer glows.
The Guardian moves from room to room ridding the Sunken Pyramid of Scorn and defeats three of the Fanatic's Chosen.

lines.speaker: Queen Mars Sov
lines.text: The Scorn retreat from the Pyramid once more. You will undoubtedly be needed again when they return. In the meantime, do not rush away. The Pyramid holds many secrets yet… Information that could prove useful to our coming fight against the Witness. Do not delay.
The Guardian reports their findings on the Hidden's Evidence Board.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: The Crow and The Hawk, Let Loose Thy Talons

title: Report: REVERSE-LURE: Final Report — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Enclave to log their final report on the Evidence Board.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, Immaru is still on the loose, but at least we cut off any chances of him upgrading the Lucent Brood's weaponry. You can reap your reward from the Relic.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Retribution — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Guardian. With your Light and the power which I have imbued, you have grasped the Ascendant Plane in total, and may traverse it at will. We are poised for a victory. It is time to strike. The Shadow Legion flagship is a stain on your sky. Destroy it, and find joy in its destruction.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: We will travel the Ascendant Plane by Marakel's grace, and aid you in your attack.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: We'll follow your lead. Get inside that ship, and we'll all take it down together.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Never fear, Guardian. We'll be your support as you find a path to the ship's engine.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Go. Find your retribution. Deliver justice as Queensguard.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: In all my years fighting back the Taken, I never thought I'd set foot in the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Marakel's power is considerable, but it is not boundless. We must use this opportunity wisely.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: That's right. We have our breach points. Make this count.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Find a way through that ship, Guardian. Crow, Mithrax, and I will bring down the Shadow Legion's commanders one by one.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I am ready to cut them down. We will break their ship, and watch it fall from our sky.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Remember what they took from us. Don't let anything stand in your way.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Charges armed. Detonating ammunition storage now.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: There. I took out their firepower.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Marakel's Corsairs are with me. We are ready.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I have them in my sights. Don't worry, Guardian. We've got things handled on our end.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Accept my power, Guardian, and tear down their defenses with your Light.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Those cooling fans are the only thing stopping the engine from going critical. You'll have to destroy those generators first.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Earlier, I took out the Legionary with the biggest helmet. Had to be their leader. They're headless now… uh, so to speak. You're clear to bring down those engineers. Then that engine is all yours.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Destroy the engine and take down this ship.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Marakel will bring us back safely. Complete your mission, Guardian.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: And have a little fun with it.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: There are many battles to come, but we have this victory today.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Every civilian in the EDZ can see what we've done. They know we're keeping them safe from whatever the Witness wants with them. Well done, Guardian. You too, lads. We made quite the team up there.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: We made the Shadow Legion hurt. We showed them that we can strike back.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: In this, we honor Amanda's memory.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Voice of Light, Let Loose Thy Talons
Wayfinder's Voyage III: In the Shadow of the Past

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Fallen Transponder and Zero Hour, Outbreak Perfected

title: Remembrance of  Sagira — Transcript

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: When you said you understood...I never asked why.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: She saved me. As she always did. Throughout all the lives we shared, she was always my better. Just before she...She told me, “Don't lose hope in the darkness.” She must have known what I'd find here.
Sagira's shell lays on a pedestal behind Rohan's tombstone.

title: Restoration — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There is so little left. We were lucky to even find this ship. A Guardian can’t do much to protect the City without one. But, it needs a warp drive if we ever hope to fight beyond Earth, and that Cosmodrome is the only place I know where we might still find one. We survived the Fallen once… we can do it again.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A Guardian ship was recently shot down here. If the Fallen haven’t gotten to it, there might be parts we can salvage.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The ship’s avionics are completely catatonic. But I can cull their last transmission.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They managed to restore an information hub here. Down in the tunnels below. We should check it out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A map of the entire area.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What we really need to find is a warp drive, so we can jump to any planet or moon. Our only hope is where we found our ship. We have to go back.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Scaning for the warp drive. Bad news. It’s already in Fallen hands.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I hope you’re ready for this

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You just killed an Archon and we got a warp drive.

title: Report: REVERSE-LURE: Briefing — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Evidence Board to investigate another Hidden report.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: My Hidden, we've put together enough pieces of the puzzle. A picture is finally beginning to form. Savathûn stole the idea of the Glaive from the Witness's disciple in order to lure us into unlocking her memories. But beyond that, she had no plans for upgrading the Hive's weaponry. Immaru, however, aims to impress. He's been on the hunt for the remaining fragments so he can arm the Lucent Brood with enhanced Glaives. So, I propose a gamble. Our intel places Immaru in a Dark area of the Throne World. Take the fragment there as a lure. If we play this right, we may be able to get a new Glaive and a Ghost in one fell swoop.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Rites of the Deep | Willbreaker Shard: Champions

title: Retribution: Debriefing from Crow — Transcript

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: You did it, Guardian. And thanks for taking us along for the ride. Felt good to get a few shots in. You make one hell of a Queensguard. Wish it didn't have to end, but Mara won't be able to channel her energy out forever. She'd deny it, but she's getting tired. Even if the power of the Awoken fades, you'll always have their gratitude. And Mara's. And mine. There are still pockets of prisoners out there. Devrim and Misraaks will keep running rescue efforts as long as it takes. I'll be here too. We can't protect everyone, but helping who we can… there's nothing's more important than that. See you 'round, Guardian.
Season of the Lost Opening Cinematic

title: Retribution: Briefing from Crow — Transcript

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: Mara and I have been talking, and we came to the same conclusion: it's time to act. The Witness sees our connection to each other as a weakness to exploit. It's counting on us not risking more lives in another attack. But if Amanda were here, I think she'd tell us it's time to play some offense. Mara's focusing all her energy directly through you, Guardian. We need you to blaze through the Ascendant Plane one last time. But it won't be without backup. We're all going. Mara says your power is strong enough to sweep us up in your astral wake. When you come out on the Shadow Legion flagship, we'll be right there with you. Lead the charge, Guardian. Let's finish what they started.

title: Riptide — Transcript

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: All right, we're not out of this yet. Now that we've reached the Control Center, we still need to power up this place before we can take care of our Fleet. Commander Zavala tells me you've volunteered. I'll run tactical. Shipwright Holliday here will provide tech support. It's a straightforward op: get in, flip a switch, get out.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Heh. Sloane's got a way of making things sound easy, doesn't she?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Did we lead the Fallen here?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: No. Those vultures have been following us since we evacuated Earth.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Sloane, Amanda. The Hive have infected everything.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Holliday, we gotta get you back in the air. We'll need ongoing aerial threat assessments to keep our perimeter secure.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Oh, uh… Yeah, you know my ship took a beating during the evacuation.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I'll bump you to the front of the line for repairs once the lights are back on.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen and Hive.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can see the wave energy converters from here.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Sweet. Now just flip the switch and turn 'em on.
The Guardian turns on the Wave Converters.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Ugh. Some of the pistons are moving, but we're still sitting in the dark.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Something went wrong. Pistons must be jammed.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Sorry, pal, but you're gonna have to go out there, rig a workaround.
The Guardian heads towards the converter platforms, defeating any Fallen and Hive they encounter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We made it to the converter platforms.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: OK. Get to the stalled pistons, see what's jamming 'em. Once they're all moving, we're in business.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh yeah, found the problem. The Hive have gunked up the pistons.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: First piston's good to go. We gave it a power scrubbing.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's great and all, but, uh… It's still pretty dark on this end.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Sounds like you got more scrubbing to do, Guardian.
The Guardian heads towards the second piston, defeating any Hive they encounter on the converter platforms. The Guardian destroys the Hive gunk blocking the second piston.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Control Center's still dark. So it's gotta be more than a piston problem. Gonna have to get in, futz with the circuit breakers.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Try the Central Platform. Everything routes through there.
The Guardian heads towards the Central Platform. They defeat the Hive on the Central Platform.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Circuit breaker's going to be around there somewhere. Find it and flip the switch. Just like I said.
The Guardian destroys the Hive gunk blocking the circuit breaker, then flips the circuit breaker switch.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Exemplary work, everyone. But we still have to deal with these intercepted enemy transmissions.

lines.text: HALL OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: My verses are bloated with lies. I long for the stars. The Fundament is my calling. And the Taken throne — yours. Long live the King.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: BROTHER. SAVATHÛN SPEAKS OF YOUR RASH INTENTIONS. YOU WOULD ABANDON US ONCE MORE?

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: You know that I must know the truth.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: COWARDICE! TO FLEE THE THRONE, THE BLADE, IS COWARDICE.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: IF YOU INTEND TO DEPART, THEN I SHALL COME AND KEEP YOU IN DEATH. I SHALL BEAR DOWN UPON YOUR ROTTED WORM AND KILL YOU IF THAT IS WHAT IS NEEDED TO MAKE MY BROTHER STAY.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: When I depart, the High War will be your inheritance. This court is my love of you, sister.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I SPIT ON YOU EVEN AS I SWEAR I WOULD NOT TRADE YOU FOR A THOUSAND COURTS. WE CAME FROM THE HELLISH DEPTHS OF THE FUNDAMENT TOGETHER. WE CONQUERED MOONS AND WORLDS TOGETHER.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: And yet I’ve learned nothing since then. So I must go. This is my nature, little sister. I cannot change it.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: THE WARRIOR OF THE SKY KNOWS VIOLENCE. TO SEE IT IN MOTION ONCE MORE…

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Yes. They are the sovereign-presumptive. You see, King? Presiding over the High War is your natural state.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: MY BROTHER DOES NOT LOVE EASILY, SKY WARRIOR. BUT YOU ARE HIS KILLER.
HALL OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Witnessing your glory furthers my compulsion to leave. The Taken throne is sharp and sleek… under you. I think you lust for it.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I designed this court for Xivu’s love. When I’m gone, it will belong to her. As an endless cycle of sword logic.

lines.text: The Guardian gazes into the Shaping Slab.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian, I am returned, and my throne is magnificent.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: It’s good to have you back, Eris. And more than that: now we have a foothold on the Ascendant Plane. Your throne world is a strategic advantage we never thought possible. It could turn the tide.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. I intend to use it well. We must capture the Echo and bind Oryx to my throne. His sword, Willbreaker, is our key. Its power to evert can drag Oryx from the Echo’s hold.

lines.text: Eris, we have no idea if that’s possible. But we do know that the Echo is too dangerous to exist. Willbreaker was the catalyst of the Dreadnaught’s superweapon. It contains immense destructive power. Guardian, if we can wield his sword, you can use it to destroy the Echo, and Oryx with it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: A waste of potential. The Echo would allow us to travel effortlessly through the Ascendant Plane. We cannot let that slip through our fingers, Deputy Commander.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: And if Savathûn or Xivu Arath takes it from us?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You’re relying on the cooperation of the Taken King.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I am relying on the strength of the Guardian’s will. But as of yet, the sword is not complete, and wielding it in service to me was almost too much for the Guardian to bear. We may neither destroy the Echo nor excise Oryx.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: For now, all we can do is hold the line. Guardian, your operations on the Dreadnaught are crucial. Use your power. Strengthen your resolve. We’ll find our footing and strike back.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation

title: Rites of the Deep | Report to Eris Morn — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Shaping Slab.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oryx seeks a path to Fundament. The Witch Queen, in delivering truth, has set her brother’s mind. Savathûn did not expect this reaction from him. Her misstep has created a new complication. We cannot allow Oryx to escape. We must force a confrontation. With the flesh of Akka, I may do so. But the deputy commander’s doubt… Hm. She tells me my methods are based on faith. Faith, the same flaw in Oryx’s logic. I did not challenge the word; an argument here would only divide our cause further. But when it is faith, it is faith in you. And when it is not… it is ambition. Binding the Echo of the Navigator to my throne will require immense power and the precise application of will. Together, we possess both. Then we may discover a way to excise Oryx’s foul essence. Only a being infused with Taken power may wield Willbreaker. Sloane and I will guide you to that becoming. Keep the faith, my knife. My acolyte. We must not be stymied by an adherence to order in pursuit of safety. This is the Deep. This is the Taken. There is no safety.

title: Rites of the Deep | Trial of Will: Ambition — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: A threat is forming on Luna, our moon. It cannot be left to congeal from mere blight to Eversion Anchor. But where there is threat, hides opportunity. I shall teach another method by which you will strengthen your hold of Taken power, and shatter theirs.
The Guardian touches down on the Moon.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive twist arcane threads ahead of you. Their spellcraft pulls at the gathering blight here, adulterating Luna’s crust beyond the Hive’s normal perversions. And I hear... whispers... playing at shapes made real. Shadows of shadows aching to speak words into being. Do not dally.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: To be as the Taken are, is not control, but acceptance of your weakness and ambition to seize power — costs be damned. I will pen my own tenet to this mantra: abstain from suffusion, become the Taken will. We will not heed the commands of whatever presence has manifested within their psychic trauma. Make yourself the sole will. Take up the embodiment of a truth so undeniable that they become you — and all barriers fade away.
The Guardian witnesses an Ogre surrounded by Wizards and engulfed in Taken energy.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That Ogre is undergoing… the Offering? The Hive do not possess this power… Without Oryx or the Witness, how? I fear another’s hand may carve these new Taken into being.
The Guardian defeats the Taken Wizards.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They retreat to Oryx’s shrine, I assume to seek the Taken King’s blessing… The Wizard’s ritual has yet to complete. End it here.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Reach into the unknown, and prepare for it to reach back.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian! Meet the gaze of the abyss! Steep yourself in suffocating blight. Invite the horror in. Hold it close.
The Guardian defeats the newly-Taken Ogre and is taken into the Ascendant Plane.
PLACE OF THE OFFERING, ASCENDANT PLANE

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This place… the Place of Offering, where the Taken submit their weakness to gain strength. There is… something else here… calling… rabid with grief. No! Sever the bindings! Unshape this beast now, Guardian!
The Guardian severs the bindings to the Ogre, which implodes into a portal. The Guardian leaves through it.
The Guardian destroys the leftover Blights.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Another foul stain scoured from Luna’s ailing depths. You reap strength from their defeat. Aiat. Yet… the Taken King is absent from this clash of swords. He offers no substantiation of their ritual. Why here then? The Dreadnaught, the Taken… they are entwined, but their goals do not seem aligned. Perhaps the presence we felt here in the Deep drives them… perhaps there is more to uncover. Search the grounds.
The Guardian discovers a memory of the Hive.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian — a remnant etched into the receding Deep. Draw it forth with your newfound power.
Savathûn: Oryx. The Witness is dead. It lied to you.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: We saw the syzygy, sister, and we dove to avert doom. I followed you to th—
Savathûn: Let me cut to the truth. The god-wave wasn’t the Traveler. We were chosen for Light, and the Witness gave us chains. But I can break us out of this game.
Savathûn: We’ve both been played since the beginning. Look, this is Immaru, my Ghost.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Light-pawn! Where is my cunning sister? She would never allow such heresy.
Savathûn: And what do you call what you are now, if not heresy?

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: ENOUGH! Does my blade not cut? Its edge is truth. Do tithes not sate my form? Our logic, proved in violence.
Savathûn: You’re an inanimate object, dear brother. Your blade cuts nothing.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I do not accept this! I will navigate through each manipulation, from the beginning, and I will divine the truth. ALONE!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oryx has shown the flaw in his logic: faith. Now doubt creeps in. He has long been a creature of singular purpose… and boundless curiosity. This revelation could send him reeling, or spell doom should he align with the Witch Queen. We cannot wait for the Echo to decide which avenue to explore. We must act in the face of uncertainty. I will begin preparations and contact you when they are ready for action.
