title: Riven's Lair — Transcript

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: What have you come to claim, dear Guardians?

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: My lair crawls with vermin. Present company excluded, of course.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: We made exquisite partners, you and I. Even if our partnership had its violent disagreements. You had so many dreams, and I knew how to weave them into the weapons you craved. Let's rekindle that little arrangement, shall we? I'm already here, after all. Slay my enemies. Protect my children. Give me peace, and I will forge a small measure of your brutality and greed into tools of death. I ask for nothing in return... but your dedication to our cause, and the pleasure of each broken enemy. Go, now. Your prey await.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: This is an interesting facsimile of the wider city. Not unlike a simulation — equally impervious to the demands of physical space.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You would see it that way.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Is it the work of a nostalgic heart, or that of a favored listless pet, tunneling into the walls?

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Simply, indulging the creative spark, O mortal mine.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Once again into the Confluence. Our enemies await you. Bring them fire.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: We'll keep your exit into the overworld clear for when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I wonder, if Mara did not cast Riven's eggs into... wherever this is, and Riven did not either... who did?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Maybe it was how Savathûn exploited Riven originally. Although... I don't remember her needing much motivation.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Doubtful. Riven would be aware of such an arrangement.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Yeah, and she'd NEVER lie to us about that.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: How is it that every time we work with the Vanguard, you find a way to get involved, Crow?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: You could say I'm a little invested.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Any assistance the Vanguard is willing to provide is a boon to us, Petra.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It's all right, Mara. She's still warming up to me.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: You're a bit dim, so it's taking a while.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: [chuckles] Relax, Venj. You already shot me once.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: How does it work, anyway? Raising a ghost — I mean — a spirit?

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Ahamkara are an anomaly unto themselves. A warp in the fabric of reality. In death their stamp lingers upon the world. It is a matter of drawing the essence of what remains into a... coalescence of her original form. Powerful, but still diminished.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You'll need Sol Divisive signatures to pick those locks.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Their corruption may reshape these halls. Deal with them, before the path collapses around us.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: These braziers stabilize the pathways of the Confluence, much like Ascendant beacons in the Ley Lines.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Scorn moving through the Confluence have a rare level of organization. They're normally more of a brute force. Not prone to executing ambushes or tactical maneuvers.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Unless they're following orders from someone. Keep an eye on their leaders.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: If the Techeuns were not occupied, we might arrange alternate passage.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: What timid adventurers we find these days. You want reward without danger.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Every time we encounter the Sol Divisive in these pathways, their code burrows into everything they touch.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Maybe something they picked up from the Black Garden? Everything in there has a tendency to get under your skin.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: That would be a nefarious development, and given the engrained Darkness we've been detecting in their radiolaria...

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'll let the Techeuns know after we clear this wing. We can help them sweep for any assimilating stowaways.
Mara Sov (Riven): The Queen's Wrath. Always coming up short. To think all your righteous vengeance amounted to this.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Is that all you have for me, Riven? I've told myself worse for years.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Your loyalty will doom you, Petra. Free yourself.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Do you still watch over your Corsairs, Petra? They all make the same wish, week after week: to escape.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I don't know why I thought you'd be above twisting the knife.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Perhaps, like your queen, I enjoy seeing dangerous creatures trapped in a cage.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The chamber is clear. The Techeuns will alert us when they've found the next egg.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You know, I respect you quite a bit. I honestly thought you'd have given up by now.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You're a victim as much as I am. She's ruined us both, you know. Why not you in her place?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Each offer is less tempting than the last. You must be hungry.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Isn't it unfortunate your City hunted down all of my kind, Osiris? You might have wished for Saint-14's return from the Forest.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: And have him trade the Vex's torment for yours?

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Perhaps you simply didn't want him back badly enough to pay the price.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Save the bait for someone naïve enough to take it.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Alliances are fragile things. What happens when the threat of extinction is past? Take care you do not end up a pawn of greater powers. Remember, O Guardian mine: none of us are to be trusted.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Every time we go up against the Scorn, I think about how they're cursed too. Reanimated and doomed to an existence of pain, all because... I wished it.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: That's not on you. Riven, as usual, twisted your desire to help someone in need.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Yeah. A lot of help I was, huh.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You still wear your desires on your sleeve. Friends. Forgiveness. It could all have been so easy.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It's not supposed to be easy.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: For you, it never will be.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: No Taken incursions, no Dark Ether pollutants... time looks normal. I think that's a wrap, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Is it? I think, there's more you want out of this. It's on the tip of my tongues.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I'm not interested in anything you're selling.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: I don't sell, I grant. I give, graciously and fully. I'm your chaperone to happiness. But what wouldn't you give to have her back?

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: You know me... which means you know I'm prone to emotional outbursts. You wanna keep pushing this?

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: [chortles] I'm sorry. That was rude of me.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: I remember each wing's construction. I rendered architecture from reality, and shaped something beautiful. I seeded the arboretum, laid crystal and dust where your witches designed your tightly bound demands.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: We conjured the first steps. Watched together as the realm formed out beyond our sight. You chose to be my enemy.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Captive. Enemy. Captive. These things come in rhythms.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Riven, we're not trying to trick you. I'm sure you can understand the hesitance coming from this side too.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: You never saw the Dreaming City at its height, Guardian. Perhaps you've grown accustomed to the blights and Scorn. But it was peaceful once.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: [scoffs] What do Guardians care for peace? They want to slay dragons.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I heard you're concerned about the new clutch of wish-dragons.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: As the Regent should... You're not alone. The Vanguard could help.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Hunt was instigated by the Warlocks of the City, yes.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: It's a different age. The Ahamkara aren't the ones ones who deserve a second chance.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The last time Ahamkara roamed free, they reshaped Venus. Unraveled reality itself.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Reality didn't suit the Guardians of the past. They wished to shape it accordingly. We merely... obliged.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: It was your City that called for the extinction of the Ahamkara. They believed the risks too great, the cost too high. But you understand the true value of power, O murderer mine.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Approach me. We have bargains to strike.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You have wants and wishes to trade.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: You want for SO much. Guardian. It's... salivating.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Another run around the loop. What voices will they hear this time?

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: This run will be different. You'll get what you came for... if you wish it.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: All the years in the universe won't make you as strong as this.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: The wish kept in that glass — a tragic vengeance, so... poorly worded.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Do not tell the others. They will envy you.
Wishing All the Best - Crow & Mara (Week 3)

title: Rohan's Funeral — Transcript

lines.text: Nimbus walks along the hall carrying Rohan's core, flanked by candles.

lines.speaker: Quinn Laghari
lines.text: Today, we honor relentless Rohan. His service...his sacrifice. More than a protector of Neomuna, he was a true Cloud Strider. He cut his years short, so that the whole of humanity may thrive far into the future.
Kneeling, Nimbus places Rohan's core into a pedestal.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Today, we suffer...so tomorrow can live on.
The pedestal begins to glow, raising itself and forms into a tombstone. Nimbus leaves the room.

title: Rites of the Deep | Writ: Path of Ambition  — Transcript

lines.text: HALL OF SOULS, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian finds a tithing wormspawn.
The Guardian arrives on the Dreadnaught.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: The Tithing Wormspawn resonates in your mind: seek the source of paracausal power locked away within the Dreadnaught.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The call I felt emanating from the Deep was not for us, or anyone. It was a beacon of want and purpose, sounding from whatever new entity now inhabits the Deep. Drifter has located the source. Make no mistake: it is no gift. This, we take for ourselves.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: An impossible will beckons... Something is calling from deep within the Dreadnaught.
INVASION BAY, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
Xvaak, a renegade Hive wizard attempts to unseal the chamber. The Guardian disrupts the ritual.
CORE OF CORRUPTION, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian enters the room and is transported to the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sloane would advise that we contain this aberrant expression of Taken energy. Her methods are not wrong, but there are often more paths than one to victory.
The Guardian absorbs the power from the slab, embracing their ambition.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. In one fist, you grip control. In the other, you reach with ambition. You are ready to face any horror the Dreadnaught can produce, and turn them away with your fury.
INVASION BAY, DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

title: Root of Nightmares — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardians search for Nezarec's body in its encasement.
The Guardians proceed in search for Nezarec's body in its encasement.
The Guardians continue in search for Nezarec's body in its encasement.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: I'm glad my messages reached you. I considered you might leave me here to rot, but we both know you Guardians can't resist unanswered questions. Or a challenge.
The Guardians continue exploring the Pyramid, "Essence", and enter the root.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: Oh, these sensations! The tingle in my fingertips! This power is familiar, yet... different. Oh, it's invigorating.
The Guardians continue exploring the Pyramid, "Essence".

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: If I had a modicum of my original power, I'd have killed one — or three — of those citizens to expedite your arrival. Instead, I suffer from the incompetence of these... new recruits.
The Guardians proceed to cross the chasm (first message from this section).

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: Mmm... I can hear the shifting roots across the Pyramid's architecture. Taste the paracausality on my tongue. Progress.
The Guardians proceed to cross the chasm (second message from this section).

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: After that witch killed me and cursed my remains, I assume that's when she whisked away the Veil to Neptune. The coveted key to the Witness's plans... and the sapid secret of its first victims. As much as I loathe her, I must applaud her efforts.
The Guardians continue to cross the chasm (third message from this section).

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: Lightbearers have always seemed... efficient at creating their own chaos. Your Warlords did a masterful job of that. Do you enjoy hearing the final screams of your enemies? Screams are the most delicious when they're wrenched directly from the throat. An echo that reverberates through eternity. Aah... beautiful.
The Guardians continue to cross the chasm (fourth message from this section).

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: As I've gathered, there was barely anything left of me for the Witness to collect. Hmm... has anyone suffered from the pieces they took? I wonder if I could track them down. Do you happen to know who took them? Consider the information reparations for my untimely death.
The Guardians confront the Explicator and disrupt his influence.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: Tear that useless sack of meat apart for me, won't you? He hasn't accomplished nearly as much as you in your short time here.
The Guardians traverse the roots to locate Nezarec's body at the place of his newfound power.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: Such tenacious adventurers. It's fascinating to see the lengths you'll go to reach your goals. Emissaries of pain and death. It's inspiring.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: I have been trapped for a very long time. Such a cruel fate for simple fulfilling my duties... don't you think? Free me. I want to experience this world with my... new perspective.
The Guardians confront Nezarec to lay him to his final rest.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: [laughs maniacally] Oh, a shame we cannot entertain our one-sided conversations further! Ah, but this... this feels too good. Guardians! Let me devour your fear!
The Guardians defeat Nezarec, the Final God of Pain.

lines.speaker: Nezarec
lines.text: My memory will never extinguish. In your calmest moments, your deepest slumber... you will remember me, Guardians.
The scythe of infinite nightmares lies before you awaiting your cooperation.
With the Neomuni now free of Nezarec's influence, Osiris only has one question: Where has the Witness gone?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: While our attention was drawn to Neptune, something wicked stirred in the Witness's Pyramid... a life force thought to be lost, unknowingly revived by the Traveler's terraforming power. Its defensive display forever imprinted upon the vessel, the infamous "final god of pain" sought to use this paracausal power for his own curiosities. But it proved to be his final mistake. The people of Neomuna may now be free of Nezarec's influence, but the Cabal and Vex remain at their doorstep, though an unanswerable question remains of all our minds... Where has the Witness gone? We must begin our search in the pieces it has left behind. It will not succeed for as long as we remain in existence.
Jisu Calerondo informs the citizens of Neomuna that Nezarec is dead.

lines.speaker: Jisu Calerondo
lines.text: Vanguard forces recently engaged an independent provocateur identified as "Nezarec" within a derelict Black Fleet vessel. Described as "the Final God of Pain" in pre-Collapse sources, he possessed potent psionic abilities. Authorities believes these abilities allowed him to access and disrupt CloudArk operations here in Neomuna.

title: Root of Nightmares Completed — Transcript

lines.text: The Traveler above the earth, surrounded by the Black Fleet. It fires its beam into the Witness's ship, ripping a hole in the side. Roots grow around the breach.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: While our attention was drawn to Neptune, something wicked stirred in the Witness's Pyramid, a life force thought to be lost, unknowingly revived by the Traveler's terraforming power.
Nezerac within his crystal, arms crossed before the plants. Behind him, the roots grow into a Tree of Silver Wings.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Its defensive display forever imprinted upon the vessel. The infamous "final god of pain" sought to use this paracausal power for his own curiosities. But it proved to be his final mistake.
Neomuna is surrounded by Nezarec's hand, which shatters into dust and disappears. Flickering circuitry remain above the city.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The people of Neomuna may now be free of Nezarec's influence, but the Cabal and Vex remain at their doorstep, though an unanswerable question remains on all our minds...
The portal on the Traveler's surface. An image of the Witness appears behind it and four planets and earth come into view.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Where has the Witness gone? We must begin our search in the pieces it has left behind. It will not succeed for as long as we remain in existence.

title: Sabotaging Salvation — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian travels to the Fallen City.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Good to have you back, Guardian. The Fallen are producing advanced weaponry on Europa to improve their military strength throughout the system. Our goal is to sabotage their efforts however we can. We'll start by taking out a critical manufacturing plant.
The Guardian unseals the barrier and pushes forward.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Variks will be advising on this mission. He has specialized knowledge of the facility.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: It is well guarded, not only by Eramis's Eliksni… Vex incursions threaten Europa. [insect-like chattering] A scythe through those who still whisper Eramis's name.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Perhaps we can use that to our advantage.
The Guardian proceeds deeper using a teleporter.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: You will encounter many locks here. Variks offers you his keys. They are… old. [inhales] The teeth must fit this new lock.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Do you really think your old access codes will work? Maybe there's another way.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right. Just between you and me, I'm really tired of hacking security systems…
The Guardian discovers Vex attacking House Salvation members. The Guardian clears the way forward until a door closes and locks, blocking them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I still don't see why this would work, but if I have to hack this thing, I will.
Ghost inputs Variks's key to bypass security. Fallen appear and attack the Guardian. Variks's key is denied access.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Access denied. Big surprise there. New plan. Guardian, I'm picking up a volatile energy signature on the other side of the room. A power core, I think. Let's get a little more proactive here.
The Guardian steals the power core and throws it, destroying the door.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: That was very Titan of you, Ghost.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've been through a lot lately. I'd say we're… learning to do things our own way.
The Guardian defeats Brig Factory Guards while hacking and sabotaging the nearby Fallen Brigs. The Guardian pushes deeper into the facility.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wow. The Fallen really built this place up. And another computer terminal.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [inhales] You must not blow it up. You will disrupt too much.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Fine, fine, let me have a look.

Ghost hacks into the Fallen terminal and a House Salvation Factory Walker appears. While fighting the Factory Walker, a Factory Brig suddenly descends and destroys the Factory Walker. The Guardian destroys the Factory Brig.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Well done, Guardian. This will go a long way in gaining us a foothold on Europa. But we should hit them again as soon as possible. Take advantage of the Vex presence here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Just give the word, Commander. We'll be ready.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.text: Unsavory Allies, Hunter and the Hunted

title: Sails of the Shipstealer I: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Hello, Guardian. My father and I are already studying the relic you reclaimed from the pirates. I am eager to learn the nature of the strange energies that seep from within. I was thrilled to aid in your engagement with Eramis's fleet. I hope my support was beneficial, although I admit I am unused to the rigors of combat. While I did study with the Awoken Techeuns, gunplay was never a part of the syllabus. I am proud of the progress we made together. Thank you for including me as part of your crew. I must continue my studies. May the Light provide.

title: Sacrilege — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Io. The whole place hums with the energy left behind by the Traveler's unfinished work. No wonder Guardians consider this site sacred. Now that Cayde is back in the fold, all we need is to find Ikora— make the Vanguard whole again… and bring down the Almighty.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Of all the places I've been in all the years since my rebirth, this is where I return. The last place the Traveler touched. I came for answers. I stand here still with nothing.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora, Zavala is forming a resistance and he believes—

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: What good is a resistance when you are the only one who would survive? I believe this Ghaul creature knows the Traveler blessed this site. I believe he sent his Legion to find something they could never possibly understand. And I believe they will continue to desecrate all we hold sacred. Save this place, Guardian. Do not squander this second chance.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Red Legion ships have been in and out non-stop since I got here. We need to know what they're doing. Get into that base.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look at the sky! What is that, Ikora?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Energy… The Traveler's energy! What have they done?! This is my fault. I could have stopped this.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora, there's no way! Not without your Light.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I am more than just my Light! I could have tried! I should have tried. But… after all these years dying, being reborn, dying again… The Traveler has left me with one life, and I am afraid to lose it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That might happen anyway. Ghaul has a weapon that can blow up our sun.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: What? Why would he destroy what he's worked o hard to conquer? Get into that base. There must be answers there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like the Legion's packing up, Ikora.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Find out what they're shipping. We need every scrap of intel we can get.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Keep looking. It's not like the Cabal to invest so much in a base and just abandon it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're coming up on a big drill

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: A drill? Are they mining the Traveler's energy? No, it's not Light. It can't give the Traveler's blessing. Not to me, not to Ghaul — Or could it?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Why are the Taken here? They have no leader; Oryx is dead.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Taken will always be drawn to the Traveler's energy. They are no longer Fallen or Hive or Cabal. Oryx changed them with the dark powers he stole. He — Wait. Is Ghaul's plan to do the same, but with the Light? That has to be it!
The Guardian kills a Taken Wizard

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Ghaul must be mining the Traveler's remnant energy in the hopes of transforming himself and the Red Legion into wielders of the Light. If he succeeds, he will become immortal. Unstoppable. We have to tell Zavala. Meet me outside.
The Guardian fights their way out of the Wraith Mines

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: All channels. This is a skyshock alert! Someone or something drew the Taken here!

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Irrelevant! The Taken are sapping the moon's energy. I hypothesize that Io will implode if someone does not intervene!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Guardian, we cannot lose this sacred place. Do what must be done. Stop the Taken.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like the Taken are conjuring some kind of portal.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Stop them! Doubtless, those mindless vermin intend to summon every last one of their spectral friends to devour this moon.
The Guardian defeats Wry, Norr and Erruk, the Taken Wizards.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There it goes. Looks like we closed the portal.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Then why am I still seeing abnormal neutrino scattering?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hang on. We're gonna take a closer look.
The Guardian walks closer, and the portal expands into a dome, surrounding the Guardian

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ahh! Remedy this mess, you fools!
The Guardian destroys Irausk, Herald of Savathun

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Portal's closed. We're clear. Ikora, I know this place is important to you, but…

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: There's nothing here for me on Io. I have one life left to give, and I will give it gladly to stop Ghaul. We leave now.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Don't be so hasty Ikora Rey, we must talk. And as for you, meddling Guardian, I have a few choice things to say to you.

lines.speaker: Asher
lines.text: Ikora tells me that Commander… Somebody… I-don't-care… has a plan to attack the so-called Almighty. A plan unsupported by any data! However, there are remnants of an old interplanetary defence network here. We shall use it to assess the Almighty's capabilities. Then, we will tell Za-va-la precisely why his plan is wrong! And oh, I will relish that. Meanwhile, I refuse to squander valuable research opportunities. Therefore, you shall be my assistant. Go! All this talk wastes my time.

title: More Than a Weapon IV: Speak to Ana Bray — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian receives a transmission from Ana Bray at the Holoprojector.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Okay, I know this sounds unbelievable, but I think I found our solution. During the Dark Age, Rasputin segmented off a portion of his code to develop on its own. An independent AI. He stuffed that code into an Exo body… and long story short, that seedling of code became a Guardian called Lord Felwinter. Felwinter died. Like, a final death. But I had this idea, so I reached out to Saladin. He told me that the Iron Lords kept the remains of Felwinter's Ghost, Felspring, at the Iron Temple. Think about it! Missing pieces of Rasputin's code, linguistic data, pieces of Felwinter's personality engram… we can use it all! I convinced Saladin to grant us access to Felspring’s remains. He’s got allies on the ground preparing them for us. I need you to go out and get the data. This could be the breakthrough we’ve been looking for.

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Speak to Saint-14, The Trials of Osiris

title: Sails of the Shipstealer I: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian. I thought the Eliksni had moved on from such senseless brutality. It seems I was mistaken. Eramis has awoken and has summoned the old crews to aid her. Regrettably, it falls on you to stop them. For that, you will require a Star Chart and a Captain's Atlas. Spider had these antiques in his collection. Use them if you must, but remember that you are a Guardian, chosen by the Light. These pirates — brutal remnants of our past — are not. Eramis chose to ally with them for a reason. They know the stars in a way even House Salvation does not. I fear that Eramis may seek — ah… pay me no mind. Raise arms against these pirates and discover the truth for yourself.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer III: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian, we have new readings: Eramis's fleet moves across the system, pursuing relics of power. Summon your crew. And… a request. Please. As a favor to me. Do not involve Eido in your violence against the old crews. She is brave and curious, but does not yet understand the brutality of the world. There are pain-truths in our history. I should have told her earlier, before all this… But I must learn before I can teach. And for that, I need time. Disrupt Eramis's crews, and stop her from collecting the relics. Some mistakes must remain in the past.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer II: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian, I… I greet you in the Light. And yet, I feel adrift in shadow. Eido and I studied the artifact you claimed from the pirates, and it emanates pure Darkness. It is an object pulled from Eliksni legend… and I fear it is not the only one of its kind. The old crews fought and died for these relics, believing they could bestow power— The very power the Great Machine withheld. That is why Eramis enlisted their help. She seeks the relics, and pirate legends hint at where they may be hidden. And if her task is at the command of the Witness… hm… Eramis cannot be allowed to claim the powers within. If she does, all will fall to corruption. You must find them. You must.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer IV: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Guardian. As you prepare for your next voyage, know that I will continue to assist in the conflict against Eramis. I had words with Misraakskel concerning his recent behavior. He explained he wished to shelter me from the violence displayed by Eramiskel's crews. I said one does not protect by forbidding exposure. There is no safety in ignorance. I told him plainly that I will not be sheltered. As the Guardian credo states, "Devotion inspires bravery, bravery inspires sacrifice…" The unspoken line that follows is why I will remain on the radio. Now, we must continue to pursue the relics Eramis seeks. Board your ship, and let us begin.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer V: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Misraakskel of House Light… my father… a murderer, and a liar. Learning the truth is difficult, but… the sharpest pain comes from the fact that he didn't tell me earlier. I was aware he had a past, but in a way, Eramiskel showed me who my father is today… and who he sees when he looks at me. He must think I am unable to understand… or he doesn't care whether or not I do. I am either underestimated or dismissed. And I can take only one lesson from this: my own father does not want me to know him. Our priorities have not changed. We must stop Eramis from claiming the relics of Nezarec. I will not place my own feelings above our mission. I will not become the hypocrite that my father is.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer II: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: [hums a jaunty tune, then cuts off] Ah, hey there, hero! Ha, sorry — getting a little swept up in all this adventurin'. I'm on debrief duty while your Eliksni buddies are busy with the relics you got from Eramis's crew. Eido's researching how to tap into their power. The kid's thorough, I'll give her that. She thinks something's hidden inside 'em. I swear she was about to crack one open before Mithrax stopped her. Now, me? I took one look and knew those things were bad news. Gave me a little shiver. Reminds me of something… from a long time ago. Huh. Maybe I should do a little research of my own.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer V: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian… Eido has taken action that may endanger us all. She sent a message to Eramis. She invoked a ritual from the old crews: "words with empty hands." It is a type of parley, where no violence is permitted. Eido believes Eramis will follow the rules of her people. I am not so trusting. Should Eramis accept, I would ask that you accompany us. In the meantime, continue the fight. This may be a ploy, and we must not be fooled. I hope that she ignores Eido's request. But if she does not, know this: Eramis does nothing that is not to her benefit. A word can do more damage than a blade. And Eramis is skilled at wielding both.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer VI: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I greet you, Guardian. I wished to speak to you earlier, but I did not have the words. I will not apologize, as I believe the secrets of my old life were mine to keep. But I do regret. I am ashamed of my cruelty. Of the things I did, the people I hurt. I thought I left it behind. But the old Misraaks is still within me, and now he has hurt my daughter — I have hurt my daughter. I must set it right. I was a killer, but I am a Kell. I will prove to you which title I deserve.

title: Sails of the Shipstealer VI: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey there, hero! I heard you parleyed with Eramis, and she hit you with some heavy truths. Mithrax used to be… [gasps theatrically] a bad guy! Can you believe it? Heh. Wait'll I tell Crow. [chuckles] I know Eido's pissed because her dad didn't tell her about it. Makes sense… but it don't shake me. Mithrax — he's just a fella who done something he ain't proud of. And that I understand. Which reminds me… long time back, I found myself at the Fourth Tomb of Nezarec. Recognized these relics the first time I saw one. That's why I needed you involved. Ain't nobody I trust with that kind of power more'n you. Well… after Eris. She gave me some ideas that might help Mithrax use these things for good. Whatever he does will show us just what kind of person he is… If we can stop Eramis from finding the last few relics and killing us all.
Rites of the Deep | Writ: Path of Ambition

title: Sails of the Shipstealer IV: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I have just spoken with Drifter. He says another force assaulted Eramis's pirates. If you and Eramis are not the only ones searching for the relics, I fear this is beyond my control. I believed we could collect the relics, and contain their power. Keep them safe. Guardian, there are… details I have kept from you. From everyone. I… must ask for the gift of your patience. I will find an answer. I will. Trust me for a moment longer, I beg you.

title: Saint-14's Return - Speak to Ikora Rey — Transcript

lines.text: Bazaar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Let's hope your journey to help Saint doesn't have any unintended consequences for our timeline. Even the Warlock Orders don't fully understand the ramifications. The Speaker exiled Osiris for less. But I know you'll stop at nothing to right a wrong. Eris says that Guardians are bound to lives of loss. We don't usually get to see our old friends again after they've passed. So thank you for this. Just… try not to make this a habit.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Saint-14’s Return - Speak to Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I've come to expect great things from you, Guardian. You never wavered when the Tower fell. When Cayde died. I rely on you when all else fails. But this - rectifying the past - I could not expect. Today you saved the life of a Titan. No more, no less. And for that I'm grateful. He might not say it to your face, but Saint idolizes you. He'll need your help reacclimating to… all of this. Do what you can.

lines.text: The End, Exploring the Corridors of Time

title: Sails of the Shipstealer VIII: Visit the Holoprojector — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian receives a message on the holoprojector near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: So... [chuckles] lemme get this straight: Mithrax has Eramis at the end of his sword, and then... nothing? I mean, nothing? Huh. I thought that guy still had some mean in him. Guess I was wrong. I was right about you, though! Gotta hand it to you, kid: you did a hell of a job out there. Drove Eramis off, stopped whatever plan the Witness had, and brought home all the pieces of Nezarec. Not bad at all. Mithrax and Eido have the relics now. Don't know what those things can actually do, but if anyone can figure it out, it'd be them. Hope it's something good. Yup, nothin' for you to do now but lay back in that big ol' pile of pirate treasure you got. You deserve it. And don't worry about giving me my cut, Captain. It just felt nice to be a good guy again. Heh. Trust.

title: Salvation, Beckoned (Bray Exoscience) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Ziggurat after speaking with the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardian, this feels wrong. You wielding Darkness. But I'm not going anywhere. If you need me, I'm here.
The Guardian attunes Phylaks's Splinter of Darkness to the Ziggurat's glyph.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This power, this Stasis, I'm worried it's taking more of a toll on you than you realize. I'm able to bring you back from death with the Light, but I may not be able to, if this power consumes you.
As the Guardian travels to Bray Exoscience, Eramis is broadcasting a transmission.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up another transmission from Eramis.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: To my Eliksni sisters and brothers out amongst the stars and here at home on Europa: we have suffered a great loss today. Our beloved warrior Phylaks was murdered by the pawns of the once "Great Machine." As always, they eagerly seek to eradicate us. Remember, Light only burns bright so long, but Darkness is forever.

The Guardian approaches a Crux of Darkness and communes with it. The Darkness beckons… and the Guardian becomes temporarily empowered with Stasis. Fallen from House Salvation flood into the area. The Guardian defeats waves of Fallen with Stasis. The Guardian returns to the Crux of Darkness and ends their communion.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm here to fight for the Light. And so are you. If this is how we're going to do it… I'll be by your side. But we are toying with power neither of us understand. And I have no control over it. If anything happens to you, I may not be able to help. But I'll do what I can.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Sails of the Shipstealer VIII: Visit the Star Chart — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Star Chart for instructions.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian. You are close to securing the last relic of Nezarec, and we near the end of our mission. I have noticed no further communications between Eramis and her crews. I hope this means the worst is behind us. I did find, however, a transmission from Eramis... to Eido. It was embedded in an unsecured Scribe log. You may have heard it. I do not know what Eramis gains in speaking with Eido. We know the Shipstealer only acts to her own benefit. But Eido shuns me. She studies the coordinates of the pirate lairs without my assistance. I have never seen her behave this way. I cannot place blame solely on Eramis's influence. My actions pushed Eido away, though I meant only to protect her. She will see that, in time — she must. Unless she has already made her choice. We must end this now, before something happens that cannot be undone. Claim the final reliquary and finish this conflict. May the Light provide.

title: Salvation, Beckoned: First Attunement — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches Drifter, Eris Morn, and the Exo Stranger after their brawl with the Fallen.
If the Guardian talks to Drifter

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Your old pal Drifter was right. It's time to ditch the "Light good, Dark bad" dogma. And folks are finally starting to see it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: With everything that's at stake — you are reveling in being right?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Just let me have this one, Three Eyes. All right? Just once.
If the Guardian talks to Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I cannot tell you how relieved I am to see you. We are in great need of allies… And I am in even greater need of a buffer between myself and the ever-obnoxious Drifter. The Stranger, you see, is far too reserved to provide sufficient rest from his chatter. I suspect her quiet has more to do with what she has to hide. Though I've yet to work out what or why… Still, even these two are an improvement from my solitary studies on Luna. You're lucky to have your Ghost, Guardian. As you can surely tell already, this journey into Darkness is not to be traveled alone.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I know. I owe you an explanation for all this. I once asked Guardians to destroy the Black Heart. To prevent Darkness' arrival. Success may have been achieved, but I now know that fate comes knocking sooner or later. The floodgates are open. The Darkness is here. I wield it now with intent to stop our enemies where the Light cannot. Your resilience within the Pyramid proves you're capable of wielding it too. Before us lies what we call a "Ziggurat." Its purpose is temptation. To begin your training, you must give in. Here, take this.
The Exo Stranger gives a Splinter of Darkness to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Please understand. The line between Light and Dark is so very thin. Let's cross it together.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I understand why you're going along with the Stranger's plan, but… well, she's clearly not telling us everything.
The Guardian attunes their Splinter of Darkness.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The longer we're here, the more nervous I get. Not that I think you can't handle it. I know you can. I just wish I had a better idea of what that might be. We're definitely in uncharted territory out here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up a Fallen transmission. It's… Eramis!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Attention all pawns of the once "Great Machine": did you know that before it doomed your kind, it did the same to mine? You are not special. Just the plaything of a so-called god who would sooner see your life end than its own.

The Guardian approaches and communes with a Crux of Darkness. The Guardian becomes empowered by Stasis. Multiple hordes of Vex appear. The Guardian uses Stasis to defeat the Vex. The Guardian returns to the Crux of Darkness and ends the communion.
The Guardian approaches a Fallen barrier nearby sealed by Stasis. The Guardian uses Stasis to unseal the barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, we can use Stasis to unlock these latches after all. Let's look inside; see if we can find something useful.
The Guardian unseals a chest using Stasis and receives Aged Armor.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Can it be? I can smell that poisoned power on you. Does corruption spread so quickly? Or do you hope to fight Eramis with her own weapons? [insect-like chattering] You walk a very dangerous path. Take this recklessness to Phylaks, then. But beware. [insect-like chattering] She is Eramis' most skilled warrior. She made her name at Twilight Gap. Prove yourself a worthy opponent, and she will show herself. [insect-like chattering]
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Parts Long Lost, A Moment In Time

title: Salvation, Beckoned (Riis-Reborn Approach) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Ziggurat after speaking with the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm worried, Guardian. Wielding Stasis may be taking more of a toll on you than you know. I can resurrect you with the Light, but if using Darkness consumes you, I may be powerless.
The Guardian attunes Praksis's Splinter of Darkness to the Ziggurat's glyph.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I never imagined you'd be wielding Darkness. Maybe once we defeat Eramis, you won't need to anymore.
As the Guardian travels to Riis-Reborn Approach, Eramis broadcasts another transmission.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eramis is sending another wide-range transmission.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Judgment day is upon us, my fellow Eliksni. Another foundational pillar of our beautiful society has been knocked down. Praksis, dear friend. Your hand at the hands of those puppets will not go unavenged. Soon they will answer for what they've done. I will see to it myself. Rise now, my fellow Eliksni. Do not let this scum take more of our sisters, brothers, fathers, and mothers. We are the future of our kind, and we will destroy all who threaten our kind. Leave no pawn alive.

The Guardian discovers Vex attacking the Fallen city as they push towards the Crux of Darkness. The Guardian approaches a Crux of Darkness and communes with it. The Darkness beckons… and the Guardian becomes temporarily empowered with Stasis. House Salvation Fallen flood into the area. The Guardian defeats waves of Fallen with Stasis. The Guardian returns to the Crux of Darkness and ends their communion.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Be careful, Guardian. This is Stasis at its most powerful. I won't lie; it scares me. I just don't want to see it turn on you. Its grasp is sinister.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Savathun's Spire — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Ascend Savathûn's Spire. We shall see what mysteries await us.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You're only here because Savathûn's letting you in.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Guardian, remind Immaru why that is.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Savathûn went through all this trouble just for you. Don't waste it.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Empower the Spire and unlock its secrets.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Eris is having the time of her life. She'll never give up being a Hive.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Yes she will. The sooner we can get this done, the sooner she can finish this.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: I wouldn't be so sure. I see that look in her eyes when she gets those tithes... and you see it too.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Reckless? No. I know the danger, and I will accept the outcome.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: And if I won't accept it?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That is what will lead us into recklessness.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Bringing down Savathûn's sister is gonna take more than chanting in a circle.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Maybe. But from where I'm floatin', you're not exactly a fan of her methods.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I trust her judgment. I only wish it hadn't come to this.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: One of Savathûn's experiments with Arc Light. Interrupt its charge.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Break the charge of Arc energy to contain its Light.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Disrupt that thing to clear the room of Arc energy.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Transfer the Arc charge to each Crystal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Conduct the charge of Arc to the inert Crystals.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You'll need to move that Arc energy to those Crystals.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That Solar Light is unstable. Disrupt and control it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Unchecked Solar Light. Savathûn's experimentation. Contain its power, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: That thing is burning up the place. Get it under control!

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Solar crystals must be contained.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Bear each Solar crystal to its vessel.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Use those Solar crystals to unleash their power.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Void Light will pull you in. Break its hold over you, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Void Light exerts its inexorable pull. Break its tether.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: That Void Light'll keep draggin' you in if you don't contain it.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Shoot the Void crystals to bring 'em down.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Break those Void Crystals to release their power.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Shatter the Void crystals to undo their power.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Take the Hive's Light to the ritual circle.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Transmute your charged Light within the ritual circle.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Bring the Hive's Light to that ritual circle!

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Savathûn really thinks some half-Hive half-wit can take out her sister. We're all doomed.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Say that again. Eris will survive this, but believe me: you won't survive Eris.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You're all bluffing. You can't crush me; I'm too important.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: For now... but your freedom of movement is a privilege... and we have a crate just for you.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Hive runes aren't letters. They're logograms. Each one represents a word or idea. Their patterns draw power from their meaning, and their orientation casts a spell. Eris uses them in her rituals... and we can use them now.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You some kind of expert on Hive runes?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. Each rune manifest their referent. Death brings death, lies brings lies. We seize them all with our inscriptions, grasping their malign power. We wield them as we wield fear.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, aiat, aiat. Forget I asked.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Those Hive are all that's left in your way. Bring them down, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: These are the Spire’s wardens. Remove them and complete our ritual.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: These are some of Savathûn's best. Take 'em down.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Clear out the Scorn and take the Spire.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian! Remove the Scorn and claim the Spire.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: One of Savathûn's experiments. Real mean. Go get 'em!

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Scorn are still all over the Throne World. No matter how many you kill, they keep comin' back. Witness must be churning 'em out. Hey, didn't your precious boy Crow wish them into existence? Great move. Really spiced things up for all of us. Thank him for me.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Savathûn kept these undead dolts in here under lock and key. Studied 'em for a while. She wanted to see if they were anything like Nokris's necromancy. They weren't. They got a special kind of resurrection just for them. No Ghosts, no throne worlds. Just Dark Ether and the Witness. And lucky for us, they just keep comin'.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: It never gets old watching you glowbugs fight the Scorn for us, heh. You even took care of Rhulk! Must be why you're still in Savathûn's good graces. So, keep it up, champ. You're doing great. I know that's what you Guardians like to hear.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Eris, I spoke with Elisabeth Bray.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I can imagine why. She fears phantoms. Futures that have not come to pass. I do not fault her for her concern. Tell her I am not alone.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I don't know if she'll understand.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Sword logic is easy. "Survival of the fittest." You don't need to dress it up.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is not an evolutionary adaptation, but a philosophical understanding. Active, not passive. You must prove your right to exist, or else you do not deserve existence. It creates a moral imperative to seek out and destroy everything you encounter.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: You have to keep breaking things until you find something you can't break.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well... yes. That is one way of putting it.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris, you have to take time to rest. These transformations... you know I don't like this. I don't like what you've become.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I understand your concern, Ikora. But I wonder: If I am subsumed, and remain Hive... would you still be concerned for my wellbeing?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Let us hope that claim is not tested.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Xivu IS war. And as far as I can see, that's what we're in. So what's your pet Hive's plan?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: No one is more versed in Hive magic than Eris Morn. She'll find a way. She has to.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: When the Hive gods made their pact with the worms of Fundament, they were bound to fulfill their ambitions, lest the worm devour them. Oryx sought understanding. Savathûn sought lies and trickery. Xivu Arath has fatted her worm on the strength of civilizations. And all that remains of those are the epitaphs etched in the pages of Hive apocrypha.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: She always like this? Lighten up a little! Yeesh.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: So, what'll be on your civilization's tombstone? “Here lies humanity. We thought we were the center of the universe, right up until a Hive God tore us apart.”

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We will have no such inscription.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah. That's right. Because there won't be anything — at all.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You tear through everything in front of you, huh? Can't help yourself. It's what you do. I'm not gonna say, “we're not so different”, because you'll never believe it. What's the point? But Eris and Xivu… let's just say our God of War is getting exactly what she wants.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You're going toe-to-toe with Xivu Arath. Wonder what that tusked-up tyrant thinks about that.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The empress trusts Eris to get this done. After everything with her father, she's earned some rest.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Too tuckered out from her daddy issues to do it herself, huh?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I'll pass along your concerns. I'm sure she'll want to thank you in person.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You think Eris will finally lose her marbles? She seemed short a few when she started. This might be the thing that finally knocks ‘em loose.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: What? I hear how your Guardians talk. They ain't exactly discreet.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: We trust Eris to get this done.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Huh. You really think so? Might want to check your comms because that's not what I'm hearing.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Funny. The Witness can bring back any dead Eliksni and turn ‘em into Scorn. Sounds just like our Guardians, doesn't it. It’s good to have an army of useful, undead dummies. Looks like the Vanguard knows that too. So… snap-snap, hop to it. You've got a lot more Scorn to kill.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: “Well done”? We don't even know how to take out Xivu, and you're handing out cookies.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah? So where's your master plan?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Xivu Arath breaches the Spire’s secrets. I will not let her breach ours.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You're done. Now get out before you break anything else.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We are not your Hive, and you cannot give us orders.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Hah, as if you could hold up against my Hive. Where'd your Ghost go again? Oh, right. She's dead.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris, your ritual called on the Hive Worm Gods, and there were some I didn't recognize.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Not all are Hive. Sel, Ora, Leis… they were Ahsa’s sisters. Dead, or lost. She whispered their names to me, and I invoked them alongside the worm gods both slain and living.
Ikora. I see. Ahsa is one of our greatest allies. I just hope she finds time to rest.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Savathûn kept the spire hidden from us for too long. It seems this place is still full of secrets.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Such is its nature. Throne worlds are cyst universes, created by practitioners of the sword logic and manipulated by their whims. The Spire may be an emanation of Savathûn’s desire to control the Light.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Who died made you an expert on throne worlds?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris, I can't keep ignoring Elsie.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have no trouble doing so.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Think about this from her perspective. You don't know what she's seen.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I am familiar with her perspective. I hear the speculation. There are Guardians who believe I will take control of the Hive, go mad, and kill you all. If not that, then they say I have nothing else to live for, and think my death is inevitable. That I will sacrifice myself for the good of all.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Tell that to Elisabeth. Perhaps she will believe you this time.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: ERIS MORN. YOU ARE CONJURED WITH VENGEANCE. I AM CONJURED WITH WAR. IN YOUR VENGEANCE, YOU INVOKE YOUR UNDERSTANDING. IN YOUR UNDERSTANDING, YOU INVOKE MY BROTHER.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your brother is dead! He failed, and his children failed.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOU ARE THE BLADE HAS HAS APPOINTED. NOW AND FOREVER OUR KING.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Rasputin was the best you got, and he still folded when Xivu came knocking.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: He was a hammer. The Warmind escalated attacks with the goal of overwhelming his enemies. That was futile against Xivu Arath. Self-sacrifice was his only option.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: So, what's Eris’ plan? Throw herself on a sword?

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah? What makes you so sure?

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: ERIS MORN. YOU MEET ME IN MY COURT AND KNOW ME. YOU FIND ME IN OUR WAR AND SEE THE VIOLENCE OF YOUR BROOD. YOU BRING YOUR BLADE AGAINST MINE, AND IN THEIR CROSSING, I FIND YOUR LOVE. I WILL END YOUR EXISTENCE. AND WHEN YOU RETURN, I WILL KILL YOU AGAIN… AND WHEN YOU RETURN, I WILL KILL YOU AGAIN. AIAT. AIAT.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive gods killed one another out of love. Perhaps Xivu Arath seeks to do the same with me, and speaks her scripture to that end. I believe it is all she knows.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I AM WAR AND YOU ARE VENGEANCE. THOSE THAT FALL TO YOUR SWORD DESERVE THEIR FINAL DEATH.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Be silent! Your brood falls at each engagement! We will exterminate them, and you.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: MY WORM FEASTS ON THIS FINE FLESH. MAY YOUR WORM FEAST UPON YOUR VENGEANCE.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: CHILDREN OF THE SKY. YOUR FALSE PEACE AND FALSE SMILE WILL BREAK BENEATH MY SWORD. WITH EACH DEATH, I TEST MY TRUTH AGAINST YOU. WE ARE PAIRED TO OUR TRUE SHAPES.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Your logic will fail you, Xivu Arath, and the Deep will not save you.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: WITH OUR WAR, YOU CUT THE ROT AND PROVE MY LOGIC TRUE.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: HARBINGER. AUGUR. I SEE THE BEAUTY OF YOUR MORPH. WITH OUR LOGIC, YOU WILL STAND BESIDE ME AS MY SISTER.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I am not one of you!

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: TAKE YOUR PLACE AMONGST OUR KIND. I AWAIT YOUR GLORY. AIAT. AIAT.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Xivu Arath could squish us like bugs. What's her plan? Why is she hiding behind her troops?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I have considered this. In my transformation, I promised vengeance against the Hive... And we are her brother’s killers.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: You’re suggesting that if Xivu Arath attacked directly, she would empower you?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The sword logic precludes revenge. Perhaps she is afraid she will take it.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: I AM XIVU ARATH. YOUNGEST SISTER OF A DEAD KING. THE TRAVELER LIES TO YOU AS IT LIES TO MY SISTER’S TAINTED BROOD.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I am Eris Morn, Crota's Bane. I will strike you from the pantheon of gods as I did your siblings.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: WE ERADICATE WEAKNESS. WE MAKE OURSELVES SHARP. YOU FOLLOW DOWN OUR BLADED PATH SO YOU JOIN THE FINAL SHAPE. AIAT. AIAT.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The tithes have finished but we can still take control of the Spire with our magic.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: There's still a lot to learn from Savathûn’s Spire. Hone your magic, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Venture into the Spire. See what secrets may yet be found.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Spire’s machinations lie open to us. Traverse it, and grasp its magic for our own ends.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: The boss is singing your praises. You did everything she asked, and you did it with style. She liked watching you tear through her Lucent Hive. Very sword logic. I guess old habits die hard. I know we're all cozy, but don't think we'll go easy on you after this. We still gotta “make ourselves sharp”, don't we?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: My Hidden are looking for Xivu Arath, but apart from lingering Wrathborn it seems she's gone to ground.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That was enough for Savathûn. She used us to continue an age-old game between her and her sister.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: And we played into her hands.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Yes. But we have what we need, and Xivu Arath’s position is weakened. That must be enough for us as well.

Savathûn: I built this Spire piece by piece with my will. Everything here serves one purpose: mastery of our Light. You Guardians have tested the Light's boundaries for as long as you've had it. I thought I'd do the same. After so many years finding the limits of Hive magic, it was lovely to stretch my wings.

Savathûn: These Hive crystals contain powerful Light. Do you know where that comes from? I think you do. You've ripped it out of enough of your cousins to know that by now. My Brood did the same on Titan. You've become so good at it. I enjoy watching you work.
Savathûn: Eris Morn. Such a resourceful woman. You know, I'm proud of her. She did exactly as I asked. And now, we know.
Savathûn: That the Hellmouth was the best thing that ever happened to her.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You’ve become quite a little spellcaster. Eris and Savathûn taught you so much. Mastering the Spire, fighting like hell in our Oubliette, taking Xivu down a peg. You really did your mommies proud.
Savathûn: Our runes hold power. You're writing yourself a little spell with each path you take. I hope you’re paying attention. Though even when you stumble, you're giving me some delicious tribute.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Pat yourselves on the back. Savathûn saw all this coming and laid out her plan on a platter for you. All you did was follow it.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Savathûn gambles in possibilities, not certainties. Predictions are only as accurate as hindsight makes them. We could have failed. What Savathûn did was an act of faith.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: To lose the tithes… [sighs] I was a god, Ikora. I no longer understand myself as I once did. There was something lost, but also dearly gained. But mostly… I am tired. Perhaps I will rest.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That sounds perfect. I think I'll join you.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Savathûn took these guys apart and put them back together. She knows exactly how they work. They’re a little Ahamkara trick. Wishing someone back alive doesn't mean they'll come back the same. I heard Eris knows all about wishing. Too bad you put Riven in the ground. Sounds like you could use a wish or two.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: So, what's that washed-up worm doing now?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: If you mean Ahsa, she went back into hibernation. Sloane is monitoring her. There's been no sign of any lingering effects since her pact with Eris concluded… Why? I know you're not concerned for her.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Gotta keep tabs on her. Queen's orders.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: You don't know why, do you?

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: It's need to know! Whatever Savathûn’s planning for Ahsa, it's better than what Xivu wants to do to her. Let’s leave it at that.

Savathûn: So, Eris Morn became the Hive God of Vengeance. We all saw that coming. But oh, how she revelled in it. She's always been so buttoned-up. Formal. Aloof. It must have been good to see her finally cut loose. When you peeked under that bandage, what did you see? I think it was her truth. I love that for her.
Savathûn: That was quite the masterstroke, Eris. I'm impressed. You have the unique honor of murdering me. A long time ago, my siblings and I would have welcomed you into our little family.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your resurrection was out of necessity. I slit your throat and took my revenge. I will not be taunted by you now.
Savathûn: Oh you took more than your revenge, honey — and I can't wait to see what you do next.
Savathûn: You did very well in my absence, Immaru.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Yeah? Then why'd you leave me with that wannabe Hive? She said she'd lock me away if I “tested the limits of her hospitality.” Then she called me a lout. I said she was a drummed-up dimwit. And she hit me with a book.
Savathûn: Be kind to your host, and keep up appearances with my Lucent Hive. You're a token of good faith. We don't want to give them a reason not to trust us, do we?

Savathûn: My sister feels her worm's hunger, gnawing away at her for running from us. She has to keep testing her strength if she doesn't want to be eaten alive… and she has no one left to love. Now you see: I needed my worm exorcised so I could tell you the truth. And didn't I uphold our bargain? I knew you could do it. You've done so many impossible things… O murderer mine.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris, I've sent a message to the Techeuns as you requested.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Thank you, Ikora. Queen Mara will know the way forward. A long time ago, she listened when I warned of Oryx's imminent threat. With this, she constructed a throne world of her own. It saved her life. May she arm herself with our knowledge once again.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Xivu isn't dead, you know. You didn't win.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oryx and Savathûn couldn't truly kill their sister. It was a game to them. It was love. If they died, they would simply return to their thrones.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: And they did that over and over again to make themselves stronger. We cut Xivu Arath’s safety net.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: So, you took her toys away. Now what?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: We deal with the Witness. Then, we deal with her.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: You didn't kill Xivu Arath, so what makes her less dangerous now?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I severed her connection to her throne world. They allow their creators a method of resurrection, but they have limits. Oryx brought his throne world into his Dreadnaught’s embrace. That vanity was his undoing. The Guardians breached it, and destroyed him. So, too, did his sister perish when she welcomed us into her throne world. The Guardians found Savathûn there and ended her life. But Xivu Arath’s undoing will be for lack of a throne. And when that happens, I will smile.

lines.speaker: Immaru
lines.text: Here's what I don't get: all the power of the Hive in your claws, and you gave it up.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No. I used it to protect humanity, and in doing so, I disproved the premise of the sword logic.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: She knew that killing Savathûn would be an act of vengeance, and that it would empower herself enough so that she wouldn’t need to fight at all.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We withstood the violence of the Hive and the primacy of their hunger. I proved our right to exist, and it broke their blade apart. I heard Xivu Arath’s screams. It was not just pain… It was heartbreak.

Savathûn: You know, my sister's violence comes from a place of love. Even when we were young and playing Swords and Lanterns, she wanted to cut apart the universe so that she could survive it. So she cuts you apart until there's nothing left but what can withstand her. She wanted that for me… and she wanted the same for Eris, to stand with her at the final shape. That’s how Xivu Arath shows her love.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Eris, you said the Worm Gods derived their power the same way as the Ahamkara.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That is Queen Mara's prevailing theory. They are thaumaturge to the space between the actual and possible. That power transformed the Hive from a prey species into some of the strongest beings in the universe... and it saved me in the Hellmouth.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: But the Ahamkara never give you what you want.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: They do... but our wants are tangled and contradictory. Such is the nature of the Ahamkara. Such is the nature of desire.

title: Scourge of the Past Introduction — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian heads towards the Last City.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Siviks was after much more than simply stealing and abusing our forge. His gaze has turned to our most prized possession: a vault, filled with the finest wares the Black Armory has to offer. Our very soul resides in that vault. It must be secured.

title: Salvation, Beckoned (Nexus) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Ziggurat after speaking with the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I understand why you're going alone with the Stranger's plan, but… well, she's clearly not telling us everything.
The Guardian attunes their first Splinter of Darkness to the Ziggurat's glyph.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The longer we're here, the more nervous I get. Not that I think you can't handle it. I know you can. I just wish we had a better idea of what that might be. We're definitely in uncharted territory out here.
As the Guardian travels to the Nexus, Eramis is broadcasting a transmission.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up a Fallen transmission. It's… Eramis!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Attention all pawns of the once "Great Machine": Did you know that before it doomed your kind, it did the same to mine? You are not special. Just the plaything of a so-called god who would sooner see your life ended than its own.

The Guardian approaches a Crux of Darkness and communes with it. The Darkness beckons… and the Guardian becomes temporarily empowered with Stasis. The Vex begin to transmat into the area. The Guardian defeats waves of Vex with Stasis. The Guardian returns to the Crux of Darkness and ends their communion.
Ghost guides the Guardian to a nearby House Salvation cache. The Guardian uses Stasis to unseal the glyph and disable the Fallen barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, we can use Stasis to unlock these latches after all. Let's look inside; see if we can find something useful.
The Guardian uses Stasis to unseal the glyph and unlock the Fallen cache. The Guardian received aged armor.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Scavenging the 'Drome — Transcript

lines.text: According to Zavala, Eramis has left Europa to reconnect with the House of Devils on Earth. Zavala sends the Guardian to Shaw Han, a Guardian patrolling the Cosmodrome, for more details on this new intel.

According to Shaw Han, Eramis's sergeant Bakris is still in the Cosmodrome to ensure recruitment to the army of House Salvation. Shaw reports evidence of Stasis recently found in The Divide, not far from an old Devils hideout.
The Guardian collects House Salvation Intel from the House Devils soldiers and searches for Bakris, the Adamantine.
The Guardian follows the intel to Bakris's hideout.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks, we've figured out what Eramis was doing in the Cosmodrome. It's the House of Devils — or what's left of them. She called for reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Of course. [insect-like chattering] The Devils will follow Eramis's every command. And there are many left yet.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We've tracked them to an old factory.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [wheezes] Do not allow them to reach Europa. [insect-like chattering]

The Guardian approaches the center of the factory and witnesses a Crux of Darkness. The Darkness beckons and empowers the Guardian with Stasis. Deksis-5, Taskmaster appears. The Guardian defeats Deksis-5.
Bakris, the Adamantine appears. Bakris uses Stasis against the Guardian. The Guardian defeats Bakris and receives Bakris's Missive from Eramis.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks, Eramis was planning on flooding Europa with Spider Tanks. We've dealt with the ones in charge.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [wheezes] Yes, our comms buzz with chatter. Word of your success has already reached Europa. Eramis is most unpleased. [chattering] She intends to react with another set of reinforcements: the Vex.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Europa holds yet another dark secret — a portal, built by Clovis Bray, leading directly to the Vex. Eramis intends to activate it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then she needs to be stopped. We're on our way.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
