title: Scourge of Winter — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those Fallen we faced in the Archive belong to the House of Winter. Their Kell, Draksis, has been hunted by Guardians for years. If these reports are correct, he's commanding them from a network of caves up in the Cinders. If we want to keep the Academy's secrets safe we should push into their lair and take him out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's got to be the way into their lair.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There could be thousands of Fallen in here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A Ketch! It must belong to the House of Winter. I've never seen one on the surface, the Kell's gotta be inside.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Somewhere on this thing there's a throne room. That's where we'll find Draksis.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Draksis was one of the worst plagues this system has ever seen. Without their Kell, Houses usually turn against each other. We may finally have broken their hold on the Academy.

title: Scorned — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Now we are friends. And I take friendship seriously. [chuckle] Very seriously. Oh, now don't look at me like that. I would never ask you to do something that wasn't in your own interest, too. Remember that. So. To Business. I will supply you with the Barons' location - with which I am quite familiar, as it was, until recently… MINE.
The Guardian speaks to Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Spider gave us a chance to kill them all. One fell swoop. And if Uldren's there too… even better. The traitor prince will not survive us.
The Guardian heads towards the Barons' hideout.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Petra is out for blood. But we're here for justice. Aren't we? Anyway, let's hope Spider's tip about Uldren and the Barons' location is solid.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: This territory was once mine. In the "relocation," I was forced to leave some valuables behind. A proposition, friend… Retrieve my caches, and I will make it worth your while.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn and recovers two of the Spider's caches.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Aah, marvelous. Accept my thanks in the form of my belligerent associates.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn with the help of the Spider's Associates and recovers two more caches.
Elkyris, the Machinist appears. The Guardian fights against the Machinist. The Machinist transmats away. The Guardian continues towards the Barons' hideout.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn and recovers another one of Spider's caches.
A door opens. The Guardian heads through the door. Pirrha, the Rifleman appears.

lines.speaker: The Rifleman
lines.text: Go on… take out your Ghost… I need the target practice.

lines.speaker: The Rifleman
lines.text: Every shot I take adds another soldier to the Scorn army.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn with the help of Spider's Associates. One of Spider's Associates is killed during the fighting.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Spider… we lost one of your guys.

lines.speaker: Spider
lines.text: The cost of doing business, my friend. Do not let it trouble you.
The Guardian finds another one of the Spider's caches in front of a locked door. The cache is transmatted. Two more of the Spider's Associates appear as the door opens.
The Guardian enters a large room with a Scorn Walker blocking a door. The Guardian defeats the Scorn Walker and the Scorn in the area. The Guardian continues towards the Barons' hideout.
The Hallowed Lair, The Tangled Shore
The Guardian enters a large room with a cache near a door.
The Guardian approaches the cache and attempts to recover it. The cache disappears and a Scorn tether trap appears in its place. A large number of Scorn appear.
The Guardian defeats the Scorn and continues further into the Barons' hideout. Reksis Vahn, the Hangman appears. The Guardian fights against the Hangman. The Hangman disappears.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: You fight… You kill… it pleases me. Pleases King Uldren. You think you will defeat my Scorn, my siblings, AND my father all at once? You think you will succeed where Cayde-6 failed? Kill a Fallen, I claim it as Scorn. Kill a Scorn, I raise ten more!
The Guardian continues further into the Barons' hideout, destroying Scorn fire traps along the way and defeating the Scorn which they encounter.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: I do not need Barons to slaughter you. My Scorn will be enough to end you.
The Guardian enters a large room and finds Fikrul, the Fanatic.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: Rise, my Scorn. Give this dead things its final death.
Scorn of the Fanatic appears. The Fanatic transmats into a small room adjacent to the main room, which is blocked by a barrier. The e Guardian defeats the Scorn of the Fanatic.

lines.speaker: The Fanatic
lines.text: I do not fear the dead. I CONTROL death. And YOU… more use to me alive. Go. Pursue your vengeance. I claim your Fallen victims for my Scorn army.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The stronghold is secure… but the Barons escaped. This was our best shot at ending this. And now they've scattered. What are we going to do now?
The back of a playing card with the Spider's symbol on it is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: [laughs] Oh, you really showed them, didn't you? Piece of advice, eh? Know your enemy before you… deal with them.
A card with a picture of Reksis Vahn, the Hangman, is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Reksis Vahn - the Hangman. A silent sadist. Used to dock the arms of Dregs with his bare hands.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Kaniks, the Mad Bomber is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Kaniks - the Mad Bomber. Emphasis on "mad." Demolitions expert with an irritating way about him.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Araskes, the Trickster is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: The Trickster - Araskes. A liar and a schemer. Friendly advice: trust nothing she touches.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Hiraks, the Mindbender is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Hiraks - The Mindbender. Has a rep for manipulation. Has a morbid obsession with the Hive.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Yaviks, the Rider is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Yaviks, a.k.a. the Rider. The leader of a bombastic gang of Pike-riding heathens. They sow chaos everywhere they ride.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Pirrha, the Rifleman is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: The Rifleman - Pirrha. The only Fallen alive who could make the shot that mortalized… Cayde-6.
The card falls and another card with a picture of Elykris, the Machinist is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Elykris - the Machinist. The scourge of Solis Descent. This one sits atop a trove of tech and heavy armaments stolen from me!
The card falls and another card with a picture of Fikrul, the Fanatic is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: The Fanatic himself - Fikrul. The leader of the Barons and the first of the Scorn. His dark magic has no place on my Shore. No place!
The card falls and another card with a picture of Uldren Sov is shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Last and most certainly least… Uldren Sov. Traitor to his people and the man who pulled the trigger. He may be in the wind, but his Barons are ripe for the picking.
The card of Uldren Sov falls and lands in a circle made up of the other Baron's cards. The cards of the Barons move away from the card of Uldren Sov until it is the only remaining card shown.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Divide. Conquer. Isolate Uldren. He'll wind up at your feet. And all you have to do… is pull the trigger.
The Guardian speaks to the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: So - even the great "hero of the Red War" has limits. Eight Barons and an Awoken prince - and only one of you. I so dislike betting on the underdog… But you are resourceful… And you do have the Queenless Queen's Wrath in your corner. Ah, you've talked me into it. Our friendship shall continue. Pursue your vengeance. When the Shore is a bit less crowded, we will speak again of favors.
The Guardian speaks to Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Cayde's killers are still out there, but the hunt is not over. You take down the Barons. Thin the herd. As for Uldren… Did you see that Awoken spire when you landed here? It's called the Watchtower. I shouldn't be telling you this, but… my people's greatest secrets lie beyond that spire. There's no other reason Uldren would come to the Tangled Shore. Sooner or later, he WILL go to the Watchtower. We must stop him BEFORE that happens. Good hunting.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Unsavory Allies, Hunter and the Hunted

title: Season of Arrivals Closing Event — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian receives an alert from the Vanguard and returns to the City. The Guardian traverses the streets of the Last City and investigates the disturbance.
The Guardian arrives and wanders through the plaza.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm picking up… something. It's… like a Ghost. Only bigger. Emanating from the Traveler. There's a resonance in the Light I haven't felt since the day I was born. And when I found you. Ghosts reporting in from across the system — we can't explain it, but… we all sense it. A heartbeat.

The Guardian continues to investigate the City streets and hears the people screaming as they point at the Traveler. The Guardian passes by a Daito store as they traverse the rooftops. The Guardian discovers more Guardians on the rooftops all looking towards the Traveler as its Light shimmers and pulses.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Something is coming. I can feel it…
Eris pauses while the Guardian continues to witness the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is drawing power. Could it be enough to drive the Darkness away from us?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Every fireteam has returned to the City. Even the Hunters. They're with the people, keeping them safe. Well, the last time this happened… the world ended. I'm not worried. I'm not.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is reforming. Healing its wounds. This will not be the end. It will be an escalation.
As the Darkness encroaches Io, Titan, Mercury, and Mars, it begins to extend its reach towards Earth. The Traveler responds with a burst of its Light in all directions. The scene goes dark.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Season of the Chosen Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Lord Saladin
lines.text: The Cabal. War, wanted or not, is all they understand. And so we taught them. Sand Eaters… scattered. Dust Giants… felled. Ice Reapers… buried. Siege Dancers… broken. Until we grew complacent… and Ghaul drove a blade between our ribs. Left us gasping. Before the Vanguard showed them… that the Light cannot be tamed so easily. I should've stepped forward. Stamped the Red Legion into extinction. Instead, I ran the Banner… and watched the City's victories dull our edge once more. It should've ended before they fattened us. Before they exploited us. Before they forced us to lift up a murderer as our savior. Another Cabal Warmonger now leads a fleet on Nessus. No more waiting. We will be there… to put her in the ground.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

lines.speaker: Quest
lines.text: Speak to Saint-14, The Trials of Osiris

title: Season of the Haunted Opening Cinematic  — Transcript

lines.text: Eris provides the Guardian with news that Calus had roused the Lunar Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is the beginning of the end. A dormant herald of the Collapse stirs in its lunar tomb. Where once we banished the Nightmares, a new terror rouses them from their slumber. Calus. The emperor of the Cabal, betrayed by his own daughter and cast into exile... now obsessed with a Voice calling to him from within the Darkness. But we will not cower in fear of Nightmares. We will do as Guardians have always done. We will rise... to meet the enemy. And confront our darkest fears with open eyes.

title: Season of Arrivals Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Hive wanted a return to war on the Moon. They built a lunar fortress to back their assault. A grand stage to announce their revival. You climbed that Scarlet Citadel… and the Hive met you head on. You buried them. But we found more than the Hive on the Moon. The Dark has reached out. We have no choice but to reach back.

Ana Bray and Rasputin watch a hologram of a Pyramid approaching Io. The hologram shows Rasputin attacking the Pyramid. The hologram of the Pyramid briefly disappears, then reappears again. As the hologram of the Pyramid descends upon Io, Rasputin is neutralized and the Mindlab goes dark.

title: Season of Plunder Closing Cinematic — Transcript

lines.text: After the Guardian community rallies to help rebuild the Eliksni Quarter, Saint-14 provides an update on Mithrax's efforts studying the reliquary.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: And in the Last City, as Misraaks would say, "the Light provides." The Guardians gave their treasures to those in need. Our people were being cared for, and Misraaks could take time to study... the secrets of the reliquaries. He said they were connected by threads he alone could perceive, and that they whispered to him. He performed... a conversion. He claimed from them a mass of primal Darkness. He distilled it, transformed its terrifying energy... into a... more agreeable state. And Osiris, my phoenix, who broke time itself to bring me to his side... awoke. As he recovered, Osiris would tell us how the energy opened his mind, let him remember Savathûn's thoughts and fears as if they were his own. He would tell us of a power she knew of, a secret hidden away on Neptune. Yes, he would explain all of this. But when he first opened his eyes, his words were only... "Saint, my love." That was all. And that was enough.

title: Season of the Hunt Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Darkness. Our ancient enemy. Foretold by many, they came… as the Warmind warned us they would. They were confronted with fire. And when that failed, met with intrigue among the bones of Io's last monument to the Light. It promised us power. And for it, a price was paid. A lull holds the system. Though it is not emptiness that gives us pause. Yet not all is lost. Stand, Guardian. Brandish your Light… and join the hunt!

title: Season of the Lost Opening Cinematic  — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I am Mara Sov, Queen of the Reef. I once made a great sacrifice to protect humanity from the Hive. I lost everything. My fleet. My brother. My people's very way of life. I watched the Dreaming City fall into ruin. Desecrated by Oryx. Cursed by Savathûn. Now I've returned to retake this sacred place ...to finally wrest it free from the Hive's claws. Although you have taken things near and dear to me, as well. You have also learned that your list of enemies... need not be so broadly defined. Today, we are afforded a unique opportunity. The road ahead of us is fraught with perilous choices, Guardian. Choose wisely.
The Drowning Labyrinth | Enter the Pyramid

title: Season of Plunder Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.text: Eramis begins to break free from her encasement in Stasis crystals.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I was not there when my House fell to ruin. Defectors joined the cowardkel Misraaks — and his worthless House of Light — and fled to the Last City. They devoted themselves to their oppressors: the Guardians and their "Great Machine." There is no greater shame. I tried to claim Stasis for my people... But I was judged. Bound. Abandoned by the same power I sought to command. Some chains cannot be broken. Or so they would have you believe.
Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic

title: Season of the Seraph Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Rasputin, the Warmind. The most powerful artificial intelligence humanity ever created... with an arsenal to match. Thousands of Warsats, primed to obliterate any and all threats to humanity. But when the greatest threat of all arrived, it nearly tore Rasputin apart. I saved the pieces of him that I could... encrypted them in a specialized engram. I've been trying to restore him in an experimental Exo frame. But every attempt I've made has failed. Until he's back online, all of his weaponry is up for grabs. And it's only a matter of time before his Warsats fall into the wrong hands.

title: Semaphore Signals II: Eido and Spider — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a conversation on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Baron Spider, I greet you in the Light.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Baron? [chuckles] I haven't heard that in some time. What is it you want, Scribe Eido?

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I have heard that you have a great interest in Human cultures, and as such, have acquired many curiosities.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Yes. I had quite the collection before my… unfortunate relocation. But this isn't why you hailed me; get to the point.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: You and my father came from the House of Wolves, once known as the House of Gentle Weavers. I have very little record of that time. A firsthand account would be invaluable.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: [grunts] The Kell wouldn't like my speaking to you.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Misraakskel would understand. This is important to the history of House Light, of which you are a part.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: You don't know what your father is capable of, little Scribe.
Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic

title: Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: This morning, for the first time in humanity's long and storied history, the sun did not rise. Osiris tells me it's a Vex simulation… that has plunged the City into an endless night. It seems they've found a way to harness our energy against us. And even in all his wisdom, Osiris can offer no solution. I don't know what will happen if we can't break the Vex's hold over the City. I do know that we must protect our people, no matter the cost. The Vex are machines… and no one understand machines better than the Eliksni. Osiris and I could only think of one we might turn to… Mithrax, Kell of House Light. My spies report he claims to be among the last Sacred Splicers… those with the power to commune with machines. He may be our best and only hope. Find him, Guardian, before the Vex do.

title: Season of the Worthy Opening Cinematic — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Two years ago… the Warmind Rasputin helped humanity defeat the Hive on the Martian frontier. On that day it swore to protect us. Now… it may be the only thing that can. The Red Legion has one last play. They have boarded their superweapon, the Almighty. And it's on the move. You already destroyed its starkilling munitions. But whatever the Legion hopes to achieve… won't end well for us. They once took the Tower. They will take nothing else. We'll see to that.
The Almighty is shown drifting away from the Sun. Zavala is then shown aboard the Almighty, fighting against several Cabal.
Another part of the Almighty with several Psions is shown. Ana Bray appears from the shadows and unsheathes one of her knives from her boot.

Ana sprints towards the Psions and performs a somersault. She dodges Psion's rifle projectile, stabs another Psion in the head, and sweeps the Psion that shot at her, knocking it to the ground. The third Psion aims for Ana's head: she ducks and slides to avoid being shot and takes down another Psion. Ana knocks the last Psion's weapon down, performs a back-handspring manuever, and throws her knife into the last Psion's head. Ana reclaims her knife.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Copy Commander. I've located the central manifold. It seems the Cabal have… disabled the ship's mav thrusters.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: They've killed the steering on this thing?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Checking. That explosion came from the propulsion deck. The Cabal have taken out the primary engine. Have you made it to the bridge yet?

Zavala summons Arc energy to his fist. A Psion is shown destroying the bridge controls and monitors. The Psion suddenly turns towards the door and aims at it, waiting for the door to open. The door opens and the Psion shoots, but Zavala blocks the shot with the armor on his left shoulder. Zavala shoots the Psion, killing it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Hmm… Now I'm on the bridge. They've destroyed the ship's navigation system. We're a dead stick.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: None of this makes any sense. No nav, no engine, no way to steer or change course. It's like they want this thing to drift off into space forever.
Zavala discovers a projection of Earth, the Moon, and the Traveler.

title: Semaphore Signals I: Message from Eramis — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a message on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Misraakskel of House Light. This is Eramiskel of House Salvation. We need not be enemies, but you intend to make one of me. Very well. I have been restored by a power too great to oppose… More powerful than the traitor Machine that abandoned us, and the Machine-spawn who did not hesitate to kill me. But we both know humiliation, don't we? You live in the shadow of those who have destroyed the dream of a unified Eliksni. They have our people's blood on their hands, and you scrape at their feet. It is shameful. YOU are shameful. Where is the Misraaks of legend, feared by so many? Is he trying to outrun his past? We know this is impossible. I am told you have a daughter. Does she know who you are? What are you teaching her, and what lies will she repeat? What won't you tell her when you look into her eyes? You think I am without remorse, but I do not wish to harm my fellow Eliksni. But if you want a fight, then I will give you one. Rally your crew. Take what you believe is yours by right of plunder. I don't expect any better from you.
Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic

title: Semaphore Signals IV: Saint-14 and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a conversation on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Misraaks, my friend. I hear you clash swords with pirates now, and fight alongside… strange crew.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The Saint has heard correctly. I wish it had not come to this. I do not enjoy it. To see Eliksni fight and die for scraps of power… These bring to mind old memories. A past I wish to forget. It is a shameful one.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: I am not one to speak of shame. I carry my own. That you forgave me for what I did to your people speaks to your strength. I can only do the same for you.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Your grace is appreciated. House Light and its Kell thanks you. But how… is Osiris?

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: He sleeps. I wait for him.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: He will wake. I know stories of the phoenix. Osiris will rise from this as well.

lines.speaker: Saint-14
lines.text: Your words mean much to me, my friend.
Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic

title: Semaphore Signals V: Eido and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a conversation on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I did not have to hear it from her. That was your choice.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: That was not a story Eramis had any right to tell.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Did you believe that I would never find out? That no one would remember? I'm charged with preserving the history of our people!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Some history does not need to be preserved.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Like the Whirlwind? So much was lost; so much we will never recover, no matter how much we search… no matter how much we remember. Is that what you wish to happen to us now?

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: I want to understand! You will not let me!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You do not know what I know! You did not see what I saw! When I pulled you from the wreckage of a Ketch, I knew that you deserved more than the world that orphaned you. I want you to look forward! Not to what the Whirlwind made us. You do not need to carry this history.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: It is a part of me, whether I witnessed it or not. I don't want to look away, and I don't want to forget.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You do not know what you ask.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Perhaps not. But nothing good comes from refusing to face the truth.

title: Semaphore Signals VI: Eido — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a message on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Eramiskel. I greet you in the Light. I wish that you could greet me in the same. You told my father that we need not be enemies. This is still true. But we will always be your enemy if you serve the Witness. I do not know what it has promised you. An Eliksni reborn? A Riis restored? Did it promise us a future? But I ask: Do you strive for our future? Or do you flee the Whirlwind? The Lucent Hive and the Witness both pose a great threat to the Eliksni. But there is no greater threat to us than when we fight against each other. This division will destroy us completely. You remember the Whirlwind. I do not. But I believe that the greatest treasure we lost was unity. I called for our parley because you believe this too. You will say that House Salvation will bring unity through the destruction of our enemies. But that path does not end, Eramiskel. You will never find what you are seeking. You will never undo the legacy of the Whirlwind.

title: Semaphore Signals VII: Eido and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a conversation on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Eido of the House of Light, Scribe log Zeta-7-8D. At this point in the Guardian's adventures, we have had contact with a great many pirates. Each crew has a unique composition, and pledges loyalty to the most powerful among their numbers. They fight for whomever promises them the most power, or the most Glimmer. They adopt whatever code of honor befits them and concern themselves with little beyond the present. A friend told me that these pirates are not as free as they seem. That their lives are fueled by desperation more than their own desires. But there is still the call of the open stars. These pirates sought to possess the relics of Nezarec. What else might they hold?

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Eramiskel? I— I greet you in the Light.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: You are young, and honor the old ways… so I will speak gently. You say there are paths that never end. But these are also paths you cannot turn away from. Misraaks thinks he can. He is wrong. He and I will always be what we are. But we are not something you would wish to become. I remember the Whirlwind, and we are running from it. We are running from that pain, and will be forever. You do not want this life.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Do not stand in my way. If we meet again, I will be the last thing you see… you and that hypocrite you call a father.

title: Seraph Wings — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: The Almighty has been reduced to smouldering ash, thanks to you… and Rasputin. Our success serves as a reminder that we're in this fight together. Allegiances have never been more important. Together, we'll overcome whatever enemy we face. And with allies like Rasputin, who can stop us?

title: Sever — Grief: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Zavala.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This construct is coated in the same spores found aboard the Glykon. Ikora says they could connect consciousnesses through the Darkness.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Isn't it magnificent? The Leviathan was once my prison, but now, we are one body. Its systems, my mind.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Is that so? Mechanical function is compromised, Guardian. It's harmless. Don't let him stall you.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: [chuckles] I wouldn't dream of it. It is a unique delight to feel the Leviathan's inhabitants wriggling through my innards. And when you do battle across my steely flesh? Mmm… an unmatched sensation. Caress every dark reach you can find. In your futile journey, you will come to see things my way. You will lay down your arms and stay. On that night, I'll raise a chalice to your lips, and we will feast.
Season of the Splicer Opening Cinematic

title: Sever — Forgiveness: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Zavala.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: To continue chasing pain when you could slumber in euphoria everlasting… that is a foolish endeavor, Guardian. Think of your commander. He mourns this woman you seek to exploit against me? Bring him to me instead. I will shower him with my blessings, give him the power to see his love returned. He may keep her as long as he wishes. For I am benevolent. And that is only a taste of my generosity, a taste that extends to you as well. Eternity is what I offer. Consideration is all I ask.
Season of the Haunted Opening Cinematic

title: Sever — Rage: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Caiatl.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Oh… thank you for this gift, Guardian. We truly are friends, aren't we? Caiatl has hunted me for so long; now, to feel her rage burn through the Underbelly, driven by Ghaul's brutalism, it is… intoxicating. Like the aroma of drippings hitting a crackling fire. An inescapable, primal draw. That is vengeance. Beneath me, as I ascend to peace… but still enjoyable to look down on. [chuckles] Your mission hangs in the balance. Caiatl is getting away from you. Fly. I wish to watch the chase.

title: Sever — Reconciliation: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Crow.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: You. You attempt to halt a cosmic performance that is beyond you, a beauty forged outside of your understanding. You struggle, as I did: a grub fattened on the lies of reality, writhing within a suffocating existence. But the silken walls of that cocoon are not a grave, little grub. They are petals, waiting to bloom. Soon, you will emerge to see the magnanimous arc of eternity unfurl before you, its story laid bare. You will understand what I understand. Our end is set. All that remains is the drama of our strife. The struggle to push open our walls. So, resist if you must. It is in your nature to defy, even against your own best interests. It will only hasten your revelation.

title: Sever — Resolve: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Caiatl.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: Brilliant! BRILLIANT! I have warned you, I have offered gold and power and so much more. And still, you deny me. Good. Every bond you sever, every piece of my fleshy hull you storm, paints a worthier tale, crowned by the triumph of my expansion. In truth, this is what I always desired, my good friend: a display of my… enormity, immortalized by those who resist it. Individuals are defined by what we are not, after all. Unfortunately, this duality we are partners in… is short-lived. Soon, I will grow beyond such small ideas as conflict. Until then, I will savor our time together.

title: Sever — Shame: Calus's Automaton — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian finds one of Calus's Automatons while helping Crow.

lines.speaker: Calus
lines.text: An uninvited guest slithers through the bowels of my Leviathan? This mechanical appendage is maintained poorly, unable to see the grandeur of your brave face. Come, now. Closer. Let me bask in you.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Another trap? I'd keep your distance. Our mission takes precedence.

lines.speaker: Calus

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Oh yes! By locating the original Vex Teleporter the Cayde Unit used, you can shut down the loop and free him. I can guide you there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK. So we find this Vex teleporter and shut it down. Easy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ew. This looks like the stuff inside the Vex.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: It's called Radiolaria. You know, mind fluid!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora says it's an organic compound, which means the Vex are not pure robot.
The Guardian destroy a group of Harpies

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What could have possibly brought Cayde to Nessus?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: One: stop listening in on us. Two: ... what's the answer?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: He asked me not to tell anyone!
The Guardian continues navigating through the Pools of Luminance

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Warning! Vex threat detected! They are blocking your path to the Cayde Unit's teleporter. You will have to eliminate them.
The Guardian destroys all the Vex

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I thought your wholesale destruction of the Vex would make me miss my captain and crew less.
The Guardian emerges into a circular room with two statues and machinery in the middle

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Yes! The Cayde-6 will want it. You should pick it up!
The Guardian deactivates and picks up the device

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Take that you scrap heap! I'm out, baby! Out! Woo!

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey! You did it! You got me out! Ha! Hahha… And… wh-where- where am I?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Cayde Unit, you are near the remains of my reactor core. Welcome to the Exodus Black. Where all your dreams come true.
The Guardian starts to head back to the surface of Nessus to meet up with Cayde-6

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Seems like you met my new friends, Failsafe and her evil twin, Failsafe.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: If I had feelings, they would be hurt!

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh oh. The Fallen's got the Vex in a tizzy, and by tizzy I mean murderous rampage. I'll hunker down in the Exodus Black.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Here? But my hull is in 108 pieces. Decks 1 through 20 are buried. And my coolant system… Ugh… I am a mess.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Oh, we know, Failsafe. We know.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: It's me! It's- It's "the Cayde Unit"?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: False. I mean, true. But you are attracting large numbers of Fallen to my position.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Dagnabbit! Failsafe, they're shootin' at me!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Then I advise you not get shot.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I was hoping the Fallen and Vex would finish each other off on Venus.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: But then you'd miss all the fun!
The Guardian spots Acanthos, a Gate Lord

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That is a really big Vex
The Guardian fights their way toward the Exodus Black

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guys, we're blocked! The Vex put up a barrier!

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I know how to disable that barrier! The bix Vex. Smash it.
The Guardian destroys Acanthos, Gate Lord

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Gate Lord's down. Hold on, Cayde, we're on our way.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh, thats good to hear, 'cause the Fallen just found us.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Activating defence shield. The Cayde-6 must stand back.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey, nice one, Failsafe!. The Fallen can't get to us now! That's- that's right though, they- they can't, right? … get to us?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey, you probably wanna hustle. I think they just said something about ripping my beautiful horn off my face? My beautiful, beautiful horn. Then again, my Eliksni is pretty rusty.
Jaliks, Fallen Captain brings in reinforcements, but the Guardian kills Jaliks
The Guardian picks up Jaliks' scorch cannon, and fights off the rest of the Fallen

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: You have saved us! Updating my crew log. New captain registered. Welcome aboard, Captain!
The Guardian walks in. Cayde's ghost peaks out from behind cover.
Cayde stands up, surveying the Guardian waving the Vex teleporter

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: So it's true. The Light found its way back to you. Not that I'm jealous or nothin', but take it easy out there, will ya? You're making me look bad.
The Guardian passes Cayde-6 the Vex teleporter

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What, may we ask, were you going to do with a Vex teleporter?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Get up close and personal with Ghaul. Put a bullet in his head. The maybe eat a sandwich. Gotta work out a few kinks first. Fun fact about Vex tech: not as intuitive as you would think.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Cayde, you can't do this alone.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: [sigh] Even if you manage to kill Ghaul, when the Red Legion leave a system — defeat or victory — they leave nothing behind.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: The Cabal are bad guys who do bad things. Yes. I get it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I do not think you do. The Cabal *literally* leave nothing behind. They have a weapon that can destroy a star! And it is pointed directly at our sun.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey! Easy, easy, you're gonna blow a bulb.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala has a plan. He needs you, Cayde.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yes, well Zavala always says he has a plan, but sometimes he just — Wait… Zavala said he needs me? As in you heard those exact words coming out of Zavala's mouth?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Please tell me you recorded it!
Ghost and Guardian exchange a blank look

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Well, did Ikora at least hear it?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Actually, Zavala lost her after the City fell. We don't know where she is.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Io. Io, it's where she'd go to look for answers. Hey, um… Thanks. I owe ya one.

title: Solstice of Heroes: Reflect on the Past — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Do you remember this day, my friend? It was to be a commemoration of our past victories. A celebration of us Guardians. But while you were thousands of miles away… the Red Legion struck. They took everything from us. Our Light… our friends… our home. The memory is never far from my mind.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: But even inside our memories, we must always be ready for what is next - and so, the time has come again for you to journey into your past. What challenges you there will be different from what you remember. Rise to this new challenge, and even greater glory will be yours.

title: More Than a Weapon V: Speak to Rasputin — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the Exo Frame to receive an update from Rasputin.

lines.speaker: Rasputin
lines.text: Welcome, Guardian. I have completed my assessment of my current functional capabilities. Despite my newfound ability to communicate with you, key elements of my code remain incomplete. I would be unable to take command of the Warsats even if I were uploaded to the network. No submind cores remain for reintegration. Our only option is to continue collating ancillary submind data for my reconstruction algorithm. In summary, we must stay the course. Breach the vaults. Retrieve and reintegrate the submind data. Soon, the Warsats will once again be humanity's to wield.

title: Speak to Eris Morn — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: For me, the Moon's story began with Crota. For the Traveler, it began with a far more ancient evil. It is that evil that will thread its way through all of us, friend and foe alike, binding us together in a tapestry of ruin. The Undying Mind may be dead, but the threats around us only grow stronger. Transcend yourself, Guardian. The battle on the horizon will take more than power or cunning to overcome.

Saint-14's Return - Speak to Ikora Rey

title: Splintered — Transcript

lines.text: After talking to the Exo Stranger, the Guardian approaches the Ziggurat.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Ziggurat, the Crux, the Splinters… all the Darkness here on Europa… I thought I could stand it, but… I had no idea we'd be here for so long. Or that you would keep getting closer and closer to it.
The Guardian attunes Eramis's Splinter of Darkness to the Ziggurat's glyph. The Guardian is teleported inside the Europan Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I just want you to know… I'm here with you. Through Light or Dark… we're partners. Always.
The Guardian ascends up the stairs and approaches the Veiled Statue and embraces the Darkness within. The Guardian is teleported back to Europa's surface.

title: Spark — Transcript

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You sure you want to do this? That Shard is the reason this place is called a "Dead Zone."

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We have to, Hawthorne. It's a sign.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Yeah a sign that says, "Dead Zone."

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: You know, I've been all over the EDZ. Charming enough. I mean nothing says "come visit" like a dark, haunted forest.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But non-Guardians aren't supposed to leave the City!

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: There's a small gap in the wall. Hard to see, but it's there.

lines.speaker: Hawthorne
lines.text: Here's the thing about City rules – they stop applying once you leave the City.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hawthorne? Hawthorne! Can you hear us?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those Fallen weren't wearing any house colors we've seen before.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is it. Right out of our vision.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we… scared them away.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is why we were led here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I haven't been this close to the Traveler's Light since…
Ghost absorbs the Light and the Guardian regains their power

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Do you feel it? The light is back! We're back!

title: Strange Terrain — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: If we find the place where this God Worm feeds, we can use the Traveler's fragment to draw out Xol.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've been running some scans. There's a cavern that intersects with one of Xol's tunnels.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Zavala, listen to me. I've studied the logs. Rasputin was barely able to stop Xol the first time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Guardians, I'm getting some kind of interference. I can't make sense of it.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Our mission stands. We will defeat Xol, and we don't need the help of a Warmind to do it. Not when we don't know what else it might do.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The interference is getting worse, but I'm starting to pick up a pattern. Do you hear it, Ana?

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I'll need more data to be sure, but yeah. I'm thinking it might be an encoded message.
The Guardian reaches an area with a glowing crystal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Those crystals are surging with energy. They must be using them to gather power to feed Xol.
The Guardian kills the Ugul Gar Knight. A relic appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The energy in this relic is volatile. Try throwing it at the crystal.
The Guardian throws the relic at Hive crystal, opening up the pathway.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It looks like the Hive have been busy down here.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Keep going. According to scans, there's a large chamber where all the tunnels intersect. That makes it the most likely spot for Xol's feeding ground.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look at the size of these tunnels. Xol must be immense.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Meaning Xol is stronger than we thought.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: All the more reason to take it down now.
Guardian kills the Wizard, Simmumah ur-Nokru

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They were chanting in an archaic form, about a priest - Nokris - and how he was labeled a heretic.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: What could possibly qualify as heretical for the Hive?
The Guardian enters a cavern with two glowing crystals.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is some kind of holy space. They're readying another offering for Xol.
The Guardian kills the Ugul Gar Knights, picks up the relics that appear and throws each of them at one of the crystals. The Guardian then kills the Ogre, Kvada ur-Nokru.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The feeding ground is right below us.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I've decoded the interference pattern. Akka, Eir, Yul, Ur… those are names, Guardian. Ancient, powerful names. This is more than we-
The comms are suddenly cut off.
The Guardian enters an area with several kneeling Suluh-teth and Suluh Knights. The Guardian kills the Knights.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There, in the center. That's where we can place the fragment.
Ghost places the fragment in the center. Suddenly, the Guardian is imobilized. Xol, Will of the Thousands, appears.

lines.speaker: Xol
lines.text: There is no Light here. You are alone. You shall drift. You shall drown in the Deep.
The cavern ceiling falls, burying the Guardian.
Ghost searches for the Guardian. The Guardian regains consciousness and struggles out of the debris.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Xol is heading directly for the Clovis Bray facility and Rasputin. If Rasputin dies, the javelin goes with him. Xol wins.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Very well. My reservations about the Warmind aren't as important as defeating Xol. We do this together. What do you say, Guardian?

title: Stop and Go — Transcript

lines.text: The Gulch, European Dead Zone, Earth

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ah, it's you again, excellent! We have a unique opportunity.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: My dear Devrim, you just said the magic words.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Cayde-6, so glad you could join us.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Course you are. Listen, Guardian, we've got a unique opportunity. Tell'em Dev.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ugh. The Red Legion's looking to upgrade the power systems in their base. For a limited time, they've switched to backup generators.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Which means they'll have beefed up the security.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can handle that part. Red Legion troops in the area will have security keys. Get me enough of those and we're in.
Guardian kills Red Legion troops near the mouth of the tunnel, procuring Security Data Fragments.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Got it. That's enough to synthesize a new access code and get us inside.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You can make a key by shooting bad guys? I gotta talk to my Ghost.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Ugh. The Legion's a bit paranoid about Security. That code won't last long.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: The best things never do. Get a move on you two.
Guardian plugs the security code into a nearby console.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Forcefield down, but there are more, a lot more.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: This is getting too complicated. Isn't there anything you can… you know, blow up?
Guardian destroys an explosive next to a forcefield, triggering a 30 second countdown timer, and the barrier to disappear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Uh, we're in trouble! Their defenses are linked to the alarm system. Actually…

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Ooh, smart… I mean, oh no!

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: If they are connected, deactivating the barriers should buy you time before the alarm sounds.
Guardian destroys more explosives, dropping more barriers, and proceeding through the tunnels.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's the last one! And I've got a read on those backup generators ahead.

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Finally, our real target, take them out and the sudden power loss should overload all connected systems.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Ah. I wish I could be there for the explosions. I never get to see the good stuff.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Take that Red Legion, now we have the power.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Uh, not wild about that one. Whaddya think, Dev?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: I think you should stick to the clever turns of phrase. Their actions speak louder than words. Especially yours.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Come on, how did I end up the jerk here?

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: One of life's great mysteries, I suppose.

title: Stranger in a Strange Land (Visit 1) — Transcript

lines.text: After the Ziggurat touches down in Beyond, the Guardian rendezvouses with Eris, Drifter, and the Exo Stranger.
The Guardian speaks with Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I cannot tell you how relieved I am to see you. We are in great need of allies… and I am in even greater need of a buffer between myself and the ever-obnoxious Drifter. The Stranger, you see, is far too reserved to provide sufficient rest from his chatter. I suspect her quiet has more to do with what she has to hide. Though I've yet to work our what or why… still even these two are an improvement from my solitary studies on Luna. You're lucky to have your Ghost, Guardian. As you can surely tell already, this journey into Darkness is not to be traveled alone.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Your old pal Drifter was right. It's time to ditch the "Light good, Dark bad" dogma. And folks are finally starting to see it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: With everything that's at stake — you are reveling in being right?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Just… let me have this one, Three Eyes. All right? Just once.
The Guardian approaches the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: I know. I owe you an explanation for all this. I once asked Guardians to destroy the Black Heart. To prevent Darkness's arrival. Success may have been achieved, but I now know that fate comes knocking sooner or later. The floodgates are open. The Darkness is here. I wield it now with intent to stop our enemies where the Light cannot. Your resilience within the Pyramid proves you're capable of wielding it too. Before us lies what we call a "Ziggurat." Its purpose is temptation. To begin your training, you must give in. Here, take this. Please understand. The line between Light and Dark is so very thin. Let's cross it together.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Stranger in a Strange Land (Visit 2) — Transcript

lines.text: After defeating Phylaks, the Warrior, the Guardian returns to the campsite in Beyond.
The Guardian speaks with Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Understand, Guardian. This power we wield is not a gift from a benevolent overseer. It is a tool, stolen from an enemy. One that is all too tempting to abuse. I know this well. Before the Stranger came to offer her guidance, I despaired of my entanglement with the Darkness. I shudder to think how easily I could've slipped down the path to destruction. How anyone could. A balanced mind is the best defense, Guardian. Do not let fear or anger tip the scales.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Once word get outs about Stasis, the Vanguard'll be bleeding schmucks. Can't show a Lightbearer a new toy and then tell 'em not to play with it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You underestimate Zavala and Ikora. When they can see what we've seen, they will do what's right.
The Guardian approaches the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: Eramis's presence on Europa is not happenstance. Temptation set the wheels in motion, but obsession propelled her here. To destroy the Light with an army of Darkness — she and her followers make those selfish choices moment to moment. The Darkness places a spotlight on our desires as it once did me and those I cared about. For a time, I had forgotten… Humanity relies on our selfless acts to bring about a better world. Darkness is no more than a tool with which we do so. With Splinters of Darkness still in hand, Eramis remains an immediate danger to humanity. Look within. Focus your power. Let it grow: The Ziggurat awaits.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Stranger in a Strange Land (Visit 4) — Transcript

lines.text: After defeating Eramis, Kell of Darkness, the Guardian returns to the campsite in Beyond.
The Guardian speaks to Eris Morn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You're far from true mastery, but your progress with Stasis marks a step forward for our cause. Hopefully, your example will encourage others to explore this path. The Vanguard view us three with suspicion. But you… you, they trust. Show them it is not misplaced. Demonstrate how the Darkness can be used for good, Just as the Light has been for evil. This is only the beginning, Guardian. We have much more yet to uncover…

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That power looks good on you, kid. Real snappy. When the world goes to hell, folks like you and me just keep on going. Still gotta work. Still gotta get paid. Bring those new fancy powers through Gambit sometime, huh?
The Guardian approaches the Exo Stranger.

lines.speaker: Exo Stranger
lines.text: You see now. Darkness resides within, beckoning you, as it has many others. Across lifetimes… timelines. Beyond ours lies another world. One pervaded by Darkness. Where Guardians abandoned their Light at the call of temptation. In that world… you were no exception. But here, in this world, Light and Dark swell within you, side by side, giving you strength. Remember that when you step onto the Ziggurat once more. You're there for one reason, and one alone: to fully harness the Darkness within you. It's time now. They're expecting you.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Stranger in a Strange Land: Speak to Commander Zavala — Transcript

lines.text: After defeating Praksis, the Guardian returns to Beyond to meet with the Exo Stranger, but instead finds multiple Vanguard Frames at the camp. The Guardian enters the tent and approaches Commander Zavala.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian. I don't even know where to begin. It seems every day I know less and less… But that's not why I came here. The Vanguard has been watching Eramis, and I have important intel for you. You've clearly disrupted Eramis's plans. Vanguard scouts report that she's fled to the Cosmodrome. Perhaps to loot the remains of the old House Devils hideouts. Her plan is unclear. But I believe she's getting desperate. Go to Earth, find out what her next move is. And Guardian… I understand what you're doing. Fighting fire with fire. But the Darkness is not our friend. The Darkness caused the Collapse. By all accounts, it seeks to cause another. Don't let it lead you away from the Light. The City needs you. I need you. For now… do what you must for the good of humanity. But don't lose sight of who you are.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Summoner's Circle — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The machinations of the Hive never cease. By your hand Oryx has been thrown from our world. But his will still drives the horde, clawing at the light. In the depths of the Dreadnaught, a coven of Acolytes gestate an abomination — a warspawn of the Hive, pulsing and growing in a pool of Taken power. We cannot suffer this beast to live.
Hull Breach, Dreadnaught, Rings of Saturn

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The priests of Oryx work their spell deep in the heart of the ship. Your goal is simple: summon the beast before their work is complete. Begin with the crackling green core of their magic. Find champions of the Hive and destroy their souls.
The Guardian collects three Taken Polyps.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The soul you have harvested screams for freedom. Find a tomb husk and give it purchase.
The Guardian picks up the tomb husk.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The souls nestle within the husk. Find its gestation pit and summon forth the beast. Do not allow the worm to complete its cycle. End it now.
The Guardian deposits the tomb husk. The Infantine appears.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Send it back to the void!

lines.speaker: Eris Morn

title: The Awoken — Transcript

lines.text: In their jumpship, the Guardian and Ghost enter The Reef for the first time. Hundreds of destroyed ships, stations, and other pieces of debris surround them.

The Queen's throne room, the Reef. The Guardian and Ghost walk toward the throne, followed closely by Awoken guards. The Queen’s Brother, Prince Uldren Sov awaits them, standing in front of the throne.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: So these are the trespassers demanding an audience.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: The Queen herself judges who may or may not enter the realm.
The brother smirks and steps closer to the Guardian and Ghost.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Me? I see no reason she should be available for whatever washes up at The Reef. But here we are.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: We've come to ask for help.
From behind the throne, two Fallen Vandals with spears approach, snarling.

The Guardian pushes one of the guards back and grabs the gun from their holster. The Vandals ready their spears in a defensive position. The Brother unsheathes a knife, and holds it to the Guardian's throat while catching the Guardian’s wrist. The other Guard raises her pistol at the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: It is afraid of the Fallen.
Mara Sov, the Queen of the Reef, appears.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: It does not understand these ones are mine.

As the Queen sits on her throne, the two Vandals lift their spears and stand at rest. The Awoken Guard takes her weapon from the Guardian's hand and re-holsters it. The brother removes his blade from the edge of their neck, and the Guardian pulls their forearm away.
The brother bows slightly and steps back.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: I am a Guardian, from Earth. We're searching for the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: We seek to destroy the Darkness at its heart.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: You want to turn it into a battleground. How unimaginative.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Everyone knows where it is. The hard part is getting in.
The brother advances on The Guardian once more.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: The Queen requests counsel with her brother.
The brother turns around, walks toward the Queen, and kneels by her side. The two speak between themselves, inaudible to the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Yes, that's good. That's good. Why not? We'll make you a key...how's that? All we need is the head of a Vex Gate Lord.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: Why do you want a Vex head?

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Oh, we don't...and I doubt we'll get one either. But it's your only hope of getting into the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Uldren Sov
lines.text: Or die on Venus. Either way.
The Guardian turns and leaves, the Guards following closely behind.

lines.text: The Traveler transformed Mercury into a garden world. It was a paradise… until the Vex came. The Vex replaced the planet's core with their own machines. We call it the "Infinite Forest." An ever expanding labyrinth of realities. No two paths are ever the same. No one has ever escaped. It was Osiris's… obsession.
The Guardian flies down to Mercury and transmats onto the surface.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: Welcome to Mercury, Guardian. The signs told me you would come.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What a coincidence. We followed the signs here, too. And by signs, I mean facts.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: That too is a sign! I am Brother Vance of the Followers of Osiris, keeper of the Lighthouse, and oracle of the Lost Prophecies.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: There is a Vex gateway near your location. Osiris spent years studying it. He was convinced it was the door to the infinite Forest. If it is still possible to find Osiris, we need to open that door.
The Guardian searches for the doorway to the Infinite Forest, getting closer to The Lighthouse.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: I'm so pleased that Osiris has brought you to me, his most faithful servant.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Considering how you revere a man who questions everything, I am surprised how well faith serves you.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: The Vex are at my door. Osiris has not returned. Faith is all I have left.
The Guardian uses a Vex jump to cross a chasm, bringing the Gateway to the Infinite Forest into sight.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The gateway to the Infinite Forest. A place from which no one has ever returned. Not even Osiris.
Agoros, Gatekeeper blocks the Guardian from reaching the gateway.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Here it is. Well… I'm ready if you are?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We can't get through. If Osiris's ghost were awake, then maybe she could help.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: Osiris preserve us! You have his Ghost? Sagira? Please— please— bring her to me!
Vex reinforcements arrive, including Tyranos, Gatekeeper

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Descendants… we haven't seen these Vex since the Vault of Glass.
The Guardian fights off more descendant Vex before killing Methodios, Module Proxy.
The Guardian shoots the module disabling the teleporter.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Vex from different timelines are converging on Mercury. That's bad.
The Guardian uses the Vex teleporter to teleport into the Lighthouse.

lines.speaker: Brother Vance
lines.text: Thank you. I don't know what I would have done if Osiris hadn't sent you to me. In return, the Followers of Osiris can help you revive his Ghost. We have a hidden temple on Earth. Take Sagira to these coordinates. I will notify the Followers that you are coming. Now that the Lighthouse is safe, we can prepare for Osiris's return. All the lost prophecies are coming to pass. I'm finally going to meet Osiris!

title: The Glassway — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to Europa and pushes towards the Nexus pushing through House Salvation's defenses to reach the Vex portal. The Guardian witness Eramis's Ketch at the top of the Glassway.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks, we're here. Heading in after Eramis now.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: The portal within. It was built in your Golden Age to study Vex. But Vex escaped. Murdered many. You must hurry. Devastation is all we face if Eramis opens that portal.
The Guardian discovers Fallen Skiffs deploying Fallen soldiers in the Nexus.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Hello, pawn. It's no surprise to find you here.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis, you must not do this! Do you not care for our people?

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Far more than you know, traitor.
The Guardian defeats the Fallen and disables a barrier, moving deeper into the Nexus.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Tell me, Variks. Was it not you that tortured and murdered Eliksni in the Prison of Elders?

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: A hypocrite? Yes. At least here they die for a cause.
Warrior's Enforcer appears. The Guardian defeats Warrior's Enforcer and disables another Fallen barrier.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: You are a monster if you do this.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I'm no monster. What I do, I do for the future of our people.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Open that portal, and you kill them all!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Many will die, yes. But more shall live.
Technocrat's Assistant appears. The Guardian defeats Technocrat's Assistant and disabled another Fallen barrier.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Our world died, Variks. Do you recall? We were absolutely powerless to stop it. I tried everything to put it behind me. To move on. But in my head, I could not silence the collective cries of our injured and dying. But then… Darkness presented itself. And I took it. Finally, Variks — finally, I felt I could do something. So go ahead. Call me a monster. But do not doubt that what I do, I do for the future of our people.
The Guardian fights through more Fallen defenses and begins draining the Radiolarian Fluid to unlock the path forward.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Believing all this, the desperate plan of a Kell gone mad, rather than a step towards absolution. Let's call it justice. For spilling the blood of worthy Eliksni and taking what was rightfully mine.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [wheezes] Eramis has always been brash, but this… [insect-like chattering] is different. The Darkness pervades her mind and spirit.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll stop her, Variks. We have to.
The Guardian traverses the pit and reaches the Vex portal.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Poor foolish pawn. This time, I made you into one of my own.
Eramis, Kell of Darkness appears. Eramis retreats and transmats into a Skiff and flees the area.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Unfortunately, you're too late. I'll just have to eviscerate you another day. If you make it out alive.
The Vex portal activates. Transcendent Hydra arrives. Belmon, Transcendent Mind also arrives followed by Vex reinforcements.

The Guardian prevents Belmon and Transcendent Hydra's invasion as they take to the Void. The Guardian defeats Belmon, Transcendent Mind and Transcendent Hydra. The Radiolarian Fluid in front of the Vex Portal is drained.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wait — where is all that radiolarian fluid going?
Before returning to the Exo Stranger, Variks tells the Guardian of the Eliksni homeworld, Riis, and how the Whirlwind affected the Eliksni.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Ours was a world of prosperity and peace. Not unlike your Golden Age. We worshipped the Great Machine. But fate intervened. With it, came a whirlwind of destruction. In the chaos, the Great Machine fled… abandoning us all. Eramis, like most, was consumed by rage. In the wake of loss, Eramis rebuilt a life. Found new family, one forged from anger.
Eramis's new family depicts her four lieutenants — Phylaks, Praksis, Kridis, and Atraks — as well as Taniks.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis saw only destruction of that which abandoned us. Variks fears for Eliksni lives. At the command of Eramis, they will meet their end. We all do. We must all make choices. Eramis chose herself over her people. If Eramis is to succeed, the Great Machine and all who follow it… will meet their end. In Darkness, there is only one truth… death.
After defeating all of the Vex from the Vex Portal at the Glassway, the Guardian receives a transmission from Eramis.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Oh, pawn. In another life, we may have been allies. But instead, you put us at odds. So I have no choice but to use Darkness to rip, shred, and tear through every single one of your kind.

title: The Insight Terminus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, we've received limited intel regarding a Vex information depot. I want you to get in there and figure out what they know.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Greetings, Captain! Commander Zavala has requested that I run tactical on this mission. Please allow me to help you with your invasion of the Insight Terminus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hello, Failsafe. You're familiar with this place?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Oh yes, quite! The Vex were very active there when the Exodus Black first arrived on Nessus. The Vex that murdered my crew came from there.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm sorry you have to relive those memories.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: It's all right. It's only taken me a few centuries to suppress them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, hello, Failsafe. What can you tell us about this Terminus?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I have not detected significant Vex activity in that area since shortly after the Exodus Black arrived.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, that's good news. Maybe we won't run into much resistance.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Yeah, but since Death kinda follows you around, I wouldn't count on that.
The Guardians defeat Vex as they attempt to locate the Insight Terminus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Red Legion? Great, the Cabal are here.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Correct. I have been monitoring Vex transmissions. The Cabal are invading the installation as well. Gotta love coincidence.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Captain, a word of caution. I have been monitoring Vex transmissions. It appears the Vex are repelling a Cabal incursion at your present location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Any idea what they're doing down here?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Vex are currently calculating probabilities to that question. Response will be forthcoming! Whatever it is, you just know it's not good.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Red Legion? What are the Cabal doing here?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I am monitoring Vex Transmissions. It appears that the Vex are repelling a Cabal incursion at your present location.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Yes, but what are they doing here?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The Vex are currently calculating probabilities to that question. Response will be forthcoming!

Valus Pra'urg appears and Guardians force Valus Pra'urg to retreat. The Guardians clear the area of Cabal, defeat Valus Pra'urg, and proceed further into the installation. The Guardians discover Kargen, the Technocrat attempting to access a Vex conflux. Kargen retaliates and teleports away.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That guy looked like a commander of some sort.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: That's correct, Friendly Ghost! That commander was Kargen, an elite Cabal psion who has caused significant damage to the Vex collective in this timestream.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The psion was wearing commander regalia.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Friendly Ghost, the Vex believe that commander is Kargen, an elite Red Legion psion. And a particularly murderous one at that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We always get the fun ones.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: They say "like attracts like," you know.
The Guardians secure a Vex plate and unlock a Vex gate.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Guardian, I'm making the elimination of Kargen your priority on this operation. His crew has been active all over the system. From our intel, he's mostly targeting Vex installations. However, removing him can only strengthen our position. Put him down.
The Guardian enters the Vinculum Cell pursuing Kargen and the Cabal.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: I have good news… and bad news.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Give us the good news first.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The good news is that Kargen is killing Vex by the dozen.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right. What's the bad news?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Kargen has almost complete control over the Vex gate network. I predict several detachments of Cabal over the next few minutes.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: The good news is that you can expect only a few Vex as you approach the entrance to the Terminus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That is good news. What's the bad news?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Courtesy of this Kargen guy, the Vex you do encounter will be headless suicide machines. Have fun.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: According to the Vex, Kargen has almost complete control over the local Vex gate network. I predict several detachments of Cabal over the next few minutes.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No, I said give us the good news first.

lines.speaker: Wanted
lines.text: Bracus Ghir appears. The Guardians clear the area of Cabal and defeat Bracus Ghir. The Guardians pursue Kargen accessing another Vex conflux, but Kargen escapes and blocks off his exit.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Kargen is getting dangerously skilled at manipulating this Vex architecture. Maybe if we catch him, he can give Cayde a lesson or two.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: One does have to admire Kargen's command of Vex technology. Maybe if we catch him, he can give Cayde a lesson or two.
Val Ghuusk appears as Cabal enter the area through multiple Vex gates. The Guardians defeat Val Ghuusk and take the Arc charge to the right-most insertion point.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Nice work, Captain, but you're gonna need one more.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Excellent work, Captain. You are at 50 percent completion of this task.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All right. We need one more. Keep an eye out for another Cabal drop or Centurion.
Val Urgus appears and more Cabal reinforcements are deployed through the Vex gate network. The Guardians defeat Val Urgus and take the Arc charge to the left-most insertion point unlocking the way.
Damaged and headless Vex flood into the area and attack Cabal and the Guardians. The Guardians clear the area of all enemies and proceed down the Vinculum Cell's well to pursue Kargen.
The Guardians witness Kargen unleash five void orbs that destroy multiple Vex Minotaurs and a Vex Hydra.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Wow! OK, don't get hit by that.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Intercepted communication from the Vex indicates that Kargen has bypassed their initial security protocols.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It looks like Kargen is using that conflux to access the data artifact. Get me over to that Vex plate and I'll try a counter-hack.
The Guardians secure the Vex plate.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I injected some bad variables into his decryption process. That should slow him down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Firewall in place. That should slow him down.
Kargen appears and Guardians weaken Kargen until he retreats. Three more Vex plates activate and are secured by the Guardians, forcing Kargen to leave the conflux.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm pretty sure he realizes that we're not going to let him get away with stealing the data while we're here.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: You are correct, Friendly Ghost. A massive buildup of energy indicates several Cabal transports are inbound to your position. You asked for it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Second protocol in place, but he's getting faster.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This guy is good. But we're better.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Good work, Guardian. What intel did you discover?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's an almost unreadable data artifact here, labeled "OXA." It's heavily corrupted, but I'm able to make out "MSund12" from the access log. What is "OXA," and who was "MSund12"?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Hmm, there's only one data artifact here, labeled "OXA," and it's seriously corrupted. Metadata says it was last accessed by an "Otzot" centuries ago. What is "OXA," and who is "Otzot"?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Those are questions for another day, I suppose. But for now, well done.

title: The Iron Tomb — Transcript

lines.speaker: Shiro-4
lines.text: When the Splicers started fusing SIVA into their systems, they created a massive network to control the nanotech. So, just like they took down our sensor grid? We're going to take down theirs. That should neutralize SIVA long enough for you to enter the replication complex.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: This is where my fellow Iron Lords sacrificed their lives. You must stop the flow of SIVA now and forever, no matter the cost.

lines.speaker: Shiro-4
lines.text: There are a lot of Splicers between you and that replication chamber, Guardian. Stay alert.

lines.speaker: Shiro-4
lines.text: The Splicers have built a fortress to protect the entrance to the complex. Short-sightedly, they decided to use the reactor in an old oil tanker as a power source. That's going to be our ticket.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Picking up a strong energy signature nearby.

lines.speaker: Shiro-4
lines.text: That'll be the reactor. Swapping the fusion cells should knock out the network for a few minutes: defences, replication, everything.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK. Pull the fusion cell and switch it with its counterpart.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: OK. Tinkering with an unstable Golden Age reactor infested with SIVA? Child's play.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Move, Guardian! The SIVA replication complex awaits.
The Iron Lord's original plan was to destroy the replicator in the SIVA chamber. Jolder's explosion apparently only damaged it, so when you reach the chamber, you will need to finish what she began.

lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.text: There's more than one battle in a war.

lines.speaker: Shiro
