Guardian proceeds through Archons' Forge, clearing Fallen

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Only a few of us reached the replication complex. The worst of Rasputin's defences had already blanketed this entire area. Frames, constructs... Some things I haven't seen before nor since. They felt no pain. No fear.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: All we've seen so far is Fallen

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Last time, his presence was almost physical. I think he was trying to communicate, but we did not understand.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How can you be so certain Rasputin won't get involved once we're inside?

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: The Vanguard still believe Rasputin to be simply a Warmind. He hasn't been that for a very long time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So when we stop the production of SIVA - because it'll be that easy - what about who's controlling?

lines.speaker: Shiro-4
lines.text: I have some leads on that. Fallen chatter about some crazy Splicer priest who wants to play god. I'm kind of with Saladin now, though. Zealots can take a back seat until the heavy lifting is done.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: The replication chamber is beneath you. Look for a way down.
Fallen release flare, alerting other Splicers

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: You are close to SIVA's dark heart, Young Wolf. Be on your guard.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: I did what I could to protect their resting place. But I knew what would happen if someone found it. We were touched by the Light. I - I didn't even know someone with the Traveller's Gift could die... until they did.
Find the replicator, and deactivate it. Only that will stop the flow of SIVA once and for all.

The Guardian continues to search for Eramis, defeating the Fallen which they encounter. Piksis, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats Piksis, House Salvation and and confronts Eramis, Kell of Darkness in her command room with a hologram of a Pyramid.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Welcome back. It's time to meet your end.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: The Darkness was not meant for you! You do not understand this power! I will destroy you, your once Great Machine, and everyone you care for!
The Guardian continues to fight against Eramis.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Your chains are showing. All that power, wasted serving false gods. Ha!
Eramis strikes the Guardian with Stasis, freezing their legs to the ground.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Allow me to help you break free.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is… I… I can't — I'm sorry.
Eramis suppresses Ghost with Stasis. The Guardian reaches for their Splinter of Darkness. Eramis snatches the Splinter out of the Guardian's hand.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: [grunts] Look what I've done for you. No more Light. No more Dark. [grunts]
Eramis shatters the Guardian's Splinter of Darkness. As the Guardian becomes fully surrounded by Stasis crystals, they hear the voice of the Exo Stranger.
The Guardian breaks free from the Stasis crystals, knocking back Eramis and freeing Ghost.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: The only thing we have to break here — is you.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Come then, pawn. Show me what freedom has given you.
The Guardian becomes empowered with Stasis. Several Cruxes of Darkness appear. The Guardian continues fighting Eramis.
The Guardian fights against Eramis using Stasis.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: I will tear the Darkness out from inside you.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: How dare you get in my way!

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: You are not special. The Darkness is MINE! However you do this, it does not matter. I will still tear you apart.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: This power was meant for me and the Eliksni! Not scum like you.
The Guardian fights against Eramis. Eramis falls to her knees and then gets to her feet.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: It will not end this way. It can't! [grunts] What? [gasps] Nooo…!
Eramis is consumed by Stasis crystals as she reaches towards the Europan Pyramid.

title: The Last Array — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There’s reports a team of Guardians went dark near the old Skywatch. They were running a mission for Dead Orbit, had codes to a hidden array that could reconnect us to other colonies in the system. If we can find their Ghosts, maybe we can open that array.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Ghosts were last heard from near the Skywatch. Let’s head there and see if we can find them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We’re heading back to that Hive breeding ground. The Vanguard say they’re spilling onto the surface now, keeping the Fallen busy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Ghosts… They’re in a clearing between buildings not far from here.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Ghosts are still here! The Fallen have them.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This one still has the Codes. Let’s find the Array!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Approaching the Control Station. This is it!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There’s the controls. I’ll see if these codes still work.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, negotiating cryptosystems. Shor-resistant security lattice verified. It’s working! Outside the array it’s opening. Amazing... it’s activating! Hive Tomb Ships! Cutting through!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think we’re clear! You need to see this!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This Array is controlled by The last Warmind - Rasputin. It’s connecting to defense constructs all across the system. There could be something out there to help us survive the Darkness.

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: A friendly warning: I am detecting seismic events all along the planet's crust. I believe the Red Legion is to blame.

lines.speaker: Failsafe Second Half
lines.text: Hey, who wants to bet the Vex will tear us apart trying to fix it?

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Agreed. Be careful, Guardian. There's no one out there to back you up.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: On your right: a waterfall of Vex... milk. Yes, Vex milk.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Is it weird when I look at that light, and I think, "Wow. That is one big Ghost."

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Hey friends: I'm detecting seismic activity past the barrier ahead.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Let's see how the Red Legion plans to kill you today, Guardian.
Guardian defeats the Vex and Cabal in the area then the barrier deactivates

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: What could the Red Legion possibly be drilling for?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: According to radio chatter, they want to build more guns.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Zavala! Looks like the drills are manned by a full battalion of Cabal!

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: A full battalion? What is that to you, who have slain gods in the heart of the Black Garden?
The two Cabal Drill Officers Centurions are defeated

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Research team? More like research army. There's so many of them.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Indeed. But we still need to know what they're looking for. Brace yourselves.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I think they want their drill back!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I hope this is safe. The Cabal don't need to stick the landing. We do.
Legion Dig Site, Unstable Centaur, Nessus

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh, no. Please. Nonononono. Please. Please. No!
The Inverted Spire, Unstable Centaur, Nessus

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Uh, hey.. what's happening to the floor?
Protheon changes to Solar with an Arc weapon

lines.speaker: Ghost

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Well done. Failsafe, what's your assessment of this incident?

lines.speaker: Failsafe
lines.text: Vex records indicate the Cabal discovered the Mind, and dug into this world to capture it. Had the Red Legion achieved their goal, I estimate a 60% chance this planetoid would have been destroyed in the ensuring battles. Luckily, the captain stepped in.

title: The Leviathan Returns: Operation: Midas — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian investigates the Leviathan's arrival near the Moon.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Vanguard reconnaissance op "Midas" is go. Guardian. The exiled emperor Calus has anchored his ship off the Moon. Caiatl's fleet is holding a perimeter. Eris Morn, our subject expert and lunar field agent, will oversee your mission.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Shortly after the Leviathan's arrival, it emitted a disruptive frequency.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We assumed the broadcast was comms interference.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: But then, the Pyramid responded. I believe a connection has been made. Your task is to confirm that notion and assess the danger.
The Guardian touches down in the Castellum of the now derelict Leviathan.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The house of Calus falls to rot… and his "Loyalists" have abandoned their posts. Ikora has spoken of these fungal growths before, in reference to the derelict Cabal cruiser, Glykon Volatus. This does not bode well.
The Guardian feels the Leviathan shakes as they approach the throne of Calus.
The Guardian finds an alternate route through the Pleasure Gardens.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Do you see the phantoms? Strange that they have left the Moon. They were generated by the lunar Pyramid: dredged trauma, like scorch marks lifted from a ruin.
As the Guardian enters the Pleasure Gardens, their radar detects enemies... but nothing is present.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Is the entire vessel infested? More phantoms… congregating around something.
The Guardian follows the phantoms to a dead Cabal Loyalist.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Vines fused to spine and skull, stimulating brain activity. An experiential perpetuity, endlessly feeding the Egregore.
The Guardian finds and scans a dead Ghost.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: On the Moon, phantoms and Nightmares alike were attracted to remnants of Light… Refracting them into weaponized projections of fear and doubt.
The Guardian sees the Nightmare of Safiyah.

lines.speaker: Nightmare of Safiyah
lines.text: Lightbearer. I have seen your kind before. You seek oblivion.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: All the same, proceed with caution.
A dead Cabal falls from above. The Guardian continues upwards to find an illusion of a War beast. They chase after it.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Nightmares exploit a target's vulnerabilities. They do not make contact at random. But I do not believe this is the Guardian's Nightmare.
The Guardian continues onward. They encounter a Cabal.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Stow your weapons! That Cabal radiates foul energy. Keep from sight!
The Guardian finds a malfunctioning door.
The Guardian destroys the conduit. The door opens. The Nightmare of Safiyah appears once more, tempting the Guardian forward.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Egregore spores open one's consciousness to Darkness, allowing passage through fungal barriers. Agitate the pod and coat yourself, but take care… We do not know what else lurks in that shared abstraction.
The Guardian coats themself in Egregore and pushes onward.

lines.speaker: Nightmare of Safiyah
lines.text: When you see… you will know what must be done.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: That door leads to Calus's throne. The H.E.L.M.'s instruments detect it is radiating Pyramid resonance.
The door opens for the Guardian.

The Guardian investigates the Calus automaton they destroyed on their first journey aboard the Leviathan. The lights in the throne room dim and many phantoms appear. The Guardian's Light is suppressed by Nightmarish Affliction.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is time to leave. Hold fast! I will retrieve you.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Something has placed itself between us. I cannot reach you!
The Guardian escapes the throne room.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I'm calling in your ship. Move!
The Guardian enters their ship and retreats from the Leviathan.

title: The Lost Splicer — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: It's been a long time, Guardian. My Hidden report that Mithrax was last seen on Europa, helping Variks evacuate Eliksni defectors. Both the Vex and Eramis's loyalists are down there hunting for survivors, shooting anything that moves. Be sure to shoot back. We need Mithrax alive if he's to help us with our Vex problem.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: You're closing in on some residual signals. It could be Eliksni bound for House Light… or it could more of Eramis's loyalists. Clear the Vex and introduce yourself to the survivors. Make it known you're not a threat… unless you need to be.
The Guardian encounters the Vex while investigating the last known location of Mithrax.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Empty. The Eliksni cleared out before the Vex showed up. See if you can learn where they're headed.
The Guardian interacts with an Eliksni terminal.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: — over their possessions. Trigger message repeat. This is Misraaks. To those who renounce the violence of House Salvation and seek refuge in the House of Light… I will be landing a Skiff near Asterion Abyss. Bring only what you need. We must prioritize survivors over their possessions. Trigger message repeat.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Asterion Abyss. That's their rendezvous point. A single Skiff recently touched down near your position. It's got to be Mithrax. Hurry, Guardian. Before he takes off.
The Guardian witnesses a trail of smoke at a crash site in the distance and heads for Mithrax's rendezvous point.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Mithrax is wrapped up in some dangerous business. It's a bad time to ask for a favor, but he and his House of Light still worship the Traveler.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: That heat signature — flames. Someone brought down the Skiff. Quick now. Secure the crash site and assist the survivors… if there are any.
The Guardian clears the area of the Vex.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Vex took down the ship and ambushed the Eliksni defectors. There are bodies in the snow… nothing can be done for them now. Mithrax must have led a few survivors out, but they're completely exposed. Eyes up. Move.
A snowstorm begins while the Guardian searches for Mithrax and the surviving Eliksni.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: You're close… and I'm picking up unusual energy spikes ahead. Be ready for anything.
Mithrax leads Eliksni refugees into a cavern.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: [grunts] The Guardian is almost here. Stay down, stay quiet.

lines.speaker: Dreg
lines.text: How do you know we can trust them?
Mithrax exits the cavern and approaches the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Guardian, I find you in the Light. And on your signal… Ikora Rey?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Mithrax-kell, it is an honor. We have been searching for you for some time.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: This is known. You are not the only one with hidden eyes. Many enemies pursue my House of Light. We did not wish to be found.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Then times are desperate for us both. The Vanguard seeks your assistance.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I am aware. Vex systems pulse with talk of the City's Endless Night… but my people demand much protection. If this Guardian could assist me in blinding the Vex here, we can speak without risking more bloodshed.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Blinding the Vex… My Guardian will do whatever you need.
The Guardian follows Mithrax as he creates a portal into the Vex domain.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I have opened the door for you, Guardian. Will you walk the path of the Sacred Splicer?
The Guardian witnesses the Eliksni refugees
The Guardian enters Mithrax's portal to claim data on Mithrax's Eliksni.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Did you send them into a Vex simulation?

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The path before them is no illusion. The Guardian ventures through the Vex domain itself, where the machines guard their most precious secrets. I will clear the way.
Mithrax creates structures for the Guardian to cross the chasm.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You move freely through space none but our most skilled Splicers can even perceive. The Light shines strong within you.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Hold fast, Guardian. I will alter the fabric of this Vex system to aid you.
The Guardian defeats more Vex units.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You are farther than I have ever been… find the Vex curator. Destroy it and claim the living code woven through its core.
The Guardian approaches a closed space. Subjugated Curator appears. The Guardian defeats the Subjugated Curator.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You must flee! Now! Do not fall in that Lightless place!
The Guardian flees while a Vex security protocol closes in on them.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Hmm. Another power works against me, pushing back. This is troubling.
The Guardian reaches the exit point and the Vex prevent the Guardian from exiting.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The system is collapsing! Hold strong, I will create another exit!
Mithrax pulls the Guardian out of the Vex domain.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Vex signals are dissipating from your region. They're leaving.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Yes. With the core you hold, the secrets of the Vex reveal themselves to us. To study such an artifact would benefit us both… but there is no time. My people must move on if we hope to survive.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Mithrax. I saw those who wished to join you dead in the snow. Let them be the last to fall. Come. Shelter in our City — you and your people.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Ikorakel, can you offer the Eliksni such a thing?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I just did. You'll be under the Vanguard's protection. The Vex are the enemy here, and any Lightbearer who disagrees can take it up with me.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Then we accept, with Light in our hearts. We will join you in your City… beneath the Traveler.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Leviathan Returns: Commune with the Crown of Sorrow — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Crown of Sorrow.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is done. We are inexorably bound to the power of this Hive artifact, and to one another. The Crown of Sorrow was once forged by Savathûn's hand, designed as a psychic prison, binding the mind of its bearer to her will. Now it serves a new witch. You have become a reaper of Darkness, dooming slain Nightmares to imprisonment within the Crown. Calus has begun to forge a bond between the Leviathan and the dormant Pyramid buried on the Moon. I do not yet know why, or how. But with enough imprisoned Nightmares, I can use their essence to invoke a ritual to sever those connections Calus is forging. For now, return to the Leviathan and seek out concentrations of these new Nightmares. Destroy them and bind them to the Crown. As I warned Zavala, Nightmares wear familiar faces and speak with familiar voices. They manifest our darkest fears. You will assist Crow when it comes time to perform the first severance ritual. We both know what form his Nightmare will take. It will do everything in its power to stop you. Be wary.
Crown of Sorrow — Legacy: The Leviathan Returns
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Machinist — Transcript

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: Look at you. If our prodigal prince is not yet afraid of you… He should be. Six down… yet the strongest three remain. Of the prince and his pet Fanatic, reports are few. However, your bloodbath has forced the Machinist out of hiding. Moreover, I hear she's amassing great quantities of corrupted Ether - to grow the Fanatic's depraved armies. When you pay the Machinist a visit, I urge you to destroy any and all caches of their vile ambrosia. And by the way? Death suits you.
The Dark Forest, European Dead Zone
Uldren Sov walks through the Dark Forest. He encounters a group of Dregs, who bow to him. Uldren walks towards the shard of the Traveler. Mara Sov appears behind Uldren.
Uldren shoots the shard of the Traveler, exposing a small, glowing shard.
Uldren picks up the small shard.
A bullet narrowly misses Uldren. Petra Venj is shown, hiding nearby with a sniper rifle.
Petra Venj runs away. The group of Dregs chase after her.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're in the Machinist's territory now. This one isn't just another name on a list. The Machinist is the Fanatic's right hand. She commands an arsenal of stolen tech. Human, Awoken, Fallen, Cabal… anything she can get her hands on.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This tank is City-made. Machinist has good taste, I'll give her that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Everything's working - except the two most important parts: the turret and the nav module. But we ARE in a junkyard. I've ID'd some possible replacements nearby.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This turret's seen better days. But I can make it work.
The Guardian picks up the turret and places it in the tank.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Turrets are online. You get the nav module. I'll cover you.
The Guardian finds the nav module. They pick it up and place it in the tank. The Guardian enters the tank.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nav module installed. Your chariot awaits.
The Guardian fights through the Machinist's lair. The Guardian finds an energy barrier blocking their path further into the Machinist's lair.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That energy barrier is a problem violence can't solve. Let's check around for a power source.
The Guardian finds a terminal. Ghost hacks the terminal, disabling the barrier. The Guardian continues further into the Machinist's lair and encounters a Fallen Walker.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm detecting huge shipping containers of dark Ether in here - enough to raise a Scorm army.
The Guardian destroys the Walker and the fuel caches. The Guardian finds another Fallen Walker and destroys it. The Guardian continues further into the Machinist's lair.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Machinist has been raiding cis-Jovian space for years. What she doesn't supply to the Barons, she adds to her hoard.
The Guardian finds another energy barrier blocking their path.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Look around. Must be another power source nearby.
The Guardian finds a terminal. Ghost hacks the terminal, disabling the barrier.

lines.speaker: The Machinist
lines.text: Shipments… away. All our weapons… to Fikrul and… the Awoken King.
The Guardian continues further into the Machinist's lair. The Machinist appears.

lines.speaker: The Machinist
lines.text: You want revenge? I watched Cayde die! Pathetic death!
The Guardian fights against the Machinist.

lines.speaker: The Machinist
lines.text: The Scorned Barons… always stand together. Divide us… but you cannot break us.

lines.speaker: The Machinist
lines.text: I bought them… time… The Scorn… the Barons… stand together… forever…

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Seven down. One to go. Then Uldren. It's almost over. It's almost over.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: GUARDIAN. I know where Uldren is headed. It's time to end this.
The Guardian speaks to Petra Venj.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: After the war, everyone in the Reef mourned our Queen and our prince. Except me. I didn't believe they had died. I couldn't. But then... Uldren returned. He told me he could hear the Queen's voice in his head. That's when I knew he was changed. I could have prevented all of this. But instead, I hid him away in the Prison of Elders. And now... Cayde is dead. The Reef is in ruins. And I've confirmed that Uldren is on his way to the Watchtower. It's now or never.
The Guardian speaks to the Spider.

lines.speaker: The Spider
lines.text: So that royal runt Uldren wants into the Watchtower. I always wondered what secrets and treasures the Awoken stashed in that ersatz spire. But my friendship with Queen Mara, while she lived, stayed my hand. Well, that and a locked door. Thus I am honor-bound to send a selection of my finest to help you find that ever-elusive closure. I must say... I cannot wait to see how this ends.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Leviathan Returns: The Binding Ritual — Transcript

lines.text: Zavala, Eris Morn, and Empress Caiatl stand at the viewport of the H.E.L.M. and gaze at the Leviathan.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The lunar Pyramid stirs to the Leviathan's call. It manifests our deepest regrets. They wear familiar faces and speak with familiar voices.
Empress Caiatl indicates Eris Morn with a jerk of her head.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I can bind these Nightmares to us, grant us safe passage through the ship.

lines.speaker: Empress Caiatl
lines.text: Hive Magic. You would doom us all.
Eris Morn speaks to Zavala and touches his arm.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: I know what I'm asking you to confront.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The rules have bent around us. We must also bend.

lines.speaker: Empress Caiatl
lines.text: Madness. Your witchcraft plays right into my father's hands. Find someone else for your ritual.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your regrets will follow you, Empress. Let me offer protection.
Empress Caiatl slams her fist against her chestplate.

lines.speaker: Empress Caiatl
lines.text: [grunts] My armor is protection enough. I will lead the charge. You need only follow.
Zavala and Eris Morn nod to each other.
Wing of the Haunted, The H.E.L.M.
Eris Morn, Zavala, Crow, and the Guardian participate in a ritual in front of the Crown of Sorrow.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: No matter what happens, do not break the circle.
Eris Morn holds out the Nightmare Harvester.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: This will anchor our offerings. Now, tithe your weights to the Crown.
Eris Morn offers her Ahamkara bone.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: My heart… from a time long past.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: My memory, from one life to the next.
Crow offers a cloth scrap from Uldren Sov's burial shroud.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Song of Sathona, your words are mine to command. Vorlog. Aiat.
Eris Morn is lifted into the air by the Nightmare Harvester.
Zavala starts to rise and reach for Eris. The Guardian holds Zavala's arm and he pauses.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Chords plucked in offered throats, find chorus. Echoes once dissonant, exhumed, find harmony in binding flesh. It burdens. It burdens.
The Nightmare of Safiyah appears behind Zavala.
The Nightmare of Uldren Sov appears behind Crow.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It burdens… until the choir relents, accepting. Aiat.
The Nightmare Harvester pulses with energy, and Eris Morn returns to the ground.
Empress Caiatl is still at the viewport of the H.E.L.M. The Nightmare of Ghaul appears behind her.

title: The Lost Splicer: Eliksni Quarter — Transcript

lines.text: Botza Ruins, Botza District, The Last City
After evacuating Eliksni refugees from Europa, the Guardian rendezvouses with Osiris and Lakshmi-2 to welcome Mithrax and the House of Light into the Last City.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: My people shelter beneath the Great Machine… This is beyond simple generosity. I must thank Ikora for her gift.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: This sanctuary is not granted by Ikora alone, but by all who live in the Last City.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Yes, and on their behalf, let me extend a welcome. I am Osiris, and this is Lakshmi-2, Future War Cult leader and City representative.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: My greatest appreciations to you both. The House of Light thanks you.
Mithrax bows towards Osiris and Lakshmi-2.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: You House can best show gratitude by keeping to itself. I know your assistance with the Vex will benefit us all, but not everyone in the City is so open-minded. You appear to be settling in. I will leave you to it.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: If you require further help from us, you must only ask.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I shall. There are several modifications we will need for stable Ether production.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: Submit a proposal to Ikora. She seems willing to get you anything you need. I must return to the people in the City.
Lakshmi-2 turns away from Mithrax and Osiris.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: Future War Cult has foreseen great misery for them in the days ahead, and they will need an advocate.

lines.speaker: Lakshmi-2
lines.text: I often forget how highly those in the Tower have placed themselves. The air is thin there. Best not to breathe too much of it.
Lakshmi-2 transmats out of the area. Mithrax turns toward Osiris.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You must understand, this situation is tense for us all. This encampment perches on the edge of decree and democracy. I hope your stay with us will be… uneventful.
Osiris transmats out of the area.

title: The Nether - Heresy — Transcript

lines.text: TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Be ready, Guardian. The Dreadnaught will try to push you out. Keep fighting.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Taken and Dread think this ship belongs to them. They want a new base of operations in Sol. Rip them out of the hull, every inch of it.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: LIAR! HERETIC! YOU HAVE RAISED YOUR BLADE TO ME AND I WILL RAISE MY OWN.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the first boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Eris' killer in somewhere on the Dreadnaught. A Taken subjugator... I don't know who's doing the Taking now, but that's a problem for another mission. Let's hit this first. We left this place to rot, like a bad memory tarnishing Saturn's rings. Not a smart call, and it cost us too much.
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Taken power is pulsing through this place. It's... alive. Breathing.
The Guardian defeats the final boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Transmatting you out, Guardian. You fought hard, but the Dreadnaught fought back. If we're going to do this, then we need to change our tactics. We need to adapt.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the first boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: When Ikora heard what happened… Rage. It was rage. But she couldn’t just abandon the Tower. So Ikora sent us as her rage, Guardian. Let’s do her justice.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the second boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Dreadnaught’s always been dangerous. Any fireteam we send in takes on tremendous risk. The Vanguard kept it monitored, but bringing Oryx’s flagship under our control? We’d never hold it for long enough to matter. Well… sometimes, you do the impossible. You just have to cinch up your armor straps and get to work.
The Guardian defeats the final boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Eris always did whatever she set her mind to, regardless of the risk. And regardless of who told her no. I can respect that, but that risk gets an edge when you encounter something you’re not ready for. We can’t let ourselves be caught off guard again. We’re going to peel this place apart until there’s nowhere to hide another ambush.
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the first boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Drifter. You and Eris were close.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: That’s all you have to say?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: This was hard on all of us. You know you aren’t alone, right?

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: See, that’s the thing, Thunderguns. We try to distract ourselves from it, but… we’re all alone.
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the second boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I don’t believe we’re all alone, and neither do you. We’ve built a community in the City.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Not my community. There’s no use putting my life on the line for it.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Stop throwing chaff. You choose that community, every day. It’s why the loss hurts. Why it demands justice. So we take it and put that justice between us and our enemies.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I’d envy you… if you weren’t so damn gullible. Justice! Does justice keep your heart from collapsing? No! Never does.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You finish, and she’s still just gone.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the final boss.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: This isn’t what she would have wanted. You know that.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: What do you want? Some kinda sappy confession? I don’t do those! I’m not gonna say she made me a better person! That wasn’t on her. I am who I am! And I sure as hell ain’t gonna say, “She’s in a better place.” She fought to live! I saw it, in her eyes! She trusted me, and I failed her. That’s it! She’s dead! And I’m done talkin’.
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the first boss.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Whenever you dust a Taken, they get sent back to the Ascendant Plane; then they come right back to fight again. Only good thing is, they couldn't Take anymoe. Now they can, and no one here knows why.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether after defeating the second boss.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Here's something big about the Taken: they need someone to tell them what to do. Oryx, the Witness... bet Mara could grab 'em, too, if she wanted. Hell, even I can get ahold of 'em for Gambit. So, I got a question for you, killer: Who told them to murder Eris?
The Guardian defeats the final boss.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Eris wouldn't have wanted you to quit. And she didn't want me to quit, either. Probably why she said what she said. Keep us strong. I dunno if I... coulda been stronger. I died too. I... Only difference is that... I could wake up. To this. You know... you're the closest thing I got to a friend. Ain't that the saddest thing you ever heard?
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
Nether Mortem - Objective- Destroy Hostile forces or WIPE

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Stay focused, Guardian. Don't let your fear overwhelm you.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
Nether Mortem - Objective- Destroy Hostile forces or WIPE

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Taken suffocation. Control your fear, and find the source.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian readies to fight Lezrel, Eversion Channeler

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That Eversion Anchor is readying up! It's gonna spit out Taken all across the system!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: More Eversion Anchors. Shut it down, Guardian.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian readies to fight Herald of the Weapon

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Sterile neutrinos. The Dreadnaught's weapon systems are engaging.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
Objective- Defeat the Taken Cluster Keeper
The Guardian readies to fight Kelrosh, Spawn Keeper

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Hive have established a breeding ground. Clear it out, fireteam.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You riled up the nest's caretaker. Put it in the ground.
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian readies to fight Hashon of Endless Horrors

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: A Taken Chimera. Send this thing back to the Ascendant Plane.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Taken converging on your position, Guardian. Be ready.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats Kelrosh, Spawn Keeper

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Taken, Hive, Dread... don't matter to you, does it? Ha!

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Every enemy you put in the ground secures our hold on the Dreadnaught. Keep pushing.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We've got this area cleared. Resume operations.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats Herald of the Weapon

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Done and done. Keep moving, fireteam.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats Lezrel, Eversion Channeler

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We have this sector locked down. Keep digging, fireteam. This place is a maze.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian enters the Nether (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Heir presumptive. You have returned to my throne.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: My Dreadnaught tests you, heir-presumptive. Show me your sharpness.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Heir-presumptive, I make you sharp so that you may continue my logic and uphold my law. You will take up my mantle and become me. You will remove everything that can be removed. And you will bring extinction to your enemies, as I brought extinction to mine.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I am told that in my last life, I had a son. Crota, my sister tells me, came to your only moon and hollowed it with his throne. When you destroyed him, I brought my Dreadnaught to bear my High War upon this system. Is that what drove me here? Sentimental revenge? A waste of my logic. The dead deserve extinction.
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the final boss (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: What other heresies did I entertain as the years unfolded? What else, besides my death? Xivu Arath fails to test her strength out of fear of her own mortality. She wants me to turn away from our logic out of liar’s love. In my resurrection, I only see her failure. Hers, and mine. In you, I see the strength I had that can endure forever.
The Guardian defeats the first boss and enters the next area (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: WHY DOES OUR BROTHER REFUSE TO PICK UP HIS SWORD ONCE MORE, IN FLESH AND BONE?

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: I spoke to the Deep. If I truly died, then I am dead. Aiat. You followed a charlatan into heresy and lost your edge. What truth can you offer?

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: AN UNWORTHY SPEAKER, PUNISHED. A FALSE IDOL, UNSEATED. AND I WAS DETHRONED. AND YOU WERE DEAD. WHAT IS BEHIND IS TAINTED. WHAT IS FORWARD IS TRUTH. TITHES, AND SWORDS, AND ORYX, OUR KING.
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the second boss and enters the next area (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOU ARE HERE, WITH ME. WE MAY RETURN TO OUR PATH. WE MAY REJOIN OUR CONQUEST.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Then test me, sister. Destroy me. Are you afraid that you will fail? Or are you afraid you will succeed?
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the final boss (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: BROTHER! YOU WOULD LAY DOWN YOUR EXISTENCE FOR AN UNWORTHY SUCCESSOR! YOU WOULD MANTLE A LIAR. WHY? I WILL NOT LET YOU!

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: We agreed: if something greater comes to destroy us, then we do not deserve existence. I must be what I am, and I am defeated. My logic is true. This is proof eternal. And yet you deny it. That, sister, is heresy.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the first boss and enters the next area (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Knife of My Slaying, you walk these halls as heir-presumptive. Answer.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: The Guardian doesn’t want it. Doesn’t NEED it.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: This is what they are. There is nothing else they can become. The ruthless will drag them down to die, unless they become so. Unless they become free.
THE FOUNTS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the second boss and enters the next area (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Taken, yet you retain your will. Sword-bearer, Knight of the Deep. You defy your king.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I’m no Taken, and you’re no king. The universe is more complicated than you think. That’s why you failed, and your legacy died with you. I barely remember your name.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Hm. So you say. Yet here you are, vying for the remnants of my kingdom.
The Guardian defeats the final boss (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: The halls of my Dreadnaught are filled with the gleeful exploration of knives. They descend as I descended, carving their names into the Deep, where dead worms speak sharp truths.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Is that some sort of challenge? The Guardians killed you once, Oryx. They’ll kill you again.

lines.speaker: Echo of Navigation
lines.text: Let us discover that end together, then. Aiat.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether. (Act I, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Guardian. I mentioned that there's a new influence on the Taken. Like feedback over a comms channel. It's been getting stronger, and gaining clarity. Like a radio signal gradually tuning in. I didn't want to mention this until I was sure but... it has a familiar rhythm to it. A cadence. I'm not sure how, but I'm afraid a Dread commander gained access to the Taken. Keep this between us for now. I don't want to raise alarm unnecessarily. Just... keep your eyes open.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Dreadnaught is filled with terrors. Do not be afraid; staunch them at their source!
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian readies to fight Herald of the Weapon (Act II)

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Guardian! You must disempower the Dreadnaught's systems before its weapon can be readied.
THE MAUSOLEUM, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian readies to fight Kelrosh, Spawn Keeper (Act II)

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Taken corruption spreads to the Hive's spawn! Remove the infection and destroy its caretaker!
HALL OF SOULS, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian defeats the final boss (Act II)

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Well done, Guardian. Each blow dealt to the Dreadnaught holds the line against our enemies.
TRENCHWAY, THE DREADNAUGHT, RINGS OF SATURN
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 2)

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Sloane. Drifter tells me that you confronted him in the wake of my sudden absence.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: I may have lost my temper, but... He abandoned his post. That doesn't bother you?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It troubles me, yes. But he has returned to us, and to our goal. I believe that is what matters, regardless of what drives him. When all was lost, he sought the only thing he thought would give him comfort. Escape. When escape did not comfort him, he returned to face his guilt. I will not judge him for it.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 2)

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Oryx’s return instigated a grand schism in the Hive. They are shaken. They entertain the first doubt, the oldest doubt. They call it the “Entaoxuanna.” The doubt that will destroy them. The doubt that will undermine their core philosophy. Whatever happens must be so, but what must be so, is poison. Their king was slain, but his mantle went unassumed. Now he returns as a sword: wormless, resurrected, and without the strength of his brood. There is no greater heresy than this. His sisters know it. He knows it. And so, in this, Oryx wishes to begin again.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You know, Drifter kept me grounded when I came back from Titan. I was surprised he left.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Once, he would have killed himself again and again to avoid feeling a thing like grief. He has grown, but we can all fracture.

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: We need to be able to absorb hits like this without backsliding. How can we be sure he won't walk out again?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We cannot. All we can do is trust and heal.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: Losing you broke him. I should have realized how bad it was. I'll give him time.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: We all recoil sometimes when challenged. I have done the same. Isolate, throw myself into danger. Wallow. Rage. Is running worse than self-immolation?

lines.speaker: Sloane
lines.text: You did something with your grief. Helped humanity.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: It is grief all the same. That it did not inspire sacrifice in him is not a fault. Grief is a knife clutched in a closed fist, and he used it to harm himself. We must extend grace. That is all.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Hey, Eris. When you got all Hive-like to take on Xivu, I knew you’d be there when the job was done. I don’t doubt you now either, but… maybe you hang out back from now on. I can’t take that again. Please.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Your worry is sweet, but unnecessary. In my absence, I did not mean to cause such grief.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: I know you have your shiny new immortality palace, but… That’s just it. You’re bringing Oryx there. And I trust you, but…

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: You trust, but you fear. I understand your guilt. But I would have been aboard the Dreadnaught with or without you.

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: But I WAS there. And then I woke up to a world without you.

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: There is no blame for my death… nor your surviving it. I woke to a world of my own. Put down your fear, Drifter. You do not deserve such a burden.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: Keepin’ the Echo locked down is tough. I ain’t gonna tell you what you can and can’t do. Still, it could go sideways fast. But I’m here if it does. And so in Thunderguns. Taken King won’t one up us. I trust us. I trust you. We’ll get it done. And after…
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: SISTER! YOUR TRICKERY WOULD HAVE DENIED THE LIARS THEIR LIGHT. YOUR CUNNING COULD HAVE DENIED THEM THEIR SKY. YET YOU OPPOSE ME. YET YOU REFUSED THE FINAL SHAPE. YOU COURT EXTINCTION AS YOU INDULGE HERESY.
Savathûn: Aren't you tired, sister? That sword logic must be so heavy. I know you'd put it down, if you could. Don't you want to be on the right side of the blade when it falls?
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)

Savathûn: I needed you off the board, little sister. I knew that you would hide and lick your wounds without your throne. It kept you from invading the Traveler. It kept you away from the Witness' failure. Now I can extend a hand in familial love. Now that you need protecting, I can protect you.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOU REFUSED MY LOVE WHEN YOU GUIDED OUR HERETIC-SISTER TO HER THRONE. I REJECT YOU.
The Guardian explores the Nether (Act II, Week 3)
Savathûn: You were lied to, Xivu. Just like Oryx. Just like me.

lines.speaker: Xivu Arath
lines.text: YOUR WORDS LED US TO THE DEEP. YOUR CUNNING BROUGHT US POWER. NOW YOU ASK US TO RELINQUISH IT? NOW YOU AKS US TO TURN AWAY FROM THE LOGIC THAT HAS HELD US SINCE WE TOOK OUR MORPHS? REMEMBER, SISTER: WE WOULD HAVE BEEN EATEN AS PREY. WE WOULD HAVE BEEN DROWNED BY THE GOD WAVE.
Savathûn: That was long ago. Now look at it this way: unless you escape this game, you'll be worm good. And no one wants that.
The Guardian fails to defeat the Hostile Forces (Act II, Week 3)

lines.speaker: Drifter
lines.text: That's it, bringing you back. Head in when you're ready, hero.
Rites of the Deep | Court of Blades: Xivu & Oryx

lines.speaker: The Leviathan Returns
lines.text: Commune with the Crown of Sorrow
The Drowning Labyrinth | Third-Tier Initiate: Rhulk's Experimental Hive Worms

title: The Nexus — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Far below the Ishtar Academy, the Vex have set something in motion, a world-eating machine transforming Venus into another link in their intergalactic chain. This Nexus must be stopped and the Mind that controls it, destroyed.
Fireteam enter N/Gen Branch, Ishtar Academy
Fireteam head for Ishtar Research Lab, Dig Site 4

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We're getting close. I'm detecting a massive surge from the dig site below us.
Fireteam go deeper into Dig Site 4

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's got to be the Nexus!

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: One tendril of the Vex surge has been severed. But their presence here still grows in other dark places, far out of our reach. We must continue to understand their power and haunt the realms where they gather.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The New Kell — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Variks. The power Eramis used to trap you. Was that…

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Darkness? Yes. We call it Stasis. Power in opposition to your Light, given by the Pyramid.

[insect-like chattering] It led Eramis astray. Europa was to be a haven for Eliksni. But Stasis corrupted her. With it, she turns obsession into opportunity, working in haste to empower Eliksni with the Dark gift. If Eramis is not stopped, she will build an army capable of snuffing out the Light, once and for all. [insect-like chattering]

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is what remains of Eventide, Clovis Bray's Europan colony. Built to house those who came to build Exo… and to become them. So you came to Europa to what? Hide from the Vanguard?

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Variks knows of the "elephant in the room." Cayde-6's death was not my intention. No day passes without regret. I will answer for these crimes. [insect-like chattering] But not before my people are safe from Eramis.
The Guardian uses a lift to access the Fallen city.
The Guardian approaches an overlook of the Dark Empire's city.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That dome, is that where you live?

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: A pinnacle of hope for the remaining Eliksni, but a standing reminder of Eramis's betrayal of Variks. [insect-like chattering]
Heavy Shank, House Salvation appears. The Guardian defeats the Heavy Shank. Ghost disables the Fallen barrier.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I feel it again — the energy I felt earlier. It must have been Eramis using Stasis.
The Guardian approaches a barrier with an unfamiliar seal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Darkness trail Eramis left behind leads right through that door. But it's locked.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: [insect-like chattering] With Stasis, yes. You will not be able to break through.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Then we'll find another way around.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: … you're all here for the same reason. Because you desire freedom for our people. And I can give you just that.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Eramis is close. She's ours now.
The Guardian spies on Eramis as she showcases the Darkness to the House of Salvation.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Chains! For centuries we have been bound by them. Servants to the so-called "Great" Machine. We even built idols in its image. We have become pawns of our own devices. No. Longer. [shouts]
Eramis freezes the Servitor behind her.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Today… we begin breaking free from our chains. [grunts]
Eramis shatters the Servitor. The Fallen congregation below Eramis are astounded by her actions.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: This power is a gift. One I will share with all of you, in time. Phylaks!
Phylaks approaches the Crux of Darkness.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: One by one, we will rise again.
Phylaks receives a Splinter of Darkness and attaches it to her armor. Phylaks summons a wall of Stasis in front of the Fallen congregation.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: This is our future! Our enemies stand no chance against this power. The Great Machine will finally know our pain!
The Fallen congregation chants approval of Eramis and the power of Darkness. A Dreg points out the Guardian's position to Eramis.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: It would appear our enemies have arrived, eager to test us. Let's not keep them waiting.
The Guardian searches for an escape from Riis-Reborn.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Oh no, this — I can feel it. It's too powerful!

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Eramis has begun spreading Stasis to her army. You must get out now!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm calling our ship. Let's go!
The Guardian eliminates Fallen while evading and surviving Phylaks’s use of Stasis, and exits the building into the Fallen City.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They actually have Darkness. The Fallen. This is really bad.
The Guardian emerges from the building to find more Fallen soldiers.
The Guardian fights through the Fallen to their ship.
The Guardian returns to Variks after escaping Riis-Reborn.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Variks believed Eramis wished to create a new life for the Eliksni. But these dark powers have poisoned her mind. And so I fled from her. For this, she calls me betrayer. [insect-like chattering] There are others who fled. Those, like me, who still worship the Great Machine. They are in hiding. I will not leave them behind. They will be casualties in her war without our help. But perhaps they can be brought to safety. [insect-like chattering]
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Plaguelands — Transcript

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: The Iron Lords believed we could contain SIVA by destroying the chamber where it was produced. These Fallen must have restarted the process. We need to get back in to the chamber and cut off the flow of SIVA at the source.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: I think we need to focus on what we know. The Fallen have occupied a military bunker in the Plaguelands. We won't get any reinforcements until the Fallen's artillery is taken out.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: The Fallen are a symptom. SIVA is the disease.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: All right. Vanguard reinforcements are standing by, but until those guns are down they can't leave the hangar. I need you to shut them down.
Guardian, there's a dead Vandal near you. Can you get me a scan?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: He's Fallen, basically, but armour is enhanced, weapons have been modified, cybernetic enhancements.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Most Fallen Houses have a sect dedicated to this sort of thing. They're called Splicers. They're like body hackers, bioengineers.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: It is worse than I feared. The Splicers are not only using SIVA to transform this place, they are using its technology to transform themselves.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Fallen have done some… remodelling.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: They're taking the metal for something big. Hope they're not using it to toughen up those gun emplacements.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: I've never seen the Fallen do anything on this scale before. I'm calling for more reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: You said yourself reinforcements will be useless until the guns are down. Besides, they will not be prepared for what they'll find.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I thought SIVA was technology, but this... It's like something alive. Growing. Out of control.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: These Devil Splicers are using SIVA, but they cannot control it. They are like children with a new toy.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I don't know of any toys that eat Russian industrial complexes.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Those guns were destroyed during the Collapse! How did the Fallen—

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Maybe it's not, but the Fallen are the ones pulling the triggers out here. The Vanguard wants them taken down? We take them down.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ok, just to be clear: I don't like creepy tech that spreads like a virus. It gives people the wrong idea about artificial lifeforms.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Detecting a high concentration of SIVA shielding the gun emplacements.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Even SIVA-enhanced shields would require and energy source. But be careful... There's something familiar about all this.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Right! Destroy the familiar generators, then take down Shiro's zombie guns.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That's it! Shield is collapsing. You should be clear
If I didn't know better I'd say the Splicers were creating a beachhead. Something of this scale could be used against the City.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: So, those destroyed guns? SIVA undestroyed them.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Look for a central SIVA node inside those emplacements! Destroy that, and it will break the Fallen's hold on the gun!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Get ready! Fallen are sending in reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Keep it going! Air support is standing by, but they can't do much while those guns are still up.

lines.speaker: Shiro
lines.text: Great job! Hawks are inbound! Just hold the area until they get there!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Uh, Shiro, I'm pretty sure that air support isn't going to get here in time.
Fallen drop Perfected Walker and reinforcements
Guardian counter attacks huge Fallen reinforcements

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: It's directing the corruption to resurrect the guns!

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Centuries passed and I have learned nothing. Shiro, can your forces secure that area?

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: Try. I need the Guardian to return to the Temple. If we are to avoid the mistakes which led us here, we and I must speak about the fall of the Iron Lords.
The Iron Temple, Old Russia, Earth

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: This may not make sense to you, but it took your fight to remind me that immortality is not the same as invincibility.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: When the Ghosts first found us, those who where chosen were blessed with power, but not wisdom.
The Iron Lords came together in search of a solution to mankind's struggles. Instead, we found SIVA.
We dreamt of using SIVA to build starships, colonies. We would become what the Traveler always believed we could be.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: SIVA had been lost to time. When Timur tracked it to the Cosmodrome, we thought our quest was finally over. SIVA would be ours for the taking.

More than a hundred Iron Lords entered the Plaguelands. [In the end] only nine reached the replication chamber. But since we were chosen by the Traveller and our cause was just, we were certain the day would be ours. Until SIVA took control.
It infected our weapons. Our armour. The corruption puppeted us against one another.
In the end, Jolder sealed the chamber with the Iron Lords inside, rather than let SIVA escape. A battle was won. Heroes died. And our mistakes stayed here.

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: This is not Rasputin. But neither is it something I know how to fight. They are using SIVA in ways we never even imagined.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: How would the Fallen have learned more about SIVA than the Iron Lords? Or, better yet, where did they learn?

lines.speaker: Saladin
lines.text: They haven't mastered SIVA yet. This is all still new to them...
See Tyra. She's studied SIVA's origins. If there's a way to track the Fallen's discoveries, she will know where to look.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Promethean Code — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: Stealing from Rasputin… you are entering a world you do not understand.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Don't worry about her Guardian. She's still mad about what you did to her ship. We need cloaking tech to slip past the Taken and the Warmind bunker's got the code we need.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: After all this time, how can we be sure Rasputin has the code?

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I already stole it once. Used my last copy making that stealth drive you blew up. It was getting old anyway.
Walking down to the Rasputin's bunker entrance

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I haven't had much luck breaching Rasputin's security.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: You've got the same byass frequency that got me inside.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: More interdimensional goo. The Taken are here.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: What? Not possible. We sealed the complex after the Omnigul breach.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Oh, that does look bad. Okay, so if you see 'em, ah, just shoot 'em.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: How did they even get in there?

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: The Taken are not bound by terrestrial constraints.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Yeah, I bet they'll be constrained by terrestrial bullets.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I can't believe the Taken can track us so easily. Oryx really does hate us.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Which is exactly why we're here. We need those cloaking codes.
The Guardian defeats the Taken in the control room.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Alright, see what you can pull out of Rasputin. Hmm, there's a joke there somewhere.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These cryptosystems follow no logic I understand. I'm not sure if it can be modified to work on a Guardian.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Where do you think Bladedancers got their cloaking ability? [Grab the codes, I'll upload my modifications.]

lines.speaker: Eris Morn
lines.text: If the Vanguard are satisfied, we can finally end this. Return to the moon. Steal Crota's soul.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Revelry Begins — Transcript

lines.text: Bazaar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Eva Levante
lines.text: Welcome to the Revelry, my friend. In the City, spring is a time for ordinary people to celebrate the simple fact that we are alive. However dark the night may grow, we are still here! Still standing. I want to share this tradition with the Tower. You Guardians must never forget the power of joy. So, please! Revel! Revel in being alive! Break some rules. And most of all… Have fun. Happiness is fleeting. We must cherish it where we can find it.
The Guardian receives the Reveler's Tonic from Eva Levante.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Shadow Thief — Transcript

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Taniks has no House. He kneels before no banner, owes allegiance to no Kell. He is a murderer, and very good at what he does.
I have been tracking him since Wolves broke their chains, yes? Now Taniks works for Wolf pack…but not for long.
Fireteam arrive at the Temple of Crota

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Taniks has been sent to plunder the Hive. Your job just as simple. Avenge the dead. Stop him from stealing the Dark.
Fireteam proceed through the Temple, fighting Hive &amp; Fallen

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Watch yourself. Taniks is no common mercenary. He fights to fulfil a contract and hone his combat skill for…fun.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Lift field distortion! Ketch just above you.
Fireteam surrounded by Fallen, Taniks appears

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Taniks has called you out, Guardian. You are challenged, in the ways of old.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Taniks is jamming our comms. Fight well, Guardian. Fight for honour.
Fireteam fight Fallen in Traitor's Ketch

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Notorious mercenary dead. No small matter. You will be rewarded treasure from the Queen. And my respect, as well.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Ruling House — Transcript

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The House of Kings is unique among the Fallen. They are secretive, dangerous. They hide in the shadow of the Cosmodrome. Waiting. Plotting. If Skolas can bring the House of Kings under his banner, we’re all in trouble. I’m game...damn. I’m getting a lot of interference down there. Hold tight. Guardian.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Guardian, I’m losing you. Try to find the source of interference and stop it.
Variks, the Loyal: Skolas jamming signals with High Servitors. Reef War Tactic, advanced warfare. May fool Petra. Does not fool me. I shall be your guide.
Variks, the Loyal: Servitor is source of interference. Kill it dead.
Variks, the Loyal: Signal’s still corrupted. Wolves must have second Servitor. Push forward, find the source.
Variks, the Loyal: I was House Judgment scribe to House Wolves. Skolas was vicious, even for a Fallen Kell. I could not stomach his hate.
Variks, the Loyal: It is good to work with you, with Petra. All that are Fallen are not lost, yes? Signal close can you see it?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Excellent! Whatever you did, your signal’s coming through loud and clear now. Variks, are you with us?
Variks, the Loyal: Yes, yes. I am here. Kings will see Wolf pack as well. They will not be pleased.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Wolves are approaching old command center beyond the Rocketyard. That must be where the Kings are hidden.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: At the battle of Twilight Gap the Devils, the Kings and the House of Winter joined forces to take on the City. The House of Wolves could have turned the tide for the Fallen, but my Queen interfered.
Variks, the Loyal: You are here to deny Skolas House Kings. They will not know. And they would not care. They will try to kill you. Kill them back.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I’m detecting lots of activity from the command center. I think you dropped the Servitor jamming just in time.
Variks, the Loyal: If Kings detected House Wolves before attack, Skolas may have met his match.
Yavek, Wolf Baron; Paskin, King Baron; Vekis, King Baron gather around a projection of the Traveler
Yavek, Wolf Baron; Paskin, King Baron; Vekis, King Baron defeated

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Wolves are dead, and the Kings...well they’re still a danger to the City, but at least they don’t work for Skolas. I call that a win. Come on back, Guardian.

title: The Speaker — Transcript

lines.text: Tower North, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: There was a time… when we were much more powerful… But that was long ago. Until it wakes and finds its voice, I am the one who speaks for the Traveler. You must have no end of questions, Guardian. In its dying breath the Traveler created the Ghosts, to seek out those who can wield its Light as a weapon - Guardians, to protect us, and do what the Traveler itself no longer can.

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: I could tell you of the great battle, centuries ago… how the Traveler was crippled. I could tell you of the power of the Darkness, its ancient enemy. There are many tales, told throughout the City to frighten children. Lately those tales have stopped. Now… the children are frightened anyway. The Darkness is coming back. We will not survive it this time.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Its armies surround us. The Fallen are just the beginning.

lines.speaker: The Speaker
lines.text: You must push back the Darkness. Guardians are fighting on Earth and beyond… join them. Your Ghost will guide you. I only hope he chose wisely.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I did… I'm sure of it. We're in this together now.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: The Ritual — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Traveler! Ikora, the Traveler is already here. I think we're too late.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: We are in the domain of the god of cunning. Things are never what they seem. It's not too late. I can feel it.
The Guardian enters the outskirts of Savathûn's fortress.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Now that the Traveler sees what Savathûn is doing, why won't it take the Light away from her? Why is it just letting this happen?

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: I don't know why. We may never know. But we know what we need to do to protect the Last City. Stop the ritual. Protect our connection to the Light. Humanity needs you. Both of you.
The Guardian continues into the Florescent Canal.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Scorn are flocking to the fortress because of the ritual. The Hive are summoning heavy reinforcements from the portal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: That will block our route into the fortress.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Hold off the Hive and the Scorn as long as you can, and leave the portal to me. I'm on my way.
The Guardian fights off Scorn and Hive. A portal blocks the doorway forward. A large Ogre emerges from the portal.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Hold your fire, Guardian! I've got this.
A drop ship flies past and Ikora transmats out of it. Ikora hovers in the air and throws a Nova Bomb at the Ogre, killing it.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Go on! I'll draw fire here. All that matters right now is the Traveler. Whatever you hear, whatever you see, don't let it distract you from stopping the ritual.
Ikora fires a Chaos Reach beam at the portal, which disappears. Ikora maintains the beam as the Guardian proceeds through the doorway and up a stairway.
Court of Thorns, Savathûn's Throne World

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: The Scorn are arriving by the hundreds. The ritual must be growing stronger. Remember the plan, Guardian. Stop the ritual by whatever means necessary. Without the Light, the Last City is defenseless.
The Guardian battles through Hive and enters the fortress.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The ritual is happening at the top of the fortress. We need to find a way up.
The Guardian follows Hive glyphs and proceeds through a series of portals, climbing higher.

Savathûn: You're back! What a surprise. Only joking. This throne world is indistinguishable from my own mind, Guardian. Every step taken, every bullet fired, every thought whispered... I keep and count them all. Remember that.
The Guardian battles through Hive and ascends to the top of the fortress.
Sanctum of the Brood Queen, Savathûn's Throne World
Savathûn: I'm so glad you're here to see this.
The Guardian battles Savathûn and several Lightbearer Hive. As Savathûn falls, her Ghost appears vulnerable.
The Guardian approaches the Ghost, and becomes Threadbound and is unable to reach the Ghost. Savathûn is resurrected and teleports away.
Savathûn: Fight, run, fight, run. The pattern is always the same for you. Don't you ever get tired of it? Don't you want to escape?
A bridge appears across the nearby water. The Guardian walks across it.

Savathûn: Little Ghost... you were asked to accept the Darkness. Asked to turn against your cousins. Asked to defy the will of the Traveler. My Ghosts make no concessions. We serve the Traveler's true interests.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No concessions? How stupid do you think I am? You and your siblings, you killed my friends! I remember Crota, and the Great Disaster! I remember Oryx and the Taken! I remember what you did to the Awoken and the Dreaming City! I'll never forget what happened to Sagira. To Osiris. I would die before I ever chose to help the Hive.
The Guardian battles with Savathûn but cannot do significant damage.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: She's too powerful! What do we do? We have to reactivate that portal to access the memory altar. Showing her the truth won't stop her, but we need to try.
Projections of Savathûn appear. The Guardian defeats them to disrupt the ritual and open the portal.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: This is a spell. Savathûn is spinning a web around the Traveler. We have to free it. The tethers are coming from those towers. Find a way to reach them.
The Guardian defeats a Threadweaver wizard. Threads fall away from the Traveler.
Savathûn: What do you think you're going to do? You can't stop this. I know it goes against your nature, but you can still lose gracefully.
The Guardian places the Worm on the memory altar. An image appears of Sathona cradling a Worm.

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: [whispers] These frail siblings will soon be claimed by the Light... unless we claim them first.
Savathûn: What is this? How did you —

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: We will tell the most cunning sibling of a cataclysm. A prophecy of great loss.
Savathûn: No... no, that's not what happened. The Traveler never came to us. We were forced to choose the Deep. How could I have missed this? So now you want to play games? Then let's play.
The Guardian is teleported back to the courtyard at the end of the bridge. The Guardian once again battles Savathûn and enters the portal.
Savathûn: So you're the expert now? The expert on me, on the Hive, on trickery. Is that what you really think?
The Guardian defeats more Threadweavers and places the Worm on the memory altar. An image appears of Sathona cradling a Worm.

lines.speaker: The Witness
lines.text: [whispers] We will feed her fear. Her pride.
Savathûn: Go on, then. You know so much? Tell me who I am!
The Guardian is teleported back to the courtyard, engages Savathûn, and is unable to significantly damage Savathûn.
The Guardian defeats Threadweavers to gain the power to harm Savathûn. The Guardian defeats Savathûn.

title: The Summoning Pits — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Something dark stirs in the depths of the Hellmouth; we can feel it. A Hive abomination bred for unthinkable evil. We must pierce the veil of their Summoning Pits, and destroy this creature before the Hive unleash it upon us all.
Hellmouth, Ocean of Storms, Earth's Moon

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's no telling how far down we'll have to go to find the Summoning Pits.
The Gatehouse, Ocean of Storms, Earth's Moon

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We need to get through. I'll try to open that gate.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: A triptych of Hive runes...said to be uncrackable...

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They know we're here—I'll get to work!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'm starting to sense a pattern! Shouldn't be long.
Mormu, Xol Spawn appears and is defeated
The Summoning Pits, Ocean of Storms, Earth's Moon
Phogoth, the Untamed is chained in the center of the room. Hive jump from all directions

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Well, at least it's chained up.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Finally. The abomination has been destroyed. The Vanguard will be grateful.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: A creature of the Dark has been slain, and our worlds spared another atrocity. But how many more Hive abominations are still out there? Growing among the Darkness? I fear we may find out all too soon.
The Taken Path | A Hammer’s Path

title: The Ritual: Death of the Witch Queen — Transcript

lines.text: Sanctum of the Brood Queen, Savathûn's Throne World
Savathûn falls to the ground after her battle with the Guardian.

Savathûn: Isn't this interesting? I miscalculated. So did you, Guardian. So protective of your Traveler... that you wouldn't let me keep it safe. But the Witness is coming. The game is yours to play now. Yours to win... or lose. Just don't say I didn't warn you.
Savathûn dies. Immaru looks over her body. The Traveler escapes the throne world. Immaru disappears in a flash of Light.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: No... Where did her Ghost go?

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Guardian! I just got the message: the Traveler is back in the Last City. Is it done? Is Savathûn... ?

lines.speaker: The Guardian
lines.text: She's dead. But her Ghost got away.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Good enough. Hold your position. The Hidden are coming to secure the remains. Good work, Guardian. You did the right thing.

lines.speaker: The Guardian
lines.text: Now... we prepare for the Witness and stop the next Collapse.
Decision Point - Stand with the Vanguard

title: The Sundial — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Welcome to the Sundial, Guardian. The Red Legion seek to wipe away all of our accomplishments and replace them with their own. Reteach them the failures of their past.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: This is where your work begins. Gain access to the Sundial. Acquaint yourself with the timelines the Red Legion have wished into existence. Their ambitions should alarm you.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Sundial awaits you, Guardian. Normally, I suggest treading lightly through the halls of time. But we cannot hesitate. Foil the Cabal's scheme. Leave only destruction in your wake.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Red Legion is using the Sundial to bend history to their whims. Their actions cannot go unchecked.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Consider what you see as an alternate reality that has not yet come to pass. The Red Legion work to solidify this reality. Show them again how easily their work can be swept away.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Acclimate yourself, Guardian. You have faced horrors before. You have torn the Legion down and seen their banners break. Do it again. Steady. Focused. Onward.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Fractured and leaderless as they are, I do not know how the Red Legion conceived such a clever plan. Have these Psions united them?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Red Legion Psions have co-opted the Sundial for their nefarious purposes. I have often wondered who truly mans the helm of the Red Legion's ship: the Cabal or their so-called "conquered" Psions.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Red Legion jealously guard the Sundial. It is their only hope for changing their fate. You must open the way to their timelines and destroy them.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Cabal are using the Sundial to rewind their fate, to rewrite their defeat as a victory. You must punish their ambition.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Red Legion dislike the hand they were dealt. Unfortunately for them, history is written by the victor. I intend the victor to be you.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian. Time has been split open by the Red Legion. Move quickly and root out these interlopers before their plans reach permanence.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, the broken ranks of the Red Legion mean to reverse their fortunes. They've seized the Sundial to write themselves a new history. See that they fail.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: The Psion you see before you keeps this fraudulent timestream open. You have your target. Hunt, and cut down any obstruction.

lines.speaker: Osiris
