title: Wayfinder's Voyage I: The Plan — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian faces a transmitter next to the Wayfinder’s Compass; a hologram of Petra Venj appears.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Queen Mara has already told you we must recover our lost Techeuns in order to free Savathûn from her servitude to the worm gods. I will tell you how. Imagine the universe as a set of coins, stacked one on top of the other. The top coin is our reality. The bottom: the Ascendant Plane. Between them lies an intermeshing of ever-shifting pathways known as the Ley Lines. Almost all the ancient pathways are now defunct, but beings of paracausal ability can navigate and rebuild them. This is the art of Wayfinding. We know our lost Techeuns are stranded somewhere among the Ley Lines, and they're leaving us markers to follow. I'm forwarding you the coordinates to the first marker. It should tell us which Ley Line to look in. Then we'll use the Blind Well to tear open a rift and send you through to find them. Xivu Arath is desperate to capture her sister. Her forces, which now include the Taken, will attempt to stop you at every turn. Listen. I know your Crow intends to accompany you. Mara also wants him close. Our Techeuns went to retrieve Queen Mara on my orders. This can't fail. Not because of him.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage II: Interrogation — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian enters the portal to Queen Mara Sov's chambers in the Dreaming City.
Mara Sov's Chambers, The Dreaming City
The Guardian approaches the cocoon containing Savathûn, who speaks.

Savathûn: I knew you'd be back. I'm so glad we get to talk. You and that charming little Ghost of yours; you're not like the rest. You're not afraid of my words. Words are just thoughts given shape. Ideas emerging into the physical world, birthed by a mouth. Not good or evil, not Light or Dark, or this or that. And you understand, don't you? Despite the excruciatingly binary worldview of those around you. You don't have to say it. We've all heard it before: "The line between Light and Dark is so very thin." As if you were so incapable of lifting your eyes from a scrawl of chalk on the ground... The Traveler and the Light near one foot, your old enemies and the Darkness at the other. Let me tell you a secret. If you ever want to see what's been watching you since the very beginning, just stand on that line, and look... up.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage II: Summoned by Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Wayfinder's Compass to receive a briefing from Mara Sov.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: I know you have reservations about my arrangement with Savathûn. I feel it in your heart. For all her clever machinations, the Witch Queen did not anticipate your success in stopping Quria or the Endless Night. Her schemes unravel, and now she needs my protection from Xivu Arath. From the worm gods. From you. I have already learned much by observation: the Taken pursued her here. Taken she once controlled. Taken that now serve a new master. Or, if Savathûn is to be believed, their original master. Not her brother, Oryx, but something far older. She fears it. It commands Xivu Arath to conquer the Ascendant space surrounding the Dreaming City... To use the Taken in her campaign against us... for now. Savathûn claims that without the Taken, she cannot break the curse she placed on the Dreaming City. She thinks she can entice me with these half-truths and secret temptations. But she underestimates the lengths to which I will go to correct the past.

I want to explain why I did what I did. I want him to know that my affection is true. Because the less he knows, the more vulnerable he is. But with Mara back, I can finally see the end approaching. It's been a long time coming. There are still Techeuns in need of your strength. title: Wayfinder's Voyage III: Summoned by Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Wayfinder's Compass to receive a briefing from Mara Sov.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: We Awoken were born of Light, and Dark. Our perspective on the universe is a complex one. The Light is not inherently good, as your Warlords of the Dark Age so clearly demonstrated. In spite of Zavala's preconceptions, Darkness is not inherently evil. Some among you already discovered this on Europa. In my travels, I have seen true evil. It is the worm gods that the Hive serve. It is the Black Fleet, waiting to strike. It is the Entity that commands them all: the Voice in the Darkness. These creatures are not evil because they wield Darkness. They are evil because — like Savathûn and Xivu Arath — they are cruel, hateful things with no regard for the lives of others. Some might say that includes me as well. I will let history be the judge of my guilt. Before that judgment is cast, I will see my Techeuns returned. Perhaps with them, I can save us all.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage IV: Interrogation — Transcript

Mara Sov's Chambers, The Dreaming City
The Guardian approaches the cocoon containing Savathûn, who speaks.

Savathûn: I've been thinking about family quite a bit, what with all the spare time I have. It might surprise you to hear, but everything my siblings and I have done has been for each other. Even though the Vanguard isn't quite the same, they're no different at heart. You'd do anything for your family, chosen or otherwise. Go to any lengths to avenge them. Look at the Crow and Queen Mara. Siblings, bonded by cosmic fate, forever orbiting one another like binary stars... Mara reminds me of my sister. She's afraid. Holding on so tightly because she can't bear to lose one more thing... But we all have to let go. When I am separated from my worm, I'll be separated from Xivu Arath too. And then my sister will be alone. The last of us. But as much as I care for her... I cannot stay like this.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage IV: Summoned by Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: Each Ascendant beacon you reawaken reclaims a road once lost to me. Broadens my sight. But my realm still aches. Savathûn has done so much to destroy everything my people worked for. She stole my brother from me, twisted his mind, and delivered him to his executioners. Then she had the audacity to steal him from the Traveler, manipulate him, and... lead him back home. It is strange, having him here. And yet, not. Crow is a wounded bird, flinching away from me. So much like Uldren, but lost without a guiding man. Do you understand why I forbade him from speaking with Savathûn? This reunion is such... cruel kindness. I will find a way to repay her for it. And you will continue to bring me the Techeuns I need to do so.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage III: Unauthorized Access — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian returns to the H.E.L.M. and approaches the portal to Mara Sov's Chambers. Petra Venj and Crow stand facing each other in front of the portal. Petra's arms are crossed. Glint hovers behind Crow.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Osiris was like family to me!

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: I know. Just let me speak to Savathûn. Please.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: No. I won't give that witch another chance to dig her claws into you.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: You know I am. Savathûn is already in your head. You're a liability to the mission.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Why do you have such a problem with me, Petra? Five minutes. That's all I'm asking.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Queen of the Reef forbids it.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Well, I don't take commands from the Queen of the Reef.
Petra uncrosses her arms and takes a wider stance, leaning toward Crow.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Savathûn unraveled the Dreaming City with a single wish; I've spent years trying to contain that mistake. Better men than you died because of it.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: To my ear, it sounds like you're the liability. Maybe your queen's trust in you was misplaced.

Petra lunges forward and holds her knife close to Crow's throat. Crow leans slightly away from the knife but keeps his feet planted. Glint bobs forward, floating nearly between the two and looking back and forth between them.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: A knife against a Hunter? [softly chuckles] I'd be more careful who you pick fights with.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Another step, and my Corsairs will have to prepare you a second grave.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Save it for the Hive! Both of you. This isn't getting us anywhere.
Petra withdraws the knife and takes a step back.

lines.speaker: Glint
lines.text: Thank you. We could all probably use a minute to cool off —
Crow turns and transmats away as Glint finishes.
Glint transmats away in the same direction. Petra addresses the Guardian.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Keep both eyes on that one.
Petra departs in the direction of the portal.

You've done a lot of killing over the years… Let me ask you something. Of all the enemies you've fought, how many saw your Ghost and realized, "Ah! That's why Guardians are so strong!" lines.text: We are surrounded. A ring of spears pointing inward from the edges of our system. The Black Fleet could have destroyed us, and yet they have waited. Why? Savathûn knows more than she lets on. It is the only reason she still lives, and she is keenly aware of that fact. It is why Xivu Arath pursues her so relentlessly, for Xivu Arath answers to the same entity as the Black Fleet. We must uncover whatever secrets she knows with the time that we have. I must reiterate: she will try to betray us. It is all that a wretched, self-serving creature like Savathûn knows how to do. She needs me to free herself of her worm, but after that... The Blind Well requires alignment. As you rescue my remaining Techeuns, continue your audiences with her. How did Misraaks put it? "We must all learn to live alongside our monsters." You should thank me. Just imagine if it had come from someone with bad intentions. Someone who could have colored the truth about how he died to turn him against you. Against the Traveler. But I would never do such a thing. I see too much of myself in him. We were both looking for our purpose. Now that the Crow has found his as a Guardian, he can see it for what it truly is. lines.text: You were kind to me. I thought you were my friend.

title: We Stand Unbroken I: Briefing from Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I sensed your triumph through the choke of the Pyramid's suppression. With the Scepter in hand, you were able to move through the depths of the Ascendant Plane. It is as I hoped. Your Light sings with the incantations I send forth, strengthening you in ways not seen since the seven Paladins. Since the Queensguard. Powerful as I am, I cannot be everywhere at once. But the Guardians can. So, I entrust you with my favor. Take it. Breach the Ascendant Plane, walk the Ley Lines within, and banish those who would oppose you. I do not ask for fealty in return. I would not kneel in your place, as favor with condition remains a shackle. No. Claim this power freely, as your strength serves my kingdom and your own. Let it flow through you, Queensguard… and I shall knight you myself.
Awaken, Queensguard: Briefing from Devrim Kay
Awaken, Queensguard: Infiltrate the Pyramid outpost in the EDZ

title: We Stand Unbroken I: Debriefing from Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: When the Last City called for aid, I pledged the Awoken to the cause without hesitation. The Vanguard has helped my people many times in the past. But what you face now is no simple endless curse or vengeful god-king. We Awoken were first struck when we came between the Traveler and its hunter, and I chose my people above either one. The choice has come again, and my answer is no different. I do not blindly defend the Light, and I do not listen to the Voice in the Darkness. Instead, I choose that which holds Light and Dark together in hands and heart. I choose you. Now… Humans, Exos, cousins all… Detach. Fall forward. Number among the first. Awaken… as Queensguard.
Wayfinder's Voyage V: Summoned by Mara Sov

title: Wayfinder's Voyage VII: Summoned by Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian approaches the Wayfinder's Compass to receive a briefing from Mara Sov.

lines.speaker: Queen Mara Sov
lines.text: When I first saw Crow, I looked into his mind. I did not see my brother’s memories. Savathûn dredged them from a place beyond my grasp when she revealed his past life to him. She suspects I do not mean to let her live once the separation ritual is complete, and is testing our patience. Perhaps she means only to hurt me. The risk of her cunning is too great, no matter her intentions. Until the conditions are right for us to exorcise her worm, I am restricting all access to Savathûn. I will, however, afford you one last meeting to conclude your investigations before I seal her away. Steel your kind when you face her, Guardian. The Witch Queen is no less dangerous now than she has ever been. We have one last Techeun to locate. Go forth.

title: We Stand Unbroken II: Debriefing from Devrim Kay — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Hello, Guardian! Though I suppose I should hail you as a fellow Queensguard now. When Mara performed her ritual, she knighted all of us, with and without the Light. You Lightbearers are the only ones who can draw on her power, of course. But for the rest of us, like Ms. Holliday and… Mr. Mithrax? It's nice to be included. "Sir Devrim Kay, Queensguard." Mmm. Quite like the sound of that. I think when the Witness did… whatever it did to the Traveler, it sought to destroy our hope at the source. That didn't happen. Humans and Eliksni, officers and civilians—we banded together, stronger than before. That's what our enemies don't understand: when things are at their worst, that's when we are at our best. I'm looking forward to the battles ahead.

title: We Stand Unbroken II: Briefing from Amanda Holliday — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hey, Guardian. Been meaning to thank you for busting us all out of prison earlier. I heard you came back from Neptune just to help us out. It's near enough to make a girl tear up! [chuckles, then sighs] You wanna know what really got to me? At the Farm, I heard some of the folks I was locked up with asking when they could get back out and look for more survivors. I mean, I expect it from Guardians and the other pilots, but… these were civvies, just folks who got caught up in the Shadow Legion sweep. They still wanted to help. I asked Mithrax to talk some sense into 'em, but he shrugged, like, three of his arms and said, "The Witness created heroes instead of victims." [laughs] I couldn't have said it better myself. Anyway, Shadow Legion's been sighted in the Cosmodrome. Probably trying to pick up new prisoners. C'mon. Let's go be heroes.
Wayfinder's Voyage V: Summoned by Mara Sov

title: We Stand Unbroken III: Briefing from Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Hail, Queensguard. I felt you reaching out. You shine as a beacon of ascendant power. Maintaining my connection is demanding, but by observing your astral wake… I am discovering ways through the Ley Lines that have never been charted before. As you move through the Ascendant Plane, you consecrate it on a paracausal level. Its borders fray and yield to your touch. The corruption within withers as you approach. For someone of your ability, one step through that darkness can equal a thousand on this plane—ten thousand. Ten million. A Shadow Legion prison ship drifts above us, amidst the stars, far beyond our range… or so they believe. Come to me, and I shall open a path. Show them… nothing is outside your reach.

title: We Stand Unbroken III: Speak with Amanda and Mithrax — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hey, Guardian! We were just grabbin' a little downtime. Gotta celebrate your successes, y'know?

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Amanda told me we must not forget to… "kick it back." [chuckles] Ah, we have accomplished much, and saved many lives.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's right. There's no I in team, but there is an A and an M. …Please don't tell folks I said that. But yeah, we're a team! Any door I can't hack open, you splice through. We are in this together!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: It is a privilege to join you. You and the Vanguard welcomed us as honored guests in your City.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Guests? The City is your home! When I first showed up at the gates, I felt like I belonged. That's how it should be for everyone.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Ah, I had thought you were born there.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Nope. I got there later, same as you.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Amanda. You know our story, but… I would very much like to hear yours.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: I grew up on the road. Long as I could remember, my family had been walking toward the Last City. My momma told me we'd be safe there. She said that was all that mattered. But at the time, all that mattered to me were the jumpships in the sky above. I thought they were the greatest thing I'd ever seen. My folks tried their best. But… the road's a dangerous place. when the House of Winter attacked, my momma fought 'em off best she could. Even killed a Captain before they shot her. Pneumonia got my daddy not long after. I'd heard tales of people resurrected. Chosen for immortality. But not them. They were just… gone. When I finally reached the Last City, I knew my momma was right. I'd be safe there. I was finally home. I learned to fly as soon as I could reach the stick. I never had powers like the Guardians, or a Ghost to resurrect me. But in the cockpit, I'm every inch as tough. Now, every time I fly, I remember where I came from… and who I'm fighting for. And that's all that matters.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Thank you, Amanda… for your story and your spirit.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Yeah, well… we've come a long way, huh?

title: We Stand Unbroken IV: Jailbreak — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Our scanners picked up a distress signal coming from a prison facility in the EDZ. We reckon it's a new bunch of captives. Mithrax and I are fixing to break them out.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I can splice the base security, but we will need a route for escape.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: That's where you come in, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Clear all opposition, that we may lead the prisoners to safety. And do not engage your Sparrow. The signal will alert our enemies.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Everyone solid? Then let's go get our people back!

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Guardian, kick down their front door while we slip in the back. We'll meet you inside.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: [static] Misraaks, I must speak with haste. Turn back now. This is not a fight you can win.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: You cannot share fear with us, Eramis, for the Light provides.

lines.speaker: Eramis
lines.text: Leave these captives, and live to see your Great Machine again. Pursue this quest, and you will die. [static]

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: The Shipstealer is allied with the Voice in the Darkness... but she does not speak lies. Perhaps there is something here we do not yet see.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: There's always something. I'm not leaving our people behind, no matter what.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: I think I found us an LZ, Guardian. We're going in through the roof.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: This was not the plan, Amanda Holliday. Are you certain this ship will fit?

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Only one way to find out!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Spider hated when I did things like this. Now… I see why.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Aaand… we're in! Next round's on you, Mithrax!

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: Amanda and I will now locate the security terminal.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Deal with those armored units, and we'll meet you on the other side.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: I see you, Guardian! I'm in the surveillance room above.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I am splicing the security network now. I will soon locate the captives.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hot damn, Guardian! You got a big dog incoming. Hold 'em off while Mithrax works!

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hoo boy! Taken energy readings are spiking. Looks like you ain't done yet.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: This is a tactic of desperation. You near victory, Guardian.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hoo! Glad we called you in for this one. We'd have been goners without you.

lines.speaker: Mithrax
lines.text: I have located the prisoners. We are nearly ready for extraction.

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Gotcha. Soon as the Guardian secures the hatch, we'll get everyone the hell outta here!

title: We Stand Unbroken IV: Briefing from Amanda Holliday — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Rally up, Guardian. I won't say we've got the Shadow Legion on the ropes just yet, but we're making progress. I meant to ask—how you handling all this Queensguard stuff? Only thing that's changed for me is that Crow bowed and asked if he should call me, "Lady Amanda of Holliday." I told him to call me whatever he wants. I'm just glad he's finally recognizing my natural authority. Anyway… I like how things have been shaking out lately. Tearing through magic planes to bust into a Shadow Legion ship uninvited? That's the kinda entrance Cayde would've liked. [chuckles softly] Enough talk. Let's get back out there.

title: We Stand Unbroken IV: Report to the Farm — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Devotion. Bravery. Sacrifice. Devotion… Bravery… Sacrifice…

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Guardian. Zavala grieves, and… Misraaks is recovering in the infirmary. How do you want to proceed?

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: We have to regroup. Bury Amanda… and put her killers in the ground.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Think with your head, not your heart. Grief is poor counsel.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: And yours is better? [exhales] Make arrangements for Amanda. The Guardian and I will handle it from here.

lines.speaker: Crow
lines.text: It is. I know you want it too. Vengeance. You'll be the first to know when it's time.
Wayfinder's Voyage I: Speak with Ikora Rey

title: We Stand Unbroken IV: Message from Devrim Kay — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Guardian, I'm glad I caught you. Mithrax and Amanda are out on patrol and called for a touch of backup. Seems they picked up another distress signal, and the outpost is absolutely crawling with Shadow Legion. I was surprised they called it in. Makes me think the odds are worse than they're letting on. Usually, those two can take care of themselves. I'm sending you their signal now. Head over and back them up, won't you?

title: We Stand Unbroken IV: Speak with Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: I have lived for centuries upon centuries, Guardian. Though death has not lost its sting, it is a ritual whose movements are familiar to me. It has become easier to bear. But… seeing loss twist the faces of those around me—Zavala, my brother—that has not. Amanda's absence will be felt deeply by those of us who knew her. Despair will be at our side where a friend once stood. So while it does not lighten the burden, let us hold this pain together. And when you lift your eyes, may you look only upon kind faces. I need to focus on the Queensguard now. When the time comes to strike back, we must all be strong. As strong as Amanda Holliday.

title: We Stand Unbroken V: Briefing from Devrim Kay — Transcript

lines.speaker: Devrim
lines.text: Guardian. I woke up this morning and looked out across the gray mists of Trostland, and I've got to tell you… my heart just wasn't in it. I didn't want justice, or revenge. It wouldn't bring her back. I felt… tired. I didn't want to fight anymore. But then, out in the distance… I spotted a deployment of Shadow Legion moving through the fog, pushing a group of prisoners before them. It's not about me. It's about them. So I picked up my rifle, and I got to work. We've got to fight on. Not just because we're in the Vanguard, or Queensguard, or because we're heroes, or all that rot. Because it's what Amanda would have done. And that's good enough for me.

title: We Stand Unbroken V: Speak with Mara Sov — Transcript

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: One cannot hear Zavala's words and remain unmoved. That man has borne suffering enough for many lifetimes. That is the price we pay for opening our hearts. And as the Voice in the Darkness extends its reach, we know only that few will finish this journey with us… For the path is long. As the nebulae whirl and billow above us, we remain. We endure. This is our privilege. Our duty. And our curse. Take heart, Guardian. Know that we will endure… together.
Wishing All the Best - Crow & Mara (Week 3)

title: We Stand Unbroken V: Speak with Zavala — Transcript

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: We've all died countless deaths. But we still only feel loss from the outside in. Holliday… She died doing what was necessary to protect the people of the City. She didn't do it out of obligation or circumstance. She knew it had to be done… and she believed in it to the end. She had one life… and she used it to save us. She set an example for us all. I… [exhales] I don't know what else to say. Amanda… I would give my Light, my last life, if it would bring her back. I’ve begged before. It’s a false hope. A lie. At every loss, the Traveler is silent. Each path I take leads me to a grave. Cayde. Safiyah. …Hakim. I failed them all. I love you, Amanda. I am so proud of you. Forgive me.

title: Welcome to Crimson Days — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Shaxx
lines.text: Crimson Days. We use these holidays to honor friendship. Camaraderie. Love, for those of us lucky enough to find it. Today is a celebration! And oh, how I've reveled in its making. You and your chosen partner - your Crimson Bond - will take on all comers in my Crucible… To prove whose bond reigns supreme. Don't do it for me, Guardian. Do it for your Crimson Bond.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Semaphore Signals VIII: Eido — Transcript

lines.text: Eliksni Quarter, Botza District, Last City
The Guardian listens to a message on the radio near The Ether Tank in the Eliksni Quarter.

lines.speaker: Eido
lines.text: Eramiskel. Again, I greet you in the Light. Not as my enemy, but as my savior. You protected me from the Lucent Hive. Without your intervention, I would have died at their hands. I thank you. I was terrified. Not only of the Hive, but of you. When you arrived, I thought it was to follow through on your threat. Then you turned and raised your blade against my assailants. But that same blade would have taken the life of my father, if you'd had the advantage. I am not afraid of what you are. But I am afraid of what you do. The Whirlwind led to you. It led to my father. But it led to me as well. We can see a future for the Eliksni beyond the pain of the Whirlwind, but you think you can't be a part of it. I do not believe that. My father spared you because he saw that you could turn from a path he had once followed. I see this also. I know the futility of this, but I will say it regardless: there is a place for you here. We need not be enemies. Come home, Eramis. May the Light provide.

title: What Remains — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Good. Any sign of the Sol Divisive?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Not a Vex in sight. You should be proud, Nimbus. Rohan's passkey worked perfectly. I guess they're still hurt over missing out on the action.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: All the more reason for them to stay out of the Garden. It has a way of… amplifying such emotions 'til they blot out all reason. So, quickly and quietly now. Find a Conceptual Mind, grab its memory core, and get out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Sol Divisive! How did they know we were here?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Focus on getting past them now. We can dwell on the "how" later.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Made it through! Though I still don't understand how that happened. Unless we tripped an alarm on the way in…

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It's possible. Perhaps Rohan's passkey had a flaw we didn't see.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: But why not attack where we portaled in? Why let us get so far?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Are you suggesting someone else tipped off the Sol Divisive?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: It's also disappointing. Stay on task. I'll go check on Nimbus.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Looks like someone beat us to the next security measure.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Sorry, friends! I couldn't sit this one out. I owe this to Rohan.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You owe it to Rohan to do your duty as a Cloud Strider.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Like you know what it means to be a Cloud Strider.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Nimbus, how did you even get in without a passkey?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Y'know that conflux you found back on Neomuna? Let's just say… those lasers were meant for more than just a light show.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Taken?! What are the Taken doing here?

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I don't know about your end, but they're slowing me down over here!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Be careful. If the Taken are there, you're in for an even tougher fight than we expected.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I suspect the Taken have been sent to do what the Sol Divisive refuse to: to cover the Witness's tracks. Completely.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: They're here for the Conceptual Mind.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Clearly, its knowledge presents a real threat to the Witness's plans. We need that memory core.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: No time to lose. Last one to the Conceptual Mind is a disappointment to Rohan's legacy!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: As if they needed more cause to act rashly. Guardian, you have to catch up with them, before it's too late.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Nimbus, I know you feel you have to do this for Rohan's sake, but—

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: Rohan is dead. I can't do anything for him anymore… except live up to what he taught me. A Cloud Strider does whatever it takes to keep Neomuna safe. We don't hesitate in the face of danger. We don't let pain stop us. We let it remind us that…

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: …You're still breathing, still fighting. Yes, I know. You shouldn't let pain stop you. But you can't let it propel you either. Trust me. That path only leads to more pain.

lines.speaker: Nimbus
lines.text: I found this. It's Cloud Strider tech, all right. Rohan probably ran right past this spot when he… Looking at this, all I can think of is how… Rohan didn't need weapons or fancy mods. Sure, he liked his gear, but… he didn't need all that to defend our city. To do his duty as a Cloud Strider… …Which is what I should be doing right now. You take it. Use it to get the blueprint. Meet me back in Neomuna when you're done, OK?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Osiris? We caught up with Nimbus. They're on their way back to Neomuna.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: You convinced them? Well done, Guardian. Must be your way with words. But you'll need more than that if you're to reach the Conceptual Mind before the Taken. Don't forget what you're here for.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Taken are pulling ahead! Time to really let loose, Guardian. We can't let them destroy the Conceptual Mind. …At least not until we get its memory core!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There's the Conceptual Mind! And its failed creation… or its god. Huh. I never really thought about that before. What kind of beings create their own god? And it's not even an original!

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Happens more than you'd think. Something to ponder AFTER the memory core's safely in hand.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Conceptual Mind is down for the count! Looks like the Taken have all cleared out. Why aren't they fighting us for the memory core?

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: I'm sure they were merely told to destroy the Black Heart's architect. I doubt they were aware its knowledge is the true threat.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: You really think this blueprint will help us with the Veil? After all, if the Black Heart was meant to be a copy of the Veil, it didn't exactly succeed.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: True. But even studying the failed attempt can lead to useful information. We won't know for certain until we open up the memory core… which will take some time, so hurry back. Besides, I'm sure our friend Nimbus could stand to hear some good news right about now.
Wayfinder's Voyage VI: Summoned by Mara Sov
Wishing All the Best - Mara & Osiris (Week 1)

title: Will of Crota — Transcript

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: Omnigul is the last of Crota's Generals. She is the architect of her masters wakening. As long as she lives, the threat of Crota's return will haunt this world. Track her down and exterminate every Hive that stands in your way.

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: A new Hive army is spawning under the Skywatch. This is Omnigul's doing. Find her.

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: Omnigul is wicked and desperate. Keep your Light safe.

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: The Hive have stirred the scavengers. Omnigul's clever, using the Fallen against you.

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: Omnigul's only purpose is to usher in Crota's return. If she lives, our fight against Crota's armies my never end.

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: Omnigul's only purpose is to usher in Crota's return. She failed, but wont stop fighting until her master's will is done

lines.speaker: Eris
lines.text: The agents of Crota's Will have been defeated. The Hive will not take this transgression lightly. But you Guardian have given them something new to fear.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum

title: Will of Crota (Heroic) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Remember Omnigul? Hive General with the lovely voice? She's back.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Vanguard scouts report she's undone her death.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Undone her death? You make it sound like she pulled her knitting apart.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: Eris would tell you not to make light of this.

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: There's no telling what else might follow Guardian. Destroy Omnigul and any lingering threats.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: If Omnigul can come back to life, how do we make sure she stays dead? I wonder if the Hive think that about us?

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: To the Hive, death is relative. We'll face Omnigul as many times as it takes.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Guess we were made for each other.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Be ready for anything. The Hive and Fallen here are more desperate than they have ever been.
Fireteam defeats Devil Splicers and Hive

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Guardian, you remind me of… well, Ikora, back in her Crucible days.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I'm sure Shaxx hasn't forgotten. He still has trouble sitting.
Fireteam encounter more Devil Splicers and Hive

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: The Cosmodrome is turning into a breeding ground for Hive and SIVA. Like one big disgusting petri dish.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Now that you're all warmed up, let's find Omnigul.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Omnigul is back and it's for a reason. And it's not just to yell, although she does seem fond of that. Finish her before it's too late.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: I can't believe that voice is coming out of such tiny animals. (Hive version only)

lines.speaker: Ikora Rey
lines.text: There are no further traces of Hive energy.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Welp! If she comes back, so will we. Look at us! Omnigul's neutralized and Eris didn't have to lift a finger.

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Trust me, she would prefer to hear it from you. Come on back Guardian. Good work.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
Wayfinder's Voyage VI: The Past Comes Knocking

title: Winters Run (Taken) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Cayde-6
lines.text: Those Fallen in the Ishtar Sink on Venus… story is they raided the Prison of Elders in the Reef. Got an Archon Priest. The Queen's bounty is high so we know it's powerful. We need to hunt this thing down before they fully restore its soul.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It won't take them long to restore the Archon Priest's soul. We'd better head for the caves.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We'll need to get through! I'll check it out.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: It's locked down tight. Just give me some time.
Fireteam discovers a group of parked fallen Pikes

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Think they'd mind if we take their Pikes?

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I was sure the Archon Priest was… Taken incoming! Get ready!
Fireteam defeats Nixis, Hunger of Oryx

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I'll contact the Vanguard and let them know what happened.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Fallen found the Prison of Elders, but then the Taken found the Fallen. Too bad for them. The Archon Priest was better off in the Prison.
Discuss this Transcript on our forum
A Play of Shadow and Light
Wayfinder's Voyage II: Summoned by Mara Sov

title: Will of the Thousands — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Xol is tearing apart Rasputin's Neural Network, and if he does enough damage, he could trigger a chain reaction that will devastate Mars. All I know is we have one advantage left… the Valkyrie.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: I'll never trust Rasputin, but we'll need every weapon we have to stop Xol… even one that's powered by a Warmind.
The Guardian defeats the Hive. Xol's roars shake the ground.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: If we overload Rasputin's core, we can use the excess energy to overcharge the Valkyrie. I think that's our only chance of really hurting Xol.
The Guardian fights against the Hive.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Open the cooling vents on the inhibitors. Then hit it with everything you've got.
The Guardian opens the vent on the inhibitor core and overloads it by shooting it.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Attention, Neural Net Inhibitor offline. Core power levels rising. Continued fluctuations will result in a critical failure. All personnel are advised to initiate safety protocols. Remember: a safe work environment is a happy work environment.
The Guardian heads further into the facility and enters a room with a Neural Node. Ghost scans the Neural Node.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Oh no. With the inhibitor offline, the Neural Network is going crazy. I'll try to stabilize it. Defend the area!
A horde of Hive appears. The Guardian defeats the waves of the Hive. A Kamus Wizard appears. The Guardian defeats the Kamus Wizard.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Got it! Neural Net is online and ready. Now for the inhibitor vent…
The Guardian continues to fight against the Hive.
The Guardian overloads the vent by throwing the Valkyrie into it.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Core power levels approaching critical overload. Personnel are recommended to evacuate.

The Guardian continues further into the facility and enters an open space with another inhibitor core. The Guardian defeats the Hive, then opens the vent on the inhibitor core and overloads it by shooting it.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Great work! Get to the core before it goes critical. It's time to forge a new Valkyrie.
The Guardian continues further into the facility and enters the room with the core. The Guardian defeats the Hive. Sulhava, Vassal to Xol, appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We could really use the Valkyrie right now.
The Guardian continues to fight against the Hive.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Stabilized! Kind of. But the Valkyrie is ready!
The Guardian defeats Sulhava, Vassal to Xol.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: All right. I need you to throw the Valkyrie into the core and force and full meltdown.
The Guardian throws the Valkyrie into the core.

lines.speaker: Concierge AI
lines.text: Complete core meltdown initiated. If you can hear this message, you are too close to the core.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Valkyrie is surging with energy far beyond what my sensors are capable of analyzing.
The Guardian takes the overcharged Valkyrie and defeats the Hive with it.
Xol, Will of the Thousands, appears.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I've never seen anything so powerful! Be careful.
The Guardian fights Xol, Will of the Thousands.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Try to hold on a little longer. Ana is bringing the Neural Net online!
Ana brings the Neural Net online.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Auxilliary power has been activated! Get to a node and power up the javelin!
The Guardian continues to fight Xol, Will of the Thousands.
The Guardian defeats Xol, Will of the Thousands.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: I can't believe it. You did it! You took down a worm god!

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: We all did. We're a team now, Ana. A good one.

The Guardian, Ana Bray and Zavala stand outside the entrance to Rasputin's core. The door opens and the three Guardians enter the chamber. They reach the end of the platform. Rasputin begins to speak in Russian. Ana translates what he says.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: The Bray family shaped me to be an all-seeing savior… while your Vanguard sough to wield me as a primitive weapon. But today, that ends, and I define the reality of my own existence.
The outside of the Mindlab is shown, where Rasputin is firing Warsats into orbit.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: My sight will stretch to the edge of the system and beyond. Never again will a threat go unseen.
The chamber with Rasputin, Ana Bray, Zavala and the Guardian is shown.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: From this day forward, I will defend Humanity on my own terms. I am Rasputin, Guardian of all I survey. I have no equal.
Ana places her hand on the terminal at the end of the platform. The terminal scans her hand and an image of Ana's Clovis Bray ID appears.

lines.speaker: Ana Bray
lines.text: Are you familiar with the phrase, "Be careful what you wish for"? Yeah. It's something that's been running through my head since watching Rasputin launch a brand new Warsat network... under his sole control. I should be afraid. Any rational person would be. But I'm not. I know without a question, that no matter what comes next, we can face it together.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Back from scheming with Mara, are you? Fear not, O Guardian mine. I hold no contempt for those who prepare... contingencies. In fact, that is what I respect most about Mara. She is wise not to trust me, as I have never trusted her. For ages, Awoken and Ahamkara were both allies and adversaries, each seeking to extract a victory from the other. That is the nature of all bargains: to relinquish as little as possible while securing all you desire.
Our bargain is no different. It is not built on trust, but on the knowledge that upholding it will benefit us both... And that breaking it will result in more suffering than you can imagine.

We must wait for another egg to drift across the Ley Lines and re-enter our reality. Continue securing my lair until then. Those who trespass within it have nothing to bargain with, and are thus of no use to me. You would do well to keep that in mind.

I would love to find amusement in their inadequacy — make a meal of it. However… The task of helping those who can't help themselves has fallen on your shoulders again. Something of the Ahamkara in you, perhaps? The lodestone must be attuned to the Confluence. Like teaching a compass where north lies. I've simplified, of course. For your sake. The calibration will take some time. Should I pray for you to make it out alive?

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Techeuns are in final preparations for the Lodestone. Your work in its calibration was invaluable. It will serve as a beacon for the queen to make contact with her personal Harbinger. She'll commune with it — ask it to guide the remainder of the clutch back to us. It's the last of its kind… and it's good to see a Harbinger, normally a weapon of war, used for diplomacy. Even with Riven. In the past, the pinnacle of the Spine of Keres provided the open sky the queen needed for this communion. It will suffice again. But the Taken contest that region, as they have since Riven’s curse rang out. They will hinder your every step. So cut through them. Secure the spine, and the queen will do the rest.

title: Wishing All the Best - Speak to Riven (Week 2) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian speaks to Riven’s spirit.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: A timely arrival, Guardian. Another egg from my clutch will soon pass by our reality. You should prepare to claim it. It is a strange turn of events that they were cast into the Ascendant Plane. Strange… but not unintentional, I suspect. Ask yourself: who would benefit from such a situation? Who wields the requisite mastery over the Ley Lines? Who has a history of sequestering the Ahamkara to keep them hidden? I said before that I do not trust Mara Sov. Tell me… do you? She offers you praise and gifts. Bequeaths to you a share of her power. Is she so different from an Ahamkara? From me? Do you truly believe she wishes for nothing in return? Know this, Guardian: I have been forthright about what I stand to gain from our arrangement… a future for my otherwise extinct kind. Mara, on the other hand… what does SHE stand to gain?

title: Wishing All the Best - Speak with Osiris  (Week 2) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, we are coming to the final moments. These choices, these risks… They mean everything. Mara requests I provide some small… measure of insurance should Riven prove too perilous a gamble. I've learned the Veil is linked to the Traveler. That this link was not created. It is a primal truth of their existence, er… a pairing. The Witness accessed this link through your Ghost. The motions of what it did are written in the Veil's own memory. But like an incantation, without the ritual, the understanding — the words, so to speak — the motions are useless. My attempts to recreate what the Witness did, to follow it, have been... inadequate. And dangerous. I — I must temper my ambitions. The Veil is the power of consciousness, made manifest in our physical world. It whispers an electromagnetic language that resonates with our minds…One that can be deciphered, but not by the laws we wield in this universe. Ah, it's no easy task. If there is another way to follow the Witness, I'll find it here, on Neptune. It will take time, as all things do. Continue to aid Mara, and I will uncover what knowledge I can.

title: Wishing All the Best - Speak to Riven (Week 1) — Transcript

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: Greetings, O Guardian mine. I always knew we could work together. I speak to you now with my true voice. Consider it... a sign of trust. The need for deceit has passed. My corporeal death freed me from the Taken curse. My bargain with their king has expired. These Techeuns train themselves to conjure my essence. They cannot do so forever. Savathûn's wish will be the last I grant. Mara has made it clear the terms of our agreement. Retrieve my clutch of uncorrupted eggs, and I will uphold my end of the bargain. Obviously, I cannot gather the eggs myself. Instead, I will guide you to them, through the halls of my former lair. And beware, Guardian. You may find it a place most unwelcoming.

title: Wishing All the Best -  Speak with Osiris (Week 3) — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian interacts with the holoprojector.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Guardian, I'm afraid progress is slow. The Veil is a clever tangle in and of itself. It reforms as the consciousnesses connected to it ebb and flow. They rush in, awash with dreams and wonder, and then drain away. I believed that once I understood the Veil — mechanically — once I understood Strand, that I would see its patterns with new clarity. That has not happened. This is not like charting a course through the currents of a sea or the depths of space. It is an architecture defined by how we intend to imagine it. Not dissimilar to the Ascendant Plane… but if more like its opposite. The Ascendant Plane mirrors aspects of our world, aspects of will and import to those who traverse it. Those aspects are decided upon through our actions. The Veil, conversely, weaves not with our will, not our decisions, but with intent, unfiltered by logic. What we feel, not what we decide. Mapping such a thing would be like… rebuilding a creature from the calcified remains we’ve found aboard the Pyramid ships. They are an image of a dissection. A deadened echo of existence. But to look at them as they are, to see their disparate parts… even understanding their anatomy does not give us the knowledge to make them as they were. I will continue to seek the path the Witness forged into the Traveler, but I am… no longer confident that it could ever be walked again. Riven may be our only option.

After gathering all the missing pages from the Black Armory papers, the Guardian speaks to Ada-1.

lines.speaker: Ada-1
lines.text: Her name was Henriette. She was our founder. And… my mother. All along, one and the same. I can't believe I never knew. The last page was a letter. Written to me. To me. Her death was self-sacrifice. To save me. I will not waste this second chance at life. But… she is only one of two reasons I stand here today. You are the other. There are not enough gifts from the Black Armory to show my appreciation. But know: you are always welcome here.

title: Wolves' Gambit — Transcript

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The House of Wolves is on the march. They're surrounding Vex strongholds across the Ishtar Sink. Every soldier under his command is down there.
Skolas has either gone completely insane, or he's become a tactical genius. I love fieldwork, but the hunt must end. Now.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Skolas said, "I am Kell of Kells. All Houses shall burn. All will bow before Wolf Banner."

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: I'm getting a Fallen comm channel interlaced with Vex coding. Whatever he's doing, I've never seen anything like this before. He's mad!
Guardian arrives at Vault of Glass, Waking Ruins

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Okay, that's not a good sign. The Wolves are assaulting the Vault of Glass. What is Skolas planning?
They've…they've cracked the seal on the Vault. Get in there, Guardian. We have to stop them!

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Skolas has gone crazy is the good version here. I've seen reports from Prince Uldren's Crows, reports about the technology of the Vault. Really just, awful stuff.

lines.speaker: Variks
lines.text: Bad. Very bad. Wolves trying to tap Oracles. Big glowing squares. Guardian, destroy the Oracles. Destroy them fast.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: Variks, good work. Guardian, even better. Clear out the rest of those Wolves and we'll talk.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj

lines.speaker: Variks

title: Uldren’s Death — Transcript

lines.text: Courtyard, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Do not think for a moment that I shed a tear over… Uldren's death. In another life… I would have killed him myself. But we are Guardians. One life is nothing when weighed against the lives of an entire people on the very precipice of extinction. When you pursued vengeance into a foreign dominion, you put all of those lives at risk. The death of Uldren Sov will have its consequences. Maybe not today. Maybe not tomorrow. But the day will come. I hope we will survive it.
Bazaar, The Tower, The Last City, Earth

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I realized the other day… Cayde may have been my… healthiest relationship. My Hidden agents I must keep at a distance. Zavala and I rarely see eye-to-eye anymore. My Ghost and I - it's complicated. And Osiris? You know that story. As for you… I have only ever been a supporting character in your story. But Cayde was just… my friend. My ridiculous, funny, constant friend. If we don't fight for our friends, what are we fighting for? What I'm trying to say is… I'm proud of you. And… thank you.

lines.speaker: Petra Venj
lines.text: The Techeuns’ calculations look promising so far. The next egg should be close. Be cautious. The Taken have already gained a foothold here.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: They spread their influence with mindless fervor— much like Awoken royalty.

lines.text: Wrath of the Queen, this is not your fight. Somewhere out there, a pack of doomed corsairs waits for you.

lines.speaker: Mara Sov
lines.text: Absent a commanding will, the Taken return to more… basic directives. Their corruption may reshape these halls. Deal with them, before the path collapses around us.

title: Zavala and Osiris Meet with Empress Caiatl — Transcript

lines.text: Commander Zavala and Osiris meet with Caiatl.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Even my people have a word for peace, but we do not use it often — or lightly. I wouldn't have summoned you if I was not sincere.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: The Darkness crowds the edges of this system. The Hive serves it. You'll fall to one, if not the other. My world did.

lines.speaker: Zavala
lines.text: Empress Caiatl, I'm sorry for what you've lost.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: We have all suffered. I propose an alliance.

lines.speaker: Osiris
lines.text: Cabal don't ally. They conquer. She betrayed her father to Ghaul. Don't think she won't put a gilded knife in your back too.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: As you do. Humanity won't survive unless the commander expands his horizons. Join my empire. You'll keep your title and gain a seat on my war council. With my army and your Light, the Cabal will crush the Hive. Then… the Black Fleet. Bow.

Psions take aim at Zavala and Osiris while Caiatl's guards step forward and ready their weapons. Zavala's Ghost disappears as the guards behind them step closer. Caiatl raises her hand and her forces stand down.

lines.speaker: Caiatl
lines.text: Very well. Ready yourself, Commander. I'll sharpen my gilded knife — and see you both on the battlefield.
Zavala and Osiris peacefully leave the vicinity.

title: Vex Offensive: Final Assault — Transcript

lines.text: The Guardian hacks the Vex gate network and defeats the Vex which appear. Six Oracles appear. The Guardian defeats multiple Gate Technician Minotaurs and uses the Void Craniums which the Gate Technicians drop to destroy the Oracles. The Guardian heads further into the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: When Guardians last faced the Undying Mind, the Vex were trying to seal the Garden to resurrect the Black Heart. The object of their worship. Darkness incarnate. I wonder if that's still the case… or if the Pyramid forced a change of priority.

The Guardian hacks the Vex gate network and defeats the Vex which appear. Twelve Oracles appear. The Guardian defeats multiple Gate Technician Minotaurs and uses the Void Craniums which the Gate Technicians drop to destroy the Oracles. The Guardian heads further into the Black Garden.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: There are hundreds, maybe thousands of copies of the Undying Mind lurking in the network. The only way we'll put an end to the Vex incursions on the Moon is by destroying every last one. We've got a lot of work ahead of us. This fight is just step one.
The Guardian reaches the area to plant the transmat beacon that will draw out the Undying Mind.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Ikora's portal should wrench the Undying Mind from wherever - whenever - it might be hiding. Be ready. Once the beacon is deployed, there's no turning back.
The Guardian plants the transmat beacon. The Undying Mind comes through Ikora's portal. The Guardian defeats the Undying Mind.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: Great work, Guardian. That's one Undying Mind down. But there are still a great many more left to go. Fortunately for us, we're not alone in this fight.

title: We Stand Unbroken III: Debriefing from Amanda Holliday — Transcript

lines.speaker: Holliday
lines.text: Hell of a time on that Shadow Legion ship, wasn't it? 'Course, I joined for other reasons too. You heard the story: I needed a home, a family… someplace to belong, just like Mithrax. He's amazing to work with. He's always so gentle around the Tower. I forget he's an Eliksni war captain. But man, I learned quick when we started tackling those prison transports. Once, he got jumped by two Legionaries, and when I turned to help, he just shouted, "You need not waste your shells!" Man, he's a tough old bastard, and I absolutely love it. Bringing the fight to them for a change? That's the kinda thing I joined the Vanguard for. He's the best patrol partner I've had in years… but I gotta keep our comms closed. Last week, Devrim heard me call him "crawdaddy"—nearly laughed himself unconscious.

title: Visions of Light — Transcript

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: I understand your visions have taken the form of trees. I've seen them too. I went back to Io for answers. The last place the Traveler touched. Io will react to your arrival… if you let it.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: I put us down right in front of the crater where the Traveler touched Io.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Vanguard maps have it marked as "Last Eden."
Some form of energy bursts from the crater.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Whatever you saw was for you and you alone. The Traveler is speaking to you. Eyes up, Guardian.
The Guardian finds a small tree.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: Devotion inspires bravery. Bravery inspires sacrifice. Sacrifice… leads to death.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: These are different from the other trees we saw…

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: These visions are constructs of the Traveler's Light. And Light reacts to its surroundings.
The Guardian finds another small tree with several Taken Thrall feeding from the ground surrounding it.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: The Garden grows in both directions. It grows into tomorrow and yesterday. The red flowers bloom forever.
The Guardian defeats the Taken Thrall.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Taken can see the trees. No… they sense the Light.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Taken are weeds, Guardian. Pull them up.
The Guardian sees another burst of energy. The guardian finds a few more small trees together with a number of Taken. The Guardian defeats the Taken and proceeds to another tree surrounded by Taken.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: You might have been kings and queens of the Deep! But you have toppled Oryx, and you have not replaced him!
The Guardian defeats the Taken and destroys the Taken Blight above the tree. Another burst of energy can be seen. The Guardian finds another tree surrounded by Taken.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: Humanity must have protectors… Will you stand with me?

The Guardian defeats the Taken and destroys the Taken Blight above the tree. Another burst of energy can be seen. The Guardian finds several more trees including another tree that is surrounded by Taken. Kurumo, the Uprooter can be seen in the distance.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: … Even the stars are brighter now… the whole cosmos is ablaze…
The Guardian defeats the Taken and destroys the Taken Blight above the tree.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: The Traveler's been alive for a year. Why has it waited so long to speak to us?

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: The Traveler gave you a vision even before its rebirth. When Ghaul blocked its Light, the Traveler showed you a path forward. The road to recovery is long, but when we grow stronger, so too does the Traveler.

The Guardian finds the Vex, including Outopos, Stranded, fighting against the Taken, including Val Hragan, Lighteater. The Guardian defeats the Vex, including Outopos, Stranded, and the Taken, including Val Hragan, Lighteater. The Guardian heads further into the tunnels. The Guardian finds Kurumo, the Uprooter, near another tree. The Guardian destroys the Taken Blight above the tree.

lines.speaker: Vision of Light
lines.text: The Light lives in all places, in all things. You can block it, even try to trap it. But the Light will find its way. And the Traveler will defend itself.
The Guardian defeats Kurumo, the Uprooter.
The Guardian examines the tree. The tree is cleansed and grows leaves.

lines.speaker: Ikora
lines.text: Congratulations, Guardian. Remember, when we channel the light, we connect to something much bigger than any one of us. Even departed sparks – like Cayde's – still leave a trace in this luminous web we call the Light.
Several trees appear surrounded by Light. The Guardian defeats the Taken.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage III: In the Shadow of the Past — Transcript

lines.text: In the Shadow of the Past
The Guardian speaks to Crow after Petra has barred him from speaking to Savathûn.

lines.speaker: The Crow
lines.text: Venj thinks I'm vulnerable, and I'm supposed to just take a seat? Like I was the only one fooled by Savathûn wearing Osiris's skin? You'd known him far longer than I thought I had, but I don't see her forbidding you from speaking to her. Because it's not about me. It's about who I was, isn't it? Every time the Vanguard tells me that things will get better, I thank them. As if it's a privilege not to be beaten to death. Our past lives aren't supposed to matter. I'm beginning to wonder why I'm the only Guardian being judged by mine. No more apologies. No more creeping around on eggshells. I deserve an audience with Savathûn. I deserve to know how much of what she told me as Osiris was a lie. I deserve answers.
